jobs.title: Associate Chemist - PFAS Analysis - 2nd Shift, Tues-Sat
jobs.description:
Company Description

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate.

Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies.

Job Description

Position Summary:

The Associate Chemist prepares and analyzes environmental samples using standard analytical techniques according to approved scientific methodology in compliance with Eurofins Environment Testing Quality Assurance programs and standard operating procedures (SOPs). This position can be a physical job that may require standing for long periods, working with organic solvents, laboratory glassware and specialized equipment.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Performs routine lab tasks that provide experience and familiarization with methods, practices, and programs. These include:
Preparation of samples using standard techniques
Performing chemical analysis using standard techniques
Evaluation and quantification of data
Recording and reporting data and any unusual test occurrences to the supervisor
Performing routine instrument maintenance

Competency in complex instrumentation instrument specific software (training is provided)
Responsible for keeping personal training documentation (training records, IDOC/DOC) current and accurate
Responsible for timely completion of assigned/scheduled QC samples (MDL, LOD/LOQ, PT)
As required, documents NCMs for projects with quality issues
Understands and utilizes backlog reports to manage personal workload
Works under close supervision using routine and standard methods
Regular attendance and punctuality
Responsible for general housekeeping in work area
Proficient with IDOCs, for assigned methods carried out in the department
Responsible for performing job functions in compliance with Eurofins Environment health and safety and quality assurance standards
Demonstrates and promotes the company vision
Inventories and stocks laboratory supplies
Washes and inventories glassware
Purges analyzed samples
Assists in other areas of laboratory when needed
Additional duties as assigned

Follow and learn appropriate protocols in one or more of the following disciplines. This role will focus on PFAS Analysis and LC/MS.

Organic preparation
Metals preparation and analysis
PFAS sample preparation
HRMS sample preparation
Gas Chromatography
Liquid Chromatography
Mass Spectrometry
Radio Chemistry
Wet Chemistry
High Resolution preparation and analysis
Low Resolution preparation and analysis

This position is 2nd shift, Tues-Sat, 3pm -1130pm. Training will be M-F 7am-3:30pm.

Qualifications

Basic Minimum Qualifications

BS or BA in Chemistry or related field, Associate Degree, or 2 years of related laboratory experience in lieu of degree.
Professional working proficiency in English is a requirement, including the ability to read, write and speak in English.
Authorization to work in the United States without restriction or sponsorship

Ideal Candidates Will Have

Previous experience with PFAS and/or LC/MS
Previous experience in a lab or production setting
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
Able to interpret written materials and communicate findings effectively.
Demonstrated ability to identify issues, analyze root causes, and propose practical solutions.
Applies critical thinking to evaluate options and make decisions.
Effective collaboration skills to contribute to team goals and support department productivity goals
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage priorities and meet deadlines.
Effectively balances multiple tasks while maintaining accuracy.
Comfortable using mathematical formulas and tools to perform calculations and analyze data.
Consistently delivers high-quality work within established timelines and specifications.
Able to work independently, following written or verbal instructions with minimal oversight.
Strong interpersonal skills; able to coordinate tasks and communicate effectively both verbally and in writing.

Additional Information

Pay rate: $18-19/hour + 10% shift differential

Please note - Eurofins Environment Testing (USA) provides a compensation range for informational purposes, the actual base salary may vary based upon, but not limited to, relevant experience and skill set, base salary of internal peers, business sector, and geographic location.

As a Eurofins employee, you will become part of a company that has received national recognition as a great place to work. We offer excellent full-time benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, life and disability insurance, 401(k) with company match, paid holidays, paid time off, and dental and vision options.

The benefits package offered will vary based on the employee’s full-time or part-time regular status.

We support your development!
Do you feel you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development.

We embrace diversity!
Eurofins network of companies believe in strength and innovation through diversity, being an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique.

Sustainability matters to us!
At Eurofins, we believe sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. Guided by our vision to be the Global Leader in “Testing for Life,” our mission to contribute to a healthier and safer world, and our core values, we are building a strong foundation for Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives. Eurofins’ commitment to sustainability begins within our own companies through a shared responsibility to people and the planet. With climate change posing an imminent threat, Eurofins and its many companies recognize their duty to proactively reduce or offset the environmental impact of essential operations while also helping our clients do the same—serving as a true ESG Enabler.

Find out more in our career page: https://careers.eurofins.com/

The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and Eurofins Scientific agroscience contract research services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialized and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 35 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 61,000 staff across a decentralized and entrepreneurial network of ca. 900 laboratories in 61 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2025, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 7.296 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

Your impact

As an Environmental Remediation Project Manager
based in Texas, you’ll play a crucial role in cleaning up our communities and improving our environment.

What You’ll Do

Lead and Manage Projects Plan, staff, schedule, and budget projects while ensuring quality, consistency, and safety.
Collaborate and Coordinate Work with subcontractors, internal support staff, and subject matter experts.
Technical Excellence Analyze data, prepare technical reports, and design and implement pilot studies and remedial systems.

Here's what you'll need

Education Bachelor’s degree in environmental engineering, civil engineering, environmental science, geology, or a related technical field.

jobs.title: Environmental Compliance Manager
jobs.description:
About Atlas

Atlas is a trusted leader in environmental and infrastructure consulting services; we provide services that enable communities to flourish and thrive. With a team of 3,500 employees and offices throughout the US, we combine local expertise and a network of relationships to deliver solutions to both public and private clients. Our services help improve the quality of life in the communities where we live and work. We always aim for smart, safe, and sustainable results. At Atlas we understand that our future is everyone’s responsibility, and we create a better experience at every stage of a project.

Job Description

As an Environmental Compliance Manager (Project Manager), you will lead environmental compliance efforts for industrial and commercial clients while supporting brownfield redevelopment across the Ohio Valley.

This role combines technical expertise, project leadership, and client partnership. You will help organizations stay compliant, reduce risk, and operate responsibly—while contributing to projects that revitalize communities and protect the environment.

Core Responsibilities

Lead environmental compliance programs across air, water, waste, and chemical regulations (CAA, CWA/NPDES, RCRA, EPCRA, TSCA), ensuring client operations meet all applicable requirements.
Manage permits, reporting, and compliance documentation—maintaining accurate records and ensuring all regulatory deadlines are met.
Serve as a primary point of contact for clients, regulators, and project partners—providing clear guidance on compliance strategy and requirements.
Conduct compliance audits, identify gaps, and implement corrective actions to reduce risk and maintain audit-ready operations.
Lead SPCC and SWPPP program implementation, inspections, and corrective actions to support safe and compliant site operations.
Support project delivery by managing scope, schedule, budget, and team coordination, including assigning work and tracking progress.
Contribute to business growth through client relationship management, proposal development, and identifying new opportunities.
Support environmental site assessments and brownfield projects while tracking regulatory changes and translating them into actionable updates.

You’ll thrive here if you have

5–10+ years of environmental compliance experience in industrial, manufacturing, or energy/chemical environments, with direct responsibility for permits, reporting, and audits.
Strong working knowledge of EPA and state regulations (CAA, CWA/NPDES, RCRA, EPCRA/Tier II/TRI, TSCA) and ability to interpret and apply requirements in real-world settings.
Proven experience managing compliance programs, closing audit findings, and implementing corrective actions across teams.
Hands-on experience with permitting and reporting programs (e.g., air permits/Title V, SWPPP, SPCC, NPDES, hazardous waste, Tier II/TRI).
Experience conducting or managing Phase I/II Environmental Site Assessments and supporting site history research.
Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, track deadlines, and deliver high-quality work on time and on budget.
Clear and practical communication skills, with the ability to translate complex regulatory requirements for clients, operators, and stakeholders.
Detail-oriented and accountable, with strong organizational, analytical (Excel/data), and problem-solving skills; certifications (e.g., PE, CHMM, QEP, CPESC) are a plus.

What You Can Expect From Us

The A-Team Experience is our employee program focused on helping our people thrive professionally, personally and as part of a community. We trust our people to do great work and live fulfilling lives, and we provide resources that care for our people, both at work and in life:

Health & Wellness: We offer medical, dental and vision coverage with multiple plan options, including no-cost employee-only medical coverage.
Time Off & Family Support: We offer vacation time, paid holidays, sick & safety leave (SSL) and paid parental leave
Retirement: We help employees plan for the future with a 401(k) and company match.
Insurance: To provide protection and peace of mind, we offer Life, AD&D (Accidental Death & Dismemberment) and Disability insurance.
Safety Program: We are committed to safety as part of our ‘quality of life’ core value, and we provide approved PPE at no cost and reimbursement for prescription safety glasses and protective footwear.
Learning & Development: We provide clear career paths, learning resources and development programs allowing you to see how you can grow and advance within the company. We offer internal certifications on specific skills and support external credentials through tuition reimbursement.
Belonging: We support Employee Communities (ECs), voluntary, employee-led groups that create connections, belonging and shared purposes.
Flexibility: May vary by project demands and regional workloads, but we are committed to providing reasonable accommodation to help employees manage their personal and professional responsibilities.

Our people and our culture are central to our work. Our values bring us together, create a sense of belonging and give us purpose. They guide how we make decisions, how we work as a team and how we serve our clients.

Life: We enhance the quality of life. We value people and safety above all else.
Heart: As our hallmark, we act with compassion, empathy, and respect.
Trust: We work together as partners, doing what we say with full accountability.
Mastery: Always striving for the highest quality, greatness inspires our work.

About The Job

Career Level: Professional
Employment Type: Full-time

jobs.description:
Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

AECOM is actively seeking a talented and experienced Project Manager for employment in our Austin, TX office. This position will support the Environmental business line, primarily overseeing Federal environmental remediation projects.

Other responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to, those listed below:
Familiar with project invoicing and cash flow management
Manages and directs professional and technical staff to complete complex environmental projects
Leads teams by utilizing advanced scientific principles, theories, and practices
Utilizes existing technologies and experience to develop technical solutions to complex problems
Interprets and records data, conducts analyses, compares findings to relevant studies and local, state, and federal regulations to ensure compliance
Analyzes financial statements and completes budget tracking
Performs work with minimal direction with periodic reporting to area manager
Oversees the preparation of work plans and organizes project studies
Performs complex assignments often requiring the development of unique solutions to problems with the support of the project team
Supervises junior and mid-level staff during all phases of project work
Conducts reviews and provides staff feedback for continued improvement

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements

BA/BS in Geology, Engineering, or related field with + 6 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education
A valid driver's license is required, along with the ability to pass a Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check in accordance with company policy.
Due to the nature of the work U.S. Citizenship is required.

Preferred Qualifications

Professional License (PE, PG, PMP, CHMM, or similar)
10+ years’ experience in environmental remediation (soil, groundwater, surface water, sediment, PFAS, munitions) project management
Master’s degree in Geology, Environmental, Civil, or Chemical Engineering, or related field
Experience with regulator and stakeholder negotiations
Experience successfully managing environmental projects for Federal clients (USACE, AFCEC, Navy)
Thorough working knowledge of RCRA and CERCLA
Detail oriented with strong organizational and communication, both verbal and written skills
Experience in team management and scheduling of staff and resources to ensure on time and on budget project delivery
Superior communication, writing, editing, and reporting skills for a wide variety of audiences
Experience preparing proposals, cost estimates, schedules, and change orders
Interest in business development
Have led teams of professionals in executing Site Investigations, Remedial Investigations, Feasibility Studies, Risk Assessment, Treatability Studies, Remedial Design, and Remedial Action Construction, in support of Federal environmental projects
Occasional overnight travel required

Additional Information

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

Offered rate of compensation will be based on individual education, qualifications, experience, and work location. The range for this position is $120000 to $140000.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. jobs.description:
PLEASE READ THIS JOB ANNOUCEMENT IN ITS ENTIRETY. An Alameda County Job Application is required to be considered for ALL County recruitments.

Alameda County, Environmental Health Department,
is recruiting for a provisional appointment: HAZARDOUS MATERIALS SPECIALIST

Join our dynamic motivated and compassionate team.

$114,129.60-$136,697.60 Annually

Plus, an excellent benefits package!

This is a provisional recruitment.

*Provisional Appointments:
For a provisional appointment, a civil service exam is not required. However, to obtain a regular position, the appointee will need to compete successfully in a County Exam when open.

ABOUT US

Alameda County
Department of Environmental Health Environmental Health programs impact the lives of Alameda County citizens every hour of each day. Our work protects and enhances the health and quality of life by ensuring food and recreational safety, reducing exposures to toxins and pests, protecting the quality of our water, air, the physical environment and so much more. In many other ways, we work to make your community better as our goal is always environmental health protection.

Learn more about us!

https://deh.acgov.org/index.page

The POSITION

Under general direction, conducts hazardous waste investigations and evaluates and interprets problems of environmental and public health hazards. This position works under the general direction of a Supervising Hazardous Materials Specialist.

DISTINGUISHING FEATURES

The Hazardous Materials Specialists are located in the Certified Unified Program Agency (CUPA), Local Oversight Program (LOP), and the Household Hazardous Waste (HHW) Program, of the Environmental Health Department. Incumbents conduct investigations and site data analysis for industrial, governmental and community sites regarding possible health hazards, environmental impact, or regulatory compliance concerns. The Hazardous Materials Specialist is distinguished from the Environmental Health Specialist in that the latter is primarily responsible for environmental and public health impacts associated with the improper use or storage of hazardous materials or has responsibility for the safe operation of Household Hazardous Waste Facilities, HHWF's. The handling and managing of hazardous waste require a comprehensive knowledge of the hazardous materials field. Incumbents receive directions from a Supervising Hazardous Materials Specialist.

EXAMPLE OF DUTIES

NOTE: The following are the duties performed by employees in this classification. However, employees may perform other related duties at an equivalent level. Each individual in the classification does not necessarily perform all duties listed.

1. Makes recommendations for the elimination, minimization, or control of hazardous conditions; evaluates hazardous waste at the phase of generation, transportation and disposal.

2. Interprets industrial health standards; provides information to the public; prepares correspondence; reports on investigations and evaluations. Provides educational outreach to schools, professional organizations, and other members of the public.

3. Represents the Hazardous Materials/Waste Program in collaboration with industrial hygiene engineers, physicians, safety engineers and representatives of private industry, public utilities and other governmental agencies; provides technical consultation and formal training to management, labor organizations, governmental agencies and civic groups regarding complex hazardous material problems and issues.

4. Gathers supportive data and may prepare documents for the District Attorney’s Office or other administrative agencies to initiate possible prosecution of violations of applicable hazardous materials codes

5. Operates computer systems for data entry and retrieval.

When assigned to the CUPA Program:

6. Conducts routine environmental surveys; investigates potential community health hazards; evaluates work sites; ensures compliance with applicable laws and regulations and local ordinances.

7. Responds to emergency hazardous materials incidents within the County’s jurisdiction; documents, identifies, assesses risk and advises on clean up.

HAZARDOUS MATERIALS SPECIALIST

https://www.jobapscloud.com/Alameda/specs/classspecdisplay.asp?ClassNumber=5650&R1=undefined&R3=undefined

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Education:

Possession of a Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university with a major in industrial hygiene, environmental health science, physical science, engineering science or a related field.

AND

Experience:

The equivalent of two years of increasingly responsible, full-time experience in hazardous materials management, environmental health inspections, industrial hygiene practices, operations of a HHWF, or in a research and resources recovery program in a hazardous materials program. (A Master's degree in an appropriate field may be substituted for the equivalent of year of the required experience).

License:

Possession of a valid California State Motor Vehicle Operator's license.

Certification:

Incumbents must be certified under applicable Occupational Health and Safety standards as established within HAZWOPER guidelines within 6 months of appointment.

Special Requirement
:
The Certified Unified Program Agency requires possession of the minimum experience requirement specifically to include:

CUPA programs such as hazardous waste generator, hazardous materials business plan, underground storage tanks, aboveground storage tanks, Cal ARP and storm water programs; investigating community health hazards; evaluating occupational work sites and ensuring compliance with the applicable laws and regulations.

Responding to emergency hazardous materials incidents (including the documentation, identification, risk assessment, and advisement of clean up)

NOTE: The Civil Service Commission may modify the above Minimum Qualifications in the announcement of an examination.

The Environmental Specialist is responsible for the administration and enforcement of environmental programs related to shoreline management and aquatic invasive species (AIS) within Kandiyohi County. This position involves overseeing shoreline alteration permitting and AIS prevention efforts. The role requires coordination with various local, state, and federal agencies, as well as watercraft users and the public.

Job Duties:
Oversee shoreline alteration permitting according to the Kandiyohi County Shoreland Ordinance, including grading, filling, vegetative alterations, retaining walls, decks, boat houses, and other structures within shoreland areas.
Conduct field inspections to ensure compliance with shoreline management regulations and document findings. Coordinate with Kandiyohi Soil and Water Conservation District and MN DNR Conservation Officers on enforcement actions and implementing restoration orders when violations are identified. 
Provide public education and guidance regarding shoreline best management practices.
Assist in the implementation and administration of the Kandiyohi County Zoning Ordinance.
Help prepare for and attend planning and zoning public hearings.
Assist with the permitting, installation, and inspection of subsurface sewage treatment systems (SSTS) within the county.
Develop and deliver training and educational materials for AIS prevention and proper inspection procedures.
Supervise and support seasonal AIS watercraft inspectors and decontamination specialists.
Use scheduling tools, such as WhenIWork, to manage AIS staff schedules based on public water access site usage and staff availability.
Monitor, inspect, and decontaminate equipment as required, including watercraft, trailers, and docks.
Lead watercraft inspections and decontaminations at designated lakes, including surveying and community outreach.
Perform regular staff support checks, maintain professional communication, and enforce adherence to AIS procedures.
Serve as AIS Coordinator to address emerging challenges and improve work conditions.
Maintain accurate records of inspections, decontaminations, and compliance checks.
Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:
Associate degree or Bachelor’s Degree in Environmental Studies, Biology, Natural Resource Management, or a related field preferred. Equivalent combinations of relevant certifications, education, and/or experience will be considered.
Minimum of two years of experience in environmental management or related areas.
Supervisory experience in program management or environmental services preferred.

Supplemental Information:
Knowledge:
Shoreland alteration permitting and AIS management.
Relevant environmental laws and regulations at the local, state, and federal levels.
Techniques for shoreline inspection, permitting, and enforcement.
Watercraft inspection and decontamination procedures.
Best practices in program management, training, and public outreach.
Basic computer applications, including Excel, Microsoft Office, GIS, and scheduling software.

Skills:

Performing field inspections and evaluations of shoreland areas and watercraft.
Conducting staff training and public information sessions.
Preparing and maintaining accurate reports and records.
Using computer software for data management and scheduling.
Communicating effectively with stakeholders, including the public, agency personnel, and watercraft users.

Certifications:

Ability to obtain relevant environmental management certifications as required.
Ability to obtain Minnesota Pollution Control Agency SSTS Certification.

Physical Requirements:

Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds.
Ability to walk, stand, bend, and kneel for extended periods during field inspections.
Capable of working outdoors in various weather conditions.
Must be able to perform the essential physical duties of the job with or without reasonable accommodation.

Additional Information:

Must possess a valid Minnesota Driver’s License and maintain a clean driving record.
Must pass a background check.
Must be a U.S. citizen or legally authorized to work in the United States.

Toeroek Associates is a dynamic small business provider of specialty consulting and analysis services to the U.S. Government. Our multi-disciplined environmental staff includes scientific, legal, and engineering experts who support federal and state government entities in compliance, remediation, field services, site assessments, oversight, historical and technical research, litigation, and community engagement. Toeroek offers a collaborative and congenial work environment with a team of passionate staff dedicated to finding solutions to complex problems in the fields of environment, records and knowledge management, and national security.

Toeroek Associates is seeking a junior-level Environmental Analyst to provide support in the Denver, Colorado, Sacramento, California, Dallas, Texas, or Chicago, Illinois areas.

**Summary**

The analyst will work as part of a team to assist EPA and other government agencies with administering environmental regulatory compliance and enforcement programs. Our focus is on cleaning up our communities. The analyst will work on multiple contracts, researching and compiling evidence to characterize contamination and identify potentially responsible parties (PRPs) at hazardous waste sites. Superior research, writing, and analytical skills are essential to this position, as is an interest in helping government agencies enforce their environmental regulations.

**Duties include:**

* Assist in identifying sources of information about PRP operations, including federal, state and local agencies, public libraries, private archives, and map and aerial photography archives
* Conduct research to obtain documents pertinent to PRP historical operations and waste disposal practices, as well as environmental regulatory compliance
* Review information on PRP operations, including responses to EPA information requests, facility inspection reports, sampling and investigation reports, hazardous materials inventories and other documents collected, and identify relevant data for purposes of analyzing Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation, and Liability Act (CERCLA) liability
* Draft evidence summary reports that present information about PRP operations, chemical usage, disposal practices, and soil and groundwater sampling data
* Review laboratory sampling data results for purposes of extracting and summarizing relevant data from sampling and investigation reports
* Review real property title documents and prepare title reports and tables showing the ownership history of the property
* Conduct corporate research and identify corporate successors (training will be provided)
* Input data and manage databases
* Translate information obtained from research into charts, graphs, maps, and infographics
* Occasional overnight travel may be required

**Education/Experience**

* Bachelor of Science or Bachelor of Arts degree from an accredited university
* Minimum of two years of relevant work experience preferred

**Requirements**

* Hybrid arrangements for Lakewood, CO and Concord, CA.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Detailed, critical, and thoughtful writing and analysis skills
* Knowledge of or experience in environmental information collection, analysis, interpretation and report preparation
* Ability to function as a member of a team and work in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to handle multiple tasks at once and meet deadlines and to adapt quickly and smoothly to changing project requirements
* Proficient in Office 365 and Windows-based applications
* Ability to use software to retrieve, evaluate, and organize information and documents

**Bonus Skills/Certifications**

* Experience with ESRI suite of GIS software is a plus

San Francisco Public Utilities Commission (SFPUC)  
Headquartered in San Francisco, we have 2,300 employees operating across eight counties serving more than 2.7 million customers in the San Francisco Bay Area – 24 hours per day, 365 days per year.

**Our Mission:** To provide our customers with high quality, efficient, and reliable water, power, and wastewater services in a manner that values environmental and community interests and sustains the resources entrusted to our care.

**Our Vision:** We are an innovative utility leader, recognized for excellent results in service, safety, stewardship, and inclusiveness.

If you are passionate about water quality, regulatory compliance, large-scale infrastructure programs, and building efficient operational processes, we encourage you to apply!

**Project Name:** Hazard Assessment Program

**Project Description:**

Under the State of California’s new cross-connection control regulations, the SFPUC must review all service connections (~180,000+) to properties in San Francisco, as well as the eight other water systems under SFPUC’s control, to evaluate potential hazards to the public drinking water distribution system arising from activities on user premises. In addition, the new regulations require the installation of backflow prevention assemblies on about 4,200 fire service connections. SFPUC has submitted a plan to the State Water Resources Control Board with deadlines for completing hazard assessments by 2049, ensuring backflow prevention assemblies on all dedicated fire services by 2044.

**Position Summary**

Are you a technical professional looking to make a direct impact on public health and water safety on a massive scale? We are seeking a dynamic Utility Specialist to serve as the Technical Program Coordinator for our Water Quality Cross Connection Control (CCC) Program under the direction of the Hazard Assessments Program Manager.

In this vital role, you will contribute to the implementation of SFPUC Cross-Connection Control Program inline with new regulatory requirements established by the State Water Resources Control Board (SWRCB) through the Cross Connection Control Policy Handbook (CCCPH).

You will help shape a high-profile, multi-decade program by developing tracking systems, operational processes, coordinating complex field logistics, and partnering with internal teams, contractors, and external stakeholders across multiple program areas including Hazard Assessments, Fire services upgrades and Regional Compliance.

**Work Location:** 1657 Rollins Road, Burlingame, CA, 94010

**Schedule:** Full-time, Monday – Friday

* This position requires a valid driver’s license.

* **Systems & Data Management:** Establish tracking systems, dashboards, and reporting templates to monitor inspections, costs, schedules, and compliance metrics.
* **Research & Analysis:** Conduct research using internal databases, GIS systems, spreadsheets, field reports, and photos to compile baseline data on service connection characteristics and assess cross-connection hazards.
* **Cross-Functional Coordination:** Coordinate daily program activities with field staff, contractors, customers, and other City departments, serving as a liaison to ensure smooth communication, scheduling, and execution.
* **Contractor & Consultant Oversight:** Coordinate with contractors and consultants to ensure field activities align with approved scopes of work, schedules, and Cross Connection Control program requirements.
* **Reporting & Continuous Improvement:** Prepare program reports, dashboards, and documentation for Program Manager review, highlighting trends, risks, and lessons learned while developing procedures, reference materials, and recommendations to improve program effectiveness.
* **Field Engagement:** Conduct field coordination and site visits (as needed) to support hazard assessments, inspection activities, and validation of program data.
* **Technical Support:** Provide technical support for Hazard Assessment Program initiatives, including compliance studies, analytical tasks, and administrative support. Performs other project-related duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Senior Regulatory Consultant / Toxicologist – GRAS & NDI Expert
jobs.description:
For over 25 years, **dicentra** has been a trusted global leader in regulatory consulting and clinical research for the life sciences and dietary supplement industries. We partner with innovators worldwide to navigate complex regulatory landscapes, turn scientific rigor into commercial success, and bring safe, compliant products to market.

To support our continued growth and meet high client demand, we have an **immediate opening** for an experienced **Senior Regulatory Consultant / Toxicologist (GRAS & NDI Expert)** to join our dynamic, fully remote consulting team.

**The Opportunity**

In this senior-level role, you will serve as a premier technical authority and trusted advisor to our clients. You will lead scientific safety assessments, evaluate manufacturing chemistry, author high-impact regulatory submissions, and provide strategic roadmaps for novel food and dietary ingredients across both **human and veterinary applications**.

You will bridge the gap between complex science, rigorous toxicology, and commercial market access—helping clients determine the optimal regulatory pathways while delivering exceptional consulting service.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Regulatory Pathway Strategy & Feasibility:** Conduct feasibility assessments and gap analyses to determine whether novel ingredients require a GRAS (Generally Recognized as Safe) notification, an NDI (New Dietary Ingredient) notification, or alternative pathways.
* **Toxicology & Safety Evaluation:** Critically evaluate published and unpublished toxicology, safety, and efficacy data; design testing cascades and safety profiles to support ingredient safety determinations.
* **Manufacturing & Chemistry Assessment:** Review and assess detailed manufacturing processes, batch analyses, specifications, impurity and contaminant profiles, and stability data to ensure data integrity for GRAS/NDI dossiers.
* **Dossier Preparation & Submission:** Lead the end-to-end authoring, review, and assembly of robust GRAS notices, independent GRAS determinations, and NDI notifications for submission to the U.S. FDA.
* **Expert Panel Coordination:** Identify, convene, and lead Independent GRAS Expert Panels—managing consensus statements and scientific dialogues through to completion.
* **Broader Food & Dietary Supplement Compliance:** Support clients with high-level regulatory compliance, including product classifications, claim substantiation dossiers, and label/ingredient reviews.
* **Client Advisory & Account Leadership:** Act as a strategic partner to C-suite and R&D leaders, translating complex toxicology and FDA feedback into actionable business strategies.
* **Cross-Sector Scope:** Support regulatory strategies for both human food/supplements and animal/veterinary feed and ingredient submissions.

**Qualifications & Background**

* **Advanced Scientific Degree:** Ph.D. or Master’s in Toxicology, Pharmacology, Food Science, Biochemistry, or a closely related discipline (DABT certification is a strong asset).
* **Prior FDA Experience Strongly Preferred:** Direct experience working within the U.S. FDA (e.g., CFSAN or CVM) reviewing or evaluating GRAS, NDI, or food additive petitions.
* **Deep GRAS & NDI Mastery:** Proven track record authoring and successfully submitting GRAS determinations and NDI notifications with documented FDA engagement.
* **Manufacturing & Toxicological Acumen:** Strong familiarity with manufacturing flow charts, specs, and contaminant thresholds, paired with extensive experience evaluating genotoxicity, subchronic/chronic toxicity studies, safety margins, and ADME profiles.
* **Client-Facing Leadership:** Exceptional communication skills with the poise and commercial mindset required to manage client relationships and guide them through strategic decision-making.
* **Compliance Knowledge (Big Plus):** Demonstrated familiarity with U.S. dietary supplement and conventional food regulations, including 21 CFR Part 111, labeling compliance, and structure/function claim substantiation.

**Why Join dicentra?**

* **Fully Remote Flexibility:** Work from anywhere with a high degree of autonomy and collaborative virtual infrastructure.
* **Industry Leadership:** Join a recognized firm with a 25-year legacy of excellence and trust in life sciences and regulatory compliance.
* **High-Impact Work:** Direct involvement in shaping the market introduction of cutting-edge ingredients and formulations.
* **Dynamic Culture:** Collaborate with a multi-disciplinary team of passionate regulatory affairs experts, toxicologists, and clinical scientists who value innovation, excellence, and teamwork.

**How to Apply**

This position is **available to fill immediately**.

**Why join us**

**Best workplace**
  
*We nourish an environment devoted to honesty and fairness, trust and respect. We care deeply for our team members and take work-life balance seriously, allowing our people to decide on a schedule that best fits their life and working preferences.*

**Best people**
  
*We unite cross-industry professionals with a shared passion for improving people’s health and wellness. Our inspiring leaders are accessible and work eagerly side-by-side with individual employees to help them understand and achieve their objectives.*

**Best opportunities**
  
*We encourage our team members to continuously develop and enhance their skills and expertise. We recognize and reward courageous choices and innovative ideas that result in the growth of our people and company, and in the success of our clients.*

**Become a part of a purpose-driven and future-oriented business that impacts and improves millions of lives worldwide!**

Title: Social Media Manager
Location: Florence, KY (on-site/hybrid)
Employment Type: Full-Time (Salary)
Compensation: $72,000 - $80,000 annually (based on experience)
Job Summary:
We’re seeking a proactive, creative, detail-oriented Social Media Manager to oversee social media and eLead platform support for our three brands: Kona Ice, Travelin’ Tom’s Coffee, and Beverly Ann’s Cookie Truck.
This mid-level role combines content strategy, social media execution, community engagement, performance analysis, and digital platform management.
The ideal candidate can manage multiple brands, collaborate with creative and marketing teams, troubleshoot technical issues, and stay current on evolving social media platforms and digital marketing tools.
Primary Responsibilities
Social Media Strategy & Content Management
* Develop and execute social media strategies aligned with each brand’s identity and business goals.
* Manage content calendars, plan campaigns, write copy, and coordinate the creation and publishing of engaging content across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.
* Maintain consistent brand voices while identifying relevant trends, platform updates, and opportunities to improve content performance.
Community Engagement & Brand Management
* Monitor and respond to comments, messages, and audience inquiries, aiming for a response within 24 hours.
* Maintain a positive brand presence and appropriately escalate sensitive customer concerns or reputational issues.
eLead & Digital Platform Management
* Manage assigned eLead Lite accounts and workflows, ensuring accuracy and consistency.
* Troubleshoot platform issues, account access, publishing errors, and other technical challenges, escalating when needed.
* Stay informed about platform updates, technical changes, and new features that may affect our brands or franchisees.
Analytics & Optimization
* Monitor social media performance, including reach, engagement, audience growth, and referral traffic.
* Provide regular performance insights and actionable recommendations to improve content and campaign effectiveness.
Cross-Functional & Franchisee Support
* Collaborate with the Kreative, Video, and Marketing teams to coordinate content production, deadlines, and campaigns.
* Assist franchisees with relevant social media and digital platform setup, access, troubleshooting, and education.
* Support marketing education at Roll Brands University and contribute to other brand and campaign initiatives as needed.
Process Improvement & Platform Knowledge
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve social media workflows
* Maintain accurate account access, platform configurations, and process documentation.
* Continuously develop knowledge of social media tools, digital marketing technology, and industry best practices.
What Success Looks Like in This Role
A successful Social Media Manager will do more than keep our social calendars full.
They will:
* Own the day-to-day social media presence for all three brands.
* Balance creative execution with performance analysis and strategic thinking.
* Keep accounts and assigned workflows accurate, functional, and organized.
* Stay ahead of relevant platform changes and help the team understand their implications.
* Identify and troubleshoot issues instead of waiting for someone else to flag them.
* Coordinate effectively with the Kreative, Video, and Marketing teams to keep production moving.
* Provide useful insights that help improve content and campaign performance.
* Deliver dependable support to franchisees and internal partners.
Additional Information:
* Standard working hours are Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM ET.
* Periodic travel to our Florence, KY headquarters is required for pre-planned meetings, company events, and other business initiatives.
Why Join Our Team?
We believe great marketing comes from talented people who are trusted to take ownership, think strategically, and continuously improve.
You'll join a collaborative, high-performing team where your work has a direct impact on business growth, franchisee success, and nationally recognized brands.
We work hard, support one another, and genuinely enjoy building something great together.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

This role is responsible serving as a senior strategic partner to the CMO and leading and streamlining marketing operations establishing the governance, operating rhythms, resources, budgets, agency model, workflows, and launch disciplines needed to drive focus, discipline, speed, and accountable execution. Partners with the CMO and Marketing Leadership Team to prioritize high-value opportunities, align teams and resources, and ensure programs are sufficiently financially viable, operationally executable, teams are aligned around shared priorities, and ready for successful systemwide launch and execution.

**KEY DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:**

***Marketing Leadership Operations***

Translates Marketing priorities into clear organizational priorities, workstreams, milestones, owners, and operating plans.

Leads the process to design a calendar of sales-driving programs, product launches, promotions, brand moments, value initiatives, and customer programs that can be brought to market cohesively across paid, owned, earned, digital, restaurant, and franchise channels.

Maintains an integrated view of programs, campaigns, product launches, digital initiatives, customer programs, and organizational priorities.

***Marketing Budget & Financial Operations***

Leads Marketing budget operations and reporting in close partnership with Finance and Marketing leaders to provide clear visibility into budgets, commitments, actuals, forecasts, and risks.

Coordinates Marketing's annual budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes and monitors Marketing expenditures to flag significant variances and risks.

***Agency & Partner Operations***

Leads the operating model and commercial management of Marketing's agency and external partnerships eliminating overlapping scope and improving effectiveness.

Leads agency scope and fee management, commercial negotiations, and ongoing financial governance in partnership with Procurement, Finance, Legal, and Marketing leadership.

Job description:

\*\*About\*\*

CulinaryFleet is a curated food & beverage platform that connects consumers, businesses, restaurants, and bars with high-quality, vetted, and credentialed culinary professionals—including chefs, bakers, and bartenders. Our mission is to modernize how culinary talent is discovered, booked, and supported, creating a trusted ecosystem for both service providers and clients.

\*\*Role Overview\*\*

CulinaryFleet is seeking a strategic and forward-thinking Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) with deep experience in hospitality and go-to-market (GTM) execution. The ideal candidate is a brand builder, growth strategist, and analytical leader who can drive growth through data-informed storytelling, customer engagement, and scalable acquisition strategies.

As a key member of the executive leadership team, the CMO will help shape the company’s growth trajectory, market positioning, and expansion strategy while building the marketing function from the ground up.

This position begins as a part-time executive role and is designed to evolve into a full-time leadership position based on company growth, funding milestones, and market expansion objectives as CulinaryFleet expands nationally and internationally.

\*\*Key Responsibilities\*\*

\* Develop and execute CulinaryFleet’s multi-channel marketing strategy with a strong GTM focus across digital, social, partnership, and experiential channels.

\* Build and maintain a powerful and consistent brand identity aligned with CulinaryFleet’s mission, values, and long-term vision.

\* Lead user acquisition, engagement, retention, and customer lifecycle strategies for both service providers and clients.

\* Partner with the CEO and executive leadership team to develop growth strategies, market expansion plans, and customer acquisition models that support company objectives.

\* Lead product positioning, market research, competitive analysis, and customer insight initiatives to strengthen product-market fit and market differentiation.

\* Collaborate with executive leadership to refine positioning, messaging, and value propositions across all target segments.

\* Establish and track key performance metrics to assess marketing ROI, customer acquisition costs, conversion rates, engagement, retention, and overall brand impact.

\* Build scalable marketing processes, reporting frameworks, technology platforms, and customer engagement systems to support long-term growth.

\* Manage, recruit, mentor, and grow an agile marketing team composed of internal talent, contractors, agencies, and strategic partners.

\* Direct public relations, media relations, thought leadership, and partnership initiatives within the culinary, hospitality, and food service industries.

\* Oversee launch campaigns, membership drives, strategic partnerships, and key milestone rollouts in new and existing markets.

\* Use data, analytics, and customer insights to continually optimize GTM strategies, campaign performance, and customer engagement.

\* Support fundraising efforts through market analysis, growth narratives, investor materials, and strategic communications as needed.

\*\*Qualifications\*\*

\* 10+ years of progressive marketing leadership experience, ideally within hospitality, food & beverage, technology, marketplace platforms, or related industries.

\* Proven expertise in go-to-market (GTM) strategy development and execution, with a track record of driving measurable growth.

\* Strong understanding of both B2C and B2B growth models, customer acquisition strategies, and brand development.

\* Experience leading brand launches, market expansion initiatives, or early-stage growth efforts within startup environments.

\* Demonstrated ability to build marketing functions, processes, and teams from the ground up.

\* Strong understanding of performance marketing, customer lifecycle management, analytics, and data-driven decision making.

\* Exceptional communication, strategic thinking, analytical, and leadership skills.

\* Experience working cross-functionally with executive leadership, product, operations, sales, and external stakeholders.

\* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, mission-driven, entrepreneurial, and remote-first environment.

\*\*Equity is set at 1.5%\*\*

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

jobs.description:
**Company:**  
Kem Krest is a $600M, certified minority-owned business (MBE) and trusted partner to OEMs for scalable, high-performance supply chain solutions. Kem Krest specializes in complete 4PL services for aftermarket parts and service fluids fulfillment – from sourcing and supplier management, to inventory ownership, through dealer fulfillment.

Well beyond 3PL commodity logistics, Kem Krest offers OEMs bespoke chemical blending and down-packing solutions, the ability to kit complex parts and accessories, regulatory compliance expertise, and a network of more than 15,000 dealer touchpoints. We have over 45 years of experience working with leading OEMs in the Automotive, Heavy-Duty, and Powersports industries, and are supporting a growing number of OEMs in Construction, Mining, and Agriculture. Kem Krest has 11 locations throughout the U.S. and Canada.

**Opportunity:**  

Kem Krest is seeking a Marketing Manager – Dealer to own the strategy and execution that grows our share of wallet within existing OEM dealer programs. You will develop a deep understanding of dealership parts and service audiences, translate customer and purchasing insights into actionable marketing strategies, and lead campaigns and promotions that increase active dealer participation, purchase frequency, and incremental revenue.

Reporting to the Director of Marketing, this individual contributor will collaborate with Marketing, Sales, Account Management, Operations, Supply Chain, OEM customers, and suppliers. This is a hands-on builder role for a marketer who is equally comfortable analyzing complex data, conducting Voice of Customer research, developing campaign strategies, and writing compelling copy.

This is a fully remote position with a strong preference for candidates located in the Midwestern United States, including the Detroit, Chicago, and Indianapolis markets. The role requires approximately 20–25% travel for dealership visits, customer research, industry events, trade shows, and periodic visits to Kem Krest locations

**Responsibilities:**

* Own the dealer-channel marketing strategy, including audience definition, segmentation, buyer personas, messaging, campaign objectives, and performance measurement.
* Establish an always-on Voice of Customer program using dealer interviews, surveys, sales feedback, and AI-enabled market intelligence to identify customer needs and purchasing barriers.
* Analyze D365 transaction data to identify high-opportunity, underpenetrated, and lapsed accounts, quantify revenue opportunities, and guide marketing investment.
* Develop and maintain dealer personas and buyer journeys spanning onboarding, repeat purchase, reactivation, and advocacy.
* Lead the dealer campaign and promotions calendar across email, digital, direct marketing, events, and promotional programs.
* Design test-and-control methodologies, cohort analyses, and pre- and post-campaign comparisons to measure incremental revenue and promotional lift.
* Create dealer-facing value propositions, campaign concepts, emails, offers, and sales tools that connect with dealership parts and service audiences.
* Partner with the Digital Marketing Manager and shared marketing operations resources to execute campaigns within established digital, automation, reporting, and channel standards.
* Manage the dealer marketing budget and agency relationships, evaluating promotional economics, volume lift, margin impact, and overall return on investment.
* Maintain accurate dealer contact coverage across HubSpot and D365 while supporting applicable marketing, Quality Management System, safety, and regulatory requirements.

  

**Your Contributions:**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing or a related field preferred.
* At least 10 years of progressive B2B marketing experience, including ownership of integrated campaign strategy and execution for a distributor, dealer, reseller channel, or comparable install base.
* Advanced analytical skills with experience working directly with transactional, purchasing, ERP, or CRM data using tools such as Excel, Power BI, D365, and HubSpot.
* Hands-on experience developing customer segmentation, measuring incremental lift, and translating purchasing behavior into targeted marketing action.
* Demonstrated experience developing pricing, promotional, or offer strategies, including modeling economics and evaluating volume lift against margin.
* Experience conducting Voice of Customer interviews and survey research and converting findings into actionable personas, buyer journeys, and campaign strategies.
* Strong creative, writing, presentation, and communication skills, with the ability to develop campaign concepts and copy while effectively directing agency partners.
* Knowledge of automotive, aftermarket, heavy-duty, powersports, industrial B2B markets, or dealership parts and service operations is highly desirable. Lean Six Sigma training is a plus.

Description:

**ABOUT BAHAMA BUCK’S**

At Bahama Buck's, our mission is to provide the ultimate tropical dessert experience to our guests. Our marketing department shapes this mission by creating brand awareness, inviting new guests into our shops, and ensuring that our flavorful, friendly, and fun approach is top of mind for our guests and the communities we serve.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Digital Marketing Specialist supports brand awareness and business growth by managing Bahama Buck’s online presence and executing impactful, data-informed digital campaigns that support positive ROI and increase guest traffic.

This role supports the planning, execution, and optimization of national digital initiatives, including social media, paid digital advertising, content strategy, SEO, and online reputation management. The Digital Marketing Specialist collaborates across departments, supports franchisees with scalable local digital marketing solutions, and ensures digital content reflects both brand integrity and operational excellence.

The ideal candidate is analytical, creative, highly organized, and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple digital projects in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Digital Strategy**

* Support the development and execution of digital marketing strategies across paid and organic channels
* Monitor KPIs, reporting rhythms, and performance data to identify insights and opportunities
* Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure digital initiatives support broader marketing and company goals
* Support the execution and maintenance of scalable local digital advertising solutions for franchisees

jobs.title: Marketing Director
jobs.description:
Excellent creative work can help extraordinary organizations raise more and serve more. Unseen is looking for a Marketing Director who knows what great looks like, can explain why it works, and can bring together the people who make it happen.

You will own Unseen's brand, voice, marketing strategy, and creative standard. You will lead an outside agency through a brand rebuild, turn that work into a focused annual marketing plan, and direct major projects for selected Unseen partners.

You will turn complex information into compelling ideas that capture attention, build belief, and motivate action. You will set creative direction and hold teams accountable for quality.

Creating amazing products and campaigns is the floor. Activating people to invest in anti trafficking work is the job.

About Unseen

Unseen accelerates the fight against human trafficking and its root causes. We equip anti-trafficking organizations around the world with marketing, fundraising, and storytelling tools, and we deliver strategic grants that fund their most critical projects.

Since 2011, Unseen has worked with 94 partner organizations in 66 countries. Those partners have raised more than $119 million and served more than 1.3 million people.

We are entering a new chapter and investing in the leadership and creative work to support it.

The opportunity

This is a role for someone whose strength is creative judgment and leadership. You can recognize an exceptional idea, write a clear brief, give specific feedback, and push work further. You know how to recruit talented people and hold them to a high standard.

You will have direct access to Unseen's leadership, room to challenge assumptions, and the opportunity to shape work with lasting consequences. We want someone who can push back on the CEO's preferences, support their recommendations, and earn trust through their decisions.

You will lead through strategy, direction, and accountability, not by personally producing every asset. A social media specialist will activate the social strategy, and a production manager and production team will manage the execution of creative projects. You will guide the standard of work, help identify outside talent, and collaborate with the people responsible for daily delivery.

What you will lead

Brand and voice. Serve as the primary day-to-day client for an outside brand agency, guide the rebuild, and establish standards the team can consistently apply.

Marketing strategy. Build and execute an annual plan with clear audiences, priorities, budgets, responsibilities, and measures of success. Define how marketing builds awareness and trust, motivates engagement, and supports measurable growth.

Visibility and credibility. Build Unseen's visibility and credibility among priority donors and businesses, activating established relationships and advocates in selected markets.

Fundraising communications. Set the strategy and creative direction for campaigns, stories, and materials that support philanthropic strategy, major gifts, Guardian Business expansion, and a major capital initiative.

Partner projects. Lead strategic and creative oversight for substantial marketing and storytelling assignments for selected Unseen partners, with scope and delivery commitments established through the annual plan.

Creative talent. Identify, evaluate, recruit, and brief excellent agencies, freelancers, and other creative specialists.

Quality and accountability. Set creative standards, provide decisive feedback, and remain accountable for the quality and strategic effectiveness of work delivered by staff, production teams, agencies, and contractors without directly managing every task.

Practical AI adoption. Champion thoughtful AI use in research, creative development, workflows, and production, while protecting accuracy, privacy, and storytelling integrity.

Our philanthropic leadership owns fundraising strategy, donor relationships, and asks. Our Guardian Business lead owns that program's expansion. You will be their marketing partner, responsible for work that helps them succeed.

What you bring

* Exceptional creative judgment across storytelling, copy, design, photography, video, and campaigns.
* Demonstrated ability to turn complex information into persuasive creative concepts using audience psychology, narrative tension, message hierarchy, and clear calls to action.
* A track record of developing campaigns that produce measurable results, including fundraising outcomes, with an honest account of your strategy, decisions, contribution, and results.
* Experience selecting, briefing, directing, and evaluating outside agencies and creative specialists, including providing clear feedback and knowing when to change course.
* The ability to recruit strong creative talent beyond your existing contacts.
* Clear, constructive leadership that makes other people's work better.
* Strong execution skills, including setting priorities, managing budgets, and delivering on commitments through teams.
* Resourcefulness within a limited budget, with the judgment to surface tradeoffs early and recommend solutions.
* Practical fluency with AI tools and the ability to lead adoption collaboratively.
* Respect for ethical, survivor-centered storytelling that protects dignity, informed consent, privacy, and personal agency.

An established network of creative professionals, agencies, media contacts, or business partners is a plus. Experience in anti-trafficking work is welcome but not required.

What success looks like

In your first year, you will:

* Launch Unseen's brand rebuild and establish a consistent voice and creative standard.
* Build and execute a focused annual marketing plan with defined audiences, engagement goals, and performance measures.
* Provide creative direction and quality oversight for priority campaigns and partner projects delivered by the responsible teams against agreed goals, schedules, and budgets.
* Equip our fundraising and Guardi

jobs.description:
**About ARTECHOUSE**
====================

ARTECHOUSE is the nation's first innovative art space dedicated to experiential and technology-driven art. Working at the intersection of art, science, and technology, we create immersive exhibitions in New York, Washington DC, and Houston that redefine how audiences experience art.

You will own how ARTECHOUSE shows up online and turn that presence into audience and ticket sales growth. You'll set strategy and lead execution across our website, social channels, email, influencer and creator partnerships, and paid media.

Much of your execution capacity will come from a team of AI agents that you design, deploy, and manage, covering content ideation, ad optimization, customer journey automation, and reporting. You'll decide what agents do, connect them to our tools, and review their work so quality stays high and our voice stays human.

* Willingness to experiment with new tools, APIs, and integrations.
* Strong organization across complex schedules, exhibition rollouts, and many stakeholders.
* A strong visual and editorial eye, with clear writing.
* A genuine interest in digital art, immersive experiences, and emerging media.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience in arts, culture, attractions, live events, or ticketed experiences.
* Multi-location or multi-market marketing experience.
* Experience supervising staff, interns, or freelancers.
* Short-form video production or editing skills.

**Salary:** 75,000–115,000 per year, commensurate with experience

A key part of this role is unifying data across disparate systems into a trusted, single view of marketing performance, ensuring accuracy and availability for decision-making

**Tracking & Attribution**

* Own campaign tracking architecture, UTM governance, and attribution setup.
* QA lead routing and conversion tracking to ensure accuracy and integrity.
* Maintain alignment across platforms to eliminate duplicate or misattributed data.

**Reporting & Dashboards**

* Build dashboards for spend, performance, ROI, and pipeline contribution.
* Ensure timely and accurate reporting for daily operational use and executive insights.
* Collaborate with Analytics to deliver clear, actionable performance readouts.

**Testing & Incrementality**

* Lead experiment design and incrementality measurement across campaigns.
* Ensure tests are properly instrumented and results are trustworthy.
* Share learnings broadly to refine investment and optimization decisions.

**Process & Governance**

* Establish and enforce data quality standards across all performance marketing activities.
* Create governance frameworks for routing, QA, and reporting accuracy.
* Continuously optimize processes to improve efficiency and scalability.

**Tools & Technology**

Fluency with marketing operations and analytics tools, including:

* **Analytics & Attribution:** Google Analytics (GA4), Looker Studio, attribution platforms.

* **Collaboration & Workflow:** Project management and campaign orchestration platforms.

**What You'll Bring:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Digital Media, or a related field
* 7+ years in marketing operations, performance marketing, or related data-driven marketing roles.
* Experience managing and developing operational or technical talent.
* Proven expertise in tracking, attribution, and campaign QA.
* Hands-on experience building dashboards, reporting frameworks, and governance processes.
* Strong attention to detail, with a reputation for data accuracy and operational rigor.
* Collaborative leader who can partner across marketing, analytics, and technology teams.

**Mindset**

* **Thinks big picture:** Growth is holistic, expanding beyond just acquisition and performance marketing.
* **Experimental:** Naturally curious; makes data-driven decisions, in a timely manner, to solve problems and propose ideas.
* **Forward thinking:** Demonstrates a continuous improvement mindset, respecting the past while remaining flexible and open to new ideas and driving transformation.
* **Acts like an owner:** Keeps the big picture in mind while managing the inputs daily to achieve intentional outcomes. Holds accountability in the highest regard and instills others to follow suit. Translates results into digestible information and avoids buzzwordy jargon.

**Why Join Us**

* Lead the operations and governance backbone of a new Performance Marketing CoE.
* Build and grow a team that ensures marketing is accountable, transparent, and scalable.

jobs.title: Klaviyo Email Marketing Specialist (Ecommerce)
jobs.description:
About the Role

We're looking for an experienced **Klaviyo Email Marketing Specialist** to take ownership of our email marketing program.

RNC is an established ecommerce company selling Natural Health Products. We're looking for someone who knows Klaviyo inside and out, writes compelling emails, and understands how to turn email marketing into consistent revenue.

This is a hands-on position. You'll be responsible for everything from planning campaigns and writing copy to building automated flows, scheduling emails, and analyzing performance.

We're looking for someone who can bring fresh ideas, take initiative, and confidently manage our email marketing from start to finish.

This is an in-house position, not an agency or freelance contract. We're hiring for a full-time role but are open to someone starting part-time and transitioning into full-time.

What You'll Be Doing

**Email Campaigns & Strategy**

* Plan, create, and manage our email marketing calendar.
* Develop email campaigns that drive sales, build customer relationships, and encourage repeat purchases.
* Identify opportunities to increase revenue through email marketing.
* Coordinate email campaigns around promotions, product launches, holidays, and other marketing initiatives.

**Klaviyo Flows & Automations**

* Build, manage, and continuously improve automated email flows in Klaviyo.
* Optimize welcome series, abandoned cart, abandoned checkout, post-purchase, win-back, and other key flows.
* Develop customer segments to deliver more relevant and personalized messaging.
* Identify gaps in our existing automations and implement improvements.

**Email Copywriting & Creation**

* Write engaging subject lines, preview text, and email copy that encourage customers to open, click, and purchase.
* Build attractive, mobile-friendly emails within Klaviyo.
* Create messaging that aligns with our brand voice and connects with our customers.
* Test different messaging, offers, and creative approaches to improve performance.

**Scheduling, Testing & Optimization**

* Schedule emails based on customer behavior, engagement data, and the best-performing send times.
* Run A/B tests on subject lines, content, offers, and send times.
* Monitor open rates, click rates, conversions, revenue, and overall email performance.
* Maintain healthy email deliverability and list engagement.
* Review results regularly and make data-driven improvements.

What We're Looking For

**Required Qualifications**

* Proven hands-on experience managing Klaviyo for an ecommerce business.
* Strong understanding of email marketing strategy, campaigns, automated flows, and customer segmentation.
* Excellent copywriting skills with the ability to write emails that drive engagement and sales.
* Experience building and designing emails directly in Klaviyo.
* Ability to analyze campaign performance and make improvements based on data.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage an email marketing program independently, from initial idea to final send.

**Bonus Qualifications**

* Experience with Shopify and its integration with Klaviyo.
* Experience managing email marketing for an established ecommerce brand.
* Familiarity with subscription-based ecommerce businesses.
* Experience with customer retention, lifecycle marketing, and customer win-back strategies.
* Experience improving email revenue, conversion rates, and deliverability.

What We Offer

* **Ownership:** Take responsibility for our email marketing program and have a direct impact on business performance.
* **Creative Freedom:** Bring your ideas to the table and help shape our campaigns, messaging, and marketing strategy.
* **Room to Grow:** Help improve and expand an established ecommerce company's email marketing efforts.
* **Flexible Starting Arrangement:** Opportunity to begin part-time and transition into a full-time position.
* **Meaningful Work:** See the results of your campaigns and have a direct influence on customer engagement, retention, and revenue.

Who Will Succeed in This Role?

You'll be a great fit if you're equally comfortable planning an email strategy, writing compelling copy, building Klaviyo flows, and analyzing campaign results.

You enjoy both the creative and technical sides of email marketing. You understand what makes customers open an email, what motivates them to purchase, and how to continuously improve performance.

Most importantly, you're proactive. You don't need someone telling you when to send an email, what flow to improve, or which campaign to test. You can identify opportunities, develop a plan, and execute it.

We're looking for someone who wants to take real ownership of email marketing and help us grow.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume along with a brief description of your experience using Klaviyo.

We'd also love to see examples of email campaigns, automated flows, or measurable results you've personally worked on.

**If you're an experienced Klaviyo marketer who loves creating great emails and driving ecommerce revenue, we'd love to hear from you.**

**Position Summary**

Nationwide Transport Services is seeking a data-driven and detail-oriented SEO Analyst to strengthen our organic search presence, increase qualified website traffic, and generate more leads for our vehicle transportation and logistics services.

The SEO Analyst will support the development and execution of search engine optimization strategies designed to improve visibility across search engines and AI-powered search platforms. This role will focus on keyword research, technical SEO, website content optimization, competitor analysis, performance reporting, and identifying opportunities to increase quote requests and customer acquisition.

The ideal candidate understands how customers search for auto transport and logistics services, including vehicle shipping, enclosed auto transport, open car shipping, motorcycle transport, dealer and auction vehicle transportation, and long-distance vehicle relocation.

This individual will work closely with marketing, content, web development, and operations teams to improve website performance and ensure SEO initiatives support measurable business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Keyword Research and Search Strategy**

* Conduct keyword research focused on vehicle shipping, auto transport, car hauling, vehicle relocation, and related transportation services.
* Identify high-intent keywords that attract customers actively seeking vehicle transportation quotes.
* Analyze search volume, keyword difficulty, search intent, competition, and conversion potential.
* Develop keyword maps for service pages, location pages, route-specific pages, and supporting blog content.
* Identify content gaps and opportunities to improve rankings for commercially valuable search terms.
* Monitor changes in customer search behavior, seasonal demand, and industry-related search trends.

**2. On-Page SEO and Website Optimization**

* Optimize title tags, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, internal links, image alt text, and other on-page SEO elements.
* Improve service pages covering open transport, enclosed transport, classic and luxury vehicle shipping, motorcycle shipping, and specialty transportation.
* Optimize origin-and-destination pages targeting vehicle shipping routes and geographic search demand.
* Evaluate existing content for relevance, accuracy, search intent, and opportunities to improve organic performance.
* Reduce keyword cannibalization and improve website architecture through effective keyword mapping and internal linking.
* Collaborate with content writers to create SEO-focused landing pages, educational resources, FAQs, and blog articles.

**3. Technical SEO**

* Conduct regular technical SEO audits to identify crawlability, indexation, duplicate content, broken links, redirect, canonicalization, and metadata issues.
* Monitor XML sitemaps, robots.txt, structured data, and search engine indexing.
* Evaluate Core Web Vitals, mobile usability, page speed, and website performance.
* Identify and communicate technical issues to web developers, providing clear documentation and recommendations.
* Monitor the SEO impact of website redesigns, page launches, URL changes, and site migrations.
* Help maintain a scalable website structure as service offerings and geographic landing pages expand.

**4. Local SEO and Geographic Optimization**

* Support local and regional SEO strategies where relevant to the company's service areas and business locations.
