* Identify pages and keywords that generate qualified leads and recommend opportunities to improve conversion rates.
* Develop recurring dashboards and reports that communicate performance trends, issues, opportunities, and recommended actions.
* Measure the impact of SEO initiatives on qualified lead volume and overall customer acquisition.
* Work with marketing and sales teams to understand lead quality and identify opportunities to improve organic campaign performance.

**6. Competitor Analysis and Market Research**

* Monitor competing auto transport and vehicle shipping companies to identify changes in keyword rankings, content strategies, and organic visibility.
* Analyze competitor service pages, geographic coverage, content gaps, and backlink profiles.
* Identify opportunities to differentiate the company's website through stronger content, better search intent alignment, and improved user experience.
* Track search engine algorithm updates and evaluate their potential impact on organic performance.
* Provide actionable recommendations based on competitive and market insights.

**7. AI Search Optimization and Emerging Trends**

* Monitor the impact of AI-powered search experiences, including Google AI Overviews and other relevant AI search platforms.
* Support Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) initiatives.

jobs.title: Email & Growth Marketer (Email, Content, SEO)
jobs.description:
**About us**

AchieveCE (achievece.com) is one of the fastest-growing, nationally accredited continuing education platforms in healthcare. We hold every major medical accreditation for healthcare CE/CME, and we run on our own proprietary software platform delivering best-in-class experiences for the industry.

We have delivered education to over 1,000,000 healthcare professionals since 2017.

**What you will own**

**Email and lifecycle (the core of this role)** Build and run our automated email program in our Email platform: onboarding, post-purchase, renewal reminders, winback, re-engagement. On-brand Copy writing. Branching at the right times to ensure each customer journey is optimized.

**Content and SEO** Plan and write content that reaches licensed professionals while they are searching for what their state requires. Work with our SEO team on structure, backlinks, and what gets built next.

**Building things that save time** We are not on Shopify or WordPress, so there is rarely a plugin for what we need. A lot of the work means moving data between systems, generating content across hundreds of state and profession combinations, and wiring up tools that do not ship with an integration. You should be comfortable reading API docs and building something that works creatively with our technical and marketing teams.

**Role fit**

Expect to spend roughly 80% of your time executing and 20% shaping strategy, with more of the second as you learn the business. We will set the priorities together. You own the work and execution.

This suits someone who would rather build the program than manage people who build it.

**What you need**

* Excellent copywriting and brand voice creation: You can write an email to an array of healthcare professional types that is clear, persuasive, and does not fall into gimmicky marketing lingo.
* Real experience building branching automated email flows, not just sending campaigns. We currently use Brevo (formerly SendinBlue) - so bonus points if you have experience setting up automations with it.
* Working knowledge of on-page and off-page SEO & content marketing, enough to plan and execute without hand-holding
* Comfort in a custom environment where you may have to build the thing you need
* You use AI to move faster on research, data, and tooling, and you write the actual copy yourself
* Background in e-learning, online education, B2C SaaS, subscription, or any business where customers buy repeatedly over years

**Who this is not for**

* If your experience is mostly Shopify or WordPress stores, this will most likely not be a fit
* If your answer to every problem is a Klaviyo flow, this will most likely not be a fit
* If you need a brand guide, a documented process, and a finished brief before you can start, this will most likely not be a fit
* B2B and enterprise demand generation backgrounds are not what we are looking for

**How this works**

You report to our Head of Growth and work alongside a developer, a subject matter expert on continuing education, and contractors running SEO and paid media. It is a small team and it moves fast.

Copy clears a compliance review before it ships, because our content has to satisfy accreditation and state rules. Some claims that are normal elsewhere are off limits here.

**How to apply**

Answer these four questions. Applications that skip them will not be reviewed.

* Describe an automated email flow you built that branched on customer data. What triggered it, what decided each branch, and what did it do for the business?
* Describe something you built or automated with an API, a script, or an AI tool where no off-the-shelf integration existed. What was the problem, and what did you build?
* Paste one subject line and the first three lines of an email you wrote that performed well. Tell us why it worked.

Pay: $40.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Analyst
jobs.description:
**Vividly** is the leading modern trade promotion management (TPM) solution built by and for the consumer packaged goods industry. From campaign creation to deductions management and promotion measurement, we help brands manage every element of trade spend. With our easy-to-use platform and industry-leading experience, we pride ourselves on our ability to bring businesses to the next level.

Not familiar with trade promotion spend? That’s OK. Most people aren’t. It’s an $8 trillion dollar problem that is ripe for disruption by an innovative SaaS startup. In order to grow, consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands spend 20% of their topline revenue to get into retailers and promote their products within those retailers. The problem is that today 70% of those promotions are not ROI positive. This is because ROI is hard to track. The industry operates on emails, pdfs, and xls spreadsheets. At Vividly, we’re solving this massive problem with exciting tactics including AI, Machine Learning, and Fintech and adding value to everyone in the chain. Some of our customers include brands you may use and love - Liquid Death, Amy’s, and Perfect Snacks.

As we grow, we’re looking for a **Senior Marketing Analyst** who can help us better understand our market, our audience, and the performance of our go-to-market efforts and turn those insights into action.

**The Role**

The Senior Marketing Analyst will sit at the intersection of **Marketing, Sales, and Revenue Operations**, helping Vividly answer a simple but critical question: **What should we do more of, what should we do less of, and where are we missing opportunities?**

This is not a reporting-only role. You’ll dig into content performance, advertising data, prospect and account intelligence, event audiences, and CRM data to identify patterns and translate them into clear recommendations for the teams responsible for growth.

You’ll partner closely with our Content, Demand Generation, Sales, and RevOps teams and will be expected to proactively surface insights - not simply wait for someone to ask for a report.

**What You'll Do**

* Monitor SEO performance, keyword rankings, organic traffic trends, and emerging search opportunities.

* Surface new content opportunities based on search behavior, audience engagement, competitive trends, and recurring themes from the market.
* Build a clear, ongoing view of what's working, what's not, and what the Content team should test next.

* Support additional prospect and account research that helps Sales focus its time on the highest-value opportunities.

**Account Intelligence & CRM Enrichment**

* Identify relevant contacts and buying committee members within target accounts.

* Experience analyzing digital marketing and content performance, including paid media, website analytics, and SEO.

**Director | Growth Marketing**

**Mary Cook Associates | Chicago, IL**

Help shape the next chapter of a nationally recognized design firm.

At Mary Cook Associates (MCA), we believe great design does more than create beautiful spaces. It builds experiences, strengthens communities, and drives measurable value for the businesses and clients we serve.

As we celebrate our 40th anniversary, MCA is entering one of the most exciting chapters in our firm's history. Building on four decades of experience, trusted relationships, and design excellence, we're evolving alongside an ever-changing industry, expanding our capabilities, and investing in the people and strategies that will drive our next era of growth.

We're looking for an exceptional **Director | Growth Marketing** to help lead that charge.

This is a high-impact opportunity for a strategic, creative, and entrepreneurial marketing professional who understands the intersection of **design, brand, business development, and commercial real estate.** Someone who recognizes the strength of an established brand while seeing the extraordinary opportunity to help shape where it goes next.

**The Opportunity**

The Director | Growth Marketing will lead MCA's marketing strategy and execution, serving as a critical connection between marketing and business development to strengthen our market presence, elevate our brand, and drive meaningful business growth.

We're looking for someone who thinks big but isn't afraid to get into the details. A visionary strategist with the organizational discipline, communication skills, and hands-on experience to turn ambitious ideas into measurable results.

This individual will play an instrumental role in advancing MCA's brand as our business evolves, helping shape how we position ourselves, communicate our value, engage our clients, and bring our story to market.

**This isn't simply an opportunity to manage an established marketing function. It's an opportunity to fundamentally shape its future.**

**Who We're Looking For**

Our ideal candidate is a confident, resourceful, and highly motivated marketing leader who brings equal parts creativity, strategic thinking, and business acumen.

Someone who:

* **Thinks like a strategist, executes like an entrepreneur.** You can develop a compelling vision, establish priorities, manage resources, and personally drive initiatives from concept through completion.
* **Understands the business of design.** You appreciate the relationship between creativity, client experience, brand positioning, and commercial success.
* **Connects marketing to business growth.** You recognize that marketing and business development are most powerful when working together toward shared goals.
* **Is passionate about design and real estate.** You understand the industries we serve and are energized by the opportunity to tell meaningful stories about the impact of our work.
* **Communicates with confidence and clarity.** Whether presenting to leadership, engaging industry partners, developing messaging, or directing creative collaborators, you know how to connect with people and inspire action.
* **Balances creativity with operational excellence.** You're an exceptional project manager who can coordinate multiple initiatives, manage deadlines and budgets, and hold a high standard for execution.
* **Thrives both front and center and behind the scenes.** You're equally comfortable building relationships and representing the firm as you are developing campaigns, refining content, and managing the details.
* **Brings energy, initiative, and ownership.** You don't wait for direction at every turn. You identify opportunities, bring solutions, and make things happen.

**What You'll Lead**

Working closely with firm leadership and business development, you'll oversee and advance MCA's marketing efforts, including:

* **Brand Strategy & Positioning:** Lead the continued evolution of MCA's brand, messaging, market positioning, and visual identity to ensure consistency, differentiation, and relevance.
* **Integrated Marketing:** Develop and execute strategic marketing initiatives across digital, social, email, print, and other channels to build awareness, engagement, and measurable results.
* **Business Development Alignment:** Partner closely with business development to connect marketing strategies with client relationships, market opportunities, pipeline priorities, and firm growth objectives.
* **Market Intelligence & Growth Opportunities:** Research target markets, client needs, industry trends, and emerging opportunities to inform marketing priorities and the development of new service offerings.
* **Digital Presence & Content:** Oversee website strategy, digital content, SEO, social media, project storytelling, and the firm's overall online presence.
* **Creative Direction & Brand Assets:** Maintain a high standard for all marketing materials, photography, presentations, collateral, and visual communications.
* **Public Relations & Industry Recognition:** Advance MCA's visibility through thought leadership, industry engagement, awards, editorial opportunities, and strategic communications.
* **Team & Partner Leadership:** Lead and develop internal marketing resources while identifying, directing, and managing external agencies, vendors, and creative partners.
* **Marketing Operations & Performance:** Manage marketing budgets, calendars, project timelines, and performance metrics to ensure initiatives are executed effectively and aligned with business priorities.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience leading externally focused marketing, brand, or communications initiatives, preferably within professional services.
* Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, interior design, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience developing comprehensive marketing strategies and executing them across multiple channels.
* Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skill

jobs.description:
**About Us**

FMO Media is a full-service digital marketing agency for professional services businesses. Since 2018 we have run our clients' entire marketing engine under one roof: social media, content, on-site video production, paid media, websites and branding. We serve mortgage, law, real estate, wealth management and health services, and we are growing into home services and skilled trades, led by solar.

We send our own videographers to film clients in person, at volume. Our team produces more than 37,000 pieces of content a month across the client base. Paid media is included in every package we sell, so the ads team touches a large share of our clients.

We are minority- and veteran-owned and fully remote. Real people do the work and AI makes them faster. We build brands strong enough that leads follow, and we tell clients exactly what is working, what isn't and what we are doing about it.

How we work: execution over conversation, industry fluency, ownership mentality and transparency.

**Role Mission**

Own FMO's paid social pipeline from ad strategy to monthly report, so every client campaign launches on time, tracks its leads correctly and gets reported on without anyone chasing it. About 80% of our ad work runs on Meta, followed by Google and TikTok.

**Who We Are Looking For**

You live in Meta Ads Manager. You have run paid social for a lot of clients at once and you liked it. You keep a 70-task board current every day without being reminded. When leads stop flowing at 4pm, you find the broken step and fix it that day. You can explain how an ad account, payment method, pixel and lead form connect, and you know why a report has to name its attribution window.

You care more about a signed client than a cheap click. You write clearly, follow up relentlessly and tell the truth when a campaign is underperforming. You work well inside a team where the Account Manager owns the client relationship and you own the paid account.

**Responsibilities and Expectations**

* Own the Ads Team Pipeline in Asana across roughly 40 live campaigns, plus proposals, builds and accounts on hold. Every task sits in the right stage and is updated within 1 business day of a change.
* Turn Account Manager ad requests into paid media proposals within 3 business days. Each one covers platform, objective, audience, budget, Special Ad Category and campaign structure.
* Confirm account readiness before any build starts: the client's own ad account, payment method, FMO access, healthy page and pixel, and signed paperwork. 100% of builds start ready.
* Launch approved campaigns within 5 business days of client approval and account readiness, mostly on Meta (Facebook and Instagram), plus Google and TikTok. Every ad is QA'd and previewed by the AM and client first.
* Set up Meta lead forms, call campaigns and lead routing into each client's CRM or lead sheet (Zapier, GoHighLevel or the client's IT team). Verify tracking at launch and at every report, and fix breaks within 1 business day.
* Optimize pacing, audiences, creative rotation and budget against each client's agreed cost per lead and lead volume, consulting the AM and client on budget changes.
* Deliver monthly reports on 100% of live campaigns by the 6th of each month, plus a first report within 14 days of every new launch. Join client calls to cover paid media when the AM brings you in.
* Coordinate the Paid Media Specialist: set weekly priorities, split builds and reporting, and be the first stop for questions.
* Keep admin access and recovery contacts documented on every account, so no account depends on one person.
* Post a daily end-of-day update in Slack: status, wins, risks and decisions needed.

**Required Experience and Skills**

**Required:**

* 2+ years hands-on in Meta Ads Manager, ideally at an agency running 20 or more client accounts at once
* Meta lead gen forms, call campaigns, Business Portfolio management and Special Ad Categories for housing, credit and employment
* Working knowledge of Google Ads and TikTok Ads
* Comfortable connecting lead routing with Zapier or a CRM and troubleshooting it when it breaks
* Daily project management in Asana or a similar tool
* Clear written English. Most of the work happens in Slack and Asana.
* Based in the US and available during Eastern business hours

**Preferred:**

* Advertising experience in mortgage, law, real estate or financial services
* GoHighLevel, CallRail, Supermetrics or YouTube ads
* Experience reporting cost per signed client from CRM data, not only cost per lead

**Benefits and Perks**

* Fully remote
* Paid time off
* 10 paid holidays
* Health Insurance reimbursement
* Referral bonus
* 401k + 401k match

**Schedule**

* Monday to Friday, 9am-5pm EST

Pay: From $55,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Work from home

This role advances Silver Key's position as a community hub that centers older adults while connecting generations through services, relationships, and shared experiences. Working closely with executive leadership, directors, and cross-functional teams, this role ensures that communications are not siloed, but instead serve as a unifying force that strengthens internal alignment and amplifies external impact.

This role ensures that Silver Key's communications are not just informative-but strategic-by aligning messaging, partnerships, and funding narratives into a cohesive story that strengthens the organization's impact and long-term sustainability.

**Job Summary**

Miller Service Company (MSC) is a Dallas high-end residential HVAC contractor with nearly 60 years of experience, serving a discerning, referral-only clientele. From high-end conventional systems to geothermal and VRF/VRV, our work is something to be proud of, and we're looking for a Marketing Specialist who can show it off and build MSC's brand.

In this role, you'll lead the marketing initiatives that drive MSC's growth. You'll own our social media and digital presence, tell the story of our work and our people, and turn that attention into leads for our service, new construction, and replacement teams. You'll work directly with MSC leadership and have real room to shape our marketing.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Plan, run, and track marketing initiatives that generate leads and grow the MSC brand
* Build and manage MSC's presence on Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn, Nextdoor, and Google Business Profile
* Create and schedule engaging content: project photos and video, team features, homeowner education, seasonal tips, and behind-the-scenes stories
* Grow our audience and following through consistent posting, community engagement, and fresh ideas
* Capture content in the field with our technicians, installers, and project teams
* Collect and promote customer reviews and manage MSC's online reputation
* Maintain website content and local search presence (SEO and Google Business Profile)

* Manage advertising spend, including paid social and local search
* Track results and report on leads, engagement, reach, and ROI
* Keep all marketing consistent with MSC's brand standards

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**Required:**

* - 2–4 years of professional marketing experience
* - Proven experience growing a brand's audience on social media, with examples you can show us
* - Working knowledge of the major social platforms and how each is used differently
* - Strong content creation skills: photography, short-form video, and basic editing
* - Excellent writing skills with a polished, professional voice
* - Comfort with a social scheduling tool and with analytics
* - Organized, self-directed, and able to manage multiple initiatives at once
* - Clear verbal communication and the ability to work with field and office teams

**Preferred:**

* - Experience marketing home services (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, remodeling, or similar)
* - Experience with paid advertising (Meta Ads, Google Ads)
* - Familiarity with SEO and local search
* - Experience with email marketing platforms and a CRM

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* - Direct access to leadership and a company committed to growing the right way

Apply through Indeed with your resume. Please include links to social accounts, campaigns, or content you've created or managed. **About Us**

Torro Media is an innovative digital marketing agency specializing in helping businesses achieve their online marketing goals through strategic, data-driven solutions. As *The Matadors of Marketing*, we pride ourselves on bold ideas, strong execution, and measurable results.

**Job Description**

As a Paid Media Manager at Torro Media, you will own paid advertising performance and outcomes for your client accounts. This role is responsible for developing strategy, translating it into execution, and ensuring every campaign is aligned with real business objectives—not just clicks, impressions, or traffic.

You will identify growth opportunities through data, customer behavior, competitive research, and platform insights, then execute strategies that drive measurable business results. You'll work closely with internal teams across SEO, Web Development, and Social Media, but you are ultimately responsible for moving client accounts forward, solving problems, and delivering exceptional performance.

This is a highly technical role requiring expertise in Google Ads, Meta Ads, analytics, conversion tracking, and campaign optimization. We are looking for someone who enjoys building campaigns from the ground up just as much as optimizing mature accounts.

**Key ResponsibilitiesAccount Ownership & Paid Media Strategy**

* Own, develop, and execute paid media strategies for assigned client accounts.
* Serve as the primary account owner for Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns.
* Translate client business goals into measurable paid advertising strategies.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships through proactive communication and strategic recommendations.
* Identify growth opportunities and proactively recommend new campaign initiatives.
* Connect campaign performance to business outcomes such as leads, revenue, sales, and return on investment.
* Manage campaign budgets efficiently while maximizing performance and profitability.

**Campaign Development & Management**

* Build campaigns from start to finish following industry best practices.
* Conduct comprehensive keyword research and audience research.
* Develop campaign structures that maximize performance and scalability.

* Search
* Shopping
* Performance Max
* AI Max
* Display
* Video
* Demand Generation
* Remarketing
* Meta Conversion Campaigns
* Meta Lead Generation Campaigns
* Develop compelling ad copy and creative recommendations.
* Configure bidding strategies based on campaign objectives.
* Continuously optimize campaigns through testing and data analysis.
* Manage multiple client accounts simultaneously while maintaining exceptional quality.

**Conversion Tracking & Technical Implementation**

Technical implementation is one of the most important aspects of this position.

The Paid Media Manager should possess advanced knowledge of conversion tracking implementation and troubleshooting.

Responsibilities include:

* Configure and maintain Google Tag Manager (GTM)
* Configure Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

* Implement Meta Pixel and Conversion API where appropriate
* Configure Enhanced Conversions
* Build and manage GA4 Events and Key Events
* Troubleshoot broken tracking implementations
* Validate conversion accuracy across platforms
* Assist with CRM integrations when needed
* Work closely with the web development team to implement advanced tracking solutions
* Understand attribution models and reporting accuracy
* Ensure campaign data is accurate, actionable, and reliable

**Performance Analysis & Optimization**

* Monitor campaign performance daily, weekly, and monthly.
* Analyze KPIs including:
* Cost Per Lead (CPL)
* Cost Per Acquisition (CPA)
* Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
* Click-Through Rate (CTR)
* Conversion Rate
* Cost Per Click (CPC)
* Impression Share
* Search Lost Impression Share
* Quality Score
* Identify optimization opportunities before clients ask.
* Develop testing strategies for:
* Ad copy
* Landing pages
* Audience targeting
* Bidding strategies
* Creative assets
* Campaign structure
* Continuously improve campaign performance using data-driven decision making.

**Reporting & Client Communication**

* Prepare professional monthly reports and campaign analyses.
* Clearly communicate campaign performance to clients in an understandable and strategic way.
* Translate complex advertising metrics into meaningful business insights.
* Present recommendations confidently during client meetings.
* Build strong, long-term client relationships through proactive communication.
* Educate clients on paid advertising best practices and platform changes.

**Team Collaboration**

* Collaborate with SEO, Web Development, Social Media, Design, and Account Management teams to ensure paid media campaigns align with broader marketing strategies.
* Coordinate landing page recommendations with designers and developers.
* Provide campaign insights that support cross-channel marketing initiatives.
* Share knowledge, best practices, and ideas across departments.
* Contribute to a collaborative, positive, and solution-oriented team culture.

**Innovation & Continuous Improvement**

* Stay current with updates across Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4, GTM, and emerging paid advertising technologies.
* Research and implement new campaign types, platform features, and automation opportunities.
* Leverage AI tools to improve campaign management efficiency while maintaining strategic oversight.
* Recommend improvements to internal PPC processes, reporting, and campaign workflows.
* Continuously improve how paid media is delivered across all client accounts.

**Success in This Role**

Success in this position means:

* Consistently achieving or exceeding client KPIs.
* Campaign tracking is implemented accurately and maintained proactively.
* Clients trust your recommendations and communication.

**About Glean:**

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.

At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.

Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.

If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.

Glean is seeking a strategic, analytical, and execution-oriented Director, Digital Marketing to lead the digital growth engine for our Enterprise AI platform. This leader will own Glean’s digital channels, web experience, and performance strategy, connecting audience insights and company priorities to measurable engagement, qualified pipeline, and revenue impact.

**About you:**

* 10+ years of digital, growth, performance, demand generation, or revenue marketing experience, including leadership experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, or AI.
* Proven success building multi-channel digital programs that drive qualified pipeline, revenue, and efficient growth in a complex, sales-led environment.
* Deep experience across paid search, paid social, programmatic or display, retargeting, web marketing, CRO, experimentation, SEO, analytics, and campaign operations.

**Location:**

**What are Trust Fund Positions?**

Trust Fund positions are unique to the Smithsonian. They are paid for from a variety of sources, including the Smithsonian endowment, revenue from our business activities, donations, grants and contracts. Trust employees are not part of the civil service, nor does trust fund employment lead to Federal status. The salary ranges for trust positions are generally the same as for federal positions and in many cases trust and federal employees work side by side. Trust employees have their own benefit program, which may include Health, Dental & Vision Insurance, Life Insurance, Transit/Commuter Benefits, Accidental Death and Dismemberment Insurance, Annual and Sick Leave, Family Friendly Leave, 403b Retirement Plan, Discounts for Smithsonian Memberships, Museum Stores and Restaurants, Credit Union, Smithsonian Early Enrichment Center (Child Care), Flexible Spending Account (Health & Dependent Care).

**About Darkroom**
------------------

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

**About the Role**

We are hiring for our Paid Media team, looking for a **Senior Director, Paid Search**: the head of Darkroom’s Paid Search practice. This is an executive leadership role. You’ll own the strategy, performance, and commercial health of the practice across Google, YouTube, Microsoft Advertising, and the emerging AI search ecosystem (including platforms like Perplexity, OpenAI, Koah, and Kontext as their ad products launch), lead a team of Associate Directors, Paid Search Managers, and Specialists, and be accountable for the outcomes paid search delivers across Darkroom’s client portfolio.

The ideal candidate is a recognized expert in search buying behavior who has already built and run a paid search organization. You’ve scaled Google ad accounts well beyond $1M USD per month, led teams that include people managers, and served as a trusted strategic advisor to CMOs and founders. You’re curious about where AI search is heading and want to be the person who defines how Darkroom shows up there. You think in systems, not campaigns, and you know how to build a team that runs those systems well.

You’ll report to the Managing Director of Paid Media and sit on the Paid Media leadership team, partnering with Darkroom leadership on practice growth, margin, hiring, and the evolution of our service offering. You’ll collaborate closely with Paid Social, Programmatic, Creative, Analytics, Growth Strategy, and Shadow, and will be responsible for building the next generation of paid search leaders at Darkroom.

This is a fast-paced, high-accountability environment for leaders who want to shape how a practice operates and grows. You’ll have the scope to define what best-in-class paid search looks like at Darkroom, at a moment when search itself is changing faster than it has in a decade.

Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

jobs.title: Account Manager - Digital Marketing
jobs.description:
**About Strive Marketing**

At Strive Marketing, we are more than just a digital agency; we are a growth partner for local businesses. We provide comprehensive inbound marketing strategies (including SEO, PPC, Web Design, and Video Marketing) to help our clients win. Our agency culture is built on collaboration, clear communication, and a strong sense of community. We measure our success by how long our clients stay with us and how loudly they recommend us.

**The Role**

We are looking for a detail-oriented, energetic, and relationship-driven Digital Marketing Account Manager to join our team in Sacramento. This role goes well beyond scheduling meetings and passing along updates. You will be the driving force behind client retention, building lasting relationships that turn clients into raving fans of Strive Marketing. As the bridge between our clients and our technical team, you will make sure campaigns run smoothly, results are clearly understood, and every client feels known, valued, and confident in their partnership with us.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Client Relationships & Retention:** Act as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for your clients. You will build genuine, long-term relationships through proactive communication via email, video calls, and in-person meetings. You own the client experience, anticipating needs before they become concerns, addressing issues quickly, and making sure clients feel heard and supported. Client retention is a core measure of success in this role.

**Campaign Oversight:** Oversee the progress of digital campaigns, including SEO, web design projects, and Paid Search (Google Ads, Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads, TikTok Ads, etc.).

**Data Interpretation & Strategy:** Review performance reports created by our technical team. Your goal is to interpret the data (keyword rankings, conversions, and ROI) and clearly communicate the “story” of the campaign’s success to the client, building trust and showing the value of our partnership.

**Growth & Agency Reputation:** Identify upsell opportunities to help clients grow their accounts. Turn happy clients into raving fans by actively requesting reviews for Strive Marketing (Google Business Profile or video testimonials). We offer a bonus for every review you secure!

**Team Collaboration:** Collaborate with the sales and technical teams on strategic initiatives, advocate for your clients’ needs internally, and assist with general agency operations to support business growth.

**Experience:** 2+ years of experience in an agency, account management, client success or client-facing role is preferred. A degree in Business, Marketing, or Communications is a plus.

**Local:** Currently lives in the Greater Sacramento area (Required).

**Tech Stack:** Proficiency in Google Suite (especially Google Sheets) is required. Experience with ClickUp is highly preferred as it is our primary project management tool. If you need an accommodation or an alternative format, please let us know.

**Hybrid Schedule:** Enjoy a balanced work week with remote days on Monday and Friday, and in-office collaboration Tuesday through Thursday.

**Growth Culture:** You’ll report directly to leadership that cares about your career path.

**Benefits:** Paid time off, paid holidays, flexible schedule, Health Benefits, 401k.

jobs.description:
Our Houston digital marketing team manages social media for a range of brands in the health and wellness, retail, professional services and home furnishings industries. We are hiring a Social Media Coordinator to manage publishing and community engagement for multiple client accounts and help capture content that brings each brand's strategy to life.

You will combine thoughtful publishing and audience engagement with hands-on content capture, working closely with our strategy, photography and production teams.

**About Steinreich Communications**

Steinreich Communications is an independent public relations and communications firm founded in 2003, with offices across the United States, Europe, the Middle East and Africa. The firm works in media relations, corporate communications, crisis, investor relations and public affairs, and its client roster spans national food and beverage, health and wellness, defense, technology, government, not-for-profit, consumer and home furnishings brands. Our Houston Digital Marketing team runs social-first content for a portfolio of local and national clients, and this role sits on that team.

**About the role**

You will own day-to-day publishing and community management for your assigned accounts, following each client's approved calendar, brand voice and service scope. We manually publish content during each client's allocated daily audience engagement time, with exceptions coordinated as needed. You will also support content sessions, helping clients feel comfortable on camera and making sure the planned footage is captured. Session cadence varies by client: monthly, every other month, quarterly or three times per year.

**What you will do:**

* **Publish approved content manually.** Manage feed posts, Reels, videos and Stories across multiple accounts according to each client's calendar. Prepare assets in advance and publish during allocated daily audience engagement time, coordinating exceptions when needed.
* **Own community management.** Respond to comments and DMs, engage with relevant audiences and flag inquiries or issues that need client input. Keep replies aligned with each brand's voice and work within the engagement time included in its scope.
* **Capture content at client sessions.** Work alongside our photographer and content team using cameras, iPhones, gimbals and stabilizers. Attend sessions as scheduled across the portfolio; individual clients have different session frequencies.
* **Guide clients on camera.** Help clients prepare for filming, provide clear direction during takes and capture footage that supports the approved content plan.
* **Keep shoots aligned with the plan.** Track the shot list and content requirements, adapt when needed and flag missing footage before the session ends.
* **Run boosting and support paid campaigns** in Meta Ads Manager.
* **Share performance insights.** Report on content performance, audience engagement and recurring questions each month to help the strategy team refine its recommendations.

**What we are looking for:Required**

* One or more years managing social accounts professionally, either at an agency or running several brands simultaneously in-house.
* Professional experience publishing and managing communities across multiple platforms, including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Pinterest, LinkedIn and YouTube. Familiarity with platform-specific formats, publishing tools and audience expectations.
* Experience publishing and managing Instagram and TikTok accounts day to day, including Stories.
* Based in the Houston area and available for in-person content sessions, which run weekly across the portfolio.
* Reliable availability during each client's daily engagement window, since we publish manually rather than scheduling in advance.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Meta Ads Manager, post boosting or paid social.
* Experience working with the Notion app.
* Your own portfolio or reel of content you shot, published, or both.
* Experience with a social scheduling or listening tool such as Later, Buffer or Sprout.

**How we work**

You will move between brands with different voices, audiences and posting schedules. Planning ahead matters: prepare approved posts before publishing time, keep track of engagement commitments and coordinate coverage when content sessions overlap with account responsibilities. Raise scheduling conflicts, missing approvals or client concerns early so the team can work through them.

**Compensation and benefits**

Salary range: $45,000 to $53,500 per year, depending on experience. Where a candidate lands in the band depends on filming ability, paid-social experience and how independently they can carry an account.

Benefits include:

* Medical, dental and vision coverage
* 401(k) with employer match
* Short- and long-term disability and life insurance
* A collaborative digital team with opportunities to contribute across a varied client portfolio
* A small, senior team where your work is visible and your name is on it

**How to apply**

Send your resume to careers@scompr.com with "Social Media Coordinator" in the subject line. Tell us which platforms you managed, roughly how many accounts you handled, and what you personally did in each example: filming, publishing, community management or paid support. If you have a portfolio, a reel or accounts you have run, include the links and we will look at those first.

Pay: $45,000.00 - $53,000.00 per year

* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Whether a prospect walks in for the first time or attends a BIG Money Retirement dinner seminar in that market, the experience should feel organized, professional, welcoming, and intentionally prepared.

 **Compensation:**

$50,000 - $65,000 yearly

 **Responsibilities:**

**LOCATION SEMINAR INVENTORY & EVENT READINESS**

* Maintain accurate local inventory of all seminar materials, prospect packets, seminar booklets, booking resources, event totes, technology equipment, client touchpoints, and reusable supplies within the assigned office — monitoring levels continuously and following the established cycle: Monitor Reorder Confirm Delivery Stock Prepare. Inventory is not restocked reactively after an event reveals a shortage. It is managed proactively so no shortage is possible.
* Coordinate all replenishment needs with the Events Coordinator before shortages develop — communicating inventory levels, projected event needs, and lead time requirements clearly and early enough for orders to arrive before they are needed. The Events Coordinator should never learn that a location is short on materials at the seminar.
* Complete a documented pre-event readiness check before every assigned dinner seminar — confirming that materials, equipment, venue requirements, and personnel assignments are fully prepared before the team leaves the office. The standard is ready before departure, not problem-solving at the venue. A readiness check completed at the venue is not a readiness check.
* Proactively identify inventory shortages, equipment issues, printing problems, late deliveries, or any other concern that could affect event execution — resolve them where possible and escalate to the Events Manager early enough for leadership to intervene. The Events Manager should never learn about a preventable problem for the first time at the seminar.
* Maintain the inventory tracking record for the assigned location as a current, accurate document — updated after every event to reflect consumption, confirmed deliveries, and projected needs for upcoming events. This record exists so anyone can assess the location's readiness at any moment without having to ask.

**LOCATION ADMINISTRATIVE & OFFICE OPERATIONS**

* Maintain the assigned Big Money Retirement office in a client-ready, professionally presented, and fully supplied state every business day — including lobby presentation, conference rooms, client-facing areas, marketing displays, printed collateral, and refreshment supplies for any client, any Advisor, any leadership visit, at any moment of the business day.
* Proactively identify anything in the office environment that is not at standard — a display that needs updating, a supply that is running low, a conference room that has not been reset, a lobby that does not reflect the firm's brand — and address it rather than waiting to be directed.
* Prepare all required prospect and client materials within the assigned location — including first-appointment packets, seminar follow-up materials, prospect folders, and Advisor meeting resources — ensuring all assembled materials are complete, correctly printed, professionally presented, and available on time. A first-appointment packet with a missing page or a misaligned insert is not a small detail. It is the firm's first impression in physical form.
* Personally greet every client and prospect who enters the assigned office — confirming who they are meeting, notifying the appropriate Advisor or team member promptly, offering appropriate refreshments, and ensuring every guest is seen, welcomed, and knows what happens next. No client or prospect should enter the office and wonder whether anyone noticed them. Every arrival is an experience. The Marketing Assistant owns it.
* Manage all location-level administrative tasks assigned by the Events Manager — including scheduling support, correspondence, supply ordering, vendor coordination, and any other operational function required to keep the location running smoothly. Administrative work is not background work. When it is done well, nothing falls through the cracks.

**SEMINAR EXECUTION & ACTIVE EVENT PARTICIPATION**

* Attend all assigned dinner seminars on the established seminar-day schedule — using the first portion of the shift to complete administrative and event-preparation responsibilities before transitioning to the venue, and remaining through the full completion of all teardown and close-out responsibilities. Seminar-day is not a split responsibility. It is a full commitment from preparation through close.
* Contribute actively to every seminar from arrival through teardown: lead or assist with full venue setup, greet every arriving guest by name, help create a warm and comfortable atmosphere before the Advisor presents, and work the room during appropriate portions of the evening to support the CES team and build prospect engagement. Active means visible, engaged, and contributing — not standing near the door waiting to be needed.
* Assist with booking activity and prospect inform

East Liverpool, Ohio  
Full-time | Salaried

ABOUT SUNSHINE

Sunshine Party & Event Rental provides tents, tables, chairs, inflatables, games, and event equipment for schools, churches, businesses, community organizations, and private celebrations throughout Ohio, Pennsylvania, and West Virginia.

We are looking for a creative, organized, outgoing marketing professional who wants to take ownership of marketing and help a growing local business reach its next stage.

We are accepting applications now and interviewing ahead of an anticipated January–February 2027 start.

THE OPPORTUNITY

This position combines hands-on marketing with business development. Approximately 70% of the role will focus on marketing and 30% on developing customer relationships and new business.

You will work directly with the owner and coordinate with our operations manager and existing sales team. You will have room to bring ideas, improve processes, and demonstrate measurable results.

Our sales team already handles incoming inquiries. Your primary responsibility will be creating demand, encouraging repeat bookings, and developing new opportunities.

**Social Media Content Specialist**

Steinreich Communications · Houston, Northern New Jersey or the Piedmont-Triad area of North Carolina · Full-time

We are hiring a Social Media Content Specialist to turn creative plans into polished social content for our digital team's clients. You will film content and own the editing, design and monthly calendar production for your assigned accounts, working closely with our strategy and account teams.

Day to day, that means filming at client content sessions, cutting short-form video for Reels, TikToks and Stories, designing graphics and monthly feed layouts in Canva, writing captions and keywords in each brand's voice, and building the complete monthly content calendar for every account you own.

**About Steinreich Communications**

Steinreich Communications is an independent public relations and communications firm founded in 2003, with offices across the United States, Europe, the Middle East and Africa. The firm works in media relations, corporate communications, crisis, investor relations and public affairs, and its client roster spans national food and beverage, health and wellness, defense, technology, government, not-for-profit, consumer and home furnishings brands. Our Houston Digital Marketing team runs social-first content for a portfolio of local and national clients, and this role sits on that team.

**About the role**

Reporting to Erika Ruiz, Senior Vice President of Digital Marketing, you will manage content production and content calendar development for multiple client accounts varying in scope. This is a hands-on role combining filming, short-form video editing, graphic design and social copywriting. Our strategy team develops the direction and content plans; you bring them to life through content sessions, finished assets and organized monthly calendars. You will collaborate with the account director on internal review and communicate with clients about approvals and revisions.

**What you will do:**

* **Build monthly content calendars.** Turn approved content plans and raw footage into complete calendars for assigned accounts, including edited videos, graphics, captions and assets ready for internal review and client approval.
* **Film and edit short-form video.** Attend client content sessions and capture footage for Reels, TikToks and Stories, then turn raw footage into finished, captioned, on-brand cuts.
* **Design graphics, carousels and templates** in Canva, and design each client's monthly feed layout as a whole rather than post by post.
* **Write captions, hashtags and SEO keywords** in each brand's voice, not your own.
* **Coordinate client approvals and revisions.** Share work after internal review, clarify feedback and manage updates while keeping the account team informed of changes to scope or timing.
* **Maintain a cohesive visual identity.** Apply each brand's guidelines with thoughtful typography, color, composition and video pacing, and check your work for accuracy and consistency before review.
* **Contribute to our own social media presence.** Develop ideas, film and edit content, and publish 2–4 approved posts per month on our agency's social accounts, collaborating with the team to showcase our work, people and expertise. Attend 2–3 team content sessions per year involving both photography and video.

**What we are looking for:Required**

* Two or more years of professional short-form social video experience, with demonstrated skills in both filming and editing across multiple brands or in an agency setting.
* Strong graphic design skills demonstrated in a portfolio, including layout, typography, color and the ability to adapt designs to distinct brand identities.
* Working proficiency in CapCut or an equivalent editor (Premiere, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve) and in Canva.
* Experience writing clear, accurate social captions in different brand voices.
* Strong organization and experience managing production deadlines and revisions across multiple client accounts.
* Experience communicating directly with clients, including receiving and acting on revision notes.
* Candidates should be based in either the Houston, Northern New Jersey or Piedmont-Triad area of North Carolina in order to be close to their teams, and able to travel for select client content sessions.

**Preferred**

* Experience working in the Notion app.
* Experience designing a full monthly feed layout, not only individual posts.
* Experience art directing or briefing a shoot.

**How we work**

We are open to candidates based in the Houston, Northern New Jersey or Piedmont-Triad areas, close to the teams they will work with. You will travel for select client content sessions, and a Houston-based candidate attends the sessions for their own accounts in person. Mileage reimbursement applies to eligible travel, and required travel expenses are covered. You will balance production, feedback and revisions across multiple accounts. Content calendars typically turn around in about three days, depending on scope. Flag missing assets, competing deadlines or changes in scope early so priorities can be worked through with the account team.

**Compensation and benefits**

Salary range: $60,000 to $68,000 per year, depending on experience. Where a candidate lands in the band depends on editing and design range, how many accounts they can carry independently, and whether they can art direct a content session rather than only shoot it.

Benefits include:

* Medical, dental and vision coverage
* 401(k) with employer match
* Short- and long-term disability and life insurance
* Paid holidays and paid time off
* A collaborative digital team with opportunities to contribute creatively across a varied client portfolio

**How to apply**

Send your resume and portfolio to careers@scompr.com with "Social Media Content Specialist" in the subject line. Include your portfolio and/or short-form video samples you filmed and edited, plus graphics or carousels you designed

Intracoastal Wellness Center is looking for a versatile, patient-focused professional to run our body contouring program from start to finish. You will perform Emsculpt Neo and iLipo treatments, guide patients from first consult through completed packages, and create the marketing content that brings new patients in. This role fits someone who is as comfortable behind a camera or analytics dashboard as they are in a treatment room.

Responsibilities

**Treatment Administration**

* Perform Emsculpt Neo and iLipo treatments per practice protocols and physician supervision
* Prepare patients, set parameters, monitor comfort and response, and document each session accurately in the EHR
* Maintain and sanitize equipment, and keep treatment rooms stocked and compliant
* Track patient progress, including measurements and before/after photos, to support outcomes and marketing

**Patient Consults & Sales**

* Conduct consultations to assess goals, explain treatment options, and recommend appropriate packages
* Present pricing, financing, and promotions clearly and ethically
* Close and enroll patients in Emsculpt Neo and iLipo packages, and meet monthly sales goals
* Run outreach calls and follow-ups to leads, existing patients, and event registrants

**Patient Care Coordination**

* Schedule full treatment series and keep patients on track
* Be the main point of contact for questions, concerns, and post-treatment check-ins
* Coordinate with providers, front desk, and manufacturer reps to give patients a smooth experience
* Encourage retention, rebooking, reviews, and referrals

**Nutrition Analysis & Support**

* Review patient intake and nutrition data to support body composition goals
* Give general nutrition guidance that complements treatment results, within your scope of practice
* Flag anything that needs a provider's attention

**Marketing & Content**

* Create graphics, social media content, and short-form video (Reels) for our services, events, and promotions
* Edit and publish content on a consistent schedule
* Track and analyze analytics (reach, engagement, lead sources, conversions) and recommend adjustments
* Help plan and promote in-office events, such as trial days and patient education sessions

Qualifications

* Experience with body contouring or aesthetic devices (Emsculpt Neo and iLipo preferred), or willingness to be trained and certified
* Proven sales or consultative selling experience, ideally in aesthetics, wellness, or healthcare
* Strong skills in Canva, Adobe, CapCut, or similar editing tools, and familiarity with social platform analytics (Meta, Instagram)
* Working knowledge of nutrition principles (formal credential a plus)
* Experience with an EHR/CRM (Eclipse EHR a plus)
* Excellent communication, organization, and follow-through
* Comfort with HIPAA and patient privacy standards

What Success Looks Like

* Patients finish their treatment series and feel cared for at every step
* Package sales and consult-to-close rates meet or exceed targets
* Marketing content drives measurable lead growth
* Treatment documentation is accurate and complete

Pay: $20.00 - $22.00 per hour

Expected hours: 25.0 – 35.0 per week

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off

**Job Type:** Full-Time | In-Person

**Department:** Marketing, Catering & Events

**Reports To:** Marketing Director and Food Truck/Catering Manager

We are looking for an organized, energetic, and dependable **Event Coordinator & Marketing Liaison** to join our team in a full-time, in-person position.

This individual will work closely with our Marketing Director and Food Truck/Catering Manager to support daily marketing operations, catering orders, food truck events, and special promotions.

* Help promote restaurant specials, upcoming events, catering services, and food truck appearances.
* Assist with capturing photos and videos for social media and promotional purposes.
* Help organize marketing materials, promotional items, and event supplies.
* Support marketing campaigns, giveaways, and community outreach initiatives.

**Catering & Food Truck Operations**

* Assist the Food Truck/Catering Manager with daily operations and scheduling.

**Event Coordination & Administrative Support**

* Help coordinate event logistics, supplies, and setup requirements.

**Marketing Strategist & Campaign Manager**

**Milah’s | Remote | Contract | Project-Based**

**About Milah’s**

**Milah’s is a B2B marketing agency that operates nationally and internationally, helping businesses strengthen their brand visibility, expand their market presence, and pursue strategic growth opportunities through marketing, branding, and digital promotional services.**

**We are building our core marketing and creative team to support incoming client projects and the continued development of our agency. We are seeking a strategic, organized, and results-oriented Marketing Strategist & Campaign Manager who can translate client goals into structured marketing plans and coordinate campaign execution.**

**This is an opportunity to join an emerging agency at an early stage, contribute to the development of its marketing operations, and potentially grow into a longer-term role as the company expands its client base and takes on larger projects.**

**Position Overview**

**The Marketing Strategist & Campaign Manager will develop marketing strategies, organize campaign activities, coordinate deliverables, and help ensure that client marketing initiatives align with their objectives and purchased service packages.**

**This is a remote, contract-based opportunity structured around client projects and recurring 30-day service cycles. Initial assignments are expected to begin once Milah’s secures its first client and the project scope, deliverables, schedule, and compensation have been agreed upon.**

**The position is designed for a professional who is comfortable working in an early-stage agency environment, contributing ideas, taking initiative, and helping establish effective marketing processes as the client roster grows.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Marketing Strategy & Planning**

* **Develop customized marketing strategies based on client objectives, target audiences, brand positioning, and business priorities.**
* **Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and audience research to identify opportunities for brand differentiation and growth.**
* **Help develop campaign concepts, marketing calendars, promotional strategies, and content direction.**
* **Recommend appropriate marketing channels and campaign approaches based on client goals and contracted services.**
* **Support the development of marketing proposals, strategic recommendations, and client-facing presentations.**

**Campaign Management & Coordination**

* **Organize marketing activities and deliverables within each 30-day client service cycle.**
* **Coordinate campaign timelines, priorities, approvals, and deadlines.**
* **Collaborate with the creative content specialist to communicate campaign objectives, creative briefs, messaging, and content requirements.**
* **Ensure that marketing activities remain consistent with client brand identities and agreed scopes of work.**
* **Monitor campaign progress and identify opportunities to improve execution.**
* **Maintain organized project documentation, client requirements, and campaign records.**

**Performance Monitoring & Reporting**

* **Identify appropriate key performance indicators (KPIs) based on each client’s objectives.**
* **Review available campaign analytics and engagement data.**
* **Prepare concise performance summaries and recommendations for future campaigns.**
* **Identify potential improvements to messaging, audience targeting, content direction, and channel strategy.**
* **Communicate findings clearly without promising results that cannot be guaranteed.**

**Proposal & Business Development Support**

* **Assist with research, marketing strategy, campaign planning, and supporting materials for prospective client proposals.**
* **Contribute strategic input to Milah’s proposal for the City of Palm Desert Tourism Marketing and Creative Services opportunity, as applicable to the agreed scope and project timeline.**
* **Help develop repeatable marketing processes that support future client onboarding and campaign delivery.**

**Working With the Milah’s Team**

**The Marketing Strategist & Campaign Manager will collaborate with agency leadership, sales representatives, sales management, and creative personnel.**

**Sales representatives and sales management handle their designated sales and revenue-generation responsibilities. This position focuses on marketing strategy, campaign coordination, and client delivery rather than sales prospecting or closing deals.**

**The creative content specialist will focus on producing agreed-upon visual and multimedia assets. The strategist will define the marketing purpose, campaign direction, messaging, and content requirements so that creative production supports the overall strategy.**

**Responsibilities and workload will depend on the package purchased, project requirements, and deliverables agreed upon before work begins.**

**Client Packages & 30-Day Service Cycles**

**Milah’s offers multiple levels of marketing and promotional services, including placement-based promotions and more comprehensive marketing packages.**

**The strategist will support the services included in each assigned client engagement. Depending on the package, this may involve campaign planning, marketing coordination, content calendars, research, performance review, and strategic recommendations.**

**Each client engagement will have a defined scope of work and a 30-day service cycle where applicable. Workload, deliverables, and time commitments may vary by client and package.**

**Compensation & Initial Engagement**

**This is an initial contract opportunity with fixed, project-based compensation structured around assigned client work and the applicable 30-day service cycle.**

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Marketing Operations
jobs.description:
Restaurant365 is transforming how restaurants run their businesses. Today, we help more than 50,000 restaurant locations manage their finances, operations, and people. As AI changes what's possible, we're reimagining how restaurant back offices operate—automating routine work, helping teams make better decisions, and giving restaurant leaders more time to focus on growing their businesses.

We're transforming how we work, too. AI is changing how we build products, solve problems, and deliver results for our customers. We're embracing new ways of working, moving faster, and creating opportunities for our people to make a greater impact.

At Restaurant365, our culture is built on ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We believe in challenging ourselves, learning every day, and working together to achieve great results. We're looking for people who are curious, take initiative, and want to grow while helping shape the future of an industry.

We are looking for an AI-forward leader to lead Marketing Operations at Restaurant365. This person runs the systems, data, and processes behind our demand generation engine and owns lead flow from first touch to sales handoff. That includes HubSpot and Salesforce administration, scoring and routing, campaign tracking, and the reporting marketing leadership uses to make budget and program decisions. You will set the direction for how the MOPs team uses AI, build the agents and automated workflows yourself, and train the team to build and run them. You will report to the VP of Revenue Operations, work daily with Demand Generation leadership, and coordinate with Sales, Sales Development, Customer Support, and Finance.

### **Responsibilities**

* Manage and develop Marketing Operations team members, setting clear priorities, coaching performance, and ensuring timely delivery of operational initiatives.
* Manage and optimize the marketing technology stack Hubspot, Salesforce, LeanData, Allgood, ZoomInfo, 6sense, Qualified, Active.ly), using automation and AI capabilities to improve workflows, segmentation, lead scoring, reporting, and data quality.
* Partner with Marketing leadership to implement and maintain consistent definitions and reporting for lead scoring, campaign attribution, funnel efficiency, and conversion benchmarks.
* Improve cross-functional processes and reporting standards across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Support to reduce friction and provide reliable, actionable insights.
* Maintain marketing attribution and reporting frameworks, including multi-touch attribution, campaign ROI analysis, and dashboards that demonstrate marketing contribution to pipeline and revenue.
* Lead marketing automation platform implementations and migrations, including HubSpot, overseeing data migration, CRM integrations, workflow configuration, lead scoring, campaign operations, testing, and user adoption.

jobs.title: Account-Based Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
At SolarWinds, we're a people-first company. Our purpose is to enrich the lives of the people we serve—including our employees, customers, shareholders, partners, and communities. Join us in our mission to help customers accelerate business transformation with simple, powerful, and secure solutions.

The ideal candidate thrives in an innovative, fast-paced environment and is collaborative, accountable, ready, and empathetic. We're looking for individuals who believe they can accomplish more as a team and create lasting growth for themselves and others. We hire based on attitude, competency, and commitment. Solarians are ready to advance our world-class solutions in a fast-paced environment and accept the challenge to lead with purpose. If you're looking to build your career with an exceptional team, you've come to the right place. Join SolarWinds and grow with us!

**About the role**  
SolarWinds is looking for an Account Based Marketer to drive pipeline and revenue from our highest-value ITSM target accounts, across both new business and expansion within our existing customer base. Using intent data, you'll find in-market buyers, build vertical campaigns that speak to their priorities, and run targeted engagement programs that earn meetings. Data enrichment tools such as Clay will help you grow the number of marketable contacts within target accounts, and you'll write custom, targeted sales sequences to reach them.

Work arrangement  
**This is a hybrid role based in Austin, TX, with 3 days per week in our Austin office.**

**What you will do**

* Pipeline and revenue: Own ABM targets for sourced and influenced pipeline and revenue, across new logo acquisition and customer upsell, cross-sell and expansion.
* 6sense: Own the 6sense platform for ITSM. Build and maintain segments, account scoring, buying stage models and intent keyword sets. Launch 6sense advertising and orchestration plays and deliver account insights to sales.
* Sales sequences: Write custom, targeted sales sequences in for priority accounts, verticals and personas. Partner with sales to launch sequences tied to intent signals and ABM plays, and test messaging to improve reply and meeting rates.
* Customer expansion: Build plays that identify expansion signals in the installed base and help account managers grow existing customers into additional SolarWinds ITSM products and seats.
* Incentives and gifting: Build and manage meeting-for-incentive programs, survey offers, direct mail and e-gifting through platforms such as Sendoso, Reachdesk or Alyce to engage key contacts, drive qualified conversations and accelerate active deals.
* GTM alignment: Partner with sales, BDR and customer success leaders on target account lists built from SolarWinds ICPs, account plans, sales sequences and follow-up. Run regular pipeline reviews by segment and vertical.
* Measurement: Report on account engagement, contact enrichment, sequence performance, meetings booked, cost per meeting, meeting-to-opportunity conversion, pipeline created, velocity, win rates and expansion revenue for target accounts. Use results to refine targeting and spend.
* Collaboration: Coordinate with digital growth, demand generation, events and marketing operations so account plays connect across every channel.

**What you bring**

* 4 to 6 years of B2B marketing experience, with at least 2 years in account-based marketing, ideally in SaaS or IT software
* A track record of ABM programs that delivered measurable pipeline and revenue from both new logos and existing customers
* Hands-on experience administering 6sense (or Demandbase, Terminus or a similar ABM platform)
* Experience using Clay or similar data enrichment tools to expand contact coverage within target accounts, and writing sales sequences in Outreach (or Salesloft or a similar platform)
* Experience running vertical or industry-focused campaigns
* Experience managing incentive, gifting or direct mail programs, including vendors and budgets
* Proficiency with Salesforce and marketing automation (Marketo, Eloqua or HubSpot)
* Strong analytical skills and comfort reporting on pipeline and ROI
* Excellent communication skills and a collaborative style with sales and customer success teams
* Strong writing skills, including sales sequences that drive replies and meetings

**Nice to have**

* 6sense certification
* Familiarity with ITSM, service desk or IT operations buyers and buying committees, and how to turn them into target account strategies
* Experience with Sendoso, Reachdesk, Alyce or similar gifting platforms
* Experience building Clay waterfall enrichment workflows across multiple data providers
* Experience with intent data, account scoring and buying stage models

The client you will be working for is a Top 20 Fortune Global 500 Consumer Electronics and Technology Company. This opportunity will give you experience in the technology sector in the United States with a company that is a globally recognized leader in smartphones, televisions, home appliances, and semiconductor innovation — and one of the most well-known brands in the world.

Monday-Friday, 40 hours
  
Fully onsite
