12-month contract with high likelihood of extension or conversion to full-time employee

**POSITION OVERVIEW – Brand Marketing Communications Manager, Home Entertainment**  
You'll make sure everything customers see about TVs, audio, memory, and monitors looks right and says the right thing. You'll work day to day with the launch, go-to-market, and paid media teams, writing and polishing product copy, checking creative work against brand guidelines, coordinating translations for other markets, and tracking legal review so approved wording makes it into the final assets. You'll also keep launch toolkits and messaging documents organized and up to date. It's a hands-on role for someone who loves details and wants to protect the quality and consistency of a big product lineup.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**  
**Product Messaging Execution & Maintenance**  

* Execute product messaging across home entertainment launches and campaigns in line with the positioning frameworks and messaging architecture set by the Sr. Manager, writing and refining consumer-facing copy including headlines, feature callouts, and product descriptions
* Partner with the go-to-market (GTM) team to validate that messaging deliverables align with go-to-market strategy, launch timing, and channel-specific requirements
* Maintain a master messaging document for each product line, tracking approved copy, claim status, and version history as the cross-functional source of truth

**Brand Guidelines Application & Governance**  

* Apply and enforce brand guidelines across all creative assets, serving as a day-to-day brand steward for the integrated marketing team
* Review creative from internal teams and agency partners for adherence to global brand standards and category-specific guidance, flagging inconsistencies and coordinating revisions through to resolution
* Support the Sr. Manager in cascading brand guideline updates to relevant teams and documenting category-specific brand application rules

**Localization Execution & Quality Control**  

* Manage day-to-day execution of localization workflows for marketing assets, coordinating with translation vendors, regional teams, and the Integrated Marketing team to ensure on-time, accurate delivery
* Review localized assets against source files to confirm messaging intent, visual standards, and brand voice are preserved across all markets and languages
* Maintain organized records of localization scope, status, and approvals across all active launches and campaigns

**Creative Standards, Toolkit & Governance**  

* Apply established creative best practices to asset briefs, creative reviews, and production feedback, and keep the best practices library updated with new learnings from campaign performance and platform updates
* Support the development and ongoing management of product launch and campaign toolkits, ensuring assets are brand-aligned, messaging-approved, version-controlled, and include all required components before distribution
* Coordinate the day-to-day legal review process for creative assets, tracking submission status, ensuring approved language is accurately reflected in final deliverables, and flagging claims that need re-review
* Conduct thorough QA checks across all asset types before publication or distribution

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS/SKILLS**  

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Advertising, or a related field
* 4+ years of experience in brand marketing, content strategy, creative operations, or integrated marketing
* Strong copywriting and messaging skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate product features into brand-consistent, consumer-relevant content
* Solid understanding of brand guidelines, with hands-on experience applying and enforcing visual and verbal brand standards across multiple asset types
* Experience coordinating legal review processes and managing compliance documentation for marketing assets
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, able to manage multiple concurrent workstreams across different product lines and campaigns
* Comfortable working cross-functionally with GTM, paid media, legal, and creative teams in a fast-paced environment

**Preferred**  

* Experience in consumer electronics, tech, or a related category
* Familiarity with eCommerce content workflows, including product detail page (PDP) execution
* Experience managing or supporting localization workflows across multiple markets
* Exposure to digital asset management (DAM) systems and creative production pipelines
* Experience building or maintaining toolkits, creative best practice libraries, or brand resource hubs
* Background working with or alongside HQ or global brand teams in a subsidiary or regional marketing structure

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you interested in shaping and elevating the customer and brand experience for Premium Fashion on Amazon?  
  
We are looking for a results-driven Brand Manager (BM) to join Amazon Fashion's exciting and fast-paced Premium Fashion Concierge (PFC) team. This individual will own the end-to-end strategy for onboarding and managing strategic corporate priority selling partners, and will lead initiatives that drive measurable impact and growth across the broader Premium Fashion program.  
  
The Premium Fashion Brand Manager will define and execute the shopping experience for premium customers, while partnering closely with Premium Brands to grow their selection, enhance their brand storytelling through new onsite experiences, and unlock new revenue opportunities. In this role, the BM will develop and own strategies for sustained long-term growth, drive brands toward improved operational performance, and build scalable programs that set the standard for the broader organization.  
  
A successful candidate will be a self-starter motivated by an entrepreneurial, fast-paced, and highly collaborative environment, with high quality standards and a passion for delivering best-in-class experiences for customers. They should demonstrate the ability to think both strategically and analytically about the business, influence without authority across cross-functional teams, build clear processes in the face of ambiguity, and drive alignment across multiple stakeholders and organizations.  
  
A strong sense of ownership, bias for action, and the ability to independently drive execution end-to-end while mentoring junior team members is a must.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own and cultivate strategic relationships with key brand partners and internal stakeholder teams across the Premium Fashion portfolio, serving as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor

  

* Act as the strategic 'business owner' for assigned brands and vendors, possessing deep understanding of internal and external variables that impact the business and proactively identifying risks and opportunities

  

* Develop and execute comprehensive selection growth strategies to expand brands' full product catalog and availability on Amazon, ensuring an ideal customer experience

  

* Design and implement scalable playbook processes and frameworks to define, simplify, improve, and accelerate growth for all Premium Brands across the program

  

* Lead the creation of Joint Business Plans with Premium vendors on an annual basis, conducting regular business reviews with senior leadership regarding progress, roadblocks, and strategic pivots

  

* Analyze data and customer insights to continuously identify opportunities to improve the customer experience, making actionable recommendations to the business backed by quantitative analysis

  

* Serve as the strategic voice of Premium Brands, influencing partner teams and senior leadership to enhance tools, systems, and policies based on program findings and brand feedback

  

* Identify and lead cross-functional initiatives that drive programmatic improvements, partnering with Product, Tech, Marketing, and Operations teams

  

* Mentor and develop junior team members (Associate Brand Managers), providing guidance on brand strategy, vendor management, and professional growth

  
About the team  
You will be joining 5 Vendor Managers on the Premium Fashion Concierge (PFC) Team (6 total). PFC is a new team (launched 2022) created with a vision of improving the brand experience for Premium Selling Partners working with Amazon. PFC supports the growth of strategic Premium Brands, and is helping to build and define the future of Premium Fashion on Amazon.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of with Excel experience
* 3+ years of retail, operations, product or program management, or business management/consulting with negotiations and delivering results experience
* Bachelor's degree, or 3+ years of professional or military experience
* Experience with financial analysis and P&L ownership

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience managing large data sets and utilizing to drive performance and process improvements
* Experience in vendor negotiations, pricing and promotion, inventory management, and product development
* Usage of generative AI tools to enhance workflow efficiency, with a willingness to learn effective prompting and evaluation practices
* Ability to recognize opportunities where generative AI could enhance products, workflows, or customer experiences

  
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.description:
**Company Description**  
For over 100 years, BlueScope continues to build on our reputation of quality brands and products, leading technology and a customer-first spirit. Through our global brands, we are one of the largest manufacturers of building solutions in the world. Our diverse, bright and inspired workforce is committed to bettering the communities we serve through breakthrough thinking and innovations. Your goals, ideas and perspective can help shape our future – we look forward to hearing them!

BlueScope is seeking a strategic marketing leader to drive growth, innovation, and market expansion across our residential building products portfolio. This role sits at the intersection of market strategy, customer insight, product development, channel growth, and planning.

Working with senior leadership and partners across sales, innovation, manufacturing, supply chain, finance, digital, and customer experience, you will help identify high-value opportunities, validate product-market fit, supporting the development of marketing strategies that brings new solutions to market.  
  
This position is eligible for remote work; however, candidates must reside in one of the following states: **California, Florida, Illinois, Kansas, Missouri, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, or Texas.**

**What You'll Own**

* Develop the North American growth strategy for the residential building products market.
* Lead market, segment, customer, channel, and competitive assessments to identify attractive growth opportunities and plays.
* Define priority customer and influencer segments, including distributors, lumberyards, dealers, roll formers, contractors, builders, architects, designers, and homeowners.
* Build go-to-market strategies, value propositions, customer journeys, channel models, and activation plans for priority segments.
* Build a segment demand and forecast model for the residential segment.
* Validate product-market fit and channel acceptance through customer research, pilots, partner feedback, and stage-gate decisions.
* Establish scorecards that track adoption, distribution, leads, conversion, revenue, volume, margin, mix, and customer experience.
* Build a sequenced three-year segment and channel growth roadmap, including capability, resource, technology, partnership, and capital needs.
* Develop influential relationships with customers, partners, industry organizations, and market influencers.

**Why This Role Stands Out**

* Shape a growth strategy with impact across the North American residential market.
* Influence product innovation from early market insight through commercialization and scale.
* Partner broadly across the business and gain visibility with senior leadership.
* Help grow brand equity, segment share, customer adoption, and long-term profitability.
* Work from a flexible U.S. location while staying close to customers, partners, and the market.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
* 7+ years of experience in strategic marketing, product marketing, commercialization, market development, category management, brand management, or a related commercial function.
* Experience developing and executing segment, channel, marketing, or go-to-market plans.
* Proven experience launching new products, solutions, or brands and managing commercialization from planning through execution.
* Experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives with partners in sales, product development, operations, supply chain, or marketing.
* Strong analytical skills and experience using market research, customer insights, competitive intelligence, and business economics to guide decisions.
* Demonstrated project management, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills.
* Experience managing marketing budgets, priorities, timelines, and performance measures.
* Ability and willingness to travel up to 50% throughout North America.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in building products, residential or commercial construction, construction materials, manufacturing, industrial products, or a related industry.
* Experience with channel strategy, distributor or dealer networks, contractor-focused marketing, or multi-step routes to market.
* Experience in category management, segment marketing, portfolio strategy, or market development.
* Knowledge of residential construction trends, building systems, customer buying behavior, or building code considerations.
* Experience working with established brands and driving growth through positioning, channel activation, and customer experience.
* Experience partnering with digital teams to support market growth and improve the customer journey.
* MBA or other advanced degree in Business, Marketing, or a related discipline.

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $147,600 - $171,200 annually, plus an annual incentive opportunity. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

**Additional Information**  
The preceding job responsibilities and tasks were designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by associates in this job. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all job duties and responsibilities required of associates assigned to this job. Associates may be required to perform other duties as assigned. Additional job competencies, individual goals, and performance measurements are set at the department level.

**Position:**

Marketing and Brokerage Coordinator

Miami, Florida

**About Us:**

VSRE is a full-service commercial real estate firm specializing in industrial properties. Headquartered in Miami, Florida, with a New York City office supporting our property management division, we provide institutional-grade brokerage, development, and property management services. With more than 20 million square feet of leasing and management assignments and millions of square feet in our development pipeline, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional value through innovation, integrity, and client-focused service.

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a detail-oriented Marketing and Brokerage Coordinator who combines strong marketing production skills with dependable administrative follow-through. You will help our team bring industrial properties to market, prepare persuasive client materials, maintain accurate listing and contact information, and keep brokerage assignments organized from initial inquiry through transaction completion. You will work closely with our brokers, leadership, development, and property management teams.

**Responsibilities:**

· Marketing collateral: Create and update property flyers, brochures, offering memorandums, tour books, maps, signage, and team credentials using VSRE templates. Coordinate photography, aerial imagery, video, printing, and other vendors within approved budgets.

· Listing platforms: Maintain property information on the VSRE website and approved platforms such as CoStar and LoopNet. Confirm availability, suite sizes, asking terms, photographs, and broker contacts; promptly update or remove listings when status changes.

· Industrial property information: Organize and verify building and site specifications, including clear height, loading, office area, power, truck access, and delivery timing. Identify missing or inconsistent information and obtain confirmation before publication.

· Proposals and pitches: Assemble listing presentations, leasing proposals, responses to requests for proposals, market surveys, and comparable-property summaries. Gather broker-approved pricing, research, case studies, and team qualifications.

· Market research and reporting: Collect, organize, and verify market statistics and research provided by the team, and use company templates to prepare recurring market overview reports. Coordinate team input, maintain consistent formatting and source references, and ensure reports are accurate and completed on schedule.

· Digital marketing and social media: Manage VSRE’s social media accounts and content calendar; create, schedule, and publish approved property listings, company news, market insights, and other marketing content. Coordinate organic and paid social media campaigns within approved budgets, monitor engagement and inquiries, route leads to brokers, and report campaign performance. Support email campaigns and website updates while maintaining consistent branding and messaging across digital channels.

· Transaction coordination: Maintain deal checklists, document versions, signature status, and broker-confirmed deadlines. Assemble approved letters of intent and proposal packages, coordinate document circulation, and provide complete transaction and commission documentation to accounting.

· Quality control: Check facts, calculations, spelling, branding, links, image rights, and version consistency before release. Maintain organized templates and source files, obtain required approvals, and protect confidential client and transaction information.

o At least 3 years of relevant marketing, brokerage support, or professional services coordination experience, with examples of polished client-facing materials.

o Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook, plus Adobe InDesign or a comparable professional layout tool; ability to learn and maintain VSRE templates.

o Strong writing, proofreading, organization, and client service skills; ability to manage multiple deadlines, work independently, and follow through with colleagues and vendors.

o Experience maintaining contact databases or CRM records and producing digital or email marketing content.

o Ability to interpret commercial lease terms, prepare lease abstracts, and calculate commissions using applicable agreements and company templates.

o Experience managing business social media accounts and coordinating content calendars and campaigns.

o Ability to organize market data in Excel and prepare accurate recurring reports using company templates.

· Preferred

o Commercial real estate experience, especially industrial leasing or sales in South Florida; familiarity with CoStar, LoopNet, and brokerage transaction workflows.

o Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field; Adobe Creative Cloud experience; website content management and campaign reporting skills; professional Spanish communication skills.

VSRE offers a competitive salary based on experience and qualifications, with performance-based bonus opportunities. Our benefits package

As part of our Performance Marketing Center of Excellence (CoE), the Marketing Operations Manager ensures the integrity of our marketing data, systems, and performance measurement. jobs.title: Senior Manager, SEO/AEO (AI Search)
jobs.description:
**Reports to:** Eric Siu, CEO  
**Type:** Full-time, client-facing player-coach. Not a people-manager seat.  
**Clients:** an assigned book of Single Grain SEO/AEO accounts  
**Location:** Full-time, remote, with at least 4 hours of US time-zone overlap  
**Comp:** $100,000–$150,000 USD / year

**One-liner**
-------------

Get Single Grain clients cited in AI answers and growing qualified organic pipeline, with agents doing most of the production.

**About the role**
------------------

Single Grain combines marketing services, software, and AI. Search is splitting between Google and answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews), and buyers now build their shortlist before they click. This seat owns SEO and AEO for an assigned set of client accounts: what to ship, why, and how we will know it worked.

You are the client's organic strategist and you stay hands-on. You set the roadmap, you build the agents that do the production, and you report citations and pipeline, not ranking screenshots.

You should be an advanced AI user. You will work inside Single Brain (our agent operating layer) and ClickFlow (our AI content-optimization platform), and build your own workflows in tools like Claude Code. Use AI for research, briefs, refreshes, internal linking, technical checks, and reporting, and check what it produces before anything ships.

**What you will own**
---------------------

* Diagnose each client's search demand, answer-engine visibility, technical health, content system, and conversion path; set baselines and targets.
* Own the SEO/AEO roadmap for your accounts and decide what ships next.
* Track answer-engine citations: a fixed prompt set per client, run weekly across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews, logging where the client and its competitors are cited.
* Build and maintain the agents that do production (research, briefs, refreshes, internal linking, technical checks, reporting) and get teammates using them.
* Keep brief-to-publish under five working days, with a human check on facts, brand, and technical accuracy.
* Lead client strategy calls with proactive recommendations; give writers, developers, and analysts clear acceptance criteria.
* Report monthly in terms a GM would use: citations, qualified organic traffic, and pipeline or revenue where attribution allows.
* Write runbooks so the system runs without you at the keyboard.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

* **By day 30:** client diagnoses done; baselines set for citations and qualified organic pipeline; your AI citation tracker is live and at least one teammate runs it on an account they own.
* **By day 60:** an agent-built brief-to-publish pipeline is running on every account; the monthly citation + pipeline report is in use with clients.
* **By day 90:** brief-to-publish under five working days; at least one account up on answer-engine citations or qualified organic pipeline vs baseline; a runbook another person can follow. Failure = content volume going up with no citation or pipeline readback.
* **By 6–12 months:** citations and qualified organic pipeline up across your book; workflows do 70%+ of production; clients treat you as their go-to marketing strategist; you have designed yourself out of the daily queue.

**Evidence we want to see**
---------------------------

* 6+ years in SEO or organic growth, currently at Senior Manager, Associate Director, Director, or Head scope, with client-facing ownership.
* Shipped answer-engine or AI-for-SEO work we can inspect: the pages, the citations, and how you measured them.
* One agent or workflow you built and still maintain that removed real production work: inputs, outputs, QA, and the result.
* One quantified result (citations, qualified traffic, pipeline, or revenue) with the baseline, period, and how you attributed it.
* AI fluency you can show: how answer engines retrieve and cite sources, and which calls you still make yourself.
* Strong technical SEO, analytics, and prioritization judgment.
* Steady tenure; internal promotions are a big plus (same company counts fully).
* Ideal: specialist search agency or an in-house growth team that ships; B2B.

**What this role is not**
-------------------------

Not a content-volume role. Not vendor management or QC-only. Not a strategy-only seat that hands implementation to someone else. Not a people-manager seat. Not for occasional AI users.

**How the process works**
-------------------------

Application 7 short questions sent to you by email evidence review live working session (diagnose a site propose the AEO plan measurement plan) paid, time-boxed practical on two sample accounts with a live defense references. Redacted or recreated examples are welcome for confidential work.

**Benefits**
------------

Medical, dental, and vision; life insurance; 401(k) with 4% match; unlimited PTO; monthly UberEats; MacBook; home-office stipend/setup. Subject to plan terms and eligibility.

**Apply**
---------

Apply with your resume or LinkedIn. We will email you 7 short questions; answer them yourself. AI-written answers are disqualified.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Paid Media (AI-First)
jobs.description:
**Reports to:** Eric Siu, CEO  
**Type:** Full-time, hands-on player-coach. Client-facing. Not a people-manager seat.  
**Clients:** an assigned book of Single Grain paid media accounts (Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, programmatic)  
**Location:** Full-time, remote (United States or Latin America; at least 4 hours of US overlap; professional English)  
**Comp:** $100,000–$150,000 USD / year, depending on location

**One-liner**
-------------

Own paid growth for a book of Single Grain clients as their performance strategist, and build the AI workflows that take build-outs, reporting, and QA off your plate.

**About the role**
------------------

Single Grain combines marketing services, software, and AI. This seat runs paid search, paid social, and programmatic for an assigned set of client accounts. You still get your hands in the accounts; your agents do most of the production. Clients treat you as their growth strategist: you tell them what to test next, and you tie spend to pipeline and revenue, not ROAS screenshots.

You should be an advanced AI user. The platforms already run on automation (Performance Max, Meta Advantage+, smart bidding); you know when to trust it and when to override it. On top of that you build your own agents for build-outs, pacing, reporting, creative iteration, and QA, and you check their output before it touches client spend.

**What you will own**
---------------------

* Diagnose each client's paid program; set baselines and targets (CAC, ROAS, CPL, qualified pipeline, revenue) and own the plan.
* Run and optimize accounts across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, and programmatic within approved budgets.
* Ship test cycles fast: from idea to first readout in under five working days.
* Run an account health + QA agent on every account: weekly pacing, anomaly flags (spend spikes, broken tracking, disapprovals), and next-test recommendations.
* Run AI creative iteration: generate ad and landing-page variants, test them, and keep a human brand and claims check before anything goes live.
* Lead client strategy calls and bring proactive recommendations every month.
* Report monthly in terms a GM would use: spend tied to pipeline and revenue, with baselines.
* Write runbooks so the work does not depend on you being at the keyboard.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

* **By day 30:** client diagnoses done; baselines and targets agreed; your account health + QA agent is live on your accounts and at least one teammate runs it on an account they own.
* **By day 60:** test cycles running on every account; AI creative iteration live on at least one account; monthly reporting ties spend to pipeline or revenue.
* **By day 90:** launch-to-learn under five working days; at least one account showing measurable CAC, ROAS, or pipeline improvement vs baseline; a runbook another person can follow. Failure = tests still launched without a hypothesis, baseline, or readout.
* **By 6–12 months:** client programs hit their agreed targets; workflows do 70%+ of paid production; you have designed yourself out of the daily build queue.

**Evidence we want to see**
---------------------------

* About 5+ years in digital paid media, currently at Senior Manager, Associate Director, Director, or Head scope, and still running accounts yourself, with spend scale.
* One paid result with the metric, baseline, period, and how you attributed it.
* One AI workflow or agent you built that removed real paid production work, and what it changed.
* AI fluency you can show: the workflow's inputs, outputs, and controls, and how you check agent or platform-automation output before it touches spend.
* Client-facing strategy: examples where you set the plan, not just executed tickets.
* Steady tenure; internal promotions are a big plus (same company counts fully).
* Ideal: growth/performance agency, B2B SaaS lead gen, or multi-client experience.

**What this role is not**
-------------------------

Not a media buyer or ticket-taker. Not vendor management only. Not TV, OOH, or print planning. Not a people-manager seat. Not for occasional AI users. Not a fit if freelancing, consulting, or your own agency is your main work today.

**How the process works**
-------------------------

Application 7 short questions sent to you by email evidence review live working session (diagnose an account propose tests measurement plan) paid, time-boxed practical on two sample accounts with a live defense references. Redacted or recreated examples are welcome for confidential work.

**Benefits**
------------

Medical, dental, and vision; life insurance; 401(k) with 4% match; unlimited PTO; monthly UberEats; MacBook; home-office stipend/setup. Subject to plan terms and eligibility.

**Apply**
---------

Apply with your resume or LinkedIn. We will email you 7 short questions; answer them yourself. AI-written answers are disqualified.

jobs.title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager - Business & Government
jobs.description:
**Senior Growth Marketing Manager – Business & Government**

**Remote - United States**

**About the Role**

The Senior Growth Marketing Manager is the campaign engine behind Blackboard’s new logo pipeline — and a critical connector between acquisition and the post-sale customer journey. Sitting within the Revenue Marketing org and reporting to the VP of Revenue Marketing, this role is responsible for translating GTM positioning and segment strategy into integrated, multi-channel demand generation campaigns that create and accelerate pipeline across the Business & Government market.

This is a creator and executor role. You will own end-to-end campaign planning and delivery: from brief to launch to performance reporting. You will work in close collaboration with Product Marketing, Marketing Intelligence, Marketing Operations, and the Sales org to ensure campaigns are tightly connected to targeted audiences, pipeline goals, and revenue-focused strategies. You won’t just fill the top of the funnel — you’ll be accountable for the quality and conversion of what flows through it, and you’ll stay connected to the customer signals on the right side of the bow tie that inform where and how we show up.

You will also own our physical and digital field presence in Business & Government — regional events, third-party conferences like DevLearn, and our flagship customer event BbT. For this role, field is not a logistics function. It is a pipeline strategy. Every event runs against a documented pipeline target, with a measurement plan and clear post-event attribution.

The right person for this role understands that AI is changing the buyer journey. You are expected to actively build AI-native workflows — not just use AI tools, but design systems and automations that let you operate at a pace a traditional marketer cannot match. You will also stay ahead of how Blackboard’s buyers are increasingly using AI in their own research and selection process and adapt campaign strategy and channel mix accordingly.

**What You'll Own**

Campaign Strategy & Execution

* Own the integrated campaign calendar for new logo acquisition in the Business & Government segment, with pipeline targets defined for every program.
* Translate GTM positioning and competitive differentiation from the GTM Marketing team into compelling, audience-specific campaign narratives and assets.
* Execute multi-channel campaigns spanning paid media, email, content syndication, webinars, and field event integration.
* Design and run ABM programs for target accounts across the Business & Government universe — account-based thinking is core to this role, not optional.
* Support Blackboard’s visibility in AI-generated research environments (GEO), coordinating with the VP GTM on which prompts and themes buyers are searching.
* Partner with Marketing channel teams to ensure programs compound ROI rather than run in isolation.
* Build AI-native workflows for always-running campaign analysis, audience personalization, and performance optimization — and share what you’re building with the broader team.

Field & Event Marketing

* Coordinate with Events, Sr Manager to manage regional field activation programs — road shows, executive dinners, partner-hosted events — tied to pipeline goals in specific accounts or geographies.
* Serve as a key campaign contributor to BbT26, Blackboard’s flagship customer event, ensuring field and campaign strategies are coordinated.
* Build and own post-event attribution models: every event investment is measured against pipeline sourced, pipeline influenced, and closed won contribution.

Pipeline Generation & Attribution

* Own a direct pipeline contribution target — not just activity metrics. You hold a number, review it weekly, and course-correct when programs underperform.
* Work with Marketing Intelligence to define campaign-level pipeline targets and track performance against them.
* Leverage intent data and buying signals from the Marketing Intelligence team to prioritize campaign audiences and personalize outreach.
* Build and maintain multi-touch attribution to ensure campaign contribution is accurately captured across the full funnel.
* Flag expansion signals — customer engagement patterns, advocacy activity, product usage — to the Customer Growth & Advocacy team so post-sale programs can act on them.

Content & Asset Development

* Brief and collaborate with Content and Brand teams to develop campaign assets: landing pages, nurture emails, one-pagers, and digital ads.
* Coordinate with Marketing Ops to ensure proper list segmentation, lead routing, and campaign tracking in HubSpot and Salesforce.
* Align with Product Marketing on sales enablement and ensure campaign messaging is consistent across GTM teams.
* Develop field-specific assets — event booth briefs, executive event guides, post-event nurture sequences — that connect field presence to campaign pipeline.

Reporting & Optimization

* Own campaign performance reporting: pipeline contribution, MQL-to-SQL ratios, closed won rates, cost per opportunity, and event ROI.
* Continuously test and optimize campaign elements — messaging, creative, CTAs, audience segments — to improve performance.
* Present campaign results and recommendations at weekly pipeline reviews; come with a point of view, not just a dashboard.

Crescendo is the AI-native customer experience platform built to run a company’s entire CX operation in one connected system. We bring together customer support, workforce management, quality, and knowledge, with specialized AI agents doing the work and people guiding it.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Assistant
jobs.description:
We are looking for a volunteer to build Write.It's presence on LinkedIn. LinkedIn is where our buyers are: SME directors, bid and sales leads, procurement specialists, charity leaders, authors and coaches. You will help us show up there consistently and credibly, so that the right people recognise Write.It before we ever contact them.

This is a content and brand role. It is not a cold-outreach role.

**What you will do**

* Plan and draft a simple monthly LinkedIn content calendar for the company page and the founder's profile, weighted towards bids and tender evidence, with room for grants, awards and books.
* Turn our expertise into short, useful posts: e.g., tender/grant/award/book-evidence tips, before-and-after writing examples, myth-busting, plain-English explainers on public-sector procurement or funder legislation, and lessons from the Conscious Writing™ approach.
* Draft posts for the founder's review, in her voice, and prepare carousels, short documents and simple graphics (Canva or similar).
* Support engagement: schedule posts, monitor comments and messages on our own content, and flag warm replies to the founder or sales lead within one working day.
* Help build the company page: strong About section, services, featured content and a consistent look.
* Support relationship-building with relevant communities: SME networks, procurement and bid-writing groups, author and publishing communities and potential partner organisations, through genuine, non-promotional participation.
* Keep a simple weekly tracker (posts, impressions, engagement, profile visits, inbound enquiries) and share a short monthly summary of what is working.
* Collect, with permission, anonymised wins, testimonials and case-study material for the content calendar.
* Post about latest events (workshops, webinars) we hold.

**How we work**

* **Accuracy:** Every claim is checked and sourced. We do not claim client results, scientific proof of uplift, or contract wins that we cannot evidence.
* **No reader assumptions:** We do not imply a prospect is failing, in distress, or lacks a writer. We lead with something useful.
* **Respect:** No spammy tagging, scraped lists or automated connection requests. We follow LinkedIn's rules and UK privacy and marketing regulations.
* **Confidentiality:** Client names, documents and results are only used with written permission.
* **Senior approval:** Anything speaking on Write.It's behalf is approved before publishing until we agree otherwise.

**Time commitment**

Around 6–10 hours per week, flexible and mostly remote, for an initial three-month period, after which we review together. There are no fixed working hours and no obligation to meet minimum hours, and you can step back at any time. A short weekly check-in (15–20 minutes) with your manager keeps us aligned.

**What you bring**

**Essential**

* Strong, clear writing in British English, with a good eye for tone and detail.
* Hands-on LinkedIn experience: you understand what makes B2B content get read and shared.
* Reliable, organised and comfortable working independently and to a calendar.
* Good judgement about what is confidential, accurate and appropriate to say publicly.

**Desirable**

* Interest in or experience of bids and tenders, grants, awards, publishing or editing.
* Experience with Canva, a scheduling tool or LinkedIn analytics.
* Study or early career in marketing, communications, English, journalism, business or a related field.

What you get

* Real ownership of a live B2B channel for a growing consultancy, with a portfolio of published work and measurable results.
* Direct mentoring from a founder with a decade of experience in bid management, editorial strategy and applied linguistics.
* Practical learning in B2B content strategy, positioning and the procurement and funding landscape.
* A tailored reference and LinkedIn recommendation on satisfactory completion of the three months.
* Out-of-pocket expenses agreed in advance will be reimbursed.
* A genuine route to discuss future paid or commission-based opportunities with Write.It, though none is promised.

**Measures of success (first 90 days)**

* A published and consistently followed content calendar.
* A refreshed, complete company page.
* Steady growth in relevant followers and engagement, with targets agreed after the first month, not imposed upfront.
* Warm inbound conversations and profile visits from our target audience, tracked and passed to the sales lead.
* A reusable library of approved post templates and proof points.

**How to apply**

Send us your CV, along with a short note (no more than 250 words) and one LinkedIn post you have written, or would write for Write.It about a topic of your choice, to Jose Mbenga at info@writeitsolutions.co.uk. Tell us why this role interests you and roughly how many hours you can offer.

We care more about writing ability, judgement and enthusiasm than a long CV. So if you're unsure about your experience or your CV, send it in anyway.

*Write.It is an equal opportunities organisation. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds.*

Pay: From £1.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

**Wanted: A Data-Driven Marketing Architect to Own the Growth of a Global Academy & 5-Clinic Group (100% Remote)**

Most marketing jobs are about "activities." This one is about **Outcomes.**

We don't care about your "creative vibes," your "brand awareness" theories, or how many likes our last post got. We care about two numbers: **12 qualified Academy calls** and **45 new clinic patients** every single week.

If you are a veteran agency operator who is tired of managing 10+ clients you don't care about, and you’re ready to finally own the strategy and the results for one high-growth brand, keep reading.

**The Mission**

We run ProSport Academy (global education for physios in 50+ countries, called The Go-To' Physio) and ProSport Physiotherapy (a 5-clinic group in the UK). We have the videographers, the sales team, and the budget. We are missing the **Architect** who looks at the data, finds the leaks, and scales the winners.

**This is for you if:**

* **You speak the language of Math.** You don't guess; you calculate. You know that if the CPL is X and the landing page converts at Y, the result is Z.
* **You hate the "90-day ramp-up."** You believe a funnel can be tested and tweaked in 48 hours. You want to see the needle move by the end of your second week.
* **You are a GoHighLevel Ninja.** You can build, track, and automate funnels in your sleep.
* **You want to be the Owner of your department, not the Helper.** You don't want a boss to tell you what to do; you want a Scorecard that tells you if you won.

**What You Will Own:**

* **The Academy Funnel:** Scaling Meta/YouTube ads to deliver 12+ high-ticket sales calls weekly.
* **The Clinic Engine:** Driving 45+ new patients weekly across 5 physical locations using local lead gen google ads/Meta
* **The Creative Brief:** Directing our full-time videographers based on what the data says is working.
* **The Scoreboard:** Reporting daily and weekly on CPL, Cost Per Booked Call, and ROAS.

**This is NOT for you if:**

* You need a "creative director" to sign off on your headlines.
* You think "busy" equals "productive."
* You can’t explain the difference between a lead and a qualified sales appointment.
* You want to "test things out" for three months before being held accountable to a number.

**Why Join Us?**

* **Direct Access:** You report straight to the Founder (Dave O’Sullivan). No corporate layers.
* **World-Class Mentorship:** You’ll get weekly coaching from leading direct-response marketers who are doing exactly what we are doing, just at much bigger levels. You'll be on the cutting edge of whats working now in these changing times.
* **Full Autonomy:** You own the £10k+ monthly ad spend. If you hit the targets, we scale the budget.
* **Remote Freedom:** Work from anywhere, as long as the numbers hit the Scorecard.

**HOW TO APPLY (Read Carefully):** Do not just send a CV. Send a direct message with the following:

* A brief summary of a funnel you personally managed and the specific ROAS/CPL you achieved.
* **The Math:** If we spend £2,500 a week on ads and need 12 qualified calls, and our landing page converts at 3%, what is the maximum Cost Per Click we can afford to stay on target?
* Why you are ready to stop being an "account manager" and start being a Growth Architect.

We'll then give you the next steps in this process!

Pay: £35,000.00-£40,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Company pension

About ThredUp

ThredUp is transforming resale with technology and a mission to inspire the world to think secondhand first. By making it easy to buy and sell secondhand, ThredUp has become one of the world's largest online resale platforms for apparel, shoes and accessories. Sellers love ThredUp because we make it easy to clean out their closets and unlock value for themselves or for the charity of their choice while doing good for the planet. Buyers love shopping value, premium and luxury brands all in one place, at up to 90% off estimated retail price. Our proprietary operating platform is the foundation for our managed marketplace and consists of distributed processing infrastructure, proprietary software and systems and data science expertise. With ThredUp’s Resale-as-a-Service, some of the world's leading brands and retailers are leveraging our platform to deliver customizable, scalable resale experiences to their customers. ThredUp has processed over 172 million unique secondhand items from 55,000 brands across 100 categories. By extending the life cycle of clothing, ThredUp is changing the way consumers shop and ushering in a more sustainable future for the fashion industry.

Recognized on TIME Most Influential Companies of 2023, Digiday's WorkLife 50 2023, TIME's Best Inventions of 2022, and Lattice's People Success Awards 2022.

How You Will Make An Impact

ThredUp is looking for a talented Growth Marketing Associate to join our growth marketing team as we continue to acquire and retain customers efficiently and at scale. This person has some experience with paid search marketing, wants to grow into a paid search expert as well as other paid media, and will work in partnership with the Growth Marketing team on channel execution and success. This role interacts extensively across Marketing, Creative, Engineering, Finance, and Product teams. Their input will help shape key business decisions and their efforts will drive new customer acquisition and shape the strategy of the growth function at ThredUp. We are seeking a smart, talented and creative individual who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment to help us inspire a new generation to think secondhand first.

In This Role You’ll Get To

Support strategy and execution across various paid search channels (Google Ads, Bing Ads) consisting of (but not limited to):
Campaign targeting, bidding, budget and keyword optimization in alignment with channel KPIs
Execute continuous testing across ad copy, landing pages, bid strategies, and creative assets to improve performance
Cross-functional collaboration with creative, merchandising, strategy teams on brief creation/execution
Support and strengthen partnerships with ad platforms and vendors
Help manage and optimize product feeds to drive efficiency for Google Shopping and PMax campaigns
Analyze and contribute to daily, weekly, monthly, and ad hoc channel reporting
Work closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics teams to enhance our Ad Technology for campaign optimization
Make strategic recommendations around best practices and learnings from channel performance
Integrate AI Skills and Agents in how we analyze and optimize our campaigns
Stay up-to-date on upcoming industry trends

What We’re Looking For

2+ years of work experience in performance marketing, e-commerce, or other quantitative/data-driven fields
2+ years of hands-on work experience with Google Ads
Experience working in Claude Cowork or other AI interface
Versatile and able to work in a fast-paced environment
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills
The ability to make data-driven decisions that add value to the customer experience
BA/BS in quantitative fields or marketing

At ThredUp, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. This role pays between $90,000 and $100,000 per year, and your actual base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

What We Offer

4-day work week, with Fridays off

Many ThredUp employees also have the opportunity to own shares of ThredUp stock and are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards

Located in the heart of the Bay Area, Monterra Credit Union is a community-centric and growth-oriented financial institution. We invest in the success of people and our community by giving back, making things easier, and committing ourselves to our members’ potential. Diversity, equity and inclusion are critical to our success, and we value the varied backgrounds and experiences that everyone brings to our organization. If you value collaboration, forward-thinking, and giving back, this just might be the place for you.

SALARY & BENEFITS

Monterra Credit Union reflects the value placed on employees by providing an excellent salary and benefits package:
Starting pay of $50.48 - $57.69 per hour depending on experience
Semi-annual bonuses for meeting key financial and operational goals
Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and Long-Term Disability insurances
401(k) including generous matching contributions
Discounts on financial products and services, including mortgage and auto loans
Paid time off, tuition reimbursement, and much more!

This position is based on-site at our Corporate Office in Redwood City, CA. Following the successful completion of meeting performance expectations, you may request a hybrid work arrangement of up to two remote days per week, subject to approval from your supervisor.

POSITION SUMMARY

As a key member of Monterra Credit Union’s Marketing team, the Digital Marketing Lead owns and drives the end-to-end digital marketing strategy to accelerate member acquisition, product adoption, engagement, and retention across deposit, loan, and ancillary products and services. This role is central to advancing Monterra’s digital readiness by maximizing the impact of owned digital channels through data-driven decision-making, personalization, and continuous optimization to deliver measurable business results and enhanced member experience.

The Digital Marketing Lead oversees digital channel strategy and performance across the website, mobile app, email, text messaging, and digital media. Partnering closely with marketing team members, internal stakeholders, and agency partners, this role translates product strategies and value propositions into integrated, high-performing digital campaigns. As the digital subject matter expert, the Lead ensures effective use of marketing technology investments through testing, analytics, and performance refinement, and serves as a trusted advisor and “go-to” resource for digital marketing best practices, innovation, and execution.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Own and lead the end‑to‑end digital marketing strategy across all owned digital channels, including digital and social media platforms, SEO, the public website, email, text messaging, online banking, and the mobile app, while also supporting digital media optimization in collaboration with marketing leadership and agency partner.
Define digital channel goals, performance benchmarks, and optimization roadmaps to drive brand awareness, member acquisition, retention, and cross‑sell.
Serve as the digital marketing subject‑matter and technical expert, providing strategic guidance on emerging platforms, tools, trends, and best practices.
Lead the planning, execution, and optimization of integrated digital marketing campaigns and product launch initiatives, ensuring strong positioning, market readiness, and consistent messaging, in collaboration with Product Marketing colleagues.
Drive performance through analytics, reporting, and a continuous test‑and‑learn approach; track KPIs (e.g., conversion rate, click‑through rate, cost per acquisition) and provide insights and recommendations to leadership.
Leverage member and digital banking data to develop segmentation, personalization, automation, and testing strategies that increase relevance and engagement.
Analyze market trends, member insights, and competitive performance to identify growth opportunities and enhance the digital member experience.
Partner cross‑functionally with internal teams and external vendors to ensure alignment, efficient execution, and the successful rollout of new or enhanced products.
As a senior‑level team member, provide guidance to marketing team members and act as a “go‑to” resource for digital marketing strategy and execution.
Identify opportunities to enhance the member experience by refining processes, communications, and/or delivery methods that support product and service adoption or engagement.
Provides service that aligns with the Credit Union’s mission of delivering timely, relevant products, services, and information aimed at increasing adoption and engagement.
Perform other duties as assigned

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Apply Now for Consideration!

Monterra Credit Union is an equal-opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Business, or a related field, plus a minimum of three to five years of progressive digital marketing experience, including digital channel ownership and extensive management of digital programs and campaigns.
Proven success driving measurable growth outcomes (acquisition, conversion, retention, cross-sell, engagement) through digital marketing in a data-driven environment
Experience in financial services marketing preferred.
Strong background using performance analytics and KPIs (e.g., conversion rate, CTR, CPA, engagement metrics) to inform decisions and guide continuous improvement.

jobs.description:
We are located approximately 20 miles north of Boston and parking is free. We are also accessible by commuter rail on the Newburyport/Rockport line. Come and explore Endicott’s seaside locale where employees are an important part of the bustling campus community!

Please apply today if this opportunity looks like the right fit for you.

Job Summary

Working under general supervision of the Assistant Vice President, Communications & Marketing, the Director of Marketing & Advertising serves as a strategic leader within College Communications & Marketing (CCM) and is a key marketing partner to academic and enrollment leaders across Endicott College. The Director develops integrated marketing and advertising strategies that strengthen Endicott’s market position, increase visibility of its undergraduate and graduate academic offerings, and advance institutional enrollment and auxiliary revenue goals.

The Director will lead Endicott’s overarching advertising strategy across digital and traditional channels, ensuring investments are informed by institutional priorities, market conditions, data, and defined measures of success. Another primary responsibility is establishing the strategic foundation for how the College brings its programs to market, including positioning frameworks, audience strategies, value propositions, and campaign plans across advertising, web, print, digital, recruitment communications, and content.

Working closely with the Brand Manager, Undergraduate Admission, the Director of Admission Communication, and the Assistant Vice President of Graduate Enrollment, the Director will help steward undergraduate and graduate enrollment marketing and lead major marketing initiatives from strategy through implementation and assessment.

About Endicott College

Endicott College is a vibrant community located on Boston’s North Shore, with a beautiful oceanfront campus in Beverly, Massachusetts. We’re known for combining academic excellence with hands-on learning, and we take pride in fostering a supportive environment for both students and employees.

Working at Endicott means joining a close-knit campus community where your contributions matter and where collaboration, creativity, and professional growth are valued.

Benefits

To learn more about our employee benefits click here.

Key Outcomes

30
% of Time:
Integrated Marketing Strategy & Institutional Priorities

Develop and lead annual and long-term marketing strategies that advance College priorities, including enrollment, institutional visibility, engagement, and revenue growth.
Serve as a primary marketing partner to leaders across the College, helping identify marketing opportunities, define audiences and objectives, and determine the appropriate strategies and resources to achieve them.
Translate institutional goals into actionable marketing plans that establish audiences, positioning, messaging, channels, investment, timelines, and measures of success.
Lead marketing strategy for major College initiatives and emerging priorities, bringing together advertising, brand, creative, content, web, social media, and communications as appropriate.
Evaluate marketing requests and opportunities against institutional priorities, audience needs, revenue or enrollment potential, available resources, and expected impact.
Monitor market conditions, audience behavior, competitive activity, and marketing trends to identify opportunities and inform College marketing strategy.

30% of Time: Advertising, Digital Marketing & Performance

Lead Endicott’s advertising strategy across digital and traditional channels, partnering with an external agency on paid search, paid social, and digital display while directly overseeing out-of-home, print, broadcast, and other advertising opportunities.
Manage advertising agencies, media partners, vendors, and other external marketing relationships.
Establish KPIs and reporting frameworks for major campaigns and regularly communicate performance, insights, and recommendations to College leadership and campus partners.
Ensure paid campaigns are supported by strong creative, content, web experiences, and conversion pathways.
Evaluate new advertising channels, partnerships, sponsorships, and promotional opportunities based on audience fit, institutional goals, cost, and expected return.

25% of Time: Enrollment & Academic Program Marketing

Lead integrated marketing strategy supporting undergraduate and graduate enrollment in close partnership with Enrollment Management and academic leadership.
Develop annual undergraduate and graduate marketing plans informed by enrollment goals, priority audiences, market opportunity, program demand, and performance data.
Develop marketing strategies for new and priority academic programs, including audience identification, positioning, value propositions, competitive differentiation, launch strategy, and campaign planning.
Partner with Undergraduate Admission, Graduate Enrollment, academic leaders, and CCM colleagues to align advertising, recruitment communications, web, print, digital, and content around a cohesive prospective-student journey.
Use enrollment and marketing data to identify opportunities and recommend changes to targeting, investment, channels, messaging, creative, and conversion strategies.

15% of Time: Marketing Content, Web & Audience Experience

Continually assess whether Endicott has the content, creative assets, web experiences, and audience pathways necessary to support its marketing priorities.
Partner with CCM’s creative, social, and web teams to identify gaps and establish priorities for new marketing assets.
Partner with CCM’s content, creative, social, video, and photography teams to identify gaps in the College’s marketing asset library and establish priorities for new asset development, with particular attention to priority audiences and programs.
Conduct ongoing audits of Endicott’s marketing and enrollment web presence and recommend new pages, landing pages, content improvements, audience pathways, calls to action, and other enhancements.
Ensure major advertising and marketing initiatives have the content and digital infrastructure necessary to effectively move audiences from awareness to action.
Be an active participant in the life of the College by attending and supporting major events such as Commencement, Homecoming, and other all-hands-on-deck gatherings. As a member of the leadership team, model a strong commitment to community engagement.
Other duties as assigned

Reports to the Assistant Vice President of Communications & Marketing.

Supervises the Brand Manager and is responsible for setting priorities, assigning and overseeing work, providing coaching and performance feedback, supporting professional development, conducting performance evaluations, and participating in hiring and onboarding as appropriate.

Strategic Marketing Leadership

Connects institutional and enrollment priorities, audience insights, market conditions, and data to develop focused, actionable marketing strategies with clear objectives and measures of success.

Builds credibility and trust with academic, enrollment, and institutional leaders; asks the right questions to uncover underlying needs and opportunities; and translates complex priorities into effective marketing strategies.

jobs.description:
About Us

Rho is the modern banking platform built for the AI era. Startups and growth-stage companies can open accounts in minutes, issue cards, manage expenses, pay bills, and close the books – all in one connected platform backed by real human support.

About The Role

We're hiring a Head of Growth Marketing to own how Rho wins new customers across every acquisition channel: paid search, paid social, connected TV, outbound, direct mail, lifecycle, SEO and AEO, referrals, and affiliates. You'll be the growth PM for the entire funnel, deciding what to test, proving what works, and moving budget toward it.

Growth at Rho runs as a pod with two leads. You'll lead growth marketing in partnership with our growth engineering lead: you shape what we test and why, and growth engineering builds it and makes it scale. You'll work alongside a team that ships landing pages, data pipelines, and outbound systems in days, AI routines that run every morning, and a BDR team that calls new leads within minutes.

You're accountable for new funded customers and the gross profit they bring. Cost per funded customer, payback, and experiment velocity are how your work gets judged.

Key responsibilities

Own Rho's growth target for new funded customers and gross profit, and break it into channel goals each owner in the pod can run with.
Build and run the experimentation program: a one-page brief for every idea (audience, channel, copy variants, tracking, and the scale or kill threshold), a shared tracker, and a Friday retro. Ideas ship in days.
Turn ideas from across the company, from the CEO to the sales floor, into experiments that marketing operations and growth engineering can stand up quickly, and own the follow-through.
Design holdouts and incrementality tests that show which channels create new customers, and move the next dollar based on the results.
Own paid strategy across Google Ads, LinkedIn, Meta, and connected TV, including agency partners, with a clear cost-per-funded-customer and payback bar for each channel.
Lift conversion from first click to funded account through landing page and onboarding tests with design and engineering, from comparison tables to one-click email capture.
Shape lifecycle and nurture so every lead gets the right message at the right moment, and approved customers fund and start using Rho.
Partner with Growth BDRs and account executives on lead routing, speed to lead, outbound plays, and which sources turn into customers.
Work with data and marketing operations on attribution, conversion tracking back to ad platforms, and the weekly scorecard the team runs on.
Agentify the growth loop: build and run AI agents and daily routines that pull funnel and CRO data, generate hypotheses, draft variants, and report results, so the team spends its time on judgment, not busywork.

Requirements

5-7+ years in growth or performance marketing, including at least two years leading growth at a B2B, fintech, or high-velocity SaaS company. You can name the numbers you moved.
Revenue-oriented first: funded customers and gross profit are what get you out of bed.
Has run a high-volume experimentation program and kept it both fast and rigorous.
Hands-on experience designing incrementality tests and holdouts, and the ability to explain to a CEO what last-click reporting misses.
Hands on across paid search, paid social, lifecycle email, and outbound; you build a campaign yourself when that's the fastest path.
Comfortable in SQL and modern data and marketing tools.
You build with AI agents yourself (Claude Code or similar). Your first move on a repetitive task is to agentify it, not hire for it.
Leads through influence: you've partnered with engineering as a peer and rallied a cross-functional team around one goal. Experience managing people is a plus.
Comfortable working inside a regulated business: exact disclosures, verified claims, and compliance review as part of the shipping process.
Based in New York City and excited to work in office with the team.

We believe every member of the Rho community enriches our ability to provide a broad range of ways to understand and engage with the market, identify problems, and drive solutions that align with our mission. Track conversion from MQL to meeting to opportunity by program, and diagnose where it breaks.
Meet regularly with SDR leadership and AEs to learn what prospects are saying and adjust messaging and targeting.
Route play-triggered leads directly to Sales with context, and measure each play against the pipeline it creates.

Identify and run plays that fire on a signal rather than the calendar, such as multi-registrant accounts, webinar attendance, badge scans, and intent data from tools like 6sense, ZoomInfo, and Qualified.
Build evergreen cross-sell programs between Workforce Compliance products.

Own campaign setup, naming, and source tagging in HubSpot and Salesforce, and reconcile attribution with RevOps.
Build repeatable playbooks and templates, and use AI to speed up list building, personalization, follow-up, and reporting.

Experience working directly with SDRs and AEs, and a clear understanding of how Sales motions turn leads into meetings and opportunities.

jobs.description:
About The Wellness Group

The Wellness Group (TWG) is a diversified healthcare holding company committed to transforming how care is delivered, managed, and experienced. Across our portfolio of companies, we build and scale innovative healthcare businesses: from care management and pharmacy services to wellness technology. We hire people who are mission driven, operationally sharp, and ready to do meaningful work.

About the Company

This role sits within one of TWG’s fast growing healthcare services companies, built to support patients in the space between the doctor’s visit and real life. Our clinical team pairs smart technology with real human connection, so patients get consistent support between visits. The company is scaling quickly in Dallas Fort Worth and nationally, and needs a commercial leader who can turn that momentum into predictable growth. Additional details about the company will be shared with qualified candidates.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Director of Sales and Marketing to own how the company finds, educates, and enrolls the patients and partners who need us. You will lead the field and community sales team, build the marketing engine that feeds patient enrollment, and turn provider, senior living, and community relationships into a repeatable growth channel. This is a builder role: you will set the strategy, hire and coach the team, choose the tools, and own the numbers.

You will not inherit a playbook. You will write it, and every enrollment it produces is a patient who gets care that would otherwise slip through the cracks.

Key Responsibilities

Build and execute the company’s sales and marketing strategy, with clear enrollment, revenue, and partner growth targets for the DFW market and each new market we enter.
Lead, hire, and coach the field sales organization, setting territories, goals, and a disciplined weekly operating cadence.
Develop and grow referral partnerships with physician practices, health systems, senior living communities, skilled nursing facilities, and community organizations.
Own demand generation across community, event, digital, and partner channels, delivering qualified leads that convert to enrolled patients.
Partner with operations and patient engagement leaders to align lead flow, messaging, handoffs, and conversion metrics from first touch to enrolled patient.
Build the brand and message, including seminar content, collateral, website, and campaigns that explain our services in plain language to patients, families, and providers.
Ensure all sales and marketing activity complies with Medicare program rules, HIPAA, TCPA, and federal and Texas anti kickback and patient solicitation laws, working hand in hand with Compliance and Legal.
Design and manage sales incentive plans that reward quality enrollments and patient retention, with review and approval by Finance and Legal.
Build pipeline reporting and dashboards in the CRM, and deliver accurate forecasts and performance updates to company and TWG leadership.
Manage the sales and marketing budget, vendors, and agencies with a sharp focus on cost per enrollment and return on spend.
Identify expansion markets and new partner channels as the company scales nationally.

What You Bring

Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, healthcare administration, or a related field (required)
; MBA or MHA a plus.
10+ years of progressive sales and marketing experience, including 5+ years leading teams of managers and field based representatives (required)
.
Healthcare services experience strongly preferred, ideally in chronic care management, remote patient monitoring, home health, hospice, senior living, Medicare Advantage, or value based care.
Working knowledge of the compliance rules that govern healthcare sales and marketing, including Medicare marketing guidance, HIPAA, TCPA, and anti kickback laws.
A proven record of building referral partnerships with physician practices and senior care organizations that produce consistent volume.
Hands on command of CRM and marketing automation platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar) and the discipline to keep data clean.
Strong analytical skills: you know your funnel, conversion rates, cost per acquisition, and forecast, and you can explain all of it in two minutes.
Excellent communication skills; you are as credible presenting to a room of seniors in the morning as you are pitching a health system executive in the afternoon.
Willingness to travel locally across DFW every week and periodically to new markets.

You Might Be a Great Fit If...

You thrive in a build stage company where the systems do not exist yet and you get to create them.
You get energy from being in the field with your team, not just reading their reports.
You believe growth and compliance go together, and you would never trade one for the other.
You want your success measured by patients served as much as by revenue booked.
