jobs.title: Marketing Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Talkdesk competes in a market where the quality of execution separates companies that grow efficiently from those that spend more to get the same result. Marketing Operations is where that execution lives. This role exists to ensure that every dollar of marketing spend, every campaign, every event, and every account-based program translates into pipeline with zero friction. That requires a system built for precision where the right prospect reaches the right person at the right time, consistently and by design.
You sit inside the Marketing team, with close partnerships across Sales and RevOps. The marketers running campaigns, events, and account-based programs are your primary stakeholders. When the system works, their work converts.
In practice, that means owning the full operational surface of marketing technology: administering and continuously improving the tools that make up our GTM stack, building and maintaining the integrations that keep data moving cleanly between systems, designing the orchestrations that automate account and contact engagement, ensuring the enrichment and data integrity standards that make every downstream decision reliable. This is an interdependent system, and this person keeps it running as a coherent, high-performing whole.
What You'll Own

Account-Based Marketing Orchestration:

Serve as the technical owner of our ABM orchestration layer. Translate signals from our intent platform into automated, sequenced actions across our marketing automation platform and CRM, working closely with campaign and field marketing teams to ensure the right programs reach the right accounts at the right moment. Getting this infrastructure right is one of the highest-impact contributions this role makes to the business.

Marketing Technology Foundation:

Own the day-to-day health of our martech systems and the workflows, API calls, integrations, and syncs that connect them to keep prospect data moving accurately through the funnel. When something breaks or underperforms, you diagnose it, fix it, and document the resolution so it does not recur.

Agentic AI Workflow Engineering:

Design and build automated workflows that use AI capabilities to evaluate qualitative signals, such as demo request notes, intent activity, and unstructured form inputs, alongside firmographic data to produce dynamic lead scores and routing decisions. You write the API calls, design the orchestration logic, test against edge cases, and iterate based on conversion outcomes. Experience shipping something to production is the bar.

Enrichment and Insights:

Build and manage the workflows that construct a complete, account-level intelligence profile from the moment a prospect engages. That means aggregating first-party behavioral signals, third-party intent data, firmographic context, and web research into a unified view that captures not just the individual contact but the broader buying committee: who across the account is engaging, with what content, and what their activity suggests about organizational priorities and pain points. That intelligence surfaces in the systems where sales and marketing work, so every follow-up is informed, relevant, and timed to the account's buying journey.

System Documentation and Enablement:

Every workflow you build or modify gets documented: field mapping dictionaries, AI orchestration logic, routing rule change logs. Beyond documentation, you actively invest in making the marketing team more self-sufficient, building self-service reporting and dashboards that allow marketers to check campaign performance, list quality, or lead status independently, and creating resources that allow colleagues to troubleshoot routine tasks and leverage AI tools without filing a request. An empowered marketing team operates with greater speed and confidence, and this role contributes meaningfully to that outcome.

Who You Are

You operate with a high degree of autonomy. You are embedded in the relevant standups, attentive to system performance, and typically ahead of issues before they surface as escalations. Your manager will set context and priorities; the execution is yours to own.
You are invested in the success of the Marketing team. You understand that the campaigns, events, and programs your colleagues execute are only as effective as the systems that support them. Leads from a field event that go unrouted, an ABM sequence that executes against incomplete data, or a high-intent inbound request that experiences significant delay before reaching an SDR all represent measurable pipeline impact. You approach your work with that accountability in mind.
You are technically strong and collaborative by nature. Marketers, Sales and RevOps are close partners. You understand their workflows well enough to anticipate where system gaps will affect their work, and communicate clearly when something is broken, when it is fixed, and why. Strong cross-functional relationships are central to this role.
You see the work through to completion. You build, test, document, and close the loop. When something you own regresses, you identify it first.
What We're Looking For

Required
3 to 5 years in B2B SaaS Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, or a systems-adjacent role
Hands-on marketing automation and CRM administration, including configuring and maintaining MAP-to-CRM syncs
Demonstrated ability to build and deploy an automated workflow that calls external APIs, whether webhooks, REST APIs, or LLM endpoints, in a production environment
Native fluency in B2B funnel mechanics: MQL definitions, lifecycle stage transitions, opportunity lifecycles, and attribution models
Experience coaching or enabling non-technical stakeholders on new tools, AI workflows, or self-service reporting

Strong Signal
Hands-on administrative experience with intent data platforms, routing engines, and ABM orchestration
Prior experience building LLM-powered workflows for lead scoring, routing, or qualification
Comfort reading and writing JSON, working with REST APIs, and debugging integration errors independently

How We'll Measure Success

The through-line across all of it is pipeline efficiency: more of the right prospects converting into pipeline from the programs already running, with less manual intervention and less fallout.
30 days: Full audit of marketing automation-to-CRM field mapping is complete, ownership of inbound routing rules is established, and current ABM workflow patterns are mapped to identify key automation opportunities.
60 days: First agentic AI workflow is deployed to staging or production. At least one major ABM orchestration sequence that previously required manual steps is automated. An initial self-service enablement resource or dashboard is delivered to the marketing team.
90 days and beyond: Lead sync exception rate is at target with a monitoring process that catches regressions before Sales does. ABM orchestration operates as a reliable service layer that campaign and field marketers can brief and trust to execute. Marketing colleagues actively leverage self-service tools and AI workflows independently.
Application Question

Required with your resume (200 words max):

A high-intent prospect submits a demo request but never reaches the assigned SDR in the CRM. Walk us through your exact diagnostic process: which logs you check first, how you trace the break across the marketing automation-to-CRM sync and inbound routing rules, how you validate the fix, and how you would design an agentic step to evaluate the prospect's form submission notes for priority routing.

across CRM, email marketing, lifecycle marketing, digital campaign activation, or closely related work.

.
Deep understanding of the end-to-end email campaign lifecycle, including briefing, creative development, campaign requirements, audience segmentation, deployment readiness, reporting, and optimization.
Strong experience with Braze and/or Movable Ink is highly valued
.
Strong understanding of dynamic content, personalization, behavioral segmentation, audience logic, and campaign versioning
.
Experience translating marketing objectives into detailed campaign requirements for email operations and technical teams.

Strong client-facing communication and stakeholder-management skills.

.

Senior Email Marketing Manager, Senior CRM Manager, Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager, CRM Campaign Manager, Associate Director of CRM, Associate Director of Email Marketing, Director of CRM, or Director of Lifecycle Marketing.

will be essential.

jobs.description:
Position Number: 22161822

County: Prairie; Pulaski

Posting End Date: [[postingEndDate]]

Anticipated Starting Salary: $47,397

[[section]]

Position Specifics:

This position is primarily field-based, requiring daily travel within an assigned territory to visit retailers, monitor inventory, deliver materials, and provide training. The role involves analyzing sales data, resolving retailer issues, promoting products, and identifying opportunities for business growth. The employee works independently while maintaining regular communication with management and completing reporting and compliance requirements.

Preferred Qualifications:

Preferred candidates will have a bachelor’s degree and several years of experience in outside sales, route sales, or territory management, particularly working with retail or convenience store environments. Strong relationship-building, data analysis, and problem-solving skills are essential, along with the ability to work independently and meet sales goals. Experience in field marketing, merchandising, or account management is highly desirable.

The mission of the Department of Finance and Administration is to provide Arkansas citizens convenient, effective, and courteous service which will encourage voluntary compliance with tax, license, and child support laws.

Position Information

Job Series:
Lottery

Classification:
OAL Marketing Sales Rep – Career Path

Class Code:
LLO25P

Pay Grade:
SGS05

Salary Range:
$47,397 - $70,148

Job Summary

The Marketing and Sales Representative (MSR) will promote and sell OAL lottery products. This position is responsible for overseeing a designated field territory, ensuring consistent and continuous service to our retailers. The MSR will act as the primary customer service and account representative, serving as the main point of contact between retailers and the OAL. In this role, the MSR will train retailers on the lottery games and address any complaints or issues that may arise between retailers and customers. Additionally, the MSR will work to secure new business and ensure that new license applications are completed. The MSR will also collaborate closely with vendor partners to maintain the ongoing workflow of OAL as needed.

Primary Responsibilities

Serves as a customer service representative and liaison for ASL within an assigned territory. Identifies route requirements and retailer needs, analyzes ticket usage to determine current demands, and coordinates the placement of ASL promotional materials and supplies. Travels extensively to vendors and retailers to deliver promotional material, provide training, and offer other necessary services. Utilizes a system to deliver and track tickets, reconciles ticket usage with inventory, adjusts inventory levels, and reallocates tickets to other retailers as needed. Ensures proper activation for financial accountability and billing purposes. Analyzes store layouts to recommend the most effective placement of point-of-sale and promotional items. Instructs retailers on strategies to increase sales, motivates them to promote ASL products, and suggests suitable promotional strategies or programs. Recruits and secures new retailers, ensuring the completion and compliance of licensing applications. Trains both new and existing retailers on instant games, other ASL games, and the operation of Lottery validation equipment. Maintains retailer centers to ensure they are presentable and serve as effective sales tools. Identifies retailer issues and plans appropriate actions to resolve them, ensuring the rapid delivery of special ticket orders to retailers. Ensures compliance with ASL rules and regulations. Completes accounting, security, and sales reports, and meets regularly with the assigned Regional Sales Manager to provide updates and information.

Knowledge And Skills

Skilled in negotiating and resolving conflicts while maintaining positive working relationships.

Ability to analyze sales data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.

Familiarity with marketing strategies, promotional campaigns, and brand management.

A strong customer service mindset with the ability to respond to retailer and customer needs in a professional and timely manner.

Experience in dedicated sales route management or direct customer interaction is a plus.

Strong verbal and written communication skills are necessary.

The ability to work independently without direct supervision.

Effective Time Management And Organizational Skills Are Essential.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and basic office equipment (printers, copiers, fax machines).

Minimum Qualifications

A bachelor’s degree is preferable, but a high school diploma plus 3 years of sales or customer service experience can be substituted.

Special Dimensions:

Valid Driver’s License.
Ability and willingness to travel, lift, carry, and transport ASL/retailer materials as needed.
Eligibility for Bonding

Licensure/Certifications

jobs.title: Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
Marketing Specialist

HydroJug — Brand Marketing
Location: Ogden, UT
Reports to: VP of Marketing
Team: Brand Marketing

ABOUT HYDROJUG

HydroJug built a category and a community around hydration as a daily ritual. Our marketing team is the customer — they know the brands, the gyms, the creators, the moments. That insider fluency is why the work lands. We're expanding into new categories and new consumer segments, and we need that same engine running on the new side of the house.

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

You won't be coordinating launches for a community you study. You'll be coordinating launches for communities you're already part of. Our existing marketing works because the team lives in the world it markets to — same gyms, same feeds, same creators. The new category will only work the same way: with someone whose network is already in the spaces we're entering, who can tell us which podcast just blew up before the rest of the internet catches on, and who knows which brands are doing the most interesting work in lifting, hybrid athletics, run, hunt and outdoor, combat sport, and performance wellness. This is a specialist role on purpose. You'll own a compressed version of what a much larger team owns on our established side — seeding and influencer first, brand partnerships second, then events, content, and the rest as the program scales.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN (IN PRIORITY SEQUENCE)

Priority 1 — Product seeding & influencer relationships (first 90 days)
Build the PR list for the new category from scratch — tiered by network economy, not follower count.
Run all four customization tiers (generic → one-of-one) against the right recipients.
Own the seed → follow-up → track → convert workflow for every send. No charitable donations.
Open warm channels with creators across our priority spaces: lifting and hybrid, run, outdoor and hunt, combat sport, and performance wellness.

Priority 2 — Brand partnerships (months 3–6)
Identify the brand counterparts that fit alongside our existing partnership portfolio in these spaces.
Open conversations with the operators (not the agencies) at those brands.
Build the institutional seeding lane — gyms, teams, races, schools — where attention concentrates in these communities.

Priority 3 — Events, content, and adjacent motions (months 6+)
Stand up the event calendar in coordination with the Events Coordinator.
Brief UGC and Social on what reads as native in these spaces — what to do and what not to do.
Become the in-house translator: every team that touches the new category comes to you first.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The non-negotiable credential is demonstrated immersion in and access to the communities
and culture surrounding the spaces above. That shows up as:
An active, real network of creators, athletes, and brand operators in those spaces — the kind where DMs get answered the same day.
Lived participation in at least one (ideally more) of our target spaces: lifting, hybrid and HYROX, run, hunt and outdoor, combat sport, or performance wellness.
Fluent reads on the brand landscape in these categories — you can name the five brands doing the best work right now and the three about to break.
A track record of putting product in the right hands or building programs that earned attention from these communities. What "experience" looks like is flexible. 2–4 years in influencer, partnerships, brand, or creator-side work is typical. We care more about your network and judgment than your title history.

OPERATING STYLE WE HIRE FOR

You run on calendar discipline. A missed send is cheaper than a bad send.
You build relationships, not contact lists. The litmus test is whether the recipient stays if a competitor offers 20% more.
You customize. Generic PR boxes are the floor we're trying to clear.
You track conversion, not volume. Seeds earn relationships, not impressions.
You're opinionated and you write it down.

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

VP of Marketing (direct manager), Influencer Manager, Strategic Brand Partnerships, Social, UGC, Events, Retention, Performance Marketing, and the Product team driving the new-category launches.

HOW YOU'LL BE MEASURED

Active PR list size and tier mix in the new category
Conversion rate of seeds → ambassador, earned content, or partnership
Cost per earned impression in the new category
Brand-partner pipeline opened and activated
Quality of cross-functional collaboration (named, not surveyed)

jobs.description:
Who Are We?

At BaseCamp Franchising, we are revolutionizing the apparel retail industry through our two fast-growing resale brands, Uptown Cheapskate and Kid to Kid. We take an entirely new approach to clothing resale, offering a vast assortment of in-demand brands at unbeatable prices, all in a boutique-style shopping environment. Thanks to this unique combination, BaseCamp has more than doubled sales to over $350 million over the past 5 years, with a huge wave of growth still on the horizon.
We have sustainability at our core and recycle tens of millions of items each year through our growing network of over 300 franchised stores. We are also strong advocates of the upcycling ethos: shopping resale can make the world a better, cleaner, and more sustainable place while helping families save money at the same time.
As one of the fastest-growing franchise systems in the country, we are privileged to help hundreds of entrepreneurs find success by owning and operating Uptown Cheapskate and Kid to Kid stores. Continuous improvement and innovation are the cornerstones of our culture, and our top priority is to maximize the impact our franchisees have in their local communities. Our two brands are expanding rapidly, and we are looking for people who are excited to join us in our mission to make Uptown Cheapskate and Kid to Kid the two preeminent brands in resale.

What You’ll Do

As the Social Media Coordinator, you will manage and grow the day-to-day organic social presence of Uptown Cheapskate and Kid to Kid’s corporate channels, support content creation efforts for our paid media efforts, and help develop franchisee-facing tools and resources.

Content Creation, Production & Organization

Conceptualize, create, and edit engaging social-first content for organic and paid campaigns, including short-form videos, photography, graphics, and other emerging formats.
Edit videos and images using tools like CapCut, Canva, or Adobe Creative Suite.
Adapt content into multiple formats (9:16, 1:1, 16:9, etc.) for different platforms and campaigns.
Stay current on fashion, resale, and social media trends to keep our brands relevant, timely, and fun.

Organic Social & Community Management

Develop, schedule, and publish posts across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Pinterest, and other digital platforms.
Write captions and maintain a consistent brand voice across our two distinct concepts, Uptown Cheapskate and Kid to Kid.
Monitor comments, DMs, tagged content, and mentions, and engage with our communities daily.
Manage and monitor UGC, influencer content, and outreach.
Maintain social media tools, templates, trackers, and content calendars to streamline workflows.
Track performance metrics and surface insights about engagement, recurring themes, and customer sentiment.

Social Media & Team Support

Maintain LinkedIn content for BaseCamp, Uptown Cheapskate, and Kid to Kid.
Educate franchisees on social media and marketing fundamentals so they can effectively use their social channels at the local level.

What We’re Looking For

2-4 years experience managing social media accounts for a brand, agency, or business.
Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communication, or related field (OR experience in social media).
Trend-savvy: deep awareness of what’s happening on TikTok, Instagram, and other platforms, with the ability to quickly adapt formats for brand use.

Customer-service mindset for handling community interactions with care.

Ability to create or maintain training materials, guides, or checklists for internal teams or franchisees.

This role is based at our headquarters in North Salt Lake, UT at the base of the Wasatch mountains. We offer competitive pay and benefits that include:

jobs.description:
JOB TITLE: Director, Portfolio Strategy & Product Marketing

REPORTS TO: Chief Product Officer

STATUS: Full time, Exempt

LOCATION: Remote

SALARY RANGE: $220,000/year based on experience & qualifications

EQUITY ELIGIBILITY: Eligible for company stock options as part of the overall compensation package, subject to plan terms.

BONUS ELIGIBILITY: Performance-based annual incentive

BENEFITS: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, optional FSA/HSA, 401k with 6% employer match, life and AD&D insurance, Employee Assistance Program, short & long term disability, tuition reimbursement, 21.67 days of paid time off + 10 holidays

About Tidal Vision

We believe that sustainability should not require customers to compromise on price, convenience, or performance. Our mission is to create positive & systemic impact for the critical industries that sustain life. We value innovation and take pride in challenging the status-quo; we choose to view obstacles as opportunities. We value new ideas and encourage the team to apply creativity and invent new solutions to meet challenging demands. We foster open, direct communication, and a collaborative working environment through our unique approach to work culture. We value our employees and demonstrate that through our compensation and benefits programs and opportunities for growth and development.

About Tidal Grow AgriScience

Tidal Grow AgriScience develops next-generation agricultural technologies designed to improve crop performance, nutrient efficiency, and grower profitability. By translating advanced chitosan science into practical, scalable products, we create innovative agricultural solutions that integrate seamlessly into modern farming operations to deliver higher yields with more efficient inputs.

About Tidal Vision’s Unique Work Culture

Tidal Vision strives to build and invest in the highest performing and most innovative team. We put our people and customers above process, avoid company-wide rules as much as possible, and have the courage to take unusual approaches to advance our mission. With this approach, we believe we can create a more flexible, fun, stimulating, creative, collaborative, and innovative organization.

Our commitment to developing, practicing and promoting direct and open communication, responsibility and freedom, and leading with and seeking context is a responsibility for every role at Tidal Vision.

Job Summary

The Director, Portfolio Strategy & Product Marketing leads the commercial strategy and market success of Tidal Grow AgriScience’s product portfolio. The role owns segmentation, targeting, positioning, pricing, channel strategy, label and claims strategy, launch planning, and lifecycle commercialization.

This role is a critical member of the Product organization, working alongside Product Management and R&D to shape and commercialize Tidal Grow AgriScience's product portfolio. As the portfolio's commercial leader, the Director drives market strategy, positioning, pricing, channel strategy, launch planning, and lifecycle commercialization to ensure products achieve successful market adoption and long-term growth.

Essential Job Functions

Lead portfolio commercialization strategy across crop nutrition, biostimulant, and crop protection markets.
Own segmentation, targeting, positioning, value propositions, pricing architecture, and channel strategy.
Own the commercial direction of each product from development through launch and lifecycle management.
Own label and claims strategy, partnering with Regulatory on registrations, substantiation, and compliance.
Partner with Product Managers to translate technical capabilities, efficacy data, and customer needs into commercially successful products.
Partner with Marketing to establish promotional strategy, message hierarchy, proof points, and sales-enablement priorities; Marketing owns creative development and execution.
Build market, customer, competitive, pricing, and channel intelligence into portfolio plans, business cases, forecasts, and commercialization decisions.
Work with the Chief Product Officer on product vision, roadmap priorities, portfolio architecture, and investment decisions.
Align Product Management, R&D, Commercial Ag Science, Regulatory, Marketing, Sales, and Operations around commercialization plans and market outcomes.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in agriculture, agronomy, agricultural economics, marketing, business, crop science, or a related field.
At least 15 years of progressive experience in agricultural product marketing, portfolio strategy, product management, market development, or commercial leadership.
Commercial leadership experience across both crop nutrition/fertilizer and crop protection.
Proven success leading segmentation, positioning, pricing, channel, launch, lifecycle, and portfolio strategies for agricultural products.
Strong understanding of grower economics, agricultural distribution, retail channels, product labels, claims, and commercialization requirements.
Ability to translate technical and field-performance data into differentiated value propositions and commercially compelling strategies.
Strong financial acumen and experience developing value-based pricing, channel economics, and product business cases.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive decisions without direct authority.
Executive-level communication, judgment, and presence.

Preferred Qualifications

MBA or advanced degree in agribusiness, marketing, agricultural economics, agronomy, or a related field.
Experience leading a multi-product portfolio within an established agricultural input company.
Experience launching and scaling innovative or technically differentiated agricultural products.
Experience across distributor, retailer, and direct-to-grower channels.
Success operating in an entrepreneurial or rapidly scaling business.

Licensing & Special Requirements

Kendo Holdings, Inc. is a San Francisco-based beauty brand developer and wholesaler owned by LVMH Moët Hennessy - Louis Vuitton, the world’s largest luxury group. A play on the words “can do”, Kendo has become the hub of creativity and next generation beauty product development for global Sephora channels and selective retailers outside of Sephora.
Through original development, collaborations and acquisitions the Kendo stable of brands will always be creative, inspiring and innovative. A dynamic engine of speed, expertise and market-savvy, the Kendo team continues to redefine the beauty industry through great product, great storytelling, great retail and direct-to-consumer partnerships. This shows up in everything we do and in what we stand for:

Evaluate and responsibly adopt new capabilities in automation, predictive analytics, AI-assisted orchestration, and agentic workflows within defined governance and measurement guardrails.

Establish data-quality standards for identity resolution, consent, customer attributes, event definitions, taxonomy, suppression logic, deduplication, latency, reconciliation, and downstream usability.
Create an escalation and remediation process for data gaps, broken feeds, schema changes, unexpected volume shifts, and platform discrepancies before they affect customers or reporting.

Performance Management & Insights

Set expectations for KPIs, reporting frameworks, and insights across CRM.
Translate performance trends into strategic recommendations for leadership.
Ensure testing frameworks align with broader business goals—not just channel metrics.

Cross-Functional & Executive Alignment

Align CRM priorities with:
Brand strategy

Personalization roadmaps

We build thoughtful marketing strategy, positioning, messaging and creative assets to deliver messages that matter to our audience, communicated through anything from video content, to social media interactions, to immersive physical experiences. We also shape Waymo's go-to-market initiatives, helping to transform Waymo into a thriving business with a growing user base.

In this hybrid role, you will report to our Head of Marketing.

You Will

Set the vision, strategy, and priorities for Product Marketing, ensuring the customer and market perspective informs Waymo’s product strategy, go-to-market decisions, and rider experience.
Serve as a strategic partner to Product, Engineering, and Operations leadership, influencing roadmaps, business priorities, and key decisions while driving alignment across teams.
Develop holistic marketing strategies for Waymo’s ride-hailing product and beyond, from positioning and launch through adoption and growth.
Lead product marketing for U.S. and international market launches, expansions, and ongoing market health, integrating consumer, brand, business, competitive, and product signals to identify opportunities and guide market priorities.
Build and develop a high-performing global Product Marketing team, fostering strong strategic thinking, execution, and collaboration to support Waymo’s rapid growth and evolving needs.

You Have

15+ years of product marketing or related marketing experience within consumer technology, including significant experience leading Product Marketing teams and complex consumer products or services.
Proven ability to lead and develop high-performing Product Marketing teams, setting a clear vision and priorities while fostering strong strategic thinking, execution, and cross-functional collaboration.
Deep experience partnering with Product leadership and influencing product strategy and roadmaps, bringing customer, market, and business perspectives into product development and key decisions.
Experience leading U.S. and international market launches and expansions, with the ability to synthesize consumer, brand, competitive, product, and business insights to inform market priorities.
Exceptional strategic judgment and executive influence, with the ability to navigate complexity, develop clear recommendations, and align senior stakeholders across Product, Marketing, Operations, and other functions.

We Prefer

Experience at a ride-hailing, marketplace, or app-based B2C company.
Concrete marketing experience driving the adoption of emerging technologies or new consumer behaviors, particularly where building understanding and trust is critical.
Track record across both established and early-stage products or markets.

Plans and coordinates trade shows, NHRA race events, sales meetings, customer events, and other marketing activities in collaboration with Marketing, Sales, Product Management, and other business units.

About Our Client:

The organization operates in the marketplace sector, focusing on providing solutions tailored to general contractors, subcontractors, and suppliers. It addresses challenges in user engagement and activation within this industry by delivering specialized programs and tools that enhance customer lifecycle management and communication.

About the Opportunity:

The LIFECYCLE MARKETING MANAGER role is designed to drive user engagement and retention through strategic lifecycle marketing initiatives. This position is responsible for defining and executing activation milestones and user journey programs, optimizing communication workflows, and analyzing performance to enhance user activation, retention, and plan upgrades. The role is integral to improving customer experience and supporting growth through targeted lifecycle marketing efforts.

Responsibilities:

Define user lifecycle journeys, activation milestones, and progression criteria with Marketing Operations and Product.
Design, build, and optimize workflows for onboarding, activation, plan upgrades, retention, and win-back.
Manage lifecycle messaging, including copy, cadence, and campaign execution.
Segment and personalize communications based on trade, geography, behavior, and plan.
Plan and oversee communications via email, in-app messaging, and other channels.
Conduct experiments to evaluate the impact on activation, usage, retention, and upgrades.
Develop and maintain lifecycle reporting, including cohort and funnel analysis.
Lead lifecycle program requirements for email platform and user-profile migration.
Monitor email engagement, deliverability, and suppression practices.

Requirements:

Minimum five years of experience in lifecycle marketing, CRM, or marketing automation.
Proficient with HubSpot workflows, segmentation, and data models.
Strong analytical skills including cohort and funnel analysis, experiment design, and SQL or BI tool usage.
Experience managing high-volume email programs and behavioral, event-triggered campaigns.
Proven ability to set lifecycle strategy and optimize programs.
Strong copywriting skills focused on clear, relevant customer communications.
Knowledge of email deliverability, consent management, and compliance.
Effective communication skills to collaborate across multiple teams.
Experience with customer data platforms and orchestration tools like Braze, Iterable, or Klaviyo.
Experience supporting email platform migrations or implementing new messaging capabilities.
Background in B2B marketplaces, construction, or SMB customers preferred.

Base salary range of $105,000 to $120,000 per year, depending on experience.

Open time-off policy.

jobs.description:
At Arcus, our mission is to empower anyone to build wealth by making investing accessible, affordable, and simple. The team behind Arcus previously built dYdX, helping power over $1.5 trillion in trading volume. Now we're bringing the world's financial markets onchain.

Built in partnership with Robinhood Chain and backed by a direct investment from Robinhood Crypto, Arcus brings crypto, stock tokens, commodities, and perpetual futures into one self-custodied account. Our vision is to build the world's best spot and perpetuals exchange - trusted, accessible, and reliable, with deep liquidity and accurate prices. Every asset, 24/7.

Experienced team: Google, Meta, Citadel, DRW, IMC Trading, Stripe, Coinbase, and more.
Leading backers and advisors: Andreessen Horowitz, Polychain Capital, Brian Armstrong, Fred Ehrsam, Naval Ravikant, Elad Gil, and more.

Join us in shaping the next generation of global financial markets!

→ Learn more about working at Arcus

Role Overview

We're looking for Product Marketing Lead who is also a trader who's also a strong communicator to own how Arcus explains what it ships to its users to generate excitement and engagement.

You turn what engineering builds into communications that traders understand and trust: blog posts, announcements, changelogs, docs, and launch threads. Every product update and incentive change passes through you first.

You're also the product team's best read on what traders actually think. You talk to traders directly, follow what they're saying across the chats, and bring back clear findings that shape product decisions and the roadmap.

This is a hands-on senior role that reports to the CBO and works daily with Product, Engineering, Growth, and Community.

Done well, this role is how Arcus earns trust with every launch. You'll be the voice that makes complex products feel clear, keeps traders confident in what's shipping, and turns real trader feedback into a sharper product for everyone.

Responsibilities

Launches: for every release you write the positioning, the announcement, the blog post, the X thread, and the docs update. You approve launch timing with Engineering so traders hear about a change before it goes live.
Prepare a short brief for each launch so KOLs, BD and regional communities have the right facts and assets.
In product copy: You own and sign off on all user facing copy within the product and app.
Eng to comms pipeline: you run the weekly changelog with Engineering and read it daily. Sensitive changes (fees, liquidations, withdrawals, points, security) get lead time and a reviewed draft. Nothing ships unannounced.
Announcement approvals. You draft, validate internally, and sign off on announcements. You decide what gets said, when, in which channels, and in what order.
Long-form content: use internal data to draft blog posts, product explainers, market-structure pieces and launch narratives that a trader would actually read.
Narrative and positioning: refine differentiation theses and roadmap into credible narrative positioning on why Arcus is different from competitors
Product signal: Talk to traders every day: whales, early contributors, active traders and people who churned. Transmit feedback on fills, listings, fees, UX, competitors, and other signal into structured synthesis for leadership
Get the most out of every partner, starting with Robinhood and the Robinhood Chain ecosystem. Set up co-marketing with each partner, then write and coordinate joint announcements, campaigns and content.
Incident / crisis comms: during rare market or product events, you write what we say, working with Engineering and Community. Community operates the information dissemination; you own the strategy.

Requirements

4+ years in product marketing, content or comms at a crypto-native or trading product, or an equivalent record of shipping launches.
You trade actively. You can explain funding rates, liquidations and fee tiers precisely, because a wrong sentence about them costs trust and money.
You've worked closely with engineers. You can read a changelog or spec, ask the right questions, and turn it into plain language without losing accuracy.
You write clearly and fast, in both long and short form.
You have a network of traders who reply to you and tell you the truth.
Good judgment about tone under pressure: you know when to explain, when to stay quiet, and when an apology makes things worse.

Nice To Haves

Launched products at a perp DEX (decentralized perpetual-futures exchange), a prediction market or a trading venue
Experience with points, rewards or token programs
Knowledge of Asian trader communities (Korea, Greater China)

Collaboration & Influence

Leverage analytics and reporting to inform planning cycles, optimize performance, and drive accountability across tactics
Review campaign performance, including SEM and content engagement metrics, and apply insights to refine marketing tactics

Minimum Qualifications

6-8 years of experience in communications, marketing planning, or program management in a large, complex, or regulated environment
Demonstrated ability to support translating strategy into executable marketing plans
Strong skills in project management and execution of tactical deliverables
Experience with SEO, segmentation, analytics, and channel planning
Demonstrated ability to translate strategy into executable marketing plans
Experience integrating marketing efforts with broader institutional or enterprise campaigns to ensure a unified brand approach
Experience in audience segmentation and channel optimization to effectively engage both patient and physician audiences
Bachelors degree in Communications, Marketing, or related field required

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with marketing analytics, campaign evaluation, and optimization methods
Experience working with PCC + Radiation Oncology, Transplant, Neurology, Neurosurgery, ENT, Womens Health, OBGYN, GI, Surgery, Ophthalmology, Adult Psych and Urology

You will own a portfolio of category products and projects and partner with Sales, Marketing, Pricing/Revenue Management, R&D, Sensory, and Innovation to align the organization and deliver results. You will also coach and develop Associate Managers.

Key Responsibilities

Category Strategy & Planning

Contribute to the annual situation assessment and category/brand strategy for FSVAP.
Evaluate internal strengths and weaknesses and external opportunities and threats, including consumer, operator, and competitor dynamics.
Track progress against category priorities and recommend adjustments.
Market, Customer & Competitive Intelligence

Translate category trends, consumer and operator behavior, and competitive activity into insights and recommendations.
Assess competitor and industry capacity and the implications of market shifts.
Portfolio & Product Strategy
Lead product and pricing performance assessments, quality monitoring, and competitive benchmarking.
Partner with Sensory on drivers of liking and competitive testing.
Lead white-space and gap analysis and renovation initiatives.
Lead SKU rationalization analysis and recommend portfolio actions.
Innovation & Growth Strategy
Partner with Innovation to turn white-space and gap analysis into opportunities.
Identify emerging consumer and operator needs and recommend priorities.
Brand & Commercial Enablement
Review Brand Marketing materials for alignment with category and customer insights.
Partner with Pricing/Revenue Management on performance and pricing decisions.
Develop and present category recommendations to Sales, Marketing, and senior leadership.

Leadership

Coach and develop Associate Managers.

Manage multiple complex projects and align cross-functional partners to deliver results.

Experience: 5+ years of experience in category management, marketing, market insights, strategy, or a related field
Computer Skills: Proficient in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; experience with syndicated market data (e.g., Circana) preferred.

Special Skills: Knowledge of the foodservice and/or CPG industry preferred; Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn market, customer, and competitive data into actionable insights; Solid understanding of category, portfolio, and pricing performance; Ability to coach and develop others; Strong project management skills and the ability to influence cross-functional partners in a fast-paced, changing environment.

Gallo Privacy Policy

We are GALLO

We’re a family-owned company with a 90+ year legacy, that’s consistently recognized as a Glassdoor “Best Places to Work.” We have 130+ brands in our total alcohol beverage portfolio including wine, malt, spirits, and ready-to-drink beverages. We’re home to the #1 wine and spirits brands in the U.S. - Barefoot Wine & High Noon and are the official sponsors of the NFL, NHL, UFC, and PGA of America.

View our Corporate Values and Mission Statement here.

Location: Must be willing and able to be based in NYC, NY (Requires 3 days per week onsite)

A Taste of What You’ll Do

Join GALLO as our Senior Manager, Web & Digital Marketing and lead the strategies that shape how consumers discover, engage with, and experience our brands across digital channels. You’ll bring together websites, email/SMS, SEO, CRM, paid media landing pages, and emerging AI-driven search to create connected consumer journeys that drive brand growth and business results.

As a digital marketing subject matter expert, you’ll turn data into action. You’ll lead A/B testing, conversion rate optimization, audience segmentation, analytics, and personalized marketing programs while advancing Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). You’ll partner across brand, MarTech, social, creative, data and insights, PR, paid media, and external agencies to build integrated strategies and continually improve the consumer experience.

You’ll also shape the future of our digital marketing organization. From evolving operating models and assessing readiness for emerging capabilities to managing resources through Agile/Scrum practices, you’ll help ensure our team scales with the business. As a people leader, you’ll coach and develop talent, champion the thoughtful use of AI tools, establish scalable best practices, and create an environment where innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning translate into meaningful results.

What You’ll Need

Bachelor’s degree plus 8 years of digital and/or e-commerce experience reflecting increasing levels of responsibility; OR Master’s degree plus 6 years of digital and/or e-commerce experience reflecting increasing levels of responsibility; OR High School Diploma or State-issued equivalency certificate plus 12 years of digital and/or e-commerce experience reflecting increasing levels of responsibility.

Strong project management skills with the ability to effectively partner cross-functionally.

Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools to drive operational efficiency, accelerate speed-to-market, and support ideation and collaboration.
Strong analytical skills and demonstrated ability.

How You’ll Stand Out

4 years of specific experience in contemporary digital media (websites, search, social, content marketing, video, mobile, CRM Strategy).
Deep understanding of paid media's role in cross-channel digital strategies ensuring a unified consumer journey.
Experience in developing end-to-end customer journeys and designing automated marketing programs leveraging CRM data.
Expertise in managing website strategy to optimize for emerging AI and generative search changes, maintaining organic visibility and user experience.
Expertise in Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and generative/AI search strategy, maintaining organic visibility and user experience as brand discoverability and consumer search behavior evolves.

Job Description:

We welcome remote candidates based in the continental United States

Merkle is a leading data-driven, technology-enabled, global performance marketing agency that specializes in the delivery of unique, personalized customer experiences across platforms and devices. For more than 30 years, Fortune 1000 companies and leading nonprofit organizations have partnered with Merkle to maximize the value of their customer portfolios. The agency's heritage in data, technology, and analytics forms the foundation for its unmatched skills in understanding consumer insights that drive people-based marketing strategies. Its combined strengths in performance media, customer experience, customer relationship management, loyalty, and enterprise marketing technology drive improved marketing results and competitive advantage.

We are champions for meaningful progress and we strive to be a force for good—for our people, for our clients, for the industry and for our society. We keep our people at the center, creating space for growth, understanding and learning so they can thrive. We embed diversity, in our mindset, in our solutions and in our teams to empower an inclusive, equitable and culturally fluent environment. Building this culture within our teams makes us better collaborators with each other and with our clients, driving better outcomes for all. Merkle is an agency of dentsu.

As Senior Associate, Customer Lifecycle Marketing, you will join a team of talented and experienced marketers who focus on helping Merkle clients achieve their our goals.

You will plan strategy, with a focus on first party data-driven channels (email, SMS, direct mail, push notifications). You will help develop and manage campaign strategies that produce measurable return on investment and you'll work across multiple vertical markets (Insurance, Financial Services, Non-Profit, Retail, Automotive, Travel, Media and Entertainment, B2B, High-tech).

To be successful in this role you need to have a deep passion for finding solutions, and an understanding of how businesses, brands and customers interact,
with an advanced understanding of the always evolving role that data and technology play in this relationship. You know how to identify business growth opportunities and develop recommendations to help group client relationships.

You Will:

Build, develop, and deliver messaging strategy for omni-channel marketing plans using 1st party data.
Be a subject matter expert and be able to translate new technology - focused on areas of messaging and CRM - into new marketing ideas for the client.
Show an understanding of differences in marketing to customers in different industries and environments.
Ensure meaningful client value is delivered through a mix of best-practice solutions, capabilities, and original thinking.
Write campaign briefs to hand off to creative and execution teams.
Collaborate and develop relationships with internal Merkle teams (account management, operations, creative, analytics), and partner agencies to understand the feasibility of cross-channel recommendations/ plans.
Identify main data points and measurements to show the impact of our approach and strategy on our client's business.

Experience with client-facing communication (writing and presentations)
Experience translating data analysis into applicable marketing recommendations and presentations – proficiency in PowerPoint (advantageous)
Prior experience incorporating internal and external feedback on an iterative basis.
Experience using business knowledge to identify new business and marketing opportunities.
Salesforce Marketing Cloud or Braze experience (advantageous)
Experience working on several projects simultaneously that are delivered on time, as well as networking and the ability work with a diverse team.
Comfort and experience working within a matrixed organization in roles with a wide degree of latitude.
20-40% travel

401k,

Paid sick and safe leave, and
Paid parental leave.

Great Colleges to Work For®

This recognition reflects our commitment to creating an organizational culture where employees are valued, supported, and empowered.

Lone Star College-University Center at The Woodlands

Lone Star College-University Center at The Woodlands and University Park

With 100,000 students and counting, Lone Star College System provides transformational educational opportunities that help individuals get from where they are to where they want to be. The two-year institution is training tomorrow's workforce today, offering more than 200 degrees and certification programs that empower students to take the next step.

Lone Star College System has eight main campuses and more than 20 locations in the Houston area. Learn more at LoneStar.edu .

Lone Star College-University Center, located in The Woodlands and LSC-University Park is a partnership with several leading universities to provide bachelor's degrees, master's degrees, and doctorates. Utilizing partnerships and seamless credit transfer programs, the center serves as the critical link for community development and individual opportunities.

The Woodlands address is 3232 College Park Drive, The Woodlands, TX 77384. All applicants must reside in Texas.

The University Park address is 20515 SH 249 (TX 249 and Louetta Road), Houston, TX 77070. All applicants must reside in Texas.

Job Description

The Coordinator III, Marketing and Outreach collaborates with the LSC marketing team at System Office to develop a marketing plan for the LSC-University Centers and coordinates the implementation of the marketing plan. The responsibilities of the position include multiple websites, social media presence, designing of marketing materials (online and printed), and coordinating outreach and public relations events. Attendance at some events is required during heavy orientation and graduation times. jobs.title: Director of Brand Marketing
jobs.description:
Department:
Marketing

Reports To:
VP of Integrated Marketing

Direct Reports:
Brand Marketing Managers, Social Media Managers and Coordinators, and supporting Brand team members

Employment Type:
Full-Time

Location:
Remote

Annual Base Salary:
$160,000–$180,000, based on experience and qualifications

About Bask & Lather

Bask & Lather is a rapidly growing beauty and haircare company dedicated to helping consumers achieve healthier hair and feel confident in their natural beauty. Rooted in a scalp-first philosophy, product efficacy and authentic storytelling, we serve customers across DTC, Amazon, TikTok Shop and national retail. Our mission is to help customers grow it and keep it too.

About The Role

We are seeking a strategic, creative and execution-oriented Director of Brand Marketing to lead brand positioning, product marketing, integrated campaigns, go-to-market planning and organic social. Reporting to the VP of Integrated Marketing, this leader directly manages the Brand and Social teams and translates business objectives and consumer insights into compelling strategies and dependable execution.

This role combines exceptional creative judgment, commercial awareness and operational discipline. You will independently develop recommendations, lead approved plans through completion, develop your team and verify that work meets quality standards. You will identify resource needs early, resolve dependencies and escalate risks before they affect delivery.

Scope and Partnership

The VP of Integrated Marketing owns the broader function, investment priorities, resource allocation and overall performance. The Director owns Brand and Social strategy and delivery within that direction. Channel leaders own their forecasts, resources and execution commitments; Finance consolidates and validates forecasts and economics. This role integrates those inputs into one actionable launch and campaign plan.

Key Responsibilities

Brand Strategy and Consumer Insights

Define brand positioning, messaging, consumer value propositions and competitive differentiation. Build annual and quarterly plans aligned with business priorities.
Identify priority consumers, unmet needs, purchase motivations, barriers and reasons to switch. Translate research, customer feedback, category trends and cultural insights into actionable decisions.
Develop SKU-level competitive analysis covering positioning, pricing, size, benefits and supported advantages. Clarify each product’s role within the portfolio and its relationship to existing products.
Proactively identify research and data gaps, evaluate providers and present recommendations covering scope, cost, timing and business value. Advance work using available evidence while clearly identifying assumptions.

Product Marketing and Go-to-Market

Own integrated GTM strategies for collections, product launches and major initiatives, from consumer opportunity through postlaunch support.
Define the target consumer, purchase rationale, SKU positioning, competitive differentiation, hero products, product routines, messaging and activation strategy.
Translate strategy into channel-specific briefs, asset requirements, launch phases, budgets and measurement plans with named owners, deadlines, dependencies and approvals.
Partner with Product Development, Operations, Supply Chain, Creative, Growth, E-Commerce, Retail and PR to validate specifications, claims, inventory readiness, distribution assumptions and launch feasibility.
Verify that approved assets are accurate, usable, delivered on time and received by executing teams. Maintain readiness gates and contingency plans, and sustain adoption after launch.

Integrated Campaigns and Creative Strategy

Develop compelling campaign concepts, storytelling platforms and creative briefs grounded in consumer insights and product benefits.
Lead coordinated campaigns across paid, owned, earned, retail and experiential touchpoints with Creative, Growth, Social, Influencer, PR and Experiential partners.
Translate strategy into specific production plans, shot lists, creator briefs and channel deliverables. Maintain consistent positioning while adapting execution to each audience and platform.
Apply strong creative judgment to copy, imagery, demonstrations and content. Coordinate required claims, permissions and usage-rights approvals with appropriate partners.

Social Strategy and Publishing Operations

Own organic social strategy, defining each platform’s audience, purpose, content pillars, publishing cadence and performance objectives.
Lead a social calendar balancing education, demonstrations, consumer results, cultural relevance, community and promotional priorities. Maintain a rolling four-week pipeline of approved and scheduled content, with flexibility for timely opportunities.
Establish mandatory content reviews and quality checks for brand alignment, accuracy, sizing, cropping, captions, product tags, shoppable links and live presentation.
Verify scheduled content publishes correctly, including weekends and holidays. Establish named primary and backup owners, account access, training and documented workflows.
Oversee community management, response standards and escalation. Partner with Growth on social commerce, affiliate content and paid amplification with clear deliverable ownership.
Use platform analytics and structured tests to improve content, timing, formats and resource allocation. Connect engagement to relevant audience, product discovery, qualified traffic and commercial outcomes.

Retail and Omnichannel Marketing

Develop coordinated brand initiatives supporting DTC, Amazon, TikTok Shop, national retail and international expansion.
Partner with Retail and Growth on retailer-specific launch support, merchandising messages, education and consumer activations based on confirmed plans.
Adapt campaigns to regional audiences with relevant partners while preserving brand positioning and approved product messaging.

Budgets Measurement and Delivery

Own departmental campaign plans, timelines and budgets within approved investment priorities. Justify significant shoots, partnerships, events and other spending through clear objectives, costs, deliverables, distribution plans and expected outcomes.
Maintain an initiative tracker with accountable owners, dependencies, approval status and evidence of completion. Report accurately, distinguish pending commitments from completed work and escalate risks with recommended solutions.
Measure brand health, awareness, consideration, product adoption, social performance, launch readiness, on-time delivery and budget performance. Assess commercial impact with Growth, channel owners and Finance.
Lead postlaunch and campaign reviews that explain results, investment effectiveness, execution gaps and changes required for future initiatives.

Leadership And Qualifications

Team Leadership

Lead, coach and develop Brand and Social team members. Translate priorities into clear assignments, realistic workloads, deadlines and approval requirements.
Provide timely decisions, constructive feedback and respectful communication. Address performance gaps directly and build team capability and independent judgment.
Take ownership of departmental decisions and results when work is delegated. Maintain backup coverage and continuity through absences, turnover and changing priorities.
Identify staffing, agency and production needs early and present actionable recommendations. Manage external partners against agreed scope, quality, budget and deadlines.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of experience in brand, integrated or consumer marketing, including substantial experience leading teams and complex cross-functional initiatives.
Experience in beauty, haircare, personal care or closely relevant CPG, with demonstrated ownership of product launches from insight and positioning through execution and evaluation.
Proven success developing consumer-led positioning, integrated campaigns and creative briefs, with clear examples of personal contribution and business results.
Direct experience managing social teams and publishing operations, creative quality, community engagement and shoppable content.
Experience across digital commerce and national retail, with strong analytical judgment and an understanding of channel economics and measurement limitations.
Demonstrated budget ownership, investment evaluation, vendor management and proactive resource planning.

jobs.description:
CAZ was founded in 2001 with the backing of some of the most respected and successful families in the state of Texas. Since our inception, we have focused our efforts on finding excellent opportunities to invest our personal money and then providing the ability for our global network of investors to co-invest with us. We exist to provide Exclusive Access to Unique Alternatives.

We recently grew our ownership consortium to include several veterans in financial services as well as the world’s leading life and business strategist, Tony Robbins. Robbins was thrice named to the WORTH 100 most influential people in the world of global finance. His two financial books, Money: Master the Game and Unshakeable, were both #1 New York Times Bestsellers. Robbins’ latest book, The Holy Grail of Investing, co-authored with our Chairman and CIO, Christopher Zook, recently became a #1 New York Times Bestseller as wel l . Robbins’ private financial events often feature speakers like Paul Tudor Jones, Ray Dalio, Jeff Gundlach, Hank Paulson, Alan Greenspan, and others.

We are quite different than the vast majority of other investment management companies in multiple ways. First, we always invest our personal capital alongside our Investors. We have more than $650mm of our personal capital committed to our investment vehicles. We provide access to our Investors to co-invest with us in these vehicles, which we believe provide the best opportunities for our families’ and our Shareholders’ money. Second, because of the scale of our investments, we have access to opportunities that would otherwise not be available to investors with less than $250mm - $500mm of investable assets. Quite simply, there are many investments we can provide for our Investors they could never access on their own. Third, and what we believe is the most unique feature of our Firm, almost all of our compensation is earned only if an investor makes money. Capacity to work within and across Teams to bring success to all members of the firm.

jobs.title: Sr. Partner Marketing Manager, AI , NAMER Partner Marketing
jobs.description:
Description

AWS is looking for a Sr. Partner Marketing Manager to own the North America marketing relationship with our most strategic AI Labs and frontier model provider and AI ISV partners. You will be the connective tissue between AWS's AI product and service teams and partners such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Space X, Cohere - translating technology roadmaps into joint go-to-market programs that accelerate customer adoption and drive measurable pipeline in North America.

This role sits within the North America Partner Marketing team, part of the AWS Global Partner Marketing organization working closely with the Data & AI Partner GTM team, Global AI & SUP Partner Marketing. The partners you work with are not traditional ISVs - they are category-defining companies at the frontier of foundation model research whose models power workloads across Amazon Bedrock and the broader AWS AI stack. Your job is to build the marketing engine that takes global AI marketing strategy and helps these partners succeed on AWS in NAMER while helping AWS customers access their capabilities through joint messaging, campaigns, launches, and programs.

You will develop joint marketing plans (JMPs), orchestrate cross-functional activation across AWS field sales, product marketing, and partner development, and own pipeline and attribution metrics for your assigned partner portfolio in region. The right candidate combines deep marketing craft with enough AI/ML literacy to hold their own in technical product conversations, and enough commercial instinct to prioritize programs by revenue impact. This portfolio will evolve as the frontier AI landscape shifts - we need someone comfortable building structure in ambiguity while staying close to where the technology and customer demand is heading.

Key job responsibilities

Develop and execute North America joint marketing plans (JMPs) for assigned frontier model provider partners, aligned to AWS AI service priorities and customer adoption goals.
Define Industry marketing plans together with AI partners joint positioning that differentiates the partner's offering on AWS for priority industries.
Design, launch, and optimize multi-channel industry tailored campaigns (digital, events, content, ABM) that drive joint pipeline for both AWS and the partner.
Own Marketing Development Fund (MDF) planning and execution for your partner portfolio in close partnership with Global AI & SUP Partner Marketing team.
Coordinate partner presence at AWS flagship events (re:Invent, Summits, Builder Days) and partner-hosted events, advising on messaging, audience targeting, and customer engagement tactics through "precision programs"
Create partner activation playbooks and enablement assets (messaging guides, battle cards, solution briefs) that equip AWS field teams and partner sellers.
Serve as the primary marketing point-of-contact for assigned partners, building trusted relationships at senior marketing and executive levels within partner organizations.
Align closely with Partner Development Managers (PDMs), Solutions Architects, AWS Product Marketing, and Service GTM teams to ensure marketing programs reinforce co-sell plays and technical readiness in North America
Collaborate with global partner marketing teams to scale worldwide programs into local / North America execution while maintaining message consistency.
Set clear KPIs - partner-sourced pipeline, marketing-influenced revenue, MDF ROI, activation milestones - and report progress to leadership.
Track and report on pipeline contribution, campaign ROI, MDF utilization, and co-sell revenue; use data to continuously optimize partner marketing performance.
Prepare monthly business reviews (MBRs) and quarterly partner scorecards for leadership review.

A day in the life

You might start your morning reviewing AI Partner originated performance data for your partner portfolio, then jump into a strategy session with a partner's marketing team to align industry messaging ahead of a model launch on Bedrock. Later, you could be working with AWS ABM teams on an account-based play targeting enterprise customers evaluating foundation model providers or AI ISVs. You might wrap up by joining a cross-functional planning call for re:Invent partner activations - ensuring your partners have the right presence, the right story, and the right audience. No two days look the same, but every day centers on connecting partners with customers through compelling marketing that drives measurable business outcomes.

About The Team

The NAMER Partner Marketing team is within AWS global Partner Marketing. We are the marketing engine for AWS's most strategic AI relationships - spanning frontier model providers, AI software companies, building on AWS AI services.

Our team works at the intersection of partner innovation and AWS's most rapidly evolving service areas: AWS Bedrock, AgentCore, AWS SageMaker, Kiro and the broader generative AI stack. We work with category-defining companies - from the largest AI labs in the world to ISVs - building joint go-to-market programs that drive customer adoption and revenue.

We value marketers who combine strategic thinking with execution intensity, can navigate ambiguity in a fast-moving domain, and measure their success by the pipeline they create rather than the programs they run. This is a builder role in a builder team - you will be creating motions that do not yet exist.

Basic Qualifications

6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
Experience communicating results to senior leadership
Experience using Microsoft Excel to manipulate and analyze data

Preferred Qualifications

Experience creating and executing integrated marketing lead generation campaigns using tactics that include live or virtual events, webinars, email, lead nurture programs, and CRM/sales insights
Experience with Salesforce and Tableau
