jobs.title: Director of Marketing
jobs.description:
At Unity Environmental University, we value different perspectives, champion innovation, and create an environment where both employees and learners can excel. We are committed to fostering a workplace where talent and dedication drive success.

Job Overview

The Director of Marketing provides strategic and operational leadership for Unity Environmental University’s marketing efforts, translating institutional priorities into integrated campaigns that strengthen brand awareness and clearly communicate Unity’s distinctive value. Working across the University’s portfolio of online and in-person educational offerings as well as its Sustainable Ventures, the Director leads campaign planning and execution, digital marketing, content strategy, brand management, audience segmentation, and performance measurement. This position supervises marketing staff and external partners, manages budgets and project timelines, and collaborates closely with recruitment, academic, creative, and institutional leaders to ensure marketing initiatives are coordinated, audience-centered, data-informed, and aligned with the University’s mission and growth objectives.

This role is funded through Research and Development in order to create institutional bandwidth. It begins with a structured learning period of a minimum of three to six months in which the incumbent shadows and learns from the Chief Marketing Officer. Specific tasks and projects are assigned during that period. Following the learning period, the incumbent is assigned a portfolio, either at the Enterprise level or dedicated to a subsidiary or SEBU, based on institutional need. Any portfolio assigned remains within the scope of this role. The portfolio assignment and any reports are determined by the institution and are not fixed at the time of hire.

Position Specific Responsibilities And Expectations

Work with the CMO to develop and execute marketing strategies that strengthen the Unity Environmental University brand and support the growth and visibility of its individual colleges.
Establish clear positioning, value propositions, and audience strategies for each college while ensuring alignment with the University’s overarching identity.
Build greater awareness and understanding of Unity’s distinct educational models, academic offerings, mission, and competitive advantages.
Partner with college and University leaders to identify growth opportunities and develop marketing strategies that support their goals.
Lead institutional and college-level campaigns across digital advertising, web, email, social media, content, print, video, and other appropriate channels.
Direct the development of messaging and creative assets that clearly and consistently communicate the identity and value of the University and its colleges.
Use market research, competitive analysis, audience insights, and industry trends to guide brand positioning and marketing decisions.
Establish brand-awareness and campaign-performance measures, analyze results, and adjust strategies to improve reach, engagement, and impact.
Partner with the CMO on website strategy, search engine optimization, AI-search optimization, and digital-content initiatives that strengthen visibility and audience engagement.
Oversee institutional and college-level social media strategy, content planning, publishing standards, and performance measurement.
Maintain and enforce University brand standards across institutional, University, academic, and promotional materials.
Coordinate marketing support for new SEBUs, academic programs, partnerships, events, and other strategic University initiatives.
Work with the CMO on the development of video, photography, web, email, print, and social media assets.
Work with external agencies, consultants, media partners, and vendors to ensure work meets established expectations, timelines, budgets, and brand standards.
Establish effective workflows, project-management practices, and quality-control standards for marketing initiatives and deliverables.
Ensure marketing materials and practices comply with applicable accessibility, privacy, copyright, and institutional requirements.
Monitor emerging marketing technologies, artificial intelligence applications, digital platforms, and changes in audience behavior.
Lead assigned institutional initiatives and projects, including work that may extend beyond the position’s primary portfolio as organizational needs evolve.

UNITY ENVIRONMENTAL UNIVERSITY INSTITUTIONAL RESPONSIBLITIES:

Stay open to counterintuitive ideas and direct feedback. Unity employees are expected to think creatively and remain open to approaches that challenge initial instincts or traditional methods. Taking direction, seeking clarity, and executing with precision are critical to moving innovative work forward.
Work confidently with AI, digital tools, and emerging systems. As a technology-enabled institution, Unity expects all employees to adopt a growth mindset around digital tools. This includes using AI systems to enhance productivity and decision-making, as well as learning new platforms and processes with curiosity and accountability.
Deliver results in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Agility, resilience, and follow-through are essential. Employees must remain focused on outcomes even as priorities shift, iterating quickly and adjusting to change without losing momentum.
Communicate with clarity and consistency. Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability and willingness to engage professionally by phone, video, and digital channels is essential. Employees must document decisions, convey key information clearly, and support alignment across teams.
Model integrity and professionalism in all aspects of work. Every employee is responsible for upholding high ethical standards, demonstrating sound judgment, and maintaining an ownership mindset when it comes to their role and results.
Own the accuracy of your work. While Unity equips employees with advanced systems and AI-enhanced tools, the responsibility for quality, precision, and correctness rests with the individual. Attention to detail and proactive error-checking are non-negotiable.
Demonstrate a commitment to sustainability in all aspects of work. This includes responsible stewardship of resources, strategic decision-making, and ensuring long-term institutional impact.
At Unity, we encourage input, feedback, and collaboration from all employees, your perspective matters. However, once a decision has been made, employees are expected to act as an extension of their supervisor’s bandwidth, carrying out directives with clarity, consistency, and precision. We do not operate in independent silos; instead, we emphasize cross-functional collaboration and shared accountability.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

To be successful in this position you must be able to execute each of the position specific responsibilities while meeting the position expectations.

Additionally, the position specific education, skills and competencies listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability needed. Reasonable accommodations may be made upon approval by the supervisor and Human Resources, to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

POSITION SPECIFIC EDUCATION, SKILLS AND COMPENTCIES:

Required:

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field required; master’s degree preferred.
Seven or more years of progressively responsible marketing experience, including experience leading integrated campaigns and managing staff, vendors, or agency partners.
Experience in higher education, enrollment marketing, or another complex, multi-audience organization strongly preferred.
Direct experience supervising employees.
Demonstrated ability to develop and execute marketing strategies that support brand awareness, lead generation, and organizational growth.
Strong knowledge of digital marketing, including paid search, paid social, email marketing, content marketing, audience segmentation, retargeting, and conversion optimization.
Experience using CRM, marketing automation, analytics, and reporting platforms; familiarity with Salesforce and Marketing Cloud is preferred.
Working knowledge of search engine optimization, AI-driven search and discovery, and emerging applications of artificial intelligence in marketing.
Ability to interpret campaign and audience data, identify actionable insights, and clearly communicate results and recommendations to senior leaders.
Strong brand stewardship skills, with the ability to maintain consistency while adapting messaging for distinct programs, audiences, and delivery models.
Excellent writing, editing, presentation, and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex institutional information into clear, compelling, audience-focused messaging.
Demonstrated success managing multiple campaigns, priorities, budgets, and deadlines in a fast-moving environment.
Strong leadership and team-development skills, with the ability to establish clear expectations, provide constructive feedback, and foster accountability and collaboration.
Ability to build productive relationships across departments and influence outcomes without relying solely on direct authority.
Strategic and creative thinker who can connect long-term institutional goals with practical, measurable marketing execution.
Sound judgment, attention to detail, and a commitment to accuracy, accessibility, inclusion, and ethical marketing practices.
Adaptable and solutions-oriented, with the ability to respond effectively to changing priorities, emerging technologies, and evolving student expectations.
Commitment to Unity Environmental University’s mission and its focus on making education accessible, affordable, flexible, and relevant to the needs of today’s learners.

Work Schedule / Availability Requirements

Work hours are specific to the requirements of this position and can include days, evenings, and weekends as scheduled by their supervisor to best support students. Working extended hours required as needed. Must be flexible and cooperative in fulfilling responsibilities and meeting the Institution’s needs. Although Unity Environmental University employees are generally scheduled to work at their specifically assigned locations, there are times when travel is necessary, and employees are required from time to time to attend events, meetings, or work temporary assignments at any Unity Environmental University location.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

While performing the duties of this job, it is regularly required to sit and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand or walk. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 40 lbs. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. The use of either hand for repetitive movements such as grasping, grasping and turning, and fine manipulation is required as is the ability to use the telephone for internal and external communications.

ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS

Work is performed mostly in an office setting. The noise level in the work environment is normally moderate. Exposure to changes of temperature or humidity 1-33% of the time.

Dialpad is the AI platform for customer experience, built to resolve customer problems in real time across voice and digital. Our AI agents learn from your best human agents and improve with every interaction, helping organizations understand their customers, deliver better experiences, increase operational efficiencies, and build a lasting competitive advantage.

Market-leading brands, including Randstad, Motorola Solutions, Netflix, the San Diego Padres, the Colorado Rockies Baseball Club, and Cal Athletics, trust Dialpad. Dialpad is backed by Andreessen Horowitz, GV, ICONIQ Capital, and T-Mobile.

Being a Dialer

At Dialpad, AI isn’t just a feature; it’s how our teams do their best work every day. We put powerful AI tools in every employee’s hands so they can move faster, think bigger, and achieve more.

We believe every conversation matters. And we’ve built the platform that turns those conversations into insight and action, for our customers and ourselves.

The ISV & Strategic Alliances Sr. Partner Marketing Manager leads high-impact partner marketing programs that drive measurable pipeline and revenue growth through Dialpad's strategic technology and alliance partnerships. This role primarily supports the Google Cloud partnership globally and T-Mobile for Business nationally, while helping accelerate growth across Dialpad's broader ISV and Strategic Alliance ecosystem.

Develop strategic partner marketing programs and repeatable go-to-market plays, including Workspace-led displacement, enterprise voice, contact center, Google Cloud Marketplace, and other joint solution motions that drive partner engagement, pipeline, and revenue.
Build scalable co-marketing frameworks and best practices that strengthen partner activation, improve efficiency, and extend to additional ISV and Strategic Alliance partners as the business evolves.

Create scalable campaign assets and partner enablement resources, including joint value propositions, discovery guides, objection-handling content, and other seller-facing materials, in collaboration with cross-functional teams.

Develop customer advocacy programs featuring joint customer stories, strategic partner wins, and executive testimonials that strengthen credibility and support joint go-to-market efforts.

Establish KPIs and measurement frameworks to track marketing-sourced and influenced pipeline, partner engagement, campaign performance, and overall program impact.
Oversee partner-facing content and campaign development to ensure consistency, quality, and alignment with Dialpad's brand, product positioning, and joint partner messaging.

Experience in marketing with T-Mobile, telecommunications carriers, resellers, or comparable strategic partners is strongly preferred.
Strong experience developing partner pipeline growth strategies and executing integrated demand generation programs across channels, including partner seller activation, compliant seller incentives, executive and customer events, webinars, sponsorships, digital campaigns, and other tactics that engage partner sellers, account teams, and channel organizations.
Experience developing, managing, and optimizing MDF or partner marketing investments to maximize business impact and return on investment.
Ability to translate technical, cloud, AI, marketplace, and platform capabilities into clear customer and seller value propositions, including identifying relevant use cases, personas, industries, and joint solution opportunities.
Strong analytical and business acumen, with experience defining KPIs, measuring partner program performance, interpreting results, and using data to optimize programs.
Hands-on experience with Salesforce and marketing automation platforms, including campaign tracking, attribution, reporting, and performance measurement.
Strong project and program management skills, with the ability to manage multiple complex, high-priority partner initiatives simultaneously.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the executive presence and influence required to work effectively with senior internal stakeholders, sales leaders, and external partner executives.
Proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with a strong focus on continuous improvement, operational excellence, and measurable partner-led pipeline and revenue growth.

Plan and implement culturally relevant marketing, branding, communication, and outreach campaigns promoting Student Wellness Center services, events, and healthy behaviors
Coordinate outreach requests, communication schedules, event promotion, and educational initiatives with Student Wellness Center leadership and campus partners

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
Join Galaxy Desserts

Galaxy Desserts, also known as Brioche Pasquier | Galaxy Desserts, is part of the Brioche Pasquier family of bakers, based in France. What really sets us apart is that we do all the crafting, baking, freezing and packaging ourselves. We carry three families of products: (1) Brioche; (2) Croissants; (3) Frozen Desserts, all dedicated to excellence and quality for Retail and Food Service. Our products are either made in France or manufactured at our facility in Richmond, California. Intensely committed to quality, we try and source all of our ingredients from the best producers we can find. We endeavor to mitigate our environmental impact and support our community every day.

Our core values are based on RESPECT: Recognition, Executive, Simplicity, Passion, Equality, Closeness, and Transparency. They shape our company culture and guide our business strategy. They bring together our employees and are integrated in our everyday work practices.

Summary

We are seeking an organized, analytical, and creative Marketing Coordinator to support product strategy, product-development initiatives, and promotional programs for our retail and food-service product families. This role helps bring products to market by supporting brand positioning, product messaging, new-product launches, packaging development, merchandising recommendations, and customer- and consumer-facing marketing tools.

The Marketing Coordinator works closely with Marketing, Sales, Inside Sales, Research & Development, Quality Assurance, and other cross-functional teams to develop materials and programs that strengthen product visibility, support sales growth, and respond to customer and consumer needs. The successful candidate will analyze sales performance, market trends, customer insights, consumer preferences, and competitor activity to identify opportunities and make practical recommendations.

This is an on-site position based in Richmond, California, offering the opportunity to work directly with a growing food business across retail and food-service channels. The role is well suited for someone who enjoys managing multiple projects, working collaboratively, and combining analytical thinking with strong communication and marketing execution skills.

FLSA:
Full-Time; Regular | Nonexempt
Location:
Richmond, California
Department:
Marketing
Reports to:
Marketing Manager
Schedule:
Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., with flexible start times based on business and operational needs
Overtime:
Overtime may be required based on business needs and will be administered in accordance with applicable law
Work setting:
On-site role based in an office environment at an active food-manufacturing and packaging facility, with periodic work in operational areas and local and domestic travel for retail-store visits, customer meetings, tradeshows, demonstrations, consumer events, and other business activities

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
The duties below are considered essential functions of this position. This list is not exhaustive and may be revised to reflect legitimate business needs, consistent with applicable law.

Support the development and execution of product-family strategies for retail and food-service products, including brand positioning, messaging, and recommendations that address customer and consumer needs.
Support planning and execution of new-product launches, including coordination of product specifications with industrial and cross-functional teams and development of customer- and consumer-facing promotional plans.
Coordinate packaging-development activities with internal stakeholders and external creative partners, including partners located outside the United States, as applicable.
Develop, update, and maintain product-information decks, presentations, and other product-support materials that communicate product features, positioning, and value propositions to internal and external audiences.
Support Sales Managers and other internal stakeholders with product knowledge, positioning, value propositions, and training materials to strengthen selling efforts.
Develop and maintain promotional and sales-support tools for buyers, customers, and consumers, including brand catalogs, product-demonstration tools, in-store point-of-sale materials, off-premise collateral, and other marketing materials.
Develop merchandising recommendations, including shelf-staging and brand-blocking recommendations, to improve product visibility and consumer reach.
Analyze sales reports, market data, product performance, and consumption trends; identify insights and make recommendations related to product launches, promotional plans, visibility, and sales growth.
Collect, organize, and analyze customer, consumer, and competitor information; monitor competitor products, marketing methods, and market positioning; and provide recommendations based on findings.
Visit stores and collaborate with Sales Managers and Inside Sales Associates to build knowledge of customers, purchasing practices, buying criteria, market needs, and product-placement opportunities.
Support planning, preparation, coordination, and execution of tradeshows, in-store demonstrations, consumer events, and other assigned promotional activities.
Partner effectively with Marketing, Sales, Inside Sales, R&D, QA, and other departments to support product-development and marketing initiatives.
Prepare accurate reports, presentations, analyses, product materials, and other assigned documentation; maintain organized electronic and physical marketing files, product information, project materials, and records.
Follow all Company policies, safety procedures, food-safety requirements, Good Manufacturing Practices (“GMPs”), and applicable site rules when working in Company facilities or attending Company-sponsored events.
Perform other related marketing, product-development, promotional, and administrative duties as assigned by the Marketing Manager or other authorized management personnel

Required Qualifications

Associate’s degree, bachelor’s degree, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience in marketing, product management, project management, business, or a related field is preferred.
Knowledge of U.S. consumers and the U.S. food market, including retail and food-service channels.
Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills, including the ability to communicate persuasively and professionally with internal stakeholders, customers, and external partners.
Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Ability to interpret sales reports, market data, product-performance information, and consumer or customer trends and translate findings into practical recommendations.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office 365 applications, including Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, deadlines, and cross-functional requests in an organized and timely manner.
Ability to work independently after receiving direction and to work cooperatively in a team and cross-functional environment.
Ability to maintain professional, effective, and respectful working relationships with employees, customers, vendors, and other business partners.
Valid driver’s license and proof of automobile insurance, with the ability to travel locally to visit stores and attend events as required.
Ability to work the assigned schedule, including flexibility for occasional overtime, travel, tradeshows, in-store demonstrations, consumer events, or other business needs, as applicable.

Preferred Qualifications

Three or more years of experience in product marketing, product management, brand management, or related marketing functions, preferably in the food, CPG, retail, and/or food-service industry.
Direct experience in product management, product marketing, marketing, brand management, or project management in a retail and/or food-service environment.
Experience in the food, bakery, dessert, frozen-food, consumer packaged goods (“CPG”), retail, or food-service industry.
Experience supporting new-product development, product launches, packaging development, brand positioning, merchandising, promotional planning, or sales enablement.
Experience analyzing market data, sales data, customer insights, consumer trends, or competitor activity.
Experience developing product presentations, product-information decks, catalogs, point-of-sale materials, sales-support tools, or marketing collateral.
Knowledge of design software is a plus.

Compensation and Benefits

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, AI Security
jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

Job Summary

Your Career

As a Senior Product Marketing Manager focused on AI Security, you will define how the market understands and adopts security for the next generation of AI systems. AI is no longer just generating content, it is making decisions and taking action. As enterprises move from AI assistance to AI autonomy, the risk shifts from what AI says to what AI does. Your role will be instrumental in shaping how organizations secure this transition. You will drive messaging and marketing strategy across critical layers of AI systems, including models, artifacts, access and control layers, and agentic execution helping customers safely deploy AI at scale. In this role, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including product management, sales, PR, social, and field marketing, across multiple business units to craft and execute narratives that resonate with both technical practitioners and business leaders. You will bring a systems-level understanding of AI technologies, the cybersecurity landscape, and real-world enterprise challenges – transforming complex architectures into clear, differentiated, and high-impact stories that drive adoption and market leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Define the Core Narrative – Lead the creation of foundational messaging and positioning for AI security across models, access layers, and autonomous execution. Reframe how the market understands risk – from static models to dynamic, acting systems.
Shape an Emerging Category – Help establish the category for securing autonomous and agentic AI systems. Identify gaps in industry thinking and introduce new frameworks that influence customers, analysts, and internal teams.
Drive High-Visibility Launches – Own and orchestrate high-profile launches that unify multiple capabilities into a cohesive story. Create moments that move the market—not just announce features.
Translate Complexity into Clarity – Turn complex AI system architectures into simple, compelling narratives that resonate across audiences, from CxOs to hands-on practitioners, without losing technical depth.
Lead Integrated Marketing Strategies – Define and execute marketing strategies for launches and campaigns, aligning cross-functional teams to drive adoption, pipeline, and measurable business outcomes.
Operationalize Vision into Execution – Partner deeply with product, sales, and field teams to translate strategy into scalable assets, enablement, and real-world impact.
Act as a Trusted Voice in the Market – Represent Palo Alto Networks with customers, partners, analysts, and industry influencers through events, thought leadership, and executive engagements—reinforcing leadership in AI security.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

8+ years of professional experience in Product Marketing or Technical Product Marketing.
Deep domain knowledge with a proven track record in at least one of the following: Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Cloud Computing, or Developer Programs.
Proven ability to translate complex technical systems into clear, differentiated, and value-driven narratives for both technical and business audiences.
Demonstrated track record of driving high-impact product launches and market adoption in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.
Strong systems thinking with the ability to connect product capabilities to broader workflows, architectures, and customer outcomes.
Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to engage executive leadership, technical teams, and customers.
Proven ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, operating effectively from concept through delivery.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degrees or certifications in AI, cybersecurity, or related fields.
Deep understanding of modern AI systems and architectures, including how models, agents, tools, and data interact, and where risk emerges across that lifecycle.
Exceptional ability to lead and execute across complex, cross-functional environments, aligning diverse stakeholders to deliver cohesive outcomes.
Experience shaping or contributing to category-level narratives or market positioning, not just product-level messaging.

Compensation Disclosure

The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non-sales roles) or base salary + commission target (for sales/com-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here.

$155,000.00 - $252,000.00/yr

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

jobs.description:
Position Summary

Samsung Ads is an advanced advertising platform that leverages Samsung’s massive first-party TV data to help brands connect with audiences across all screens. With over 200 million Samsung Smart TVs worldwide, we provide advertisers with unparalleled reach and insights into TV viewership. We are at the forefront of the connected TV revolution, delivering advertising solutions that are intelligent, innovative, and effective.

At Samsung Ads, we're redefining the future of digital advertising by connecting brands with audiences in innovative ways. As a global leader in technology and innovation, we're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to lead our efforts in North America and beyond, shaping the future of our ads product marketing strategy for Samsung.

Role And Responsibilities

We're looking for a highly motivated (Senior) Product Marketing Manager to join our Samsung Ads Product Marketing team. This B2B-focused role is responsible for developing, designing, and executing on the Samsung Ads Product Marketing portfolio, including offerings related to new ad formats, new targeting types, new data partnerships, and more as it pertains to upper funnel video products (e.g., reach, awareness, audiences) within Samsung TV+.

This leader will be responsible for working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Sales, and GTM partners to translate Samsung Ads’ goals into actionable, sellable solutions for Samsung Ads Sellers and Agency teams. The role requires strong product marketing ownership of solutions while also working closely with partner teams throughout the product development lifecycle (e.g. Product Managers in development; Monetization and FPA for roll-out and lead lists; Sales L&D and PMO for product adoption tracking and training).

This senior individual contributor role will play a key part in the continued success of Samsung Ads.This lead will work regularly to package incoming product ideas from Samsung to drive well-tested, well-monetized, and well-adapted success for Samsung’s B2B clients, agencies, and industry partners. This role reports into the Senior Director of Product Marketing, which is part of the Commercialization team.

The goal of this role, over time, is to make Samsung Upper Funnel Video solutions a must-buy partner to top brands and agencies. A secondary goal is to simplify, streamline, and better define Samsung’s go-to-market strategy in partnership while delivering industry-leading solutions.

What You'll Do:

Lead B2B Product Marketing for Samsung Upper Funnel video products - Serve as the primary point of contact for Product Marketing for select Samsung upper funnel video products, working closely with cross functional teams to bring these offerings from launch into successful, always-on, must-buy offerings.
Develop and Execute Strong Go-To-Market that Drives B2B Samsung Upper Funnel Solutions Adoption - Refine and accelerate the team’s overall go-to-market product strategy from conception to launch to recurring buys.
Understand the Customer and What it Takes to Win - Capture the voice of the customer by analyzing advertiser needs, pain points, demands, and market trends, and translating those insights into prioritized product and GTM strategies to accelerate sales.
Package New and Existing Offerings that Meet Customer Business Objectives - Take new, complex products and distill them into easy-to-understand offerings for client audiences, working with partner teams to refine product market fit.
Build and Refine Value Propositions - Create clear, compelling narratives for each Samsung Upper Funnel offering/content, bringing industry and market intelligence into the mix.
Define the Samsung Product Arc - Work with Product, Engineering, GTM, and Insights to build clear ‘sales ready’ turnkey programs, including cases, claims, and benchmarks that inspire confidence in sellers and adoption from clients.
Partner Cross-Functionally - Work daily with Product Managers, Product Strategy, Marketing and Sales to bring offerings to life. Regularly to go top-to-top and bring an informed recommendation on offering steer and deployment.

Required Qualifications:

CTV/Media/Advertising Product Marketing Expertise: 8+ years of experience in leading advertising-related product marketing programs, the majority of which have been spent driving leading product marketing programs in media, programmatic, sponsorship, and/or technology-related ad sales.
Strong Upper Funnel Video knowledge: At least 5+ years of experience in upper funnel video solution building, including deep knowledge in reach, awareness, roadblocks, and audiences. Strong familiarity with client expectations and outcomes, as well as industry standard pricing and bundling concepts.
Product Marketing Lifecycle Ownership: Experience in leading the full lifecycle of B2B, ads, or content product marketing development, from early-stage Product Manager / BD partnership to alpha/beta to general availability, partnering with cross-functional teams as needed.
Proven Track Record of Successful Product Launches: Successfully developed, launched, and deployed new products, and accelerated adoption of existing products, especially within the CTV, programmatic, sponsorship, or advertising space.
Outstanding cross-functional collaboration: Particularly with Product, Engineering, Product, L&D, Monetization, and Sales teams.
Quantitative and GTM Familiarity: Proficiency in data analysis, basic 3rd party market research, and crafting product arc narratives.
Bachelor’s degree in a related field (product, marketing, business, media, etc)

Preferred Qualifications:

Strong Market Landscape Knowledge: Direct experience at or with leading media, CTV/OTT advertising platforms, or related programmatic platforms (e.g. Meta, Netflix, Google, Amazon, Apple, Pinterest, Disney, Roku, etc)
Familiarity with Samsung Ads products: Including but not limited to programmatic and direct offerings, device capabilities, and Samsung TV+ upper funnel offerings
Data-driven: Use data and metrics regularly to understand product adoption, quantify product feedback and performance, and overall commercial impact
Excellent Communication: Strong written and verbal communication, as well as persuasive presentation skills
Strong Operator: Exceptionally organized and operationally-focused

Additional Information:

Travel: This role may require occasional domestic or international travel (up to 15%) for internal and external meetings.

Skills And Qualifications

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About The Role

Proving the return on AI spend is one of the biggest business transformations in tech history, and CloudZero has repositioned the entire company to solve it. The catch is that nearly every vendor now claims to do the same thing, so differentiation is our top marketing priority for the next 18 months, and it's what decides whether a buyer picks us or someone who just sounds like us. We're adding this role to go all-in on differentiation, and to add more firepower to everything the PMM team already does today.

The Senior Product Marketing Manager will own and drive continuous progress on the core messaging and differentiation of our platform. You'll make it clear and undeniable why CloudZero is the right choice for a buyer with a specific problem, translate a technical product into the "so what" for finance and executive buyers, and build on our market research and competitive intelligence to stay ahead as the field gets more crowded.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role that supplements our existing team. We're looking for an exceptional marketer who can own the positioning of a category while it's still being defined, and who'd rather develop and continuously sharpen the story than wait for someone to hand it over.

What You'll Do

Messaging & differentiation

Own the core messaging and differentiation of our platform, the clear and undeniable reason a buyer with a specific problem should choose CloudZero over every other vendor claiming AI ROI
Translate what product and engineering build into clear buyer value for finance and executive audiences, simple enough that a rep in their first month can tell the story with confidence
Work across product and engineering, demand generation, and sales enablement to keep messaging consistent across our core content assets

Competitive intelligence & market research

Own competitive intelligence by tracking the field, arming sales with battlecards and objection handling, and sharpening our positioning against every alternative.
Run market and buyer research to keep our messaging matched to where the industry and the buyer are heading
Stay ahead of other vendors in an increasingly crowded market, and feed those insights back into our positioning and roadmap decisions

Cross-functional enablement & funnel support

Support product launches and make sure new capabilities land in our core positioning, backed by strong proof points and real customer examples
Work alongside content and demand generation to feed the top of the funnel with differentiated stories that create demand, not just capture it
Partner with sales engineering to define the capabilities and narratives that make every demo prove the CloudZero difference and move buyers to a proof of value

What We're Looking For

5-8 years in product marketing for a technical B2B product, ideally at a startup or in a fast-moving category
A track record of sharp messaging and differentiation in a crowded or emerging market
Proven ability to translate complex, technical products into clear buyer value; you can make even a junior rep sound credible
Proven experience and expertise in running market research and competitive intelligence programs
Experience marketing to finance and technical executives (CFOs, CTOs, or AI and business-transformation leaders) and their teams, ideally from a B2B tech or fintech company; a security or other technical, skeptical-audience background is a plus
Genuine curiosity: you want to be in the product, talking to customers, and learning what your audience actually cares about, without being asked (a journalistic or reporting background is a plus)
The judgment to pull context from many sources, extract what matters, and run with it, rather than waiting to be handed the answer
An AI-first operator who uses tools like Claude to move faster, learn a domain quickly, and scale your own output

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

CloudZero wins new logos when a buyer can say, in one sentence, why us and not the alternatives. This role owns that sentence and the proof behind it. You'll set the messaging, sharpen the differentiation, and give sales and content the story that turns a crowded, skeptical market into pipeline. We hire for the exceptional version of this role: curious, decisive, high-bar, low-ego, with the room to own it.

About CloudZero

CloudZero is the AI ROI Company. We built the financial control plane for AI: the system finance, IT, and engineering use to connect every AI dollar to the outcome it produced. Across every provider. In real time.

AI spend is the fastest-growing line on enterprise P&Ls and the least understood. Only 14% of CFOs can prove AI ROI today. CloudZero answers the question no one else can: what did it cost to produce this outcome, for this customer, on this model.

The largest cloud spenders on the planet already run on CloudZero, including Coinbase, Duolingo, DoorDash, and Shutterstock. We processed 14 trillion billing events in the last twelve months. We're the first listed partner on Anthropic's cost and usage API. We've raised over $119 million, including a $56 million Series C backed by leading venture capital firms.

Why Join Our Team?

At CloudZero, you’ll find a collaborative, fast-moving environment where your work makes a direct impact. We’re a team that values ownership, creativity, and curiosity — and we’re tackling some of the most complex challenges in the cloud space. If you’re excited by working with cutting-edge technology, driving meaningful outcomes, and growing with a company that’s scaling fast, we’d love to hear from you!

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

Your Team, Your Impact

Marvell's Global Marketing organization mission is to accelerate Marvell’s growth by delivering impactful outcomes and services that elevate our brand, captivate our target audiences, and exceed stakeholder expectations. The organization encompasses communications, digital, events, social, analyst relations, marketing research, and portfolio marketing. We collaborate closely with Marvell's business units, investor relations, finance, HR, and executive staff to ensure our messaging and positioning resonate effectively with diverse global audiences.

What You Can Expect

The Sr. Director, Product & Technology Marketing for the Custom Cloud Solutions Business will own the outbound marketing strategy for Marvell's custom silicon portfolio — including custom XPUs, XPU attach solutions, and the broader platform of IP, advanced packaging, and co-design capabilities that Marvell brings to hyperscaler partnerships. This is one of the most strategically complex marketing roles at Marvell: the business is built on deep, confidential co-development partnerships with the world's largest cloud operators, which means the marketer must be skilled at building Marvell's market leadership narrative and driving industry awareness without disclosing customer-specific program details. The ideal candidate understands how to create compelling outbound marketing in a space where the most important proof points are often under NDA — and can translate Marvell's platform differentiation across advanced SerDes, custom HBM, die-to-die interconnects, silicon photonics, and advanced packaging into credible, market-facing thought leadership.

Product Marketing & Outbound Strategy

Own the full outbound marketing strategy for Marvell's custom silicon portfolio — including custom XPUs, XPU attach solutions (NICs, CXL controllers, PCIe retimers, co-processors), and the advanced technology platform that enables Marvell's hyperscaler co-design partnerships — building Marvell's market leadership narrative while navigating the unique challenge of driving awareness in a business defined by confidential customer relationships.
Define and maintain differentiated value propositions and messaging hierarchies for each portfolio segment; ensure consistent, compelling communication of Marvell's competitive advantages to external audiences.
Lead product launch planning and execution, driving cross-functional readiness across sales, PR, analyst relations, digital, and events to maximize market impact at launch.
Develop competitive response playbooks and sales enablement content — including pitch decks, solution briefs, battle cards, and objection-handling guides — that equip customer-facing teams to win.
Partner with product management and engineering teams to deeply understand technology roadmaps; translate product capabilities into external marketing strategies, not internal product plans.

Technology Marketing & Thought Leadership

Build and execute a technology marketing strategy that establishes Marvell as the recognized leader in custom cloud silicon — spanning custom XPUs, XPU attach, and the advanced IP platform that enables next-generation AI accelerators — translating deep technical differentiation into market-defining narratives that build Marvell's leadership position with hyperscalers, emerging cloud operators, and the broader AI infrastructure ecosystem, while respecting the confidentiality requirements inherent to co-design partnerships.
Create a pipeline of compelling thought leadership assets including white papers, solution briefs, executive presentations, keynote narratives, and technical blogs that translate silicon-level innovation into customer and industry impact.
Partner with executive and product leadership to develop and sharpen Marvell's technology narrative for major industry forums, analyst briefings, customer events, and investor communications.
Act as a senior voice of the market — tracking industry trends, competitive dynamics, and customer requirements to continuously sharpen Marvell's positioning.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Organizational Influence

Serve as the primary outbound marketing partner to product line executives and product management teams — translating roadmap inputs into external marketing strategies, audience narratives, and campaign execution.
Collaborate across marketing functions — corporate, digital, events, AR/PR, and content — to ensure portfolio messaging is consistently amplified across all channels and touchpoints.
Establish shared messaging frameworks, launch standards, and audience segmentation playbooks that scale across Marvell's business units and marketing organization.
Represent the marketing function in senior leadership forums, ensuring outbound marketing strategy and investment priorities are informed by market insight and tied to business outcomes.

What We're Looking For

BS degree required; a degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline is highly preferred. MBA or MS in a business or quantitative discipline valued in addition to an engineering foundation.
15+ years of progressive experience in outbound product marketing or technology marketing within the semiconductor, systems, or AI infrastructure industry — candidates with pure product management backgrounds will not be considered.
Deep expertise in custom silicon and AI accelerator markets — including custom ASIC/XPU design, XPU attach solutions, and hyperscaler infrastructure — with demonstrated understanding of the hyperscaler buyer landscape, co-design partnership dynamics, and the competitive and technology trends shaping next-generation custom AI compute.
Demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi-product outbound marketing programs — from audience strategy and positioning through campaign execution — with measurable business results.
Exceptional ability to synthesize highly technical concepts into external audience narratives, customer value stories, and industry thought leadership that drives awareness and preference.
Proven experience developing and activating marketing content across the full outbound mix: executive presentations, white papers, solution briefs, digital campaigns, event activations, and media/analyst engagement.
Strong cross-functional influence skills — able to collaborate effectively with product management without conflating the two disciplines; clear understanding of where marketing responsibility begins and ends.
Strong executive presence and communication skills — confident presenting to partners, at industry conferences, and in internal leadership settings.
Experience building and leading teams; strong track record recruiting, developing, and retaining top marketing talent.

Preferred

Experience working with or marketing to hyperscalers and cloud service providers in the context of custom silicon co-design programs — with a demonstrated ability to build compelling outbound narratives while navigating customer confidentiality requirements.
Familiarity with custom ASIC program dynamics, advanced packaging technologies (2.5D/3D, RDL interposers), and the multi-generational partnership models that define hyperscaler custom silicon engagements.
Track record of building or scaling a product marketing function; prior people management experience a strong plus.
Track record of building or scaling a product marketing function in a business where key proof points are under NDA; experience developing credible thought leadership in a confidential co-development environment strongly preferred.

About WellnessLiving

WellnessLiving is a business management software platform that helps health, wellness, and beauty businesses across North America grow and thrive. We help studios, gyms, spas, and salons run their business, connect with their clients, and get more done. AI is a big part of how we work, and our marketing team is leading the way.

About The Role

We're looking for a creative, curious person who loves working with AI. In this role, you'll use AI tools like Claude to create marketing content and build marketing automations for the WellnessLiving brand. You'll spend most of your day working side by side with AI. You'll tell it what to do, check its work, make it better, and turn great ideas into real results.

This isn't a coding job. It's a job for someone who can think clearly, write well, and knows a great piece of marketing when they see it.

What You'll Do

Build and manage automated email and SMS campaigns that reach the right people at the right time
Use AI to create engaging social media posts for WellnessLiving
Use AI to write and improve website pages and blog posts
Write clear instructions (prompts) that help AI create high quality work
Review everything AI creates and make sure it's on brand, accurate, and ready to go
Follow step by step guidance from AI tools to set up and test new workflows
Work closely with the marketing team to turn ideas into finished campaigns
Keep testing and learning new ways to use AI to save time and get better results

What Will Make You Successful

We believe these five qualities matter most in this role:

You're creative. You bring fresh ideas and you're not afraid to try new things.
You know what good looks like. You can spot strong writing and design, and you can tell when something isn't quite right yet.
You can instruct AI well. You give clear, detailed directions and you know how to get the best out of AI tools.
You ask great questions. You dig in to understand the goal before you start, and you're not shy about asking for help.
You can follow instructions and stay patient. AI often guides you step by step. You follow along carefully, and you stay calm and keep going when something takes a few tries to get right.

What You Bring

2+ years of experience in marketing, content, or communications
Excellent writing skills. You can write in a clear, friendly, and engaging way.
Hands on experience using AI tools in your work
Experience with email, SMS, social media, or website content
Strong attention to detail
Comfort learning new software quickly
Bonus: experience in the health, wellness, or beauty industry

This Role Might Not Be For You If

You'd rather do everything yourself than work with AI
You get frustrated when something takes a few tries to get right
You prefer to be told exactly what to do instead of asking questions and figuring things out
You're happy with "good enough" instead of excellent

What We Offer

Health benefits
A hybrid schedule with 3 days a week in our Delray Beach office
A chance to be at the front of how AI is changing marketing
A supportive team that loves to learn and try new things

How To Apply

Send us your resume along with a short AI task:

Use AI to create a 5-email drip campaign aimed at yoga studio owners, inviting them to book a demo of WellnessLiving software. Along with the 5 emails, share your first prompt and every follow-up prompt you used to build and improve the sequence.

We want to see how you think, how you guide AI, and how you make the final result excellent. We can't wait to see what you create!

Please note that only those selected for an interview will be contacted. 

We appreciate you taking the time and look forward to reviewing your application!

Overview

Azure Customer Success Marketing
helps customers get more value from the cloud investment they have already made. Our team owns the authoritative guidance Microsoft publishes for building and running on Azure, including the Cloud Adoption Framework, the Well-Architected Framework, and the Azure Architecture Center, along with the programs that put that guidance in front of the engineers and architects who need it.

We are looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager
to own how that guidance reaches its audience. You will build the layer that sits above the source material: the ebooks, technical papers, blogs, and video programming that take guidance spread across dozens of articles and turn it into something a practitioner can follow end to end. You will also host and produce our flagship Azure technical video series, a catalog of more than 220 episodes reaching developers, IT decision makers, and business decision makers. This role asks you to be genuinely technical and genuinely a marketer. You will write deep technical content yourself, working alongside subject matter experts rather than briefing them from a distance, and you will hold your own in architecture conversations with cloud solution architects, product teams, and engineering leaders. You will also own the campaign mechanics that carry the work: channel strategy, integrated marketing, measurement, and the vendor and production partners who help you scale. The portfolio is active and growing. A multi-part technical masterclass series is in production, the video show is moving to a fully produced format, and in-product and agent-driven guidance experiences are being built with engineering. You will inherit momentum and be expected to shape where it goes next.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

Own the marketing strategy for Microsoft's authoritative Azure guidance, turning framework content into material that engineers and architects can act on.
Write and co-author long-form technical content, including ebooks, technical papers, blogs, and narrative overviews that sit above the source documentation.

Land guidance through integrated marketing, customer success teams, technical workshops, and partner channels.

Manage lifecycle communications for published guidance, including deprecation, end-of-life, and archive notices.
Coordinate messaging with adjacent product marketing teams so guidance stays consistent across the portfolio.
Brief and prepare the speakers who represent this guidance externally.
Define and track the measurement plan for the portfolio: video and livestream performance, content engagement, downstream service referrals, partner actions, and product usage signals.

Qualifications

Required/minimum qualifications

Master's Degree in in Marketing, Communications, Computer Science, Engineering, Business or related field AND 3+ years experience in technical product marketing, developer marketing, technical content, or a related discipline
OR Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Communications, Computer Science, Engineering, Business or related field AND 5+ years experience in technical product marketing, developer marketing, technical content, or a related discipline
OR equivalent experience.

OR Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Communications, Computer Science, Engineering, Business or related field AND 8+ years experience in technical product marketing, developer marketing, technical content, or a related discipline

Experience presenting technical content on camera or on stage, such as a video series, livestream, conference session, or webinar.
Hands-on familiarity with cloud architecture and the practice of designing, deploying, and operating workloads on a major cloud platform.
Hands-on familiarity with Microsoft Azure and its published guidance, including the Cloud Adoption Framework, the Well-Architected Framework, and the Azure Architecture Center.
Working knowledge of building and operating AI agents in production, including landing zone design, agent operations, security and observability, and cost management.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Renesas is seeking an AI Search & SEO Specialist
to help improve how engineers discover, evaluate, and engage with Renesas content across AI-powered answer engines, traditional organic search, and onsite search experiences.

In this role, you’ll report to the Manager, Content Strategy & AI Visibility and work closely with content, web, product, technical, and analytics teams to monitor performance, identify trends, surface opportunities, and recommend improvements across Renesas.com. You’ll help shape how we evaluate search performance across both traditional and AI-driven environments, by identifying optimization opportunities that improve visibility and discoverability for our products and solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Improve how Renesas appears in AI-generated answers and emerging search experiences by identifying trends, opportunities, and areas for optimization across content.
Establish and socialize AI search, generative engine optimization (GEO) and SEO best practices, enabling content owners, marketers, web producers, developers, and regional teams to create content that is accurate, discoverable, structured, and aligned with how customers search and evaluate.
Build and maintain recurring reporting for search visibility, traffic, engagement, and conversion performance using tools such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, SEMrush, Conductor, onsite search analytics, and emerging AI visibility platforms.
Analyze onsite search behavior to identify customer intent, content gaps, terminology mismatches, and relevance issues, then partner with product and web teams to improve search experiences through tuning, taxonomy, synonyms, facets, rules, and AI-informed content recommendations.
Work closely with the technical web team to identify and prioritize technical improvements that help search engines and AI systems better interpret, index, and surface Renesas content.
Support business reviews and stakeholder presentations by preparing performance summaries, visualizations, and insight narratives.
Stay current on search and digital marketing trends to help inform future optimization opportunities, reporting needs, and measurement approaches.

Qualifications

3+ years of experience in SEO, search analytics, content optimization, or digital search strategy, including experience identifying opportunities to improve visibility across organic search, AI-search/GEO.
Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, computer science, data analytics, engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience using tools such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, Bing Webmaster Tools, Baidu Webmaster Tools, Conductor, Profound, onsite search analytics, or comparable platforms.
Passion for understanding how LLMs and answer engines discover, evaluate, and cite content, and how AI-powered search is changing brand visibility and content performance.
Experience with onsite search platforms or relevance-tuning concepts such as synonyms, rules, boosts, facets, filters, query behavior, and search result optimization.
Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, CMS platforms, and how web development decisions impact search visibility and user experience.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to evaluate search visibility, rankings, traffic, engagement, conversions, content performance, SERP features, prompt behavior, competitor activity, and AI visibility signals, then translate findings into clear insights, prioritized recommendations, and measurable optimization plans.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate search opportunities into actionable recommendations for content, engineering, product, analytics, and marketing teams.
Experience in the semiconductor industry is a plus.

Additional Information

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier
. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

Are you ready to join our team and shape the future
with us?

jobs.title: Part-Time Marketing Strategist & Growth Partner
jobs.description:
Part-Time Marketing Strategist & Growth Partner

Company: The Blue Sock
Location: Remote
Employment Type: Independent Contractor
Engagement: Part-time, ongoing

About The Blue Sock

The Blue Sock is an early-stage, Southern California-based boutique dog-sitting marketplace connecting pet parents with a curated community of experienced, independent sitters.

Unlike traditional pet-sitting marketplaces, we emphasize quality, transparency, and personalized care. Our platform helps pet parents discover and compare sitters based on their care styles, home environments, specialties, and unique experiences.

We’ve successfully launched our website and app, established a growing customer base, and are generating bookings and repeat business.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we’re seeking an experienced marketing professional to help us develop a sustainable, data-driven marketing strategy.

About the Opportunity

We’re looking for a part-time Marketing Strategist & Growth Partner who can evaluate our current marketing efforts, identify opportunities for improvement, and develop a clear, actionable growth roadmap.

This is a strategic and hands-on consulting opportunity designed for someone who enjoys working directly with founders and helping early-stage businesses grow.

Our philosophy is simple: Identify the highest-impact opportunities, execute one priority at a time, measure results, and build on what’s working.

We’re not looking to implement every marketing initiative simultaneously. We want to make thoughtful investments that deliver measurable business value while staying within our available resources.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct an initial assessment of our existing marketing strategy, acquisition channels, website, customer journey, and competitive positioning.
* Develop a prioritized marketing roadmap with actionable recommendations, measurable goals, and clear deliverables.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer acquisition, booking conversion rates, customer retention, and revenue growth.
* Evaluate geographic marketing opportunities as our two-sided marketplace expands.
* Review our existing Google Ads strategy and collaborate with our advertising specialist on potential improvements.
* Recommend and help implement focused marketing initiatives, one priority at a time.
* Establish meaningful performance metrics and evaluate results to guide future priorities.
* Collaborate directly with our founder to refine the strategy as our business evolves.

Potential initiatives may include conversion rate optimization, SEO, local marketing, customer retention campaigns, email marketing, referral programs, brand positioning, and paid advertising strategy.

The exact priorities will be determined through the initial assessment.

Ideal Candidate

We’re looking for someone who brings both strategic thinking and practical execution experience.

Preferred qualifications:

* Proven experience developing and executing growth strategies for startups or early-stage businesses.
* Experience with online marketplaces, two-sided platforms, booking platforms, or consumer-facing service businesses.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing, customer acquisition, conversion optimization, and retention.
* Ability to analyze marketing performance and connect recommendations to measurable business outcomes.
* Experience developing actionable growth roadmaps and prioritizing initiatives based on expected impact, cost, and effort.
* Comfortable providing hands-on execution rather than exclusively strategic recommendations.
* Resourceful, proactive, and comfortable working within a modest startup budget.
* Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach to working directly with founders.

Experience in the pet care industry is welcome but not required.

How We’ll Work Together

Our initial engagement will focus on understanding the business, evaluating existing marketing efforts, and identifying the highest-value growth opportunities.

From there, we’ll work collaboratively on a prioritized roadmap.

Rather than tackling numerous initiatives simultaneously, we’ll select a manageable priority, agree on the deliverables, implement improvements, evaluate the results, and determine our next steps.

We currently have a dedicated Google Ads specialist managing day-to-day campaign activity. We welcome strategic oversight and recommendations, but we’re not necessarily looking to duplicate existing campaign management responsibilities.

Our goal is to develop a long-term partnership with someone who can grow alongside the business.

Compensation & Engagement

* Starting monthly consulting budget: $800
* Part-time, remote, independent contractor engagement.
* Limited monthly scope with mutually agreed deliverables.
* Flexible working arrangement focused on outcomes rather than a traditional employment schedule.
* Opportunity for increased compensation and expanded responsibilities as the business grows.

Our $800 monthly budget is a starting point, reflecting our current stage as an early-stage marketplace.

We’re looking to build a long-term relationship with a marketing professional whose work contributes to measurable improvements in customer acquisition, booking conversions, retention, and platform revenue.

As our business grows and marketing initiatives demonstrate a positive impact, our intention is to reinvest in marketing and gradually increase the budget and scope of the engagement.

Future increases will depend on demonstrated results, sustainable business growth, and available resources rather than a predetermined timeline.

We recognize that some marketing initiatives take time to deliver measurable financial returns, and we value thoughtful strategy, effective execution, and consistent progress.

Individual Consultants Only

We’re a small team and prefer to collaborate directly with one dedicated marketing professional.

We are not seeking marketing agencies, outsourced teams, or arrangements where work is routinely delegated to other individuals.

We value direct communication, continuity, accountability, and a partner who takes the time to understand our business.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role isn’t measured solely by website traffic, impressions, or social media engagement.

We’re focused on meaningful business outcomes, including improved booking conversion rates, more qualified customer acquisition, stronger retention, and sustainable growth in platform revenue.

We’re seeking someone who can help us make informed marketing decisions and gradually build a stronger foundation for long-term growth.

If you enjoy partnering with early-stage companies, identifying practical growth opportunities, and turning strategy into measurable results, we’d love to hear from you.

Samsung Electronics America (SEA) is a leader in mobile technologies, consumer electronics, home appliances, enterprise solutions and networks systems. Across each of these areas, our work drives innovation, economic growth and workforce opportunity in the United States.

For nearly five decades, Samsung has been at the forefront of technological advancements, investing over $100 billion and creating more than 20,000 jobs nationwide. Our mission? To integrate cutting-edge products, services, and AI technology to deliver smarter, sustainable, and more connected experiences that empower people to live better.

As a wholly owned subsidiary of Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd., SEA offers opportunities to work alongside global visionary thinkers and innovators who are passionate about making a difference. Explore the exciting opportunities at Samsung Electronics America and discover how you can make an impact.

To learn more, visit Samsung.com. For the latest news, visit news.samsung.com/us.

Role And Responsibilities

The Samsung Home Entertainment (HE) Division is seeking a visionary, highly strategic and results-driven Director of Paid Media to lead the holistic paid media ecosystem across national, retail, and performance channels. This leader will build and execute integrated strategies that connect Samsung Home Entertainment to its consumers and shoppers – maximizing efficiency, performance, and brand equity across every stage of the funnel.

This role reports to the Director of GTM & Campaigns, is based in Plano, TX, and follows Samsung's onsite work model, with 5% travel expected to support retail partners, agencies, and cross-functional teams.

Overall Responsibilities

Lead the Paid Media team, driving strategy, planning, measurement, and reporting.
Develop a holistic paid media strategy across National, Retail, and Performance Media to maximize sales nationally, at strategic retail partners, and at Samsung.com.
Collaborate with Executive Leadership, Integrated Marketing, Product Marketing, Global Marketing and other stakeholders.
Leverage advanced measurement tools, including Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), and media analytics to maximize incremental ROAS and optimize media in real time.

National Media Responsibilities

Media Strategy and Planning:

Develop and oversee the fully integrated, national paid media strategies aligned with the HE Division’s business objectives, national sales goals, and brand health goals.
Identify and reach target audiences, leveraging first-party and partner data to optimize campaigns.
Test innovative approaches to engage consumers and oversee budget allocation across channels.
Collaborate with the marketing and product teams to ensure paid media campaigns align with product launches, promotions, and seasonal events.

Channel Management:

Oversee paid media campaigns across all channels, including traditional Linear, CTV/OTT, OLV, Display (Programmatic and Direct), DOOH, Social, Search, and Retail Media (e.g., Amazon Ads, Walmart Connect, Best Buy Ads, etc.).
Stay up to date on emerging media channels and technologies (e.g., AI-driven media buying, retail media networks, and influencer/creator media) and identify innovative ways to reach our consumers more effectively.

Campaign Planning & Optimization:

Plan and execute national paid media campaigns, ensuring timely delivery and adherence to brand guidelines.
Optimize campaigns based on performance data, adjusting targeting, creatives, and bidding strategies to improve results.
Design and conduct in-market tests to identify the most effective campaign elements.

Retail Media Responsibilities

Retail Media Strategy Development:

Develop comprehensive strategy aligning retail media efforts with national and performance media.
Integrate retail media into holistic media planning, making media budget allocation recommendations to maximize national sales while simultaneously growing all accounts.
Ensure retail media efforts are synched with in-store marketing strategies to create a seamless shopping experience.
Deliver account-specific strategic and executional guidance for each account marketing team to execute to maximize profitable sales at each retailer.

Performance Media Responsibilities

Performance Media Strategy Development:

Develop strategies to maximize qualified traffic and sales on Samsung.com.
Oversee campaigns across Paid Search (SEM, PMax, PLA, etc.), Social, Display, and affiliate marketing.
Leverage advanced data capabilities to target high-propensity audiences and maximize conversion.

Campaign Planning & Optimization:

Optimize campaigns based on performance data.
Collaborate with Ecomm and Corporate Marketing teams to align on Samsung.com performance targets.
Continuously test creative, bidding, and audience strategies to identify scalable improvements in efficiency and ROAS.

Media Analytics & Measurement Responsibilities

Regularly report on key paid media performance metrics to division leadership and to relevant cross-functional stakeholders.
Collaborate on advanced analytics such as Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) and Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), leveraging learnings from each to inform investment decisions and optimize media in real-time.
Work with the ecomm team to report on key performance marketing results and recommend optimizations.

General Responsibilities

Create, manage, and optimize media budgets, allocating spend across national, retail, and performance marketing to maximize sales.
Build and manage relationships with the lead media agency and external vendors; evaluating agencies based on expertise, performance, and cost-effectiveness.
Establish KPIs aligned to business objectives and continuously measure campaign performance.
Oversee the MMM, MTA, and advanced analytics tools to track campaign performance, inform budget allocation decisions, optimize performance, and report to the business.
Monitor and analyze competitors' strategies to ensure plans will cut through in market.
Follow internal practices for finance, regulatory compliance, data security, privacy in all operations.
Mitigate risks associated with ad fraud, brand safety, and data privacy.

Skills And Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

12+ years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree, or 10 years with an advanced (Masters/PhD) degree.
Expertise in media management, and campaign management.
Experience leading and leveraging advanced modeling techniques such as MMM and MTA.
Strong communication skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office tools.
Data-driven approach to decision-making.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in consumer electronics, durable goods, or technology hardware categories.
Proven track record managing complex, multi-agency relationships and enterprise-level media budgets.
Hands-on proficiency with platforms such as DV360, CM360, The Trade Desk, Amazon DSP, and retail media networks (e.g., Amazon Ads, Walmart Connect, Best Buy Ads).
Prior people-management experience building, mentoring, and developing high-performing media teams.
MBA or other advanced degree.
