About us:

EverQuote is a leading AI-powered growth solutions partner for regulated property and casualty insurance entities, enabling the largest insurance carriers and thousands of agents to maximize customer acquisition across digital channels. Fueled by our proprietary data assets and our AI traffic engine, EverQuote is transforming the way providers attract and engage consumers to grow market share.

Joining our team puts you at the forefront of this transformation. You will collaborate with a group of builders to solve complex problems and reshape a massive industry. If you want to drive real-world impact and do the best work of your career, you’ve found your home. We move fast, follow the data, and hold ourselves to high standards. If that's how you work too, this is the role for you.

About the role:

As Senior Analyst, Paid Media, you will own television, connected TV, streaming video, YouTube, and streaming audio for EverQuote’s consumer growth businesses. These are new and fast-growing channels for us, and you will be the single owner: planning, buying, optimizing, and proving out what works.

You will report to the Manager, Paid Media, and work closely with Data Science, Marketing, and Finance. This is a high-ownership role with significant budget and no existing playbook. We are looking for a hands-on video and audio buyer and a strong analyst who can show leadership where the channel works and how to scale it.

What you’ll do:

Own end-to-end planning, buying, and optimization of CTV, streaming video, YouTube, linear TV, and streaming audio campaigns.
Manage budgets, flighting, and pacing against monthly and quarterly targets; forecast spend and flag risk early.
Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for our media agency - brief campaigns, review media plans and post-logs, hold the agency accountable to performance and process commitments.
Build and manage direct relationships with platform and publisher partners; evaluate new inventory, beta programs, and pricing opportunities.
Partner with Data Science on measurement: incrementality and geo lift testing, media mix model inputs, reach and frequency management, brand lift studies, and cross-channel attribution.
Work with creative to build a video and audio testing roadmap; manage asset specs, trafficking, and creative rotation.
Report on channel performance to marketing leadership with a clear read on what is working, what is not, and what we are changing.
Partner with finance on accruals, billing reconciliation, and budget re-forecasts.

What you bring to the team:

2+ years of hands-on paid media experience with meaningful time spent on video and/or audio buying - not solely search or social.
Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics or related field OR demonstrated analytical ability or equivalent hands-on professional experience.
Demonstrated experience running CTV and YouTube campaigns, including hands-on work in the relevant buying platforms (for example DV360, Google Ads, Amazon DSP, The Trade Desk, Netflix, Hulu, or comparable).
Experience managing or working closely with a media agency: briefing, plan review, negotiation, and performance management.
Experience working directly with platform, publisher, or network partners.
Comfortable owning a substantial budget with accountability for efficiency metrics, not just execution.
Strong analytical skills - able to work in spreadsheets and BI tools, interrogate performance data, and connect channel metrics to business outcomes.
Clear written and verbal communication; able to present a point of view to leadership and push back on an agency.

Nice to have:

Streaming audio buying experience (for example Spotify, Pandora, iHeart, Audacy, or podcast networks).
Linear TV and Connected-TV experience, including national and local buying.
Direct-response or performance-oriented TV and audio background rather than purely brand.
Experience with incrementality or geo-based testing methodology.
Insurance, fintech, or another high-consideration, heavily regulated category. (good to have, not required)
Familiarity with ad ops and measurement tooling relevant to video and audio.
Exposure to attribution solution such as Media mix modeling

jobs.title: Demand Generation Marketer
jobs.description:
Fourth is the world’s largest and fastest-growing global leader of end-to-end restaurant and hospitality management technology solutions. We pride ourselves on delivering a world-class SaaS experience for our clients by building long-term partnerships starting from the first phone call. We know our recipe for success at Fourth is our amazing team... and that starts with hiring the right people!
Interested in joining our smart, fun, and talented team?
Position Overview

HotSchedules is the restaurant industry’s most widely used scheduling platform. Over 300,000 restaurants across North America trust HotSchedules. The SMB team is at the top of our growth funnel—introducing restaurant operators to HotSchedules.
As the dedicated demand gen marketer for SMB, you’ll own the pipeline programs that fuel bookings for two high-performing sales teams. Running both inbound programs and outbound sales-led campaigns to hit quarterly bookings targets.
Some of this GTM motion exists and needs refinement. Some of it you’ll create from scratch. You'll pull in Product Marketing, Sales, and RevOps when you need them — but you won't wait for alignment to move. You drive the work and bring people along.
The challenge in marketing today, the channels are crowded. The job is to find where there’s still signal, test aggressively, and scale what works. Plus, cutting what doesn’t work before it becomes a habit. That means bringing new ideas, tinkering with tools, and being willing to experiment your way to an answer. It also means knowing your customer deeply enough that your messaging cuts through. Understanding what operators care about, where they spend their time, and what makes them stop and listen.

Primary Responsibilities

Own pipeline:
Drive inbound and outbound demand programs end-to-end — strategy, execution, iteration — with a clear line to SAO targets each quarter. Pipeline and bookings are how we keep score.

Embed with sales:
Standups, call shadows, deal reviews. Short deal cycles mean fast feedback loops — you’ll know quickly what’s working and can act on it fast.

Build campaigns that earn attention:
Develop integrated, multi-touch programs across email, paid, content, and outbound that speak to operators’ reality.

Know your buyer:
Learn from regular operator interviews and sales calls to craft messaging, creative, and campaign strategy that works.

Build and evolve the stack:
Identify gaps, propose solutions, implement what works. You don’t wait for a better workflow — you build it.

Use AI to scale yourself:
Tools, workflows, agents. Use technology extends your capabilities and gain leverage.

Close the loop:
Partner with RevOps on scoring, routing, response times, and reporting.

Key Skills And Competencies

5–7 years in B2B demand generation, ideally SaaS, with a track record of owning a pipeline number.
Fluent across channels: email, paid, content, events, outbound. Good enough at all of them to know which one to reach for and to connect them into programs that convert.
A strong writer who can speak to a small business owner’s daily reality.
Someone who embeds with sales rather than operating at arm’s length. Low ego, high output.
A tinkerer. You’ve built workflows, tested tools, played with agents — and you have real examples to show for it.
Comfortable being accountable. You track pipeline/ SAO targets like it's your own money. When the pipeline is short, you figure out why and fix it.
You've pulled your own pipeline and conversion data, found the problem before someone told you about it, and changed your program because of what you saw.
You've killed your own programs when the data said so — even ones you built and liked.
A curious, life-long learner

Why This Role

Restaurant operators run some of the hardest businesses in the world. When HotSchedules works, it makes their lives meaningfully easier. This role puts you at the front of that pipeline—it's how you get there, but the operator on the other end is why it matters.

Fourth Benefits

🏖
Unlimited PTO!
🏥 Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance!
🏦 401k Match!
👥 Parental Leave
💻 Laptop and equipment.
Remote employment limited to: AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, ID, IL, IN, LA, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MS, NC, NE, NJ, NM, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, & WA
Our Story

In July 2019, Fourth joined forces with HotSchedules to become the global leader in end-to-end restaurant and hospitality management technology solutions. Together, the merged company now represents the world’s largest and only provider of end-to-end restaurant and hospitality management solutions for customers across the globe and of all sizes—from a single location or franchisee restaurant to a global restaurant or hotel chain. The combined company’s complete software-as-service (SaaS) solution suite, including scheduling, time & attendance, applicant tracking, training, inventory management/procurement, HR/benefits, and payroll services, now serves customers in 120,000 locations worldwide and is supported by a dedicated, unified team across offices in the US, UK, Bulgaria, China, Australia, and UAE.

Who We Are

Join a team that puts its People First! Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. What We Do

First American Trust is seeking an experienced a Senior Marketing Specialist to join our team. The position will cover a broad spectrum of marketing responsibilities; and have responsibility over various functions listed below. In addition, these specialties may deliver content & communications via a variety of methods such as digital, print and publication etc.

Direct Marketing/Advertising/Promotional

What You'll Do:

Direct marketing involves sending promotional marketing materials directly to consumers (print and publication).

Product/Brand Marketing

Product/Brand marketing is the focus area devoted to strategically bringing a new product or service to market. This discipline sets the strategy, guiding many of the other marketing specializations listed. Much of their work is based on research to understand the important variables related to competitors’ products, review and synthesize consumer research information and meet with product development teams to better understand the features of the product. This information is then used to formulate an overall product marketing strategy.

Content Marketing

Content marketing is all about creating content—basically any consumable piece of information—that serves a purpose beyond just promoting a product. Content marketing can build positive sentiment for a brand by attaching the brand to something genuinely helpful or entertaining.

Social Media Marketing

The purpose of social media marketing is generally to drive traffic to a company’s website while boosting overall brand awareness and customer loyalty. Marketers achieve this by using a variety of methods on various social media platforms, from Facebook to Snapchat and everything in between. Social media gives brands and businesses the opportunity to interact with the public in a personalized way.

Database Marketing

Database marketers collect information about consumer preferences to create targeted messages to consumers.

Marketing Research & Analysis

Market researchers employ several tactics for picking the brains of the public and gathering information and interpreting the data.

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience
4-7 years of experience in marketing, brand management, campaign execution, or related disciplines
Experience developing and executing multi-channel marketing campaigns across digital, social media, direct marketing, and content channels

Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities and business needs

And we've created a culture here that cares just as deeply about the career you're building. We're embracing a hybrid work model that enables our teams to split their time between office and home. The Role

Working across Brand, Creative, Channel, Marketing Operations, and key business partners, you'll coordinate execution, develop campaign assets, and ensure launches are delivered with consistency, quality, and speed. Qualifications

Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple launches, stakeholders, and competing priorities simultaneously

Aim High - Always challenging ourselves and others to raise the bar.

A comprehensive total rewards package that supports your wellness and provides security for SimpliSafers and their families (For more information on our total rewards please click here)

What You Can Expect

The Sr. Director, Product & Technology Marketing for the Data Center Networking Business Group will own the outbound marketing strategy for Marvell's photonic fabric, co-packaged optics (CPO), optical connectivity, data center switching, and data center interconnect (DCI) portfolio. This is a high-stakes, system-level marketing role — the target audience is not component buyers, but platform decision-makers: system architects at hyperscalers and data center operators who are making infrastructure-level choices about how to scale AI clusters beyond the rack. The marketing challenge is translating silicon-level photonic innovation into a compelling end-to-end narrative about the future of AI-scale connectivity — from millimeters between chips on a co-packaged optics module, to photonic fabric and high-radix switching connecting XPU to XPU within the cluster, to coherent DCI solutions spanning kilometers between data centers.

Own the full outbound marketing strategy for Marvell's Optical & Data Center Systems portfolio — amplifying Marvell's market-leading connectivity position across photonic fabric, CPO, data center switching, and coherent DCI — through differentiated positioning, compelling messaging, and targeted channel activation that drives awareness and preference with hyperscaler and data center operator audiences.

Partner with product management and engineering teams to deeply understand technology roadmaps; translate product capabilities into external marketing strategies, not internal product plans.

Technology Marketing & Thought Leadership

Build and execute a technology marketing strategy that establishes Marvell as the recognized leader in optical-scale AI infrastructure — telling the end-to-end story of AI connectivity from millimeters between chips on a co-packaged optics module, to photonic fabric and high-radix switching connecting XPU to XPU within the cluster, to coherent DCI solutions spanning kilometers between data centers.
Create a pipeline of compelling thought leadership assets including white papers, solution briefs, executive presentations, keynote narratives, and technical blogs that translate silicon-level innovation into customer and industry impact.
Partner with executive and product leadership to develop and sharpen Marvell's technology narrative for major industry forums, analyst briefings, customer events, and investor communications.
Act as a senior voice of the market — tracking industry trends, competitive dynamics, and customer requirements to continuously sharpen Marvell's positioning.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Organizational Influence

Serve as the primary outbound marketing partner to product line executives and product management teams — translating roadmap inputs into external marketing strategies, audience narratives, and campaign execution.
Collaborate across marketing functions — corporate, digital, events, AR/PR, and content — to ensure portfolio messaging is consistently amplified across all channels and touchpoints.
Establish shared messaging frameworks, launch standards, and audience segmentation playbooks that scale across Marvell's business units and marketing organization.
Represent the marketing function in senior leadership forums, ensuring outbound marketing strategy and investment priorities are informed by market insight and tied to business outcomes.

What We're Looking For

BS degree required; a degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline is highly preferred. MBA or MS in a business or quantitative discipline valued in addition to an engineering foundation.
15+ years of progressive experience in outbound product marketing or technology marketing within the semiconductor, systems, or AI infrastructure industry — candidates with pure product management backgrounds will not be considered.
Deep expertise in AI/data center optical infrastructure — including co-packaged optics (CPO), silicon photonics, data center switching, and coherent DCI — with demonstrated understanding of the hyperscaler and data center operator buyer landscape, platform-level purchasing dynamics, and the competitive and technology trends shaping next-generation AI scale-up connectivity.
Demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi-product outbound marketing programs — from audience strategy and positioning through campaign execution — with measurable business results.
Exceptional ability to synthesize highly technical concepts into external audience narratives, customer value stories, and industry thought leadership that drives awareness and preference.
Proven experience developing and activating marketing content across the full outbound mix: executive presentations, white papers, solution briefs, digital campaigns, event activations, and media/analyst engagement.
Strong cross-functional influence skills — able to collaborate effectively with product management without conflating the two disciplines; clear understanding of where marketing responsibility begins and ends.
Strong executive presence and communication skills — confident presenting to partners, at industry conferences, and in internal leadership settings.
Experience building and leading teams; strong track record recruiting, developing, and retaining top marketing talent.

Preferred

Experience working with or marketing to hyperscalers, cloud service providers, and data center operators making platform-level infrastructure decisions — particularly system architects evaluating optical scale-up architectures.
Deep familiarity with co-packaged optics (CPO) architectures and advanced optical solutions — including photonic integrated circuits (PICs), silicon photonics light engines, and coherent DCI technologies — and the ecosystem dynamics required to bring next-generation optical connectivity to commercial scale.
Track record of building or scaling a product marketing function; prior people management experience a strong plus.
Track record of representing a company at major optical and data center industry forums; experience such as OFC, ECOC, OCP, OIF, and other relevant standards bodies or equivalent strongly preferred.

You’ll spend a lot of your time in Braze, building campaigns and canvases in order to engage our users and drive conversion throughout the artist funnel. You’ll work closely with Product Marketing, Growth, and other key cross functional stakeholders to execute large-scale marketing initiatives effectively globally. Ultimately, you’ll be a key part of a team reimagining the way artists and their teams leverage the platform, share their art, and build their careers.
What You’ll Do

Set up and launch a range of multi-channel, multi-step journeys in Braze, with a heavy emphasis on email.
Build and QA email templates according to the approved copy/design, using liquid logic & content blocks to personalize campaigns, + coding some templates in HTML/CSS.
Coordinate with engineering and localizations teams to translate emails for up to 26 languages.
Monitor effectiveness of all campaigns and regularly raise opportunities for improvement to the wider team.
Coordinate various aspects of campaigns including targeting query workstreams, working closely with creative and product marketing teams to ensure quality executions and on-brand messaging, respectively.
Collaborate with Data Science to build and QA audience segments using SQL and BigQuery, and validate them against suppression and exclusion lists before every launch.
Work cross-functionally to help us improve processes and refine ways of working.
Work closely with the rest of the Growth Marketing team to inform strategy and tactics across all campaigns, globally.
Maintain the growth campaign calendar and Asana boards to organize incoming requests and decrease conflicting sends.
Use Claude to improve various steps of our processes.
Pull campaign and A/B test results, flag anomalies, and surface opportunities for improvement to the wider team.

Who You Are

You have 3 to 5 years of experience working within Braze to set up owned-channel campaigns + experience translating sends across multiple languages.
You have strong attention to detail, ensuring campaigns are accurate, on-brand, and technically sound.
You have hands-on experience with Liquid, HTML/CSS, and email template QA.
You have working knowledge of SQL and BigQuery.
You regularly use Claude, with a human in the loop.
You have an understanding of growth tactics, strategies, and optimizations and you understand marketing funnels.
You understand the complex dynamics within the music ecosystem. In a former life, you’ve been an artist or worked closely with creators.
You’re collaborative by nature and get energy from working on cross-functional teams and bringing people together.
You demonstrate initiative and independence, including the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously and execute projects with minimal supervision.
You’re a creative problem solver who can identify challenges and propose effective solutions.
Top 3 hard and soft skills required for this role:

Hard Skills:
Braze campaign execution, SQL / BigQuery, Claude and Jira software experience.
Soft Skills:
Cross-functional coordination, Ability to work autonomously, and Capacity to handle high volume of work.
Skills or experience that are nice to have:
Experience working directly with artists or creators in the music ecosystem, Liquid logic, HTML/CSS coding, and email template QA experience.
Strategic Role & Influence:
The role manages day-to-day campaign execution, go-to-market launches, and weekly emails to free up growth marketing managers' bandwidth for driving overarching business goals. Influence is centered on maintaining artist trust and driving product awareness across cross-functional teams.
Known Obstacles:
Short, crunchy timelines, constant resourcing changes, and sudden high-pressure requests such as weekend campaign sends.
Key Skills to Navigate Challenges:
Resilience, strong cross-functional communication, and autonomous problem-solving under pressure.
Top Priorities & Metrics (Next 6–12 Months):
Flawless campaign execution with zero errors, executing product launches, supporting creator development programs, and navigating peak end-of-year campaign seasons.

The target hiring compensation range for this role is $30.00/hr to $35.00/hr. Compensation is based on several factors including, but not limited to education, relevant work experience, relevant certifications, and location.

Digital Social Media Strategist

A rapidly expanding sports media and events organization recognized multiple times as a top workplace and one of the fastest growing private companies in the country. Manage the daily and weekly content calendars for multiple digital brands to promote articles, rankings, and recruiting news.
Define and execute the brand voice and community engagement standards across platforms including Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, and YouTube.
Collaborate with internal creative teams to brief and produce high quality video and graphic assets.

Position Summary

Samsung Electronics America, Inc. (SEA), the U.S. Sales and Marketing subsidiary, is a leader in mobile technologies, consumer electronics, home appliances, enterprise solutions and networks systems. For more than four decades, Samsung has driven innovation, economic growth and workforce opportunity across the United States—investing over $100 billion and employing more than 20,000 people nationwide. By integrating our large portfolio of products, services and AI technology, we’re creating smarter, sustainable and more connected experiences that empower people to live better. SEA is a wholly owned subsidiary of Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd.

To learn more, visit Samsung.com. For the latest news, visit news.samsung.com/us.

Samsung Mobile B2B Business delivers a combination of enterprise offerings across our product portfolio. We continue to expand our Enterprise Portfolio by providing the most innovative offerings in the market, and our dedication to Market Disruption makes this the destination company for the world’s top talent.

Role And Responsibilities

Position Summary:

The SCPs (Strategic Channel Partners) are critical to the success of Samsung’s Mobile B2B organization. Samsung plays a consultative role in helping these reseller partners build mobility marketing practices and identify opportunities for co-marketing that drives revenue and brand love for Samsung with channel sellers. The ideal candidate will be numbers-driven and optimize marketing ROI with structured and disciplined KPIs and metrics reporting. This position will be responsible for marketing strategy, planning, development, and implementation of integrated marketing and communication strategies and campaigns to support the SCP Partners across enterprise and SMB and in concert with priorities around key verticals.

This role will also be responsible for promoting and advocating for Samsung’s Ascend Partner Program among SCP resellers. This tiered program is designed for mobile resellers to grow revenue in a predictable, profitable and painless manner.

Job Description

Primary Relationships

Collaborate with IT Channel Sales, SCP team leaders and Account Managers to ensure Samsung and Partner profitability paired with continuous growth
Serve as the face of Samsung Marketing with SCP Partner marketing and sales teams and Partner executive leadership
Coordinate with Samsung Product and Solutions Marketing to plan partner investment and tactical timeline execution
Align with Samsung Channel Marketing leadership, finance, legal and compliance teams to effectively execute against annual budgets

Role And Responsibilities

Responsible for the strategy, planning, development, and implementation of integrated marketing and sales enablement campaigns to support the SCP Reseller Partners across enterprise and SMB and in concert with priorities around key verticals.
Work with Partners to design and develop marketing campaigns that achieve our joint objectives and fit within our resource allocations.
Develop, write, and coordinate marketing briefs and business cases for internal campaign approvals.
Project manage delivery of creative assets (visuals, copy, etc.) in compliance with Samsung Brand guidelines and legal approvals.
Manage and report campaign KPIs, and collect proof-of-performance for campaign payment.
Manages marketing budgets, forecasts, evaluates, measures and reports on program effectiveness and ROI.
Optimize marketing ROI with structured and disciplined KPIs and metrics reporting.
Works directly with Channel Marketing senior leadership and SCP sales executives and their regional teams to drive campaigns and programs for building sales pipeline and closing business in the IT channel.
Able to work cross-functionally to oversee the timely planning and execution of campaigns and programs.
Able to work on multiple, simultaneous marketing programs that require both strategic thinking as well as high-speed tactical execution.

Min Bachelor level degree.
6+ years of sales or marketing experience, preferably in a channel, field facing or marketing communications role. Mobile and Channel experience a must, and SMB preferred.
Strong leadership and project management skills with an ability to develop and deliver campaigns and programs within a very high velocity, shifting environment with associated analytical tools
Demonstrated skills, knowledge and experience in the design and execution of marketing, communications and public relations activities to drive business objectives
Strong creative, strategic, analytical, organizational and personal sales skills.
Experience developing and managing budgets and reporting on KPIs and ROI metrics.
Commitment to working with shared leadership and in cross-functional teams.
Strong oral and written communications skills.
Approximately 50% travel across the US is required

Develop and maintain excellent working relationships with all assigned levels within and outside the company.
Plan, organize, and prioritize multiple assignments and projects.
Review detailed product development, marketing documents and media materials as needed.
Demonstrated competency in both oral and written communication modes for both internal and external personnel at various levels.
Work independently and in a team environment in order to achieve customer business objectives, personal and team goals and complete assignments within established time frames and specifications.
The ability to develop tasks and work assignments, based on sometime vaguely defined objectives.

Work is generally performed in an office environment.

The movement and transportation of equipment, most of the time under 25 pounds.

Under the direction of the Senior BD & Marketing Manager, this position will work closely with attorneys and other members of the Marketing & BD Department to support select marketing and business development activities for the Data Privacy, Protection and Security, and Labor & Employment practice areas. The position requires a self-starter, with accomplished critical thinking skills, who can partner with other marketing, business development, administrative, and executive team members to achieve business objectives. Masters firm systems, such as CRM and experience database, to harness client intelligence and create efficiencies in process.

Law firm experience is preferable but not required. Collaborative team player who can both take direction and self-start. jobs.description:
At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As we foster a culture of inclusion throughout our company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves: What is our impact on the world?

Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our-story'

Each and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.

We believe water is more than a resource, it's a shared responsibility. As part of our Water Business Group, you’ll help shape how communities manage water for generations to come. From delivering safe drinking water and treating wastewater responsibly to developing sustainable water supplies and protecting lives and property through flood control, your work will directly support public health, environmental sustainability, and infrastructure resilience. We bring together experts across disciplines to solve complex challenges with bold thinking and technical excellence. Whether you're modernizing aging systems or pioneering innovative approaches, your contributions will make a meaningful difference in people’s lives. This isn’t just a job, it's a chance to lead change, drive progress, and leave a lasting legacy.

Join a team that’s shaping the future of water infrastructure in Northern California. As a Sr. Marketing Coordinator for the Northern California Area Water Business Group (NorCal WBG), you’ll be part of a team that is at the forefront of driving innovation, building strategic partnerships, and winning meaningful work in drinking water, wastewater, and water resources planning and design. This isn’t just marketing; it’s about being part of a team that is creating sustainable solutions for communities and making a lasting impact.

Working in partnership with the NorCal WBG Marketing Services Manager and our Proposal Managers, the Sr. Marketing Coordinator is responsible for coordinating high-quality proposals and interview materials, supporting business development and growth initiatives, and delivering marketing programs that strengthen our brand, visibility, and market presence.

In the role of Senior Marketing Coordinator, we'll count on you to:

Support pursuit teams in developing persuasive, client-focused proposal and interview materials from kickoff through submission.
Coordinate proposal development activities, including schedules, compliance, content collection, document production, quality reviews, and final submission.
Monitor client and industry websites for solicitation and procurement status.
Organize and file proposal and presentation materials following submittal for future reference and reuse.
Support management of client relationship management and financial systems to inform reporting metrics and dashboards.
Maintain accurate project and resume data in business development systems.
Promote data quality and consistency across marketing and business development systems and resources.
Arrange for professional photography on projects.
Support development of annual and long-term strategic plans within established company direction and goals, including growth initiatives and strategic investments.
Support implementation of key growth initiatives and investments as defined in annual and long-term strategic plans.
Support development and implementation of client plans, including long-term strategies to capture market share, as assigned.
Support solicitation of formal client feedback.
Administer implementation of the go/no-go decision process in accordance with HDR's Matrix of Authority.
Support content marketing campaigns to strengthen HDR's brand, increase visibility, and showcase thought leaders.
Support development and publication of engaging digital content that reflects HDR's brand and elevates thought leadership.
Support implementation of strategies that elevate HDR's brand and technical talent with industry associations.
Create marketing collateral and branded visual communications to support business development efforts.
Plan and fulfill conference sponsorship benefits and support conference participation, as needed.
Develop engaging internal communications content, including announcements, presentations, and webinars.
Plan and coordinate large internal meetings, in-person and virtual.
Maintain inventory of branded materials used for client visits, conferences, and recruiting.
Train and mentor employees on marketing processes, business development tools, proposal development, and marketing best practices.
Articulate HDR's capabilities and competitive advantages.
Help improve marketing processes, templates, tools, and resources to increase team efficiency, consistency, and quality.
Provide guidance and quality review to Marketing Coordinators and other less experienced staff, as appropriate.
Perform other duties as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in a related field
Deep knowledge of the A/E/C industry's standard approach to procurement of professional services
Ability and desire to travel and engage with others in-person

Required Qualifications

A minimum of 2 years relevant industry experience
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint
Proficient in Adobe Creative Cloud applications, including InDesign
Demonstrated "self-starter" with a history of completing projects with limited oversight

What We Believe

HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.

Our Commitment

As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day.

Our eight Employee Network Groups (Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, Young Professionals) help create a sense of belonging and foster a supportive environment where everyone is empowered to engage and contribute. Each group has an executive sponsor and is open to all employees.

We provide a comprehensive benefits package that promotes employee ownership, employee health, performance, and success, which includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, life insurance, an employee assistance program, paid time away, parental leave, paid holidays, a retirement savings plan with employer match, employee referral bonus and tuition reimbursement. Stated benefits are for full-time regular positions. jobs.title: Senior Customer Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
About Our Client:

The organization operates in the physical operations management software industry, addressing the challenge of integrating safety, operations, and financial management for drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet-related expenses into a single system. It leverages AI technology to provide visibility, control, and automation, reducing manual workloads for nearly 100,000 customers across diverse sectors such as transportation, logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

About the Opportunity:

The SENIOR CUSTOMER MARKETING SPECIALIST role is focused on developing and executing customer engagement and advocacy programs that enhance retention, growth, and brand credibility. The position involves building and managing an online customer community, coordinating advocacy initiatives, and producing customer storytelling assets to amplify customer voices. This role contributes to business growth by scaling advocacy efforts with the aid of AI and automation, ensuring positive customer experiences and measurable impact.

Responsibilities:

Execute customer marketing campaigns supporting adoption, retention, renewals, and expansion
Manage customer communications throughout the lifecycle, collaborating with Customer Success, Sales, Product, and Marketing teams
Coordinate internal teams to maintain and utilize customer advocacy assets
Maintain campaign calendars, trackers, and workflows for consistent execution
Design customer activation strategies across references, storytelling, events, campaigns, and media
Identify and recruit customers for advocacy; cultivate long-term champion relationships
Produce and manage customer testimonials, case studies, and reference stories
Maintain a centralized repository of customer proof points for Sales and Marketing
Develop and implement online community engagement strategies
Manage community initiatives including discussions, recognition programs, and events
Gather and share customer feedback and sentiment with cross-functional teams
Oversee presence on review platforms and run review generation campaigns
Monitor review performance and coordinate responses to customer feedback
Support customer-facing events such as webinars and speaking engagements
Activate advocates for product launches and marketing initiatives
Manage customer reference requests and build an advocate network
Track and report advocacy and community engagement metrics
Use data and insights to optimize programs and messaging
Handle day-to-day program execution, logistics, and asset delivery
Coordinate outreach, scheduling, approvals, and consents for advocacy activities
Maintain documentation and systems for organized advocacy efforts
Ensure polished and timely customer-facing experiences

Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field, or equivalent experience
3 to 5 years of experience in customer marketing, references, online reviews, advocacy, community, or lifecycle marketing in a B2B technology environment
Proven ability to launch and manage customer marketing and retention/expansion programs
Ability to balance customer empathy with business priorities
Strong storytelling, writing, and communication skills
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail

The pay range and compensation package for this role will be determined based on the candidate's experience, skills, and other relevant factors.

Our client is an equal opportunity employer. They celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or national origin.

jobs.title: Head of Design & Marketing
jobs.description:
Job Description

Head of Design & Marketing

Job Type: Full-time

Work Location: In person (Brooklyn, NY)

Job Description

Our client is a trendy, forward-thinking furniture manufacturer and one of the fastest-growing furniture brands in the US. They produce stylish, well-made furniture that is delivered directly to customers at competitive prices. The company is committed to high-quality products, exceptional service, and continued growth.

The Role

Our client is looking for a highly creative and visionary Head of Design & Marketing to lead their design and marketing efforts. This individual will oversee the creative process from concept through execution while ensuring that all visual and written content aligns with the company's brand identity and long-term objectives.

This is a hands-on leadership role that combines creative direction, team management, branding, marketing, and design operations. The successful candidate will manage an in-house creative team of three along with multiple freelance professionals, while collaborating closely with marketing, product development, sales, and executive leadership.

Responsibilities

Lead the creative process from concept through execution across a wide range of projects, ensuring consistency with brand identity
Manage and work directly with an in-house team of three as well as multiple freelance creative professionals
Hire, develop, manage, and inspire the creative team while effectively overseeing workloads and priorities
Collaborate with marketing, product development, sales, and other cross-functional teams to develop cohesive campaigns and marketing materials
Oversee the creation and editing of visual assets, including product photography, product imagery, lifestyle renderings, graphics, and video
Manage and organize thousands of image and creative files efficiently
Ensure all creative output and visual communications remain consistent with established brand guidelines
Manage product copywriting and ensure product descriptions include accurate details, relevant keywords, and required information
Assist with social media strategy and creative development across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Pinterest, and other platforms
Manage email marketing templates, promotional materials, and other marketing assets
Present creative concepts and strategic recommendations to executives, clearly communicating the rationale behind creative decisions and long-term goals
Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and maintaining high-quality standards
Develop and improve design systems, workflows, and processes to increase efficiency and consistency
Stay current on design, marketing, furniture, interior design, and emerging technology trends
Identify creative and operational challenges and develop solutions independently

Qualifications

Required:

10+ years of experience in graphic design or a related creative field
5+ years of marketing experience
Proven experience leading creative projects and managing designers or other creative professionals
Strong portfolio demonstrating a range of creative projects across multiple media
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign
Strong understanding of branding principles, creative direction, and marketing strategy
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Strong organizational and file management skills with exceptional attention to detail
Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to independently find solutions when direction or answers are not readily available

Preferred

Experience in the furniture, home furnishings, or home decor industry
Experience or strong passion for interior design and merchandising
Experience with 3D design software such as Blender or similar platforms
Experience developing product imagery, lifestyle renderings, and video content
Experience managing social media creative across multiple platforms
Experience working with freelance creative teams
Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, Marketing, or a related field

Employee discount

jobs.title: Marketing Manager, Customer Growth & Field Engagement (Spanish Fluency Required)
jobs.description:
The Marketing Manager, Customer Growth & Field Engagement will play a highly visible role in helping QXO strengthen relationships and drive growth with Spanish-speaking contractors, business owners, crews, and community partners across priority markets.

This individual will serve as an external ambassador for QXO and an internal champion for customer growth, partnering across Sales, Branch Operations, Marketing, Digital, Communications, HR, Learning & Development, regional leadership, and vendor partners.

The ideal candidate is a natural relationship builder who thrives in the field, can communicate professionally in both Spanish and English, and can translate customer and field insights into practical strategies that drive measurable business growth. This is an opportunity to build something from the ground up by creating the tools, relationships, programs, training, events, and repeatable field model that will help QXO better reach, serve, and grow Spanish-speaking customers across the organization.

This is a field-forward role requiring approximately 50% travel. The individual will regularly represent QXO at customer and community events, lead training sessions, speak to internal and external audiences, and coordinate field events and activations across priority markets.

Build Relationships & Represent QXO in the Market

Serve as a visible ambassador for QXO with Spanish-speaking contractors, customers, business owners, and community partners.
Develop trusted relationships with contractors, customers, trade organizations, vendors, community partners, and industry influencers.
Spend significant time in the field through branch visits, customer meetings, community engagement, training sessions, events, and market activations.
Represent QXO as a confident and engaging public speaker at customer events, industry meetings, community programs, training sessions, and other external engagements.
Strengthen QXO visibility and credibility with Spanish-speaking contractor and business communities across priority markets.

Build & Scale the Customer Growth Strategy

Develop a repeatable field engagement model that helps branches and sales teams attract, serve, and grow Spanish-speaking customers.
Partner with Sales, Branch Operations, and regional leadership to identify priority markets, customer opportunities, and local growth strategies.
Develop practical playbooks, tools, field routines, and resources that can be scaled across markets.
Build and support a network of internal champions who can help drive adoption and engagement locally.
Gather feedback from customers and field teams to continuously improve the approach and scale what works.

Lead Events, Training & Field Engagement

Plan, coordinate, and execute customer events, community activations, field training sessions, and other market-facing programs in partnership with Sales, Marketing, branch teams, and vendor partners.
Deliver engaging presentations, workshops, and training sessions in Spanish and English for sales, branch, customer-facing, and external audiences.
Coordinate event and training logistics, content, speakers, materials, partners, and follow-up to ensure a consistent and professional experience.
Coach sales, branch, and customer-facing teams on building trust and effectively serving Spanish-speaking contractors and business owners.

Partner Across Marketing, Digital & Communications

Serve as an internal subject matter resource on Spanish-speaking contractor and customer engagement.
Advise Marketing, Digital, Communications, Creative, and Social Media teams on messaging, content, campaigns, customer education, and Spanish-language materials.
Bring insights from customers and the field back into QXO to help ensure messaging is relevant, authentic, and effective.
Partner with manufacturer and vendor partners to develop co-funded programs that support customer engagement and growth.

Drive Measurable Business Impact

Partner with FP&A and business leaders to establish meaningful success measures for customer growth initiatives.
Track performance across sales growth, new and reactivated accounts, customer engagement, digital adoption, event effectiveness, training outcomes, and field adoption.
Use customer feedback, field insights, and business data to identify opportunities and continuously improve programs.
Provide regular updates to Marketing and Sales leadership on progress, successes, barriers, and recommendations.

Strengthen Field Capability & Talent

Partner with HR and field leadership to support the attraction, hiring, development, and retention of bilingual Spanish-English talent in priority markets.
Collaborate with Learning & Development to create practical training that strengthens customer understanding, engagement, and field confidence.
Help build greater capability across QXO field teams to effectively engage and support Spanish-speaking customers.

What You'll Bring

Professional fluency in Spanish and English; Including the ability to present, facilitate training, and communicate effectively with customers, contractors, field teams, community partners, and business leaders in both languages.
7+ years of experience in field marketing, sales, sales enablement, customer growth, community engagement, multicultural marketing, training, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience successfully engaging Spanish-speaking customers, contractors, business owners, or community organizations.
Strong field presence and enthusiasm for spending significant time in branches, customer meetings, local markets, training sessions, and community settings.
Strong public-speaking and facilitation skills, with demonstrated comfort presenting and delivering training to groups of varying sizes.
Experience coordinating and executing customer events, community activations, training programs, or similar field-based initiatives.
Exceptional interpersonal, communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
Ability to build credibility quickly and represent QXO professionally with external audiences.
Ability to influence and drive action across cross-functional teams without direct authority.
Strong commercial mindset with the ability to connect customer engagement initiatives to measurable business outcomes.
Ability and willingness to travel approximately 50% of the time, including regular travel to branches, customer meetings, community events, training sessions, and priority markets.

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
Marketing Operations Coordinator - E-commerce Site

Columbus, OH - Fully Remote or Hybrid if Local

3-month contract with possible extension and/or conversion

Full Time – 40 hours/week

Position Overview

Our leading children’s media and education client is seeking a detail-oriented, execution-focused E-commerce Site Operations Coordinator to support its digital commerce team during the busy holiday season. This contractor will help bring seasonal campaigns, promotional activations, and product updates to life across the company's e-commerce experience.
Working closely with the existing e-commerce, creative, marketing, and digital operations teams, this individual will execute website updates, build and maintain pages, manage product setup and sequencing, and ensure all site changes are accurate and ready for launch. The ideal candidate is organized, adaptable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with established plans, tight deadlines, and multiple competing priorities.
This is a hands-on execution role for someone who can quickly learn existing workflows, manage assigned tasks independently, and help ensure the website accurately reflects current business priorities and promotional strategies.

Key Responsibilities

Website Updates and Publishing:
Build, update, and maintain website pages and content in accordance with established site plans, creative direction, and business requirements.
Product Setup and Merchandising:
Set up new products, manage product sequencing and placement, and ensure products are presented accurately across the e-commerce experience.
Promotional Activation:
Execute promotional updates, pricing changes, and seasonal campaign activations to ensure approved offers and marketing initiatives are accurately reflected on the site.
Site Flips and Launch Execution:
Support scheduled website updates and seasonal transitions, coordinating with digital operations and other partners to ensure changes are completed on time.
Quality Assurance:
Review pages, product details, promotional messaging, pricing, and other site elements for accuracy, functionality, and consistency before and after publishing, as appropriate.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Partner with e-commerce, creative, marketing, and digital operations teams to gather necessary assets and information, clarify requirements, and resolve issues.
Task and Timeline Management:
Track assigned updates, manage deadlines, communicate progress, and proactively flag discrepancies, blockers, or risks that could affect launch timelines.

Qualifications

1-3 years of experience in e-commerce operations, website production, digital merchandising, web content management, or a related field.
Hands-on experience building, updating, or publishing website pages using a content management system or e-commerce platform.
Experience with product setup, product sequencing, site merchandising, promotional updates, or digital campaign execution.
Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy, particularly with product information, pricing, promotional offers, and website content.
Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple requests and deadlines simultaneously.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to work effectively across creative, marketing, and technical teams.
Ability to work independently, follow established processes, adapt to changing priorities, and contribute quickly with limited onboarding.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting seasonal site updates, promotional launches, or high-volume e-commerce environments.
Familiarity with website quality assurance, launch checklists, and digital operations workflows.
Experience working with creative assets, page layouts, product catalogs, and cross-functional marketing calendars.

What Success Looks Like

The successful person will help maintain smooth day-to-day e-commerce operations throughout the holiday season by ensuring site updates, product launches, and promotional activations are completed accurately and on schedule. They will quickly learn established workflows, provide dependable execution support, and free up the internal team to focus on broader planning and strategic priorities.

jobs.title: Sr. Corporate BD & Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
DLA Piper is, at its core, bold, exceptional, collaborative and supportive. Our people are the backbone, heart and soul of our firm. Wherever you are in your professional journey, DLA Piper is a place you can engage in meaningful work and grow your career. Let’s see what we can achieve. Together.

Summary

The Senior Corporate Business Development & Marketing Specialist, supports the business development and marketing efforts of the Corporate practice group, with a focus on Emerging Growth & Venture Capital (EGVC) initiatives working closely with Business Development & Marketing Managers, lawyers, and cross-functional colleagues to drive venture-focused initiatives that enhance client outreach, promote the group’s capabilities, and support day-to-day marketing activity. This individual is detail-oriented, organized, and eager to grow their career in a professional services environment. The Corporate Business Development & Marketing Senior Specialist plays an important role in supporting projects related to pitches and proposals, marketing collateral, CRM and pipeline tracking, directories and awards, and events. They gain broad exposure to key business development and marketing processes, while contributing to a team-oriented, client-focused culture.

Location

This position can sit in our Palo Alto, or San Francisco office and offers a hybrid work schedule.

Responsibilities

Provide comprehensive support for client events, webinars, and sponsorships in the EGVC space and broader Corporate practice, including managing event deliverables (branding, sponsor benefits), coordinating logistics (venue, RSVPs, materials), and liaising with the firm’s Events team to ensure seamless execution and follow-up.
Assist in executing Corporate practice and EGVC-specific BD initiatives, such as preparing targeted venture capital market content (e.g., startup-focused newsletters or thought leadership pieces) and supporting lateral partner integration by ensuring immediate BD opportunities (client introductions, welcome communications) are carried out effectively.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including design, communications, and digital teams to ensure Corporate and EGVC deliverables are on-brand and delivered on time.
Collaborate with BD team members and lawyers to assist with pitches, proposals, credential submissions and other client-facing materials and marketing collateral.
Update and maintain CRM records, track business development activity, and help pull reports or dashboards as needed.
Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and client developments to support strategy development and benchmark progress.
Supports and advises on EGVC and other Corporate practice group-related directory and league table submissions and industry awards.
Maintain experience and matter tracking tools and assist with updates as needed.
Help support onboarding activities for new lawyers from a BD and marketing perspective.
Assist with budget tracking and administrative coordination for marketing expenses.

Desired Skills  

The ideal candidate has previous experience in a marketing or business development role within a professional services or law firm setting supporting emerging growth & venture capital (or related transactional practice areas). They have proven ability to manage multiple projects independently and partner confidently with senior stakeholders. They are highly organized, detail-focused, and able to manage multiple tasks simultaneously while meeting deadlines. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, are essential, as is the ability to collaborate effectively with team members and attorneys. Candidates should have working proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, and comfort using AI, digital tools and CRM systems. A positive, team-oriented attitude, professional demeanor, and eagerness to learn are critical to success in this role.

Minimum Education   

Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Communications, Business or related field.

Minimum Years Of Experience  

5 years’ experience in marketing and/or business development in a professional services environment.

Essential Job Expectations

All DLA Piper employees are expected to demonstrate excellence in how we serve our clients and develop our people, upholding our firm values as part of our culture. Specific expectations include:

Communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, with clients, lawyers, business professionals, and external audiences.
Produce high-quality work and respond to correspondence in an efficient, timely, and professional manner.
Meet deadlines, manage competing priorities, and commit to meeting high standards.
Comply with firm policies and procedures.
Maintain confidences as required in a law firm environment.

Physical Demands

Sedentary work: This is primarily sedentary work, requiring occasional exertion of up to 10 pounds of force to lift, carry, push, pull, or move objects. The role involves sitting for extended periods, with occasional walking and standing, and occasional travel, both domestic and international.

Work Environment   

The individual selected for this position may have the opportunity for a hybrid work arrangement combining remote and in-office work. The specific arrangement will be determined at the time of hiring and may be modified at the firm's discretion.

jobs.title: Director, Product Marketing & Commercialization
jobs.description:
The Role

Lead the product marketing and commercialization organization responsible for turning product strategy into clear market value, successful launches, strong commercial readiness, and sustained customer adoption.

At Wolters Kluwer Health, the UpToDate suite supports millions of clinical decisions every day. As our portfolio evolves through AI-enabled experiences, new clinical workflows, major product enhancements, and expanded customer solutions, we need a strong product marketing and commercialization function that connects customer needs, market dynamics, product capabilities, and business priorities.

As Director, Product Marketing & Commercialization, you will lead the organization responsible for Product Marketing, Market Intelligence, Competitive Intelligence, Market Research, and Product Packaging and Go-to-Market for the Clinical Decision Support portfolio.

You will define how products are validated, positioned, packaged, launched, enabled, adopted, and optimized throughout the product lifecycle. You will lead and develop a team of product marketing and insights professionals and work closely with Product Management, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Partnerships, Strategy, Finance, Training, Operations, and Executive Leadership.

This role requires a leader who can set strategy, build organizational capabilities, develop talent, align complex cross-functional teams, and ensure high-quality execution. You will serve as a senior advisor to Product and business leadership on customer needs, market dynamics, competitive differentiation, commercialization choices, and growth opportunities.

What You’ll Do

Product Marketing and Commercialization Leadership

Define and execute the Product Marketing and Commercialization strategy for the Clinical Decision Support portfolio.
Lead and develop the organization responsible for Product Marketing, Market Intelligence, Competitive Intelligence, Market Research, and Product Packaging and Go-to-Market.
Establish clear priorities, roles, responsibilities, operating rhythms, and decision rights across the function.
Allocate resources across product launches, portfolio initiatives, market opportunities, and strategic priorities.
Build a high-performing, customer-centric, and market-driven team with strong capabilities in product marketing, commercialization, research, packaging, and competitive strategy.
Coach and develop product marketing and market insights leaders and specialists.
Serve as a senior advisor to Product and Executive Leadership on commercialization strategy, portfolio opportunities, customer needs, market dynamics, and competitive risks.

Product Positioning and Messaging

Own the product positioning and messaging architecture for the Clinical Decision Support portfolio.
Ensure products and capabilities have clear, differentiated positioning grounded in customer needs, market evidence, product value, and competitive advantage.
Oversee the development and maintenance of value propositions, persona-based messaging, use cases, proof points, product narratives, and Product Value Messaging documents.
Ensure messaging is accurate, compelling, consistent, and usable across sales materials, campaigns, training, demos, partnerships, and customer communications.
Establish standards and governance for product messaging and customer-facing product content.
Ensure customer and market feedback is regularly incorporated into positioning, messaging, campaign planning, and product decisions.

Go-to-Market and Launch Strategy

Own the commercialization framework from early opportunity validation through Early Engagement, Limited Market Release, General Availability, adoption, and lifecycle optimization.
Lead go-to-market strategy for new products, AI-enabled capabilities, major enhancements, and priority portfolio initiatives.
Establish launch governance, readiness criteria, milestones, decision points, commercialization plans, and cross-functional accountability.
Ensure Product Marketing is involved early enough to influence target customer selection, use cases, value propositions, market validation, packaging, and commercial viability.
Coordinate launch activities across Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Partnerships, Training, Finance, Legal, Operations, and other stakeholders.
Ensure launches have clear target customers, validated customer needs, differentiated positioning, effective packaging, enablement plans, adoption strategies, and measurable outcomes.
Drive consistency and continuous improvement across product launches and commercialization practices.

Packaging and Commercial Strategy

Lead product packaging and offer strategy across the portfolio.
Establish the approach for solution packaging, feature and capability grouping, offer design, naming, bundling, and portfolio architecture.
Partner with Product, Strategy, Finance, Sales, and business leadership to inform pricing strategy, willingness-to-pay research, business cases, market sizing, pipeline assumptions, and revenue opportunities.
Ensure packaging decisions are grounded in customer needs, purchasing behavior, competitive dynamics, product value, and operational feasibility.
Identify opportunities to simplify the portfolio, improve customer understanding, strengthen differentiation, and support commercial growth.

Commercial Enablement and Readiness

Provide leadership for commercial readiness across Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Partnerships, Marketing, Training, and other market-facing teams.
Establish governance and quality standards for sales enablement, product collateral, pitch decks, demo narratives, sell sheets, FAQs, release communications, and customer-facing materials.
Ensure market-facing teams understand product value, target customers, priority use cases, competitive differentiation, packaging, and launch strategy.
Partner with Sales Training and functional leaders to develop product and competitive training programs.
Measure the usefulness, adoption, and effectiveness of product marketing and enablement materials.
Drive alignment across market-facing teams to support successful launches, adoption, customer value realization, and portfolio growth.

Market and Customer Intelligence

Lead the market intelligence strategy for the Clinical Decision Support business.
Ensure customer, buyer, user, market, and industry insights inform product strategy, portfolio decisions, positioning, packaging, and commercialization priorities.
Oversee Voice of Customer programs, customer interviews, user forums, market trend monitoring, segmentation, market sizing, and primary and secondary research.
Ensure the organization proactively identifies emerging customer needs, purchasing dynamics, technology shifts, market risks, and growth opportunities.
Establish a regular cadence of market insights, customer need themes, leadership briefings, and actionable recommendations.
Ensure market insights are clearly communicated to Product teams, Strategy, Marketing, commercial stakeholders, and Executive Leadership.

Competitive Intelligence

Provide leadership and oversight for the competitive intelligence function.
Ensure timely and actionable competitive intelligence helps Product, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Executive Leadership anticipate market shifts and respond effectively.
Oversee competitor monitoring, rapid-response analysis, battlecards, competitive briefings, conference intelligence, product comparisons, and field enablement.
Ensure competitive insights are translated into implications for product strategy, positioning, messaging, packaging, roadmap decisions, and commercial execution.
Increase awareness, adoption, and effective use of competitive intelligence resources across the organization.
Foster a culture of competitive awareness and market responsiveness.

Analytics and Performance

Define the performance framework for Product Marketing and Commercialization.
Establish metrics and executive dashboards that measure launch readiness, commercialization effectiveness, product adoption, enablement effectiveness, market insight delivery, competitive readiness, and organizational impact.
Lead operating reviews that evaluate launch performance, adoption, customer and field feedback, market developments, and progress against strategic priorities.
Ensure product marketing and insights teams use data to identify risks, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
Translate performance insights into changes to messaging, packaging, enablement, commercialization strategy, resource allocation, and organizational practices.
Communicate results, recommendations, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to senior and executive stakeholders.

What You’ll Bring

12+ years of experience in product marketing, commercialization, go-to-market strategy, portfolio marketing, market strategy, or related roles.
Significant leadership experience building and managing product marketing, commercialization, market intelligence, competitive intelligence, market research, or related teams.
Demonstrated success commercializing complex healthcare, enterprise SaaS, technology, data, information, workflow, content, or platform products.
Experience establishing and scaling product marketing operating models, launch frameworks, governance, messaging standards, and commercialization practices.
Strong understanding of product positioning, messaging, customer segmentation, buyer and user personas, value propositions, product launches, adoption, and lifecycle marketing.
Experience with product packaging, offer design, bundling, pricing inputs, willingness-to-pay research, market sizing, business cases, and commercial strategy.
Demonstrated ability to use customer, market, competitive, and performance insights to influence product strategy, portfolio decisions, and executive priorities.
Strong people-leadership skills, including organizational design, talent development, coaching, performance management, and resource prioritization.
Ability to lead through influence and align Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Strategy, Legal, Operations, and executive stakeholders.
Strong strategic and analytical thinking, with the ability to connect market dynamics and customer needs to practical business and product decisions.
Excellent executive communication, storytelling, and presentation skills.
Ability to operate effectively in a complex, global, and highly matrixed organization.
Ability to move comfortably between enterprise strategy, organizational leadership, cross-functional alignment, and detailed execution.

Preferred Background

Experience in healthcare technology, clinical decision support, digital health, professional information, enterprise workflow, or regulated markets.
Experience commercializing AI-enabled products, clinical workflow solutions, data products, search, content, platforms, or decision-support products.
Experience supporting products with multiple customer segments, buyer types, users, geographic markets, and commercial models.
Experience leading Early Engagement, Limited Market Release, pilot, beta, and General Availability programs.
Experience with enterprise healthcare buyers, health system purchasing processes, clinical users, long sales cycles, and complex customer implementations.
Experience overseeing Voice of Customer, market research, competitive intelligence, segmentation, pricing, packaging, or win-loss programs.
Experience building or transforming product marketing and commercialization capabilities.
Familiarity with competitive intelligence, market research, enablement, analytics, and product marketing technology platforms.

What Success Looks Like

You will work closely with key suppliers and internal partners to turn innovative ingredients, supplier capabilities, and market opportunities into compelling solutions that help our customers win.

This role sits at the intersection of product management, supplier management, marketing, technical expertise, and commercial strategy. You will shape portfolio strategy, develop growth plans, manage supplier relationships, support pricing and profitability, and equip our sales organization with the insights and tools needed to grow the business.

The Daily Mail
reaches one of the largest news audiences in the United States. Daily Mail+ is our growing subscription product, and the US market will play an important role in reaching our ambition of one million subscribers by FY28.

We are hiring a Manager, CRM/Lifecycle Marketing
to lead day-to-day CRM and marketing activation for Daily Mail+ in the US. Own US CRM Campaign Execution-
Plan and execute CRM campaigns for the US subscriber base, including send planning, content development and adaptation, audience coordination, timing, and channel selection.
Manage email as the primary CRM channel today and support the introduction of push, in-app, and other channels for the US audience.
Maintain an accurate campaign calendar and coordinate dependencies so activity launches on time and to a consistently high standard.

Adapt Activation for the US Market-
Translate centrally developed lifecycle strategy, segmentation, and campaigns into activity that reflects US audience needs, seasonality, tone, and market context.
Serve as the primary connection point to London on what is working, what is not, and what the US market needs.
Support the US Acquisition team with activation execution when dedicated capacity is needed, aligning priorities with the Director of Subscription Growth.

Embed Compliance from the Start-
Own the day-to-day relationship with Legal on US data-protection, consent, and marketing-permission requirements, including CAN-SPAM, TCPA, and CCPA/CPRA.
Build compliance requirements into campaign planning and execution rather than treating them as a final-stage review.
Maintain clear processes and documentation to support compliant, consistent activation across channels.

Improve Performance through Insight and Testing-
Monitor CRM engagement, retention, churn, and acquisition-activation results and use performance data to improve future activity.
Partner with CRM, Customer Intelligence, and Analytics teams to evaluate campaign performance and identify actionable audience insights.
Develop a practical testing cadence across content, timing, segmentation, offers, and channels, and apply learnings across the US program.

About You-

At least four years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, marketing activation, or a closely related discipline.
Hands-on experience building and executing customer campaigns, preferably across email and at least one additional owned channel.
Experience adapting centralized or global marketing strategies for a local market.
Working knowledge of US marketing-compliance requirements, including CAN-SPAM, TCPA, and CCPA/CPRA.
Strong project-management skills and the ability to manage multiple campaigns, stakeholders, and deadlines.
Strong analytical judgment and the ability to turn campaign results into practical improvements.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work effectively across US and international teams.
Experience in subscriptions, media, publishing, or another high-volume consumer business is preferred.

Assume ownership of live US CRM campaign execution and establish a clear forward campaign calendar.
Complete a review of current US CRM activity, processes, performance, and channel readiness, identifying the most immediate opportunities and risks.
Establish an effective working model with Legal for US marketing compliance and confirm how requirements are incorporated into campaign planning and approvals.
Agree priorities and ways of working with the CRM and Customer Intelligence teams in London and the US Acquisition team.
