Description

Infor is looking for a Director of Experimentation to lead a unified testing program across four digital channels: web, email, paid media, and chat. Experimentation is active in each channel today but managed separately, and this role becomes its single dedicated owner.

You will own the method the channels follow, coordinate priorities across teams you do not manage, and make results clear to stakeholders and senior leadership. Success in this role depends as much on cross-functional communication as on analytical rigor.

A Typical Day In The Life Includes

Owning the experimentation methodology used across web, email, paid media, and chat, including hypothesis standards, sample sizing, statistical thresholds, and analysis practices
Coordinating priorities across the four channel teams through a shared backlog, resolving conflicts when tests compete for the same audience or surface
Reviewing and approving experiment designs before build, declining tests that cannot conclude or are not properly instrumented
Communicating results through a regular reporting cadence and translating findings into recommendations leadership can act on
Building demand for experimentation across the organization by bringing new teams into the program and coaching partners on what makes a testable idea
Partnering with analytics and marketing technology teams to close measurement gaps that block valid testing
Managing the experimentation agency relationship and directing analyst support on readouts and significance analysis

Basic Qualifications

Experience owning a digital experimentation or conversion optimization program, rather than executing tests within one
Experience running experimentation across more than one digital channel
Working knowledge of experiment design statistics: statistical power, minimum detectable effect, sequential testing risks, and multiple comparisons
Experience presenting test results and recommendations to senior leadership
Experience leading a program through teams outside of direct reporting lines
Experience diagnosing digital measurement and event tracking issues
Experience managing an agency or vendor

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in enterprise B2B marketing with long sales cycles and low conversion volumes
Hands-on experience with GA4, tag management, and a testing or personalization platform
Experience with email experimentation under current inbox privacy and bot-activity constraints
Experience with paid media incrementality testing, including geo holdout designs
Experience running experimentation alongside a personalization program on shared surfaces

Join Hamilton Lane, a global leader in private markets, as we scale to meet the demands of our growing client base. Here, you’ll work with ambitious, high‑performing teams built on integrity, candor and collaboration, backed by our market-leading data and technology. We invest heavily in our people and our partners, giving you the platform to enrich lives, safeguard futures and grow your career.

What We Do

As one of the largest private markets investment firms globally, we provide innovative solutions to institutional and private wealth investors around the world, specializing in flexibility and full-spectrum access. We currently employ approximately 800 professionals operating in offices throughout North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and the Middle East, and have $1.0 trillion in assets under management and supervision, composed of $146.1 billion in discretionary assets and $871.5 billion in non-discretionary assets, as of December 31, 2025.

The Opportunity

Private markets continue to open to new investor bases, and the way capital is raised is being rewritten. Institutions are deepening their allocations. Evergreen and interval structures, expanding wealth platforms and advisor demand are bringing private markets to investors who have never had access before. The firms that win will understand every client segment better than anyone else and show up for each one with the right story, the right experience and the right timing.

The Head of Channel Marketing is a newly created role responsible for translating the firm’s commercial priorities into tailored marketing solutions for each client segment. Reporting to the Head of Marketing, this leader will work with Marketing, Client Solutions, Product and Investment to identify where growth will come from, then design and execute the full-funnel programs that capture it.

The role owns segmentation and audience strategy, and uses client insight, pipeline data and campaign performance to direct marketing investment toward the segments, platforms and accounts with the greatest opportunity. The Head of Channel Marketing is accountable for commercial outcomes, including pipeline created and influenced, conversion, assets raised, and client retention, and will build the strategy, team and processes for the channel marketing team.

Your Responsibilities Will Be To

Define and own the channel marketing strategy and multi-year roadmap for each priority segment, tied to the firm’s commercial goals
Own audience strategy across institutional and private wealth, and continually refine it with client insight, market intelligence and performance data
Partner with Product and Product Marketing to ensure the brand narrative and product positioning are translated into segment-specific messaging pillars that are consistent across the firm and distinctive in the market
Design full-funnel, multi-channel programs that drive awareness, engagement, conversion and retention across the client lifecycle, with clear targets for lead generation, pipeline and assets raised
Support the full product and client lifecycle, from launch and capital raising through ongoing education, retention and expansion
Build a trusted partnership with Client Solutions, aligning segment priorities, pipeline goals and coverage models, and provide the teams with the content, tools and insight they need to win
Establish shared lead definitions, hand-offs and feedback loops between Marketing and Sales
Set measurable goals and KPIs for every campaign/program, and report on engagement, pipeline contribution, conversion, assets raised and marketing ROI
Own channel budgets and manage agency and media partners, from brief through delivery, reallocating investment based on performance

Your Background Will Include

12+ years of marketing experience in asset management, private markets, alternatives or wealth management, with at least 5 years leading teams
A record of building from scratch: a channel strategy, a segmentation model, a team or a function that did not exist before you, and the results it delivered
Proven commercial impact, with specific outcomes you can point to, such as pipeline created, conversion improved, or assets raised
Experience owning segmentation and audience strategy, and shifting budget toward the segments and accounts that produce growth
Hands-on use of AI, automation and marketing technology to launch faster, personalize at scale and improve campaign performance, with results you can quantify
Command of investment products, client segments, distribution partners and the regulatory requirements for marketing in financial services; experience across institutional and wealth or intermediary audiences is a plus
Strong digital, CRM, marketing automation and analytics skills, and the judgment to turn data into decisions
Clear, concise communication of complex investment ideas to different audiences
Experience managing budgets and agency partners

At Hamilton Lane, our benefits philosophy is simple: to provide our employees with a competitive suite of benefits and services to help navigate through the complexities and challenges of working, living, raising a family, and eventually retiring. To do this, Hamilton Lane offers the following benefits:

Enhancing Your Physical and Emotional Health

Employees have access to healthcare coverage, mental health resources, health & fitness reimbursement program, and Wellness Rewards Program.

Developing Your Career

Tuition and certification reimbursement programs are available, along with continual education and development trainings for you to grow with Hamilton Lane.

For our communities, Hamilton Lane provides paid time off to volunteer and compensates for referring qualified candidates that join our team.

For growing family, we offer an adoption reimbursement program, paid time off for new parents and newlyweds, and provide travel support for nursing parents.

Hamilton Lane contributes to retirement programs and offers an employee stock purchasing plan.

Banana Republic is a storyteller’s brand, outfitting the modern explorer with high-quality, expertly crafted collections made to inspire and enrich life’s journeys. About The Role

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Manager to be an essential role in continuous development, optimization and support for Banana Republic’s CRM and retention strategies. This data-driven, customer-focused individual will be an integral part of the CRM Retention marketing team whose objective is to understand customer behaviors that drive long term value, loyalty and engagement and identify opportunities for personalization across the customer lifecycle.

What you'll do

Own the lifecycle roadmap

Own the lifecycle and triggered program portfolio across Email, SMS, & Push (including high-intent behavioral triggers, post-purchase and order communications, low in stock, and loyalty) across all verticals, including BR Specialty and BR Factory, with a distinct plan for each customer.
Prioritize the highest-value customer moments over program count. Make the call on what to build, scale, fix, or stop.
Own lifecycle across Email, SMS, and Push so programs work together across channels, not alongside each other.
Partner with the teams that own batch communications so triggered and lifecycle programs complement them and customers get the right message at the right time.

Diagnose performance and tell the story

Own program-level performance reporting and know it cold. Diagnose what is moving and why, including year-over-year and week-over-week changes.
Separate real efficiency gains from mix shifts and volume effects, and attributed demand from incremental demand.
Reconcile data across sources and validate your numbers before they reach leadership.
Translate results into clear business implications for senior leaders: what happened, why it matters, and what we are doing about it.

Test and learn

Build and run a test agenda tied to real strategic questions: what is incremental, which customer should receive what, and how much communication is productive.
Read results carefully, know what a test actually proved, and make a clear scale, modify, or stop recommendation.

Move toward customer-level contact strategy

Help shape how we decide the best communication for a customer when they qualify for several at once.
Evaluate decisions on demand, engagement, and file health together, not demand alone.
Work with analytics and CRM partners to deepen personalization where it creates measurable value.

Execute with rigor

Run program builds, launches, and QA end to end with Digital Production, Brand and Content, Analytics, and our technology and vendor partners.
Manage timelines and hold partners accountable. Escalate early, with a recommendation attached.

Direct Mail (Retention)

Full end-to-end management of our retention Direct Mail program, including audience selection, creative briefing, execution and measuring incrementality and ROI.

Who you are

What Great Looks Like

Independent. You take an ambiguous problem from question to recommendation with minimal direction, and you bring solutions when you flag issues.
Strategic. You connect the tactical decision to the bigger customer and business question.
Analytical and precise. You are comfortable in the data, you check your own work, and you are careful not to claim more than the data supports.
An owner. Results, quality, and follow-through are yours, and partners trust you to deliver.

Hands-on experience owning triggered or lifecycle programs in an email service provider or marketing automation platform, as well as SMS and Push platforms for retail.

Working knowledge of test design and incrementality, and the judgment to separate correlation from causation

Proven ability to work across teams and navigate a large company
Customer-obsessed, with a bias toward action

We find purpose in proactively protecting and keeping our customers connected to home, no matter where they are. Join the Smart Home team to create smarter, safer and more sustainable homes.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Graphic Designer with strong visual instincts, thoughtful craft, and the ability to turn a brief into clear, compelling creative. You’ll join Vivint’s Brand & Digital Design team and work with designers, copywriters, and marketing partners to bring advertising, brand campaigns, digital experiences, and customer communications to life.

You’ll contribute ideas, build thoughtful layouts, and carry projects through revisions and final production. The ideal designer is comfortable working within an established brand while finding opportunities to make the work feel fresh, useful, and cohesive.

What You'll Do

Design advertising and marketing creative across digital and customer marketing, including paid media, social, email, customer communications, and digital and print campaigns.
Develop creative for broader brand and advertising initiatives, including campaign concepts, web graphics, presentations, and marketing collateral.
Translate creative briefs and messaging into clear visual concepts, layouts, and finished designs.
Adapt creative across channels, sizes, and formats while maintaining consistent typography, color, imagery, and hierarchy.
Collaborate with copywriters, marketing partners, and other designers to align creative with audience needs and project goals.
Apply Vivint’s brand guidelines and contribute to reusable templates and design patterns that make recurring work more efficient.
Present work clearly, incorporate feedback thoughtfully, and communicate progress and dependencies.
Prepare organized files and production-ready assets; check details, consistency, and accuracy before handoff.
Manage multiple projects and deadlines with support from the design team.

Minimum Qualifications

A portfolio that demonstrates strong typography, layout, composition, and brand application across digital and print work.
At least 2 years of relevant professional graphic design experience, including in-house, agency, or freelance work, with the ability to take assigned projects from brief through final delivery.
Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign.
Proficiency with generative AI tools to explore concepts, create and refine imagery and other creative assets, and integrate outputs into polished, on-brand advertising.
An understanding of designing for different formats and channels, including responsive digital layouts and print production.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to balance visual quality with clear communication.
A collaborative approach, openness to feedback, and the ability to explain your design decisions.
Good organization, time management, and communication skills.
A college degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field, or equivalent professional design experience demonstrated through a strong portfolio.
No professional certifications required.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience designing integrated advertising campaigns across paid media, social, email, web, or print.
Experience working with brand systems, component libraries, or reusable creative templates.
Basic motion design or animation skills.
Experience partnering with digital marketing, Customer Marketing, or an in-house creative team.

Portfolio

Please include a portfolio with your application. We’d like to see examples of your design craft, how you apply a brand across different formats, and the role you played in the work.

Website Online Optimism

We make marketing personal.

Other agencies might call it an internship program, but we offer and expect more.

Our Specialist program was crafted to be the leading program for college students and recent grads to build a future career in marketing or design. We see it as the last internship you’ll ever do.

Our Specialists work 25 – 35 hours per week (part or full-time with a daily hour lunch break) collaborating with our full-time employees, working for both our clients and Online Optimism itself. In return, we make sure they receive valuable, real-world experience, hourly pay, and the opportunity to team up with the best and brightest in the city.

You must be located in the Greater New Orleans region to apply for this position, and able to come to our office up to once per week.

To be considered you must apply through our website at https://onlineoptimism.com/career/social-media-video-specialist/

You should apply for our Social Media Video Specialist position if you want:

To build your video marketing or social media portfolio.
To get more comfortable in front of a camera, on your own or with a team.
Real, hands-on experience helping create content for local and national clients.
To learn how a short-form video idea moves from trend to final post.

You Have:

A creator’s instinct for what makes a short-form video work.
An eye for social media video trends and short-form storytelling.
Comfort, or growing confidence, in front of a camera.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Reliability and availability to travel to shoots around the New Orleans area.

You’re Excited By:

Helping brainstorm video ideas for clients across a range of industries, plus our own agency content.
Being both in front of and behind the camera, depending on what a shoot needs.
Researching social media video trends to stay ahead of what’s working right now.
Growing a video marketing portfolio (not a filmmaking reel).

What Are Some Features of Our Specialist Program?

Real Work, Real Experience

You’ll spend your time here working on real assignments and projects, being involved in actual client work, and teaming up with full-time Optimists as well as handling tasks independently. As one of our Specialists, you’ll leave us with a complete portfolio of work as well as a killer answer when you’re asked to talk about a time you proved yourself in your next interview.

Cold, Hard Cash

We provide $17/hour pay to all of our Specialists. For those still in school, we’re also happy to do everything we can to get you college credit. In addition, we’ll send you to networking events and educational lunches, ticket included.

Launch Your Career

A majority of our full-time team started at Online Optimism as Specialists, and many of our Specialists go on to work at some of the top digital marketing agencies around.

An Optimistic Culture

Our Company Aims To Keep Our Team Happy And Facilitate Work Any Way We Can, Which Is Why We Provide You:

A casual dress code
Remote and in-office happy hours
DEI learning through webinars and courses
Wellness challenges
Affinity groups
Book club
Networking opportunities

jobs.description:
As a Google Cloud Premier Partner, we work with some of the most exciting companies across financial services, retail, technology, and emerging industries. What makes us different is our belief that technology alone doesn't create transformation. People do.

Today, tridorian operates across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the US, serving customers from startups to enterprise organizations. As we continue to grow, we're looking for curious, ambitious people who want to help shape the future of cloud, data, AI, and cybersecurity.

We believe great companies are built on great relationships.

Our culture is grounded in three core values:
Curiosity
: We continuously learn, challenge assumptions, and seek better solutions.
Trust
: We act with transparency, accountability, and ownership.
Courage
: We embrace challenges, drive change, and pursue ambitious goals.

In this role, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by contributing your expertise, collaborating with talented colleagues, and helping drive our continued growth and success. You'll be empowered to take ownership, develop your skills, and play an important role in shaping the future of tridorian.

About the Role

This is a new, permanent Field Marketing Manager role based in the USA, focusing on North America. You will be a mid-to-senior individual contributor responsible for driving our go-to-market strategies through impactful events, partner marketing, and sales enablement collateral.

Main Responsibilities

Own and maintain the North America event and campaign calendar, ensuring visibility and alignment with sales and leadership.
Plan and execute a variety of events across the US and Canada, managing content, agenda, speakers, and attendee experience.
Manage and report on partner marketing funds, including application, compliance, and budget utilization.
Develop and coordinate sales-facing collateral, including call scripts, sales talk tracks, one-pagers, and pitch decks.
Collaborate with the global marketing team to ensure alignment on brand initiatives and messaging.
Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including sales teams, Google, and external vendors.
Track event performance and report on pipeline and engagement impact.

Required Experience

4+ years of experience in field marketing, partner marketing, or event marketing, preferably within a B2B tech or SaaS environment.
Proven experience managing co-op/partner marketing funds (MDF, PSF, or similar), including compliance and reporting.
Demonstrated success in planning and executing in-person events such as roundtables, dinners, and executive briefings.
Strong understanding of B2B marketing strategies across different market segments, industries, and decision-maker personas.
Experience working closely with Sales teams to provide localized marketing support aligned with their needs.
Proficiency with Google Workspace, CRM tools, and analytics platforms.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience coordinating with external partners and internal stakeholders.

Preferred Experience

Experience within the Google Cloud ecosystem.
Familiarity with marketing for tech companies focused on AI solutions.
Experience with HubSpot and Attio.

About the Team

You'll join a globally distributed Global Marketing Team, spanning EMEA and APAC. We are a collaborative group passionate about building tridorian's brand, thought leadership, events, and demand generation initiatives. We thrive on trust, ownership, and responsibility, working hand-in-hand with local Sales teams to deeply embed ourselves in their planning and execution.

We are a diverse team committed to solving meaningful problems and unlocking the full potential of cloud and AI for our customers. While we are dedicated to our work, we also deeply value collaboration, continuous learning, and building strong professional relationships. We celebrate our collective successes, support each other's growth, and cultivate an environment where everyone can perform at their best.

With a ‘One Team’ mentality, promote and sell franchise services in assigned territory, which results in meeting or exceeding assigned sales goals. Understanding, adhering to and promoting safety and guidelines while in the office and traveling

Talent in identifying and maximizing opportunities to build relationships with clients and customers to create win-win situations and support the business.
Comfortable with setting and running appointments, educational classes and community events in a group setting

“We Build Careers” - Steve White, President and COO

Apply today and join our Winning TEAM.

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Strategist
jobs.description:
Great marketing happens when people who have a problem or a need can connect with great organizations who can help them. When you are marketing at Idaho Youth Ranch, that concept takes on a whole new meaning: Young people and their families come to Idaho Youth Ranch seeking healing and hope from traumas that are keeping them from living up to their full potential.

Our brand is more than colors and fonts on social media. It is about hope and resilience.

The Performance Marketing Strategist at Idaho Youth Ranch plays an essential role in helping connect families and young people who are facing adversity, trauma, and loss with caring adults who will help them get the safety and support they need to heal.

You will be putting your unique talents and skills to work to redefine the future for Idaho’s kids while being part of a supportive team environment.

How does Idaho Youth Ranch view their brand and communications?
Idaho Youth Ranch is a diverse organization with unique marketing needs. From marketing 24 thrift stores, a car lot, and an ecommerce department to managing marketing campaigns for a statewide network of life-changing programs, our Performance Marketing Strategist must be able to see the big picture to help the public understand that when kids need help, we are here and anyone who cares about Idaho’s kids can help through donations, volunteerism, or shopping.

We are looking for someone who understands how to use the elements of branding to tell a cohesive story to anyone who interacts with our organization.

So, who are we?
Since 1953, Idaho Youth Ranch has provided healing and hope for Idaho’s kids. We use proven therapies and programs to help kids who have experienced loss or adversity transform childhood trauma into hope. We offer a statewide network of services to kids 9–24 years old and their families, including outpatient therapies, residential care, adoption services, and career readiness.

The Idaho Youth Ranch is one of the oldest non-profit agencies in the state of Idaho. Our mission:

We unite for Idaho’s youth by providing accessible programs and services that nurture hope, healing, and resilience.

Why unite with us?
Because we are better together! Our team members enjoy a workplace where Relationships
are the foundation, where we are all Committed
to the same mission, where Growth
is always possible, where we are treated with and show Compassion
, where trust guides us to Transparency
, and above all, where Joy
sustains us.

What do we offer?
In addition to contributing to our awesome mission, working at IYR has many advantages! Affordable medical and dental care, other voluntary benefits offerings, a 401(k) match, paid time off, an employee discount on purchases at our thrift stores, and working in a caring and compassionate environment just to name a few.

How will you impact our mission?
Every position at Idaho Youth Ranch contributes to the success of our mission. As the Performance Marketing Strategist, your work directly impacts our ability provide life-changing therapies to the youth we serve. You play a lead role in helping parents of Idaho’s most vulnerable youth learn Idaho Youth Ranch can provide the healing and hope they need. As a leader in our branding, website, and social media, you play a critical role in public understanding and support for Idaho Youth Ranch.

Your design skills and messaging skills play a key role in communication both within Idaho Youth Ranch and in in the broader community. Your work is often the public face of Idaho Youth Ranch and plays an important role in perceptions of Idaho Youth Ranch.

Must Haves

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications or related field
2+ years of digital communications experience
Demonstrated success in developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies that drive measurable results.
Strong, hands-on Google Ads experience is required, including campaign build and account structure, keyword and audience strategy, Performance Max, budget and bid management, conversion tracking, and performance reporting.
Experience managing a Google Ad Grants (nonprofit) account is preferred, including Ad Grants policy compliance, account structure, and maintaining click-through rate and quality score requirements.
Strong, hands-on Meta ads experience is required, including Meta Ads Manager, audience building and retargeting, creative testing, Pixel and Conversions API tracking, and budget optimization across Facebook and Instagram.
Experience applying paid media to both talent acquisition (recruiting) and retail customer acquisition, with the ability to manage separate campaign strategies and budgets for each.
Working knowledge of TikTok as a marketing channel, including short-form video content and TikTok paid advertising.
Proficiency with Google Analytics (GA4) and Google Tag Manager to measure, attribute, and report campaign performance.

Our Performance Marketing Strategist Will

Recommend, develop, and execute paid media campaigns to support staff recruiting, including hands-on management of Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, and display) and Meta ads on Facebook and Instagram to drive qualified applicant volume.
Build, manage, and optimize recruiting ad campaigns end to end, including audience targeting, creative and copy testing, budget pacing, bid strategy, and conversion tracking, to reduce cost per qualified applicant and shorten time to fill.
Grow and manage TikTok as a core social enterprise channel, producing short-form video content, leveraging trends and creator partnerships, and running TikTok paid placements to reach thrift shoppers and vehicle donors.
Provides paid media execution support for client acquisition campaigns as assigned, reaching families and referral sources seeking Idaho Youth Ranch services.
Supports growth by developing and executing comprehensive marketing plans to drive customer acquisition, retention, and sales growth for thrift stores
Produces and publishes social media content for recruiting and social enterprise business areas, working within the organization-wide social media strategy, calendar, and channel governance maintained elsewhere in the department.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
National Forest Foundation (NFF)
is pleased to offer an exempt, full-time position who will be responsible for managing NFF's social media presence including strategy, content, community, and results. The Social Media Manager is a chance for a curious, culture-obsessed storyteller and strategist who sees endless possibility to grow NFF's social presence into the online place people visit to fall in love with forests, deepening this appreciation for themselves and, ultimately, supporting the NFF so we can preserve these landscapes for future generations.

About the NFF:
The National Forest Foundation, chartered by Congress in 1990, is the official national partner to the US Forest Service (USFS). In recent years, the Foundation has grown significantly in organizational capacity, revenue, and programmatic impact. Today, the NFF works with people, partners and communities across the country to restore forests and watersheds; make forests more resilient to wildfire; and ensure accessible and sustainable opportunities for recreation in our National Forests. NFF leads with impact, deploying roughly 90% of its expenses towards projects and programs across the country's 193-million-acre National Forest System. NFF is forward-thinking and innovative, with ambitious strategies and goals building toward a bold future: a world where caring for our forests is second nature.

Position Function:
The Social Media Manager reports to the Marketing Director and is a growth-oriented position for someone who finds a way to turn NFF's mission and on-the-ground impact into scroll-stopping, share-worthy stories, with a particular emphasis on video. Working closely with the Director of Marketing, the Content & Creative team, and teams across the organization, this role considers the “we over me” approach to collaboration and translates local conservation projects into stories that resonate locally and nationally. Success will be measured by growth in reach, engagement, and community.

Position Duties and Responsibilities:
The Social Media Manager will:

Social Media Strategy & Growth

Develop and own an audience-centered organic social media strategy aligned with NFF's brand, marketing and advancement priorities and organizational goals
Assess target audience, distinct platform fit, and strategic priorities to decide where NFF should invest, which channels get full strategic and day-to-day ownership, and which get a lighter footprint, and evolve that approach over time as audiences and platforms shift
Establish channel-specific objectives, key performance indicators and growth targets, and demonstrate measurable growth in reach, engagement, followers, and other measurable audience actions
Monitor platform changes, audience behavior, cultural conversations and emerging trends to keep NFF's presence current, relevant and a step ahead
Develop and maintain an integrated social media content calendar aligned with high-level marketing strategy, organizational strategy, conservation priorities, seasonal moments and audience interests
Partner with NFF's growth marketing agency, sharing data, learning outcomes and insight that fuels larger acquisition and fundraising campaigns

Analytics, Testing & Optimization

Monitor and analyze channel, content, audience and campaign performance, and translate data into clear, actionable recommendations
Design and run structured tests across formats, creative approaches, messages and calls to action; document findings and apply learning going forward
Identify the organic content that resonates most, and use a designated amplification budget to extend its reach to new and existing audiences
Build and maintain social media dashboards and reports that communicate results, lessons learned and opportunities to drive goals; recommend key performance indicators that support marketing and organization-wide strategy

Community, Creator & Influencer Engagement

Manage NFF's social communities daily, responding to comments and messages, encouraging conversation, and cultivating relationships with followers, fans and supporters
Use social listening to understand audience interests, monitor sentiment, and uncover emerging engagement opportunities as well as potential risks to reputation
Own direct relationship management with a select set of creators and community voices, while partnering with NFF's influencer agency of record, which leads vetting, contracting and logistics for broader creator and influencer campaigns
Apply sound judgment when responding to marketplace influences, misinformation or sensitive issues, and follow escalation and response protocols for emerging or rapidly developing situations

Content Creation

Translate complex conservation projects and technical subject matter into clear, actionable creative briefs to inspire engaging and share-worthy content development
Oversee and guide social content development, inspiring content creators to consider scroll-stopping hooks, pacing, narrative structure and calls to action aligned with each platform
Create compelling, platform-native content including copy, graphics, photography and, especially, short-form video, adapting stories and assets to the audience, format and best practices of each platform
Build strong relationships across NFF to maintain a steady pipeline of timely, representative and geographically diverse stories to fuel storytelling across social platforms
Build familiarity with wide-ranging creative assets and identify opportunities to repurpose video, photography or copy into multiple platform-specific formats
Serve as a brand steward, ensuring social content is consistent with NFF's voice, look and feel; maintain accuracy, accessibility and editorial standards across all social content

Collaboration

Collaborate with email, web, fundraising, communications, partnerships and field teams to build coordinated, cross-channel campaigns
Ensure social media supports email acquisition, donor engagement, fundraising and program participation without directly owning those functions
Share social media guidance, content co-creation ideas and performance insights with colleagues, partners and key stakeholders

Education and Qualifications:
NFF expects the Social Media Manager to bring the following education and experience:

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
5+ years of experience managing social media, developing dashboards and making data-informed decisions for a national brand, with a track record of significant organic audience growth
Experience using a designated budget to boost or amplify organic content, and comfort partnering with an agency on broader paid social campaigns
Proficiency with social media management and scheduling tools, social listening tools, and analytics platforms (e.g., Meta Business Suite, native platform analytics, Sprout Social, Google Analytics or similar)
Strong hands-on video production and editing skills, including short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Facebook
Experience collaborating with outside agencies, freelancers or contractors
Must be authorized to work in the United States

Abilities and Skills:
NFF expects the Social Media Manager to bring the following abilities and skills:

Deeply curious and addicted to culture and what's trending, someone who doesn't just find the inspiration, but delivers it for others
Strategic thinker who can weigh audience, platform and data to decide where to invest, then adapt that thinking as things change
Natural storyteller with a filmmaker's eye for the shot, sound and moment that stops the scroll
Collaborative partner who values diverse input and works comfortably with agencies, creators and teams across the organization
Owns and advocates for audience-first perspective; listens to community feedback and adjusts tone and approach; warm, welcoming and inclusive communicator
Self-starter comfortable with ambiguity and energized by change; treats every test, win or miss as a chance to learn and grow
Sees the big picture, connecting everyday content to NFF's long-term mission and impact
Exercises sound judgment on sensitive or reputationally sensitive topics
Growth mindset with a bias toward action and follow-through

Location:
This is a remote/work-from-home position open to candidates in the lower 48 states. Reliable internet access and a dedicated workspace are required. Occasional travel for team gatherings or content capture may be expected.

Compensation:
NFF offers a competitive compensation and benefits package that reflects our total rewards strategy. The salary range for this position is $95,000 with the ability to grow to $118,750 based on performance over time. Starting salary within this range is determined by a combination of experience, internal equity with comparable roles, and organizational budget, and is assessed annually as part of NFF's compensation review process.

Benefits:
NFF is proud to offer our staff:

Health and Wellness

Medical and dental insurance paid at 75% by the organization for you and any dependents
Vision insurance paid 50% by the organization for you and any dependents
Health savings account (HSA) with employer contributions, predicated on coverage type
Healthcare and dependent care flexible spending accounts (FSA)
Employee assistance program (EAP) at no cost

Financial Wellbeing

403(b) retirement plan with a 5% employer match after one (1) year of service
Short-term and long-term disability insurance at no cost
Basic life and AD&D insurance at no cost, with voluntary life insurance options

Flexibility and Time Off

Employees start with 35 days of annual leave, sick leave, personal leave and holidays
Family & medical leave for up to sixteen (16) weeks with up to four (4) weeks paid

Personal Development

Training & Development Programs
Professional development reimbursement up to $1,000 per year

Journey of a Lifetime

The opportunity to support an incredible mission and travel to / work in spectacular locations

To Apply:
Applications must include both a cover letter and resume. Incomplete packages will not be considered. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting will close on November, 21st, or earlier if filled. Please visit our careers site to apply online.

jobs.description:
Hadrian - Manufacturing the Future

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

What You'll Do

As Hadrian's first product marketer you will drive how the market understands what we build and the impact it has. You'll work closely with Brand, Federal, Sales, Recruiting, and Hadrian leadership. This is a new function that you will have the opportunity to help shape from the ground up.

Set the positioning for every Hadrian offering: what we call it, who it’s for, and why it beats the alternatives. Embed with our engineers and customers until you can make the technical case to a customer’s engineering team as well as their executives.
Translate technical differentiation into mission impact. Make the copy, media, and products that show what our offerings do and why they matter. Find the proof in schedule, quality, and throughput, keeping positioning connected to customer results.
Equip every team that carries Hadrian's story with the narratives, competitive positioning, and product demos they need. Bring back what lands and use it to sharpen the story and inform the product.
Build the product marketing team: hire the specialists who join you, and develop a bench of design, video, and writing contractors you can call on.

What We're Looking For

5+ years at companies with technically complex products, with demonstrated experience defining their positioning and go-to-market. You learn complex systems quickly and turn them into clear, credible narratives. Engineers trust your technical explanations, whether they work here or at a customer. Your path may run through product marketing, technical marketing, engineering, or technical design.
AI-native, and relentless about it. We're looking for a ridiculously high-pace, high-agency marketer who uses AI to compress everything: research, writing, design, and production. You can show us concretely how AI already makes you multiples faster, and you're hungry to push it further.
Full stack across the craft. You write sharp copy and design strong slides, diagrams, and product graphics yourself, reaching for whatever medium best conveys the message. You have the taste to direct designers and video editors when the work calls for a specialist.
High-agency builder. You've been first or early in a function, found what was missing, and built it without waiting for a brief. You have a portfolio of work you personally made and can tell us which parts were yours.
Driven by the mission and the tempo. Rebuilding the industrial base matters to you, and you care about shipping at the pace our customers and teams need.

Experience in manufacturing, aerospace, defense, robotics, or industrial hardware, including selling to government customers or large primes.
A background in engineering, industrial design, or technical design.
A track record of content and positioning you can tie to business outcomes, such as pipeline, closed deals, or hires.

Experience hiring contractors and growing a team around your work.

In this high-impact role, you will be the subject matter expert and market voice for how organizations protect sensitive data wherever people work, communicate, and collaborate. This role is equal parts strategist, editor-in-chief, and operator. We’re looking for a sharp, versatile storyteller who can translate complex legal and AI topics into content people actually want to read. We move fast, value clarity over polish, and prioritize content that informs rather than advertises. This role requires legal expertise.

You’ll help set the content agenda, manage execution across multiple channels, and ensure every asset moves the needle on brand credibility, pipeline generation, and customer engagement. You’ll collaborate closely with Demand Gen, Product Marketing, Sales, Events, and Product to align content with revenue goals and company narrative.

What You’ll Do

Set Content Strategy: Define and own GC AI’s content strategy, aligning it with GTM priorities and industry trends.
Content Mix: Deliver a balanced mix of long-form content (white papers, reports), short-form thought leadership (LinkedIn posts, blogs), and campaign assets (email, landing pages, ads).
Taste and Craft: Uphold high editorial standards for clarity, precision, and restraint. Ensure GC AI’s content feels sophisticated, useful, personal, and unmistakably “ours.”
Editorial Leadership: Build and maintain a quarterly editorial calendar that supports awareness, demand gen, and customer marketing.
SEO and AEO partnership. Work with the digital/SEO+AEO lead to turn keyword and prompt opportunities into content.
Distribution and Amplification: Oversee cross-channel distribution (email, social, website, partner syndication) and ensure every piece is tracked and optimized for reach and impact.
Thought Leadership Engine: Elevate GC AI’s voice in the in-house legal community by producing high-value articles, white papers, op-eds, and bylined content.
Contributor Management: Commission and manage external contributors, subject-matter experts, and guest authors while ensuring consistency in tone, brand voice, and quality.
Quality and brand voice. Protect the voice. Every piece adheres to guidelines and hits a quality bar.
Measurement. Track performance: engagement, captures, pipeline contribution, share of voice.
Cross-functional support. Partner with PMM (positioning), DG (campaigns), corporate comms (PR), and the executive team (thought leadership).
Process & Operations: Manage editorial workflow, review cycles, and content library. Scale processes to support rapid growth.

What You'll Bring

A legal background is required
Proven track record of developing and scaling content strategies that drive brand authority and measurable pipeline impact.
Exceptional editorial instincts and writing/editing skills.
Experience commissioning and managing contributors, thought leaders, or SMEs.
Strong ability to write about a technical product.
Ability to juggle multiple initiatives, stakeholders, and deadlines.
Proven success partnering with sales, product, events, and PR.
Bonus: Executive ghostwriting or publishing in legal/regulated industries.

jobs.description:
Social Media Manager Job Summary

We are seeking a social media manager to maintain and grow our company's social networks. As a social media manager, you will update social networks and curate content to gain new followers. You will also create new social marketing campaigns, build brand recognition, and manage all published company content. While working with web analytic tools to track campaign progress and researching industry trends, you will maintain an active social presence and reply to customer inquiries. A successful social media manager will collaborate with marketing, PR, and legal teams to align company messages, promotions, and goals.

Social Media Manager Duties And Responsibilities

Develop and implement social media brand strategies, campaigns, and plans to build brand/company awareness.
Oversee day-to-day management of campaigns and ensure brand consistency.
Create, maintain, and grow new and existing social networks, including Twitter, LinkedIn, Pinterest, YouTube, Foursquare, Instagram, Google+, Facebook, and others.
Manage company blog and editorial calendar that aligns with social updates.
Monitor social media progress using web analytic tools.
Incorporate optimization strategies, analyze data, and research the best ways to increase traffic.
Review the success of campaigns and develop ways to improve.
Plan paid social media advertising strategies and budgets.
Secure new media partnerships
Drive engagement with social media influencers
Resolve customer issues through social media.
Create engaging written and visual content for blog.
Research new media platforms, trends, and industry opportunities
Provide feedback from social media trends and research; relay it to business strategists.
Write effective, concise copy for multiple platforms, websites, and social networks.

Social Media Manager Requirements And Qualifications

Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, PR, or related field and/or

Two years of social media management experience

Experience with Hootsuite, Sprout Social, or HubSpot

Knowledge of Photoshop, Illustrator, and Google Analytics

Proficient computer skills, Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Excel)

Knowledge of Search Engine Optimization (SEO) best practices

Experience with technologies and best practices for web design, web production, and creative design across multiple platforms

Experience identifying and creating campaigns for target audience.

Excellent analytical and time-management skills

Strong project management skills with the ability to supervise multiple projects.

This is a remote position.

Compensation: $44,000.00 - $65,000.00 per year

Choose a Rewarding Career with 1-800 WATER DAMAGE

1-800 WATER DAMAGE is a trusted property restoration company serving customers across the nation. With locations spanning coast-to-coast, we help home and business owners return their property to its original condition, while restoring what truly matters—health and safety. Our team is fully vetted, IICRC-certified, and insured for your safety.

What We Do

We handle a range of restoration projects including emergency mitigation, water damage restoration, carpet cleaning, fire and smoke damage restoration, sewage cleanup, mold remediation, and much more. We understand how stressful this situation can be, which is why we are equipped to help you deal with insurance companies, property management, and the many other parties interested or involved with the damage. Our water damage technicians, sales teams, and administrative professionals take pride in helping others through home and commercial building restoration.

Our Values

Owned by the BELFOR Franchise Group, 1-800 WATER DAMAGE is dedicated to excellence. We provide services with a personal touch but are also backed by the expertise of an internationally renowned restoration company. Because clients are going through an extremely difficult and emotionally taxing time, we provide caring support, upfront communication, and effective services. We believe in full transparency, which is why we provide customized solutions and pricing upfront.

This franchise is independently owned and operated by a franchisee. Your application will go directly to the franchisee, and all hiring decisions will be made by the management of this franchisee. All inquiries about employment at this franchisee should be made directly to the franchise location, and not to 1-800-Water Damage Corporate.

jobs.description:
Primary Talent Partners has a new contract opening for a Sr. Digital Marketing Experience Strategist
with our commercial real estate client Remote. This is a 12-month contract with a potential for extension.

Pay:
$80.00 - $95.00/hr
; W2 contract, no PTO, no Benefits. ACA-compliant supplemental package available for enrollment. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States and must be able to sit on Primary Talent Partners W2 without sponsorship.

Schedule: 
M-F 8am - 5pm, some flexibility will be needed for global calls | remote

Description: 

The real estate industry is undergoing significant and exciting change, increasingly driven by data and technology. At the world's premier commercial real estate services company, we empower teams to shape digital experiences that serve clients, brokers, and partners across the globe.

The Senior Digital Marketing Experience Strategist plays a critical role in defining and advancing the digital experience strategy for company's web properties and digital marketing channels — with a particular focus on our property listings experience.

This individual will partner closely with global Marketing teams, business segment leaders, and Digital & Technology counterparts to ensure our digital touchpoints are aligned to enterprise goals, regional priorities, and user needs. This role requires a blend of strategic thinking, web expertise, and a deep understanding of B2B marketing — with a forward-looking perspective on AI, automation, and emerging digital trends.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Digital Experience Strategy Define and champion digital experience strategy for assigned company web properties (Arc and related platforms), aligning with enterprise goals and regional marketing priorities.
With a particular focus on property listings, analyze digital experience consistency and variation across countries, identifying what is similar or different, better or worse, and necessary or not — translating findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
Drive the strategic evolution of user experiences across web properties to support business development, lead generation, and client engagement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration Engage with business segment Marketing teams to understand needs and deliver the right digital experiences for customers and sales teams.
Partner with brand, content, product, and technology teams to ensure cohesive execution of digital initiatives and campaigns.
Get buy-in for strategic initiatives from internal stakeholders and business leaders, using storytelling and data to communicate vision and value.

Web Strategy & Platform Expertise Contribute to CMS strategy, web architecture decisions, and governance best practices to ensure consistency and scalability across digital platforms.
Apply expertise in web strategy, CMS solutions, and digital marketing to guide the execution of high-quality web experiences.
Stay current with emerging digital trends, including AI, automation, and personalization, and champion forward-thinking approaches within the team.

Integrated Digital Marketing Support integrated digital marketing strategies aligned to business segments, including email marketing, lead nurturing, SEO/SEM, retargeting, and account-based marketing.
Leverage data-driven insights and user research to continuously improve user engagement, digital performance, and ROI.
Contribute to the definition of KPIs and measurement frameworks in collaboration with analytics partners.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES
No formal supervisory responsibilities in this position.
Provides informal guidance and mentorship to junior team members.
May lead project teams and coordinate cross-functional workstreams.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education & Experience:
Bachelor's Degree (BA/BS) in Marketing, Communications, Digital Media, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field, plus a minimum of 6+ years of relevant experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Proven experience in digital marketing or web experience roles, preferably within global B2B organizations (B2B Marketing or B2C digital platform experience preferred over internal systems).
Demonstrated expertise in web strategy, CMS platforms, and digital marketing best practices.
Familiarity with company and/or property listings platforms is a strong plus.

Skills & Expertise:
Comprehensive knowledge of digital marketing strategies and multichannel approaches, including SEO/SEM, email marketing, lead nurturing, retargeting, and account-based marketing.
Deep understanding of emerging digital trends, including AI and automation, and how they apply to marketing and digital experience.
Ability to analyze complex digital ecosystems and translate findings into clear, prioritized strategies.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to write compelling strategic communications and present effectively to internal and external audiences.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office suite. Proficiency in design thinking and prototyping tools is a plus.
Forward-thinking mindset with a bias toward action, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Proven experience in digital marketing or web experience roles, preferably within global B2B organizations (B2B Marketing or B2C digital platform experience preferred over internal systems).
Demonstrated expertise in web strategy, CMS platforms, and digital marketing best practices.

SCOPE OF RESPONSIBILITY:

jobs.title: Sales And Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
Sales & Marketing Specialist — Role & Attribution

1. Primary Responsibility

Acquire new customers for UhYea through effective sales and marketing activities.

UhYea provides guided instructions, audience intelligence, recommended marketing channels, suggested marketing materials, and unique trackable URLs. These resources help operators identify promising opportunities and execute their work effectively without having to conduct all the underlying research themselves.

The recommendations are guidance, not restrictions. Operators may use the provided materials as-is, improve them, rewrite them, or create their own when they believe a different approach will be more effective.

2. Marketing Judgment & Performance

Marketing materials and instructions may occasionally be incomplete, inaccurate, vague, ineffective, or awkwardly worded. Operators are expected to exercise their own judgment when deciding how to use or improve them.

The objective is effective customer acquisition, not blind adherence to a script. Better messaging, stronger engagement, and more effective execution can create greater opportunities to generate traffic, conversions, and earnings.

3. Customer Attribution & Ongoing Commissions

Each operator receives a unique trackable URL to identify customers they acquire.

When a new customer signs up through an operator's assigned URL, that customer is attributed to the operator as their original acquisition. This attribution remains exclusive and is not reassigned to another operator because of subsequent visits, marketing exposure, or purchases through other channels.

For as long as the operator remains with UhYea, they are eligible to earn commissions on that customer's qualifying purchases under the program's compensation rules.

Customer retention, repeat-purchase opportunities, pricing, and continued funnel activity are managed by UhYea. The operator is rewarded for the initial acquisition that brought the customer into the business.

4. Performance Beyond Direct Acquisition

Not every marketing interaction results in a newly attributed customer. For example, an operator may generate clicks, traffic, or other valuable engagement from people who are already UhYea customers.

These activities can still contribute value to the business. Operators may therefore have opportunities to earn through qualifying performance beyond directly acquiring new customers, subject to the applicable performance and compensation rules.

5. Operating Autonomy & Tracking

Operators choose how to execute their marketing activities within applicable program rules and laws. UhYea's tracking system handles customer attribution and purchase tracking automatically, so operators do not need to submit manual reports or guess which purchases qualify.

Operators must use their assigned trackable URLs for new-customer acquisition to be credited correctly. Existing customers retain their original attribution, regardless of where they encounter subsequent marketing.

6. Compensation Principles

- Customer acquisition is rewarded because bringing a new customer into the business is a valuable contribution.
- Qualifying repeat purchases from an operator's attributed customers can continue generating commissions while the operator remains with UhYea.
- Additional qualifying performance may provide earning opportunities when an operator contributes to traffic or marketing activity without acquiring a new customer.
- Commissions are subject to qualifying-purchase requirements, the applicable refund grace period, and program rules.
- There are no guaranteed hours or earnings.

About The Job

The Director, Marketing MPS I and ASMD is the brand strategy lead for Sanofi's ASMD and MPS I disease portfolio, encompassing Xenpozyme (olipudase alfa) for Acid Sphingomyelinase Deficiency (ASMD) and Aldurazyme (laronidase) for Mucopolysaccharidosis I (MPS I). This role owns brand strategy, campaign and messaging platform, brand planning process, and core team governance for these two disease areas, and serves as the primary U.S.-to-Global commercial partner for both brands.

The Director directly manages and develops a team of three a Patient Experience Marketer, an HCP Experience Marketer, and a PharmD Fellow bringing strong people leadership, strategic thinking, and rare disease commercial expertise to the role.

A defining priority of this position is leading the transition of both the ASMD and MPS I brand away from traditional agency-dependent models toward a fully AI/digital marketing platform. This includes building internal digital capabilities, owning content and campaign production digitally, and systematically reducing reliance on external creative and media agencies over time positioning this portfolio as a model for digital-first, agile brand marketing within Sanofi Rare Disease.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and Specialty Care neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, youll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

jobs.title: Senior Paid Media Strategist
jobs.description:
About the Role
We are hiring a senior, hands-on paid media strategist to independently own and improve campaign performance across Meta and Google Ads. You will build and optimize accounts, diagnose changes, develop and run tests, and make recommendations grounded in our clients' business objectives. You need to understand how the platforms actually work: what drives delivery, what limits performance, what signals they depend on, and when a proposed tactic will not work as intended. The founder will contribute business context and overall creative direction, but should not have to identify every problem, devise every test, or chase the next step.

Responsibilities
Own hands-on campaign strategy and execution across Meta and Google Ads for multiple clients, including account structure, launches, ongoing optimization, budget pacing, and performance accountability.
Monitor account health proactively. Investigate meaningful changes in spend, CPC, conversion rate, lead volume, qualified leads, cost per acquisition, revenue, and ROAS rather than waiting for problems to be flagged.
Analyze results rigorously. Choose relevant comparisons, examine change history and search terms, account for attribution delays and small samples, and distinguish plausible explanations from conclusions supported by evidence. Know when to act and when to wait.
Develop, prioritize, and execute meaningful tests across campaign types, keywords and match types, bidding, audiences, budgets, creative, and landing pages. Define hypotheses, risks, success criteria, and what to do with the findings.
Make decisions around the client's business objectives, not just the lowest CPL or highest ROAS. Recognize when growth requires more qualified leads, new demand, higher spend, or a different acquisition approach.
Use deep platform expertise to explain how auctions, automation, learning, targeting limits, placements, and conversion signals affect performance. Challenge impractical suggestions constructively and recommend workable alternatives.
Investigate gaps between platform conversions and actual outcomes, including forms, calls, booked appointments, sales, and CRM stages. Work with technical specialists on tracking, attribution, and landing-page issues and verify fixes.
Own paid-media launch and account QA: check budgets, campaign settings, targeting, exclusions, creative, destination URLs, conversion events, schedules, and Google Merchant Center or catalog feeds where relevant.
Communicate clear, decision-ready updates: what changed, what may have caused it, what you recommend, what you did, and how you will evaluate the result. Contribute confidently to internal and client performance discussions.

Requirements
6+ years of hands-on paid media experience, preferably in an agency managing multiple accounts, with demonstrated results across lead generation and ecommerce.
Expert Google Ads skills across Search, Performance Max, Shopping, and YouTube/Demand Gen as relevant. Deep command of search intent, match types, bidding, budgets, account structure, and conversion strategy.
Expert Meta Ads skills across campaign structure, audiences, placements, creative testing, automated delivery, retargeting, and conversion signals.
Proven independent ownership of account performance. You can explain decisions you made, tests you ran, trade-offs you evaluated, and what changed as a result.
Advanced analytical judgment: able to diagnose underperformance, design informative tests, spot misleading comparisons, account for attribution and sample-size limits, and avoid confusing correlation with causation.
Commercial judgment about qualified leads, bookings, sales conversion, acquisition costs, revenue, and ROAS. Able to balance efficient spending with each client's growth objectives.
Practical fluency with GA4, GTM, Google and Meta conversion tracking, enhanced conversions, Meta Pixel/CAPI, UTMs, CRM and offline conversions, and Merchant Center. Able to diagnose technical issues without necessarily coding fixes.
Sound judgment about ad messaging, creative, and landing pages. Able to identify what may be limiting response and give useful testing direction to copy, design, video, and web specialists.
Self-directed, organized, and reliable. Keeps accounts moving, follows through on investigations, and brings recommendations before being asked. Stays current with platform changes, welcomes feedback, and respectfully challenges assumptions.
Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate evidence, uncertainty, and platform limitations clearly. Full-time remote availability with substantial overlap with U.S. Central Time.

Data-Driven & Inquiring Mindset: Demonstrated customer mindset and research discipline; skilled at combining qualitative insights, market intelligence, competitive context, and performance data to challenge assumptions and guide decisions.

At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.
THE WORK:

Ripple is hiring a Lead Full Stack Engineer, Marketing to join our growing team. You will assume a vital, strategic role in establishing the technical vision and framework for Ripple’s marketing technology platform. Through creating dynamic, high-performing, and globally scalable experiences, you will directly boost our go-to-market efforts and support our internal teams.
This role is perfect for an AI-forward engineering leader who thrives where technology, growth marketing, and data converge. Operating at a Staff/Lead level, you will partner closely with Growth, Marketing Operations, and Data teams to invent scalable solutions. These solutions will allow fast experimentation, increase user acquisition, and gather actionable analytics. You will lead by example through hands-on coding, system development, and cross-functional leadership. You will advance our Next.js, Sanity, and Vercel stack into a fully dynamic, conversion-optimized platform supported by intelligent workflows.

Develop and manage the comprehensive technical plan for Ripple’s marketing web platform, ensuring it scales to support aggressive global growth, localization, and high-traffic demands.
Pioneer AI integration and workflow automation, architecting and deploying LLM-powered tools and intelligent agents that drastically increase the marketing team's day-to-day efficiency and output.

Mentor and elevate other engineers on the team, encouraging a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and forward-thinking system design.

8+ years of professional web development experience, with at least 2+ years in a Staff, Lead, or Principal engineering role focusing on marketing technology, growth engineering, or equivalent scale platforms.

Applied AI experience and an AI-forward approach, with hands-on experience integrating LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.). Use frameworks like the Vercel AI SDK or LangChain to build internal tools or agents.

Strong architectural understanding of the modern growth marketing stack, including Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), CRM integrations, server-side tagging, and event tracking schemas.
Demonstrated ability to translate high-level business goals into actionable technical roadmaps and scalable system builds.
Hands-on experience with headless CMS platforms, especially Sanity (schema building, GROQ queries, custom inputs), prioritizing flexible content modeling for marketing teams.
Excellent cross-functional leadership skills, with experience influencing senior collaborators in Marketing and Operations without relying on direct authority.
Deep understanding of performance optimization, SSR/SSG, and edge deployment strategies (Vercel, Cloudflare) to improve technical SEO outcomes.

Job title:Global HCP Marketing Lead, Duvakitug (IBD)

Location: Cambridge, MA

About The Job

Join the team transforming care for people with immune-mediated and inflammatory diseases. In Specialty Care, you'll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

Sanofi's Immunology Franchise is preparing to transform the treatment landscape for Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) with duvakitug, one of Sanofi's high-priority new assets. As the Global HCP Marketing Lead, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and executing the healthcare professional (HCP) marketing strategy from prelaunch through launch and beyond. This is a unique opportunity to build a comprehensive omnichannel marketing program for a potentially groundbreaking therapy in a disease area with significant unmet medical need and a rapidly evolving competitive landscape.

Reporting directly to the Global Brand Lead, you will be responsible for developing disease state awareness, defining HCP segmentation and engagement strategies, crafting compelling HCP messaging, and deploying innovative marketing campaigns that leverage cutting-edge technologies including AI-enabled solutions. You will work closely with key markets, including the US and Japan, and serve as the lead for the Agency of Record (AOR) relationship, ensuring strategic alignment and executional excellence across all HCP marketing activities.

As the team continues to grow in anticipation of launch, this role offers a rare opportunity to help build something meaningful from the ground up working at the intersection of science, strategy, and creativity to ensure gastroenterologists, IBD specialists, and other relevant HCPs are informed, engaged, and equipped to identify and treat patients living with IBD.

This product will be developed and marketed in collaboration with Teva with Sanofi responsible for launches outside of the EU.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and Specialty Care neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, youll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

Marketing Senior Manager, UPLIZNA gMG Medical Marketing

Live

What you will do

Lets do this. Lets change the world. The Senior Manager, Neurology Medical Marketing - Opinion Leader Engagement & Peer-to-Peer (P2P) will lead the U.S. Neurology opinion leader (OL) engagement and P2P strategy, UPLIZNA Speaker Bureau, and marketing-led HCP education and engagement portfolio across gMG and NMOSD. This role has end-to-end accountability for marketing-led OL engagement and P2P, including OL mapping and engagement planning, speaker programs, Peer Discussion Groups, industry therapeutic updates (ITUs), product theaters, symposia, speaker development, P2P content, and agency/vendor delivery. The Senior Manager will lead and develop direct reports who pull through assigned workstreams and partner closely with HCP Marketing, Medical Affairs, Field Medical, Sales, TLLs, Training, Regulatory, Legal, Market Access, Global, Professional Marketing, and other cross-functional colleagues. Advisory boards and other primary insight-generation forums are led by the Insights & Congress Strategy organization; this role translates those learnings into engagement plans.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Opinion Leader Engagement and P2P Strategy

Set and evolve the U.S. Neurology OL engagement and P2P strategy across gMG and NMOSD, aligning marketing-led HCP education and engagement with franchise priorities, customer needs, scientific developments, competitive dynamics, and lifecycle objectives.

Own OL mapping, segmentation, and engagement planning for established and emerging OLs, in partnership with Medical Affairs, Field Medical, TLLs, and HCP Marketing.

Establish clear engagement objectives, audience segmentation, deployment plans, and success measures for the portfolio; ensure each activity is appropriately aligned to customer, indication, and business needs.

Lead annual and in-year P2P and OL engagement planning, including program volume, geographic deployment, investment allocation, and contingency planning across both indications.

Own and Evolve the UPLIZNA Speaker Bureau and P2P Portfolio

Own the strategy, design, and execution of the UPLIZNA Speaker Bureau, including bureau composition, speaker segmentation, recruitment, onboarding, contracting coordination, activation, and ongoing optimization.

Own the end-to-end design and execution of marketing-led HCP education and P2P programs, including speaker programs, Peer Discussion Groups, ITUs, and other approved customer education opportunities.

Lead speaker training and development strategy, including curriculum design, content readiness, faculty preparation, and ongoing capability building for new and tenured speakers.

Partner with Sales Training and field leadership to strengthen field readiness, appropriate program pull-through, and a consistent customer experience.

Lead Opinion Leader Engagement at Congresses

Own all marketing-led OL-facing engagement at congresses, including ITUs, symposia, product theaters, speaker and faculty activity, and other approved OL-present programs.

Set the strategy, objectives, and engagement plans for the OL-facing congress workstream; lead and direct the team members responsible for detailed planning and on-site pull-through.

Partner with the TLL team to identify and coordinate priority OL engagements for the Neuro Medical Marketing Lead, other leaders, and cross-functional partners before and during congresses; ensure agreed follow-up actions are completed after the event.

Partner with the Insights & Congress Strategy lead to integrate OL engagement plans into sponsorship choices, the broader congress activation strategy, and post-congress learning. Partner with Professional Marketing to align OL-facing programs with its booth-related and sales-driven assets.

Build Content and Deliver High-Quality Execution

Own development and lifecycle management of P2P materials, including speaker decks, disease-state resources, case-based materials, and program tools; oversee agency development, MAC review, approval, rollout, and updates.

Ensure P2P content and speaker training clearly communicate the scientific and clinical rationale for UPLIZNA while meeting the distinct needs of gMG and NMOSD customers.

Manage P2P and OL engagement budgets, agencies, and external vendors with strong financial stewardship, rigorous prioritization, and accountability for timely, high-quality delivery.

Ensure high-quality execution across the portfolio by setting clear operating models, timelines, decision rights, and standards for program planning, vendor management, compliance, and follow-up.

Drive Performance, Insights, and Cross-Functional Alignment

Define and monitor meaningful measures of P2P, Speaker Bureau, and OL engagement performance, including program quality, reach, utilization, speaker effectiveness, audience feedback, and strategic impact.

Translate field feedback, customer insights, program data, competitive intelligence, and external engagement learnings into clear recommendations to improve OL engagement strategy, P2P content, and execution.

Contribute to annual brand planning, long-range planning, quarterly priorities, and tactical plans by bringing forward customer, scientific, and performance implications.

Represent OL Engagement and P2P Medical Marketing in key franchise forums and communicate performance, emerging risks, opportunities, and recommendations to senior leadership.

Lead and Develop a High-Performing Team

Directly lead, coach, and develop team members responsible for P2P execution and related Medical Marketing workstreams; establish clear priorities, decision rights, accountability, and development plans.

Create an operating model that balances strategic leadership with disciplined execution, enabling the team to manage complex workstreams while maintaining a strong customer and business focus.

Foster a culture of scientific curiosity, customer centricity, ownership, collaboration, innovation, and high standards of execution. Live and role model Amgen Values across the UPLIZNA brand team and cross-functional partners.

Win
