jobs.title: Regional Marketing Associate | East or Central US | Remote
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity

The Regional Marketing Associate supports the execution of regional marketing plans across AMER, working with all Regional Marketing Managers to deliver programs based on team priorities.

You will own assigned programs and tasks from setup through post-event reporting, using established playbooks, processes, and templates. Your manager will set priorities in partnership with the Regional Marketing Managers. You will be responsible for delivering accurate, high-quality work on time, asking for guidance when needed, and flagging risks early.

You will use AI and data tools daily to improve efficiency and inform your work, while remaining accountable for the accuracy and quality of everything you deliver.

What You'll Be Doing

Execute programs across AMER. Support all Regional Marketing Managers by delivering assigned events, campaigns and ABM activities using established playbooks, from setup through follow-up. Your manager will set priorities in partnership with the Regional Marketing Managers.
Manage program operations. Build registration pages, emails, landing pages and campaign workflows in the team’s tools. Coordinate paid social execution, vendors and logistics as assigned.
Ensure quality before launch. Review event setup, assets, emails and landing pages for accuracy, completeness and functionality before they go live.
Report on results. Maintain accurate program data, track agreed metrics and prepare post-event and campaign reports using standard tools and templates.
Keep the team informed. Maintain timelines and task status in Monday.com, and proactively communicate progress and changes.
Support budget operations. Track program expenses, manage purchase orders and coordinate invoices with Finance.
Use AI and improve processes. Apply AI and data tools daily to work more efficiently, validate outputs and share useful workflows and process improvements with the team.
Flag issues early. Bring risks, blockers, unclear requirements and competing requests to your manager early so priorities and next steps can be resolved.

What You'll Bring At This Level

Located in EST or CST
2+ years in field marketing, regional marketing or events
Strong organization and close attention to detail
Experience with, or fast ramp on, Splash, Zuddl, Salesforce and Monday.com
Comfort using AI and the judgment to validate its output
Clear written communication
Willingness to travel approximately 40%

Compensation & Rewards

In the US, the OTE (On-Target Earnings) compensation range for this role is $88,000 - $95,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive At Grafana Labs

100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:
Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

jobs.title: Director, Data Enablement & Analytics - Digital & Marketing
jobs.description:
About

Bloomingdale's makes fashion personal and fun, aspirational yet approachable. Our mission is to guide and inspire customers to make style a source of creative energy in their lives. Across all brand touchpoints, from Bloomingdales.com to our stores and emerging customer experiences, every colleague plays a critical role in bringing our mission to life. Our inclusive culture values innovation, collaboration, diverse perspectives, and customer-centered decision making.

Job Overview

Bloomingdale's is seeking a Director, Data Enablement & Analytics – Digital & Marketing to lead the strategy, governance, analytics, and measurement capabilities that support the Digital and Marketing organizations.

This leader is responsible for ensuring the business has the data foundations, measurement frameworks, reporting capabilities, and analytical insights needed to improve customer experiences, optimize marketing investments, and drive business growth. The role oversees both analytics delivery and the enablement capabilities required to scale decision-making, including data governance, KPI ownership, measurement standards, reporting frameworks, and data quality.

The ideal candidate combines strategic leadership, analytical expertise, and strong business acumen. They are comfortable influencing senior leaders, defining long-term roadmaps, developing talent, and translating complex data into actionable business recommendations.

Essential Functions

Define and lead the Digital and Marketing data, measurement, and analytics strategy, ensuring capabilities support enterprise objectives and customer growth priorities.
Own the Digital and Marketing data foundation, including governance, KPI definitions, reporting standards, measurement methodologies, data quality, and platform enablement.
Ensure the organization has the reporting, analytics, and decision-support capabilities necessary to evaluate performance, identify opportunities, and guide investment decisions.
Partner with Marketing, Digital, Loyalty, Technology, Finance, Data Science, and Macy's Inc. teams to advance measurement capabilities, analytical maturity, and data enablement priorities.
Translate complex customer, digital, and marketing performance insights into strategic recommendations that influence business decisions, prioritization, and resource allocation.
Establish scalable operating models, prioritization processes, and team structures that ensure successful delivery of analytics and enablement initiatives.
Lead, develop, and coach a high-performing team of analytics leaders and individual contributors while fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, and business ownership.
Champion adoption of advanced analytics, AI-enabled capabilities, experimentation, and modern measurement practices that improve decision-making and business outcomes.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree in Analytics, Business, Marketing, Economics, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field preferred.
8+ years of progressive experience in analytics, measurement, digital analytics, marketing analytics, or related disciplines.
3+ years of people leadership experience, including experience leading managers and developing high-performing teams.
Demonstrated success leading analytics and measurement functions within a complex, cross-functional organization.
Experience influencing senior leaders and driving data-informed business decisions.
Retail, ecommerce, digital, or customer-focused industry experience preferred.

Leadership & Technical Skills

Strong understanding of digital analytics, marketing measurement, customer behavior analytics, attribution, experimentation, and performance management.
Experience establishing analytics operating models, governance frameworks, KPI definitions, reporting standards, and measurement methodologies.
Strong technical aptitude with the ability to evaluate analytical approaches, challenge methodologies, guide technical teams, and partner effectively with Data Science, Engineering, and Technology organizations.
Working knowledge of modern analytics, cloud data, BI, and marketing technology ecosystems.
Proven ability to translate analytical findings and technical concepts into strategic business recommendations and measurable outcomes.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong leadership, coaching, and talent development capabilities.
Strategic thinker with strong problem-solving skills and a bias for action.

This position may be eligible for performance-based incentives/bonuses. Benefits include 401k, medical/vision/dental/life/disability insurance options, PTO accruals, Holidays, and more. Eligibility requirements may apply based on location, job level, classification, and length of employment. Additional benefit details are available at bloomingdalesJOBS.com.

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is a versatile expert responsible for ensuring high-value customers who purchase the Signature Success Plan achieve a significant return on their investment with our platform. This role functions as an extension of the customer’s workforce and a trusted advisor, providing guidance and advice to customer organizations. The CSM is responsible for identifying and addressing both technical and business concerns, aligning them strategically with customer priorities, projects, and problems.

In the 'Agentic Era,' the Marketing Cloud CSM serves as a Strategic Partner who is truly 'at home' in the digital-first world. You speak the customer’s language—fluently discussing ROAS, conversion funnels, and omnichannel orchestration—while navigating industry-specific challenges like peak-season scaling and privacy shifts. You act as a domain authority who understands that technology only succeeds when it is grounded in a deep understanding of the customer’s business challenges and market trends.

We are looking for candidates who have experience supporting customers in one or more of the following industries:

Retail Consumer Goods (RCG) – Partners with retail, consumer packaged goods, fashion, beauty, and consumer products companies to drive digital transformation, enhance customer experiences, and maximize value from e-commerce, merchandising, and omni-channel strategies

This is an Individual Contributor position.

Customer Accountability and Value Alignment

Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the delivery of all Signature deliverables, the overall customer experience, and renewal and expansion.
Coordinate all deliverables the customer is entitled to, overseeing the experience throughout the Signature lifecycle
Apply the correct processes to address customer needs and ensure value is delivered through the Signature offer.
Successfully align with and manage both Business and Technical Stakeholders, focusing on aligning Business Value and Technical Goals to the Signature offer.
Prioritize the most urgent work activities, organize tasks to avoid missing key steps, and create basic plans to focus time, taking responsibility for assigned tasks.

Solidify partnership commitments and drive innovation aligned with customers' business challenges.
Increase customer engagement with products and services and identify major political barriers to customer success.
Partner with more experienced team members to solve complex problems and develop strategic success plans when needed.

Act as the primary point of contact for major incidents, ensuring timely communications and resolution of issues.
Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
Form a clear plan for client engagements, communicate clearly and proactively with collaborators, and keep the customer goal central to decision-making.

Minimum Requirements

4+ years of industry expertise in Customer Success, SaaS platforms, and Marketing operations.
Consulting: Strong ability to facilitate discussions, handle objections, and translate business goals into product experiences.
Strong ability to facilitate discussions, handle objections, and translate business goals into product experiences.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Associate - American Girl CRM
jobs.description:
CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER.
It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire fans, entertain audiences and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.

Job Description

The Opportunity:

The CRM Marketing Associate is responsible for supporting the execution of American Girl’s CRM programs across email and SMS channels. This role supports day-to-day campaign planning, production, deployment, and QA while using campaign performance insights to help improve customer engagement, business outcomes, and CRM channel performance against key engagement, conversion, and revenue goals.

This role will partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Creative, Loyalty, Ecomm/Merchandising, IT, and external agency partners to deliver personalized, on-brand communications that support acquisition, retention, and lifetime customer value. The ideal candidate brings a balance of strong execution, attention to detail, and a data-informed mindset, with a passion for creating meaningful customer experiences.

What Your Impact Will Be:

Campaign Planning, Production & Execution:

Support the planning and execution of CRM campaigns across email and SMS, including promotional campaigns, product launches, and loyalty and seasonal initiatives. Support the maintenance of the CRM calendar to ensure alignment with broader marketing strategies, business priorities, and retail moments. Support development of creative briefs and partner with internal creative teams (design and copy) to deliver engaging, on-brand messaging. Provide input on messaging, subject lines, and creative to optimize performance and maintain brand voice. Coordinate campaign production across internal teams and external partners, ensuring timelines and deliverables are met while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Support audience segmentation and campaign targeting to support customer acquisition, onboarding, retention, and re-engagement. Support the build, launch, and ongoing maintenance of automated lifecycle journeys (e.g., welcome series, browse/cart abandonment, post-purchase, loyalty, winback). Use customer data to support personalization efforts and deliver relevant, timely messaging. Collaborate with merchandising and site teams to ensure strong alignment between CRM campaigns and the on-site experience, contributing to a seamless omnichannel customer journey.

Optimization & Testing:

Support ongoing optimization of CRM campaigns through A/B and multivariate testing across subject lines, creative, messaging, timing, and audience segments. Monitor campaign performance metrics and share learnings to support future optimization efforts and overall CRM performance against business and revenue objectives. Conduct thorough QA across all campaigns, ensuring accuracy of content, links, tracking, and overall customer experience.
Support CRM performance tracking by contributing to regular reporting for campaigns and key business moments. Monitor campaign performance and help identify trends and opportunities to improve engagement and conversion. Partner with teams to incorporate CRM efforts into broader marketing plans and share performance learnings to inform future campaign planning. Assist in the development of performance summaries and marketing decks as needed.

Data Stewardship & Best Practices:

Maintain strong customer data hygiene and support ongoing audience quality initiatives. Ensure all CRM communications adhere to email and SMS compliance standards (e.g., CAN-SPAM, TCPA) and deliverability best practices. Utilize CRM and project management tools (e.g., Klaviyo, Monday.com) to execute campaigns efficiently and accurately. Familiarity with customer data platforms (CDPs) or marketing data systems is a plus.

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For:

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

1+ years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, or email/SMS marketing, preferably within retail or consumer products
Hands-on experience with an ESP (Klaviyo preferred) and end-to-end campaign execution
Experience supporting CRM calendars, audience segmentation, and lifecycle campaigns
Experience working cross-functionally with creative, marketing, and merchandising teams
Excellent written/verbal, time management and quantitative/analytical skills required
Familiarity with campaign performance metrics and using data to inform optimization decisions
Strong PowerPoint and Excel skills preferred

Key Skills And Competencies

Understands the importance of delivering relevant, personalized communication across the customer lifecycle. Understands how CRM communications support the customer journey and brand experience.

Executional Excellence:

Highly detail-oriented with strong organizational and project management skills. Able to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines while maintaining a high standard of accuracy and quality in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

Data-Informed Decision Making: Comfortable working with campaign performance data to identify trends and inform optimizations. Able to apply insights to improve future campaigns and support business goals without requiring deep analytical ownership.

Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams including Creative, Marketing, and Merchandising. Able to contribute ideas and recommendations that support campaign planning and execution.

Adaptability: Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities. Demonstrates flexibility, curiosity, and a willingness to learn and grow.

Additional Information

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Join Mattel's Talent Community and start receiving exciting updates about our company, our employees, and our culture. Also, interested in signing up for job alerts? Do so here!

How We Work:

We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors:

We collaborate: Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
We innovate: At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
We execute: We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

Our Approach to Flexible Work:

This role is an in-office role Monday-Thursday, and work from home on Fridays. We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.

Who We Are:

Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.

Mattel’s award-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more.

Visit us at https://jobs.mattel.com/ and www.instagram.com/MattelCareers.

Beware of recruiting scams: Mattel will only contact you through official @mattel.com or @smartrecruiters.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

Mattel is an Equal Opportunity Employer where we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day. We welcome all job seekers, and all applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran and protected veteran status, disability status, and or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

Pursuant to the Los Angeles Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act, qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment.

The pay range for this position is between $76,000 and $96,000 annually. The pay range is indicative of projected hiring range, however base pay will be determined based on a candidate’s work location, skills and experience. jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
At Salted, we believe the future of restaurants doesn’t look anything like what we see today. The most successful brands will focus primarily on delivery and take-out - and use technology to nurture deep customer relationships that exist outside four walls.

Please note that we encourage candidates who are interested in this role to email us directly at jobs@hellosalted.com with your resumé and a brief note about yourself and why you're a fit. Please include "Growth Manager" in the subject line. We read every one of these emails.

About The Role

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Growth Marketing Manager
will manage the growth engine at Salted. You will think holistically about both top-line sales and bottom-line profitability across our entire portfolio of brands, with a focus on our flagship brand, moonbowls.

You're someone who loves to experiment, track performance, and figure out why things work (or why they didn't). This role sits at the intersection of marketplace management, direct-to-consumer (DTC) digital funnel optimization, retention marketing, and strategic growth opportunities. You will wear many hats, collaborate across teams (from Brand to Ops to Culinary), and adapt quickly as we scale from 40+ to 100+ locations.

Key Responsibilities

Third-Party Marketplace Growth & Multivariate Testing: Work directly with the CEO to design and execute multivariate tests across major delivery platforms (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub). Optimize store presentation, menu architecture, photos, promotions, and ad placement to drive maximum conversion, order frequency, net profitability
Web & Funnel Optimization: Own and optimize conversion funnels across brand websites, primarily moonbowls. Run continuous A/B tests on landing pages, checkout flows, and user experience to improve conversion rates and average order value (AOV)
Retention & Lifecycle Marketing: Partner closely with our Head of Brand Marketing to build, test, and scale automated drip campaigns across email and SMS. Focus on key metrics like retention, customer lifetime value (LTV), repeat order frequency, and win-backs
Holistic Funnel Strategy: Treat every customer touchpoint—from digital ads to our physical storefronts to packaging —as part of a unified growth engine
Data & Analytics Mastery: Analyze channel performance, customer cohorts, menu conversion metrics, and promotional margins. Uncover trends, diagnose funnel leaks, and translate data into actionable growth initiatives
White Space & Market Expansion: Collaborate with Culinary and Operations teams to advise on market opportunities and menu expansion based on consumer demand trends and performance data
Scale & Cascade: Develop growth playbooks for moonbowls and cascade winning frameworks across our portfolio of brands
Salted-Operated Locations: Maximize the customer experience and growth potential at our physical storefronts. Work cross-functionally to optimize the pickup experience, in-store branding, and hospitality touchpoints to turn one-time pickup customers into recurring first-party digital orderers
Catering Growth & Acquisition Funnel: Treat catering as a primary top-of-funnel acquisition channel. Collaborate with our Business Development team to test campaigns that convert high-value corporate/group catering clients into loyal customer accounts

What We’re Looking For

3–5+ years of hands-on growth experience in DTC, food-tech, delivery platform marketing, or e-commerce
Data-driven & obsessed with economics: You care about customer frequency, net margins and net payouts - not just top-line vanity metrics
AI-proficiency: You are comfortable using AI to solve problems and are constantly looking for ways to accelerate great work - without sacrificing accuracy and authenticity
Marketing stack experience: Hands-on experience with web analytics tools, A/B testing platforms, and lifecycle marketing platforms
Scrappy & adaptable: Comfortable moving between high-level strategic growth planning and rolling up your sleeves to execute day-to-day optimizations
Strong cross-functional collaborator: Ability to partner effectively with stakeholders across departments
LA-based: Ideally based in LA (although not a requirement)

Stock Options

jobs.description:
Level: Journeyman | Work Location: Remote

About The Role

Red Carrot is seeking a Social Media Manager to develop, write, and manage social media and digital content in support of large-scale federal communications campaigns. This role combines creative writing and content development with hands-on social media management, ensuring that all content is strategic, accurate, and optimized for engagement. The ideal candidate is a strong writer who understands both the creative and analytical sides of social communications — capable of adapting messaging across platforms and audiences while tracking results to inform future content. This person collaborates with strategists, designers, and media specialists to help shape campaigns that inform, engage, and drive measurable impact.

Key Responsibilities

Content Creation & Writing

Write, edit, and adapt social media copy, campaign messaging, and short-form content for digital platforms
Translate complex program or policy topics into clear, accessible, and engaging public-facing messages
Ensure all content aligns with campaign goals, brand standards, and accessibility requirements
Support creative concepting and message development across social, web, and digital touchpoints

Social Media Management

Manage day-to-day scheduling, posting, and community monitoring across channels (e.g., Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X)
Maintain and update social content calendars aligned with campaign milestones and topical moments
Coordinate approvals and publishing processes with internal and client stakeholders
Collaborate with paid media and creative teams to ensure cohesive messaging and timing
Stay current on platform trends, emerging features, and best practices, bringing new ideas and recommendations to the team

Reporting & Optimization

Track and analyze content performance metrics across platforms using analytics tools (e.g., native insights, Hootsuite, Meltwater)
Prepare regular reports summarizing reach, engagement, and content trends
Identify insights and actionable recommendations to improve performance over time
Partner with strategists and creative teams to refine messaging and content mix based on results
Contribute to monthly or quarterly client reports with social-specific takeaways and next steps

Collaboration & Coordination

Work closely with program managers, media leads, and creative leads to plan and deliver integrated campaigns
Contribute to creative brainstorms and strategy discussions with fresh, informed ideas

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

BS/BA in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, English, or related field
Minimum 4 years of demonstrated experience in social media management and content writing across major platforms
Strong writing and editing skills, with the ability to translate complex topics into clear, engaging, audience-appropriate messaging
Experience with social media management and analytics tools (e.g., native platform insights, Hootsuite, Meltwater)
Familiarity with brand standards and Section 508 / digital accessibility requirements
Agency experience (advertising, marketing, or communications agency) a plus
Federal government or public sector communications experience a plus

Are you naturally great at building rapport, leading conversations, and helping people take the next step?

We’re hiring an Inbound Appointment Setter

You’ll be speaking with private healthcare business owners from around the world who already know who we are, follow our content, and engage with our brand regularly.

These aren’t cold prospects.

They’re already interested.

Your role is to step into those conversations, build trust, ask the right questions, and guide qualified prospects toward booking a call with our team.

This position sits at the intersection of sales, customer experience, and community engagement — and plays a major role in driving company growth.

Who We Are

We’re Paul Gough Media
, a global marketing and training company that helps private healthcare business owners grow and scale successful clinics.

Our founder, Paul Gough, is a 5x Amazon best-selling author, host of a top-rated business podcast, and former professional sports physical therapist turned business mentor.

Over the last decade, he has built a multi-million-dollar company ($5M+ and growing toward $10M), helping thousands of clinic owners improve their marketing, attract more patients, and increase profitability.

We operate from offices in Celebration, Florida and Hartlepool, UK, serving clients across the world.

What You’ll Be Doing

In this role, you will:

Manage inbound conversations across Instagram, Facebook, and online communities
Respond to DMs, comments, and story replies with speed, personality, and professionalism
Turn engagement into genuine conversations
Ask thoughtful questions to understand each lead’s goals and challenges
Guide qualified prospects toward booking a discovery call
Follow up consistently with leads who haven’t taken action yet
Re-engage inactive or “ghosted” conversations
Track conversations, bookings, and follow-up activity

You’ll also help create simple weekly story prompts designed to spark engagement and generate new inbound conversations.

What Success Looks Like

This is a performance-driven role with clear targets and measurable outcomes.

Successful team members consistently:

Book 15–20 qualified calls per month
Maintain a 75%+ show rate on booked calls
Influence 8+ program sales per month through strong pre-call relationship building
Respond to all new inbound interactions within 24 hours
Maintain a healthy pipeline of active conversations

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You:

Have experience handling inbound leads through social media or online communities
Build rapport quickly and communicate confidently
Can guide conversations naturally without sounding scripted or pushy
Understand how to move people from engagement to action
Are comfortable following up consistently
Enjoy working toward targets and being measured on performance
Stay organised while managing multiple conversations simultaneously

This Role Probably Isn’t for You If You:

Prefer content creation or design over direct communication
Haven’t previously converted leads into bookings or sales
Avoid follow-ups or feel uncomfortable asking for commitment
Are looking for a passive community management position

Compensation

Base salary: $40,000–$55,000 per year (depending on experience)
Monthly commission tied to qualified calls booked and sales influenced

This is a results-focused role where strong performance is rewarded. High performers consistently grow their earnings through commissions on top of a competitive base salary.

What You’ll Get

No cold outreach — all leads are inbound and warm
Daily access to engaged, qualified prospects
Clear KPIs and performance-based bonuses
Structured onboarding, training, and ongoing coaching
A high-performance team culture built around ownership, speed, and results
Career progression opportunities into senior sales or account management roles
Monthly team events and potential travel opportunities across the US and UK

A Final Word From Paul

“If you’ve ever thought, ‘I’d be great at sales if I just had better leads,’ this is your opportunity. We generate a high volume of warm interest every single day — we just need the right person to capture it, nurture it, and turn it into booked calls.

If you genuinely enjoy helping people, think quickly, and aren’t afraid to follow up, we’d love to hear from you.”

Ready to Apply?

If you’re looking for a role where you can make a real impact, accelerate your career, and help ambitious business owners grow successful clinics, apply now.

The SEO & Digital Acquisition Specialist executes MCU's organic and paid search presence across its website properties. This role bridges brand strategy and technical execution, ensuring assigned web properties attract high-intent traffic across both traditional search engines and AI-driven answer and generative surfaces, engaging visitors, and converting leads effectively. Reporting to the Manager, Digital Marketing, this role is responsible for day-to-day SEO execution, coordinates paid search and programmatic activities in partnership with external agency partners, and supports analytics implementation and site performance reporting.

Responsibilities
:

Specific duties include, but are not limited to, the following:

Technical SEO: Execute technical SEO activities for the site, including crawlability, indexation, site architecture, page speed/Core Web Vitals, and schema/structured data markup.
On-Site SEO & AI Search Visibility (AEO/GEO): Execute on-page SEO execution (keyword strategy, content optimization, and internal linking) and extend that work to Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), structuring content and site elements to improve visibility and citation in AI-driven answer and generative surfaces (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity).
Local SEO & Listings Management: Maintain and optimize Google Business Profile and other local listings for MCU branch locations, supporting visibility for new branch openings and location-based search.
Paid Search & Programmatic Strategy: Serve as the internal subject-matter expert for MCU's paid search and programmatic advertising (e.g., via The Trade Desk or similar DSPs). Partner with external paid media agencies — reviewing keyword/audience strategy, bidding approach, and creative testing recommendations, and assessing performance against MCU's goals. Day-to-day campaign execution is managed by agency partners; this role provides recommendations and performance analysis.
Content & Brand Consistency: Ensure website content aligns with MCU's overall brand strategy and voice across marketing channels. Write clear, concise, and grammatically correct website copy consistent with MCU's brand voice.
Site Performance & Reporting: Track and report on site and campaign performance against engagement and conversion targets set by marketing leadership, including conversion rate optimization (CRO) recommendations and testing. Contribute recommendations and flag optimization opportunities.
Tagging, Analytics & Privacy Compliance: Manage day-to-day administration of Google Tag Manager (GTM), including tag, trigger, and variable configuration, and help ensure tracking implementation aligns with evolving privacy requirements (e.g., consent management, first-party data strategies).
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with design, product, content, and other marketing team members, as well as vendor partners, to align web messaging with marketing campaigns and broader projects.
Content Governance: Ensure all web content remains accurate, up to date, on-brand, and compliant with accessibility standards (such as ADA/WCAG).

:

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field; equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience will also be considered.
4-6+ years of hands-on digital marketing experience, with a strong focus on digital channels, website management, SEO, paid search, and analytics. Financial services experience preferred but not required.
Strong working knowledge of Content Management Systems (CMS), preferably HubSpot.
Working knowledge of web analytics platforms (Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, etc.).

jobs.description:
Who We Are

For over 30 years, CSH has changed the lives of people who have been marginalized and are our most vulnerable neighbors by:

Helping communities create over 467,600 homes for individuals and families who did not have one;
Bringing hope to thousands who thought they would live on the streets or reside in institutions; and
Ensuring not only a stable home for each, but access to the services that brought healthcare, recovery and training to their doorsteps.

CSH has proven supportive housing can change the lives of individuals, families, and communities. We have created a team of nationally recognized experts who are dedicated to our organization and its goals. We offer competitive salaries and benefits, generous leave and paid time off, and fully embrace the philosophy that work-life balance is achievable. With the goal of attracting proven candidates committed to making a difference and who aspire to advance our mission, CSH is now accepting applications for a Digital Marketing Manager
.

Why We Need You

CSH is seeking a results-oriented individual committed to sharing their talent to support a mission-driven organization that leads efforts to expand housing and service solutions for highly impacted populations. CSH is looking for a skilled digital marketer and strong writer who can help us reach and engage more people with our work. You'll lead email marketing, manage and optimize web content, strengthen our visibility in traditional and AI-powered search, and use data and testing to continually improve performance. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys combining technology, content, creativity, and analysis in support of a mission. This position will be hybrid based in the New York City metro area.

What You Will Do

The Digital Marketing Manager leads CSH's email marketing, website content, search optimization, and digital performance efforts. This hands-on role develops and improves digital campaigns that engage priority audiences, increase the reach and discoverability of CSH's content, and translate data into better marketing decisions.

Working closely with the Strategic Communications team and colleagues across the organization, the Digital Marketing Manager combines excellent writing and editing with strong digital marketing, analytical, and project-management skills. The role also helps CSH adopt emerging practices in AI-enabled marketing, communications, and search.

Email Marketing & Audience Engagement (30%)

Manage the planning, execution, and evaluation of email marketing campaigns, newsletters, event promotions, fundraising communications, and organizational announcements.
Build, test, deploy, and optimize email campaigns using marketing automation and email marketing platforms.
Develop and maintain audience lists, segmentation strategies, subscription management processes, contact engagement and re-engagement strategies, and audience data hygiene.
Design and analyze A/B testing of subject lines, content, calls to action, and other campaign tactics to improve engagement, conversions, and overall campaign performance.
Monitor campaign metrics, engagement trends, deliverability, list health, and audience behavior and recommend strategies to improve email performance.

Website Management & Content Optimization (25%)

Manage, edit, and optimize website content for three primary websites to , ensure it is clear, accurate, current, accessible, audience-focused and aligned with organizational priorities.
Create and update webpages, landing pages, forms, and other digital assets to support organizational initiatives and campaigns.
Conduct regular website content audits and recommend improvements to user experience, accessibility, navigation, and content organization.
Collaborate with staff across the organization to publish and maintain timely content, resources, announcements, and event information.
Monitor website performance and user behavior metrics to identify opportunities for improved engagement and effectiveness.

Search Optimization (SEO, AEO, and GEO) (15%)

Apply SEO and emerging AI-search practices to improve CSH content visibility across traditional search engines and AI-powered search and answer experiences.
Conduct keyword and audience-intent research and optimize content, metadata, page structure, and internal linking to improve discoverability.
Stay current on evolving search trends, digital marketing practices, and emerging technologies, recommending practical applications for CSH.

Analytics, Reporting & Optimization (15%)

Track, analyze, and report on digital marketing performance across email, website, and other digital channels.
Develop and maintain regular dashboards, reports, and performance summaries for key stakeholders.
Translate data and performance metrics into actionable recommendations that improve campaign outcomes and audience engagement.
Monitor key performance indicators, identify trends, and evaluate the effectiveness of marketing and communications efforts.
Support organizational decision-making by providing timely, accurate, and meaningful digital marketing insights.

Content & Campaign Support (15%)

Apply web writing and content design best practices to improve readability, page structure, calls to action, and user journeys.
Collaborate with Strategic Communications staff and colleagues across the organization to develop and implement integrated marketing and communications campaigns.
Use AI-enabled tools to support appropriate aspects of research, content development, search optimization, audience insights, testing, and workflow efficiency, while maintaining human review for accuracy, quality, privacy, and brand alignment.
Support the promotion of events, initiatives, publications, trainings, thought leadership content, and organizational announcements across digital channels.
Partner with subject matter experts to translate complex information into clear, engaging, and accessible content for target audiences.
Assist with content development, copyediting, proofreading, and quality assurance across digital platforms.

Coordinate project timelines, manage competing priorities, and communicate project status with internal stakeholders.

Other duties, assignments, projects, and research as needed.

How We Work

CSH staff are adaptable, entrepreneurial, creative, and flexible problem-solvers. We are strategic thinkers committed to treating each other and the communities we serve with respect. You should share a passion for the CSH mission and possess the skills to meet the expectation of this role to help shape how we share our ambitious mission.

Five or more years of relevant experience in digital marketing, communications, or marketing.

jobs.title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
What We Do

We’re on a mission to empower animal healthcare professionals with opportunities to earn more and achieve greater flexibility in their careers and personal lives.

Powered by groundbreaking technology, Roo has built the industry-leading veterinary staffing platform, connecting Veterinarians, Technicians, and Assistants with animal hospitals for relief work and hiring opportunities. Roo empowers the largest network of over 20,000 veterinary professionals to help more than 9,000 animal hospitals provide quality care to more pets.

Together, we’ve provided more than 3 million hours of healthcare, helping Veterinarians earn more than $200 million.

About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Growth Marketing Manager to grow Roo's business with independent veterinary hospitals. You'll own hospital growth across the full funnel: how practice owners and managers discover Roo, why they sign up, what gets them to post and fill their first shift, and what keeps them coming back.

You'll be accountable for bringing hospitals onto Roo and turning them into active, repeat customers, with success measured by hospitals that activate and stay active alongside sign-ups and leads. As the business unit's first dedicated growth marketer, you'll shape the growth strategy, own the growth budget and measurement, and lead testing across the hospital journey.

You'll report to the GM of Independent Hospitals, with a dotted line to the Marketing leadership and be part of Roo's marketing guild, which owns craft standards for marketing across the company.

Responsibilities

Growth Strategy & Planning

Shape the strategy.
Shape the hospital growth strategy with the GM and product, setting goals for acquisition, activation, reactivation, and expansion, plus acquisition cost and payback targets tied to hospitals that fill shifts and keep posting.
Own the budget.
Own the hospital growth budget and channel mix, allocating spend by market tier based on where shifts are most likely to fill, and deciding what to scale, what to cut, and what should wait.

Acquisition

Own hospital channels.
This covers both acquisition motions: B2B lead generation and account-based campaigns with sales, and direct-to-practice-manager acquisition through paid search and social. It also covers direct mail, referrals, sponsorships, buying-group partnerships, and SEO and AEO priorities, partnering with brand on the build.
Own hospital acquisition campaigns.
Own hospital-only acquisition campaigns, and bring the acquisition layer to company-wide campaigns led by the brand team.
Partner on events.
Partner with the brand and community teams on conferences, industry events, and webinars, bringing the hospital targeting and shaping the follow-up that turns attendees into active hospitals.
Target the right hospitals.
Partner with sales, Rev Ops, and analytics on hospital targeting and lead scoring, so marketing, the field team, and automated outreach focus on the hospitals most likely to fill and grow.
Own the field handoff.
Set lead routing, handoff SLAs, and the rules for which hospitals get a Hospital Success Partner (HSP) and which get AI-driven outreach.

Activation & Conversion

Get hospitals to first fill.
Own the CRO backlog, test roadmap, and first-fill playbook across the hospital journey, from landing pages and sign-up to approval and first shift posted, partnering with product on the sign-up and first-shift experience.
Partner on product experiments.
Work with product and growth analysts to develop, launch, and evaluate A/B tests and product experiments, such as homepage banners and headline tests.
Find where hospitals drop off.
Diagnose where and why hospitals drop off, using funnel data alongside what practice owners, managers, and the field team say, and turn what you learn into fixes.
Shape activation journeys.
Partner with the lifecycle team on onboarding and activation journeys, bringing the audience insight, goals, and offers that shape them.
Make the incentive case.
Partner with the pricing team on incentive strategy: which hospitals get one, what offer, and the payback against hospital LTV.
Brief the creative.
Partner with brand on campaign creative, landing pages, and website updates, bringing clear briefs, audience insight, and performance learnings that shape the work.
Sharpen the message.
Partner with product marketing and brand on hospital positioning and messaging, and bring channel and test results back to sharpen it.

Retention & Expansion

Win back dormant hospitals.
Own the reactivation campaign for dormant, churned, and unfilled-shift hospitals, partnering with the lifecycle team on the journeys and messaging that bring them back to Roo.
Grow existing accounts.
Build expansion programs that help hospitals use Roo more often and book across more roles, such as adding veterinary technicians.

Measurement & Insights

Own the numbers.
Own hospital growth measurement, including the model that tracks acquisition cost by channel, cohort activation, fill rates, lifetime value, and payback, the holdout standard every program is measured against, and the attribution and tests with clear success criteria that show what each program actually drove.
Report and adjust.
Read results honestly, move investment toward what's working, and share progress, spend, and learnings with business unit and marketing leadership.

How This Role Works With the Team

This role sits at the center of the business unit and works through others. You'll partner with the Hospital Success Partner field team on who to target and how leads get routed, and with product and growth analysts on experiments and the sign-up and first-shift experience. You'll also work with product marketing on positioning, lifecycle on activation and reactivation journeys, pricing on first-fill incentives, analytics on targeting and measurement, and brand and community on creative, the website, events, and webinars. Because fill depends on veterinary professional supply, you'll work closely with the Veterinary Marketplace business unit so hospital demand and supply grow in the same markets. You'll bring these teams together around a shared growth plan.

What Success Looks Like

In your first year, you will:

Grow hospital acquisition against plan and within budget.
Increase the share of new hospitals that post and fill their first shift.
Grow the number of hospitals posting regularly on Roo.
Bring dormant hospitals back to active use, in partnership with the lifecycle team.
Set a clear measure for every channel and move investment toward what works.
Build a testing roadmap and first-fill playbook the business unit runs on.

Qualifications

Full-funnel growth experience.
Experience in growth or performance marketing to small businesses, ideally at a marketplace or vertical SaaS company. You've owned a budget and a channel mix.
Outcome ownership.
You've been held to a number beyond the click, like activation, first purchase or retained customers, and you've changed your spend because of it. You defend spend in CAC, payback and LTV.
B2B channel range.
Hands-on with paid search and social, sponsorships, partnerships, referrals and direct mail, and you know when to cut a channel. Bonus if you've run account-based plays for high-priority accounts alongside broad demand gen.
Root-cause thinking.
You've diagnosed why customers sign up and don't activate, and improved conversion by fixing the root cause.
Field sales partnership.
You've worked alongside a sales or account team on lead scoring, routing and handoffs, and you can tell which touches actually move the number.
Market-level thinking.
You're comfortable allocating spend by geography and you understand that in a two-sided marketplace, demand only pays off where supply exists.
Experimentation and measurement rigor.
You can show what your campaigns actually caused. You design tests with real controls, set up attribution and holdouts, pull and analyze the data yourself, read results honestly, and have reported a negative result to leadership.
Customer understanding.
You understand how small business owners and practice managers make decisions, you write clearly and credibly for busy practice owners and managers, and you write a sharp brief.
Influential partnership.
You get alignment across sales, product, PMM, lifecycle, pricing and data without formal authority.
Startup-ready.
You thrive in ambiguity and enjoy building programs from scratch.
AI fluency.
You use AI to scale your own output and have a view on where agents can replace manual outreach.
Bonus.
Experience in veterinary medicine, healthcare, marketplaces, or staffing is a plus.

Why Roo

Be the first dedicated growth marketer for Roo's hospital business and build the program from the ground up.
Own the full hospital funnel, from first touch to repeat use.
Help hospitals get the support they need and help veterinary professionals find flexible, meaningful work.
Partner closely with an ambitious team that values first-principles thinking, ownership, and continuous improvement.

While we are a remote first company, if you are based in San Francisco this will be a hybrid role.

is not legitimate

Core Values

Our Core Values are what shape us as an organization and we're looking for people who exhibit the same values in their professional life; Bias to Urgency, Drive Measurable Impact, Seek Understanding, Solve Customer Problems and Have Fun!

What to expect from working at Roo!

Located in the US:

For permanent, full time employees, we offer:

Stipends for home office setup, continuing education, and monthly wellness.
Comprehensive health benefits to fit your needs with base medical plan covered at 100% with optional premium buy up plans.
401K

Overall, you would be part of a mission-driven company that will significantly empower the lives of all veterinary professionals and the health of the overall animal industry that seeks massive innovation.

jobs.description:
Description

Join our team as a VP of Marketing and help virtualize biological experiments to accelerate discovery!

Location:
Remote - US East Coast

Reports to:
Chief Business Officer

About Turbine

A lab without limits, built for biopharma.

Turbine’s Virtual Lab (vLab®) enables scientists to run Virtual Assays across millions of biological conditions far beyond traditional laboratory throughput. Instead of narrowing hypotheses to fit experimental constraints, scientists can explore the broader biological search space computationally before deciding what to validate in the wet lab. Turbine doesn’t replace the wet lab. It makes every experiment count. Through an integrated lab-in-the-loop workflow, virtual findings become testable hypotheses, with validation results feeding back to strengthen subsequent predictions within the workflow.

In deployed programs, Turbine has reduced decision timelines from 12-18 months to approximately two months while cutting wet-lab experiments by more than 50%.

Working with scientists at leading biopharma like MSD (Merck & Co.), AstraZeneca and Bayer, Turbine’s virtual assays have rationalized experiments across more than 30 discovery programs.

Backed by leading tech and industry investors like Accel, MSD Global Health Innovation Fund, Interactive Venture Partners and Beiersdorf, Turbine is turning biology into an engineering discipline.

About The Role

Turbine is seeking a strategic VP of Marketing to build the company's reputation and market position as a leader in BioAI and virtual biology
, translating our scientific and commercial differentiation into a clear corporate narrative, strong executive presence, and increased engagement with leading biopharma organizations.

A central mandate will be to elevate the external profiles of Turbine's founders and leadership team and establish them as credible, distinctive voices in BioAI and the future of pharmaceutical R&D.

The VP of Marketing will provide the strategic marketing leadership required as Turbine scales commercially and expands its technology across modalities and therapeutic areas. They will act as a strategic advisor to the CEO, founders, CBO, and wider leadership team on positioning, external communications, executive visibility, and market engagement.

The VP will lead Turbine's marketing function, setting strategy and direction across corporate and product marketing while developing a high-performing team focused on product marketing, scientific content, conferences, and sales enablement.

Key Responsibilities

Corporate Strategy, Positioning & Brand

Own and continuously sharpen Turbine's corporate positioning and market narrative.
Define Turbine's overarching corporate narrative and category positioning.
Establish clear, differentiated messaging around virtual biology, Virtual Cells, Virtual Assays, and Virtual Lab.
Translate sophisticated science and technology into compelling and accessible market narratives.
Clearly differentiate Turbine within the AI drug discovery, virtual cell, and broader TechBio landscape.
Ensure consistency across corporate, product, scientific, and commercial communications.
Build and maintain a differentiated corporate brand and consistent visual and verbal identity as the company and product portfolio expand.
Monitor market, customer, and competitive developments and translate these insights into positioning and go-to-market strategy.

Founder & Executive Thought Leadership

Build a systematic thought-leadership platform around Turbine's founders and leadership team.
Develop distinct thought-leadership territories for priority executives.
Identify and secure relevant speaking, media, podcast, panel, and authorship opportunities.
Develop executive narratives, talking points, and opinion pieces.
Prepare executives for high-profile external engagements.
Build relationships with conference organizers, industry influencers, and relevant ecosystem leaders.
Position Turbine executives as credible and sought-after voices on AI, biology, and the future of pharmaceutical R&D.
Work with external agencies and internal teams to deliver consistent and sustained executive visibility.

PR, Communications & BioAI Ecosystem

Own Turbine's global PR and external communications strategy.
Build direct relationships with influential biopharma, biotech, technology, and AI journalists and editors.
Lead and manage external PR and communications partners.
Develop proactive media narratives beyond company announcements and press releases.
Build communications programs around scientific results, partnerships, funding, product developments, and customer milestones.
Maximize the impact of corporate announcements through targeted media engagement and follow-on coverage.
Generate proactive earned-media opportunities around relevant industry developments and conversations.
Manage corporate announcements and issues communications.
Increase high-quality earned media coverage and Turbine's share of voice in BioAI and virtual biology.

Commercial Marketing & Account Engagement

Partner closely with Business Development and Product Marketing to translate Turbine's positioning into commercial impact.
Develop marketing strategies for priority biopharma accounts, therapeutic areas, and use cases.
Use account-based marketing and targeted campaigns to increase engagement within strategic accounts.
Coordinate executive, conference, content, and digital activity around priority accounts.
Develop messaging and campaigns around customer needs and commercial priorities.
Drive measurable marketing contribution to qualified pipeline and strategic-account engagement.
Use customer, market, and competitive insights to inform marketing and commercial strategy.
Turn customer proof points and scientific results into compelling commercial narratives in partnership with Business Development, Product, and scientific teams.

Marketing Leadership & Operations

Own the annual marketing strategy, priorities, operating plan, and budget.
Establish clear corporate and product marketing objectives and measurable KPIs.
Prioritize investment across PR, thought leadership, conferences, content, digital, and account-based marketing.
Assess marketing effectiveness and ROI and redirect investment where appropriate.
Select, manage, and hold external agencies and partners accountable for outcomes.
Lead, develop, and mentor a high-performing marketing team.
Establish effective ways of working across Marketing, Business Development, Product, and Delivery.

Product Marketing & Sales Enablement

Provide strategic direction and leadership to the Product Marketing & Sales Enablement function while empowering the team to own day-to-day execution.
Ensure clear and differentiated product positioning and messaging.
Oversee development of sales enablement materials, product collateral, and launch programs.
Build a strong portfolio of customer case studies and scientific and commercial proof points.
Ensure competitive intelligence informs product positioning and commercial conversations.
Oversee conference content, scientific publications, white papers, webinars, and product-oriented campaigns.
Ensure Business Development has the narratives, evidence, and materials required to engage priority customers effectively.
Partner with Product, Scientific, and Delivery teams to ensure scientific accuracy and identify compelling evidence and proof points.

Requirements

Experience & Qualifications

Essential

12+ years of progressive marketing, communications, or corporate marketing experience.
Significant experience in biopharma, biotech, TechBio, AI-enabled drug discovery, or an adjacent scientific technology market.
Strong existing relationships across the biopharma and biotech media, communications, and industry ecosystem.
Demonstrated success positioning a complex scientific or technology company.
Track record of developing founders and senior executives into recognized external thought leaders.
Exceptional corporate narrative, positioning, messaging, and storytelling capabilities.
Experience leading PR agencies and external communications partners.

Strong executive presence and the ability to operate credibly with founders, board members, investors, and pharmaceutical executives.
Demonstrated ability to move between strategy and execution while maintaining focus on the highest-value priorities.
Experience leading and developing a small, high-output marketing team.

Highly Desirable

Experience helping scale an investor-backed company through a significant commercial growth phase.
Strong understanding of pharmaceutical R&D and drug discovery.
Experience creating or positioning a new technology category.
Strong US biopharma network, ideally complemented by European relationships.
Experience with strategic partnerships and joint customer communications.
Experience building an executive thought-leadership program from the ground up.

What Success Looks Like

jobs.title: Founding Marketing
jobs.description:
Business unit:
GTM
Compensation:
$120k-$160k, 0.1%-0.25% equity
Reports to:
CoS (Bruce)
Location:
NYC in-person 5 days a week

Overview

Howdy! Bruce here - Chief of Staff at String. If you’re a technical storyteller who speaks the language of engineers, can move fast, and wants to write, film, and build for some of the largest enterprises in the world, I want you to join our team.

At String, we’re building the complete layer for companies to collect, structure, and receive web data. We’ve hit 7-figure ARR, are growing fast
by selling to everyone, from individual devs I meet on X to some of the most powerful financial institutions on the planet ($1T+ AUM). We’ve done it all with a lean team of < 10, with only one initial funding round.

In July, we launched our Web Access API, which allows companies to fetch, search, crawl, map, and browse nearly any site on the internet.

In <2 months from launch, that product reached six figures ARR. We have a ~95%+ conversion rate from trial → purchase, and a ~95% retention rate.

I want to get it in front of more people and companies. I want you to help us do it.

This role would own our inbound sales strategy and execution for the Web Access API. I think of the job as having three responsibilities:
Strategize:
How should we segment our prospects? What are the best places and content formats to reach them?
Create:
Build content (YT videos, blogs, ads, tweets, demos, LI posts, etc.) that show the value of our product to enterprises who use web data to build out their core product offering
Engage:
Meet engineers where they are (discords, subreddits, hacker news, hackathons, stackoverflow) and help them solve their scraping / antibot problems while demonstrating String’s value!

You are either a builder with a creative side or a creative with a technical side, and are excited about being online all day, talking to engineers, while creating data-driven content using one of the largest collections of web data on the planet.

What we do

Today, any business that wants to collect web data has to jump through tons of hoops:
Build infrastructure to send thousands of requests to websites
Build technology to avoid getting detected as a bot (very hard to do at scale)
Code individual scripts for every website they want to scrape
Fix all those scripts as websites change, and
Ensure consistent data quality across runs

We solve all of these problems so that they never have to worry about their web data pipelines. Thus, we 1) significantly improve their end products driving millions in revenue and 2) save them hundreds of thousands of dollars in engineering costs.

We cut our teeth working with hedge funds (6 of the top 10 in AUM are customers) and VC firms (names you’d recognize but I cannot disclose) and are now taking our learnings from working with them to build data solutions for every firm that needs public web data for their product.

Our end customers use our product to
Make better decisions. E.g., “How much is Lululemon discounting their products and should I therefore buy their stock?”
Fundamentally support their core products. E.g. I’m an AI legal tech company and need to scrape tons of legal codes across state & local government websites.

Building this would have been impossible before the AI revolution. We have a unique opportunity to build the first platform where anyone can collect structured data across any website with just a prompt.

What you will do

Write articles showing insights from the datasets that we collect (E.g., deep-dive analysis on the growth of Anduril, comparing success of Lululemon vs. Vuori, analyzing adoption of Chinese vs. US AI models)
Help us get to tens of thousands of followers across LinkedIn and X
Construct personalized demos for the companies we’re targeting
Engage with people asking questions about scraping and antibot on reddit, discord, etc
Set up a slack or discord for all of our users to connect, and run it!
Construct and run a paid ads program
Optimize funnel conversion and create custom landing pages for clients and specific ads
Create short and long form videos that demonstrate product capabilities, provide educational value to developers, and show life at our company!

We’re willing to bet on slope if you can demonstrate a high level of competence or hunger. We have a few must-haves, and the rest is flexible if you rock.

You do have:

Experience writing content (we ask for proof of this in the application)
An NYC home base (or the willingness to move)
Some data or technical experience (Python, Go, Typescript, working with APIs). This is not about expertise, but our product and buyers are technical and you must understand both deeply

You probably have:

1+ years of experience building GTM systems using AI
2+ years of sales or marketing experience
Experience selling $10k-100k ARR deals

Our application is structured in a way that allows you to demonstrate these things rather than just tell us about them. If you copy and paste AI-generated text into the application, I’ll know, and I will throw it in the slopcan :)

Why you'd join us

It isn’t often that a startup is hiring their first marketing employee after already generating 7 figures in ARR. We are in the initial stages of PMF and have by far the best product in the market (the vast majority of our customers have switched from competitors).

The bottleneck now is just getting it in front of buyers. For the right person, this will be an opportunity for immense career growth both to own responsibility beyond the typical marketing role and to move into managing a team much faster than otherwise possible.

This role will transform your career and give you the badge to go on to whatever you want to do next.

We believe you’ll have the skills to be a 10x asset to any startup you join in the future - the type of person that hot startups want to bring in as their first VP of marketing.

We’ve also structured our compensation to be higher than market rate and to include accelerants and equity to ensure we get the best talent. Other benefits include:
Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Flexible PTO
Free food in office - breakfast, lunch, dinner
NYC office - beautiful office in Chelsea, snacks, drinks, peak startup energy
Unlimited tokens for AI use
Annual international offsite (last 3 years - Marrakech, Istanbul, Kuala Lumpur - we like an adventure!)

Interview process

Initial conversation with Bruce (30 mins)
Conversation with Rohit (30 mins)
Work exercise with Bruce (1 hour)
Work trial in person with full team (1 day)

Team

You should read through our team values to see if working with us will be a good fit for you. If you get excited from reading the values page, it’s likely a good fit and vice versa.

Logan (CTO): Leading engineering and has extensive web scraping & AI experience. Ships like a 10 person engineering team (Rohit bragging for him). Previously worked as the founding engineer at Nourish (YC W21, now unicorn) and as a software engineer at C3 AI. Has arbitraged Polymarket, frontran ICOs & Coinbase listings, and written a chess engine.

Rohit (CEO): Leading GTM and has signed 25+ deals including 6 of the 10 largest hedge funds while spending half his time coding. Previously worked as a consultant at Bain and cofounded two startups in college, one of them with Logan called CampusOven.

Bruce (CoS): Joined from Bain to help supercharge the ops function and grow adoption of our industry-leading Web Access product. Also worked with us during our CampusOven days.

Engineers: We have 7 more great engineers on the team who help build and maintain the full end to end product. We’re lucky to have such passionate and thoughtful engineers on the team.

Growth interns: We have two rockstar interns on the team right now who have already sourced billion-dollar companies and publicly traded enterprises, they’ll be able to help you out!

Compensation

We’re building an exceptional team and so want to be generous on compensation. Our philosophy is that base compensation is for living expenses and equity is for upside. We want you to be able to give your all and benefit proportionately from your contributions, without worrying about living expenses.

So our compensation structure is a base salary competitive with other early-stage startups and generous equity relative to other startups. We know that part of the excitement of joining a startup is the upside and to feel like an owner - that’s why we left our corporate jobs.

Concretely, that means $120-$160k salary with 0.1%-0.25% equity - we are flexible here based on desired mix of cash, equity, and commission
