jobs.description:
About HYBE Americas

HYBE AMERICAS, a subsidiary of HYBE Corp., is a leading global entertainment and media company at the intersection of music, film, television, technology, brands, culture and social good. HYBE AMERICAS drives innovation across the entertainment landscape through its diverse portfolio, including Blue Highway Records, the publishing company Big Machine Music and Quality Control Music in the U.S., and HYBE’s labels in Latin America and the U.S. Hispanic market. The company represents a powerhouse roster of global artists spanning multiple genres and cultures. With headquarters in Los Angeles, HYBE AMERICAS creates synergistic opportunities for artists, businesses, and brands through its integrated approach to talent development, content creation, and technological innovation that transcends industries.

At HYBE, we believe in the power of music and foster a culture built on Passion, Autonomy, and Trust.

Position Overview

Reporting directly to the Art Director (Evergreen Content & Social Series), the Social Media Video Content Creator is the primary hands-on video creator and editor responsible for bringing the artist and brand to life across social platforms. This role combines a passion for digital storytelling, video production, and internet culture. You will shoot and edit high-volume short-form content (i.e. TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) and digital media assets that drive high engagement and keep the fanbase connected daily.

This is a full-time, hybrid role based in our Santa Monica office, with in-person collaboration 3 days per week and remote work 2 days per week. Candidates must be based in or willing to relocate to the greater Los Angeles area at their own expense prior to their start date — we are not offering relocation assistance for this role, though it may be considered on a case-by-case basis for select candidates.

Key Responsibilities

Content Creation & Short-Form Editing

Shoot and edit high-quality short-form videos (:15s to 2:00m) for all owned social channels and paid media, filling the content calendar with engaging B-roll, trends, personality clips, and brand integrations.
Bring videos to life through fast-turnaround editing, custom motion graphics, sound design/effects, trending audio, and platform-optimized subtitles.
Format and deliver platform-native video assets tailored specifically for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, e-commerce (including Weverse), and email marketing.

Long-Form Content Creation & Editing

Shoot and edit high-quality long-form videos (5:00-30:00+ minutes) for owned social channels such as YouTube, filling the content calendar with engaging programming. Examples include: Day in the life vlogs, making of/BTS videos, group challenges/activities/travel, performance-focused videos and longer episodic pieces/documentaries.
Bring videos to life through high quality production, fast-turnaround editing, custom motion graphics, sound design/effects, and platform-optimized subtitles.
Format and deliver platform-native video assets tailored specifically for YouTube.

Art Direction Alignment & Creative Execution

Work closely with the Art Directors to execute exact visual guidelines, including lighting styles, camera framing, color profiles, and overall aesthetic direction.
Brainstorm and pitch fresh, culturally relevant content ideas and act quickly on emerging social trends, audio formats, and digital subcultures.
Collaborate with social media and marketing partners to ensure video output ladders up to broader monthly content calendars and brand goals.

Studio & Equipment Management

Maintain the organization, inventory, and operational readiness for the production
Handle physical production logistics, including setting up and tearing down lighting configurations, camera gear, and loose set design and props when needed.

Workflow & Project Management

Manage multiple concurrent editing and shooting projects to consistently meet tight daily and weekly deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Organize and maintain clean post-production project files, raw footage archives, and final social asset libraries.

Qualifications

2–4+ years of hands-on video shooting, editing, and social content creation for a brand, music artist, digital media publisher, or creative agency.
Proficient with mirrorless and digital cinema cameras (Sony, Canon, Blackmagic) as well as mobile shooting setups, with a solid grasp of lighting, composition, and field audio capture.
Expert in Adobe Premiere Pro; proficiency in After Effects, CapCut, and platform-native editing tools is highly valued.
A strong portfolio or social reel highlighting high-engagement short-form videos, creative pacing, motion graphics, sound integration, and strong visual aesthetics.
Deep, native understanding of short-form social video formats, algorithms, and trend lifecycles across TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
Self-motivated, highly organized, and thriving in a fast-moving, highly collaborative environment.
Willingness and ability to travel extensively with artists on tour, on set, and for off-site appearances.

Don't match every skill listed? Almost nobody does! Think you're a good fit anyway? Please let us know.

Salary Range

The salary range for this job is $95,000 to $125,000. This is a good faith effort at the time of posting. This range is base salary only and does not include benefits and any other compensatory components of the role.

Why Join Us

At HYBE Americas, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the voice and reputation of one of the most dynamic and innovative companies in global entertainment. You’ll work with some of the world’s most exciting artists and help tell the stories that define culture. We back our passion for music with benefits that take care of you, so you can bring your best to the work that inspires millions.

jobs.title: Customer Marketing & Omnichannel Manager
jobs.description:
Apply

Job Type

Full-time

Description

The Customer Marketing & Omnichannel Manager is responsible for translating Sun-Maid’s brand and business priorities and customer strategies into customer-specific marketing and omnichannel plans that drive profitable growth.

Serving as a key marketing partner to the Sales and broker teams, this role leads the development and execution of customer-specific shopper marketing, retail media, and e-commerce programs. The Manager connects brand strategy, customer objectives, shopper insights, promotional activity, and commercial priorities to create integrated programs across in-store and digital touchpoints.

The ideal candidate brings a strong foundation in CPG customer or shopper marketing with meaningful experience in e-commerce, Amazon, retail media, and the digital shelf, as well as the ability to adapt strategies across critical retail channels, including Mass, Grocery, Club, and E-Commerce. This highly cross-functional role partners closely with Brand Marketing, Sales, broker teams, Insights, Finance, and external agency partners to move programs from strategy and brief through execution, optimization, and performance measurement.

Requirements

Customer & Shopper Marketing

Serve as a primary Brand Marketing partner to Sales and broker teams, working closely with them to understand, capture, and translate customer strategies, priorities, and opportunities into actionable customer marketing plans.
Build strong working relationships with Sales and broker partners to maintain a current understanding of customer objectives, retailer priorities, merchandising plans, innovation opportunities, and evolving business needs.
Translate Sun-Maid brand and business priorities and customer strategies into differentiated customer marketing plans for key retail partners.
Develop annual and ongoing customer activation plans in partnership with Sales and cross-functional teams.
Use customer, shopper, category, and competitive insights to identify growth opportunities and inform activation strategies.
Partner with Insights to incorporate relevant consumer, shopper, category, and customer learning into customer-specific strategies and plans.
Ensure customer programs address clearly defined business objectives, including Buy Rate, trial, repeat, conversion, brand relevance, and successful innovation launches.
Translate national brand campaigns and innovation platforms into relevant customer-specific programs.
Develop compelling customer activation stories and materials to support Sales in retailer meetings, line reviews, and joint business planning.

Activation & Program Execution

Lead customer-specific programs from approved strategy and brief through execution, optimization, and post-program analysis.
Develop clear, insight-based briefs outlining the business opportunity, shopper objective, audience, activation strategy, KPIs, and deliverables.
Lead external shopper, retail media, creative, e-commerce, and other agency partners in the development and execution of customer programs.
Coordinate customer activation calendars, timelines, deliverables, budgets, approvals, and cross-functional dependencies.
Ensure programs connect relevant in-store and digital touchpoints, including merchandising, retailer.com, search, retail media, social commerce, and consumer promotions.
Evaluate customer and Sales requests for strategic fit, business impact, and alignment with established priorities.
Independently manage day-to-day program decisions while escalating significant investment decisions, strategic changes, or competing priorities as appropriate.

Customer & Channel Strategy

Develop customer strategies that reflect the unique shopper, merchandising, and activation dynamics of priority channels, including Mass, Grocery, Club, and E-Commerce.
Partner closely with Sales to support Club customers, including Costco and Sam’s Club, to identify opportunities to protect and grow the core business and support innovation, including customer-specific and limited-time offerings.
Translate brand and Innovation priorities into customer-specific activation strategies that reflect each retailer’s business model, shopper expectations, merchandising approach, and path to purchase.

Promotional Integration & Activation

Partner with Sales and Insights to understand customer promotional plans, performance, and opportunities, incorporating relevant learnings into customer activation strategies.
Align shopper marketing, retail media, e-commerce, and consumer-facing activation with priority promotional and merchandising windows.
Leverage Insights-led promotional analysis and historical performance to inform activation timing, tactics, and investment recommendations.
Identify opportunities to amplify priority promotions through integrated in-store and digital activation.
Manage consumer-facing promotional programs, including coupons and other shopper incentives, as appropriate within the broader customer plan.
Incorporate promotional and activation learnings into post-program reviews and future customer marketing plans.

Omnichannel & E-Commerce

Lead the integration of e-commerce and digital commerce into customer marketing plans, connecting in-store, retailer.com, and pure-play e-commerce experiences.
Bring strong omnichannel expertise across e-commerce and digital commerce, including Amazon and key retailer platforms, while connecting digital capabilities to broader customer and channel strategies.
Partner with Sales, Brand Marketing, and external partners to improve the discoverability, relevance, and conversion of Sun-Maid products online.
Support Amazon strategy across product content, retail readiness, search, digital merchandising, media, and promotions.
Identify opportunities to strengthen Sun-Maid's digital shelf across Amazon, Walmart.com, Target.com, Kroger.com, and other priority platforms.
Help optimize product detail pages, search relevance, enhanced content, ratings and reviews, online assortment, and conversion.
Ensure e-commerce best practices are applied to both existing products and new product launches.

Retail Media

Lead the development of customer retail media strategies aligned to brand, shopper, and commercial objectives.
Partner with Sales, agencies, and retail media networks to develop integrated retailer media plans.
Support planning across platforms such as Walmart Connect, Amazon Ads, Roundel, Kroger Precision Marketing, and other priority networks.
Evaluate agency and retailer recommendations across paid search, onsite and offsite media, display, social commerce, connected TV, and other relevant formats.
Ensure campaigns have clear objectives, audiences, KPIs, benchmarks, and measurement plans.
Connect retail media investment to the broader customer strategy rather than managing it as an isolated media tactic.
Use performance data to recommend optimizations to targeting, tactics, and investment.

Measurement & Optimization

Partner with Insights, Sales, Finance, and agency partners to establish objectives and KPIs for customer marketing, retail media, e-commerce, and consumer activation programs.
Leverage Insights-led analyses, customer data, and agency reporting to evaluate program performance and identify business implications.
Evaluate programs using relevant measures such as sales, Buy Rate, trial and repeat, new-to-brand, incremental sales, ROAS, conversion, digital penetration, and promotional lift.
Understand and appropriately distinguish between attributed sales and incremental business impact.
Translate results into clear, actionable recommendations for future customer activation and investment.
Capture post-program learnings and apply them consistently to future planning and optimization.

Budget & Agency Management

Manage assigned customer marketing, shopper activation, retail media, e-commerce, and consumer promotion budgets.
Maintain accurate budget forecasts and manage program spending in partnership with Finance and agency teams.
Ensure investments align with strategic priorities and expected business impact.
Recommend opportunities to increase, reduce, or reallocate investment based on performance and business needs.
Manage agency partners through clear briefs, scopes, timelines, deliverables, and performance expectations.
Hold partners accountable for strategic quality, execution, timing, budget, and results.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Build strong partnerships across Brand Marketing, Sales, Insights, Finance, Innovation, Operations, and external partners.
Work closely with Sales to understand, capture, and apply customer strategy, acting as a key connector between customer objectives, brand strategy, shopper needs, and activation execution.
Bring the customer and shopper perspective into broader brand, innovation, and business planning.
Partner with Brand and Innovation leads to translate campaigns, positioning, and innovation priorities into effective customer activation.
Partner with the Associate Brand Manager on customer-facing assets, innovation launches, and shared executional priorities as appropriate.
Proactively communicate performance, opportunities, risks, and recommendations to key stakeholders.
Operate with a high degree of ownership and autonomy while elevating the decisions that require senior leadership direction.

Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field.
5+ years of experience in customer marketing, shopper marketing, omnichannel marketing, e-commerce, trade marketing, or a related CPG discipline.
Experience developing and executing customer-specific marketing plans for major retailers.
Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with Sales and/or broker teams to translate customer priorities into actionable marketing strategies.
Strong understanding of the relationship between Brand Marketing, Sales, shopper marketing, promotions, e-commerce, and retail media.
Demonstrated experience developing customer marketing strategies across multiple retail channels, with experience in e-commerce/Amazon and/or Club strongly preferred.
Working knowledge of digital shelf fundamentals, product content, retailer search, digital merchandising, and e-commerce conversion.
Experience working with retail media networks such as Amazon Ads, Walmart Connect, Roundel, Kroger Precision Marketing, or similar platforms preferred.
Experience leading external agencies and complex cross-functional projects from strategy through execution and measurement.
Strong analytical and commercial skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, budgets, stakeholders, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Strong written, verbal, presentation, and cross-functional influencing skills.

CPG, food/snacking, Amazon Vendor Central, Club (including Costco and/or Sam’s Club), syndicated data, digital shelf, and new product launch experience are preferred.

Shape Positioning and launches

Content priorities reflect customer needs, product plans, and business goals.

The ability to build strong cross-functional relationships, influence stakeholders, and move work forward in a lean organization.

Automotive, fleet, service and repair, parts, data, SaaS, APIs, analytics, or other technically complex B2B markets.

jobs.description:
About C4 Therapeutics:

C4 Therapeutics (C4T) (Nasdaq: CCCC) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company dedicated to delivering on the promise of targeted protein degradation science to create a new generation of medicines that transforms patients’ lives. C4T is progressing targeted oncology programs through clinical studies and leveraging its TORPEDO® platform to efficiently design and optimize small-molecule medicines to address difficult-to-treat diseases. C4T’s degrader medicines are designed to harness the body’s natural protein recycling system to rapidly degrade disease-causing proteins, offering the potential to overcome drug resistance, drug undruggable targets and improve patient outcomes. For more information, please visit www.c4therapeutics.com .

Job Summary

The Associate Director, Marketing will own the pre-launch brand foundation for cemsidomide: market definition, positioning, and early launch planning in multiple myeloma. You will work hands-on, translating clinical data into a clear strategic story and partnering closely with Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Market Access, and Corporate Communications. As cemsidomide is investigational, all external activity will be non-promotional and compliant with pre-approval guidelines.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone equally comfortable designing a marketing campaign and running a physician advisory board to get in on the ground level of our commercial build out at C4T. Your skills and passion for this space will allow you to have a front row seat to see what it looks like to build out a commercial function at a small life sciences company as one of our first dedicated commercial hires.

Your Role

Messaging Development

Lead development of disease-state and messaging for multiple myeloma, translating clinical data into clear, compliant narratives.
Run message testing with hematologist-oncologists, community oncologists, and other customers; refine messages as data mature.
Build and maintain the core messaging platform and ensure consistent use across venues and audiences.
Take materials through Medical/Legal/Regulatory review with a clear grasp of pre-approval compliance.

Agency of Record (AOR) Selection and Onboarding

Lead the search for C4T's first marketing AOR: define requirements, build the RFP, run pitches, and recommend a partner.
Onboard the selected agency: brief them on the disease area, science, and compliance expectations; set up ways of working, review cadence, and scopes of work.
Manage the agency day to day, including budgets, timelines, and quality of deliverables.

Advisory Boards

Plan and run advisory boards with KOLs and community physicians, in partnership with Medical Affairs, to gather customer insights.
Set objectives, design discussion guides, select participants, and manage logistics with vendors.
Synthesize findings into clear recommendations and share them with cross-functional and senior leadership.

Competitive Intelligence

Track the MM landscape, including next-generation IKZF1/3 degraders, BCMA- and GPRC5D-directed bispecifics, CAR-T, and anti-CD38 regimens.
Lead congress coverage and competitive readouts at key meetings.
Deliver regular competitive intelligence updates and assess implications for Cemsidomide's development and messaging.

Congress Booth Presence

Own C4T's corporate and disease-awareness booth presence at major hematology and oncology congresses.
Lead booth concept, design, and content with the AOR, medical affairs and exhibit vendors, ensuring all content is non-promotional and approved.
Manage booth logistics, staffing, budget, and post-congress performance reviews.

Your Background

Required:

A Bachelor's Degree in life sciences, business, or a related field with a minimum of eight years in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology space, including at least five years in product or brand marketing, including oncology marketing experience.
Hands-on experience turning corporate and departmental strategy into marketing execution with a strong sense of independence.
Working knowledge of pre-approval compliance and the Medical/Legal/Regulatory review process.
Ability to read and communicate clinical trial data with accuracy and confidence.

Preferred

MBA or advanced scientific degree (PharmD, PhD, MS).
Hematologic malignancies experience strong preferred, including multiple myeloma experience, ideally on a launch or pre-launch team.
Experience at a small or emerging biotech building processes from scratch.
Familiarity with the healthcare professional community

Compensation

The base pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between $199,104.00 – $219,500.00 annually; however, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

jobs.description:

We’re looking for a Senior Marketing Operations Manager to lead and evolve Marketing Operations in a scaled, multi‑team organization. This role is both strategic and hands‑on—you’ll set the vision for how marketing operates at scale while staying closely involved in execution, systems, and analytics.

You’ll be a key partner to Marketing, Sales, Product, and RevOps leadership, responsible for ensuring our marketing engine is efficient, aligned, measurable, and continuously improving as the business grows.

What You’ll Do

Marketing Operations Strategy & Ownership

Own the end‑to‑end Marketing Operations strategy for a scaled organization, balancing flexibility with governance
Act as the primary Marketing Ops partner to senior marketing leadership

Hands
‑ On Systems & Execution

Own and actively manage the marketing technology stack (e.g., Dreamdata, Marketo, and related tools). Configure, optimize, and troubleshoot systems to support campaigns, launches, and lifecycle programs including email, landing pages, and lead flows
Ensure data quality, integrations, and system performance across tools through thorough QA of all implementations
Lead vendor selection, renewals, and day‑to‑day tool optimization

Process Optimization & Scale

Establish and maintain scalable workflows, templates, and operating rhythms
Identify gaps in the marketing technology stack and recommend tools to improve efficiency, capability, and scale
Identify operational bottlenecks and design solutions that scale globally and work across functions
Partner closely with the CRM and RevOps teams to manage approvals, releases, and cross‑tool dependencies
Drive automation and standardization while maintaining flexibility where needed to support growth
Enable segmentation, regional execution, and localization from an operational and systems perspective
Design, build, and continuously optimize workflows, processes, and automation supporting marketing campaigns and lifecycle programs

Analytics & Insights

Define and own marketing and funnel metrics across the full customer journey
Build and maintain executive‑ready dashboards and recurring performance reporting
Deliver insights that inform investment decisions, strategy, optimization, and campaign performance
Partner closely with RevOps and Finance on attribution, pipeline, and ROI measurement
Cross‑Functional Leadership & Collaboration
Serve as a trusted operational partner to Growth Marketing, Sales Ops, RevOps, Finance, Product, and Regional Marketing teams
Align on data definitions, KPIs, SLAs, and handoffs across GTM teams

At Fieldwire, we’re looking for our next Senior Marketing Operations Manager to have the following skills and experiences

8+ years of experience in Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, or GTM Operations
Must be Marketo Certified
Proven experience operating in a scaled B2B organization (SaaS or complex GTM preferred)
Deep, hands‑on expertise with CRM, marketing automation, and analytics tools
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to turn data into actionable insights
Demonstrated ability to operate at both strategic and executional levels
Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills
Comfortable driving change, structure, and clarity in complex environments

What Success Looks Like

Marketing operates with clarity, consistency, and speed at scale
Leadership has clear visibility into performance, impact, and ROI
Teams are enabled by systems and processes—not slowed down by them
Marketing Ops is viewed as a strategic partner, not just a support function

Compensation

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows: $110,000 - $130,000

The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors such as your skills, qualifications and experience. As part of the Hilti Group, Fieldwire combines deep construction expertise with modern digital innovation to deliver better outcomes on every job. Learn more at Fieldwire.com.

This role is hybrid on-site in San Francisco, California. Our headquarters are based in beautiful San Francisco and our office is centrally located right off of Embarcadero Bart station.

jobs.title: Marketing Technology Manager
jobs.description:
JOB TITLE:
Marketing Technology Manager
FLSA STATUS:
Exempt
SCHEDULE:
M-F, 40 hrs./week
LOCATION:
Phoenix, AZ; Denver, CO; Kansas City, MO; Nashville, TN; Dallas, TX; Houston, TX; Oklahoma City, OK; or Tulsa, OK
REPORTS TO:
Chief Marketing Officer

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Marketing Technology Manager serves as the lead strategist and day-to-day manager for the firm’s marketing technology platforms, including the website, intranet, CRM, email marketing tools, analytics platforms and related digital communication systems. This role is responsible for ensuring the firm’s technology stack is well managed, effectively integrated and leveraged to create efficiencies, improve collaboration, strengthen data quality and uncover actionable insights that support client development and business development opportunities. Working closely with marketing team members, attorneys, attorney teams and support staff, the Marketing Technology Manager translates data into practical intelligence and proactively helps stakeholders use that intelligence to enhance pursuits, deepen client relationships and advance firm growth objectives.

COMPENSATION:
At Spencer Fane, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including but not limited to location, skillset, experience, training, licenses, certifications and other business or organizational needs. Compensation will be determined based on the above factors along with the requirements of the position. We expect the starting salary for this position to be between $92,000 and $122,000.

BENEFITS:
Medical, Vision, Dental, PTO, 401k, Life, Disability.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Serve as the primary manager and subject matter resource for the firm’s marketing technology stack, including the CRM, website, intranet, email marketing platform, analytics tools and related systems used to support marketing and client development efforts.
Contribute to the firm’s broader strategy for leveraging technology to create efficiencies, improve collaboration, strengthen internal processes and identify new opportunities for client development and business growth.
Manage all aspects of the firm’s CRM database and associated technologies, including, Pardot, Introhive, Power BI and other related platforms, with responsibility for maintenance, implementations, integrations, reporting, policies, procedures and training.
Play a key role in identifying, evaluating, recommending, implementing and deploying new technologies that support marketing and client development efforts, including tools related to experience management, pitches and proposals, business development intelligence, relationship mapping and campaign performance.
Develop comprehensive reports, dashboards and actionable insights that help internal marketing teams, attorneys and attorney teams make informed decisions related to events, client development initiatives, pitches, proposals, public relations opportunities and other business development pursuits.
Proactively identify trends, opportunities, relationship insights and data-driven recommendations that can be used to support attorney teams, strengthen pursuit strategies and help the firm compete more effectively for new work.
Partner with marketing team members, attorneys and support staff to translate data and analytics into clear, practical guidance that supports outreach, follow-up, targeting, cross-selling and client relationship development.
Maintain and improve data quality across marketing technology platforms by regularly analyzing, updating, cleaning and reviewing data for accuracy, consistency and completeness.
Create, update, maintain and document firmwide guidelines, processes, data standards and best practices to promote consistent use of the digital marketing platforms by all users and data sources.
Provide training, guidance and responsive support to marketing team members, attorneys and support staff on CRM use, reporting, mailing lists, analytics tools and other marketing technologies.
Manage, maintain and optimize the firm’s website, serving as project manager and primary contact for website-related projects, enhancements and initiatives.
Optimize website content to improve visibility, usability and search performance; provide regular reporting on website, email communications, blog and campaign analytics.
Work directly with marketing department team members, attorneys and support staff to create and maintain mailing lists in the firm’s email marketing platform and CRM for newsletters, announcements, events, alerts and other communications.
Generate and format reports for active and post-campaign, event and business development follow-up; create and refine report formats as needed to support expanded business development efforts.
Support the firm’s visibility on third-party websites and assist with digital communications initiatives that strengthen the firm’s brand and market presence.
Maintain vendor relationships, coordinate with external technology partners and collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure systems, integrations and services meet the firm’s evolving needs.
Perform other select marketing, client development and business development duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATION/SKILLS:

Education:
Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year accredited college or university preferred.
Experience:
Minimum of 8+ years of database, CRM, marketing technology or related digital marketing experience preferred.
Previous experience in a law firm or other professional services firm is a plus.
Technical, Systems & CRM Expertise:
Experience managing CRM systems, marketing automation platforms, reporting tools and related integrations.
Experience with digital media and marketing tools, including content management systems, WordPress, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEO, HTML, email marketing platforms and similar systems.
Advance computer literacy skills, including proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, Adobe Creative Suite, and template-based SaaS products such as Concep, Constant Contact, Mailchimp or similar platforms.
Experience working with digital analytics tools and developing reports or dashboards that inform marketing, client development, or business development strategy.
Strong understanding of CRM platforms, with the ability to manage data, reporting integrations, workflows, user adoption and training.
Demonstrated ability to turn data into meaningful insights, recommendations and opportunities that support marketing, client development and business development objectives.
Collaboration & Professional Effectiveness:
Ability to work independently and as part of a team within a complex, fast-paced law firm environment, and collaborate with all marketing department team members.
Proactive, Solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to anticipate needs, identify opportunities and help team members and attorneys use technology more effectively.
Project Management & Organizational Skills:
Strong project management skills, including the ability to prioritize multiple projects, manage competing demands and move initiatives forward and minimal supervision.
Highly organized, efficient, responsive and detail-oriented, with a strong commitment to data accuracy, process improvement and client service.
Communication & Relationship Management:
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both written and oral, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to users with varying levels of technical experience.
Comfort working directly with attorneys, attorney teams, marketing professionals and support staff to understand business needs, identify useful data points and provide practical guidance.
Ability to maintain strong vendor relationships and coordinate effectively with internal stakeholders and external technology partners.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Physical Requirements:
Position is generally sedentary in nature; involves sitting most of the time but may involve the need for inter-office mobility for brief periods of time.
Ability to occasionally or routinely lift up to 10 – 20 lbs.
Communication:
Ability to efficiently communicate.
Manual Dexterity:
Ability to perform repetitive motions required.
Visual Requirements:
Ability to see and read PC screens, detect color coding, read fine print, and/or normal size print.

DISCLAIMER:

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required of personnel so classified.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager (US Remote)
jobs.description:
About Feathery

Feathery is the AI operating system for financial institutions. With hundreds of clients and over $30 million raised, Feathery is the fast-growing leader in financial agentic automation. Industry leaders like Tokio Marine, Sequoia Financial, and Cerity Partners run their client-facing workflows on Feathery, from onboarding and risk assessment to reconciling systems and generating proposals and reports.

At the center of it all is Robin, our AI operations assistant. Robin scans client documents, configures and deploys workflows, assists users in their day-to-day work, takes notes during meetings, and supports a growing range of operational tasks across the client lifecycle.

We're building a future where financial operations shift from paperwork, manual data entry, and disconnected systems to intelligent, automated workflows that let firms spend their time on clients instead of process. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Portage Ventures, Allstate Ventures, and Index Ventures, among others.

We're driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Own the Problem, Grit Beats Gloss, Say It Straight — shape how we work and grow as a team.

Why We’re Hiring

As Feathery scales across financial services, we’re investing in a world-class go-to-market motion to keep pace. With growing enterprise demand and new product capabilities rolling out quickly, we need strong product marketing to sharpen our positioning, accelerate adoption, and enable our Sales and Customer Success teams to win.

We’re hiring a Product Marketing Manager to own strategic positioning, competitive differentiation, product launches, and the voice of the customer. You’ll help shape how Feathery tells its story internally and externally, translating complex product capabilities into clear narratives that resonate with enterprise buyers.

You’ll collaborate closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Leadership to refine our market strategy, influence product direction, and build the messaging and enablement that help win enterprise deals.

About The Role

What makes this an exciting role to step into? You’ll have significant ownership, with a few things that make this opportunity stand out:

Driving an AI-native marketing organization, shaping marketing in the AI era
We have lots of fun making videos for launches: see examples for our Robin launch and Proposals
Ability to build and hire a team, and grow into a marketing leader

You’ll play a key role in shaping how Feathery tells its product story and brings it to market, with direct impact on customer adoption and growth.

What You’ll Do

Go-to-Market, Positioning & Product Launches

Define and evolve Feathery’s core messaging, positioning, and value propositions across insurance and wealth management
Lead go-to-market strategy for new products and feature launches, from narrative and positioning through enablement and launch execution
Translate complex product capabilities into clear, compelling messaging for enterprise buyers
Partner with Product and Marketing to bring new capabilities and use cases to market

Sales Enablement & Competitive Intelligence

Develop customer-centric collateral including decks, one-pagers, case studies, product pages, and other GTM assets
Partner with Sales and Customer Success to build enablement that helps win competitive deals, shorten deal cycles, and expand accounts
Analyze competitors, market trends, and buyer insights to strengthen Feathery’s differentiation
Ensure internal teams are aligned on the latest product updates, positioning, and GTM priorities

Customer & Market Insights

Champion customer research and voice-of-customer initiatives to refine messaging and identify new opportunities
Develop customer stories and case studies that demonstrate Feathery’s impact
Partner with Product to inform roadmap priorities based on customer insights, usage patterns, and feedback from the field
Identify emerging customer needs, use cases, and market opportunities across insurance and wealth management

About You

5+ years of B2B SaaS Product Marketing experience, including ownership of product launches and go-to-market programs
Proven track record of positioning technical or workflow automation products for enterprise customers
Exceptional storytelling and communication skills — able to distill complex technology into compelling narratives
Experience building sales enablement and competitive intelligence programs
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills across Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing
Deep curiosity about customers and how they evaluate and buy technology
Ability to operate both strategically and tactically in a fast-paced environment

Bonus

Experience in financial services, insurance, wealth management, or other regulated industries
Technical proficiency or familiarity with APIs, workflow automation, or data platforms
Experience with AI-powered products
Background in high-growth B2B SaaS environments

What We Offer

Competitive compensation and equity
HRA health plan
Unlimited PTO
Retirement: 401(k) plan
A supportive, low-ego team that values ownership and growth
Company offsites to connect and recharge

Feathery is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristic. We’re committed to building an inclusive team and provide reasonable accommodations upon request.

jobs.title: Director Of Marketing, B2B
jobs.description:
Who We Are

RYNO Strategic Solutions is an innovative, full-service digital marketing company with 200+ RYNOs offering exceptional internet marketing services since 2008. We stay ahead of our competition with top-notch proprietary strategies, tracking, and reporting. Due to our total transparency, our customers always know exactly what they receive through their marketing efforts with us. We are dedicated to helping Home Service companies find their customers online by utilizing the most cost-effective desktop and mobile strategies.

Our Mission

We Exist to Grow Your Business...PERIOD.

Our Values

We prioritize INTEGRITY
and transparency in every interaction, building trust and delivering lasting value.
We aim for EXCELLENCE
in everything we do, ensuring exceptional outcomes for clients and continuous growth for our team.
We take ACCOUNTABILIT
Y for our successes and failures, fostering a culture of trust and collaboration to deliver impactful results.
We think differently, pursue INNOVATION
relentlessly, and embrace every challenge as an opportunity for growth.
OBJECTIVITY
drives our decision-making because data-backed solutions plus industry expertise wins every time.

Summary of Position:

RYNO is seeking a creative, driven Director of Marketing to take full ownership of our overarching strategy and elevate our brand as the undisputed authority in the Home Services ecosystem. This role is ideal for a driven, player-coach marketer who wants to build a growth plan from the ground up, spearhead strategy, and actively drive execution.

You will assess our current marketing footprint, design a comprehensive multi-channel strategy, and determine how strategic industry partnerships fit into our growth engine. While you will directly own core strategy and narrative crafting, you will have cross-functional execution support across the organization to help bring your strategy to life.

Key Pillars of the Role:

Amplify Brand Authority:
Harness RYNO’s existing brand authority to drive continuous growth, expanding our footprint and deepening our influence on national stages and social channels. 
Grow Partnership Ecosystem:
Evolve our partnership roadmap into a high-leverage network of strategic alliances with industry leaders.
Scale Content:
Scale our content engine that translates technical expertise into market dominance. 

We are looking for someone who bridges the gap between high-level brand strategy and day-to-day execution. You have a proven track record of marketing professional service providers at scale, but you aren’t a manager of managers who hides behind decks.

If you are a gritty, strategic builder looking to mobilize your industry expertise, command market attention, and scale RYNO's reputation as the gold standard for the Home Services space, this is your next move.

Position Responsibilities:

B2B Strategy & Brand Positioning:
Conduct a full assessment of RYNO's current marketing efforts and design a grounded, high-impact marketing plan from scratch. Drive comprehensive marketing strategy, repositioning RYNO’s market presence at the forefront of the industry.
Partnership Program Strategy:
Evaluate the competitive landscape to decide how new partnerships should integrate into our core marketing plan, setting the roadmap for strategic high-level industry influencers and vendors alliances. 
Content & Narrative Architecture:
Re-define RYNO’s brand voice and develop high-impact case studies, B2B campaigns, and collateral that turn brand authority into measurable revenue through day-to-day content creation and channel management.
Cross-Functional Revenue Alignment:
Partner with sales and product teams to translate brand authority into scalable lead generation and directly support corporate revenue goals.
Data-Driven Optimization:
Establish clear KPIs across all campaigns, using market sentiment and performance analytics to continuously refine messaging and channel mix.
Industry Presence:
Serve as a key brand representative for RYNO at trade shows, conferences, and industry events.
Other Duties:
As assigned by management 

Position Requirements:

Experience Level:
2+ years of hands-on marketing experience within B2B or agency, environments (Home Services vertical experience is preferred).
Builder Mindset:
Demonstrated ability to assess existing programs, map out a cohesive strategy, and execute plans from the ground up.
Player-Coach Mentality:
High initiative, adaptability, and a strong work ethic; comfortable wearing multiple hats in a lean, fast-paced environment.
Storytelling & Content Creation:
Exceptional copywriting and B2B narrative-crafting skills with a track record of creating engaging content across digital platforms (LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, Email, etc).
Resourcefulness & Collaboration:
Ability to coordinate effectively with internal team members on shared goals.
MarTech & AI Proficiency:
Familiarity with B2B marketing stacks (e.g., SalesForce, Wrike, Google Analytics, SEO tools) and practical experience utilizing generative AI tools to maximize productivity.

Remote Position

Salary Range:
$135,000 - $150,000

This target compensation range is subject to multiple factors, including role, level, experience, and location. As you go through the interview process, your recruiter will work with you to identify a competitive base salary within the proposed target compensation range that will get your excited about your future with us. 

Benefits:

We've Got You Covered! RYNO is proud to offer a variety of benefits to support employees and their families, including:
Performance-based bonuses
to reward excellence
Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance

401(k) matching
to help you plan for your future
6 weeks of paid parental leave
for new parents
$2000 annual tuition reimbursement
for continued education
Monthly data stipend
to support your remote work environment
Paid Vacation and sick time off
for work-life balance
11 paid holidays
to enjoy throughout the year
Paid Days for You
to reset and recharge
Paid birthday holiday
to celebrate your special day
Comprehensive Employee Assistance Program
for personal support
Leadership and career advancement
opportunities
Anniversary rewards
to celebrate milestones

About RYNO:

Knowledge of contemporary practices in Marketing
Excellent financial and statistical analytical skills

Motivate and inspire cross functional teams

The Marketing Coordinator will play a pivotal role in promoting the Vancouver Symphony Orchestra USA’s performances, events, and educational initiatives to a diverse and growing audience in the Vancouver, Washington area and beyond.

jobs.title: Senior Director, HCP and Access Marketing
jobs.description:
Summary

We are seeking a Senior Director, HCP and Access Marketing to lead the end to end customer segment strategies through tactical execution for HCPs and access stakeholders as the company prepares for the portential approval and launch of vidofludimus calcium in relapsing MS. This is a builder role for a marketer who has done this before: someone who has led/supported global brand strategy through an MS launch , understands how positioning, messaging and channel strategy need to flex across the US market, especially targeted at HCP and access (e.g., population based/financial decision makers, payer, practice manager) and can build/lead a high performing team of marketers focused on these stakeholders. This role sits at the center of launch, working in lockstep with Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Market Access, Patient Services, Commercial Operations and other functions to maximize the near- and long-term value of vidofludimus calcium across its lifecycle while supporting the development of brand strategy that reflects both the science and the realities of how the therapy will actually reach patients.

You will join us at a pivotal point pre Phase 3 data readout, when the organization is actively planning key commercial activities such as positioning, disease education and building the commercial function. The ideal candidate combines high strategic leadership with hands-on execution/data analysis, collaboration across varied internal and external stakeholders, ability to inspire and build a team to deliver results with lean resourcing.

Responsibilities

Own HCP and organized customer/access segment strategy. Develop strategies aligned with brand strategy and a core narrative that can be adapted across US and international markets.
Build a differentiated brand story. Translate clinical and mechanism-of-action data into messaging that is relevant to physicians.
Shape the launch playbook. Apply lessons from prior global MS launches to sequencing, market prioritization and pre-launch disease education.
Lead omnichannel and digital execution. Own end-to-end delivery across web, social and non-personal promotion, using disruptive digital and technology solutions to increase impact.
Use insights and analytics to drive decisions. Support global market research. Partner with forecasting and analytics on launch scenarios, segmentation, targeting and KPIs.
Drive market access pull-through. Partner with Market Access on an integrated plan across payers, population-based decision makers and practice managers. Own the strategy and resources for pull-through.
Integrate cross-functionally for launch readiness. Work closely with Market Access, Medical Affairs, Patient Advocacy, Regulatory and Legal/Compliance so that strategy, messaging and channel plans are ready before approval.
Manage budget and investment. Build and manage the HCP and access marketing budget with marketing peers, Access, Finance and the VP of Marketing.
Lead agency partners and scalable operations. Onboard and manage creative, media, research and digital agencies. Help build marketing processes and governance that scale from pre-launch to commercial launch.
Advise commercial leadership. Serve as a strategic advisor on market dynamics and opportunities.

Qualifications & Education

Bachelor's degree required. MBA or advanced degree preferred.
15+ years of progressive marketing experience in biotechnology or pharmaceuticals, with significant experience in brand and global marketing and access leadership roles.
Direct experience leading HCP and market access customer strategy and marketing through the launch of a therapy in multiple sclerosis.
Proven track record with end to end strategy through execution across digital and field promotional channels. Ability to showcase use of AI, data, disruptive technologies to increase impact of marketing campaigns a strong differentiator.
Experience managing global or multi-customer segment positioning, balancing core brand consistency with customer segment needs and opportunities.
Strong experience managing external agency partners across creative, media, digital, and market research.
Demonstrated ability to translate clinical and scientific data into clear, differentiated brand positioning and messaging.
Experience partnering closely with Market Access, Medical Affairs, and Patient Advocacy functions on integrated launch strategy.
Willingness and ability to travel approximately 25–40% of the time, including internationally
Comfort operating in a lean, fast-moving, pre-commercial biotech environment
Experience launching a therapy with a novel mechanism of action or first-in-class positioning
Existing relationships within the global MS clinical, scientific, patient advocacy community, practice manager, financial / population based decision maker (and other access stakeholders)
Fluency with digital and omnichannel channel approaches, and demonstrates growth mindset to adapt proven marketing approaches with disruptive technologies and innovations

jobs.title: Marketing & Brand Design Associate
jobs.description:
Two Brands. Real Ownership. Room to Create.

Full-Time | Washington, DC | In-Person | $55,000–$75,000 + Overtime Eligible

We're looking for a creative, independent marketer with strong visual design skills
to help shape and execute marketing for two growing businesses.  

Hylton-Rodic Law (HRL)
is a boutique intellectual property law firm serving innovators in biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, and the life sciences.  

EPIARX Diagnostics
is a private pathology practice serving families, healthcare professionals, attorneys, and other partners seeking answers through specialized medical services.  

The organizations share ownership, leadership, and an office in Washington, DC, but serve very different audiences with distinct brands and marketing goals.  

One opportunity to help both brands grow.

This isn't a role where you'll simply receive a list of posts to make. You'll work closely with leadership and business development to understand our audiences, identify marketing opportunities, develop creative concepts, and turn ideas into finished work.  

We want someone who can think independently, design thoughtfully, write clearly, and take ownership from concept through execution.

You don't need to know intellectual property law or pathology. You do need the curiosity and initiative to learn.  

What You'll Do

Own and maintain marketing calendars
across both organizations, planning and executing social media, blogs, newsletters, email campaigns, and other recurring content.  
Create original digital and physical marketing materials
, including graphics, brochures, presentations, conference materials, advertisements, mailers, branded collateral, and other content.  
Help develop and evolve our brands
, including creative concepts, new service logos, visual identities, messaging, templates, and campaign ideas.  
Write and translate complex subjects
into clear, engaging content tailored to distinct professional and consumer audiences.  
Maintain and improve our websites
, including content, layout, imagery, landing pages, and digital marketing initiatives.  
Support CRM and email marketing
, including campaign development, audience segmentation, and marketing workflows.  
Partner with business development and leadership
to identify opportunities, propose ideas, and execute initiatives that support organizational growth.  
Manage projects independently
, coordinating timelines, feedback, approvals, and publication without constant oversight.  

You'll receive direction, context, and feedback—but we'll also expect you to bring ideas, exercise judgment, and move work forward.  

What We're Looking For

We're looking for an emerging professional with strong creative instincts, sound judgment, and the maturity to own their work.

You should bring:  

Strong visual design ability
, including original creative concepts, typography, composition, layout, and brand consistency.  
Excellent writing, editing, and communication skills
, with the ability to adapt messaging for different audiences.  
Experience creating digital and/or physical marketing materials
, including content, collateral, campaigns, or brand assets.  
Experience with website content management
and familiarity with CRM, email marketing, or related digital marketing platforms.  
Demonstrated project ownership
, from understanding an objective and developing an idea through execution and delivery.  
Strong organization, attention to detail, and independent problem-solving skills.

Proficiency with creative software and modern marketing tools
, including the ability to leverage AI thoughtfully to improve research, workflows, and production efficiency.  
A bachelor's degree or equivalent demonstrated experience in marketing, graphic design, visual communication, advertising, or a related field.  

Especially valuable:
Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud, Squarespace, GoHighLevel or comparable CRM platforms, SEO, brand identity development, photography, and print production.  

We welcome early-career applicants with strong portfolios, meaningful internships, freelance experience, or demonstrated ownership of creative projects.  

You don't need to be an expert in everything.
We care about your creative judgment, initiative, ability to learn, and the quality of your work.  

Compensation & Benefits

$55,000–$75,000 annually
, depending on qualifications and experience. This is a full-time, in-person, non-exempt position eligible for overtime.  

Benefits include health, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) with employer matching; commuter benefits; paid time off; mental-health days; birthday leave; Sunshine Fridays; professional-development support; and an extended year-end holiday break.  

How to Apply

Please submit your résumé and a tailored cover letter
addressing the following:  
1. Show us how you think creatively.

Explore Hylton-Rodic Law and EPIARX Diagnostics. Identify one marketing or branding opportunity for each organization
and tell us what you would do with it.  

Think beyond simply suggesting another social media post. What would you create, improve, or approach differently? Who would it reach, and why would it matter?  

We're interested in your ideas, creative instincts, and ability to connect marketing with business goals—not a perfect understanding of either industry.  

2. Show us something you've created.

Tell us about one creative or marketing project you're particularly proud of. What was the objective? What did you personally contribute? What decisions did you make, and what made the result successful?  

Selected candidates may be invited to submit additional materials
, including a portfolio or work samples, college transcript, short video response, or brief creative exercise.  

We encourage applicants to be thoughtful, specific, and original. We want to see how you think—not just where you've worked.

About The Role

As a key member of the senior leadership team, the Head of Marketing

will lead the strategy, operating model, team capability, and execution required to accelerate predictable pipeline and revenue growth. Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, this role will partner across go-to-market, Product Development, and Executive Leadership to build a scalable, measurable, AI-enabled marketing engine.

The successful candidate will be a strategic, values-based marketing leader who can move fluidly from strategy to execution while building both the marketing function and the people within it. They will strengthen demand generation, improve marketing ROI, support 360’s growth story, and create the team, systems, campaigns, and measurement practices needed to help 360insights win in Channel Incentives Management.

Leadership profile:

The ideal candidate is a builder, operator, and people leader who can set clear direction, develop talent, simplify complex marketing and revenue challenges, and connect marketing activity to measurable business outcomes.

What You'll Do

Own 360insights' market positioning, brand strategy, and category leadership, establishing a differentiated narrative that strengthens competitive advantage, increases market awareness, and supports enterprise revenue growth.
Develop and lead an integrated marketing strategy aligned to 360’s growth objectives, revenue targets, and long-term company strategy.
Build and lead the customer expansion and cross-sell program, including account-based campaigns, scaled executive business reviews, and whitespace analysis, to grow revenue within the existing install base.
Own marketing’s pipeline contribution, budget, and performance reporting, including channel ROI, multi-touch attribution, and PlanHat (CRM) reporting, and reallocate spend based on results.
Assess the current marketing function and build a practical operating model with clear priorities, accountabilities, and expected business impact.
Partner across Sales, Business Development, Product, Product Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Customer Success to improve pipeline quality, conversion, win rate, and customer expansion.
Lead demand generation across priority channels, including events, content, paid media, SEO/AEO, website, analyst activity, field marketing, partner marketing, and account-based programs.
Clarify 360’s ideal customer profile, buyer personas, value proposition, and messaging so marketing investments focus on the highest-return opportunities.
Use data, experimentation, and performance reporting to improve campaign effectiveness, budget allocation, and pipeline contribution.
Evaluate and implement AI-enabled tools, workflows, and automation to improve lead generation, personalization, content, and operational efficiency.

Feathery is the AI operating system for financial institutions. With hundreds of clients and over $30 million raised, Feathery is the fast-growing leader in financial agentic automation. At the center of it all is Robin, our AI operations assistant. Robin scans client documents, configures and deploys workflows, assists users in their day-to-day work, takes notes during meetings, and supports a growing range of operational tasks across the client lifecycle.

We're building a future where financial operations shift from paperwork, manual data entry, and disconnected systems to intelligent, automated workflows that let firms spend their time on clients instead of process. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Portage Ventures, Allstate Ventures, and Index Ventures, among others.

About The Company

Gas South is a leading provider of natural gas services committed to delivering reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy solutions to residential and commercial customers. With a strong focus on customer satisfaction, innovation, and community engagement, Gas South has established itself as a trusted name in the energy sector. The company emphasizes operational excellence, technological advancement, and a customer-centric approach to ensure that clients receive the highest quality service while promoting environmental responsibility. Gas South's dedication to community involvement is reflected in its philanthropic initiatives and partnerships with various non-profit organizations, aiming to make a positive impact beyond business operations.

About The Role

The Marketing Analyst I at Gas South is a dynamic position designed for analytical thinkers who thrive on solving complex business challenges through data-driven insights. This role offers an exceptional opportunity to contribute to strategic decision-making processes by analyzing customer behavior, marketing effectiveness, and operational data. As part of a collaborative team, you will work closely with stakeholders across multiple departments, including Marketing, Sales, Finance, and Operations, to develop actionable insights that support business growth and efficiency. The role is ideal for individuals eager to develop technical skills in SQL, Python, and business intelligence tools, while also honing their ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess a bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Data Analytics, Engineering, Economics, Statistics, Marketing, Business Analytics, Finance, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field. Prior internship, co-op, academic projects, or professional experience involving data analysis or business analytics is highly preferred. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, along with exposure to analytical tools such as SQL, Python, R, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms, is essential. A foundational understanding of data validation, data transformation, and structured problem-solving concepts is required. Candidates should demonstrate curiosity about customer and business analytics, possess strong organizational and time management skills, and have the ability to communicate insights effectively. Exposure to analytical techniques like regression analysis, forecasting, A/B testing, and hypothesis testing is advantageous.

Responsibilities

Analyze customer behavior, sales, marketing, and operational data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities that support strategic growth initiatives.
Develop a comprehensive understanding of customer acquisition, retention, profitability, and lifecycle performance to inform business strategies.
Aggregate, clean, transform, and prepare large datasets from diverse sources, including databases, APIs, CRM systems, and internal applications, to facilitate reporting and analysis.
Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations that effectively communicate complex insights to stakeholders.
Conduct ad hoc analyses, customer segmentation studies, campaign evaluations, and A/B testing to support ongoing marketing and sales initiatives.
Apply advanced analytical techniques to evaluate marketing effectiveness, sales performance, and customer engagement metrics.
Support forecasting, planning, and performance measurement efforts by identifying key trends and providing actionable insights.
Validate data inputs, outputs, calculations, and assumptions to ensure accuracy and reliability of analytical outputs.
Document methodologies, data definitions, and business rules to promote transparency and facilitate future analysis.
Communicate findings, insights, and recommendations clearly and effectively to cross-functional teams and leadership.
Collaborate with various departments to understand business needs and develop tailored data-driven solutions.
Continuously seek opportunities to enhance analytical capabilities, streamline processes, and expand technical skills.

Benefits

Full-time employees at Gas South enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support their health, financial security, and personal growth. Benefits include full medical, dental, and vision coverage, along with employer-paid life and disability insurance. The company offers annual employer contributions of up to 12.5% to employees' 401(k) plans, encouraging long-term financial planning. Remote work options are available based on business needs, providing flexibility and work-life balance. Employees are also eligible for an annual performance incentive, which is a percentage of the annual benchmark aligned with their position level. Gas South recognizes the importance of rest and renewal, offering a paid four-week sabbatical every five years. Community engagement is encouraged through volunteer opportunities, and educational support of up to $5,250 per year helps employees pursue professional development and personal enrichment.

Equal Opportunity

Gas South is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. The company does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. jobs.title: AI Product Manager, Growth Marketing
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

About The Role

Truly unique opportunity to shape and scale self-optimizing paid marketing systems for Growth. This role exists to turn our performance marketing experimentation program from a prototype into the operating system. The opportunity calls for deep paid-growth expertise and a strong grasp of how channel mechanics, audiences, creative, measurement, experimentation, and automation fit together. You’ll set the strategy and operating model, and guide the agentic infrastructure that brings it to life. You’ll partner with BizOps, Strat Fin, Growth, Ecosystems, and Marketing across Meta, LinkedIn, Google, and ChatGPT, interpreting always-on geo, cohort, creative, and spend signals in context.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Achieve

By day 90:
Map how geo, audience, creative, spend, measurement, experimentation, and platform constraints interact; establish an operating model that turns those signals into hypotheses, tests, and clear kill/scale decisions, with agents supporting execution.
Build a deep understanding of onboarding and activation, and how paid acquisition connects to downstream user quality; partner with Growth PM and Ecosystems PM on meaningful improvements.
Establish how AI and agents can strengthen the end-to-end decision system—from analysis and hypothesis generation to creative and audience development, experiment QA, and reusable workflows—improving decision quality, not only execution speed.

By the end of year one:
Graduate the program from managing the experimental budget to managing the majority of paid spend, while maintaining efficiency and Notion’s quality bar for ad creative.
Establish stronger measurement and a clear, connected view of which experiments move which metrics, why they work, and how results vary by user cohort; use that understanding to shape more personalized experiences.
Turn the system into a repeatable model for Demand Generation, raising the standard for experimentation, measurement, and agentic marketing infrastructure across the organization.

Skills You'll Need To Bring

Strong systems fluency across APIs, automation pipelines, and agentic systems. You can see how platform integrations, data, measurement, workflows, and constraints fit together; shape sound architecture and tradeoffs; and partner credibly with technical teams to make the system reliable.
Deep paid-growth subject matter expertise across platforms such as Meta, LinkedIn, and Google. You understand how channel mechanics, budgets, audiences, creative, and performance interact, and can connect those dynamics to real marketing outcomes.
Expert measurement and performance-analysis judgment: you can interpret geo, cohort, creative, and spend signals in context, identify meaningful patterns, understand what is driving them, and make clear kill/scale decisions.
Strong product and systems judgment across technical and marketing domains, with the ability to connect the parts into a coherent strategy and translate an ambiguous frontier into a system with a high quality bar.
High-agency cross-functional ownership: you can work across BizOps, Strat Fin, Growth, Ecosystems, and Marketing to align decisions and deliver the full loop from strategy through operating model and infrastructure to outcomes.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $191,000 - $225,000 per year.

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. jobs.description:
About HYBE Americas

HYBE AMERICAS, a subsidiary of HYBE Corp., is a leading global entertainment and media company at the intersection of music, film, television, technology, brands, culture and social good. HYBE AMERICAS drives innovation across the entertainment landscape through its diverse portfolio, including Blue Highway Records, the publishing company Big Machine Music and Quality Control Music in the U.S., and HYBE’s labels in Latin America and the U.S. Hispanic market. The company represents a powerhouse roster of global artists spanning multiple genres and cultures. With headquarters in Los Angeles, HYBE AMERICAS creates synergistic opportunities for artists, businesses, and brands through its integrated approach to talent development, content creation, and technological innovation that transcends industries.

At HYBE, we believe in the power of music and foster a culture built on Passion, Autonomy, and Trust.

Position Overview

HYBE Americas is looking for a Social Media & Community Manager who thrives at the intersection of music, fandom, and internet culture. As a key member of our Digital Marketing team, you will oversee the social strategy, platform growth, and digital narrative that connects our artists to a global audience. You will be responsible for managing daily community engagement and executing high-impact social campaigns that resonate with fans worldwide.

This is a full-time hybrid role based in our Santa Monica office, with in-person collaboration 3
days per week and remote work 2
days per week. Candidates must be based in or willing to relocate to the greater Los Angeles area at their own expense prior to their start date — we are not offering relocation assistance for this role, though it may be considered on a case-by-case basis for select candidates.

Key Responsibilities

Manage daily posts: Schedule and post content across all social media channels
Develop and execute social media strategies to boost engagement and expand our reach
Create compelling content that is relevant to our global audience and maintains brand voice. Taking good photos, film / edit videos, and design graphics is a plus.
Engage with fans and collaborate with content creators to foster a thriving online community
Stay up to date on current trends to ensure content is fresh, relevant, and impactful (creative individual with lots of ideas, the better)
Collect daily metrics on all platforms
Collaborate across various teams to coordinate content creation and ideation
Monitor sentiment and report on fan engagement, adjusting strategies as needed
Monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs)—link clicks, likes, and other metrics

Qualifications

Being obsessively online. Proven experience in managing social media platforms and tools: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and X accounts. Weverse experience/user is a plus.
Deep understanding of social media best practices and platform operations, understanding metrics of success (engagement, acquisition, etc)
Ability to think on your feet to handle real-time situations and adapt strategies promptly.
Thrives in the dynamic rhythm of the global entertainment space, with a flexible mindset regarding working hours around key releases, time-sensitive projects, live moments, and real-time fan connection.
Previous working experience in the music or entertainment industry is a strong plus.
Excellent grammar and copywriting abilities
Great organizational skills; ability to balance multiple priorities
Basic editing and design skills (Canva, CapCut), willing to learn
Ability to conceptualize captivating ideas
Capacity to work both independently and collaboratively in a team setting.
Passion for K-pop, music culture, and global fan communities.
Able and willing to travel domestically and internationally

It’s a Bonus if you

Are Bilingual, in Korean or Japanese
Are familiar with Photoshop or Adobe Premiere
Have video & photography experience

Technologies/Systems/Software we use

Google Suite, Slack
CapCut, Photoshop

Don't match every skill listed? Almost nobody does! Think you're a good fit anyway? Please let us know.

Salary Range

The salary range for this job is $70,500 to $80,000. This is a good faith effort at the time of posting. This range is base salary only and does not include benefits and any other compensatory components of the role.

Why Join Us

At HYBE Americas, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the voice and reputation of one of the most dynamic and innovative companies in global entertainment. You’ll work with some of the world’s most exciting artists and help tell the stories that define culture. We back our passion for music with benefits that take care of you, so you can bring your best to the work that inspires millions.

Competitive compensation package for all full-time employees. We maintain salary brackets for all career tracks to ensure equitable salaries across the company.
Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Company 401(k) match up to 5%

Wellhub membership that gives you access to gyms and fitness studios
Excellent parental leave policies
