jobs.title: Senior Growth Marketing Strategist
jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

Client Strategy & Relationships

Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

Paid Media Performance

Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

Copy & Creative Strategy

Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

Tracking & Funnel Execution

Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility
Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Experience

Financial services marketing
Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
Video sales letter marketing
High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
Performance marketing agency experience
Direct-response advertising

NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)
Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

Benefits

Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays
Training & Development
Work From Home
Flexible Schedule
Performance Bonus

In accordance with Truist in-office expectations, this role will be in office 5 days/week.

The Digital Marketing Strategist is responsible for the strategy to drive revenue and engagement on Truist.com. You will lead channel-generated initiatives aligned to business strategy, along with continuously supporting Small Business Deposits and Digital Banking campaign activities.

Partner with marketing and LOB stakeholders to align website experiences with business objectives, product priorities, and client needs. Drive content, experience, and functionality enhancements across Truist.com through collaboration with marketing, content, UX Design & Research, SEO, authoring, QA, and technology teams. Utilize analytics and client behavior insights to inform strategy, prioritize enhancements, and execute optimization initiatives that improve engagement, conversion, and revenue. Communicate performance results, recommendations, and business impact to stakeholders while championing a measurement-driven approach to digital experience management.

Duties of the Digital Marketing Strategist include:

Research, develop and execute strategies for Truist digital channels which increase acquisition, retention, profitability, and cross-sell of clients across Truist’s Small Business and Wholesale site sections and product lines. Primary focus on Small Business deposit products and digital banking services.
Partner with marketing partners, channel leads, and platform product owners to develop product specific roadmaps which assist in achieving revenue goals through digital marketing strategies.
Demonstrate a solid understanding of the business owner behavior model and user journeys, and how both are applied to banking products and services. Increase Truist product awareness, consideration, and acquisition by aligning business needs with Truist offerings.
Leverage web analytics, site performance data, voice-of-client and user experience research to develop and refine digital marketing strategies, drive qualified traffic, improve conversion rates, and enhance client experiences across digital devices. Maintain appropriate reporting capabilities to establish and track KPIs and communicate the value of marketing placements and digital marketing strategies to business marketing partners and senior management.
Stay current on the changes taking place in the digital environment. Research and evaluate industry trends, the competitive environment, and emerging technologies. Adjust strategies accordingly to ensure Truist remains at a competitive advantage.
Strong quantitative, technical, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with an aptitude for measuring results and identifying actionable insights.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration or related field, or equivalent education and related training
Five years of related experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience
In-depth knowledge of principles, practices, theories, and/or methodologies associated with the Marketing discipline (e.g., Marketing P’s, Market research, analytics, digital)
Experience managing projects or project work streams and works as an Individual Contributor
Knowledge of the industry's competitive landscape and the factors that differentiate Truist and its competitors in the market
Ability to interpret and explain complex information to a range of audiences and build consensus among different stakeholders
Ability to provide direction, and mentor less experienced teammates
Proficient in Excel and PowerPoint

Preferred Qualifications:

Master's degree or MBA and previous experience in the banking industry
Experience developing digital marketing strategies that drive traffic and conversions
Demonstrated ability to apply agile marketing methodologies and processes to large enterprise, cross-functional teams
Ability to develop strategies that break long-term goals into short term wins to facilitate learning, quick iteration, with shorter time to market and return on investment
Working knowledge of various programming languages (Java, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, XML, Python, SQL)
Working knowledge of American Disabilities Act (ACT) compliance requirements
Experience with Adobe products (AEM, Target and Target, Analytics, Audience Manager and Adobe Cloud)
Certified in the use of email service providers, marketing automation and CRM platforms (e.g. Salesforce, Marketo, IBM Watson, Eloqua, Epsilon, Acoustic, Adobe Campaign, Pardot, etc.)
Experience with API development, ad servers, dynamic tag managers, market automation platforms, content management systems, A/B multivariate testing and personalization tools
Excellent understanding of HTML for email and ability to code templates, revise modular layouts and provide both strategic and technical direction to web developers
Proficiency in algebraic Boolean logic expressions for building queries and hyper-segmentation

Other Job Requirements / Working Conditions

Visual / Audio / Speaking

Able to access and interpret client information received from the computer and able to hear and speak with individuals in person and on the phone.

Manual Dexterity / Keyboarding

Able to work standard office equipment, including PC keyboard and mouse, copy/fax machines, and printers.

Availability

Able to work all hours scheduled, including overtime as directed by manager/supervisor and required by business need.

General Description of Available Benefits for Eligible Employees of Truist Financial Corporation:
All regular teammates (not temporary or contingent workers) working 20 hours or more per week are eligible for benefits, though eligibility for specific benefits may be determined by the division of Truist offering the position. Truist offers medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability, accidental death and dismemberment, tax-preferred savings accounts, and a 401k plan to teammates. Teammates also receive no less than 10 days of vacation (prorated based on date of hire and by full-time or part-time status) during their first year of employment, along with 10 sick days (also prorated), and paid holidays. For more details on Truist’s generous benefit plans, please visit our Benefits site. Depending on the position and division, this job may also be eligible for Truist’s defined benefit pension plan, restricted stock units, and/or a deferred compensation plan. As you advance through the hiring process, you will also learn more about the specific benefits available for any non-temporary position for which you apply, based on full-time or part-time status, position, and division of work.

jobs.description:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries to make life and our environment safer, healthier, and more sustainable. From the food you eat to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with organizations around the world to ensure products are safe, compliant, and of the highest quality.

With more than 58,000 employees across 900 laboratories in over 50 countries, Eurofins is a global leader in laboratory testing, regulatory support, and scientific services. Our Medical Device division partners with manufacturers throughout the product lifecycle, providing testing, consulting, and regulatory services that help bring safe and effective medical technologies to market.

Job Description

Eurofins is seeking a Marketing Communications Manager - Medical Devices
to lead the development and execution of strategic marketing programs that support the growth of our Medical Device Testing and Consulting business.

This role will drive integrated marketing initiatives that increase brand awareness, generate qualified leads, and position Eurofins as a trusted partner for medical device manufacturers. The successful candidate will translate complex scientific, testing, and regulatory concepts into compelling, customer-focused messaging that resonates with engineering, quality, regulatory, R&D, and executive stakeholders.

Reporting to the Marketing Director, this position will collaborate closely with business leaders, technical subject matter experts, sales teams, regulatory consultants, and external agencies to deliver measurable business impact.

Essential Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns that support Medical Device Testing and Consulting services.
Create compelling content for websites, email campaigns, case studies, webinars, sales materials, presentations, and social media.
Translate complex scientific, testing, and regulatory information into clear, customer-focused messaging.
Partner with technical experts and business leaders to develop thought leadership and industry-focused content.
Manage demand generation programs, lead nurturing activities, and marketing automation initiatives.
Collaborate with sales teams to improve lead quality, conversion rates, and pipeline growth.
Track and analyze campaign performance, providing recommendations to improve engagement and ROI.
Support medical device industry trade shows, conferences, webinars, and customer events.
Coordinate agency partners, project timelines, budgets, and marketing deliverables.
Maintain brand consistency across all customer-facing communications and marketing materials.
Monitor industry trends, competitive activity, and market opportunities within the medical device sector.

Qualifications

The Ideal Candidate

8-10 years of marketing communications experience in medical devices, healthcare, life sciences, laboratory services, or another regulated B2B industry.
Proven success developing campaigns that drive brand awareness, lead generation, and business growth.
Strong understanding of medical device markets and customer needs.
Skilled at translating technical concepts into clear, compelling marketing messages.
Able to influence cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Education & Experience

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Life Sciences, or a related field.
8-10 years of experience in marketing communications, demand generation, content marketing, or related B2B marketing roles.
Experience supporting medical device, diagnostics, laboratory, CRO/CDMO, or healthcare organizations preferred.
Proficiency with CRM platforms, marketing automation tools, and marketing analytics.
Experience managing agencies, budgets, vendors, and marketing projects.

Familiarity with medical device development, regulatory pathways, and commercialization.
Experience marketing testing, consulting, compliance, regulatory, or laboratory services.
Knowledge of biocompatibility, microbiology, chemistry testing, packaging validation, sterility assurance, E&L, or quality and regulatory compliance.

Additional Information

The position is full-time, Monday-Friday, 8:00am-5:00pm, with overtime as needed. Location: East Coast & Midwest — Boston, MA; Lancaster, PA; Jacksonville, FL; St. Louis, MO; Remote options available

Excellent full time benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options

Description

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

Populus is looking for a Sr. Marketing Manager to lead the day-to-day marketing of one of the most distinctive hotels in the country.

This is a highly collaborative role at the intersection of brand, culture, and commercial performance. Reporting to both the on-property Director of Sales and Marketing and Crescent’s Corporate Marketing Director, this role serves as the senior on-property marketing lead for Populus Denver and the primary day-to-day marketing liaison to the Denver-based Urban Villages ownership marketing team. The Sr. Marketing Manager is responsible for translating brand, ownership, operator, and commercial priorities into a cohesive, integrated property marketing plan and ensuring disciplined execution across internal teams and external agency partners.

The right person can move comfortably from a revenue meeting to a creative review, from developing a Denver partnership to evaluating campaign performance. You’ll be responsible for protecting what makes Populus distinctive while contributing to new ways to turn that distinction into awareness, demand, loyalty, and revenue.

About Populus

Populus is the first carbon positive hotel in the United States, created around the belief that hospitality can be both exceptional and environmentally responsible.

Inspired by Colorado’s aspen groves, its architecture, interiors, restaurants, programming, and approach to hospitality are designed as parts of one interconnected ecosystem. Located at Civic Center Park in the heart of Denver, Populus is not a retreat from the city, but an active participant in it.

Guests come for the architecture and design. They discover Pasque, Stellar Jay, and Little Owl. And increasingly, Populus has become a gathering place for people interested in food, art, design, sustainability, culture, and the future of cities.

The Sr. Marketing Manager will help shape how Denver, our guests, and the broader hospitality industry experience that story while remaining accountable to the business behind it: occupancy, direct bookings, F&B performance, event demand, brand awareness, and return on marketing investment.

What You’ll Own

Marketing Strategy & Commercial Performance

Own the day-to-day execution of the property’s annual marketing strategy, calendar, and budget against revenue, occupancy, F&B, and ownership objectives. Manage marketing performance to approved budgets, including ongoing forecasting, invoice and spend oversight, variance management, and recommendations to reallocate investment based on business needs and demonstrated performance.
Partner closely with Revenue Management and Sales to identify need periods, demand opportunities, offers, and campaigns across rooms, restaurants, bars, and events.
Track marketing performance and translate results into clear recommendations, identifying what is working, what is not, and where investment should shift.
Establish and monitor clear KPIs across paid, owned, earned, CRM, social, partnerships, programming, rooms, and F&B marketing, connecting marketing activity to measurable commercial outcomes and return on investment.
Manage agency coordination and vendor relationships, ensuring scopes, budgets, timelines, and deliverables remain accountable to business objectives.
Lead and hold accountable external advertising, media, digital, PR, social, creative, and other specialty agency partners as applicable, providing clear briefs and direction, evaluating recommendations and work product, monitoring performance against scope and budget, and ensuring agency activity is integrated against property and ownership priorities.
Prepare marketing updates, reporting, and recommendations for hotel leadership, Crescent, and ownership. Brand, Creative & Storytelling
Serve as a day-to-day steward of the Populus brand, ensuring every expression of the property feels intentional, distinctive, and unmistakably Populus.
Guide creative execution across photography, video, social, email, digital, collateral, partnerships, programming, and campaigns.
Build and manage the property’s content calendar, identifying the stories, people, experiences, and cultural moments worth amplifying.
Partner with PR, social, digital, and creative agencies to turn those stories into meaningful earned, owned, and paid exposure.
Identify opportunities for Populus to participate in larger conversations around hospitality, architecture, food, sustainability, design, and Denver culture. Programming, Partnerships & Community
Help develop signature programming and activations that give people a reason to visit Populus beyond an overnight stay.
Partner closely with the Environmental Stewardship Team to translate the hotel’s environmental commitments into tangible guest experiences and compelling storytelling.
Build meaningful relationships with Denver’s artists, chefs, farmers, makers, nonprofits, cultural organizations, businesses, and civic community.
Develop partnership opportunities that increase relevance and reach to support rooms, F&B, events, community engagement, and earned media. Collaboration & Leadership
Serve as a connective tissue between departments, bringing marketing into operational conversations early, ensuring important property moments have the strategy, creative support, and lead time necessary to succeed.
Serve as the primary on-property marketing partner to Urban Villages’ Denver-based ownership marketing team, maintaining consistent communication and visibility into property priorities, performance, campaigns, programming, agency activity, budgets, and emerging opportunities. Ensure property-level execution remains aligned with the broader Populus brand strategy, standards, and portfolio priorities established by ownership.
Balance long-term brand building with the immediate commercial needs of a working hotel.
Manage, coach, and develop direct reports as the property marketing team evolves, establishing clear priorities, accountability, performance expectations, and professional development opportunities while building a high-performing and collaborative marketing function.
Effectively navigate the owner/operator relationship, understanding when decisions sit with property leadership, Crescent, or ownership and proactively bringing the appropriate stakeholders into planning and decision-making.

What Makes You Successful

You’re equally comfortable in a budget review and a creative review.

You understand that a great hotel brand is built through hundreds of decisions, not a campaign alone. You have a point of view on design, culture, hospitality, and storytelling, but you’re just as interested in whether the work drove bookings, covers, traffic, or revenue.

You’ve helped build, launch, or evolve something rather than simply maintaining a playbook someone else handed you.

You’re curious about Denver and want to participate in the city rather than market to it from the sidelines.

You care about sustainability because you believe business can be a force for something better, and you understand that credibility comes from substance rather than claims.

Most importantly, you know how to bring people together. You collaborate, ask good questions, give clear direction, and understand when to lead from the front and when to make someone else’s idea better.

THE POPULUS WAY

Rooted in Nature:
We draw inspiration from nature's resilience, stewardship, balance, and long-term thinking.

Generous:
We create value by giving back—to our guests, associates, community, and environment.

Curious:
We embrace creativity, innovation, continuous learning, and thoughtful collaboration.

Brave:
We lead with integrity, accountability, transparency, and the courage to challenge convention.

QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Hospitality, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
7+ years of progressive marketing experience within lifestyle hospitality, luxury, travel, design, food and beverage, or culturally relevant consumer brands.
Demonstrated experience connecting brand and creative work to measurable commercial outcomes.
Experience managing marketing budgets, agencies, vendors, timelines, and cross-functional initiatives.
Strong working knowledge of digital marketing, social media, CRM/email, PR, content, paid media, and performance reporting.
Strong creative judgment with the ability to evaluate photography, copy, design, campaigns, partnerships, and brand experiences.
Ability to operate independently while collaborating effectively across property, corporate, ownership, and agency teams.
Genuine curiosity about sustainability, design, food and beverage, culture, and community.

Required

Demonstrated experience leading integrated marketing plans across multiple channels and business lines, ideally including hotel rooms, F&B, events, and local-market programming.

Demonstrated experience managing external advertising and marketing agencies, including briefing, scope management, creative evaluation, budget oversight, performance measurement, and accountability for results.

Demonstrated experience owning and managing meaningful marketing budgets, including forecasting, pacing, reconciliation, performance analysis, and investment optimization.

Prior people-management experience, including direct responsibility for coaching, developing, prioritizing work, and managing the performance of direct reports..

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities

MARKETING SPECIALIST
:

The Digital Marketing Manager will play a key role in driving the planning, execution, optimization, and measurement of paid marketing programs supporting Audience Engagement initiatives. The Marketing Manager will own day-to-day marketing programs from strategy through execution and reporting, using data and testing to improve campaign performance and identify opportunities for growth. The role will partner closely with internal marketing, sales, analytics, product, and operational teams to ensure programs are delivered accurately, efficiently, and against business objectives.

Paid Marketing, Campaign Management & Testing
Plan, execute, and optimize paid digital marketing campaigns across channels such as social, display, and testing new paid channels.
Manage campaign setup, launch, pacing, optimization, and ongoing performance monitoring to ensure programs meet defined objectives.
Monitor campaign delivery and proactively identify and resolve issues affecting performance, timelines, targeting, or data quality.
Develop and execute A/B and multivariate testing strategies across audiences, creative, messaging, channels, placements, and other campaign variables to improve marketing efficiency.
Identify opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness through new channels, audience strategies, testing approaches, data applications, and process improvements.

Analytics, Reporting & Business Insights

Analyze campaign and audience data to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and performance drivers.
Develop and monitor KPIs to evaluate the effectiveness of marketing campaigns, products, features, and audience strategies.
Pull, manipulate, and analyze data using tools such as SQL, Excel/Google Sheets, Tableau, or other BI and visualization platforms.
Ensure data accuracy and integrity through detailed QA, reconciliation, and validation of campaign and performance data.
Bring a broader business perspective to marketing analysis, connecting campaign-level performance to revenue, customer engagement, audience growth, and overall business objectives.

Program & Project Management

Own multiple marketing programs and projects simultaneously, ensuring clear timelines, deliverables, follow-ups, dependencies, and accountability across stakeholders.
Proactively track open items and follow up with internal partners to keep campaigns and projects moving forward.
Maintain accurate campaign documentation, requirements, reporting, and project trackers.
Identify operational gaps and develop processes that improve campaign execution, scalability, and efficiency.
Manage competing priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
Support strategic initiatives and ad hoc analyses that contribute to broader marketing and business objectives.

Cross-Functional & Stakeholder Management

Serve as a trusted marketing partner to Audience Engagement, Presales, Sales, Analytics, Product, Operations, Finance and other cross-functional teams.
Effectively communicate and collaborate across teams to streamline workflows, improve data and campaign processes, and identify opportunities for automation.
Build strong stakeholder relationships through clear communication, responsiveness, strong follow-through, and ownership.

Strong understanding of paid media channels, campaign optimization, audience targeting, segmentation, and digital marketing performance metrics.
Demonstrated experience developing and analyzing A/B and multivariate tests and translating results into actionable marketing recommendations.
Strong analytical and data-driven mindset with advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets; experience with SQL, Tableau, or other BI/data visualization tools preferred.
Experience building performance reports, dashboards, campaign analyses, and business-facing presentations.
Strong ability to interpret complex data, identify meaningful trends and drivers, and communicate insights clearly to stakeholders.
Highly detail-oriented with a strong focus on data accuracy, quality assurance, and operational excellence.
Demonstrated program and project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities, deadlines, dependencies, and stakeholders.
Highly responsible and proactive, with a strong track record of ownership, follow-through, and accountability.

ClassWallet, a leading financial technology company in the United States serving agencies delegated responsibility to manage public funds, is seeking to hire a Senior Director, Marketing to join our team.

Agencies use ClassWallet to get public funds to the right people, and ensure the funds are used for the right purpose. ClassWallet's suite of products and services empowers agency administrators to dramatically increase efficiency of funds distribution and spend compliance, reduce programmatic costs, maximize the full potential impact of the program, and satisfy the needs and expectations of policymakers, constituents and public reporting. ClassWallet has processed over $6.7 billion to date and serves public agencies across 39 states. In its 11+ years in operation, ClassWallet has completed over 12M transactions, funded 1.1M recipients, processed over 5M applications, and now serves 300+ state and local agency clients, supported by a team of 280+ full-time staff.

The Company has developed an industry-defining digital wallet solution which has gained rapid traction among state and local agencies and school districts across America. ClassWallet ranks as the 61st fastest growing software company on the prestigious Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing private companies and the 21st fastest growing financial technology company on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500 in 2023.

As Senior Director, Marketing, you will be ClassWallet's senior marketing leader. You will report to the Chief Product Officer and own the full marketing function: brand, product marketing, demand generation and account-based marketing, events, marketing content, marketing operations, and the corporate website.

You will partner closely with Sales leadership on pipeline and with Product Management on every launch. Product Strategy & Insights owns market analysis, pricing analysis, win/loss and proposals; you take new markets forward from the go/no-go decision.

This is a player-coach role for a builder. You will set the strategy, shape and develop the team, and roll up your sleeves on the work itself.

Responsibilities

Own the marketing strategy, annual plan and budget across people, programs, events and agencies
Set pipeline targets jointly with the Chief Revenue Officer, and own marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline as the team's headline number
Own ClassWallet's brand, positioning and messaging, using market and win/loss insight from Product Strategy & Insights, and keep the story consistent across the website, sales materials, proposals and events
Build and run an account-based marketing program with Sales, aimed at state agencies, school districts and other public-sector buyers and timed to budget cycles, legislative sessions and procurement windows
Own the event and trade show portfolio end to end: decide where ClassWallet shows up, run it well, and prove the return
Lead launch marketing under our tiered launch model, partnering with Product Management from business case through launch
Once ClassWallet commits to a new public-program market, lead its go-to-market, building on the market analysis from Product Strategy & Insights, through to the first reference clients
Own marketing content, including case studies, thought leadership and creative writing produced with an outside agency, and supply the Proposals team with approved messaging and proof points
Run the corporate website as a pipeline channel, with a focus on conversion, SEO and accessibility
Build marketing operations and reporting the business trusts, starting with attribution and a pipeline baseline in your first 90 days
Hire, develop and lead a high-performing team, with clear goals and accountability
Select and manage agencies and contractors for paid media, video production, web development, creative writing and surge capacity
Report marketing performance to the CPO and executive team, and contribute to board reporting

Requirements

10+ years of B2B marketing experience, including 5+ years leading marketing teams
Experience marketing to government, education or other public-sector buyers, where sales cycles are long and formal procurement such as RFPs is the norm
A track record of building or rebuilding a marketing function at a growth-stage company
Proven ownership of a pipeline target in partnership with sales leadership, with results you can quantify
Hands-on experience running account-based marketing and events-led programs
A strong product marketing foundation: positioning, messaging and launches
A player-coach who is as comfortable doing the work as leading it
Data-driven, and fluent in marketing automation, CRM platforms and marketing attribution
An excellent writer and presenter, able to communicate with executives, public officials and families alike
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

Preferred
:

Experience in fintech, payments, govtech or edtech SaaS
Experience taking a product into a new vertical or public-program market, such as human services or workforce programs
Experience helping a company move from a sales-led to a product-led operating model

ClassWallet is a positive, family-oriented team environment. Our focus is on encouragement, positive reinforcement, and gratitude. We work hard and are highly motivated to win but with a healthy perspective on life.

We offer an excellent salary and benefits commensurate with experience.

jobs.description:
The Business Marketing Group connects businesses with their customers on Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Messenger to help them grow their businesses through solutions like pages, advertising, messaging, and more. We succeed when we help our customers grow their business leveraging our solutions. The Global Marketing Operations team runs campaign execution for business marketing, launching hundreds of campaigns a year across an expanding set of digital marketing channels.We are seeking a Marketing Operations Manager who executes campaigns AI-first, pairing deep expertise in marketing execution platforms with the AI skills to automate that work. This role is about owning operational quality by setting executional standards that can be built at agent scale. The ideal candidate is a digital marketing expert who has already replaced meaningful parts of their own workflow with AI and can show what it produced.





Marketing Operations Manager Responsibilities:


Own campaign execution and execution quality for an assigned business area, from brief through launch, across lifecycle, email, in-product messaging, web, and Meta ads
Use AI as the primary tool for execution work, including build specification, copy and asset variants, audience logic, and QA
Build, configure, and test AI agents that execute campaign workflows, and own the automation roadmap for the area, reporting results in turnaround time, cost, and error rate
Pilot new delivery capabilities, then codify what correct execution looks like and the eval rubrics that hold agents to it
Advise partners at the brief stage on what is executable and at what cost, and translate execution learnings into platform requirements
Raise the AI capability of the team through documentation, enablement, and coaching
Find new ways to continually streamline execution processes, including working with XFNs (if needed) to automate handoff





Minimum Qualifications:


6+ years of experience in marketing operations, campaign management, or marketing automation
Hands-on build experience in at least two digital marketing channels among email, paid social, in-product messaging, web, and SEM or display, with expert-level depth in at least one execution or ads platform (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Marketo, HubSpot, Adobe)
Demonstrated use of AI to produce real marketing work output, with specific examples of what was automated and the measured effect on time, cost, quality, or volume
Hands-on experience building, configuring, and evaluating AI agents or LLM-based workflows, including prompt iteration and judgment on where output requires human review
Experience owning campaign execution at portfolio scale, including QA and trade-off decisions across competing requests
Experience scaling impact beyond own execution, through standards others adopted, requirements platform teams built, and enablement that raised team capability
Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience in digital marketing





Preferred Qualifications:


Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
Experience supporting B2B marketing efforts or high-volume audience segments at global scale
Experience leading the transition of a workflow from manual execution to automated or agentic execution
Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
Experience connecting AI tools to marketing systems through APIs, integrations, or agent tooling
SQL fluency or comparable data skills, sufficient to validate audiences and interrogate campaign performance independently
Comfort working in ambiguity, where the standard does not exist yet and part of the job is writing it
Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Marketing based in the United States.

We are seeking a strategic, hands-on marketing leader to drive the next phase of growth for an innovative AI-powered platform transforming how government organizations collaborate and deliver essential services. In this role, you will own the marketing strategy across brand, positioning, product marketing, demand generation, and field marketing. You will work closely with the CEO, founders, Sales, Product, and customer-facing teams to turn complex technology into a compelling market story. Leading a lean, talented team, you will balance strategic leadership with direct execution, from shaping campaigns and thought leadership to supporting high-value accounts and industry events. You will help establish a distinctive market category at the intersection of government operations, collaboration, and AI. This is an opportunity to build a scalable marketing function, influence company strategy, and contribute to technology that helps public servants address critical community challenges.

Accountabilities

Brand strategy and positioning: Own the brand narrative and market positioning, translating a complex product and emerging category into a clear, differentiated, and compelling value proposition.
Product marketing and storytelling: Transform customer success stories, product developments, and measurable outcomes into impactful campaigns, thought leadership, content, product launches, and sales enablement materials.
Growth strategy and demand generation: Partner with the growth marketing lead to identify priority audiences, channels, campaigns, and investments that generate qualified pipeline and support broader go-to-market objectives.
Field marketing and events: Develop a differentiated field marketing strategy encompassing conferences, roundtables, executive dinners, partnerships, and other relationship-building opportunities that support account growth.
Sales partnership and strategic accounts: Collaborate with Sales to refine messaging, support strategic opportunities, develop account-based campaigns, strengthen sales enablement, and help open, close, and expand government relationships.
Category development and thought leadership: Build market awareness and credibility through public relations, partnerships, creative campaigns, and thought leadership that establish a strong voice in modern government operations and AI.
Marketing team leadership: Lead, coach, and develop the marketing team, set clear priorities, empower functional owners, and identify the people, processes, and capabilities needed as the organization scales.
Performance measurement and optimization: Analyze campaign performance and pipeline contribution, identify effective channels and activities, and translate marketing insights into repeatable growth strategies.
Hands-on marketing execution: Contribute directly to copywriting, editing, campaign development, presentation creation, event planning, marketing operations, and strategic account support when needed.

jobs.description:
I'm hiring a Social Media & Content Manager to join my team 🎯

I'm looking for someone to take real ownership of my content and social strategy. Someone who is not just executing posts, but understanding my audience deeply and running the engine that turns content into growth. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to build something with me, not just manage a calendar.

What you'll own

Weekly reporting on total posts, total IG views, email/Manychat leads collected, and trials to my fitness app offering driven from social. You'll be close enough to the numbers to know what's actually moving the needle and help iterate from there.

Phase 1 — Get to know my audience

You'll dig into my DMs, community messages, in-app chat, and survey responses to build a real picture of who my audience is: their desired outcome, their biggest issues, and their limiting beliefs. From there, you'll define my content pillars and build out a swipe file of viral, high-performing content across those pillars to draw inspiration from (likely living in Notion).
Phase 2 — Run the content engine

Using a 70/20/10 approach, you'll manage my content pipeline: 70% doubling down on what's already working, 20% smart variations you develop, and 10% brand-new ideas you pitch and test (2–4 fresh concepts a week). You'll own my trial reels engine — 1–3 highly viral reels a day within my content pillars — handling post creation end to end, and reporting weekly on what worked, what didn't, and why.
Phase 3 — Grow beyond Instagram

Once Instagram is running like a well-oiled machine, we'll look at expanding to Facebook, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Pinterest, and figure out what team/support that would need.

What you need

Experience working in the social media creator space is a must — you should understand creator content, platform trends, and what makes short-form video perform. Experience in fitness is a plus! Beyond that, you should be comfortable going deep on research and audience psychology, then turning that into content that performs. I'm looking for someone who thrives on researching, testing, and iterating and has a passion for content creation!

How to Apply

• Apply via this Linkedin posting with your resume
• Include a short Loom video explaining why you’d be a good fit for the role, why you’re interested in working with Jorry, and showcasing examples from your portfolio

jobs.description:
Production Manager (Websites & SEO) Company:
Contractor Growth Network (CGN)
Location:
Charlotte, NC (Hybrid)
Employment Type:
Full-Time
Compensation:
$75,000–$90,000 annually + performance pay
Reports To:
Vice President / Integrator

About CGN CGN is a marketing agency specializing in website design, development, and SEO for remodeling and design-build companies. We help contractors attract the right customers and grow through effective digital marketing.
Our core values are One Size Fits One, Seek Excellence, Nail the Details, Be Your Best You, Love Your Impact, and Proactive Leadership.

About the Role We're hiring a Production Manager
to own the day-to-day execution of website projects and recurring SEO deliverables. You'll establish internal schedules, assign and prioritize work, manage team capacity, lead daily production check-ins, oversee quality standards, and ensure commitments are met.

This is an internal production leadership role, not a hands-on designer, developer, or SEO specialist position
. You'll need strong website production knowledge and the confidence to direct specialists, address missed deadlines, and resolve bottlenecks.

You'll have authority over internal assignments, deadlines, and priorities, but no direct reports. You'll document recurring performance concerns and escalate formal personnel matters to leadership. Account Managers own all client communication; you own internal production execution.

Your job is to ensure the right work gets completed correctly and on time, without constant leadership intervention.

Key ResponsibilitiesWebsite Production Create and own internal schedules, assignments, priorities, and deadlines for active website projects.
Understand website discovery, copywriting, design, development, QA, and launch dependencies to sequence work appropriately.
Assign work across designers, developers, writers, and other specialists based on capacity and deadlines.
Monitor progress daily; identify stalled tasks, bottlenecks, and delivery risks before deadlines are missed.
Coordinate internal handoffs and communicate timeline changes to Account Managers and leadership.
Keep website production plans, ownership, and task statuses accurate in Monday.com.

SEO Production Own production operations for recurring monthly SEO deliverables, including scheduling, prioritization, workflow, and delivery consistency.
Work with SEO specialists to turn their strategies and planned deliverables into clear assignments and deadlines.
Coordinate content, optimization, technical SEO, and related tasks across specialists, writers, and developers.
Track completed, outstanding, and at-risk work for each SEO client; address delays before monthly commitments are missed.
Ensure established QA procedures are followed and recurring delivery problems are identified.

SEO specialists own strategy and technical execution. The Production Manager owns operational follow-through and timely delivery.

Daily Leadership & Accountability Lead daily production check-ins to clarify priorities, progress, blockers, and next steps.
Set clear expectations for task ownership, deadlines, and completion standards.
Follow up consistently, address missed commitments directly, and prevent overdue work from accumulating.
Rebalance assignments with specialists when workloads are unrealistic; communicate resulting timeline impacts.
Independently reprioritize production work to meet business commitments.
Document repeated missed deadlines or performance concerns and report them to leadership.

Quality & Workflow Oversight Ensure specialists complete technical QA and work meets established requirements before being marked complete.
Spot-check deliverables for completeness, accuracy, and adherence to production standards.
Return substandard work to the responsible specialist with clear corrections and a revised deadline.
Track recurring quality problems and recommend improvements to reduce rework.
Identify inefficient handoffs, scheduling problems, and production bottlenecks; recommend practical process improvements.

Monday.com, Reporting & Collaboration Use Monday.com
to actively manage assignments, deadlines, dependencies, workload, and project status.
Maintain live visibility into overdue work, upcoming milestones, and production capacity.
Prepare weekly production scorecards and risk updates for the Vice President / Integrator.
Coordinate regularly with Account Managers so they can accurately manage client expectations.
Communicate production risks proactively and escalate issues requiring leadership decisions.
Maintain clear internal documentation and reinforce accurate task updates across the team.

Division of Responsibility Production Manager:
Internal schedules, assignments, priorities, workload balancing, production accountability, SEO delivery tracking, quality oversight, and reporting.
Account Managers:
Client relationships, communication, expectations, information collection, feedback, and approvals.
Production Specialists:
Technical execution, specialist-level QA, technical recommendations, and SEO strategy where applicable.

QualificationsRequired Demonstrated experience managing production workflows, digital projects, or delivery operations; proven ownership matters more than a specific number of years
.
Strong understanding of website development phases, dependencies, QA, and launch processes.
Direct Monday.com experience
managing projects, tasks, and deadlines.
Proven ability to establish schedules, assign work, prioritize competing demands, and enforce deadlines.
Experience coordinating multiple concurrent projects or recurring deliverables.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, follow-through, and independent judgment.
Confidence leading production meetings, addressing missed commitments, and holding contributors accountable.
Ability to identify capacity constraints, production risks, and quality concerns early.
Clear written and verbal communication and effective collaboration with technical and client-facing teams.
Ability to work in Charlotte, NC, under CGN's hybrid schedule.

Preferred Experience in a digital marketing, creative, or website development agency.
Familiarity with SEO workflows, content production, and recurring monthly deliverables.
Experience coordinating designers, developers, copywriters, and SEO specialists.
Experience building production dashboards, scorecards, or process improvements.
Familiarity with CMS platforms, website QA, UX, and SEO fundamentals.

What Success Looks Like On-Time Delivery:
Website production milestones and monthly SEO deliverables are completed on schedule. Overdue work is actively resolved and risks are flagged early.
Quality:
Deliverables meet requirements, specialist QA is completed, and corrections are tracked through resolution.
Workload Management:
Team members have clear assignments and deadlines; priorities and capacity are adjusted proactively.
Production Visibility:
Monday.com reflects accurate progress, and weekly reporting gives leadership reliable insight into delivery performance.
Specific targets will be established using CGN's production standards and commitments.

The Right Person for This Role You take ownership without waiting for direction. You're organized, decisive, and comfortable setting expectations and having direct conversations when commitments are missed. You understand how creative and technical work moves through production, spot risks early, and use accurate data to make decisions. You care about quality, communicate proactively, and follow through until work is complete.
This role isn't a fit for someone who only monitors task lists, avoids accountability conversations, or waits until deadlines have passed to intervene.

Why You Should Join Our Team Paid Time Off:
36 paid days annually, including 25 PTO days and 11 paid federal holidays.
401(k):
Company match of up to 4%.
Benefits:
CGN covers 50% of health and dental insurance premiums and 100% of life insurance. Vision insurance and parental leave are also offered.
Professional Development:
Industry certifications, training, and ongoing learning opportunities.
Clients:
Work with quality-driven, high-end interior remodeling contractors who value long-term partnerships.

Schedule Hours:
Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM.
Location:
Charlotte, NC.
Hybrid:
First 90 days fully in-office; afterward, three days in-office and two remote days weekly.

Practical Interview

jobs.title: Strategic Events Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
About the role:

We are looking for an energetic, highly organized, A-player who loves a fast-paced, high-performing environment. Working within Marketing, this role will support the production for Samsara's annual customer conference, Beyond, our global Go Beyond programs, and other hosted events throughout the year.
This role supports end-to-end production planning for Samsara's keynotes, breakouts, expo hall and general sessions, covering run-of-show creation, AV planning, rehearsal scheduling, and speaker management, all while executing alongside our production vendor onsite.
You'll manage relationships with production vendors and internal stakeholders while overseeing the workstreams and details that turn a production plan into a flawless live experience. Partnering closely with other members of the marketing, product, sales engineers, and customer success teams, you'll help shape programming and engagement that ladder up to Samsara's business objectives, driving best-in-class events.
This is a remote role open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area. This role requires travel, candidates must be open to traveling 30% of the time. 

You should apply if:

You want to impact the industries that run our world:
Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career:
If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity:
The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best:
At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You
will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best. 

In this role, you will:

Coordinate keynote and breakout planning and execution across key internal stakeholders, Samsara’s main production vendor and venue partners.
Support content production by building timelines, scheduling rehearsals, sourcing vehicles and equipment, and managing exec schedules and internal/external speakers.
Review venue contracts to ensure production needs are being met.
Assist in managing expo production needs including coordinating details between internal stakeholders, vendors, and the venue.
Oversee multiple events and programs with overlapping schedules.
Bring energy, creativity, and new ideas to build a successful event experience.
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

3+ years of experience in event management/production
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is required.
This role requires travel, candidates must be open to traveling 30% of the time. 
Experience using AI tools to work more efficiently.

An ideal candidate also has:

Strong communication, negotiation, and budget-management skills, with the ability to work across all levels of an organization.
Proven ability to manage multiple programs simultaneously in a fast-paced environment, navigate shifting priorities, and consistently deliver against deadlines without compromising execution quality.
Excellent project management and organizational skills, with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to build scalable processes, documentation, timelines, and operational frameworks.
Ability to work independently in an ambiguous and rapidly changing environment.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. **Qualifications**

* Ability to identify and verify the true buyer within a target organization (budget owner, decision maker, and influencers), distinguish them from adjacent or easier-to-reach contacts, and hold a disciplined outreach cadence toward that person without defaulting to volume.

jobs.description:
About The Wells Michael Collective

The Wells Michael Collective is an independent luxury real estate brokerage in Ladue, Missouri, led by partners Justin Michael and Suzie Wells. We represent significant homes across St. Louis and present them through architecture, design and the lives lived inside them.

The role

You will be the creative voice of The Wells Michael Collective across every screen and every printed page. You will own our social presence from concept to camera to caption, build the content strategy behind it, and design the brochures, mailers and campaigns that put our homes and our people in front of the right audience.

You will sit at the table with both partners and shape how the brand looks and sounds as it grows. Your ideas will move from sketch to published within days, with no agency layers or committee approvals in between. This is an in office and in field position, split between our Ladue office and shoots, listings and events across St. Louis.

What you will own

**Social media production and publishing**

* Plan, shoot, edit and publish content for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok and YouTube
* Produce short form video, reels and stories for every listing, from Coming Soon through Sold
* Direct photographers and videographers on set so every shoot matches the brand
* Write captions with an editorial voice: precise, warm and free of real estate clichés
* Manage the posting calendar, community replies and direct messages

**Content strategy**

* Build and run a monthly content strategy tied to listings, market moments, advisors and the St. Louis lifestyle
* Track performance every month and turn the numbers into next month's plan
* Develop recurring series that give people a reason to follow us: home stories, architecture, neighborhoods, design
* Grow audience quality as well as audience size, with the goal of reaching the clients who buy and sell significant homes

**Brand design**

* Design listing collateral in Canva: brochures, feature sheets, postcards, mailers and presentation pieces
* Keep every asset on brand using our Canva Brand Kit, palette and typography
* Prepare print files with correct bleed and specs for our print partners
* Build InDesign layouts for longer editorial pieces as the brand expands

**Brand expansion**

* Launch new advisors with a polished public profile and content plan
* Support press, magazine ads, events and community partnerships
* Help build the visual playbook that will carry the brand into new markets

What you bring

**Required**

* 3+ years producing social content and design work for a brand, ideally in luxury, hospitality, fashion, design or real estate
* Advanced Canva skills, with a portfolio that proves it
* An eye for elevation: you know the difference between expensive and significant, and your work shows restraint
* Strong photo and video skills on a phone and in an editing app such as CapCut, Premiere Rush or Lightroom
* Clear, polished writing with a natural editorial voice
* Comfort with analytics on Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn
* Organized, self directed and able to run a calendar with many moving parts
* Based in St. Louis and able to be on site at shoots, events and the Ladue office

**A plus**

* Adobe InDesign, Photoshop or Illustrator
* Experience with print production and working with print vendors
* Experience directing photographers, videographers or stylists
* A following or portfolio built around architecture, interiors or St. Louis

Please include a portfolio. We hire on the strength of the work.

Growth path

This role is designed to grow into the head of marketing as the company grows. The path is tied to results, and you will review progress with both partners every quarter.

* **Marketing & Brand Content Manager.** Own social, content strategy and listing design. Build the systems and the calendar.
* **Senior Brand Manager.** Lead campaigns, press and partnerships. Manage freelance photographers, videographers and designers.
* **Director of Marketing & Brand.** Lead a marketing team, own the brand budget and guide the brand into new markets.

You will also receive an annual professional development budget for courses, conferences and creative tools, plus direct mentorship from two partners who have built a luxury brand from the ground up.

Compensation, bonus and benefits

* **Base salary:** based on experience and portfolio
* **Annual bonus:** tied to company growth milestones you helped drive
* **Paid time off:** PTO and major holidays, with a quiet week between Christmas and New Year's
* **Professional development:** an annual budget for courses, conferences and creative tools
* **Your tools (provided by the company):** a laptop, Canva Pro, Adobe Creative Cloud and the gear you need to shoot
* **Access:** a front row seat inside some of the most significant homes in St. Louis, and direct connection to the clients, designers, architects, builders and community leaders who shape them, with real networking opportunities through our events and partnerships

How to apply

Send your resume, a portfolio link and three pieces of work you are proudest of to team@wellsmichael.com. Tell us in a few sentences what you would change first about our Instagram. We read every application, and finalists will complete a short paid creative exercise.

Pay: From $50,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

Our team members are the key to our company’s success, and their health and well-being, as well as that of their families, is very important to us. We offer a comprehensive benefits package that allows our team members stay healthy, plan for their future and maintain a healthy work-life balance. Benefits may vary with employment status. To see our fill list of Team Member Benefits please visit our career site: www.gotoworkhappy.com/benefits

**Job Description:**

Under the direction of the Director of Brand Marketing, the Brand Management & Marketing Manager is responsible for supporting the strategic development, management, and execution of brand marketing initiatives across Seminole Hard Rock Support Services (SHRSS), Seminole Gaming, Hard Rock International Hotels, Casinos, and Cafes, as well as departments throughout the enterprise. This role supports all aspects of brand development, creative strategy, visual identity, design, marketing communications, tactical deployment, and brand compliance to ensure a cohesive, compelling, and consistent brand experience across all business verticals and consumer touchpoints.

The Brand Management & Marketing Manager partners with internal stakeholders, creative services, external agencies, and cross-functional teams to translate brand strategy and business objectives into impactful creative concepts, marketing campaigns, and branded experiences. The role requires a strong understanding of brand management, creative development, design principles, and visual storytelling, with the ability to balance strategic thinking, creative problem-solving, and project execution while maintaining the integrity and evolution of the Hard Rock brand.

**Essential duties include, but are not limited to:**

* Support all aspects of brand marketing for Seminole Gaming, SHRSS, Hard Rock International Hotels and Casinos, and Hard Rock Cafes.
* Support the development and execution of marketing programs that strengthen brand identity and brand awareness.

* **Ensure brand integrity by guiding efforts across multiple verticals and enforcing brand standards.**

* Partner with internal teams, and external creative agencies to develop, review, refine, and approve creative assets and marketing materials.
* Evaluate creative work for brand alignment, quality, consistency, and effectiveness, ensuring that all executions reflect the appropriate brand identity and meet established standards.

jobs.title: Marketing Generalist
jobs.description:
Marketing Generalist

*Automotive Dealer Group*

**Company:** Newton Motor Group

**Location:** Hendersonville, TN

**Position Type:** Full-Time

**Reports To:** Marketing Manager / Marketing Director

**Annual Salary:** $40,000–$50,000, based on experience

**About the Role**
==================

Newton Motor Group is seeking a creative, organized Marketing Generalist to execute marketing initiatives across our dealerships. This hands-on role supports vehicle sales, service, and parts through content creation, digital marketing, promotional campaigns, and community events.

The ability to multitask is essential to this role. The ideal candidate can manage several campaigns, projects, and event deadlines at once, prioritize competing requests across multiple dealerships, and adapt to changing needs while maintaining accuracy and follow-through. You will take projects from idea to completion and use performance data to improve results.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Execute marketing campaigns across email, social media, dealership websites, digital advertising, and print.
* Create and publish content featuring inventory, special offers, service promotions, employees, and community involvement.
* Develop marketing materials, including graphics, flyers, email campaigns, signage, and presentations.
* Capture and edit vehicle photography, dealership photos, and short-form videos.
* Maintain dealership website content, promotional pages, and business listings to keep information accurate and current.
* Coordinate with sales and service teams to align promotions with inventory, department priorities, and customer needs.
* Work with agencies and vendors to coordinate creative assets, campaign launches, and project deadlines.
* Support paid advertising campaigns by preparing content, reviewing offers, and monitoring results.
* Build and distribute email campaigns, initiate audience selection and checking links, content, and formatting.
* Monitor social media engagement and online reviews, responding within dealership guidelines and escalating concerns as needed.
* Plan and execute events for multiple dealerships, including sales events, customer appreciation activities, sponsorships, and community partnerships. Coordinate event calendars, budgets, vendors, promotional materials, staffing, and on-site logistics with each dealership team.
* Track campaign performance and improvements based on engagement, traffic, leads, and conversions.
* Maintain shared marketing and event calendars, asset libraries, and campaign documentation to coordinate overlapping deadlines and activities across dealerships.
* Follow brand standards, manufacturer advertising guidelines, and internal approval processes, including required offer disclosures.

**Qualifications**
==================

* Two or more years of experience in marketing, communications, or a related role.
* Strong writing, editing, and verbal communication skills.
* Experience creating content and executing campaigns across multiple channels.
* Working knowledge of social media platforms, email marketing tools, and content management systems.
* Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite, or similar design tools.
* Basic photography and video editing skills.
* Ability to interpret marketing reports and identify practical improvements.
* Demonstrated ability to multitask, organize competing priorities, and independently manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment while maintaining strong attention to detail.
* Ability to collaborate with teams across multiple dealership locations.
* Willingness to travel between dealerships and occasionally support evening or weekend events.

**Preferred Experience**
========================

* Experience in automotive, retail, or another business with multiple locations.
* Familiarity with Google Analytics, Google Business Profile, Google Ads, and Meta Business Suite.
* Experience with customer relationship management systems and customer email campaigns.
* Knowledge of manufacturer advertising requirements and co-op documentation.
* Degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* Campaigns and promotional materials are delivered accurately and on schedule.
* Dealership websites, business listings, and social channels remain current and engaging.
* Content and campaigns generate measurable customer engagement and business opportunities.
* Internal teams and vendors receive clear communication and reliable follow-through.
* Events across multiple dealerships are well planned, promoted, and executed, with clear timelines, coordinated resources, and timely follow-up.

**Compensation and Benefits**
=============================

* Annual Salary: $40,000–$50,000, based on experience.
* Health benefits.
* 401(k) plan available.
* Paid time off and paid holidays.

**Please note:** This is an evergreen job posting, meaning we are continuously accepting applications for this role. If your experience aligns with our current or future needs, our team will reach out as relevant opportunities become available.

Job Title: Senior SEO Strategist (Enterprise & Multi-Location Focus)  
Location: Remote (USA Only)

**About Ignite Visibility**

Ignite Visibility is a fast-growing, award-winning digital marketing agency operating at the intersection of creativity, technology, and data. We specialize in solving one of the most complex challenges in digital marketing: bridging the gap between national brand presence and local market relevance.

To support our rapid expansion, we are seeking a seasoned Senior SEO Strategist to lead high-profile enterprise accounts. If you have a proven track record of dominating search for large franchise systems or multi-location businesses and you possess the leadership skills to guide both clients and internal teams, we want to talk to you.

**The Role**

As a Senior SEO Strategist at Ignite Visibility, you are more than an SEO expert; you are a strategic partner to our biggest clients and a key leader within our agency. You will take ownership of a portfolio of high-stakes accounts, developing and executing sophisticated SEO strategies that drive revenue at scale.

We are looking for a go-getter with a passion for internet marketing and a positive, solution-oriented attitude. You will be responsible for client retention, team development, and ensuring that our work remains best-in-class.

**What You'll Do: Hands-on Strategic & Client-Facing Role**

* Lead High-Value Relationships: Serve as the trusted advisor for a handful of high-profile clients, leading weekly strategic meetings and providing data-driven recommendations that align with their business goals.
* Architect Enterprise SEO Strategies: Develop comprehensive strategies for complex, multi-location brands. This includes technical roadmaps, content strategies, and scalable linking strategies that perform nationally and dominate locally.
* Drive Execution & Results: Oversee the execution of campaign deliverables, ensuring that every tacticfrom technical fixes to editorial contentis optimized for maximum impact. You will own the client's performance metrics.
* Ensure Excellence: Guarantee that Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) for your accounts are insightful and best-in-class. Monitor account health and intervene to prevent churn, with a target of maintaining 80%+ client retention.
* Shape the Agency: Partner with Talent Acquisition to define roles and salary bands for your department, and collaborate with leadership to refine company-wide strategy.

Who You Are: Qualifications & Experience

* Deep SEO Expertise: 8+ years of experience in Internet Marketing with a core focus on SEO. You have a deep understanding of technical SEO, on-page optimization, and modern link building.
* Enterprise & Multi-Location Niche: You have demonstrated experience working with franchise systems or large multi-location businesses. You understand the unique challenges of managing local pages, citations, and consistency at scale.
* Agency DNA: You have a strong agency background and thrive in a fast-paced, client-service environment. You are comfortable managing multiple high-priority projects simultaneously.
* Proven Leadership: You have direct experience managing, mentoring, and developing staff. You know how to build trust and get the best out of a team.
* Technical & Platform Proficiency:

  + Deep knowledge of Content Management Systems like WordPress.
  + Understanding of how social platforms (LinkedIn, YouTube, etc. ) intersect with and support SEO.
  + Experience with keyword research, assignment, and content gap analysis.
* Communication Maestro: You possess excellent interpersonal and communication skills. You are comfortable on the phone and on Zoom, able to articulate complex SEO concepts to clients in a way that builds confidence and trust.

Core Competencies

* Strategic Thinker: You see the big picture and can reverse-engineer a plan to get there.
* Creative Problem-Solver: You don't just follow playbooks; you create innovative strategies to overcome challenges.
* Collaborative Leader: You are a relationship builder who connects effectively with team members and clients alike.
* Highly Organized: You have excellent time management skills, attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize in a high-paced environment.
* Growth-Oriented: You are committed to continuous improvement, open to feedback, and always curious about what's next in digital marketing.

Ready to make an impact? Join Ignite Visibility and take your careerand our clients' successto the next level.
