jobs.title: Marketing Manger -Point & Ciick Solutions
jobs.description:
Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

**About Point & Click Solutions (PNC)**  
Point & Click Solutions is the leading electronic medical records software provider for institutions of higher education. PNC serves many of the largest, most complex student health and counseling clinics at the country's preeminent universities.

Our mission is to build software that works the way the campus care ecosystem actually operates, so clinicians can spend less time on administrative tasks and more time delivering care.

We are seeking a remote based (United States) Marketing Manger to join our team!

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead digital sales and marketing campaigns leveraging HubSpot, LinkedIn, Claude, and other tools
* Systematically map and target key account prospects and upsell opportunities
* Systematically track campaign performance (A/B testing, open/response rates, etc.)
* Manage website content and optimization of SEO/AEO/GEO
* Coordinate logistics and arrange marketing materials for conferences
* Coordinate with clients on security reviews and other necessary documentation

  

**Key Traits**

* Proactivity
* Attention to detail
* Accountability
* Coachability
* Tenacity when faced with rejection
* Comfort working cross-functionally in a lean, entrepreneurial organization
  

**What You've Done**

* Worked 2-5 years in B2B marketing with a track record of driving programs from idea to execution – not just supporting them
* Driven quantifiable results in outbound communications and SEO/AEO
* Worked with a variety of modern marketing tools, including HubSpot, LinkedIn, website tools, and email tools
* Built agentic AI into your workflows

  

**How You Work**  

* Self-starter: you see what needs to happen and move on it without waiting to be directed
* Go-getter: you hold the output to a high standard and bring urgency to what you own.
* Hands-on: you are willing to roll up your sleeves and do the work.
* Outcomes-driven: you care about results, not activity. You are not interested in random acts of marketing - everything you do is tied to a commercial objective and measured against it.
* AI-forward and agent-curious: you reach for AI tools instinctively to move faster and produce sharper work - and you are genuinely excited about the opportunity to build and deploy marketing agents that create real leverage.
* Operationally sharp: you are organized, consistent, and reliable - the kind of person others count on to close the loop.
* Builder mentality: you are energized by creating structure and process where there isn't any, and you take pride in what you build.
* A good human and a true team player: you show up for your colleagues, communicate openly, share credit, and make the people around you better. Culture matters to you.

The expected base salary for this position is: $85,000 - excluding bonus (when applicable). Salary is based on a number of factors including market conditions, location and may vary depending on job-related skills and experience.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
RareCyte is a precision biology company developing innovative technologies and products for spatial proteomics and liquid biopsy. Our platforms are used by leading therapeutic companies and research institutions worldwide to advance translational and clinical research programs. The company's Orion™ spatial proteomics platform uses novel single-round technology to deliver quantitative, high-plex spatial biomarker data with the throughput and reproducibility required to support the development of precision therapeutics. The CyteFinder®, AccuCyte®, and RarePlex® products enable class leading rare cell detection for liquid biopsy.

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Product Marketing Manager to develop compelling, scientifically credible content and execute digital marketing campaigns that build brand awareness, engage target audiences, and drive demand for our technologies and services. The ideal candidate is an exceptional writer with a strong scientific background and experience marketing to pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and academic clinical research audiences. This individual will independently manage content development from research and subject matter expert interviews through writing, editing, publication, and optimization with the ability to translate complex scientific concepts into clear, differentiated content across digital marketing channels.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Scientific Content Development**

* Research, write, and edit high-quality scientific and commercial content, including blogs, application notes, white papers, case studies, website copy, and sales enablement materials
* Translate complex scientific information into compelling, application-focused messaging for biopharma and life sciences research audiences
* Interview scientists, customers, and internal subject matter experts to develop accurate, differentiated content while maintaining consistent messaging and brand voice
* Leverage AI-assisted tools to improve content production efficiency while maintaining scientific and editorial quality

  

**Digital Marketing and Demand Generation**

* Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns, including email, social media, landing pages, webinars, and digital advertising
* Write, schedule, and publish engaging content across email, social media, and other digital marketing channels
* Develop audience-specific content to support customer engagement throughout the buying journey and optimize website and campaign content for search visibility, engagement, and lead generation
* Repurpose scientific content across multiple formats and channels to maximize reach and impact

  

**Scientific Thought Leadership**

* Develop thought leadership and educational content addressing trends in spatial biology, precision oncology, biomarker development, and therapeutic research
* Collaborate with scientific experts, customers, and external partners to communicate research applications and technology advances
* Support scientific presentations, conference abstracts, webinars, and media-related content

  

**Content Planning and Optimization**

* Maintain and execute an editorial calendar aligned with marketing priorities and commercial campaigns

* Apply SEO and emerging AI-search optimization best practices to improve content discoverability
* Monitor content performance and recommend improvements based on engagement, traffic, and lead-generation metrics
* Manage multiple content projects independently while meeting deadlines and maintaining high editorial standards

### **Required Qualifications**

* B.S. in biology, biochemistry, molecular biology, biomedical sciences, or a related discipline
* 5-10 years of experience in scientific content marketing and communications
* Exceptional scientific writing, editing, and storytelling skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical subjects clearly and persuasively
* Experience independently developing scientific and commercial marketing content for biopharma and academic clinical research audiences including websites, blogs, email campaigns, and social media
* Working knowledge of SEO, digital marketing, and content performance analytics
* Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple priorities independently
* Proficiency with AI-assisted content development tools
* Portfolio of personally authored scientific and marketing content

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience marketing life sciences research instrument platforms and lab services
* Familiarity with spatial biology market
* Graduate degree in life science discipline
* Experience with marketing automation, CRM, content management, and anlytics platforms

### **Compensation**

Base Salary Range: $130,000 - $160,000 (annualized)

  

* Determining a base salary will be based on several factors which include skill set, level of education, experience and qualifications, as well as RareCyte internal equity. Some roles may also qualify for additional compensation such as bonus, commission, stock options and travel allowance.

**Location:** Corporate Office - Dana Point

**Shift:** 8:30am-5pm – Monday-Friday, Onsite

**Reports to:** Director of Business Development

**FLSA Status:** Full-Time, Salary Exempt

**Company Overview:**

Alter Behavioral Health is an innovative, evidence-based treatment program specifically designed to treat primary mental health diagnoses. Our mission is to provide the highest level of personalized care and treatment to every individual seeking support to restore and maintain their highest level of functioning. Our dedicated team of professionals employ a comprehensive, multidimensional approach to create a more well-rounded and personalized experience for each individual seeking treatment.

**Job Summary:**

The Manager, Digital Marketing will elevate our online presence, optimize performance marketing channels, and guide individuals in need of care toward appropriate clinical resources. Operating as an integrated function, this position leads external agency partners, offshore contributors, and AI platforms. jobs.title: Search Engine Optimization Specialist
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

We are hiring an SEO Specialist to improve client search rankings, strengthen local visibility, and help websites attract relevant organic traffic. You'll review website performance, identify technical and content issues, manage local search listings, and use campaign data to guide ongoing improvements.

This role is suited to someone with at least two years of SEO experience who can work methodically, write clear recommendations, and understand that meaningful search improvements take time. You'll be expected to monitor campaigns consistently, respond promptly when problems arise, and report results accurately without making promises the data cannot support.

**What You'll Be Responsible For**

* Audit client websites to identify technical SEO issues, content gaps, indexing problems, and opportunities for improvement.
* Develop practical optimisation plans based on website audits, keyword research, and client objectives.
* Manage local business listings, check profile accuracy, and monitor customer reviews.
* Research keywords and search intent to identify opportunities for new pages and existing content improvements.
* Prepare clear content briefs outlining page objectives, target keywords, search intent, and recommended content structure.
* Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic, local visibility, and other relevant SEO performance indicators.
* Use Google Search Console and appropriate SEO tools to investigate changes in performance and identify potential issues.
* Review page titles, meta descriptions, internal links, headings, and other on-page SEO elements.
* Track campaign progress and prepare reports explaining performance changes, completed work, and recommended next steps.
* Investigate ranking declines, traffic changes, indexing issues, and other problems that may affect campaign performance.
* Keep campaign records, audit findings, and performance data accurate and organised.
* Respond promptly to client and team enquiries, particularly when a campaign requires investigation or corrective action.
* Communicate progress, concerns, and realistic expectations clearly to the relevant stakeholders.

**What You'll Bring**

* **At least 2 years of professional experience in SEO.**
* Practical knowledge of technical SEO, on-page optimisation, and local SEO.
* Familiarity with Google Search Console and relevant SEO research, auditing, and tracking tools.
* Understanding of keyword research, search intent, website indexing, and organic search performance.
* Good writing skills and the ability to prepare clear content briefs and optimisation recommendations.
* Ability to interpret ranking and traffic data and explain what the figures do—and do not—demonstrate.
* Strong attention to detail when auditing websites, checking business listings, and reviewing performance reports.
* A methodical approach to investigating technical issues and identifying opportunities for improvement.
* Good organisational skills and the ability to manage several tasks or campaigns at once.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to provide timely, accurate updates.
* Patience and consistency when managing campaigns where results develop over time.

**What to Expect in the Role**

You'll be expected to track SEO activity carefully, check your findings before reporting them, and communicate honestly about campaign performance. When rankings or traffic change unexpectedly, you should investigate the possible causes and explain what is known, what remains uncertain, and what action is recommended.

SEO requires ongoing attention rather than one-time fixes. We value consistent optimisation, realistic expectations, and prompt communication when a technical issue or campaign concern needs attention.

**Working Arrangements**

**Schedule:** Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM  
**Location:** 135 Henry St, Dayton, Ohio 45403  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

**How to Apply**

Apply through Indeed with your current Resume. Highlight your SEO experience, website auditing skills, familiarity with Google Search Console, and work with local search campaigns. Include examples of SEO projects you've supported and the performance indicators you used to evaluate progress.

**Job Summary**

The role partners closely with Business Development, Marketing, IT, Corporate Training, operating subsidiaries, and leadership to turn data into actionable insights, recommendations, and measurable action to drive revenue growth.

-----------------------

* Actively supports the Company’s commitment to safety and its Core Values.

jobs.description:
**A****BOUT ROOTSTOCK**

Rootstock Software builds Cloud ERP for manufacturers, distributors, and supply chain teams, native to the Salesforce Platform. Our customers run inventory, production, and supply chain operations on Rootstock, and we are investing heavily in AI across the product and our go-to-market.

**THE ROLE**

We are hiring a technical, hands-on marketer to own paid acquisition and the growth engine behind roughly half of our top-of-funnel pipeline.

This role is built around budget ownership. You will run hundreds of thousands of dollars in Google Ads and AdRoll spend, decide where every dollar goes, and scale what works. You will also be the builder behind it: shipping pages, experiments, and automation in Claude Code, and running technical SEO, without waiting on an engineering queue.

It is a great fit for a digital or growth marketer a few years into their career who already owns paid budgets and leans technical, or for an associate-level consultant who has run strategy and execution for clients and wants to own it in-house.

***This is a remote position, based in the United States or Canada.***  
*Please, no agencies/recruiters.*

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* **Own paid performance.** Run Google Ads and AdRoll against our ICP terms and target accounts, scale spend into the hundreds of thousands, and make incremental spend decisions backed by data.
* **Drive technical SEO and conversion.** Find which terms and accounts convert to MQLs, run constant experiments, and grow top-of-funnel conversion week over week.
* **Build in Claude Code.** Ship and iterate on web pages, integrations, and automation that power the growth engine.
* **Measure what works.** Track performance across every channel, build the reporting you need to make spend decisions, and present results to leadership with confidence.
* **Shape AI and review-site discoverability.** Manage our presence on G2 and similar review sites, including how Rootstock gets surfaced and recommended by AI tools.
* **Support content and campaigns.** Contribute to case studies, sales enablement collateral, and persona-basedoutbound email and LinkedIn sequences as needed.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

The profile below is what we would like to see, but we are open to the right candidate. Strong analytical ability, theability to learn quickly, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves and contribute from day one matter more thanchecking every box.

* Ideally 3 to 5 years in growth, digital, paid, or performance marketing at a startup or B2B software company, or in an associate-level consulting role focused on marketing strategy and execution
* Direct ownership of ad spend and paid budgets in Google Ads, AdRoll, or similar, with accountability for results
* A technical, builder mindset: you are already experimenting with Claude Code or similar AI tools, and you are comfortable with automation, spreadsheets, SQL, or scripting
* Technical SEO experience, including keyword strategy and conversion optimization
* An analytical brain: you make spend decisions from data, not instinct
* A scrappy, high-ownership approach; you are comfortable running many experiments at once and grinding through the daily numbers
* Executive presence: you can own a number that matters to leadership and communicate results clearl

  

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Agency, consulting, or freelance experience managing paid budgets across multiple clients
* A founder or first-marketing-hire background at a startup
* Experience with ERP, supply chain, inventory, or manufacturing software
* Incrementality or A/B testing on paid channels
* Experience with G2 or other product review platforms
* Familiarity with Salesforce or Hubspot

**FIRST 90 DAYS**

The headline goal: scale our digital ad investment and prove it pays off.

* **Day 30:** Audit current paid, SEO, and conversion performance, learn the ICP and target accounts, and get your reporting baseline in place.
* **Day 60:** Launch your first wave of experiments across Google Ads, AdRoll, and technical SEO, and start reallocating spend toward what converts.
* **Day 90:** Run a scaled, measurable ad program with a clear line from spend to MQLs, and a roadmap for what you will build next.

**INTERVIEW PROCESS**  
**STEP 1:** Hiring Managers  
**STEP 2**: BDR Manager  
**STEP 3**: Sales Leadership  
**STEP 4:** CRO/Executive  
**STEP 5:** Case study/Panel interview

**The Basics:**

* **Location**: Remote, US-based
* **Work Authorization:** This position requires candidates to be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Rootstock is not able to sponsor, extend, or transfer work visas for this position now or in the future — this includes but is not limited to H-1B, TN, O-1, E-3, and OPT/STEM OPT extensions. Candidates who will require sponsorship at any point during their employment will not be considered.
* **Compensation:** Base salary, annual bonus, and a long-term incentive plan (LTIP).
  + Base Salary: The anticipated salary range for this role is $110,000 to $ 1200,000. Base pay offered is based on market location and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations.
* **Benefits:**
  + Time Off: Flexible time-off, 12 paid holidays, 10 sick days, volunteer time off, and paid parental leave.
  + Recurring cell/Internet stipend
  + 401(k) via Fidelity + 2% Employer annual matching
  + Comprehensive healthcare with dental and vision coverage; life, accident and disability insurance; tax-advantaged flexible spending and health savings accounts; employee assistance program; other voluntary benefit programs such as supplemental life and AD&D, legal plan, pet insurance, critical illness, accident & hospital indemnity.

Rootstock Software is an equal-opportunity employer. We evaluate all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, nation

jobs.title: Manager, Performance Marketing
jobs.description:
**About Eleanor Health**

Eleanor Health is rethinking addiction by treating it as a chronic condition and building an integrated care model that expands access to effective, whole-person treatment to drive sustained recovery. Our goal is to improve upon earlier generations of opioid and substance use disorder treatment to create more accessible clinic- and community-based care.

Eleanor Health and its associated health care providers deliver best-in-class substance use disorder care utilizing Medication-Assisted Therapy (MAT), behavioral health therapy, care management, and social support and wrap services. As a multi-site, outpatient treatment organization, Eleanor delivers accessible, evidence-based, and excellent clinical care, supported by innovative technology.

If you are passionate about growing your career in a business that makes a difference, we seek highly skilled, motivated, and compassionate individuals who take responsibility and adapt quickly to change to join our deeply committed and collaborative team.

**About the Role**

Every month, thousands of people decide they are ready to do something about their substance use. They search, they scroll, they stream, they click, they call, they fill out a form. This role exists to make sure that as many of them as possible find us in more places than a search results page, and that it costs less to reach them each quarter.

This is a paid media role, and it is not a paid search role. Google Ads and Microsoft Ads are our largest channels today, and a dedicated specialist runs them day to day. This role exists to build and scale everything around that foundation: affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, Meta, and Reddit. We are hiring for depth in those channels, along with the website experimentation that turns more traffic into more members.

**Where we are**
----------------

We have built a real foundation over the past two years. Paid cost per new member has been reduced by more than half. Conversion tracking is clean and includes offline conversion data, so campaigns optimize toward people who actually enter care rather than toward form fills. Campaign structure has been rebuilt, landing page experience has improved substantially, and bid strategy and targeting have moved from manual management to value-based approaches.

This is a performance marketing function with good bones, clear measurement, and meaningful results already behind it.

**Where we are going**
----------------------

Three priorities define the next phase of the work.

* **First —** Paid channel diversification. Paid search carries too much of the load today. We need to build and prove affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, Meta, and Reddit, and to test others worth testing, so growth does not depend on a single auction that gets more expensive as we scale. Each new channel earns its budget by proving member-level economics, not lead volume.
* **Second —** Testing rigor. Our experimentation program is young, and there is substantial gain available from running it properly: structured A/B testing on landing pages and creative, and disciplined testing of newer bid strategies and campaign types, including AI Max.
* **Third —** Website conversion. The website is the front door for every channel. Landing pages, forms, and the online self-scheduling experience decide how much of the traffic we buy turns into a lead, and every point of lift improves every channel at once.

**The channels**
----------------

The channels in scope are Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, and Meta and Reddit. A paid search specialist runs the day-to-day on Google and Microsoft. This role leads the rest, builds the strategy across all five, and decides where each dollar goes.

**How the funnel is shared**
----------------------------

Marketing does not own the entire path on its own. This role owns the path from first impression to a submitted lead or call: the channels, the landing pages, the forms, and the online self-scheduling experience. From there, our Access team is the first human point of contact for every prospective member who reaches out, by phone, by web form, or through online self-scheduling. They handle insurance verification, appointment scheduling, pre-visit support, and follow-up when someone misses an appointment. The Access team reports separately to the Chief Marketing Officer, alongside this role rather than within it.

The lifecycle communications that carry a prospective member from inquiry to first visit, including confirmations, reminders, pre-visit content, and no-show recovery, are owned by the Organic & AI Acquisition team, which also owns the content behind them. This role partners with that team and with Access, because paid cost per new member depends on what happens after the lead. A standing intake funnel review brings all three together.

**What this role is accountable for**
-------------------------------------

The primary measure is paid cost per new member, and it is deliberately end-to-end: spend divided by members who complete a first visit, not by leads generated. It does not improve by producing more form fills. It improves when more of the people we reach actually enter care.

Alongside it sit website-visitor-to-lead conversion, owned outright by this role, and the mix of paid acquisition itself: the share of members coming from channels beyond paid search, and each new channel's cost against a defined target before it earns more budget. Lead-to-member conversion is owned by Access and the lifecycle function, and blended cost per acquisition across all channels, paid and non-paid together, sits with the Chief Marketing Officer.

**What You'll Do**

**Paid Media Strategy & Performance**

* Own paid cost per new member as a quarterly target, understanding that monthly variance in this category is largely seasonal rather than performance-driven
* Own budget pacing and allocation across all five ch

jobs.title: Email Marketing Operations Assistant
jobs.description:
About Future Finance

Future Finance is building the next generation of financial media: a daily newsletter that makes markets, investing, economics, and wealth creation engaging, actionable, and easy to understand for a modern audience.

Our goal is simple: become a daily habit for ambitious professionals who want to become smarter investors and better-informed consumers of financial information.

We're not going to out-spend our way to an audience. We're going to out-think, out-create, and out-connect everyone else in this space.

The Role

We're looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented assistant to support the day-to-day execution of our email marketing campaigns across multiple brands.

This is primarily an execution and operations role, not a copywriting or strategy role. Your responsibility will be to ensure campaigns are loaded, checked, scheduled, and sent accurately and on time.

Key Responsibilities

* Load and schedule 7 Future Finance campaigns per week on ActiveCampaign / Iterable (free newsletter).
* Load and schedule 5 paid newsletter campaigns per week on Beehiiv.
* Assist with scheduling 1–2 daily email broadcasts for Decentralized Masters.
* Upload provided copy, subject lines, preview text, images, and links.
* Ensure campaigns are sent to the correct audience segments at the correct times.
* Thoroughly QA emails before scheduling, including formatting, links, tracking, segmentation, and send settings.
* Maintain campaign calendars and trackers.
* Flag missing information, inconsistencies, or potential mistakes before campaigns go live.
* Assist with last-minute scheduling changes when needed.
* Schedule/segment SMS broadcasts as we roll out SMS campaigns

  
**Requirements**  
  
Who You Are

Attention to detail is the #1 priority for this role. We're looking for someone who takes ownership of their work and can be trusted to execute accurately without constant supervision.

Key qualities:

* Excellent attention to detail: Catches mistakes in links, formatting, targeting, scheduling, Messaging (user experience), etc.
* Ownership and good judgment: Doesn't blindly follow instructions. Proactively flags anything that looks incorrect or unusual and asks questions when needed.
* Reliability: Consistently meets deadlines and ensures campaigns are ready on time.
* Organization: Can manage multiple brands, campaigns, and schedules without letting things slip.
* Ability to follow processes: Comfortable working with SOPs, checklists, and established workflows.
* Proactive communication: Flags blockers early rather than waiting until the last minute.
* Independent execution: Can take responsibility for recurring tasks after training.
* Tech-savvy and trainable: Comfortable learning new software and picking up tools quickly.

Experience Requirements

Prior experience with email marketing platforms is NOT required. We're happy to train the right person.

Experience with ActiveCampaign, Iterable, Beehiiv, or similar email marketing platforms is a plus, but what matters most is being detail-oriented, reliable, tech-savvy, and a fast learner.

What You Won't Be Responsible For

* Writing email copy or subject lines
* Developing email marketing strategies
* Creating offers or promotional campaigns

All copy, creative assets, and campaign instructions will be provided by the marketing team. Your role is to ensure everything is executed correctly.

Availability: Must be available and responsive between 9:00 AM and 3:00 PM Eastern Time (ET) on working days to coordinate campaign scheduling, handle time-sensitive requests, and make any necessary adjustments.

 **Benefits**  
  
What do we offer

* Competitive salary
* Company offsites
* Remote work
* High ownership, high-impact role

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager (Remote)
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
==============

Join a team that puts its People First! Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. As part of our Performance Marketing Center of Excellence (CoE), the Marketing Operations Manager ensures the integrity of our marketing data, systems, and performance measurement. You will own the operational foundation that makes every marketing dollar accountable—driving consistency in tracking, reporting, and governance while enabling the team to scale. A key part of this role is unifying data across disparate systems into a trusted, single view of marketing performance, ensuring accuracy and availability for decision-making  
  
As a people leader, you will coach and develop talent while building scalable processes to support future team growth. By pairing strong leadership with operational rigor, you’ll help position the CoE as a trusted growth engine for the business.

**Tracking & Attribution**

**Reporting & Dashboards**

**Testing & Incrementality**

**Process & Governance**

* Establish and enforce data quality standards across all performance marketing activities.
* Create governance frameworks for routing, QA, and reporting accuracy.
* Continuously optimize processes to improve efficiency and scalability.

Fluency with marketing operations and analytics tools, including:

jobs.title: Receptionist/Administrative Assistant Sales and Marketing
jobs.description:
**Fair warning: this is not a “sit at the desk” job.**

At 9am you might be checking in a patient who’s nervous about their first treatment. At 10:30 you’re on the phone with a doctor’s office about an order. By noon you’re picking up dry ice because a shipment goes out today. By 3 you’re posting on Instagram or updating a page on our website. Next month? You could be at a conference, shaking hands with med spa owners who want what we’ve got.

If that sounds chaotic, this isn’t your job.

If that sounds *fun*, keep reading.

**Who we are**

The Stem Cell Club helps people dealing with joint pain, injuries, and life’s wear and tear explore regenerative medicine. ATOM Stem Cells, our sister company, supplies stem cell products to clinics across the country.

Same team. Two companies. Growing fast in Vegas, St. George, and nationwide.

**The hats you’ll wear**

* **Patient Hat.** Answer calls and texts, call back new leads, greet patients, check them in and out, and follow up after treatment so nobody feels forgotten.
* **Computer Hat.** Keep patient records spotless in our CRM, confirm appointments, and track follow-ups. If it’s not in the system, it didn’t happen.
* **Social Media Hat.** Create and post content on our social channels. Patient stories (with permission), behind-the-scenes moments, and stuff from our content calendar.
* **Website Hat.** Update pages, put up new content, and help build out websites as we grow.
* **Doctor Hat.** Visit with physicians and partner clinics, help with ATOM orders, and be the friendly face of the brand.
* **Logistics Hat.** Dry ice runs, shipment prep, and making sure the cells get where they need to go, cold and on time.
* **Road Trip Hat.** Conferences, trade shows, and meetings with med spas and clinics.
* **Whatever’s Next Hat.** We’re growing, and new hats show up every month. You’ll get first dibs.

**Don’t know how to do half of that? Good. Neither did we.**

We’ll train you on all of it: the CRM, social media, websites, the products, the science. You don’t need to show up knowing everything. You need to show up willing to learn it.

**What we can’t train**

A smile. A good attitude. The kind of person who’s genuinely happy to be here.

That’s the whole job, honestly. Our patients are often in pain and nervous, and a warm, happy face at the front desk changes their entire experience. Doctors and clinics feel it too. Skills we can teach. Happy, we hire.

**Let’s be real about the pace**

It gets busy. Phones ring, shipments are due, a patient needs something *right now*. Some days are stressful.

But here’s how we see it: it’s just work. We take care of people seriously, and we don’t take ourselves too seriously. Nobody here is going to lose their mind over a missed call. We figure it out, we laugh about it, and we keep moving.

**You’ll crush it here if you…**

* Smile without being told to (people can hear it on the phone, too)
* Say “I’ve got it” before anyone asks
* Can switch from a patient to a physician to a FedEx counter without missing a beat
* Love learning new things, especially tech
* Want to grow *with* a company, not just collect a paycheck from one
* Have a sense of humor (required, non-negotiable)

**You won’t love it here if you…**

* Think “that’s not my job” is a complete sentence
* Need every day to look the same
* Let a busy day ruin your whole week

**What you get**

* Full training on everything: CRM, social media, websites, products, and more
* A real shot at growing into a bigger role as we expand. The people who start here are the ones who’ll lead later.
* A front-row seat to one of the fastest-moving fields in medicine
* A small team where your work actually gets noticed

**Nice to have (not required):** medical office or front desk experience, bilingual English/Spanish

**How to apply**

Send your resume or call us.

Pay: $15.00 - $22.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Social Media Specialist
jobs.description:
Social Media Specialist at Ink'd Stores

Location: Foxborough, MA studio / Hybrid  
Type: Full-time

**Who we are**

Ink'd makes custom merch, from people who care.

We do custom apparel, company merch stores, and kits for brands like DoorDash and Crocs, plus 1,000+ companies, schools, and nonprofits. Everything gets spec'd, printed, packed, and shipped from our own floor in Massachusetts. We've printed more than a million items, we hit 99.8% of our dates, and every box ships with a handwritten note and a little duck.

We started in 2015 as a 45-day pop-up and stayed for years. No shortcuts. We just kept picking up the phone. We don't do "swag for the sake of swag." We make things people actually want to wear.

**The role**

You'll be the voice of Ink'd online. Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok and everything else: the content, the calendar, the community and the paid ads. You'll turn a busy print floor and a 10-year founder story into posts that get people to stop scrolling, and you'll turn those posts into leads.

This is not a "schedule three posts a week" job. It's for a hungry self-starter who wants to own a channel, ship fast, learn faster, and see their work show up in the pipeline. Early-career candidates are welcome. We care about drive and talent more than years on a résumé.

**What you'll do**

Own the feeds. Plan and run the content calendar on Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and TikTok (X and YouTube too). Every channel gets its own voice, and all of it sounds like Ink'd.

Make the content. Shoot and edit short-form video and photos on the floor: presses running, kits getting packed, logos on Lululemon and Patagonia, finished drops landing. Write captions that sound like a person, not a promo catalog.

Run the ads. Build, launch and optimize paid social campaigns (Meta, plus LinkedIn as we grow) aimed at the people who buy merch: HR, people-ops, marketing and office leaders. Test, read the numbers, cut what's not working and scale what is.

Tell the story. Turn Jay's Blog, client wins, new-hire kits and seasonal drops into posts, reels and carousels.

Work LinkedIn. Grow the company page and help amplify the founder's voice where our B2B buyers actually spend their time.

Listen and engage. Reply to comments and DMs, watch what competitors and the promo industry are doing, and spot trends early.

Measure everything. Track reach, engagement, traffic and leads with native analytics and Google Analytics. Report what worked, what didn't, and what you'll try next.

Keep it on-brand. Work with our team on messaging, client features, and protecting our reputation online.

**What you bring**

Real social media experience: a brand, a business, a club, a creator account, or your own feed with results you can show us.

A strong eye for short-form video and the ability to shoot and edit it yourself (CapCut, Premiere, Final Cut, or similar).

Tight, punchy writing. You can say it in five words when everyone else uses twenty.

Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, or the drive to get great at it fast.

Comfort with numbers. You know what CTR, CPM and CPL mean and you care when they move.

Ownership. You see something that needs doing and you do it without being asked.

Speed and organization. You can juggle a calendar, a shoot and an ad test in the same week.

**Nice to have**

Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) and/or Canva

A scheduling tool such as Hootsuite, Buffer, Later or Meta Business Suite

LinkedIn Ads and B2B social experience

SEO basics and social listening tools

Experience working with influencers or creators

Some familiarity with apparel, merch, printing or e-commerce, or just a love for good gear

**Why join**

You own it. Your ideas go live fast, and you'll see exactly what they do for the business.

There's a lot to film. Presses, embroidery, a million-plus items, and brands like Patagonia, Vuori and YETI coming off our floor.

Real people. A small, close team where everybody picks up the phone and owns the details.

Room to grow. We're growing, and the right person can grow this role into more.

Ink'd Stores is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds.

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

**Skills and Competencies:**

Bizzabo is the Event Experience Operating System for modern enterprise organizations, and the intelligence behind every great event. Corporate event teams use Bizzabo to run complex event portfolios across in-person, virtual, webinar, and field events, unify their data, and prove the business impact of every event they run.

We've powered more than 100,000 events for millions of attendees. We're a Leader in the Forrester Wave for B2B Event Management Technology and the only vendor in that evaluation named a Customer Favorite. Founded in 2011, we're headquartered in New York with offices in Montreal, Kyiv and Tel-Aviv.

The category is changing fast. Event teams are being asked to run more programs with fewer people and prove revenue impact on every one of them, and AI is reshaping what an event platform should do. We're building for that future, and we need someone to tell that story.

**About the role**

You'll own how Bizzabo is understood: by buyers, by our sales team, by analysts, and by the AI agents our own teams now work with every day.

This is a lead role with real scope. You'll own positioning, messaging, launches, competitive strategy, sales enablement, and analyst relations for the full Event Experience OS, including the agentic capabilities we're bringing to organizers, attendees, and sponsors. You'll sit at the intersection of Product, Sales, Account Management, and Marketing, and you'll report directly to our Co-founder and CMO.

We're looking for a builder. You'll have strong partners across Brand, Demand Generation, and Enablement, but no layers between you and the work. If you want to shape a category, not maintain someone else's messaging deck, this is the role.

You'll also get to work the way we work. Claude is part of everyone's day at Bizzabo. Our teams use Claude and Claude Cowork daily, with Skills built on our own messaging, product, and competitive knowledge, and you'll have the freedom to automate anything that slows you down.

**﻿What success looks like**

In your first 90 days:

* You've listened to dozens of sales calls, interviewed customers and lost prospects, and can explain in plain words why we win and why we lose.
* You've refreshed our core competitive materials and the field is using them in live deals.
* You've taken ownership of our next analyst evaluation and our peer review strategy.

* Our competitive win rate is measurably higher, and you can show which of your work moved it.
* Every major release goes to market with a clear story, trained reps, and customer adoption plans.
* Our analyst and peer review position reflects where the product actually is.
* The messaging that powers our people and our AI agents is sharp, current, and trusted across the company.

* Strong sales enablement instincts. You build narratives and assets that get used in the field, and you know how to check that they do.
* Hands-on experience with analyst relations, ideally including a Forrester Wave or Gartner Magic Quadrant evaluation.
* Excellent writing. You make complicated things simple without making them generic.

jobs.title: Community & Brand Manager
jobs.description:
**Community & Brand Manager**
=============================

**Company:** CyberNut

**Reports to:** CEO and VP of Marketing

**Location:** Los Angeles preferred (in-office; finding someone in LA is our ideal scenario). Remote within the US considered.

**Travel:** Frequent travel across the country to customer sites, school districts, and K-12 conferences

**Type:** Full-time

**About CyberNut**
------------------

CyberNut is a fast-growing K-12 cybersecurity startup protecting more than 1 million students and staff across hundreds of school districts. Schools are one of the most targeted sectors for phishing and ransomware, and most security training was built for corporate boardrooms, not classrooms. We built CyberNut for schools.

Our platform trains teachers, staff, and students to spot phishing, scams, and account compromise as they happen, not once a year. Districts get automated, always-on phishing simulations themed to the tools schools actually use, one-click threat reporting right from the inbox, and short, gamified lessons that take minutes instead of hours. Our squirrel mascot, acorn rewards, and school leaderboards have turned security training into something staff and students actually talk about.

**About the role**
------------------

We are looking for a Gen Z or millennial content creator who lives on social media and wants to build a brand people genuinely root for. You have native experience building, publishing, and creating content on TikTok, Instagram, and LinkedIn, and you know what makes people stop scrolling.

This is a boots-on-the-ground role at a fast-growing startup. You will travel around the country to meet our districts, show up at conferences, film content on site, and turn customer love into customer engagement. You will be part community builder, part brand ambassador, and the voice and face of CyberNut on social.

Why it exists: many of our districts like the brand as much as they use the platform. Leaderboards get posted, swag gets worn at conferences, and IT directors call themselves "a CyberNut school." Nobody on the team is accountable for growing that energy on purpose. This role owns it.

You will report directly to our CEO and our VP of Marketing, and work closely with Customer Success.

**What you will own**
---------------------

Your time will split roughly across three areas: brand activation (about 35%), community and engagement (about 35%), and brand, social media, and content (about 30%). The split will flex by quarter.

### **1. Brand activation in every district**

Buying CyberNut is not the same as being a CyberNut school. Activation is the work of making the brand visible, felt, and owned inside a district, and it looks different for a 2,000-student rural district than for a 40,000-student suburban one.

* Build an activation plan for every new customer during onboarding, alongside their Customer Success Manager: who the champion is, where the brand will show up (staff kickoff, hallways, the IT newsletter, the board meeting), which program launches first, and what the district will be proud of in 90 days.
* Track the activation level of every existing account (dormant, launched, visible, owned), review the lowest tier with Customer Success each month, and bring a plan to move each account up.
* Create and ship the activation kit: launch decks for staff meetings, mascot and poster assets, leaderboard displays for IT offices and staff lounges, email templates for superintendents and principals, and swag for the first winners.
* Run the launch moment. The first leaderboard reveal or the first trophy delivery should be an event, not an email.
* Tailor the plan to each district. A single champion IT director needs a different plan than a district with a cabinet-level sponsor. The goal is the same: staff say "we're a CyberNut school" without being prompted.

### **2. Community and engagement**

* Run competitive leaderboard programs across customers: district vs. district, school vs. school, department vs. department. For example, a fall "Phish Bowl" where 25 districts compete on report rate for six weeks, with sponsored prizes and a trophy that travels.
* Design and ship recurring promotions and events: Cybersecurity Awareness Month kits, end-of-year awards, a "first 90 days" challenge for new customers, and a winter swag drop for top performers.
* Build and host customer community calls to learn which gamification loops drive the most excitement and engagement: a customer call where IT directors share what worked, and an online community space.
* Partner with Customer Success on low-engagement accounts. When participation is flat, you bring the activation play (a leaderboard launch, a principal challenge, a superintendent shout-out) instead of another reminder email.
* Make engagement visible outside the district. A school that climbs the leaderboard sees itself celebrated on CyberNut's channels the same week.

### **3. Brand ambassador, social media, and content**

You own CyberNut's social channels. We want CyberNut showing up everywhere: TikTok, Instagram, and LinkedIn. What Duolingo did with its owl, we want you to help us do with our squirrel.

* Own the company social accounts on TikTok, Instagram, and LinkedIn with a weekly content calendar you run. Marketing sets brand guidelines and campaign priorities; you create, film, and publish the day-to-day content, about 4 to 5 posts a week, most of them built from what customers are doing.
* Bring the CyberNut squirrel to life as a personality people follow, with recurring formats, trends, and moments that make the mascot recognizable well beyond our customers.
* Get on camera. Film on site at districts and conferences, try new formats, and do fun, creative things that push the brand forward.
* Own the swag program end to end: what we make, who earns it, how it ships, and the budget. Think limited editions for top performers and referrers, not giveaways for everyone.
* Show up at regio

jobs.title: Channel Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Chervon is one of the world’s largest power tool and outdoor power equipment manufacturers with a rich history of innovation. Chervon’s commitment to build a better world by building better tools is evident in the products we manufacture and our green approach to manufacturing. We design, engineer and market power tools and outdoor power equipment within our brand portfolio- EGO, FLEX and FLEX and for other highly respected private brands. With world-class R&D, design, manufacturing, supply chain, marketing, sales, and service teams throughout the world, we do it all.

**Summary of Responsibilities**

The Channel Manager is responsible for driving profitable share growth across the entire market by managing the development of the channel harmonization strategies. This includes developing pricing and promotional strategies across channels that deliver top line sales and bottom-line profit with efficient utilization of working capital.

Brand Responsibility: EGO

Channel Responsibility: Key Channels including Home Centers, Hardware, Construction Supply, STAFDA, and E-Commerce.

**Key Job Responsibilities**

*National Promotions*

* Develop and execute the promotional strategy to drive demand and share gains for our national brands and minimize channel conflict.
* Develop a Pro Forma based approach to analyze promotional plans.
* Develop reporting to manage, track and analyze key data to measure promotional effectiveness and set KPIs.
* Attend product line reviews with major channel partners to strategize and present Chervon’s national and channel specific strategies.
* Analyze and track inventory, market share and competitive landscapes.

*Channel Promotions*

* Work with channel/customer to identify, develop, and implement channel/customer specific programs – channel promotions, strategic programs, events, etc.
* Support promotional plans to manage excess inventory at a customer level.
* Review Pro Forma financials, discuss channel conflicts and work through solutions with Sales, Brand and Product Development teams.

*Product Pricing Strategy*

* Determine market-based pricing strategies to stimulate sales to maximize share while managing profitability and channel harmonization.
* Align with Brand Managers and Product Management to ensure the right selection, positioning and pricing strategy for current products and new product launches at a SKU level.
* Work with the back-end Brand Business Management (BBM) team and senior leadership teams to create a Pro Forma reporting to analyze pricing scenarios.
* Monitor online marketplaces via third party vendor to protect the integrity of our brands in the digital space.
* Manage price changes as necessary driven by current business conditions from inflation to tariffs, from freight expense to competitive threats.
* Work with BBM team develop pricing files for all brands, including MSRPs; troubleshoot anomalies.
* Work with BBM team to maintain channel price files.
* Align with Sales teams and Back End Account Management (BEAM) teams in Nanjing, China on pricing direction, alignment and execution.

*Marketing Support*

* Align pricing and promotional strategies with Brand Managers.
* Working with the Brand Management teams, support the planning and marketing execution to drive the promotional success both online and in-store.

**Required Education and Experience**

* A bachelor's degree in business or equivalent and at least 5 years of proven success as a channel manager, account manager, or other related experience.
* Experience in building and successfully executing product pricing strategies within the retail environment
* Appreciates and thrives within an entrepreneurial environment
* Experience with sales performance metrics reporting and analytics
* Excellent communication skills
* Team management skills
* Strong analytical and organization skills
* Fluency in key business measures – sales, gross margin, etc.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects
* Salary Range: $115k to $145k base + bonus opportunity

**Travel**

This position requires up to 15% travel. International travel may be required on occasion.

**Work Environment**

Chervon North America operates in a casual and fun environment. Our North American headquarters is located one block from I-88 in a state-of-the-art LEED certified facility with high-end amenities such as a gourmet café, gym, outdoor terrace, landscaped patio, ergonomic height-adjustable desks, and open collaborative spaces. We offer a very competitive benefits package including health, dental, vision, short/long-term disability, life insurance, parental leave, a generous 401(k) match, an open PTO program and a hybrid work environment.

*We think Chervon is a great place to work! Be part of our new future!* ***Better Tools. Better World.***

Chervon North America, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer committed to hiring a diverse workforce. We consider all applicants for employment without regard to race, age, religion, color, marital status, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, gender, pregnancy, military status, order of protection status, transgender status, genetic information, or any other category protected by law.

We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

  
  

**About the Role**

McKesson Medical-Surgical is seeking a **Senior eCommerce Brand Manager, Private Label** to join our Consumer Markets team. You will lead the commercial strategy and performance of a portfolio of private label health care products across Amazon, online marketplaces, and other consumer-facing ecommerce channels.

This highly visible individual contributor role owns the end-to-end business performance of the portfolio, including growth, assortment, and listing strategies, product launch planning, profitability, and strong cross functional coordination of marketplace execution.

The ideal candidate brings deep Amazon and marketplace expertise, strong business acumen, and a proven track record of scaling brands across ecommerce channels through data-driven decision making.

Working cross-functionally with Marketing, Pricing, Supply Chain, Product Development, Operations, and Marketplace teams, you will identify and lead the go to market plans to drive profitable growth.

This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of McKesson's private label consumer business during a period of brand evolution.

  
  

**What You'll Do**

**Drive Private Brand Growth & Own Performance**

* Serve as the commercial owner for a portfolio of private label products across Amazon, marketplaces, and other ecommerce channels.

* Develop and execute growth strategies that balance revenue, profitability, market share, consumer demand, and long-term brand health.

* Lead financial forecasting, business reviews, performance reporting, and identification of risks and opportunities.

* Deploy Amazon expertise to lead as project owner supporting a large product rebranding effort delivering a coordinated ecommerce approach to drive and grow the new brand as a 3P seller

* Evaluate assortment, pricing, promotional effectiveness, and channel performance to maximize growth and profitability

* Assess commercial tradeoffs and recommend investments, pricing changes, promotional activity, assortment optimization, and portfolio priorities.

**Lead Go-to-Market Execution Cross functionally**

* Lead cross-functional stakeholders and drive alignment of go to market initiatives within a matrixed organization.

* Identify expansion opportunities rooted in analytics, competitive intelligence, and consumer trends.

* Provide direction to teams by identifying products and categories with the greatest growth potential.

* Support product lifecycle management and commercialization activities across ecommerce channels.

* Ensure products are competitively positioned with clear consumer value propositions and effective pricing architecture in partnership with the Pricing team.

* Develop launch strategies including positioning, pricing, content requirements, inventory readiness, and success metrics.

* Partner with Marketing teams to drive advertising, customer acquisition, promotional, and brand-building initiatives.

* Collaborate with Marketplace and Listing teams to improve search visibility, conversion, digital shelf performance, and key programs.

* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Operations partners to ensure inventory availability, launch readiness, and business continuity.

**Deliver Insights & Influence Decisions**

* Leverage marketplace analytics, search insights, syndicated data, and internal reporting to create actionable commercial plans and make strategic decisions

* Develop executive-ready business reviews, presentations, and strategic recommendations.

* Monitor competitive activity, marketplace trends, and consumer behavior to identify growth opportunities.

  
  

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Ecommerce, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

* 7+ years of experience in ecommerce, marketplace management, category management, brand management, merchandising, commercial strategy, or related disciplines.

jobs.title: Sr Brand Manager, Kit Kat Strategy & Growth
jobs.description:
**Location: Hershey, PA**

#### **Why Hershey:**

At The Hershey Company, our culture is rooted in purpose and inspired by Milton Hershey’s enduring vision that business should create opportunity for others. Through our commitment to corporate philanthropy, we create positive impact by supporting communities, helping children thrive, and operating as a business for good. This includes our deep and long standing partnership with Milton Hershey School, where we invest in education, workforce readiness, and hands on engagement to help students succeed beyond the classroom. Supported by strategic grantmaking, product donations, cross brand collaboration, and strong employee volunteerism, Hershey offers a place to work where making a difference—locally and globally—is part of how we do business every day.

**About The Hershey Company**
-----------------------------

The Hershey Company is an industry-leading snacks company known for making more moments of goodness through its iconic brands. With a strong portfolio across chocolate, confectionery, and salty snacks, Hershey delights consumers every day. Our beloved brands include Hershey’s, Reese’s, KitKat®, Dots Pretzels, Lesser Evil, Jolly Rancher, Twizzlers, Ice Breakers, and more.

  

At Hershey, we are committed to making a meaningful difference in the communities where we live, work, and do business. This commitment originated with our founder, Milton Hershey, and continues to shape who we are today.

  

Guided by our employee value proposition, Lead Today. Create Tomorrow, we empower our people to drive impact now while shaping what comes next. Our One Hershey mindset brings teams together across functions, geographies, and businesses, enabling us to operate with speed, collaboration, and shared purpose.

  

The Hershey Company is proud to be recognized as a top employer in the United States, reflecting our commitment to our people, culture, and purpose.

**How will you fit in the big picture?**
----------------------------------------

Kit Kat is one of the world’s most recognizable and distinctive brands, and this role will shape both what the brand stands for and how the business grows. As Senior Brand Manager, Kit Kat, you will be the vision maker and business leader for the brand, setting long-term ambition, strategic direction, creative expression, portfolio choices, and commercial growth agenda while protecting and strengthening brand health. You will serve as the creative tip of the spear, advancing Kit Kat through consumer-centric marketing, an insurgent mindset, and new ways of thinking that keep the brand relevant, distinctive, and impossible to ignore.

  

At the same time, you will own the performance narrative for the business, using rigorous tracking and analysis to identify opportunities, make clear choices, and drive action. You will offer portfolio oversight and influence the innovation pipeline, ensuring that near- and long-term growth opportunities are consumer-led, financially sound, and executable. You will serve as the brand voice in critical creative, media, portfolio, and investment decisions; lead the integrated agency team; oversee design evolution; and unlock incremental brand equity and demand through Away From Home, Seasons & Tentpoles, and other high-impact occasions. In close partnership with the Commercial team, you will ensure brand plans translate into compelling execution that converts at the moment of choice. This role calls for equal parts imagination, analytical rigor, and general management mindset: the ability to set an inspiring destination, mobilize the organization around it, and land the plane with disciplined execution and a keen sense of financial stewardship.

**What will you do?**
---------------------

* Define and champion the long-term vision, growth strategy, positioning, and business direction for Kit Kat, translating enterprise priorities, consumer insight, and marketplace dynamics into clear choices for the brand
* Lead portfolio strategy and management, making choices across formats, pack-price architecture, and channels to maximize sustainable growth and brand coherence
* Own brand health and equity, establishing the learning agenda and turning consumer, cultural, competitive, and marketplace signals into strategies that strengthen relevance and distinctiveness
* Serve as the creative tip of the spear, setting the creative ambition and leading insurgent-mindset marketing across Masterbrand equity and growth initiatives that make Kit Kat more distinctive, relevant, and iconic
* Lead the integrated agency team and partner with Creative, Media, and other cross-functional stakeholders to deliver breakthrough, insight-led work that connects strategy to execution and expands demand
* Act as the brand voice in critical creative, media, portfolio, and investment decisions, balancing brand-building impact, commercial priorities, marketing effectiveness learnings, and financial stewardship
* Own the brand’s performance narrative through disciplined tracking, business analysis, and forecasting; identify drivers, risks, and opportunities and mobilize cross-functional action to deliver business objectives
* Collaborate closely with the Commercial team to translate brand strategy and annual plans into customer- and channel-relevant programs, ensuring execution pulls through to drive conversion at the moment of choice.
* Unlock incremental brand equity and demand through Away From Home, Seasons & Tentpoles, and other strategic platforms, with clear success measures and disciplined resource allocation.

**Minimum Education & Requirements**
------------------------------------

**Experience:**

* 6+ years of relevant experience in Brand Management, Marketing, Innovation, Strategy, Media, or Creative
* Consumer Product experience required; food experience preferred
* Demonstrated experience building and deploying both long-term brand strategy and annual brand plans, grounded in consumer insight

The Marketing Coordinator takes ownership of a variety of projects and ensures work is completed accurately and on schedule while demonstrating the PrimeSource BluePrint.

Ensure materials arrive accurately and on time; coordinate post-event returns.

Master Data and SKU Management

Maintain accurate product master data and assist with the creation and setup of new SKUs.

Collect, enter, and validate product information, specifications, packaging, pricing, and other required data.

Maintain data accuracy and consistency across systems.

Label Management

Coordinate new labels and revisions to existing labels.

Reporting and Analytics

Create and maintain recurring sales and customer reports.

Provide sales representatives and leadership with requested data and analysis; support ad hoc reporting as needed.

Marketing Support

Support the Brand Manager with product launches, sales materials, customer communications, and other marketing initiatives.

Coordinate projects across departments and ensure deliverables are completed accurately and on schedule.

Assist with additional marketing and business needs as they arise.

**Qualifications**

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field preferred.

1–3 years of relevant experience in marketing coordination, sales support, product data management, or a related area.

Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

Familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite is a plus.

Comfortable working with data and learning ERP, label management, and product information systems.

Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across departments.

Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable working in a hands-on, fast-paced environment.

The ideal candidate is a highly organized, versatile team member who enjoys variety and takes ownership of getting things done. This individual is equally comfortable coordinating a trade show, setting up product data, maintaining labels, or preparing a sales report.

Working Hard: Take ownership of responsibilities, follow through on commitments, and deliver accurate work.

Working Smart: Use data, improve processes, and collaborate across departments to solve problems and reduce complexity.

Working Fast: Respond promptly, adapt to changing priorities, and keep projects moving while maintaining accuracy.

Winning Together: Clarify responsibilities, share information, support teammates, and recognize contributions to shared success.

jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world's relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

  

#### **You Will**

You will develop a global lifecycle and email marketing strategy that:

* Thinks like a customer, using merchant insights to help prospects solve their problems, improve their business and see the value of Afterpay and Cash App.
* Grows net new merchants through personalized nurture journeys that move prospects to opportunities and signed merchants.
* Gets new merchants set up and transacting as quickly as possible, then helps them adopt more of our products.
* Helps established merchants grow at scale, increasing transaction volume and engagement with Block.
* Delivers thought leadership, product releases, events and growth opportunities that increase merchant engagement, retention and lifetime value.
* Keeps merchants with us through churn prevention and winback programs.
* Sets lifecycle best practices so prospects and merchants are happy and succeed with Block.
* Uses AI to personalize content, sharpen segmentation, and speed up production and learning.

  

#### 

Day-to-day:

* Own the full prospect and merchant lifecycle across every segment, from small businesses to enterprise.
* Build global strategies but think regionally: get to know the needs of each market and adapt one global framework to fit them.
* Work with regional sales leaders to understand their needs, find gaps in the customer journey, and turn those insights into new journeys and improvements.
* Lead email for product go-to-market and thought leadership, partnering with Product Marketing, Content and regional teams.
* Own the email test roadmap: write hypotheses, run A/B and multivariate tests, and share what you learn across the team.
* Test and grow lifecycle channels and tactics beyond email.
* Set up regular reporting and feedback loops with sales and regional teams, showing how lifecycle programs affect pipeline, merchant transaction volume and retention.

  

#### **You Have**

* Minimum 5 years experience owning B2B lifecycle, email or CRM marketing, ideally for global, sales-led products serving businesses of all sizes.

* Hands-on Marketo experience building emails, nurture programs, dynamic content and audience segments.

* Experience designing, running and measuring lifecycle growth and testing strategies.

jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking an experienced results-driven Marketing Sales Representative to join our expanding company. The ideal candidate **must** possess a strong passion for sales, excellent communication skills, and a strategic mindset to develop new business opportunities while nurturing existing client relationships. This role offers an exciting opportunity to drive revenue growth through innovative marketing strategies and targeted sales efforts within a **highly** competitive **dental** environment. The successful candidate will be responsible for engaging potential clients, **vendors**, managing key accounts, and closing high-value **dental organizations** that align with **our** company objectives.

**This is a huge opportunity to join a highly reputable and ever growing full service dental lab to where you will be the face and voice for the whole team. Your passion and drive will determine the future that you are looking for.**

**Duties**

* Identify and pursue new business opportunities through targeted outreach, including warm calling and networking within the industry.
* Develop tailored sales proposals and conduct compelling presentations to prospective clients, emphasizing the value of our products and services.
* Manage and grow existing customer accounts by providing exceptional client relationship management and ongoing support.
* Negotiate contracts and close sales deals efficiently while ensuring mutual satisfaction and long-term partnerships.
* Collaborate with marketing teams to create strategic campaigns that enhance brand visibility and generate qualified leads.
* Utilize CRM (Customer Relationship Management) systems such as **ex: Salesforce (or compatible)** to track sales activities, analyze pipeline data, and forecast revenue targets accurately.
* **Maintain comprehensive knowledge of the lab, including new products, materials, software, orders and events that are benefits to our clients.**
* Meet or exceed established sales goals by applying strong negotiation skills, business development strategies, and market analysis techniques.

**Skills**

* Proven expertise in negotiation, deal closing, and B2B (business-to-business) sales within a corporate or enterprise setting.
* Strong background in marketing strategies **and social media.**
* Proficiency in CRM systems along with other sales management tools to manage customer accounts efficiently.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences.
* Demonstrated success in managing customer relationships, including account management and client communication.
* Ability to analyze market trends, identify growth opportunities, and develop strategic plans for business development.
* Experience in enterprise selling environments with a focus on managing large accounts and achieving high-value sales targets.
* Leadership qualities that foster collaboration within teams while independently driving sales initiatives forward.

Join us as we empower organizations through innovative solutions while advancing your career in a vibrant, fast-paced environment dedicated to excellence in performance!

Pay: From $18.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

* Associate (Required)

* Marketing: 1 year (Required)
* Social media marketing: 1 year (Required)

* Customer relationship management: 1 year (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 75% (Required)

jobs.description:
**Marketing Assistant to "The Gust Realty Team"**

CENTURY 21 Circle | Reports directly to: David Gust

**ROLE SUMMARY**

The Marketing Assistant is the Broker's dedicated, hands-on marketing partner and the operational engine behind every listing, client relationship, and event. This is a broad, multi-hat role: it spans MLS listing management, HOA and municipal coordination, showing and open house logistics, graphic design and print production, direct mail farming, social media, client database management, event planning, closing gifts, vendor coordination, and customer service on every transaction. The right candidate is highly organized, design-savvy, detail-driven, and comfortable owning the full process from gathering information to a closed, well-served client.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES – Hourly pay, 30+ hrs. per week.**

**Bilingual helpful but not required.**

**Documents & Electronic Signatures**

· Draft Listing Agreements, property disclosures and supporting C21Circle documents and send for electronic signatures if requested by Broker.

· Draft Offers to purchase; documents and send for electronic signatures if requested by Broker.

· Draft Complete Fully Executed Contracts and send for electronic signatures if requested by Broker.

· Draft Exclusive Buyer Representation Agreement’s, C21Circle document and send for electronic signatures if requested by Broker.

**Listing Launch & MLS Management**

· Research and gather all listing information and enter it accurately into the MLS and across all social media and marketing platforms.

· Build all MLS listing drafts and launch listings on the public MLS and/or private networks (e.g., office-exclusive or coming-soon listings).

· Serve as direct marketing support for the Broker on all listing activities.

**Property Research & Municipal Coordination**

· Identify and contact property management companies and homeowners’ associations (HOAs) to verify HOA details, including fees, rules, and amenities, so listings are marketed accurately.

· Identify and contact city and village Community Development departments to confirm parcel information and resolve other property-related questions or concerns.

· Contact villages and municipalities to confirm point-of-sale (presale) inspection requirements and coordinate any required reinspection’s after repairs.

**Showings & Open Houses**

· Schedule all open houses and ensure every host has directional signage, interior signage, and lead capture materials.

· Prepare homes for private showings with other brokers, including securing doors with an electronic lockbox (e.g., SentriLock) and placing interior signage that guides showings according to the seller's instructions.

**Marketing Design & Print**

· Design and print all marketing materials for active listings.

· Design and prepare listing presentation documents for home sellers.

· Design and prepare all buyer packets for buyer consultations.

**Farming & Direct Mail**

· Design and send quarterly mailings to the Broker's preferred farm areas, targeting recipients and messaging based on the time of year and current market needs.

**Digital Presence, Social Media & SEO**

· Manage the Broker’s business pages, primarily Facebook and Instagram, including posting all active listings.

· Manage the Broker's personal social media page and communication, maintaining and engaging his network of about 5,000 friends.

· Keep the Broker's personal and business pages connected and consistent, so his personal network supports the brokerage's marketing.

· Maintain and optimize the Broker Google Business Profile, grow the number of customer reviews, and respond to reviews to strengthen search visibility (SEO).

**Client Experience & Database**

· Maintain the master copy of the Broker's client records (database/CRM), keeping it accurate and current.

· Provide direct customer service to clients on every transaction.

· Manage all closing gifts for buyer and seller clients.

**Events & Client Appreciation**

· Coordinate, execute, and help host the “The Gust Realty Team” annual client events: a January client appreciation event, a St. Patrick's Day event, and a 4th of July parade event.

· For each event, secure vendors and party supplies, send Evite invitations, and manage RSVPs.

· Follow up after each event with thank-you notes and gift baskets.

**Vendor Coordination**

· Coordinate all listing staging consultations, professional photography, and any other professional services needed to get a listing live.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

*Suggested qualifications based on the duties above. The Broker may edit as needed.*

· Prior real estate marketing or brokerage support experience; working knowledge of the MLS strongly preferred.

· Strong graphic design skills for print and digital materials (flyers, mailers, presentations, buyer packets).

· Hands-on experience managing business Facebook and Instagram accounts.

· Exceptional organization and the ability to manage many listings, deadlines, and vendors at once.

· Polished, client-first communication and customer service skills.

· Comfort maintaining a client database/CRM with high accuracy.

· Self-starter who works independently and anticipates the Broker's needs.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

· Every new listing goes live quickly and accurately on the MLS, private networks, and social media, with photography, staging, and marketing materials ready.

· HOA details, parcel information, and municipal inspection requirements are verified up front, so listings are accurate and no compliance step delays a sale.
