jobs.title: EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT & MARKETING COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
Position Summary

Dr. Barbara Sharief DNP Inc., doing business as The Beauty and Balance Spot, is seeking a highly organized, dependable, detail-oriented, technologically proficient, and proactive Executive Assistant & Marketing Coordinator.

This individual will provide comprehensive administrative support to Dr. Barbara Sharief while assisting with daily business operations, scheduling, patient communications, marketing initiatives, social media management, financial reporting coordination, and office staff communications.

The ideal candidate must be capable of managing multiple priorities, working independently, anticipating needs, meeting deadlines, maintaining confidentiality, and ensuring that business operations run efficiently.

This position requires exceptional organizational skills, strong written and verbal communication abilities, proficiency with digital marketing platforms and artificial intelligence (AI) tools, and the ability to coordinate responsibilities across Dr. Sharief's professional commitments.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities1. Executive Scheduling and Calendar Management

* Maintain and coordinate Dr. Sharief's professional, business, clinical, and legislative calendars.
* Ensure there are no scheduling conflicts between Florida Senate responsibilities, medical office appointments, business meetings, and other professional obligations.
* Schedule, confirm, reschedule, and coordinate appointments, meetings, conference calls, and special events.
* Provide daily and weekly calendar updates, reminders, and appointment confirmations.
* Anticipate scheduling conflicts and proactively recommend solutions.
* Coordinate travel arrangements, including airline reservations, hotel accommodations, ground transportation, and itineraries.
* Maintain organized travel records and confirmations.
* Prepare briefing materials, meeting agendas, and other documents as requested.

2. Email Management and Executive Correspondence

* Monitor, organize, and prioritize designated business email accounts.
* Identify urgent communications requiring Dr. Sharief's attention.
* Draft professional emails, letters, memoranda, and business correspondence.
* Respond to routine administrative inquiries within established guidelines.
* Track outstanding correspondence and ensure timely follow-up.
* Prepare, transmit, and organize faxes, electronic documents, and other correspondence.
* Maintain accurate digital and physical filing systems.
* Ensure all correspondence is professional, grammatically correct, and consistent with the organization's standards.

3. Medical Office Coordination and Patient Follow-Up

* Maintain regular communication with office management, clinical staff, and nurse practitioners.
* Coordinate with APRN regarding clinical scheduling, patient follow-ups, and monthly promotional offerings.
* Assist with nonclinical patient communications and appointment coordination.
* Contact patients following appointments or treatments to check on their experience and assist with scheduling recommended follow-up visits.
* Maintain organized patient follow-up lists and appointment reminders.
* Help identify patients who are due for follow-up visits, repeat treatments, or scheduled services.
* Coordinate with clinical staff when patients report concerns requiring medical attention.
* Assist with patient retention initiatives and approved outreach campaigns.
* Maintain strict confidentiality of patient information and comply with HIPAA and applicable privacy policies.

**Important:** This position does not include independent clinical assessment, diagnosis, medical advice, or treatment recommendations. Clinical concerns must be referred to authorized healthcare professionals.

4. Social Media Management and Content Creation

* Develop, maintain, and implement a comprehensive 30-day social media content calendar each month.
* Create engaging promotional content highlighting medical services, wellness programs, aesthetic treatments, skincare products, and special offers.
* Use AI-assisted marketing platforms, including Marbalism and Blaze, to develop social media posts, captions, promotional materials, and marketing campaigns.
* Create and schedule content for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and other approved platforms.
* Develop content incorporating photographs, videos, promotional graphics, hashtags, and calls to action.
* Coordinate the collection and organization of photographs and videos for marketing purposes.
* Ensure that all marketing content is consistent with The Beauty and Balance Spot's brand identity.
* Monitor social media engagement and provide recommendations for improving audience reach.
* Maintain a consistent and professional online presence.
* Submit monthly content calendars and promotional campaigns for management approval before publication.

5. YouTube Channel Management and Paid Advertising

* Upload, organize, title, describe, and publish videos on company YouTube channels.
* Maintain YouTube channels, including playlists, descriptions, thumbnails, and channel information.
* Optimize video titles, descriptions, and keywords to improve search visibility.
* Promote approved videos and campaigns through YouTube and Google Ads.
* Boost approved social media posts on Facebook and Instagram using Meta advertising tools.
* Assist with creating and monitoring paid advertising campaigns.
* Track advertising performance, engagement, views, leads, and campaign effectiveness.
* Provide recommendations for improving advertising results and maximizing approved marketing budgets.
* Obtain management approval before launching or modifying paid advertising campaigns.

6. Monthly Specials and Promotional Campaigns

* Collaborate with Dr. Sharief and APRN to develop monthly promotional specials.
* Assist with planning promotions for laser hair removal, skincare, facial treatments, body contouring, wellness services, and retail products.
* Prepare promotional flyers, email

jobs.title: Creative Producer, Growth Marketing
jobs.description:
### **About AppLovin**

AppLovin makes technologies that help businesses of every size connect to their ideal customers. The company provides end-to-end advertising solutions for businesses to reach, monetize and grow their global audiences. For more information about AppLovin, visit: www.applovin.com.

To deliver on this mission, our global team is composed of team members with life experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives that mirror our developers and customers around the world. At AppLovin, we are intentional about the team and culture we are building, seeking candidates who are outstanding in their own right and also demonstrate their support of others.

**About the role**
------------------

We are looking for a Growth Marketing Creative Producer to lead the execution and delivery of marketing creatives.

In this role, you'll partner closely with Brand and Video Production teams to lead creative strategy and production. You'll own the pipeline from creative brainstorming through final delivery for ads to run across brand and performance marketing campaigns. This isn't about making one perfect ad. It's about building a creative machine that feeds our growth with constant testing and iteration.

We want clever ideas, rapid experimentation and consistent excellent ad quality. If you live and breathe performance creative, understand what makes B2B advertising work, and move fast, this role was built for you.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Own static and video creative production.** Produce creative to run across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, Twitter, CTV, OOH, and other networks.
* **Ideate and pitch.** Research and pitch creative concepts that align with our marketing plans.
* **Stay true to the brand.** The guidelines are the frame, and your job is to make the strongest ads possible inside it.
* **Build media packs and manage vendors.** Develop a media pack for each campaign to share with vendors for ad production.
* **Own ad quality.** Hold every ad to a high standard and make sure AppLovin is presented appropriately.
* **Develop or source the materials you need.** Work closely with our video production team and external vendors to get the footage you need. You source 100% of the material you need. Sometimes that means creating the work yourself with design tools and AI, sometimes it means handing it to a vendor. You decide the fastest path to the assets each ad needs.
* **Keep the pipeline full and moving.** Guide approved projects through production and final delivery while managing multiple timelines at once. While one campaign is in production, you're already strategizing the next creative delivery, planned against our marketing calendar and key seasonal moments.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

jobs.title: Paid Media Lead
jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

*Client Strategy & Relationships*

* Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
* Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
* Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
* Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
* Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
* Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

*Paid Media Performance*

* Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
* Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
* Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
* Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
* Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

*Copy & Creative Strategy*

* Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
* Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
* Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
* Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
* Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

*Tracking & Funnel Execution*

* Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
* Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
* Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
* Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

  
**Requirements**  

* 5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility

* Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
* Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
* Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
* Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
* Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
* Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Experience**

* Financial services marketing
* Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
* Video sales letter marketing
* High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
* Performance marketing agency experience
* Direct-response advertising

**NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)** Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

 **Benefits**  

* Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays

* Training & Development
* Work From Home
* Flexible Schedule
* Performance Bonus

**Who are we?**

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing American companies since 2008.

**About the role**

Smarsh is looking for a Senior Marketing Analyst to build the data foundation that marketing and go-to-market (GTM) teams run on — and that our AI tools will increasingly depend on. AI assistants and agents can only answer revenue questions reliably when the data model beneath them is clean, governed, and well defined. This role owns that layer for marketing: from source-system connectors and Snowflake, through dbt models and a governed semantic layer, to the dashboards, analysis, and AI-driven insight that leadership uses to make decisions.

You'll set the measurement and data roadmap, not just execute against it. You'll partner with Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, Sales/Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and IT/Data Architecture, and you'll be a trusted analytical partner to marketing and GTM leadership on planning, pipeline, and growth strategy.

### **How will you contribute?**

**AI-ready data foundation**

* Design and build an AI-ready data foundation for marketing and GTM: governed dbt models and a semantic layer (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, Omni) with consistent metric definitions that both people and AI tools can query.
* Prioritize foundation domains in partnership with RevOps and IT — starting with marketing performance and attribution, and connecting to pipeline, account hierarchy, and customer retention data.
* Build validation and testing frameworks (data tests, reconciliation checks, and accuracy evaluation of AI-generated answers) so AI assistants and agents return answers leadership can trust.

* Model account hierarchies and lead-to-account matching so marketing engagement rolls up correctly to accounts, buying groups, and opportunities.

**Measurement, attribution & analytics**

* Lead ABM measurement: account engagement scoring, buying-group coverage, intent-to-pipeline conversion, and target-account progression.
* Go beyond descriptive reporting — apply cohort analysis, funnel velocity, incrementality/test-and-control design, and forecasting to answer "what's working, and what should we do next?"
* Analyze campaign and channel performance (organic search, paid search, paid social/ABM, display, email, events, field) and deliver prioritized recommendations on budget and program mix.

**Strategy, reporting & stakeholder leadership**

* Partner with marketing and GTM leadership on annual planning, pipeline targets and coverage, growth strategy, and operating cadences, bringing the analysis that grounds those decisions.
* Build and own executive-grade dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Looker, Tableau, Omni) reconciled against Salesforce and finance data, and own the analytics behind monthly/quarterly business reviews and QBRs.
* Define and govern a single set of marketing metric definitions (MQL/MQA, SAL, pipeline sourced vs. influenced, CAC, ROI) and drive adoption across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.
* Set and maintain the marketing analytics roadmap: prioritize requests, balance ad hoc work against foundational builds, and communicate trade-offs.

**Data quality, governance & enablement**

* Establish data quality standards and automated checks across CRM, marketing automation, and the warehouse; fix root causes rather than patching symptoms.
* Ensure marketing data and AI use align with Smarsh data privacy, security, and governance requirements in partnership with Legal, Security, and IT.
* Mentor analysts and Marketing Operations teammates on SQL, dbt, data modeling, and responsible use of AI in analytics.

### **What will you bring?**

* 5+ years of experience in GTM, marketing, or revenue operations analytics, or business intelligence, ideally in B2B SaaS or technology.
* Advanced SQL and hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse (e.g., BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks), including designing data models, not just querying them.
* Hands-on dbt experience building production-grade, tested, documented models.
* Experience building or governing a semantic or metrics layer (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, Omni, or a BI-native equivalent).

* Expert BI skills in at least one major platform (e.g., Power BI, Looker, Tableau, Omni, Hex), including governed, self-serve dashboard design.

GO Car Wash opened its first tunnel in 2019 with one goal: to create a better car wash experience rooted in community, powered by people, and built on trust. Today, we're one of the fastest-growing car wash companies in the country, with 156 sites across 10 states — and we're just getting started. Our culture is fast-paced, energetic, and built on five core values: teamwork, integrity, caring, fun, and continuous improvement. We're looking for people who are energized by growth, take pride in their work, and genuinely enjoy the ride.

***POSITION:*** Marketing Operations Manager
  
***POSITION REPORTS TO:*** Chief Marketing Officer

***LOCATION:*** Remote position with up to 15% travel within the US. Preferred locations include Kansas City, New York, Austin, and San Antonio due to travel requirements and proximity to major airports. Candidates must reside in Kansas, Missouri, New York, or Texas.

***JOB DESCRIPTION***  
The Marketing Operations Manager is the engine behind GO's marketing team — the person who makes things happen. You'll own the coordination, execution, and follow-through that keep campaigns, field programs, and launches running on time and on brand. This role touches everything: cross-functional teams, vendors, field operators, and leadership. The ideal candidate doesn't wait to be told what to do — they figure out what needs to happen and make it happen. If you're energized by variety, ownership, and solving problems in a fast-moving environment, this role was built for you.

***WHO THRIVES HERE***  
This role works best for someone who's energized by variety, comfortable switching from a vendor call to a field escalation to a creative review — sometimes all before lunch. You'll have real autonomy and ownership, but you'll also need to build trust quickly across teams that move fast. If you do your best work when you have clear problems to solve and the freedom to solve them your way, you'll fit right in here.

***JOB RESPONSIBILITIES***  
PROJECT MANAGEMENT & EXECUTION

**About AIOS**
==============

**AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.**  
We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $10M/yr 12 months ago. We’re the world’s fastest growing AI doctor.  
We’re faithfully serving >150k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’re profitable.  
Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

* The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.
* The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

* **Step 0 $100M/yr by end of 2025**: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.
* **Step 1 $1B ARR by end of 2026**: Over the last 12 months we’ve grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.
* **Step 2 $10B ARR by end of 2028**: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.
* **Step 3 $100B/yr by end of 2031**: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.
* **Step 4 $1T/yr by end of 2035**: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.  
We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

**Being a Senior Media Buyer at AIOS**
--------------------------------------

We are building a world-class team.

As Senior Media Buyer (Paid Search) at Aios, your mission is to unlock Google as a major growth channel, taking it from a small share of our paid mix today to a mature, scaled second engine that runs alongside Meta.

Google is our biggest under-tapped opportunity. Non-brand spend today is small relative to what the account can support, and our plan is to close the gap to Meta significantly across the year (>£1m/month).

Your job is to architect and drive that scale-up: growing spend profitably, without blowing out CAC, and without ever cutting corners on the strict ASA and CAP compliance rules that govern what we can say in ad copy (Rule 12.12 in particular).

Early on, you'll ramp into the accounts: current campaign structure, keyword strategy, tCPA dynamics, Search Abs Top IS, ad copy inside compliance constraints, feed setup on Shopping, and how each market behaves. As trust builds, you'll take on increasing ownership of the Google operation end-to-end.

This is not a strategy-only role. The work today is hands-on craft inside Google Ads. Over time, the ceiling is much higher: you'll lead the Google pod, take on EU markets as they launch (Germany, Netherlands, Portugal, Denmark, Sweden), and expand into adjacent channels as you earn the right.

Great performance means Google spend scales while CAC holds or improves, Search Abs Top IS climbs materially, tCPA campaigns get pushed to their real ceilings without breaking, new markets launch cleanly without hurting UK performance, compliance is never a firefight, and leadership trusts your forecasts more than their own intuition.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you'll work async in the timezone of your choice - as long as you're around for team calls (early PST).

You'll report directly to Dave Lane (Head of Performance).

You'll work most closely with:

* André Andrade - Creative Lead
* Michael McCann - Head of CRO
* Reinhardt Grobbelaar - Performance Associate

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Google Ads ownership: Over time, you operate the Google accounts day-to-day. UK is the core market and your priority today, with the rest of the EU on the cards this year. Search, Performance Max, Shopping, YouTube, Demand Gen. Keyword research, match type strategy, negatives, ad copy, extensions, feed hygiene, landing page alignment, daily optimisation.
* Profit-aware scaling: You push spend up while keeping tCPA / CAC inside target bands. You understand how to grow Search Abs Top IS through budget, bidding, and quality score. You know how to scale a tCPA campaign when actual performance is running well ahead of target without blowing out CACs.
* Compliance mastery & account resilience: You operate cleanly under ASA / CAP and GPhC rules, particularly Rule 12.12 (POMs cannot be advertised to the public). You never reference prescription medicines, named drugs, or use words like "medication" in ad copy. You maintain and evolve our MCC and account structures to keep them resilient against the unique compliance challenges of GLP-1 advertising.
* Multi-geo orchestration: You run multiple country accounts in parallel without dropping balls - different keywords, localised ad copy, different match type strategies, different compliance realities, different reporting cuts. You build the systems that make multi-geo manageable as it grows.
* Ad copy, feed and landing page craft: You write ad copy that converts inside tight character limits and strict compliance rules. You treat Bolt like an e-commerce product on Google Shopping, owning the product feed, data quality, and the ad-to-LP handoff.
* Team building: As we add more buyers alongside you and underneath you, you hire, mentor, and lead the Google pod. You build the bench that this hire is the seed of.

**Need to have**
----------------

* Proven Google scale (hands-on): You've personally operated Google Ads accounts at £1M+/month spend for DTC ecom brands, in the platform yourself every day. Not "led a team that did it." Not "oversaw an agency that did it." ***You*** did it.

jobs.title: Social Media Lead
jobs.description:
Role Overview

VERIA develops high-performance carry systems for work, commuting, travel and everyday use. We are seeking a Social Media Lead who can turn products and brand priorities into original, platform-native organic campaigns, direct the content-production vision and grow a meaningful consumer community. Own the organic social campaign process from strategy and concept to shoot direction, publishing and evaluation, while collaborating with Creative Strategy on the shared testing framework and coordinated production requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Social Media Strategy & Campaign Development

* Own the organic direction for each active platform. Build campaigns for product launches, collections, seasonal opportunities and ongoing brand storytelling; translate product priorities and audience insights into distinctive social-first concepts and launch plans.

Creative Direction & Content Production

* Develop campaign creative concepts, visual references, shoot strategies, shot lists, content briefs and production calendars. Lead creative direction at planned shoots, communicate the intended storytelling to photography and video partners, and review assets for quality and brand fit.

Platform Management & Community Growth

* Own daily publishing on every active platform, including platform-native adaptation, editorial scheduling, captions, community engagement, social listening and brand consistency. Build an engaged audience rather than optimizing solely for posting volume.

Performance Analysis & Organic Optimization

* Evaluate content, campaign and channel performance through reach, quality of engagement, audience development, retention and relevant business signals. Analyze what resonates, document learnings and refine platform strategy and future campaigns.

Campaign Execution & Cross-Functional Coordination

* Lead organic launch schedules and approved production resources, coordinate the social requirements of product launches, and work with Creative Strategy and UGC & Creator Partnerships on shared briefs, testing insights, creators and overlapping production needs.

What We’re Looking For

* Proven ownership of organic social strategy and campaign delivery for a DTC, e-commerce, lifestyle, fashion or consumer-products brand.
* Portfolio of complete campaigns or product launches showing original strategic contribution, creative direction, channel execution and measurable outcomes.
* Strong visual judgment, social-first storytelling, concept development, campaign planning and the ability to turn product use cases into engaging content.
* Experience creating shoot strategies, shot lists and actionable content briefs, and directing photographers, videographers or other production partners.
* Practical expertise with platform-native organic content, publishing cadence, editorial planning and community development across relevant social channels.
* Ability to interpret organic performance and audience behavior and convert learning into better content and campaigns.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with a performance Creative Strategist and creator partnerships team while retaining ownership of organic execution.

How Success Will Be Measured

* Distinctive social-first product launch and seasonal campaigns delivered to approved schedules, with coherent storytelling across active platforms.
* Clear, executable shoot concepts, production briefs and visual direction; finished assets reflect the intended product story and brand quality.
* Consistent daily publishing, thoughtful community management and strong platform-native content quality.
* Improvement in relevant organic reach, engagement quality, audience growth and campaign effectiveness, interpreted in context rather than judged on vanity metrics alone.
* Effective coordination of photography, video, UGC and Creative Strategy inputs with minimal avoidable rework or launch delays.

Why Join VERIA?

Lead the organic voice of a growing consumer brand whose products are designed for work, commuting and travel.

Take campaigns from launch concept and shoot direction through platform-native storytelling, community engagement and measurable results, alongside dedicated production partners.

Pay: $95,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have leading organic social media strategy for DTC, e-commerce, or consumer product brands?
* Have you independently developed and executed social media campaigns for product launches, including creative direction and content production planning?
* Have you directed professional photo or video production teams, including developing concepts, shot lists, and creative briefs?
* Can you provide a portfolio of social campaigns you personally led, including measurable organic performance results?

Work Location: Remote

jobs.description:
At the N2 Company, our vision is "*to be the most respected franchise in the nation, to share stories that build community, and to provide meaningful work for our team".*

**About Us**

The N2 Company is America's leading publisher of community magazines. We're proud of our award-winning media brands – they reach millions of readers in nearly every state and help great businesses connect with ideal clients – but we're even more proud to provide supportive and fulfilling remote work opportunities for our people.

  

**About The Role**

We're looking for a Marketing Campaign Specialist to turn reader interest into meaningful conversations with our Readership Engagement Specialists. You'll create and manage email, text, and social media campaigns that encourage readers to get involved with their community magazines. From building targeted audiences and crafting messages to testing campaigns and tracking results, you'll help turn interest into booked meetings.

Reporting to the Director of Content Operations, you'll work closely with our readership engagement and content teams to coordinate campaigns, support publication needs, and find ways to improve results. Your focus will be generating interest and scheduling conversations, while reader interviews and advertising sales are handled by their respective teams.

This role is fully remote. Interviews for this opening will be conducted over the phone and via video calls. The salary for this position is $50,000-$60,000 annually.

**The Role in Action**

* Create and manage reader outreach campaigns across email, text, and social media using tools like Instantly.
* Organize reader lists by publication and audience while maintaining accurate contact records and honoring consent and opt-out requests.
* Write engaging campaign messages and follow-ups that clearly explain the opportunity and how readers can participate.
* Set up and test campaign schedules, links, forms, and booking pages to ensure everything works properly before launch.
* Track campaign performance and test different audiences, messages, and timing to improve responses and booked meetings.
* Connect interested readers with the right Readership Engagement Specialist and provide the details needed for timely follow-up.
* Work with readership engagement and content teams to review results and improve meeting attendance, reader fit, and story opportunities.
* Maintain campaign settings and documentation, troubleshoot routine issues, and coordinate with Technology or vendors when additional support is needed.

**The Ideal Candidate**

We're looking for someone who will hit the ground running with:

* Experience creating and managing email, text, or social media campaigns.
* Familiarity with Instantly or similar email outreach tools and the ability to learn new platforms.
* Strong writing skills and a basic understanding of audience targeting, campaign testing, and email deliverability.
* Comfort using spreadsheets, reviewing campaign results, and maintaining contact records.
* Attention to detail when managing data accuracy, consent requirements, and opt-out requests.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns, communicate clearly with teammates, and troubleshoot common issues.

**Skills and Qualities that Set You Apart:**

* Put readers first with relevant, respectful invitations.
* Own the details and ensure campaigns are ready to launch.
* Keep improving through testing, tracking results, and trying new approaches.
* Support your teammates with clear, helpful handoffs.
* Take ownership of problems and follow through on solutions.

* Full **health care coverage** for you and your family.
* Complimentary basic **dental coverage**.
* Access to a **licensed nutritionist** to support your health and wellness goals.
* **Employee Assistance Program (EAP)** with complimentary mental health resources and additional support services.

* **Monthly remote-work reimbursement** to assist with home office and internet expenses.

#### **Additional Benefits**

* **Pet care insurance and discounts** to help support your pets' health and well-being.
* The opportunity to make a difference through **N2GIVES**, our program dedicated to fighting human trafficking and supporting other impactful causes.

jobs.title: Paid Media Strategist
jobs.description:
Location  
Fully Remote

Schedule  
Monday through Friday, US Eastern business hours - Monday to Friday, US Eastern business hours. In South Africa that is roughly 3pm to 11pm, and 4pm to midnight from November to March.

Compensation  
$2,500 to $3,500 USD per month, based on experience, with review at 90 days

Reports to  
Chief Marketing Officer

Engagement type  
Full-time independent contractor

**About RevSpark Media**  
RevSpark Media is a performance marketing agency built for healthcare and franchise brands. We're based in the US, specializing in health and medical clients, including men's health clinics, compounding pharmacies, med spas, and wellness practices. We build brand awareness and lead generation systems that turn qualified prospects into booked patients and customers.

**About the Role**  
As our Paid Media Strategist, you'll own the strategic and testing side of paid media across our client portfolio. You'll design the tests, define what success looks like before anything launches, call the results, and bring ideas for what we should be trying next. You'll work closely with our Meta and Google media buyers, setting the standards they execute against and providing technical direction on structure, targeting, and tracking. The buyers own their campaigns day to day. You own the methodology behind them and the strategic thinking that makes them better. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who thinks in tests and systems, not just campaigns. When an account needs it, you will get inside it yourself and diagnose the problem, not only set standards for others.

**Your First Focus**  
Much of our portfolio is a multi-location franchise network. Every location runs similar campaigns inside its own strict geographic territory, and every owner sets their own budget. Your first priority is Google efficiency across that network: finding where spend is wasted, diagnosing the locations that are underperforming, and turning what works in one territory into tests for the others.

**What You'll Do**  
**Testing Strategy**

* Design tests with a clear baseline, success metric, timeline, and decision point before launch.
* Call tests won, lost, or inconclusive, and communicate the reasoning.
* Maintain test documentation so results are traceable and repeatable across clients.
* Bring new testing ideas and hypotheses to the table, not just evaluate existing ones.

**Account Structure and Quality Standards**

* Set standards for Google account structure: match type strategy, negative keyword management, brand search handling, conversion tracking.
* Set standards for Meta: campaign architecture, audience hygiene, naming conventions, pixel and CAPI integrity.
* Audit accounts against those standards on a defined cadence.
* Catch tracking and attribution issues before they affect reporting accuracy.

**Strategic Direction**

* Provide technical direction to media buyers on structure, targeting, and bidding and budget approach.
* Review campaign builds against defined standards before launch.
* Recommend how each owner's budget should split across Google and Meta, and where to push or pull back, always within that owner's budget and territory.
* Share what's working across the portfolio so wins on one account inform others.

**Performance Analysis**

* Review performance across the portfolio to spot patterns individual accounts won't show.
* Partner with media buyers on diagnosis when an account needs a second set of eyes.
* Surface at-risk accounts early with a recommendation attached.
* Look past lead volume to lead quality, so spend goes toward leads that become booked patients.

**Client Support, As Needed**

* Join client calls that require senior paid media depth, particularly technical reviews and performance deep dives.
* Explain methodology, structure decisions, and test results to client-side stakeholders.

**Why Work With Us**

* Real ownership of testing strategy across a full portfolio, not one account.
* Work with capable, experienced media buyers on Meta and Google, plus designers, copywriters and account managers, so you are never a one-person team.
* Direct access to the CMO and influence over how we approach paid media.
* Variety across healthcare and franchise brands, including multi-location and territory-constrained accounts.

**What We're Looking For**

* Significant hands-on experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads at an agency or multi-account level.
* Demonstrated ability to structure and evaluate performance tests, not just run campaigns.
* Deep familiarity with Google account structure: match types, negative keywords, brand search, conversion tracking.
* A track record of bringing down Google cost per conversion in small or constrained geographic markets.
* Experience with conversion tracking and server-side event tracking, including Meta CAPI.
* Comfortable working across multiple ad accounts simultaneously.
* Able to explain technical decisions clearly to both non-technical stakeholders and sophisticated client-side counterparts.
* Strong written communication and documentation habits.

**Nice to have**

* Health, medical, or wellness advertising experience and familiarity with the associated compliance landscape.
* Experience with franchise or multi-location advertising, including geographic territory constraints.
* Familiarity with GoHighLevel.
* Experience mentoring or giving direction to other media buyers.

jobs.description:
At Colibri Group, culture is at the heart of everything we do. Our values Love, Joy, Boldness, Teamwork, and Curiosity guide how we work together, support our customers, and make a difference in the communities we serve.

Colibri Group is a leader in online professional education, serving more than one million learners each year across a family of trusted education brands. Our Teacher Education Ecosystem supports educators, school leaders, and partners through professional learning and meaningful experiences.

**Come Build What’s Next**

We’re looking for a Marketing & Events Coordinator to turn event plans into seamless, well-organized experiences for educators, school leaders, partners, and colleagues.

This is an individual-contributor role focused primarily on hands-on event coordination, with additional ownership of defined marketing projects. You will help plan and execute in-person conferences, school and partner visits, webinars, information sessions, and other events from timelines and vendors to registration, materials, on-site logistics, and post-event handoffs.

You should enjoy the behind-the-scenes work of making events happen: asking the next question, spotting what is missing, keeping people informed, and solving logistical problems before they affect an event. Strong event-coordination experience matters more here than familiarity with the education industry.

**What You’ll Do**

* Coordinate event execution from planning through follow-up: schedules, registration, vendors, conference booths, travel, shipping, event materials, run-of-show details, and lead handoffs
* Serve as a hands-on operational contact for assigned in-person conferences and events; coordinate with internal partners and external vendors, and provide on-site support when needed
* Support different event sizes and formats, including up to approximately three large B2B conferences annually, approximately five to seven school/partner visits, and recurring virtual events (generally one to two per month, in a supporting role)
* Build practical event playbooks, checklists, timelines, and repeatable processes; flag missing details, dependencies, and risks early
* Track event supplies, branded materials, inventory, vendor orders, expenses, invoices, and logistics so everything arrives where and when it is needed
* Coordinate assigned marketing and cross-functional projects in ClickUp or similar tools, keep ownership and deadlines visible, and support light marketing communications, editing, or quality checks as needed.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Approximately 1–3 years of relevant experience in event coordination, marketing operations, project coordination, or a related field. Relevant internships and comparable hands-on experience are welcome
* Direct involvement coordinating actual events, such as conferences, trade shows, webinars, school events, or partner experiences not simply attending them or promoting them
* Experience managing multiple moving pieces: timelines, vendors or stakeholders, registration, supplies, schedules, and last-minute changes
* Strong written and verbal communication, dependable follow-through, attention to detail, and confidence working across teams
* Comfort using project-management tools to track tasks and deadlines, or the ability to learn new systems quickly

**Helpful, but not required:** experience in education or EdTech; familiarity with ClickUp, Asana, or Monday.com; and a bachelor’s degree in a related discipline.

**Travel Requirements:** This is a remote position requiring up to 15 - 20% domestic travel to support national conferences, partner events, and occasional office visits. Travel will vary throughout the year, with periodic visits to our Washington, D.C. office (approximately 1–2 times annually).

**Tools, Platforms, and Methodologies You May Use**

Experience with every platform below is not required. What matters most is how you organize work, coordinate people, and carry events through execution.

* ClickUp or other project-management platforms (such as Asana or Monday.com)
* Event registration, webinar, scheduling, and lead-capture tools
* Shared event calendars, checklists, run-of-show documents, and vendor trackers
* Standard collaboration, documentation, and productivity tools

**What This Role Is Not**

* Not a personal assistant or an administrative catch-all for Marketing, Sales, or individual leaders
* Not primarily a social-media, creative-content, or campaign-strategy position
* Not a role focused only on planning ideas: it requires real follow-through on logistics and event execution
* Not 100% large, in-person events; the role also supports virtual events and selected marketing projects

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

* See the impact of your work in well-run experiences for educators, school leaders, alumni, and partners
* Gain ownership of meaningful event operations while building repeatable processes that make the team more effective
* Partner across Marketing, Sales, Academics, and other teams, with a mix of independent coordination and shared execution
* Join a mission-driven organization where your organization, initiative, and judgment make a visible difference

**We Encourage You to Apply**

You may not check every preferred box, and that is okay! We welcome applicants from corporate or nonprofit events, professional associations, school/program events, conferences, hospitality-related event operations, and similar hands-on coordination backgrounds.

However, this role does require concrete event-coordination experience, strong ownership of details, and willingness to travel. If your recent work has been focused exclusively on social media, content creation, or marketing strategy without coordinating event execution, this may not be the right opportunity.

If you enjoy turning “we should host an event” into a clear plan and a well-executed experience, we would love to hear from you.

*6-month self-employed probation, then a permanent employed role*

Strive Online is a UK Meta-ads agency for trades and home improvement businesses. We run their Facebook and Instagram ads, build their landing pages and send them booked quotes. We're a young but extremely ambitious company, having around 70 clients on monthly retainers and are growing fast with the goal over 100+ by end of year.

**The role**

You’ll run the day-to-day of the agency, so the founder can focus on sales and growth. You’ll own the team, client delivery and the systems that hold it together. This is a hands-on role: you’ll be in the systems, the client data and the team chats, not managing from a distance.

**How the role works**

* **6-month probation:** you work with us on a self-employed basis. You invoice monthly and handle your own tax and National Insurance.
* **After probation:** you move to a permanent, employed contract with PAYE, holiday pay and a workplace pension.

**What you’ll do**

*Team*

* Manage our media buyer, client success manager, Tech VA, sales setter and video contractors.
* Run team meetings, set priorities and hold people to deadlines.
* Help hire, onboard and train new team members as we grow.

*Client delivery*

* Own client onboarding from signed deal to ads live.
* Make sure every client’s ads, landing pages, lead delivery and reporting are on track.
* Oversee complaints and escalations, and step in on difficult clients.
* Track retention and churn, spot at-risk clients early and act before they leave.

*Systems and processes*

* Own our SOPs: keep them up to date, find the gaps and write new ones.
* Improve our software and automations (GoHighLevel, Meta, Tally, Google Drive, Xero) with our developer.
* Build and run a weekly scorecard: leads, cost per lead, bookings, complaints, churn and cash collected.

*Premium offer and filming*

* Plan and run our in-person filming service: book videographers, prepare shot lists, brief clients and get footage into editing.
* Build the delivery process for our premium, higher-ticket clients.

*Commercial*

* Keep an eye on margins, contractor costs and ad account health.
* Report to the founder each week on what’s working, what isn’t and what you’re fixing.

**What we’re looking for**

*Essential*

* At least 2 years in an operations, account management or delivery lead role at a marketing or ads agency.
* Experience managing a small team, including remote or offshore staff.
* Highly organised. You build systems, document everything and nothing falls through the cracks.

jobs.title: SEO Specialist
jobs.description:
We’re a global online booking platform operating across multiple country-specific domains, with a custom-built website (not WordPress or a template CMS) and a large, growing footprint of landing pages, country pages, city pages, and long-form blog content spanning dozens of markets.

We’re looking for an SEO specialist who’s comfortable working across both the technical and authority-building sides of SEO, roughly a 30/70 split: **30% basic backend and on-page technical work**, **70% quality backlink creation and content marketing**.

**What you’ll actually work on:**

*Technical & on-page (about 50%)*

* Working with our custom backend to fix on-page issues: meta tags, schema markup, canonical tags, hreflang across multiple country domains
* Coordinating with developers on indexing, crawl efficiency, Core Web Vitals, and page speed issues
* Auditing and cleaning up duplicate or thin content across a large, multi-domain site structure
* Comfortable reading audit tool output (Search Console, Semrush, Screaming Frog or similar) and translating it into clear, prioritized fixes

*Backlinks & content marketing (about 50%)*

* Building genuine, relevant backlinks through outreach, guest content, and digital PR, not bulk or low-quality link networks
* Identifying and vetting link opportunities by real traffic and topical relevance, not just a domain authority number
* Repurposing and promoting content across the right channels to support both links and visibility
* Tracking and reporting on link quality, referring domains, and what’s actually moving rankings, not just volume

**What we’re looking for:**

* Real experience with both technical SEO fundamentals and hands-on link building, we need one person who can genuinely do both, not two half-skills
* Comfortable working on a custom-built website without a typical CMS plugin ecosystem to lean on
* Experience with multi-domain or multi-country SEO is a strong plus, understanding hreflang, regional targeting, and avoiding content cannibalization across markets
* Familiarity with Semrush, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics
* Someone who can explain their reasoning plainly, we care about understanding why something is being done, not just that it was done

**Nice to have:**

* Experience in travel, booking, or e-commerce SEO specifically
* Familiarity with AI search visibility and structured data for answer engines (schema, FAQ markup, and similar)

Pay: From ₹20,000.00 per month

jobs.description:
Overview

Discover greater levels of performance. With over 1,400 stores throughout the U.S. and an innovative omni-channel ecosystem, Ulta Beauty is revolutionizing the beauty retail experience. Ulta Beauty is expanding its digital capabilities, opening new stores on a continual basis and re-designing existing locations with the latest design and technological advancements for heightened guest experiences. We’re not just growing, we’re thriving through consistent innovation and a bold commitment to re-imagination. If you want the opportunity to build something strategic, to take ownership of your career trajectory, to apply your passion to operational excellence, Ulta Beauty provides the kind of stability and support few organizations can match. So be curious. Be flexible. Be more than you thought possible. The future is yours at Ulta Beauty.

POSITION SUMMARY:

Use your passion, experience and talents to build something BEAUTIFUL!

The Director, Wellness Marketing will be a key leader responsible for defining and bringing to life the end-to-end marketing strategy for Wellness at Ulta Beauty. This leader will establish how Wellness shows up for our guests across the full marketing ecosystem—building awareness, credibility and engagement while translating business priorities, guest insights and cultural trends into integrated marketing strategies that drive category growth.

Reporting to the Vice President, Wellness Commercial Lead, this role will serve as the primary marketing leader for the Wellness business and a critical bridge between the Wellness and Marketing organizations. The Director will work closely with Marketing leadership and functional teams across brand and integrated marketing, media, social, customer growth marketing, creative, consumer insights and other channels to ensure Wellness is thoughtfully and cohesively integrated throughout Ulta Beauty's marketing plans.

Importantly, this leader will help shape how Beauty and Wellness come together at Ulta Beauty, identifying opportunities to connect the categories through relevant guest experiences, storytelling, campaigns and activations. The Director will own the Wellness positioning and brand strategy, helping establish how Ulta Beauty earns credibility and builds a differentiated position in Wellness while remaining authentic to the broader Ulta Beauty brand.

The Director will lead a Wellness Marketing Manager, and will operate through significant cross-functional influence across both the Wellness organization and the broader enterprise. The ideal candidate is a strong brand strategist and storyteller who combines the art and science of marketing, thrives in an entrepreneurial environment and can translate an ambitious business strategy into compelling guest-facing experiences. This builds upon the existing Wellness Marketing role's mandate around omnichannel campaigns, Wellness brand identity and partnership across Wellness and Marketing, while elevating accountability to Director-level strategy, leadership and enterprise integration.

CORE JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

Own the end-to-end marketing strategy for Wellness by Ulta Beauty, translating the Wellness business strategy, growth priorities, guest insights and cultural trends into a differentiated, full-funnel marketing strategy across paid, owned and earned channels.
Define the annual and long-range Wellness marketing strategy, including audience priorities, positioning, messaging, campaign architecture, channel strategy and measurement approach, ensuring marketing plans support both category growth and Ulta Beauty brand objectives.
Own and evolve the Wellness brand strategy and positioning in alignment with the Ulta Beauty Brand, establishing how Ulta Beauty builds authority, relevance and credibility in Wellness and translating that strategy into clear and compelling guest-facing storytelling and experiences.
Serve as the primary connector between the Wellness and Marketing organizations, working closely with Marketing leadership and functional teams to integrate Wellness priorities across brand and integrated marketing, media, social, customer growth marketing, creative, consumer insights and other marketing capabilities.
Champion the integration of Beauty + Wellness across Ulta Beauty's marketing ecosystem, identifying opportunities to connect categories and guest needs through enterprise campaigns, seasonal moments, cultural moments, content and activations.
Lead the development of integrated, omnichannel Wellness campaigns and initiatives from strategy through execution, including strategic briefs, messaging, go-to-market plans, channel integration and measurement.
Partner with Marketing leaders and channel owners to determine the optimal marketing mix for Wellness, including paid and organic media, social, CRM/customer growth, digital, content, in-store and other guest touchpoints.
Serve as an indispensable partner to Wellness Merchandising and brand partners, developing marketing strategies and activations that support category priorities, accelerate established brands, successfully introduce emerging brands and create differentiated reasons for guests to shop Wellness at Ulta Beauty. This partnership model builds on the existing Wellness Marketing Manager mandate.
Partner with the Vice President, Wellness on development and stewardship of the overall Wellness marketing budget; own execution of marketing spend in partnership with Marketing functional leaders, ensuring investments are aligned to strategic priorities and deployed effectively.
Establish clear KPIs and measurement frameworks for Wellness marketing; analyze campaign and business performance, synthesize learnings and continuously optimize marketing strategies, investments and execution.
Maintain a strong pulse on Wellness, retail and consumer trends, cultural shifts, competitive dynamics and emerging marketing capabilities, translating insights into opportunities for Ulta Beauty. The source roles similarly emphasize industry trends, consumer behavior and competitive knowledge as inputs to strategy.
Lead, coach and develop the Wellness Marketing Manager, fostering strategic thinking, strong execution, collaboration and accountability while creating opportunities for professional growth.
Build strong relationships and influence across a highly matrixed organization, aligning diverse stakeholders around a clear Wellness marketing vision and translating ambiguity into actionable strategies and plans.
Develop and present compelling marketing strategies, recommendations and business updates to senior leadership, effectively communicating the role of marketing in driving Wellness growth.

REQUIREMENTS FOR CONSIDERATION:

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing or related field; MBA or MA preferred.
10+ years of progressive consumer marketing experience, with demonstrated success developing brand, category and/or integrated marketing strategies that drive measurable business results.
5+ years of people leadership experience, with a demonstrated ability to develop talent and build high-performing teams.
Proven expertise developing and leading 360° integrated marketing strategies and campaigns across the consumer funnel and multiple marketing channels, consistent with the expectations established for Ulta Beauty's Director-level category marketing leadership.
Strong brand strategist and storyteller with experience translating consumer insights, business objectives and cultural trends into differentiated positioning, messaging and marketing experiences.
Deep understanding of the modern marketing ecosystem, including brand and integrated marketing, paid media, social and content, CRM/customer growth marketing, digital and retail experiences.
Demonstrated ability to lead through influence in a complex, matrixed organization and build trusted relationships with senior leaders and cross-functional partners.
Strategic thinker with a strong data-driven mindset and ability to move fluidly between long-range strategy and detailed execution.
Comfortable with ambiguity and energized by building new capabilities, strategies and ways of working in a fast-paced, evolving business.
Strong financial acumen with experience managing marketing investments, agency resources and complex budgets.
Exceptional written, verbal and presentation skills, including experience developing and presenting high-impact recommendations to senior leadership.
High emotional intelligence with the ability to adapt communication and leadership style to diverse internal and external stakeholders.
Experience managing creative, media and/or other external agency partners.
Wellness industry/category experience preferred, with a strong understanding of the Wellness consumer, cultural landscape and evolving category dynamics considered a plus.
Passion for the business, curiosity and a commitment to being a lifelong learner.

The pay range for this position is $147,300.00 - $200,000.00 / Year with the opportunity for eligible associates to earn additional compensation pursuant to the Company’s bonus plan. Exact pay will be based on factors including, but not limited to relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, level, shift, geographic location, and business and organizational needs. Full-time positions are eligible for paid time off, health, dental, vision, life and disability benefits. Part-time positions are eligible for dental, vision, life, and disability benefits. About Mueller Communications

Mueller Communications is a full-service communications, public relations and marketing firm based in Milwaukee. For more than 40 years, we've helped organizations, leaders and influencers tell their stories and amplify their impact through comprehensive marketing campaigns, media relations, public affairs, creative, and crisis communications. Today, our team of nearly 50 professionals serves clients across a diverse set of industries, and we're proud that many of our senior staff have called Mueller home for a decade or more.

With integrity at the heart of everything we do, our team of strategic communicators and problem solvers is committed to doing right by our clients, our community and each other.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The Senior Manager-Performance Marketing is a collaborative problem solver who strategizes, builds, and optimizes campaigns to achieve measurable client goals. They set search-led demand generation strategy, direct junior campaign staff on execution, stay hands-on with our most complex accounts, and deliver and clearly communicate the results clients care about: qualified leads and pipeline.

The performance marketing function at Mueller Communications serves a diverse set of organizations including local, national, B2B, B2C, non-profit, for-profit, professional services, and eCommerce. Much of our work is lead generation for B2B and niche-industry clients, where a qualified lead is worth real money and attribution is the difference between a campaign that looks good and one that proves ROI.

Today, roughly two-thirds of Google searches end without a click. Winning there takes a ‘search everywhere’ approach: paid (SEM), organic (SEO), and AI visibility (AIO / GEO / AEO) managed as one program, fed by authoritative content, made credible by third-party coverage and endorsement. Mueller's elite talent works across every discipline that shapes search; we are seeking a performance marketer who can lead clients through this shift, seeing around the next corner before their competitors do.

Set strategy for and lead the builds of best-in-class paid search campaigns (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads), plus paid social and programmatic where client goals warrant
Stay hands-on with our most complex accounts: campaign architecture, budget pacing, bidding strategy, audience and keyword development, and structured testing
Drive lead generation as the primary outcome, and eCommerce revenue where clients sell direct, optimizing to cost per qualified lead, pipeline contribution, and ROAS rather than platform metrics alone.

Demand Generation & Lead Gen Attribution

Work with Mueller's proprietary, industry-leading AI search visibility and optimization platform, and help drive its continued evolution

Team & Project Management

Optimize the firm's campaign planning and delivery process
Lead campaign activities in collaboration with the Client Lead (goal setting and reporting, projections, monthly planning, and regular internal client reviews)

Strategy Development | Entrepreneurial Mindset

Contribute proactive ideas and suggestions for how to grow business from current clients
Pursue new business opportunities for the firm, including participation in pitch meetings and proposal development
Keep the firm at the forefront of the search industry by identifying technology, trends, and insights to be leveraged in both work delivery and business development

Qualifications That Will Make You Stand Out

This is a flexible hybrid role based in Milwaukee, WI

jobs.description:
As a result of the combination of the BD Biosciences and Diagnostic Solutions business with Waters Corporation (NYSE: WAT), by applying to this role, you will be applying for a position with Waters. Waters is a global leader in life sciences, dedicated to accelerating the benefits of pioneering science through analytical technologies, informatics, and service. With a focus on regulated, high-volume testing environments, Waters’ innovative portfolio harnesses deep scientific expertise across biology, chemistry, and physics. Waters collaborates with analytical laboratories around the world to advance the release of effective, high-quality medicines, assure the safety of food and water, and drive better patient outcomes by detecting diseases earlier, managing routine infections, and combatting growing antibiotic resistance. Through a shared culture of relentless innovation, Waters’ passionate team of approximately 16,000 colleagues partner with customers to turn scientific challenges into breakthroughs that improve lives worldwide.

We Are The People Who Give Possibilities Purpose

BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health™ is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities.

Job Description

About the role:

We are seeking a collaborative, results-oriented Growth Marketing
Campaign Manager
to join our US Regional Marketing team. This role will plan, execute, and optimize integrated marketing campaigns that build awareness, generate demand, and support commercial growth.

The Campaign Manager will coordinate campaigns across internal teams, agencies, and external partners, with responsibility for third-party media planning and trafficking and the day-to-day management of the US Google Ads account.

Key Responsibilities

Omnichannel Growth Marketing & Demand Generation

Develop integrated demand generation campaigns that drive awareness, engagement, qualified leads, pipeline growth, and revenue
Execute omnichannel growth marketing campaigns across web, email, SEO/SEM, paid media, social media, webinars, content syndication, and account-based marketing programs
Translate marketing priorities into actionable campaign plans with defined audiences, tactics, timelines, budgets, and KPIs.
Manage third-party media programs, including media coordination, asset delivery, tracking requirements, budgets, and performance.
Coordinate the accurate implementation of campaign tracking, UTM parameters, landing pages, and other digital campaign elements.
Manage multiple campaigns and deadlines while maintaining strong attention to detail.
Develop and adapt campaign content for select marketing channels, including email, digital advertising, landing pages, and third-party media, in collaboration with product marketing, agencies, and other internal partners.

Paid Media Management

Coordinate with agency partners to monitor pacing, performance, and optimization opportunities of Search Engine Marketing campaigns
Review search terms, ad copy, keywords, audiences and performance to recommend improvements.
Coordinate with product managers to implement new campaigns
Support paid media reporting and communicate actionable insights to stakeholders.

Performance & Insights

Track and report performance against key business metrics
Monitor campaign performance and recommend adjustments to improve engagement, conversions, lead generation, and marketing efficiency.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Life Sciences, or a related field.
At least 5 years of experience in campaign management, digital marketing, demand generation, paid media, or a related discipline.
Hands-on experience executing multichannel marketing campaigns.
Experience with paid media, media agencies, publishers, or advertising vendors.
Working knowledge of Google Ads or another paid-search platform; hands-on Google Ads experience preferred.
Understanding of digital marketing metrics such as CTR, conversions, cost per conversion, and ROAS.
Strong project management, organizational, analytical, and communication skills.
Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and external partners.
Familiarity with Salesforce, Marketo, Google Analytics, or comparable CRM, marketing automation, and analytics platforms is preferred.
B2B, life sciences, biotechnology, healthcare, or other technical industry experience is preferred.

To find purpose in the possibilities, we need people who can see the bigger picture, who understand the human story that underpins everything we do. jobs.description:
About Matrix Adhesives

Founded in 2021, Matrix Adhesives Group is a growth-driven company committed to delivering high-performance bonding and sealing solutions across diverse industries. We bring together some of the most trusted and innovative brands in the adhesives and sealants market - each with a proven legacy of quality, performance, and reliability.

Our portfolio includes industry-leading names–each contributing unique expertise and capabilities to meet the evolving needs of our customers. Through our brands, we offer a comprehensive range of products engineered for construction, industrial, commercial, and specialty applications.

At the core of our business is a relentless focus on operational excellence, customer partnership, and cutting-edge research and development. We don’t just supply adhesives. We help build stronger, safer, and more efficient systems for the future.

Matrix Adhesives Group is more than a supplier. We are your collaborative partner backed by a powerhouse of leading brands - committed to performance, innovation, and long-term value.

For more information visit https://www.matrixadhesives.com/.

About The Role

The Technical Marketing Leader will own all marketing activities for products and brands sold into technical and industrial applications within the Matrix portfolio. This includes the Self-Seal® Firestopping product line, SCIGRIP® and related products used in product fabrication, and transportation applications. These product lines have many growth opportunities in the market including adjacent applications, new technologies/products, share gain, new customer acquisition, and channel development.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Develop and execute market strategies and growth plans for technical and industrial product lines, translating business objectives into prioritized initiatives, measurable targets, and clear go-to-market actions.
Lead market, customer, and competitive analysis to identify unmet needs, emerging trends, adjacent applications, and opportunities for share gain, customer acquisition, and channel expansion.
Partner with Product Director, Sales, Technical Service, and Operations to plan and execute product launches, including positioning, value propositions, sales enablement, launch communications, and post-launch performance tracking.
Manage brand strategy and messaging across the technical portfolio, ensuring consistent positioning, differentiated value propositions, and effective application across customer touchpoints and marketing materials.
Build industry engagement and thought leadership through customer insights, technical content, trade associations, events, and other channels that strengthen market credibility and brand visibility.
Support key account growth by developing account-specific value propositions, customer presentations, commercial tools, and marketing programs in partnership with Sales and technical teams.
Lead demand generation programs across relevant channels, define success metrics, monitor pipeline and campaign performance, and optimize investments based on results.
Travel 20%-40%

Critical Competencies

Strategic Thinking
Customer Focus
Commercial Acumen
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Communication
Project Management

7-10 years B2B marketing experience.
Experience with technical construction products (eg. HVAC, specified systems).
Bachelor's degree in marketing, engineering or a related field.

MBA preferred.
Experience in firestopping applications/channels.
Experience in transportation sourcing/production (marine, RV, rail, automotive).
Industrial fabrication or maintenance exposure.

jobs.title: Manager, Partner Growth Marketing (Rocket Travel by Agoda)
jobs.description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.  

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About Rocket Travel by Agoda
Rocket Travel by Agoda is a travel technology company founded in 2012 under our flagship consumer facing product, rocketmiles.com. Since then, we have evolved to partner with some of the largest consumer travel brands in the world creating white-label solutions that allow customers to earn and redeem miles and points for booking hotels, rental cars, flights and activities. Our global partnerships range from world-class airlines to international banks to large-scale shopping platforms.  We help our partners develop successful go-to-market strategies through marketing expertise and data to support their overall growth. 
We attract customers from every corner of the globe with a seamless user experience that's built in-house from ideation to finished product: our team includes front- and back-end developers, customer service, data analysts, designers, marketers, accountants, partnership sales, and managers. 
Rocket Travel by Agoda is dedicated to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to reach new heights in their career, and expand their knowledge working alongside talented, dedicated colleagues. We encourage all applicants with a touch of wanderlust to apply to our team, as we work toward helping our travelers reach the vacation of their dreams. 

Get to know our team: 

The Marketing team operates at the intersection of business strategy, data, and execution. We build and scale programs across growth, pricing, and commercial initiatives that drive customer value and sustainable business performance globally. We’re analytical, fast-moving, and deeply cross-functional — partnering closely with Product, Finance, and other teams to shape RTA's growth agenda.

The opportunity:

We are looking for a dynamic and versatile Marketing Manager who will focus on marketing guidance and support for our white label travel platform partners. This is a strategic role where you will work closely with our Partner Managers, Product Owners and the larger Marketing team to understand the partners’ needs, advise them on impactful marketing initiatives, and drive the growth of the platform.
What you'll do:

Marketing Strategy and Execution:

Understand the partners’ business models and goals and provide expert advice on the best marketing strategies to achieve growth. Recommend initiatives to optimize campaigns and enhance platform performance for end-users.
•  Data-Driven Insights:
 Analyze large datasets to uncover trends and opportunities, delivering actionable insights that inform marketing strategies. Regularly monitor platform performance and recommend optimizations based on data findings.
•  Influencing Decision-Making:
 Guide and influence partners to adopt strategies and solutions that align with their goals as well as our business objectives. Serve as an advisor, simplifying complex marketing strategies for non-experts.
•  Revenue Growth:
 Strategically focus on maximizing contribution margin and ROI while ensuring partner satisfaction and long-term engagement.
•  Cross-Functional Collaboration:
 Work closely with internal teams, including sales, product, analytics, and operations, to ensure smooth execution and alignment of initiatives.

What you'll need to succeed:

5 years of relevant Marketing experience
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field; MBA preferred.
• Proven marketing experience, ideally within e-commerce, travel, or SaaS environments.
• Experience in a consultative or advisory role, preferably with a consulting background.
•  Strong analytical skills with the ability to dissect data and provide actionable recommendations. Basic knowledge of SQL (joins, filters, aggregates) is a must, advanced (window functions, CTEs) is a plus.
Exceptional communication, both written – clear, powerful slides – and spoken – ability to handle conversations with stakeholders and motivate them to adopt strategic decisions.
• Exposure to sales with an understanding of how partnerships contribute to revenue growth.
• Proven track record of leading multi-stakeholder initiatives successfully.

At this time, we’re unfortunately unable to provide support for OPT/CPT student visas or H-1B transfers for this role. As a result, preference will be given to candidates who are U.S. citizens, permanent residents, or Green Card holders.

The annual salary range for the NYC-metro area is $110,000-$138,000.
