jobs.title: Product Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Marketing Lead based in the United States.

The Product Marketing Lead will shape the positioning and go-to-market strategy for an enterprise event technology platform serving complex event portfolios across in-person, virtual, webinar, and field experiences. This high-impact role combines product storytelling, competitive strategy, product launches, sales enablement, and analyst relations. You will translate sophisticated platform capabilities, including emerging AI-powered and agentic features, into clear value propositions for enterprise buyers. Working closely with Product, Sales, Account Management, and Marketing, you will help strengthen competitive performance and accelerate customer adoption. Reporting directly to the Co-founder and Chief Marketing Officer, you will have significant ownership and the autonomy to build, test, and improve marketing programs. The environment rewards initiative, excellent writing, practical AI adoption, and the ability to deliver measurable results without relying on a large team.

Accountabilities

You will lead product marketing across positioning, launches, competitive intelligence, sales readiness, and customer engagement, ensuring that the product’s value is clearly communicated throughout the buyer and customer journey. Your key responsibilities will include:

Own positioning and messaging: Develop and maintain compelling messaging for the event experience platform, translating AI-powered and agentic capabilities into clear, evidence-based value propositions for enterprise event leaders. Ensure consistency across marketing channels, sales conversations, and customer communications.
Lead go-to-market launches: Partner with Product to understand product strategy and development priorities, then manage launches end to end, including messaging, launch planning, input on pricing and packaging, sales readiness, and customer communications.
Strengthen competitive strategy: Monitor established event management platforms and emerging point solutions. Develop practical battlecards, discovery questions, objection-handling guidance, and competitive intelligence that help sales teams win deals. Conduct win/loss analyses to continuously improve positioning and sales effectiveness.
Drive sales enablement: Create sales narratives, demo storylines, one-pagers, RFP content, and other field resources. Work with Sales and Solutions leadership to train teams and ensure new product capabilities are effectively presented and sold.
Manage analyst relations: Own day-to-day relationships with Forrester and Gartner, coordinate briefings and evaluation submissions, and strengthen the company’s presence on review platforms such as G2, TrustRadius, Capterra, and Gartner Peer Insights.
Build customer proof points: Collaborate with Account Management to develop case studies, customer reference programs, and measurable evidence supporting product claims and demonstrating business value.
Increase product adoption: Partner with Account Management to encourage existing customers to use new capabilities through release communications, targeted programs, relevant content, and executive business reviews.
Maintain the product marketing knowledge base: Keep messaging, product information, and competitive intelligence accurate and accessible, including the knowledge that powers internal AI tools and workflows. Use AI to automate repetitive go-to-market activities and improve operational efficiency.
Deliver measurable results: During the first 90 days, develop a clear understanding of why the company wins and loses, refresh competitive materials, take ownership of analyst evaluation activities, and deliver an end-to-end launch. Within the first year, help improve competitive win rates, establish consistent launch practices, strengthen analyst and review-site positioning, and maintain trusted messaging for employees and AI agents.

Requirements

The ideal candidate is an experienced B2B SaaS product marketer who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, strong commercial judgment, and a practical approach to AI-enabled work. Required and preferred qualifications include:

At least five years of product marketing experience in B2B SaaS, selling to mid-market and enterprise buyers, including experience as a lead or sole product marketer.
Demonstrated ability to position complex platforms for both business and technical audiences and compete successfully against established market leaders.
An AI-native approach to work, with experience using AI agents—ideally Claude—to automate practical go-to-market workflows and examples of solutions you have built.
Strong sales enablement skills, including the ability to develop compelling narratives and useful sales materials, train field teams, and measure whether those resources are being adopted.
Hands-on analyst relations experience, ideally including participation in a Forrester Wave or Gartner Magic Quadrant evaluation.
Excellent writing and communication skills, with the ability to make complex product concepts clear, specific, and persuasive without resorting to generic messaging.
Ability to work independently, set priorities, move quickly, and deliver results in an environment with limited layers and a lean team structure.
Preferred: Experience with Claude Cowork, Claude Skills, or similar agentic tools in everyday work.
Preferred: Background in event technology, marketing technology, or another platform serving marketing teams.
Preferred: Experience marketing AI-first or agentic products to enterprise customers.
Preferred: Experience developing value propositions for multiple stakeholder groups, such as organizers, attendees, and sponsors.
Preferred: Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, and Gong, including the ability to retrieve and analyze data directly from these platforms.

Benefits

Annual salary: $100,000–$150,000, as stated in the source posting under New York pay transparency requirements.
Comprehensive insurance options with employer premium coverage.
Generous paid time-off benefits.
Quarterly mental health days to support employee well-being.
Quarterly team-building events designed to strengthen collaboration and workplace connections.
401(k) retirement plan with employer matching.
Equity program.
Paid parental leave.
Sabbatical leave on milestone work anniversaries.
An opportunity to shape product marketing strategy, influence competitive performance, and work closely with senior leadership.
A collaborative, AI-forward environment that encourages experimentation, workflow automation, and independent execution.

jobs.title: Experiential Marketing & Brand Activation Intern-Dallas
jobs.description:
Advantage Solutions
is a leading provider of outsourced sales, merchandising, marketing, and technology-enabled services that help brands and retailers connect with consumers. Our summer internship program gives students meaningful, relevant work experience, exposure to business leaders, and opportunities to build professional skills through project work and program experiences.

Program Dates:
10 weeks, May 24–August 6, 2027

Position Summary
The Experiential Services Intern will support the Kroger Experiential Strategy & Innovation team in developing customer-focused, in-store, and event-based experiences that help brands and Kroger drive product trial, engagement, and sales. This opportunity is designed for a curious, business-minded student interested in experiential marketing, shopper insights, strategic planning, and client engagement.

This is a project-based internship with meaningful ownership. The intern will contribute to annual planning, opportunity identification, sales enablement, performance insights, and an executive-level capstone presentation.

Key Responsibilities
Support development of an annual experiential marketing calendar featuring seasonal, cultural, retailer, and shopper moments.
Research emerging consumer, shopper, retail, and experiential marketing trends to inform future programming.
Analyze historical program participation to identify whitespace opportunities across manufacturers, categories, and brands.
Develop recommendations that may increase experiential program participation and client engagement.
Assist with client-facing presentations, opportunity overviews, sales materials, and planning resources.
Organize and streamline experiential program information for internal and external stakeholders.
Review event performance data and summarize key learnings, trends, best practices, and success stories.
Translate research and performance findings into practical insights and recommendations for future programs and client conversations.
Collaborate with cross-functional partners and participate in team meetings, strategic discussions, and client-related projects.
Own a substantive summer project and present findings, recommendations, and proposed business impact to Kroger Experiential leadership.
Perform other duties and project work as assigned based on evolving business needs.

Qualifications
Currently enrolled in an accredited four-year degree-granting institution or accredited graduate, master’s, or MBA program in the United States.
Rising junior, rising senior, or graduate student during the internship period.
Pursuing a degree in marketing, business administration, communications, advertising, consumer insights, market research, analytics, retail studies, or a related field.
Minimum 3.0 GPA.
Ability to research business questions, identify patterns, and connect findings to practical recommendations.
Ability to communicate ideas and analytical findings clearly through written materials and presentations.
Curiosity, coachability, learning agility, and interest in shopper, retail, or experiential marketing.
Ability to organize work independently, manage multiple priorities, ask thoughtful questions, and communicate proactively.

Preferred Skills and Attributes
Interest in experiential marketing, shopper marketing, retail strategy, brand activation, consumer behavior, or client services.
Experience completing a class, academic, internship, or work project involving research, analysis, marketing strategy, or recommendations.
Proficiency with Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel; exposure to Microsoft Forms or Asana is helpful.
Strong storytelling, presentation, market research, problem-solving, and professional communication skills.
Comfort working with ambiguity, synthesizing information, and collaborating across functions.

Summer Project Deliverables
Experiential annual planning calendar highlighting key retailer and shopper moments.
Trend and opportunity assessment identifying future experiential growth areas.
Manufacturer and category opportunity database, including a priority prospect list with supporting rationale.
Recommendations for increasing participation across experiential programs.
Updated experiential opportunity toolkit and client-facing presentation materials.
Best-practice library featuring successful experiential case studies and program examples.
Executive-level capstone presentation summarizing findings, recommendations, and proposed business impact.

Work Environment and Program Experience

Dallas is the preferred location because the role will benefit from participation in team meetings, strategic discussions, and client-related projects. Candidates in Cincinnati, Atlanta or St. Louis may also be considered based on business needs and the final working arrangement.

The 10-week summer experience includes meaningful manager-led work, regular coaching and feedback, exposure to cross-functional teams, access to historical program data and planning resources, internship programming, and a final capstone experience.

Supervisory Responsibilities
This position does not have direct or indirect supervisory responsibilities.

Environmental and Physical Requirements
Work is performed primarily in an office or sedentary environment and requires regular use of a computer and communication technology. The intern must be able to perform the essential functions of the role, with reasonable accommodations provided as required by applicable law.

Job duties may include additional responsibilities assigned by the intern’s supervisor or another manager based on the needs of the position or department. This job description describes the general nature and level of work being performed and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or skills required. Advantage Solutions may alter job responsibilities or assign additional responsibilities, subject to applicable law.
Internships provide relevant work experience and exposure to potential career opportunities. Participation in the program does not guarantee future employment with Advantage Solutions.

jobs.title: Marketing Cloud Next Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.

Work You'll Do

As a US Delivery Center Senior Consultant on the team, you will:

Lead Marketing Cloud Next discovery, architecture, and solution-design workshops, translating business needs across marketing, sales, service, and commerce into connected customer journeys.
Define target-state architecture spanning Salesforce Core, Marketing Cloud Next, Data 360, Flow, Agentforce, AWS, and other enterprise platforms.
Establish requirements and strategies for data, identity, segmentation, consent, activation, integrations, reporting, security, permissions, sharing, environments, and releases.
Evaluate solution options and architectural trade-offs related to platform constraints, scalability, performance, security, cost, migration, coexistence, and operational readiness.
Define reusable architecture patterns, governance standards, quality criteria, and end-to-end designs in partnership with enterprise, data, integration, and cloud architects.
Review technical designs and lead testing, UAT, go-live readiness, production issue resolution, continuous improvement, stakeholder adoption, value realization, and mentoring of delivery team members.

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Advertising, Marketing, & Commerce offering designs and implements solutions that engage and activate customers through the customer journey.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte's scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Qualifications

Required :

Bachelor's degree
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
Significant experience architecting Salesforce or Marketing Cloud solutions.
Strong experience with Salesforce Core, Flow, data models, integrations, and enterprise delivery.
Working knowledge of Data 360, Agentforce, identity, segmentation, and activation.
Experience leading architecture workshops and influencing stakeholders.
Delivery Center Location & Travel Requirements:
Hybrid Work Model: Operate under a hybrid system requiring residence within a commutable distance to one of the US Delivery Center locations (Gilbert, Lake Mary, or Mechanicsburg) or Geo-Hub locations (Atlanta, Charlotte, Dallas, Houston, and Philadelphia)
Co-location Expectation: Spend up to 30% of working time co-located at an assigned office for orchestrated opportunities, including projects, practice sessions, training, and Moments That Matter at a Deloitte Delivery Center location, Geo-Hub location, approved site, or project location
Travel Requirement: Maximum of 10% overnight travel for client or project purposes
Relocation Requirement: If relocation is necessary, complete the move within 12 weeks from the start date to reside within a commutable distance

Preferred:

Relevant Salesforce certifications are preferred.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $120,000 to $140,000.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Director of Marketing
jobs.description:
Help people discover Sanctuary and keep coming back

A great night of music. A child’s first creative workshop. A gallery opening that brings neighbors together. A room full of people who arrived as strangers and left feeling connected.
At Sanctuary Cultural Arts Center, these experiences are at the heart of what we do. We’re looking for a Director of Marketing who can tell that story, reach new audiences, and turn interest into attendance, membership, and lasting support.
Sanctuary is a growing nonprofit cultural destination in downtown Maynard, offering live music, arts programming, family events, and community celebrations. With the opening of The Vestry, our new community and exhibition space, we’re expanding the ways people can experience and participate in Sanctuary.
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines creative instincts with strong organization and a clear understanding of what makes people take action.

The Opportunity

You will lead Sanctuary’s marketing strategy, brand development, and day-to-day execution, with support from a staff member focused on on-the-ground marketing. This role combines creative ownership with the opportunity to supervise and mentor a colleague, building a coordinated approach to promoting Sanctuary’s programs, spaces, and mission.
Working closely with the Executive Director, talent buyers, event staff, artists, and community partners, you will grow audiences and strengthen Sanctuary’s role as a regional gathering place. Your work will support ticketed Main Hall performances, free Barside programming, The Vestry, private events, memberships, and fundraising initiatives.

Marketing strategy and campaign planning

Build an integrated marketing calendar that connects event promotion, community programming, memberships, fundraising, private event sales, and broader brand messaging.
Develop campaigns with clear audiences, messages, budgets, deadlines, and measurable goals.
Balance immediate ticket sales with the longer-term work of telling Sanctuary’s story, building awareness, and strengthening loyalty and community participation.

Event promotion and artist collaboration

Manage promotional timelines from event announcement through post-event follow-up.
Coordinate with artists and their representatives on promotional assets, shared posts, email outreach, and audience development.
Establish clear marketing expectations and follow through so every event receives consistent, timely promotion.
Collaborate with the Barside Talent Manager to help free performances attract audiences and introduce emerging artists to Sanctuary’s community.

Content brand and storytelling

Develop and refine a compelling brand messaging strategy and associated visual and written identity that reflect Sanctuary’s mission, personality, and role in the community.
Oversee engaging content for social media, email, the website, event listings, print materials, and paid advertising.
Create or coordinate compelling graphics, photography, short-form video, artist features, and stories about Sanctuary’s impact.
Maintain consistent branding while giving individual events a distinct personality.
Capture the energy of Sanctuary and give people a reason to attend, return, and bring a friend.

Team leadership and coordination

Supervise and mentor a staff member who supports on-the-ground marketing execution, providing clear priorities, guidance, and constructive feedback.
Delegate and coordinate activities such as poster and flyer distribution, community outreach, promotional material placement, and event coverage.
Establish a shared workflow with clear assignments, deadlines, and regular check-ins to keep campaigns moving.
Coordinate staff support, street team members, and volunteers so their efforts align with Sanctuary’s marketing calendar.
Build a collaborative working relationship that encourages initiative, develops skills, and connects everyday execution to measurable results.

Audience growth and community relationships

Grow Sanctuary’s email list, social audiences, attendance, and repeat visitation.
Develop relationships with local businesses, media outlets, arts organizations, tourism partners, and community groups.
Coordinate publicity, calendar listings, cross-promotions, and street team activity.
Work with leadership to communicate the value of memberships, donations, sponsorships, and community partnerships.

Digital marketing and performance

Manage email campaigns, audience segmentation, and paid digital advertising.
Keep event information accurate and make the path from discovery to purchase or RSVP easy to follow.
Use OpenDate, Meta, Google Analytics, and related tools to understand what drives results.
Deliver a concise weekly report showing performance, lessons learned, and recommended next steps.
Manage the marketing budget and improve how Sanctuary allocates its time and advertising dollars.

What success looks like

Success means more people discovering Sanctuary, more well-attended events, and stronger relationships with the people who support our mission. Together with the Executive Director, you will establish practical goals for:
Ticket sales, attendance, and event revenue.
RSVPs and attendance at free community programs.
Email subscriber growth, engagement, and ticket purchases.
Advertising effectiveness and return on spending.
Membership growth, renewals, and fundraising participation.
Qualified wedding and private event inquiries.
Repeat attendance, media coverage, and community partnerships.

You’ll be expected to explain what the numbers mean and recommend what we should do next.

What you bring

Demonstrated success in marketing for live entertainment, arts and culture, hospitality, nonprofits, or another audience-driven organization.
Strong writing skills and an eye for compelling visual content.
Experience with email marketing, social media, paid advertising, and campaign analysis.
The ability to manage multiple deadlines while keeping details accurate.
Confidence working with artists, colleagues, volunteers, vendors, and community partners.
Sound judgment about budgets, priorities, and where effort will make the greatest difference.
A collaborative approach and a willingness to create, publish, troubleshoot, and follow through.
Enthusiasm for live music, the arts, and the role a welcoming cultural space can play in community life.

Our Advertising, Marketing, & Commerce offering designs and implements solutions that engage and activate customers through the customer journey.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. Qualifications

Required :

Bachelor's degree
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
Significant experience architecting Salesforce or Marketing Cloud solutions.
Strong experience with Salesforce Core, Flow, data models, integrations, and enterprise delivery.
Working knowledge of Data 360, Agentforce, identity, segmentation, and activation.
Experience leading architecture workshops and influencing stakeholders.
Delivery Center Location & Travel Requirements:
Hybrid Work Model: Operate under a hybrid system requiring residence within a commutable distance to one of the US Delivery Center locations (Gilbert, Lake Mary, or Mechanicsburg) or Geo-Hub locations (Atlanta, Charlotte, Dallas, Houston, and Philadelphia)
Co-location Expectation: Spend up to 30% of working time co-located at an assigned office for orchestrated opportunities, including projects, practice sessions, training, and Moments That Matter at a Deloitte Delivery Center location, Geo-Hub location, approved site, or project location

Relocation Requirement: If relocation is necessary, complete the move within 12 weeks from the start date to reside within a commutable distance

jobs.title: Director, Brand Marketing, Body Category, Naturium
jobs.description:
About The Company

e.l.f. Beauty's purpose is to make the world a better place for every eye, lip, and face.

Our deep commitment to clean, cruelty free beauty at an incredible value has fueled the success of our flagship brand e.l.f. Cosmetics since 2004 and driven our portfolio expansion. Today, our multi-brand portfolio includes e.l.f. Cosmetics, e.l.f. SKIN, e.l.f. Hair, Well People, Naturium and rhode.

In our Fiscal year 26, we had net sales of $1.6 Billion and our business performance has been nothing short of extraordinary with 7 consecutive years of net sales growth. This consistent, category-leading growth is a testament to the strength of our team, strategy, and portfolio of brands.

Our total compensation philosophy offers every full-time new hire competitive pay and benefits, bonus eligibility (200% of target over the last seven fiscal years), equity, flexible time off, year-round half-day Fridays, and a hybrid 3 day in office, 2 day at home work environment. We believe the combination of our unique culture, total compensation, workplace flexibility and care for the team is unmatched across not just beauty but any industry.

Visit our Career Page to learn more about our team: https://www.elfbeauty.com/work-with-us

Position Summary:

Are you obsessed with body care? Do you live for the cultural moment, the brand world, and the kind of storytelling that makes people feel something and then buy something? Do you want to build a brand, not just run a campaign?

Naturium is seeking an Director, Brand Marketing - Body Category to define and drive the global brand strategy and go-to-market vision for our body care portfolio. This is a high-impact role for a brand world builder, someone who can construct the creative and strategic architecture that makes a category feel inevitable, then activate it with precision across markets and channels.

You will own the global brand identity for Naturium body: what it stands for, how it speaks, and where it shows up. At Puck, we are Built to Lead.  Strategic marketing and growth planning Commercial and financial acumen Sales and marketing alignment Market research, segmentation, and voice-of-customer capability Campaign planning, measurement, and attribution Budget management and forecasting discipline Leadership, coaching, and resource management Communication proficiency (verbal, written, presentation, and executive-level) Organizational skills, initiative, teamwork, creativity, and problem solving Experience in Adobe Creative Suite Proficient in photography, videography, and photo/video editing  Required Education & Experience:

 Experience managing websites, social media, email marketing, and multiple media types WordPress, WooCommerce, SEO, marketing analytics, and campaign attribution experience Experience with a CRM or marketing automation platform (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce) for pipeline tracking Photography, videography, and video editing experience Experience in manufacturing, agriculture, industrial, fire, military, or other relevant markets. This position has supervisory responsibilities. You will lead the Marketing department, including work direction, coaching, performance management, staffing recommendations, hiring, and termination decisions in accordance with company policy.

This is primarily a sedentary role in a professional office environment. Team members must be able to: 

 Sit for extended periods and work on a computer throughout the day Occasionally stand, walk, bend and move throughout the facility Occasionally lift files and office products up to 10lbs  Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

This role operates primarily in a professional office environment and routinely uses standard office equipment. Frequent visits to areas throughout the facility, including manufacturing areas where noise levels can be loud and appropriate personal protective equipment may be required, are part of the job.

Occasional travel is expected for industry events, customer visits, demonstrations, conferences, agency meetings, or team activities.

At this time, relocation assistance is not available for this position. We encourage candidates within a commutable distance of Manning, IA or those willing to relocate independently to apply.

We believe our team members deserve a benefits package as strong as the products we build. Full-time team members are eligible for benefits beginning the first of the month following 60 days of employment.

Company Description
Bankable Limited is building Africa’s first financial health scoring platform, transforming six months of bank transaction data into a 0–100 score that helps individuals become bankable, often for the first time. The company addresses the gap where millions of Nigerians have bank accounts but no credit history, making it difficult for banks to assess lending risk. By analyzing financial behavior such as savings patterns, income consistency, spending stability, debt indicators, and resilience to emergencies through Open Banking data, Bankable provides actionable insights. The platform helps consumers understand and improve their financial health while enabling lenders to discover creditworthy borrowers they currently overlook. Bankable Limited is based in Abuja, Nigeria and is targeting a 2026 launch.

The Vice President of Product Marketing is a full-time remote role responsible for shaping and executing the go-to-market strategy for Bankable’s financial health scoring platform. This role oversees product positioning, message development, and market segmentation to ensure the platform resonates with consumers, lenders, and partners across key African markets. Day-to-day responsibilities include collaborating with product management to define value propositions, partnering with sales to develop enablement materials, and leading marketing initiatives that drive adoption and engagement. The VP will analyze market trends and customer insights, refine pricing and packaging strategies, manage key product launches, and guide cross-functional teams to deliver consistent, impactful campaigns. This role also involves establishing performance metrics, tracking product marketing effectiveness, and continuously optimizing strategies for growth and market leadership.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Perchwell is the modern real estate listings platform built for agents to search smarter, collaborate better, and close deals faster. We are building the future of residential real estateʼs critical listings infrastructure: a platform where market research and client collaboration converge. Our modern architecture enables continuous innovation at a pace legacy systems cannot match, with AI-powered features and mobile-first capabilities designed for how agents actually work. As consumer expectations and technology evolve, Perchwell remains focused on our core vision: empowering real estate professionals with the most intelligent, data-driven, and connected platform in the industry.

Backed by leading venture capital firms including Lux Capital and Founders Fund, along with strategic partnerships with some of the country's top Multiple Listing Services (MLSs), Perchwell represents the first major new platform to enter the listings technology market in decades. This unique combination of institutional investment and deep industry alignment provides both the resources and market validation needed to transform the multi-trillion dollar residential real estate industry.

The role

We are hiring a Product Marketing Manager to bring Perchwell's product to market (GTM). You will influence the positioning and messaging for our product, specializing in the product and customer launches that put each release in front of Executive leadership, staff, and real estate agents, and the communication programs that move thousands of real estate agents onto the Perchwell platform. You will execute product and customer launches, run the launch calendar, and build the systems that let a small team ship at the pace the product does.

Perchwell releases to every customer at once and ships continuously, so product launches are a steady stream rather than a few big moments a year. Each release needs messaging that is accurate for the people who run Multiple Listings Services (MLS) and useful to the agents who use our product, along with the assets that drive adoption. The launch process has to be systematic for this to work, and you will grow into owning it end to end, from the roadmap conversation with Product through go-live and the post-launch read on adoption.

Customer launches are the second half of the job. When an MLS moves its membership onto Perchwell, the transition runs over several months. You would build each communication plan with the MLS and our Customer Success team, write what goes out, and carry what you learn into the next one.

We strive to build a systematic marketing team enabled by AI, and the right candidate for this role should be eager to learn and implement AI as a core component of the role. The marketing team implements a shared library of skills, knowledge, and workflows, and we expect this person to extend it. Every recurring step in a launch is a candidate for a system that produces a reviewable first draft in minutes, and you would build and maintain those systems so the team's output keeps up with the product's release pace.

This role will report into the Product Marketing Lead. This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong writing, product judgment, and the organizational discipline to keep several launches moving at once, and who is eager to build the function as we grow quickly.

What You Will Do

Product launches and communication

Run the launch cadence for each release: the brief, the asset checklist, the timeline, and go-live, with Product and Customer Success inputs tracked and chased.
Write the positioning and messaging for each product area, from Search and Add/Edit to Client Collaboration, Reports and Analytics, Admin, and Mobile, and keep the messaging source of truth current.
Produce the launch assets: release messaging, help center articles and updates, Intercom macros for the support team, MLS staff enablement briefs, member emails, What's New entries, and in-app messages.
Turn a technical capability into what an agent, an MLS admin, or an MLS CEO can now do, in their words.
Keep product pages, one-pagers, and demo-deck sections current as the product moves.

Customer launches

Own the member-facing communication plan for each MLS conversion, from announcement through the parallel period, training cohorts, cutover, and the first months after.
Develop campaigns that drive adoption: announcement and reminder emails, newsletter sections, training invitations, town hall materials, FAQ and support Q&A docs, and creative campaigns.
Work directly with the MLS's leadership and staff, and with Perchwell's Customer Success and implementation team, to execute launches as a team.
Track adoption through launches and feed what you learn into the next launch.
Partner with Customer Success to capture testimonials and case studies to enable the Sales team and marketing materials.

Systems and velocity

Build and maintain AI skills and templates, so recurring work starts from a system rather than a blank page.
Run the launch calendar, cross-functional inputs, and post-launch reviews as a repeatable process, and tighten it after every launch.
Use AI in your own research and production: competitive scans, customer transcript review, first drafts, and checks against the house voice.

What Success Looks Like

Product launches ship on schedule with a complete asset set, and MLS staff have what they need to answer member questions on day one.
Customer launches hit their cutover dates with members informed, trained, and using the platform.
Perchwell's product and service story is tailored to each audience and consistently reinforced in all collateral.
Launch assets take less time each quarter because the systems behind them improve.

Who You Are

You have 3+ professional experience in product marketing, lifecycle or customer marketing, content marketing, or an adjacent role at a B2B software company where you owned launches, campaigns, or a content program end to end.
You write clearly and can show it.
You bring structure to cross-functional work. You build the plan, keep the checklist, chase the inputs, and hit the date, usually on several projects at once.
You are comfortable in front of customers.
You want to understand how real estate agents, brokers, and MLSs work, and you can learn a technical product fast.
You work easily with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Design, and keep people informed without being asked.
You use AI tools every day and have turned at least one recurring piece of work into a system other people rely on.
You take a project from idea through execution and iteration without being managed closely.
You seek feedback and apply it.
Have a willingness to travel.

Real estate or proptech experience is a plus.

Compensation

Salary band: 130-150k

The salary range does not reflect total compensation, which includes base salary, benefits, and company equity. Compensation for this role depends on several factors including location, work experience, job-related skills, business needs, and market demands.

At this time, we are only considering candidates who are authorized to work in the U.S.

Flexible PTO, plus 10 paid company holidays
401K with a company match
Medical, dental, and vision plans
HSA and FSA options
Commuter benefits
Parental leave
Company-wide onsite or offsite each year
Beautiful office in Soho, Manhattan with a stocked kitchen, catered breakfast and lunch once per week, happy hours and meet-ups

When a 911 call is answered, a detective investigates a case, or a forensic lab processes evidence, there's a good chance our software is working behind the scenes. That's been true for over four decades.

The Senior Demand Generation Manager frequently represents the marketing function in cross-departmental and external engagements, contributes directly to decisions that shape the direction of the area, mentors others, and actively champions Versaterm's values across the teams and work they influence.

What You Do

jobs.description:
About NinjaTech AI

NinjaTech AI builds enterprise-grade agentic AI that runs inside our customer’s own environment. Founded in 2022 and backed by SRI International, DCVC, and Candou Ventures, we're a lean team with our headquarters in Los Altos, California and roughly half our engineering team in Sydney, Australia.

We're building the AI agents that enterprises actually deploy — not demos. Our platform connects to 3,000+ systems, runs on-prem, in-VPC, or air-gapped, and delivers predictable economics that CFOs can live with.

We move fast, we ship, and we don't hide behind process. If you want to define a category rather than inherit one, keep reading.

The Role

This is our first marketing hire. You'll own marketing end to end — strategy and execution — and you'll be the person who builds the function from zero. There's no team to delegate to yet and no playbook to follow. You'll set the narrative, run the channels, and be the connective tissue between our product, our sales team, and the market.

This is a builder's role. You'll write the positioning, launch the campaigns, pitch the press, run the ads, post the content, and then measure what worked and do more of it. As we grow, you'll help us decide what to hire next and how to structure the function.

You'll report directly to the CEO and work side by side with our sales and engineering leads.

What You'll Own

Messaging, Positioning & Brand

Refine our narrative, ideal customer profile (ICP), buyer personas, and category positioning
Own the company's core messaging architecture and keep it consistent across the website, decks, demos, ads, and sales conversations
Translate deeply technical product capabilities into clear, compelling stories for enterprise buyers (CIOs, CTOs, heads of AI, security and procurement teams)
Build and maintain brand guidelines — voice, tone, visual identity, and editorial standards
Manage brand reputation and any crisis or issues communications

Product Marketing & Launches

Lead go-to-market strategy for product launches and feature releases, from positioning through launch day
Write launch briefs, FAQs, internal announcements, and enablement docs
Own product, solution, and use-case pages on the website

Demand Generation & Performance Marketing

Own paid acquisition end to end: Google Ads (Search, Display, Performance Max) and other paid channels
Manage budgets, bids, and creative; optimize for qualified pipeline, not vanity clicks
Build and optimize landing pages and conversion paths
Own SEO strategy and execution — technical SEO, on-page, and content-led organic growth
Run email and lifecycle marketing: nurture sequences, newsletters, and lead scoring

Content & Thought Leadership

Build and run our content engine: blog posts, whitepapers, case studies, ebooks, one-pagers, and technical explainers
Produce content for every stage of the funnel, from top-of-funnel awareness to bottom-of-funnel sales enablement
Turn our founders' and engineers' expertise into published thought leadership
Own the editorial calendar and keep a steady cadence across channels

Public Relations & Communications

Own PR strategy and media relations — build relationships with journalists covering enterprise AI and agentic AI
Write and pitch press releases, media pitches, and bylined articles
Manage awards, analyst briefings (Gartner, Forrester, Constellation), and industry recognition
Handle inbound press inquiries and coordinate executive interviews and speaking engagements

Social Media & Community

Own all social channels (LinkedIn, X/Twitter, YouTube, and others) — strategy, calendar, and daily execution
Build an executive social presence for our founders and leadership
Grow and engage our community of enterprise AI practitioners and developers
Monitor social conversation, engage authentically, and manage our online reputation

Website & Digital Presence

Own website conversion optimization — continuously test and improve landing pages, messaging, CTAs, user journeys, and other conversion points to increase qualified leads and pipeline
Work with design and engineering (internal or contract) to keep the site fast, current, and on-brand
Manage our marketing tech stack: CMS, analytics, marketing automation, CRM integration, and attribution

Sales Enablement & Revenue Support

Build the collateral our sales team needs: pitch decks, one-pagers, case studies, ROI models, and competitive battlecards
Partner with sales on repeatable sales plays and messaging that closes enterprise deals
Support ABM (account-based marketing) efforts against target enterprise accounts
Arm the team for security reviews, RFPs, and procurement conversations with the right materials

Events & Field Marketing

Own our presence at conferences, trade shows, and industry events — from booth strategy to speaking slots
Plan and run our own webinars, roundtables, and executive dinners
Manage event logistics, budgets, and follow-up pipeline
Identify and pursue strategic speaking opportunities for the CEO at relevant industry conferences, panels, summits, and other high-value events to build thought leadership and visibility

Partnerships & Co-Marketing

Identify and execute co-marketing opportunities with technology partners, integrators, and channel partners
Manage joint campaigns, webinars, and content with partners
Support partner enablement with co-branded materials

Analytics, Reporting & Operations

Define the marketing KPIs that matter and report on them regularly to leadership
Own marketing analytics and attribution — know what's driving pipeline and revenue
Manage the marketing budget and allocate spend for maximum return
Build repeatable processes so the function can scale as we add people

B2B and enterprise experience, ideally in SaaS, developer tools, infrastructure, or AI. You understand long sales cycles, technical buyers, and enterprise procurement
A writer first. You can take a complex technical concept and make it land in a sentence. Writing is the core of this job
Full-stack and hands-on. You've run paid campaigns, written content, pitched press, managed social, and optimized a website. You're comfortable being the only marketer in the building
Comfortable with ambiguity. No playbook, no team, no hand-holding. You figure out what matters and go do it

Technically curious. You can get up to speed on agentic AI, integrations, deployment models, and enterprise security without needing an engineer to translate every word
High agency. You spot problems, take ownership, and ship. You don't wait for permission
Strong collaborator. You work well with founders, engineers, and sales, and you build trust fast

jobs.title: Sr. Product Marketing Manager, Go-To-Market
jobs.description:
ABOUT OBLQ

OBLQ builds software for independent insurance agencies, providing technology solutions that help independent P&Cs operate more efficiently and grow faster. We handle the technology so agencies can focus on selling policies and driving revenue. Learn more at oblq.ai.
Same Team. More Agency.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager to help turn our products that deliver for existing customers into a company and category that independent insurance agencies know about, understand, and want to buy.

You'll work directly with the founders and stay close to both the product and our customers. You'll learn how independent agencies operate, what slows their teams down, why they buy, what makes them skeptical, and how OBLQ changes the economics of their business. Then you'll turn those insights into the way we go to market.

You'll own product positioning, messaging, launches, customer stories, sales enablement, competitive intelligence, and much of the content that connects OBLQ to the market.

This is an early-stage role. We have products our customers love, we have great data and measurable results, a brand, and a point of view. We need someone who can take those raw materials and build a repeatable product marketing engine around them.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Position OBLQ and its products.

Develop clear positioning and messaging for OBLQs current and future products. Understand what matters to agency owners & agents, and translate complex product capabilities into simple reasons to care.

Own the product story.

Make sure our website, social presence, sales materials, demos, campaigns, and product launches tell a consistent and compelling story.

Know the customer.

Spend time with independent agency owners and agents. Understand how they generate leads, quote business, work with carriers, use their CRM, follow up with customers, and make technology decisions.

Turn customer outcomes into proof.

Build case studies, customer stories, ROI narratives, testimonials, and other evidence that helps prospective customers understand what OBLQ can do for their agency.

Build sales enablement.

Give the people selling OBLQ what they need to have better conversations: messaging, presentations, one-pagers, competitive positioning, objection handling, demo narratives, follow-up materials, and customer-specific stories.

Own product launches.

Create the go-to-market plan for new capabilities, carrier integrations, product releases, and future OBLQ products. Define the audience, message, channels, assets, and measures of success.

Understand the market.

Know the insurance technology landscape, the alternatives agencies use today, and where OBLQ fits. Track competitors, comparative raters, agency management systems, CRMs, automation products, and emerging technologies that could change the market.

Build content that earns attention.

Create and manage content for the channels where our customers spend time. That may include LinkedIn, customer email, website content, product education, thought leadership, webinars, industry communities, and other formats we discover work.

Improve how we generate demand.

Work across organic, outbound, partnerships, referrals, and paid acquisition to understand which messages and channels create qualified interest. Test quickly, measure results, and keep what works.

Bring the market back into the product.

You won't own the product roadmap, but you'll have an important voice in it. Bring customer feedback, competitive intelligence, win/loss insights, and market signals back into product decisions.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You have experience marketing B2B software products and can show examples where your work changed how a product was understood, sold, adopted, or launched.

You know how to find the useful insight inside a customer conversation and turn it into positioning or messaging people actually understand.

You can explain a complicated product simply without stripping away what makes it valuable.

You understand the difference between describing a feature and explaining why someone should care about it.

You're comfortable creating the strategy and doing the work. At this stage, you may define the launch plan in the morning and write the landing page in the afternoon.

You can work closely with product and engineering teams and become technically fluent enough to market what we're building accurately.

You use data to evaluate your work. You care about pipeline, conversion, engagement, adoption, and revenue more than impressions for their own sake.

You're comfortable operating with incomplete information and creating structure where it doesn't yet exist.

You have strong judgment about brand and messaging. You know when something needs another round of thinking and when it just needs to get into the market so we can learn.

SKILLS WE'RE INTERESTED IN

Working with AI tools to accelerate research, content, experimentation, and execution
B2B SaaS or vertical SaaS
Insurance or insurtech (nice to have)
Products sold to small and midsize businesses
Workflow automation or operational software
Product-led or founder-led companies moving toward a repeatable GTM model
Sales enablement and customer storytelling
Launching new or unfamiliar product categories
Competitive and market research
Demand generation and lifecycle marketing

Insurance experience is not a prerequisite. We care more about your ability to understand a market quickly and turn what you learn into effective product marketing.

HOW WE WORK

Our development cycle is fast. New capabilities can move from idea to working software quickly, which means product marketing needs to stay equally close to the product and the customer.
We value people who understand the problem, form a point of view, communicate it clearly, put it into the market, measure what happens, and improve it.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

A year from now:
An independent agency owner can land on OBLQ and quickly understand what we do, why it's different, and why it matters to their business.
Our positioning and messaging are consistent everywhere a prospect encounters us.
Customer outcomes have become credible stories, proof points, and sales assets.
Product launches have an audience, message, plan, and measurement strategy before they ship.
Sales conversations are supported by strong materials and a clear understanding of customer objections and competitive alternatives.
We know which messages, audiences, and channels create qualified opportunities and we're investing more heavily in the ones that work.
What we're learning in the market is consistently making its way back into the product.
Our product marketing capability is repeatable and can scale with the company.

If you're driven by purpose, energized by innovation, and ready to help shape the future of precision medicine at scale, this is where you belong.

BillionToOne is seeking an experienced Senior Manager, Oncology Product Marketing
to lead the product marketing efforts for our oncology portfolio, including Northstar Select
and Northstar Response
.

As the leader in Oncology Product Marketing, you will be responsible for developing and executing the product marketing strategy - from product positioning and messaging through go-to-market planning and execution.

If you're a passionate product marketing leader with a proven track record of bringing innovative precision diagnostics products to market, enjoy collaborating across diverse teams, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we'd love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Product Positioning & Messaging: Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Management, Sales, and other teams to develop compelling product positioning, messaging, and supporting resources that resonate with target audiences.
Lead Go-to-Market Strategy: Develop and execute go-to-market plans for new product launches and product enhancements, partnering closely with Product, Sales, Marketing, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
Simplify Complex Science: Translate sophisticated clinical products into clear, compelling marketing collateral, including brochures, leave-behinds, trade show materials, advertisements, press releases, and other commercial assets.
Market Research: Conduct in-depth market research and competitive analysis to identify customer needs, market trends, and competitive insights.
External Stakeholder Engagement: Partner with healthcare professionals, Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), patient advocacy organizations, and other external stakeholders to drive product adoption and loyalty.
Internal Partnership: Collaborate closely with Sales, Medical Affairs, and Customer Service to ensure consistent messaging and flawless commercial execution. Serve as the primary product marketing resource for the field organization.
Innovation: Stay ahead of industry trends and bring innovative product marketing best practices from both the precision diagnostics industry and adjacent sectors.

Qualifications

8+ years of Product Marketing experience with a proven track record of developing and executing successful product marketing strategies within precision diagnostics, biotechnology, or healthcare.
Bachelor's degree required; BS or advanced degree in Biology or a related scientific discipline preferred.
Strong strategic thinking and analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex clinical and market data and translate insights into compelling value propositions and commercial strategies.
Deep understanding of product marketing principles, competitive analysis, and market research methodologies.
Experience creating data-driven marketing content and commercial collateral.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and communicate complex concepts clearly.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment.

Benefits And Perks

Working alongside brilliant, kind, passionate and dedicated colleagues, in an empowering environment, toward a global vision, striving for a future in which transformative molecular diagnostics can help millions of patients
Open, transparent culture that includes weekly Town Hall meetings
The ability to indirectly or directly change the lives of hundreds of thousands patients
Multiple medical benefit options; employee premiums paid 100% of select plans, dependents covered up to 80%
Extremely generous Family Bonding Leave for eligible employees (16 weeks, paid at 100%)
Supplemental fertility benefits coverage
Retirement savings program including a 4% Company match
Increase paid time off with increased tenure
Latest and greatest hardware (laptop, lab equipment, facilities)
Daily on-site lunches provided from top eateries
A variety of perks on campus (state of the art gym, restaurant)
Free on-site EV charging (compatible with all EVs, including Tesla)

The base salary range for this role is $85,327 - $106,659. This position is eligible for an annual bonus and receives a new hire equity grant of up to $50,000 at grant value, vesting over four years, plus annual equity refresh grants equal in value to the new hire grant. Together, the total four-year value of base, target bonus, and equity is up to approximately $594,000. We also offer competitive medical and dental coverage and a 401(k) with company match.

BillionToOne is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Content Marketing Lead, Insights
jobs.description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

TRM Labs is building the content engine that makes the market see TRM as the authority on crypto crime and financial-crime intelligence. As Content Marketing Lead for Research & Insights, you will turn the work of our Insights team into reports, articles, and campaigns that customers, journalists, and the wider crime-fighting community read, cite, and act on. You will own a proactive plan for which research stories TRM tells, when, and for whom, and make sure each one reaches the right audience.

The Impact You Will Have

Set the research content agenda. Build and own a proactive editorial plan with the Insights team that decides which findings become flagship reports, blog posts, social content, or media pitches, using AI to scan the research pipeline and surface the stories worth telling.
Turn research into a content engine. Carry findings from concept to published, distributed content and handle roughly 1 to 3 pieces a week, using AI workflows across review, drafting, and repurposing so quality holds as volume grows.
Decide the argument, then let AI accelerate production. Shape and pressure-test each narrative and its data yourself, then use AI to draft variants, headlines, and channel-specific cuts so more of your time goes to judgment and less to production.
Own distribution for everything you produce. Plan how each piece reaches its audience before it publishes, push it across owned, paid, and earned channels, and use AI to tailor it for social, the newsletter, and executive voice.
Grow TRM's search and AI-citation visibility. Produce the content that makes TRM the cited authority on priority themes, and use SEO and GEO tooling to find gaps and measure what moves.
Support media outreach. Work alongside TRM's head of Comms on journalist outreach for research releases, feed what you learn from coverage back into the content plan, and tune what works for the next release.

What We're Looking For

5+ years of B2B content marketing, editorial, or research-communications experience, with a portfolio of data- or research-based point-of-view work.
An AI-native approach: you use AI across research review, drafting, repurposing, and optimization, and you build workflows others can reuse.
Strong editorial judgment and the ability to strengthen complex, technical narratives without sacrificing accuracy, including when AI produced the first draft.
Experience owning a piece end to end, from concept through publication and distribution, and proactively planning content rather than only fulfilling requests.
A distribution mindset, with comfort using AI and analytics to measure and improve how content performs.
The ability to translate technical, data-driven material into clear, engaging content, using AI to adapt tone and format for different audiences.

About The Team

You will join Content & Brand Marketing within GTM Marketing, working hand in hand with the Insights team in Primary Intelligence and with Demand Gen and Comms.
The work is dedicated to data and research-based storytelling: TRM's credibility depends on the market seeing our intelligence and domain expertise, and this role scales that output.
It is a small, senior, AI-native team that expects ownership, pace, and strong judgment, and gives you real latitude to decide what TRM should be known for.
The hard part is intellectual: challenging researchers, finding the angle that makes a finding matter, and keeping quality high as volume grows.

Team Operating Rhythms

Distributed, not distant: the team works across the US and Europe/UK and keeps collaboration-hours overlap so ideas move quickly.
Async-first communication with regular syncs; the editorial calendar is the team's shared source of truth.
Close, continuous partnership with researchers, Demand Gen, and Comms rather than handoffs.
AI is part of the daily workflow, not an afterthought.

Required Online And Collaboration Hours

Schedule: Overlap with US-based team collaboration hours; specific hours confirmed at offer.

Travel Requirements

Schedule: Minimal; occasional team or event travel.
Frequency: Occasional.

Onsite Requirements

Schedule: None; fully remote.
Frequency: None.

Learn About TRM Speed In This Position

In your first 30 days, publish a research piece end to end, from concept to distribution, with a plan for how it reaches its audience.
Within 60 days, stand up an AI-assisted production workflow that lets the team ship 1 to 3 research pieces a week without adding headcount.
Within 90 days, move a flagship finding from idea to press-ready and placed, measurably lifting reach and search or AI-citation visibility on a priority theme.

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:

Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only.
The estimated base salary range for this role is $140,000-$188,000.
Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.
Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.
Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.
First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.
Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.
References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.
Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.
Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI Fluency Means You Are Among The Top 10 Percent Of Operators In Your Function In How You Apply AI To

Accelerate repeatable workflows
Structure and solve problems
Improve output quality
Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, You Should Expect

Priorities and targets to change quickly
Operating with a high degree of ambiguity
A high level of personal ownership and accountability
Close collaboration across teams and functions
Frequent, high-touch communication
Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking
A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.
Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.
Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy And Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

jobs.title: Paid Media Buyer - NAM
jobs.description:
Description

Regional Media Buyer — Paid Media

Description

At Xe, we live currencies. We provide a comprehensive range of currency services and products, including our Currency Converter, Market Analysis, Currency Data API and quick, easy, secure Money Transfers for individuals and businesses. We leverage technology to deliver these services through our website, mobile app and by phone. Last year, we helped over 300 million people access information about the currencies that matter to them and over 225,000 people used us to send money overseas.

About This Role

We are looking for a Regional Media Buyer to build, launch, and optimise paid media campaigns for your assigned region. This is a hands-on execution role at the core of how Xe acquires customers. Day to day, you will be inside the platforms — building campaigns, managing budgets, and tracking performance across Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and Apple Search Ads.

Xe runs paid media as a centralised, best-practice-led function. That means you will not be inventing your own way of doing things in isolation: you will execute against shared briefs, campaign structures, and naming conventions, apply the standards the global paid media team sets, and keep your region's setup consistent with the rest of the business. Your value is in flawless, fast, and accurate execution — campaigns that go live correctly, budgets that pace to plan, and data that everyone can trust.

We believe in using AI to optimise how we work. We want someone who is AI-forward — using it to build smarter systems and integrations, speed up competitor research, and take the manual weight out of execution and reporting — while keeping their own judgment firmly in the driver's seat. AI is a tool that makes a sharp buyer sharper; it is not a substitute for understanding the platforms, the data, and the strategy behind the work.

You will report to the Global Manager of Paid Media and work closely with the other regional buyers, as well as with design, analytics, and the wider marketing team. This is a strong role for someone early in their paid media career who wants to go deep on execution across every major channel and grow within a global team.

OUR PRINCIPLES

AMBITION - We dream big, try things out and always ask "why not?" and "what if?" We're ambitious in our thinking and our delivery.

RESPONSIBILITY - We get involved, bring our perspective, and are always open to new ideas. We take personal responsibility.

COMMUNITY - We value a sense of belonging, trusting each other and encouraging authenticity. We contribute to our community.

Roles & Responsibilities

Building & Executing Campaigns

Build, launch, and manage paid campaigns across Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display, and YouTube), Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and Apple Search Ads for your assigned region.
Set up campaigns to the shared standard — consistent structures, naming conventions, tracking, and audience/keyword configuration — so your region's account is clean, organized, and easy to read.
Write and traffic ad copy, keywords, audiences, and creative assets into each platform, and coordinate with design to get the assets you need on time.
Turn briefs from the global paid media team into live, correctly configured campaigns, and get them to market quickly and accurately.

Optimization & Best Practices

Stay current on platform changes, new ad formats, beta features, and best-practice updates across Google, Meta, TikTok, and Apple Search Ads, and put them into practice in your accounts.
Run day-to-day optimization — bids, budgets, audiences, keywords, negatives, placements, and creative rotation — to improve performance against targets.
Support and execute structured tests (creative, audience, bidding, landing page) and document what you learn so it can be applied across regions.
Flag opportunities and risks early and bring ideas for what to try next.

Working AI-Forward

Use AI tools to work faster and smarter — drafting and iterating ad copy, generating and analyzing competitor research, summarizing performance data, and taking the repetitive work out of setup and reporting.
Look for ways to build AI into your systems, integrations, and workflows so your region runs more efficiently, and share what works with the wider paid media team.
Apply your own judgment to everything AI produces — validating outputs, sense-checking against the data, and owning the final decision. We want AI accelerating your work, not doing your job for you.

Budget Management

Manage and pace campaign budgets to plan — monitor daily and weekly spend, avoid over- and under-delivery, and reallocate within your region as performance dictates.
Keep accurate records of spend by channel and campaign, and reconcile against the plan.
Escalate pacing issues, budget shortfalls, or unexpected cost changes promptly.

Data Tracking & Reporting

Own accurate tracking for your campaigns — UTMs, conversion tracking, and correct tagging — so results are measured cleanly and consistently.
Pull performance data from each platform and Xe's reporting tools, and maintain clear, up-to-date reporting on the metrics that matter (spend, CAC, conversions, and channel efficiency).
Use the shared measurement framework and metric definitions so your region's numbers line up with the rest of the business.
Surface insights from the data — what's working, what isn't, and what you'd change — in regular reporting to the Global Manager of Paid Media.

Position Requirements

1–3 years of hands-on experience building and managing paid media campaigns, ideally in-house or at an agency.
Direct, in-platform experience with at least two of Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and Apple Search Ads, and the appetite to become strong across all four.
Comfortable building campaigns from scratch — structures, keywords/audiences, ad copy, and tracking — and keeping accounts organized and consistent.
Solid understanding of paid media fundamentals: bidding, budgeting, audience targeting, and the core metrics (CPC, CPA/CAC, ROAS, conversion rate).
Experience managing and pacing campaign budgets, with a careful, detail-oriented approach to spend.
Comfortable working with data: pulling performance reports, setting up conversion tracking and UTMs, and reading results accurately.
Highly organised and reliable, able to manage multiple live campaigns at once and follow shared processes and standards closely.
Eager to keep up with a fast-changing landscape and put new platform features and best practices into use.
AI-forward: you actively use AI tools to speed up execution, research, and reporting, and to build better systems and integrations — while relying on your own judgment to check the output and make the calls.
Strong communicator who can report clearly on performance and collaborate across a distributed team.
Experience with Google Analytics, Looker, or similar reporting/BI tools is a plus.
Experience in fintech, payments, financial services, or another regulated, multi-market business is a plus.

Perks & Benefits

Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
401K Plan with Match
Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Paid Vacation / Sick Leave
Hybrid Work Schedule
Tuition Assistance
Growth Opportunities
Corporate gatherings, team bonding events, and much more!
Plumm Mental Health and Wellbeing
Volunteering day for a charity of your choice

Xe offers a competitive salary and benefits package. The reasonable estimated pay for this (Salary Exempt or Non-exempt hourly rate) role ranges from $110,000- $130,000. Actual compensation is based upon factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, Xe offers comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental and vision benefits, a 401(K) plan, Paid Vacation / Sick Leave and more.
