jobs.description:
About Legence

Legence (Nasdaq: LGN) is a leading provider of engineering, consulting, installation, and maintenance services for mission-critical systems in buildings. The company specializes in designing, fabricating, and installing complex HVAC, process piping, and other mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems—enhancing energy efficiency, reliability, and sustainability in new and existing facilities. Legence also delivers long-term performance through strategic upgrades and holistic solutions. Serving some of the world’s most technically demanding sectors, Legence counts over 60% of the Nasdaq-100 Index among its clients.

Content Development & Social Media Manager

Reports to: Vice President, Marketing, Legence
Position Type: Direct-Hire / Full-Time
Location: Remote; Ability to Travel up to 10%

Position Overview

Legence is seeking an experienced Content Development & Social Media Manager to lead the development and activation of compelling content across Legence and its portfolio of Business Unit brands.

This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role for a strong writer, storyteller, and social media strategist who can translate complex technical expertise, projects, and business priorities into clear, engaging content for a range of audiences and channels.

This individual will help bring consistency and scale to social media across a multi-brand organization. They will partner closely with Business Unit marketing contacts, subject matter experts, executives, creative resources, communications, and the enterprise marketing team to strengthen the visibility of Legence and its companies while preserving the distinct expertise and voice of each brand.

Experience within construction, engineering, architecture, consulting, energy, the built environment or another complex B2B industry is strongly preferred.

Key Responsibilities

Content Strategy & Development

Develop high-quality content that strengthens the visibility, reputation, and market positioning of Legence and its Business Units.
Proactively identify compelling stories, projects, expertise, trends, and perspectives from across the enterprise and turn them into meaningful marketing content.
Write and edit content across a variety of formats, including:
Website and landing page copy
Thought leadership articles
Case studies and project profiles
Social media content
Executive and subject matter expert thought leadership
Email and digital campaigns
Industry and end-market content
Marketing collateral
Video scripts and supporting copy
Press releases
Campaign messaging

Interview executives, technical leaders, subject matter experts and project teams to develop credible, differentiated content.
Translate complex engineering, construction, maintenance, sustainability, energy, and technical concepts into clear, compelling stories for both technical and nontechnical audiences.
Repurpose strong content across multiple formats and channels to extend its value and reach.
Maintain editorial quality and ensure content reflects appropriate voice, messaging and brand standards while recognizing the distinct identities of individual Business Units.
Partner with marketing, communications, and creative teams to identify opportunities for integrated campaigns and storytelling.

Social Media Strategy & Management

Help lead and execute social media strategy across Legence and supported Business Unit brands, working alongside the communications team who leads culture, recruiting, and investor related content.
Develop and maintain editorial calendars in collaboration with Business Unit marketing contacts, communications, and enterprise stakeholders.
Manage the development, review, approval, scheduling, and publishing of social content.
This role is not managing direct reports or a team.
Draft and edit social copy spanning corporate and industry content, projects, thought leadership, services, and Business Unit stories.
Adapt content appropriately across Legence and Business Unit channels while maintaining alignment with enterprise brand and messaging standards.
Manage day-to-day social media workflows using Sprout Social and Asana.
Coordinate with creative resources on social graphics, photography, video, and other visual assets.
Support employee advocacy and amplification programs designed to expand the reach of Legence and Business Unit content.
Monitor social channels, comments, messages, mentions and relevant industry conversations, escalating issues when appropriate.
Identify opportunities to amplify strong Business Unit stories across enterprise channels.

Campaigns & Digital Content

Partner with the broader marketing team to develop integrated content campaigns supporting priority markets, services, business initiatives and growth objectives.
Develop content that can be activated across social, web, email, thought leadership and other digital channels.
Support campaign development and execution through HubSpot, where appropriate.
Collaborate with marketing and Business Unit teams on targeted thought leadership and campaigns tied to services and priority market sectors.
Apply SEO and emerging AI-search/GEO best practices to digital content to strengthen discoverability.
Identify opportunities to extend the life and value of content by strategically repurposing it across audiences, brands and channels.

Analytics & Optimization

Track and evaluate content and social performance to understand which topics, formats and channels generate the strongest engagement and results.
Use insights from Sprout Social, web analytics, HubSpot, and other available platforms to continuously improve content strategy.
Evaluate performance across content categories, formats and Business Units.
Translate data and performance trends into clear recommendations for future content, campaigns and channel strategy, aligning with Legence’s Data and Analytics Manager.

Qualifications

Required

5–8 years of professional experience in content development, content marketing, social media, digital marketing, communications, or a related discipline.
Exceptional writing, editing and storytelling skills, with a portfolio demonstrating the ability to communicate complex subjects clearly and compellingly.
Demonstrated experience developing content for multiple formats, audiences, and digital channels.
Hands-on experience managing corporate or B2B social media channels and editorial calendars.
Strong understanding of how content, social media, and digital channels work together to build brand visibility and support broader business objectives.
Excellent project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple simultaneous priorities and deadlines.
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to develop productive relationships across functions, businesses, and levels of an organization.
Ability to work independently, proactively identify opportunities, and move projects forward without extensive direction.

Preferred

Experience within construction, engineering, architecture, consulting, energy, sustainability, commercial real estate or another technical B2B environment.
Experience working within a multi-brand, multi-business or decentralized enterprise organization.
Experience supporting multiple businesses with different audiences, priorities, and levels of internal marketing support.
Experience with Sprout Social or a comparable enterprise social media management platform.
Experience with Asana or another enterprise work management platform.
Experience with HubSpot or comparable marketing automation technology.
Familiarity with web CMS platforms, SEO, AI search/GEO principles, digital analytics and content performance measurement.
Experience developing executive and subject matter expert thought leadership.
Experience supporting employee advocacy or social amplification programs.
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, English, Public Relations or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

Compensation

Suggested salary range: $115,000-$130,000

Benefits Overview

Currently match contributions dollar-for-dollar up to 4% of eligible pay; immediate vesting.

Health & Welfare Benefits:
Employer provided medical, dental, vision, prescription drug, Employee Assistance Program and accident & illness coverage.

Life and Disability Insurance
: Employer provided basic life insurance and AD&D valued at 50K coverage amount with the option for voluntary buy up for additional coverage.

Time Off:
Flexible non-accrual vacation; company holidays per policy. (For California employees, this is separate from California paid sick leave, if applicable.)

Expenses
: Business travel and related expenses reimbursed per company policy.

Reasonable Accommodations

If you need assistance or accommodations during the application or interview process, please contact us at ta@wearelegence.com or your dedicated recruiter with the job title and requisition number.

Employment Eligibility

Candidates must have current work authorization in the U.S.; visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Legence and its affiliates do not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies; any such submissions without a prior signed agreement authorized by Legence Holdings LLC's CHRO or Director of Talent Acquisition will not incur fees and are considered property of Legence.

Pay Disclosure & Considerations

We are committed to ensuring fair and competitive compensation for all employees and comply with all applicable salary transparency laws.

Position Overview

Riviera Dining Group is seeking a creative, visually driven, and highly organized Social Media Manager to oversee social media execution across its hospitality brands. This role requires a strong understanding of social media, nightlife culture, luxury hospitality, and visual storytelling, with the ability to capture compelling content and translate live experiences into engaging digital narratives.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable managing online communities, capturing on-site content, curating photoshoots and video shoots, and collaborating with internal teams to ensure key events, offerings, and activations are effectively communicated and promoted across social platforms. This individual must also demonstrate strong communication and critical thinking skills, proactively identify opportunities for improvement, and confidently bring forward strategic proposals and solutions that support business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Social Media & Community Management

Manage daily community engagement across assigned brand social media accounts, including responding to direct messages, comments, tags, and guest inquiries in a timely and professional manner
Maintain each brand’s unique tone of voice, visual identity, and digital presence
Actively engage with influencers, DJs, tastemakers, industry professionals, and relevant local communities to build brand awareness and strengthen online engagement
Monitor social media activity, identify relevant trends, and participate in timely conversations that align with each brand
Ensure all social media interactions reflect RDG’s standards of luxury hospitality and guest experience

On-Site Event Coverage & Content Creation

Attend on-site events, activations, and special events to capture real-time social content

Identify compelling moments, details, and experiences that translate into engaging Instagram Stories, Reels, and other social-first content
Publish timely, engaging Stories and live updates during events while maintaining each brand’s established visual direction
Stay informed about nightlife culture, music trends, and relevant events to identify opportunities for engaging and culturally relevant content

Identify content opportunities that support upcoming campaigns, seasonal initiatives, menu launches, brand storytelling, and key promotional moments

Ensure all produced content aligns with brand guidelines, creative direction, and the intended aesthetic of each venue
Review captured assets and collaborate with the creative team to identify the strongest selects for social media use

Content Planning & Promotional Coordination

Manage the timely development and execution of social media content calendars across assigned brands
Proficiency in scheduling platforms, managing content calendars, and ensuring posts are scheduled accurately and published on time
Collaborate with the graphic design, video, and project management teams to ensure consistent communication and promotion of key activations, special events, collaborations, and announcements
Ensure promotional messaging, announcements, lineup releases, and supporting creative assets are aligned across relevant social media platforms and published according to established timelines
Proactively communicate upcoming promotional priorities and content needs to ensure all key events and initiatives receive appropriate social media support
Manage content ideation, trend research, caption writing, and creative planning
Maintain an organized content library, ensuring assets are properly labeled, uploaded, and accessible to the wider team
Ensure content calendars and scheduled posts are maintained and updated in accordance with team workflows and deadlines

Editing & Creative Execution

Ensure all content maintains a cohesive visual identity, appropriate pacing, and a high standard of quality
Collaborate with videographers, photographers, and graphic designers to refine assets and deliver polished, on-brand content
Stay current on editing techniques, trending formats, and creative tools to enhance the quality and relevance of social content

Strategic Thinking & Development

Proactively identify opportunities to improve social media performance, audience engagement, brand visibility, and the overall digital presence of assigned brands

Apply critical thinking to assess challenges, evaluate opportunities, and recommend effective approaches to social media strategy, content execution, and promotional initiatives
Collaborate with internal teams to identify opportunities for event promotion, brand partnerships, audience growth, and increased guest engagement
Communicate recommendations clearly, support ideas with relevant insights or performance data when available, and follow through on approved initiatives
Stay informed about industry trends, competitor activity, and emerging opportunities relevant to luxury hospitality and nightlife

Performance & Reporting

Monitor social media engagement, reach, views, and audience growth across assigned accounts
Identify high-performing content formats and opportunities to improve engagement and audience development
Contribute insights and recommendations to monthly social media reporting and future content strategies
Evaluate the performance of event promotions, creative campaigns, and content initiatives to inform future planning

Scheduling tools: Proficiency in scheduling platforms, managing content calendars, and ensuring posts are scheduled accurately and published on time

Excellent communication and critical thinking skills, with the ability to articulate ideas, collaborate effectively across teams, and approach challenges with sound judgment

jobs.description:
JOB TITLE

Director of Growth Marketing

LOCATION

Worcester

DEPARTMENT NAME

Marketing Communications

DIVISION NAME

Worcester Polytechnic Institute - WPI

Job Description Summary

The Director of Growth Marketing is a member of WPI's in-house team of experts in marketing strategy, messaging, creative, social media, multimedia, and production management. Under the direction of the AVP of Marketing Communications and in collaboration with campus partners, this team leads WPI's integrated brand strategy and the campaigns that support it. With a heavy focus on student enrollment, the Director of Growth Marketing leads strategy and execution of demand generation initiatives that drive awareness, inquiries, and student pipeline growth across undergraduate and graduate studies and pre-collegiate programs.

Job Description

Growth Strategy

Lead the university's enrollment growth marketing strategy across the full student acquisition funnel, driving awareness, audience acquisition, inquiries, engagement, and pipeline growth through integrated multichannel campaigns, digital nurture programs, and performance optimization across paid, owned, experiential, and CRM-enabled channels.
Develop and lead pre-college engagement and retention strategies that cultivate long-term enrollment pipelines, progressing students from WPI middle school and high school programs toward undergraduate inquiry, application, and enrollment.
Develop audience segmentation and targeting approaches for prospective students, families, counselors, educators, and other key enrollment influencers, including guidance counselors, superintendents, STEM coordinators, and STEM-focused student organizations.
Drive innovation through experimentation, testing, and evaluation of emerging channels, technologies, and audience engagement strategies to improve enrollment marketing performance.

Campaigns, Channels & Execution

Lead integrated omnichannel enrollment marketing campaigns.
Lead planning, execution, optimization, and performance management of enrollment marketing campaigns in partnership with Creative and Digital Operations teams.
Lead strategy for enrollment marketing platforms and third-party lead generation ecosystems (e.g., Niche, CollegeVine, U.S. News & World Report), maximizing visibility, engagement, and ROI.
Drive continuous improvement of enrollment marketing assets and campaign experiences in partnership with Creative and Digital Operations teams.
Work with partners in Admissions to design and optimize CRM-enabled nurture programs and omnichannel student journeys that improve engagement, conversion, and enrollment outcomes.

Experiential & Partnership Marketing

Lead recruitment-focused experiential marketing initiatives, including conferences, competitions, trade shows, robotics events, and other strategic activations.
Manage external marketing partnerships and sponsorships that support prospective student engagement and enrollment growth.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Lead a team of two marketing professionals, cultivating talent, collaboration, high performance, and a data-driven culture focused on growth and measurable outcomes.
Lead cross-functional planning and execution across Admissions, Marketing Communications, Creative, Digital Operations, university stakeholders, agencies, and vendors to deliver integrated enrollment marketing initiatives and measurable business outcomes.
Partner with Undergraduate and Graduate Admissions leadership to align enrollment marketing strategies, recruitment priorities, and institutional enrollment goals.
Represent the Marketing team in leadership settings and in interactions with stakeholders within the campus community.
Provide direction, prioritization, and performance oversight across enrollment marketing campaigns, initiatives, and investments.
In partnership with the Creative Director and aligned with the university brand, ensure consistent application of positioning and messaging across recruitment marketing initiatives.

Data, Analytics & Performance

Use analytics, attribution, and performance insights to optimize marketing investment and campaign effectiveness.
Monitor and report regularly on funnel performance, inquiry growth, campaign ROI, and pipeline contribution.
Establish testing frameworks and performance benchmarks across creative, audience targeting, messaging, and conversion strategies.
Use AI-enabled tools and predictive insights to improve targeting, personalization, operational efficiency, and enrollment marketing outcomes.
Performs all other duties and responsibilities as assigned or directed by the supervisor.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree required.
A minimum of eight years of progressive experience in growth marketing, enrollment marketing, demand generation, or related marketing disciplines, including at least three years of supervisory experience.

Overview

The Social Media Marketing Manager (Contract) will be responsible for developing and executing social media strategies to enhance brand awareness, foster customer engagement, drive online reviews, and support business objectives. This hands-on role requires a creative, resourceful, and results-driven professional who can operate within a fast-paced environment, leveraging low-cost platforms and cost-efficient tactics to maximize impact for a small company.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy Development: Design and implement a comprehensive social media strategy aligned with Lavu’s goals and budget, focusing on platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Linkedin, Google reviews and X to increase brand visibility, customer engagement.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Success Of The Social Media Marketing Manager Will Be Measured By The Following SMART KPIs, Tailored To Lavu’s Objectives And The Contract’s Temporary Nature

Strategy Execution:

Deliver a documented social media strategy targeting 2-3 platforms with defined goals (e.g., 10-15% increase in brand awareness and making sure we have a minimum of 12 new 4.5 ave Google reviews each month).
Achieve a 10-15% increase in brand awareness metrics (e.g., follower count, impressions, mentions) by contract end.

Content Performance:

Publish 3-5 high-quality posts per week per platform, with an average engagement rate of 3-5% per post.
Produce 12-20 posts monthly per platform, with 50% original content and 50% curated or repurposed.

Audience Engagement:

Maintain a 90% response rate to comments and messages within 24 hours.
Increase Google reviews by 15-25% through social media prompts.

Paid Advertising:

Assist with the paid advertising team’s needs.

Analytics & Insights:

Submit monthly performance reports at month-end, including 2-3 actionable recommendations.
Drive a 10-15% increase in website traffic from social media referrals.

Trend Integration:

Incorporate 1 trending format or feature monthly, achieving 20% higher engagement than average posts.

Provide 1-2 trend updates or training sessions per quarter to the team.

jobs.description:
Additional Location(s):
US-MN-Arden Hills

Diversity - Innovation - Caring - Global Collaboration - Winning Spirit - High Performance

At Boston Scientific, we’ll give you the opportunity to harness all that’s within you by working in teams of diverse and high-performing employees, tackling some of the most important health industry challenges. With access to the latest tools, information and training, we’ll help you in advancing your skills and career. Here, you’ll be supported in progressing – whatever your ambitions.

About The Role

Boston Scientific is seeking a strategic, results-driven Director, Commercial Marketing & Launch Excellence to lead global downstream marketing and the field-based Ultrasound Specialist organization supporting our Imaging portfolio.

In this highly visible leadership role, you will shape and execute commercial strategies that accelerate revenue growth, expand market adoption and strengthen the customer experience across innovative ultrasound and imaging technologies. You will translate portfolio priorities into actionable go-to-market strategies, lead commercialization initiatives and build organizational capabilities that support long-term business growth.

As a key member of the Imaging leadership team, you will collaborate with Product Management, Sales, Research and Development (R&D), Clinical, Regulatory, Quality, Medical Education and regional marketing teams to deliver successful product launches, advance clinical adoption and improve commercial performance. You will also lead and develop a team of clinical imaging experts who support physicians and customers through product launches, clinical education, procedural integration and sustained technology adoption.

This opportunity offers the ability to influence global commercial strategy, develop high-performing teams and help bring innovative imaging technologies to more physicians and patients.

Work Mode

At Boston Scientific, we value collaboration and synergy. This role follows a hybrid work model requiring employees to be in our local office at least three days per week.

Relocation Assistance:

Relocation assistance is not available for this position at this time.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Commercial strategy and business leadership

Lead the global downstream marketing strategy for the Imaging portfolio, establishing annual and long-term commercial priorities, objectives, resource allocation and performance measures.
Drive revenue growth, market share expansion, customer adoption and portfolio performance through strategic planning and cross-functional execution.
Evaluate market dynamics, competitive trends, customer needs and emerging opportunities to inform commercial strategies and investment priorities.
Represent downstream marketing in strategic planning, annual operating plans, portfolio reviews and business investment decisions.
Establish performance expectations, monitor business outcomes and implement strategies to address risks, accelerate growth and improve commercial effectiveness.

Product launch and commercialization

Lead downstream commercialization strategies for new imaging products, platform releases, software enhancements and clinical applications.
Define go-to-market strategies, customer segmentation, product positioning, messaging, launch objectives and success measures.
Partner with cross-functional leaders to ensure commercial, clinical, operational and field readiness for successful product launches.
Establish launch governance and performance metrics to evaluate customer adoption, product utilization, commercial results and opportunities for improvement.
Advance commercialization excellence by strengthening launch processes, organizational capabilities and cross-functional collaboration.

Ultrasound Specialist leadership

Lead, develop and retain a high-performing, field-based Ultrasound Specialist organization supporting the Imaging portfolio.
Define organizational structure, staffing strategies, geographic coverage, deployment priorities and capability development plans.
Establish competency standards, training requirements, performance expectations and succession plans to build clinical expertise and organizational effectiveness.
Ensure consistent, high-quality clinical support for product launches, physician education, procedural adoption, workflow integration and ongoing customer success.
Align Ultrasound Specialist resources with commercial priorities, customer needs and market growth opportunities.
Build scalable field capabilities that support evolving technologies, clinical applications and business requirements.

Clinical Adoption And Customer Experience

Lead strategies that strengthen physician confidence, customer proficiency and sustained utilization of imaging technologies.
Establish priorities and performance measures for clinical adoption, customer education, workflow integration and account development initiatives.
Partner with Sales, Clinical, Medical Education and Ultrasound Specialists to identify adoption barriers and implement effective solutions.
Translate customer feedback and field insights into actionable commercial priorities, product enhancement recommendations and continuous improvement initiatives.
Promote a consistent, high-quality experience for physicians, clinicians and patients through coordinated cross-functional engagement.

Sales enablement and market development

Define strategies and standards for sales enablement resources, competitive positioning, customer-facing materials and clinical value messaging.
Lead market development initiatives that expand physician awareness, procedural utilization, customer engagement and market penetration.
Partner with Sales Training and Medical Education to strengthen field capabilities, product knowledge and commercial readiness.
Ensure consistent, accurate and compliant communication of clinical, technical and economic value propositions.
Identify and prioritize emerging customer segments, clinical applications and market opportunities to support sustainable growth.

Physician and external engagement

Build and maintain strategic relationships with physicians, key opinion leaders, professional societies, customers and industry partners.
Collaborate with Clinical and Medical Affairs on physician education, advisory boards, evidence dissemination and customer engagement initiatives.
Represent the Imaging business at strategic customer meetings, industry events and professional society engagements.
Serve as a commercial leader and subject matter expert, providing strategic recommendations to senior leadership.

Cross-functional and organizational leadership

Provide strategic direction and decision-making accountability across downstream marketing and field-based clinical specialist organizations.
Influence and align global stakeholders across Marketing, Sales, R&D, Clinical, Regulatory, Quality, Operations, Finance and Medical Education.
Establish clear decision rights, functional responsibilities and operating processes to improve collaboration and execution.
Develop organizational talent, strengthen leadership capabilities and establish succession plans that support long-term business needs.
Foster a culture of accountability, customer focus, innovation, collaboration and continuous improvement.
Balance near-term commercial performance with long-term market development, organizational capability building and resource stewardship.

Quality and compliance

Champion patient safety, product quality and compliance with Boston Scientific policies, quality system requirements and applicable regulations.
Ensure marketing, promotional, educational and customer-facing activities align with approved product claims and regulatory requirements.
Establish effective oversight and escalation processes for quality, regulatory and compliance matters identified through customer interactions and field activities.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree.
Minimum of 10 years' progressive experience in medical device marketing, product management, sales, commercialization or related commercial functions, including a minimum of 5 years' leadership experience with accountability for people management, budgets and organizational performance.
Demonstrated success developing downstream commercial strategies that drive revenue growth, product adoption and business performance.
Proven experience leading commercialization initiatives, product launches and cross-functional programs in complex organizations.
Demonstrated ability to build, develop and lead high-performing teams in a matrixed business environment.
Strong strategic thinking, executive communication, decision-making and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Master of Business Administration (MBA) or other advanced degree.
Experience in cardiovascular, electrophysiology, structural heart, ultrasound, imaging or image-guided therapy technologies.
Experience commercializing capital equipment, software, artificial intelligence-enabled technologies or integrated medical device platforms.
Experience leading field-based clinical specialist organizations and complex global product launches.
Strong understanding of physician adoption, clinical workflows, procedural integration and health care market dynamics.
Demonstrated ability to translate customer insights, clinical needs and market opportunities into measurable commercial results.
Experience developing organizational capabilities, talent pipelines and succession plans across global teams.

Build the insurance behind the physical world.

The world is building data centers, energy projects, hospitals, schools, and critical infrastructure. Every one of those projects needs insurance to move forward. Yet the process of getting that insurance still depends on scattered documents, manual work, and weeks of back-and-forth.

Real problems. Real ownership.

Our engineers, designers, underwriters, and actuaries build together. The problems span turning messy documents into reliable data, making pricing more precise, and designing AI agents that can take on increasingly complex underwriting work.

The ambition is a platform where experts spend more time on judgment and relationships, supported by software that handles the work around them. Join us to build systems whose decisions help real projects get built.

630+ customers / $500B+ insured project value

Our investors

Capital to build. Partners to grow with.

$67M total funding / $42M Series B in March 2026

Shepherd is backed by Intact Private Capital, Costanoa Ventures, Spark Capital, Susa Ventures, and Y Combinator. In March 2026, we announced a $42M Series B led by Intact Private Capital, bringing our total funding to $67M.

Intact is also a capacity partner. Alongside its investment, Intact works with Shepherd to bring insurance products to market. That relationship connects our platform and underwriting expertise with the resources of a global insurer.

A bigger opportunity ahead

We are investing in new insurance products, our underwriting team, and the path toward autonomous underwriting. For the people joining Shepherd, that means the chance to shape both the technology and the business it makes possible.

Our backing brings together investors who build technology companies and partners who understand insurance. We are building a company that earns the confidence of both.

Director of Marketing

About The Role

As Director of Marketing, you will own how Shepherd reaches and engages commercial insurance brokers, both online and in person. Brokers are our distribution channel, and marketing in commercial insurance has historically been limited. We think there's an opportunity to do things differently.

You'll build our brand, develop content that brokers actually want to engage with, and run events that bring the right people together. You'll work closely with underwriting, business development, and leadership to make sure our marketing programs are reaching the right brokers and ultimately driving more submissions.

This is a hands-on role. You'll set the strategy, run programs yourself, experiment with new ideas, and build the team as we grow.

In This Role, You Will

Field marketing and events

Build our events program, from smaller broker dinners and roundtables to roadshows and activations at major industry conferences.
Work with underwriting and business development to identify the right brokers, offices, and markets to target.
Create repeatable event playbooks that our teams can run across different regions, with clear follow-up and measurement.
Come up with new ways to bring brokers together and give them a reason to spend time with Shepherd.

Content and digital marketing

Own our content strategy across LinkedIn, email, newsletters, and other channels where we can reach brokers.
Work with underwriters and other subject matter experts to create content that's useful, interesting, and relevant to our audience.
Build campaigns that keep Shepherd top of mind with brokers, whether they've never worked with us or submit regularly.
Experiment with different formats and channels, measure what works, and double down on the ones that drive engagement.

Brand marketing

Build Shepherd's brand in the commercial insurance market, particularly among the brokerages and producers we want to work with.
Develop creative campaigns that help us stand out from traditional carriers and MGAs.
Own how Shepherd shows up across our events, content, campaigns, and other marketing channels.
Find new ways to get Shepherd in front of the right audience, beyond the standard insurance marketing playbook.

Measurement and team

Work with revenue operations and analytics to measure the impact of our programs, from broker engagement to first submission and repeat submissions.
Own marketing priorities, budgets, and reporting. Know what's working, what's not, and where we should invest more.
Hire, coach, and grow the marketing team, and manage the agencies and vendors behind our programs.

About You

You're a marketing leader who wants to build something from the ground up. You've run successful events, built brands, and developed content that gets people to pay attention. You understand how marketing can support a relationship-driven business, and you can point to programs you've built and the results they produced.

You're creative, but you're also an operator. You like coming up with ideas, and you care just as much about getting them done. You're excited by the opportunity to do your best work in an industry where there's still a lot of room to try something new.

You'd be a great fit if you have:

8+ years in B2B marketing, including experience owning programs or leading teams at a high-growth company.
A track record of building and running field marketing programs, including proprietary events, conferences, and other in-person activations.
Strong content marketing experience, including developing content strategies and growing engagement across digital channels.
Good brand instincts. You know what makes a company stand out, and you've helped build a brand that people recognize and trust.
Experience marketing to a professional audience, particularly in a business where relationships matter.
A data-driven approach. You set goals, measure results, and change course when something isn't working.
Creativity, hustle, and strong execution. You come up with ideas, do the work to bring them to life, and aren't afraid to try something that hasn't been done before.
AI-native working habits. You use AI tools to move faster, produce content, and find better ways to run programs.
Experience in insurance, insurtech, fintech, construction tech, or another B2B industry is a plus, but not required.

How we work

Shepherd runs on four values. Here's what each one means in this seat.

Think big, build big. We exist to protect progress and the industries that rely on it. The work here is aimed at a system that runs on its own, and the roadmap gets sequenced backward from that rather than forward from what's easy.
Win together. We rise as one. We support each other, raise the bar, and celebrate collective success. Come set a standard the rest of the team inherits.
Cross the aisle. Collaboration wins. We listen deeply, work across boundaries, and prioritize shared success over individual lanes. The best product calls here come from engineers who've sat with underwriters and underwriters who understand where the model breaks, and much of this job is listening closely enough on both sides to make that happen.
Go get it. We act with urgency, move with confidence, take smart risks, and push forward with intention. Nobody hands you the roadmap, the data, or the meeting invite. You pull the failing runs, book the time with the underwriters, and decide what matters.

Oak View Group (OVG) is the global leader in premium live entertainment infrastructure and services, with a platform spanning venue development and end-to-end capabilities across venue management, hospitality, and sponsorship sales. Position Summary

Oak View Group is seeking a dynamic Marketing Manager
to lead promotional campaigns across Lexington's premier entertainment portfolio: Rupp Arena, Central Bank Center, the Lexington Opera House, and the OVG Concert Series at Gatton Park. This Marketing Manager position will develop, manage, and execute strategic marketing plans to ensure the success of events. The position will serve as a venue marketer, responsible for overseeing event advertising budgets, the media buying process, public relations, and grassroots promotions for concerts, family shows, and conventions.

This role pays an annual salary of $50,000 - $55,000.

Benefits for Full-Time Roles: Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance, 401(k) Savings Plan, 401(k) matching, and Paid Time Off (vacation days, sick days, and 11 holidays)

This position will remain open until December 31, 2026.

About The Venue

Lexington is an active and thriving market, craving an active and welcoming venue for events. The heart of any thriving community is its downtown—and Lexington Center and the historic Rupp Arena
are truly the heart of downtown Lexington and one of the most widely recognized entertainment venues in North America. Rupp Arena in Lexington, Kentucky, is fast becoming THE must-play venue. The 20,000-seat arena, affectionately referred to by some as “the Cathedral of College Basketball," is home to the National Champion University of Kentucky men’s basketball program and has played host to some of the most talented and award-winning musicians/artists in the world, including U2, Paul McCartney, Elton John, Justin Timberlake, Kenny Chesney, Taylor Swift, and many others.

Central Bank Center is our convention side, with over 99k sf of exhibition space, 24k sf each of meeting and ballroom space, 50k of hospitality space, 10k sf of flexible space, and over 2500 covered and uncovered parking spaces. Both venues are additionally joined in entertaining this area by the Lexington Opera House, showcasing Broadway talent through collaborative bookings of Broadway shows, small venue concerts, and local arts.

CommonSpirit Health Stage at Gatton Park is a 5,000-capacity outdoor venue located in the center of Lexington. From live music and stand-up comedy to unforgettable experiences set against a stunning park backdrop in the center of the city.

Founded in 2021, Lexington Sporting Club is an American professional soccer team based in Lexington, KY. The soccer complex off Athens-Boonesboro Road near I-75 opened in August 2024 in time for the organization’s first USL Super League season.

Conceptualize and collaborate on social media campaigns, email and SMS marketing, and promotions to drive ticket sales and fan engagement

Perform other duties as assigned

3-5 years of previous event or entertainment marketing experience preferred

jobs.title: Marketing and Communications Specialist
jobs.description:
We exist so families can get better together. Each night, we keep 181 families close to the care and resources they need through six area Ronald McDonald Houses® and four Ronald McDonald Family Rooms®. Enabling families to stay close to their hospitalized child supports the health and well-being of the child and saves families more than $10 million in hotel and food costs each year. We also operate the Ronald McDonald Care Mobile® program, providing medical care to children in underserved areas. Ronald McDonald House Chicagoland & Northwest Indiana is an independent not-for-profit 501(c)(3) organization.

The Marketing & Communications Specialist supports the development and execution of marketing and communications initiatives that advance Ronald McDonald House Chicagoland & Northwest Indiana’s mission, strengthen engagement, and support fundraising and organizational priorities.

A collaborative, hands-on marketing generalist and content creator, the Specialist works with Marketing & Communications colleagues and teams across the organization to help bring campaigns, events, partnerships and stories to life.

The position has a strong focus on Signature Event and Corporate Partner marketing support, while also contributing to writing and storytelling, graphic design, social media, photography, video and other content needs.

Essential Job Functions

Signature Event & Fundraising Marketing

Support marketing and communications for Signature Events and other fundraising initiatives in partnership with Development colleagues.
Coordinate the development and delivery of event materials, collateral, signage, presentations, digital assets, sponsor recognition and promotional materials.
Maintain project timelines and track assigned event marketing deliverables, approvals, production and delivery.
Work with internal colleagues and external vendors to execute event marketing needs.
Attend Signature Events and select third-party events to provide on-site marketing support and capture content.

Corporate Partner Marketing Support

Create and coordinate digital and print assets, signage, presentations, toolkits and promotional materials.
Support cause-marketing, employee engagement, fundraising and awareness initiatives.

Writing, Storytelling & Content Development

Help identify and develop stories featuring families, volunteers, donors, partners and programs.
Write and edit content for newsletters, website, social media, presentations, fundraising and stewardship communications, events, and partner needs.
Work with colleagues to ensure stories and content are accurate, respectful and aligned with Ronald McDonald House brand and messaging.
Support maintenance of the organization’s story and content library.

Creative & Digital Content

Create on-brand marketing materials and digital content using Canva and other design tools.
Develop graphics and visual assets for social media, presentations, events, email, website and partner initiatives.
Capture photography and video at program locations, events and other settings.
Edit photos and short-form video for social media and digital communications.
Support social media content development and publishing as assigned.

Project Coordination & Collaboration

Coordinate assigned marketing projects and deliverables, helping ensure work is accurate and completed on time.
Collaborate with Marketing & Communications, Development, Community Engagement, Programs and other teams on campaigns and initiatives.
Maintain clear communication regarding project needs, timelines, approvals and deliverables.
Balance planned priorities with emerging and time-sensitive needs.
Ensure work follows Ronald McDonald House Global and local brand, messaging and visual identity standards.

Additional Responsibilities

Represent Marketing & Communications at selected organizational, partner and community events.
Support public relations, media relations and organizational communications initiatives as needed.
Stay current on relevant marketing, content and social media trends.
Support other Marketing & Communications priorities as assigned.

Education & Experience

An equivalent combination of education, training and experience will be considered.

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, English or a related field preferred.
2–5 years of marketing, communications, content or related experience.
Experience coordinating multiple projects and deadlines.
Experience with events, fundraising, corporate partnerships or nonprofit marketing preferred.
Experience developing content for print and digital channels.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Strong writing, editing and storytelling skills.
Strong organizational and project coordination skills with attention to detail.
Working knowledge of Canva and the ability to create polished, on-brand materials.
Photography and video capture/editing skills for social media and digital channels.
Collaborative, service-oriented approach and ability to work effectively across teams.
Ability to manage changing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Proficiency with Microsoft 365; familiarity with project management/collaboration platforms.
Familiarity with website CMS, email marketing and social media platforms preferred.
Commitment to organization’s mission, values and approach to caring for families.

jobs.description:
Description

About Us: Born in artistry, built for real life, and fueled by a global community, Morphe delivers high-performance, high-design beauty without the prestige price tag. Leveraging exceptional product development, regulatory, and supply chain capabilities, we make innovative products that invite creativity and celebrate the freedom to look how you want, when you want. Join us in shaping what’s next in beauty.

Summary of Position
The Senior Manager, Social Media sets the strategic vision for our social presence, building an ownable, unmistakable brand point of view across every channel and translating it into a content system the team can execute against day to day. This role strategically programs content, develops ownable content series and a distinct aesthetic, and keeps the brand consistently ahead of trend and culture. The Senior Manager owns performance rigor across the social portfolio, leads the brand’s expansion into new channels including YouTube and Pinterest, and manages a team of two. This is a strategy-first role with a clear path to Director within two years for the right candidate.

Principle Accountabilities

Set and own cross-channel social strategy across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, and emerging platforms, translating brand and marketing priorities into a distinct, ownable social point of view.
Strategically program content: develop ownable content series, franchises, and a consistent aesthetic that build brand recognition over time, not one-off posts, and keep them evolving as trends, formats, and culture shift.
Push the brand consistently on trend and cultural relevance, spotting content opportunities and white space before they peak, and coaching the team to move on them quickly and confidently.
Build out and scale the brand’s YouTube and Pinterest strategies, and lead early strategic thinking on a future Reddit presence.
Manage, coach, and develop a team of two direct reports, the Social Media Manager and Social Creative Manager, setting clear priorities, giving regular feedback, and building each of their growth paths.
Own performance rigor: track TY/LY (this-year vs. last-year) KPIs across every channel, ensure the team consistently delivers against agreed metrics, and turn results into next actions and resourcing decisions.
Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Influencer, Creative, and Retail teams to keep brand voice and campaign moments consistent across owned and earned channels.
Own strategy recaps and performance reporting up to leadership, translating data into a clear narrative on what’s working and what’s next.
Represent social strategy in cross-functional planning, ensuring social has a seat at the table for major launches, campaigns, and brand moments.

Key Working Relationships

Direct reports: Social Media Manager and Social Creative Manager.
Cross-functional partners: Marketing, Influencer Marketing, Creative Services, Copy, and Retail/commercial teams.
External: content creators, agency partners, and platform partners as needed.

Required Skills & Experience

5+ years of social media marketing/strategy experience, including at least 1–2 years directly managing people. Beauty or CPG industry highly preferred.
Demonstrated experience building ownable content series, franchises, or a distinct brand aesthetic that scaled over time.
Experience across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube required; Pinterest experience strongly preferred; familiarity with Reddit’s community dynamics a plus.
Proven track record owning TY/LY performance reporting and translating results into strategy.
Experience managing and developing direct reports, with a track record of growing team members into more senior roles.
Highly organized and data-driven, with strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.
Proficient with Microsoft Office; familiar with social publishing and analytics tools (e.g., Dash Hudson) and content tools (CapCut, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite).
Ability to work cross-functionally across marketing, creative, influencer, and retail teams.

Travel Requirements

Travel for events (photoshoots, store openings, influencer activations) on a case-by-case basis.
Physical Requirements

Must be able to perform essential functions (with or without an accommodation) without posing a "direct threat" to the health and safety to self or others.

FORMA Brands takes a market-based approach to pay, and amounts will vary depending on your geographic location. The salary range reflected here is for positions based in the Greater Los Angeles area. The successful candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future without notice.

jobs.title: Director, Marketing Technology and Transformation
jobs.description:
At Early Warning, we’ve powered and protected the U.S. financial system for over thirty years with cutting-edge solutions like Zelle®, Paze®, and so much more. As a trusted name in payments, we partner with thousands of institutions to increase access to financial services and protect transactions for hundreds of millions of consumers and small businesses.

Early Warning follows a hybrid work model to allow for a more collaborative working environment.

Candidates responding to this posting must independently possess the eligibility to work in the United States, for any employer, at the date of hire. This position is ineligible for employment Visa sponsorship.

Overall Purpose

The Director of Marketing Technology and Transformation is a member of the Marketing Operations team, whose mission is to enable our people to do the best work of their lives. This role leads improvement in how Marketing works and in the technology that supports Early Warning’s portfolio of brands, including Zelle, Paze, and Certos.

This role owns Marketing’s technology roadmap and leads work to simplify processes, automate repetitive work, and use AI responsibly. The Director works across Marketing and with Technology, Data, Legal, Risk, Compliance, and other teams to identify the most important problems to solve, recommend the right approach, and move solutions from idea through implementation and adoption.

As a hands-on transformation leader, the Director will identify opportunities for Marketing to operate faster and safely while increasing impact. This leader will take a network-first approach, creating shared processes, platforms, automations, and responsibly deployed AI capabilities that improve delivery across Marketing and advance our ambition to become an AI-native company.

The Director is responsible for making sure Marketing’s technology investments work together, solve clear business needs, and can support multiple brands where appropriate. This includes recommending when to improve an existing tool, integrate systems, build a new capability, buy technology, retire tools that are no longer delivering enough value, or use AI to increase Marketing’s bandwidth faster than headcount.

Essential Functions

Marketing Technology Strategy and Roadmap

Own and maintain Marketing’s multi-year MarTech technology roadmap across Zelle, Paze, Certos, and shared Marketing functions
Set clear priorities for technology improvements with a network-first approach, based on business need, expected value, cost, risk, ease of use, and ability to support Marketing priorities
Recommend when Marketing should improve an existing tool, integrate systems, build a capability, purchase new technology, or retire a tool
Develop business cases and funding recommendations for major technology investments and present recommendations and tradeoffs to senior leaders
Work with Technology, Data and Sales Operations to deliver the platforms and solutions needed for Marketing's CRM, brand health and campaign attribution initiatives

Process Improvement and Transformation

Lead efforts to improve the Marketing processes that have the greatest impact on speed, capacity, quality, cost, or risk
Map important processes from beginning to end to understand to identify friction points and redesign processes using automation, AI, reusable components, and self-service capabilities
Establish reusable processes, standards, platforms, and self-service capabilities across brands while preserving legitimate business, regulatory, and customer requirements
Define transformation success measures and track adoption, capacity creation, cycle-time improvement, cost savings, risk reduction, and other business outcomes

Reengineer How Marketing Works, Inclusive Of AI

Identify, prototype, and lead delivery of automations, AI-enabled workflows, integrations, and lightweight tools that improve speed, quality, or capacity
Partner with Legal, Risk, Technology, and enterprise AI teams to move promising solutions from discovery and minimum viable capability through testing, release, adoption, iteration while meeting security, privacy, and governance requirements
Support Marketing's contribution Marketing's contribution to Early Warning's AI-native ambition by working with internal and external partners to develop responsible, scalable AI enablement programs for marketers, reusing enterprise capabilities and standards wherever possible
Serve as Marketing’s lead for marketing technology and process transformation with senior leaders and cross-functional partners
Identify and prioritize practical uses of AI and automation that can reduce manual work, improve quality, increase capacity, or help Marketing make better decisions. Lead new solutions from initial idea and testing through approval, implementation, adoption, and broader use
Work with Legal, Risk, Compliance, Technology, and enterprise AI teams to make sure new capabilities meet security, privacy, legal, and governance requirements
Help establish common approaches, tools, and training so marketers can use AI responsibly in their everyday work
Manage key technology and vendor relationships, including vendor evaluation, selection, performance, cost, and ongoing value

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
Typically has 12 or more years of experience or demonstrated portfolio consistent with experience required of the role in marketing technology, marketing automation, product management, solutions architecture, process improvement, or related disciplines
Demonstrated experience developing multi-year strategies, roadmaps, investment cases, and executive recommendations for complex technology or transformation portfolios
Proven ability to develop business cases, evaluate technology investments, manage vendors, and communicate recommendations to senior leaders
Demonstrated leadership of complex, cross-functional teams and enterprise transformation initiatives, establish alignment across functions, and drive decisions without relying solely on formal authority
Effective communication and presentation skills, with demonstrated ability to translate complex technology and transformation topics into clear business implications, investment choices, risks, and recommendations

Preferred Qualifications

Experience modernizing marketing technology or operations in a regulated, high-control, or complex enterprise environment
Demonstrated use of generative AI, decision automation, or intelligent workflow tools to solve real business-process problems
Product-management, process-improvement, change-management, architecture, or agile delivery training or certification

The above job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position. Incumbents will follow instructions and perform other related duties as assigned by their supervisor.

Additionally, candidates are eligible for a discretionary incentive plan and benefits.

The business actively supports and reviews wage equity to ensure that pay decisions are not based on gender, race, national origin, or any other protected classes.

Physical Requirements

Working conditions consist of a normal office environment. Work is primarily sedentary and requires extensive use of a computer and involves sitting for periods of approximately four hours. Work may require occasional standing, walking, kneeling, and reaching. Must be able to lift 10 pounds occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently. Requires visual acuity and dexterity to view, prepare, and manipulate documents and office equipment including personal computers. Requires the ability to communicate with internal and/or external customers.

Some of the Ways We Prioritize Your Health and Happiness

jobs.title: UCANZ Marketing Operations, Senior Manager
jobs.description:
About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

UCANZ Marketing Operations, Senior Manager

POSITION PREMISE

The UCANZ Marketing Operations, Senior Manager is responsible for turning global and regional marketing priorities into coordinated, localized, production-ready and successfully delivered marketing activity across the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand and South Africa.

The role owns the regional execution layer of the marketing operating model, connecting UCANZ Marketing with Crunchyroll’s global capabilities across Integrated Planning, Campaign Operations, Marketing Production, Global Localization and Marketing Delivery. This leader ensures campaigns are operationally planned, assets are produced and localized to regional requirements, dependencies are managed and final materials are delivered accurately and on time across relevant channels and partners.

A critical responsibility is end-to-end management of marketing localization across UCANZ. The Sr. Manager coordinates translation, transcreation, cultural adaptation, versioning, approvals, quality checks and delivery for assets originating from global campaigns or created for regional initiatives, while partnering with Global Localization on standards, technology, vendors and quality frameworks.

The role reports to UCANZ Regional Marketing leadership or the designated Regional Operations leader and works closely with Campaign Operations, Marketing Production, Marketing Delivery, Regional Marketing, Title Marketing, Brand Management, Creative Services, Partnerships, Social, CRM, Paid Media, Content, Curation & Programming and global centers of excellence. Success requires exceptional organization, operational judgment, strong communication and the ability to scale consistent processes while representing UCANZ market, channel, language and cultural needs. The role will ideally be based in Los Angeles or San Francisco.

KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY

UCANZ MARKETING OPERATIONS & EXECUTION

Own the operational coordination of UCANZ marketing activity, translating global and regional strategies into executable plans, milestones, asset requirements, localization needs, dependencies and delivery schedules.
Maintain an integrated view of regional marketing readiness and ensure activities move effectively from planning through execution and launch.
Coordinate multiple campaigns, markets, asset types, stakeholders and deadlines while maintaining clear ownership and accountability.
Establish operating standards that enable accurate, timely and scalable execution across UCANZ channels and partners.
Anticipate execution risks, surface decisions and proactively remove blockers that could affect quality, timing, budget or campaign activation.

REGIONAL INTEGRATED PLANNING

Partner with Integrated Planning to incorporate regional priorities, launches, campaigns, tentpoles, local initiatives and market requirements into broader global marketing plans.
Translate global plans into actionable UCANZ timelines, workstreams and readiness checkpoints.
Provide early visibility into local requirements, resource constraints, localization lead times, partner specifications and execution risks.
Coordinate planning inputs across Regional Marketing, Content, Social, CRM, Paid Media, Partnerships, Brand, PR and other stakeholders to create one integrated regional view.
Ensure campaign plans reflect regional priorities while leveraging common global processes, technology, production capabilities and standards.

END-TO-END MARKETING LOCALIZATION

Manage localization workflows for global and regional marketing assets, including copy, key art, trailers, video, social assets, paid-media creative, CRM materials, partner assets, promotional content and other campaign deliverables.
Coordinate translation, transcreation, cultural adaptation, versioning, review, approvals, quality assurance and final delivery against campaign deadlines.
Partner with Global Localization on terminology, technology, vendors, workflows and quality frameworks while retaining operational accountability for UCANZ readiness.
Ensure localized assets are accurate, brand-appropriate, culturally relevant, technically compliant and available in the required formats and destinations.
Identify opportunities to streamline regionalization, reduce duplication and create scalable approaches to campaign adaptation across the four markets.

MARKETING PRODUCTION & ASSET COORDINATION

Partner with Marketing Production and Creative Services to communicate regional production and localization requirements early and define necessary versions, formats and specifications.
Ensure global source assets are structured to enable efficient regional adaptation and avoid unnecessary duplication of production work.
Coordinate region-specific materials when global assets do not meet UCANZ needs, including the operational interface between regional creative requirements and production resources.
Maintain visibility into asset status, version control, approvals, dependencies, production milestones and final delivery.
Support asset inventories, campaign trackers, creative briefs and shared sources of truth across the regional portfolio.

Marketing Delivery & Partner Requirements

Work with Marketing Delivery and Distribution Operations to ensure final global and localized assets are packaged, distributed and available to the correct regional destinations on time.
Coordinate region-specific channel, platform, commercial partner, media, regulatory, language and cultural requirements.
Ensure partner specifications, deadlines and delivery needs are communicated early enough to be incorporated into production and delivery workflows.
Provide clear escalation when assets are missing, incorrect, delayed or unable to meet activation requirements.
Partner with Partnerships, Regional Marketing and channel teams to support accurate delivery across third-party and commercial partner environments.

CAMPAIGN & ASSET READINESS

Establish readiness checkpoints for priority campaigns and launches, validating source assets, localized versions, formats, approvals, metadata, specifications and delivery destinations.
Identify risks early and coordinate resolution across Campaign Operations, Marketing Production, Global Localization, Marketing Delivery and regional teams.
Maintain clear visibility into asset availability, localization status, production milestones, delivery readiness, risks and decisions required.
Lead or facilitate operational check-ins, status reviews and launch-readiness meetings across regional and global stakeholders.
Support post-launch follow-up and ensure outstanding delivery or asset issues are documented and resolved.

OPERATIONAL ISSUE MANAGEMENT & CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT

Serve as the regional operational control point when marketing assets, localization, production or delivery issues threaten campaign execution.
Coordinate cross-functional triage, maintain accountability through resolution, communicate impact and status, and escalate systemic issues to the appropriate global leaders.
Track performance across campaign readiness, on-time asset availability, localization turnaround, production delivery, error rates, rework and recurring operational issues.
Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, improve global-to-regional handoffs, reduce duplicate work, automate repetitive activity and strengthen scalability.
Develop reusable playbooks, templates, governance and best practices that improve speed, visibility, quality and collaboration across UCANZ and global teams.
Support the development of operational capabilities, tools and processes that enable consistent execution across the region.

Requirements

8+ years of experience in marketing operations, campaign operations, creative operations, localization, marketing production, media operations or a related field within entertainment, streaming, media, technology or another global consumer business.
Demonstrated experience managing complex, multi-market marketing campaigns with dependencies across planning, creative production, localization, asset management and delivery.
Strong understanding of marketing localization, including translation, transcreation, cultural adaptation, asset versioning, review and approval workflows and localized creative delivery at scale.
Experience coordinating both globally originated campaigns and locally originated marketing activity, operating effectively between central capabilities and regional business needs.
Strong knowledge of marketing production workflows across digital, video, social, paid media, CRM, partner marketing and promotional creative.
Proven ability to coordinate across matrixed organizations and build effective relationships among regional teams and global functions.
Excellent project and operational management skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, markets, languages, asset types, dependencies and deadlines simultaneously.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated ability to identify execution risks early and drive issues through resolution.
Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to influence across functions, cultures and time zones.
High attention to detail and a strong commitment to brand consistency, localization quality, executional excellence and the fan experience.
Familiarity with campaign-management, project-management, digital asset-management, localization-management and marketing-delivery platforms.
Experience working with creative agencies, localization vendors, production partners, media agencies and external distribution or commercial partners is a plus.
Demonstrated experience improving marketing workflows through standardization, automation, operational metrics and root-cause analysis.
Experience in anime, entertainment, streaming, television, gaming or another global content-led consumer business is highly preferred.
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related field, or equivalent experience.

jobs.title: Manager, Digital Acquisition, Marketing & Engagement
jobs.description:
Headquartered in Colorado Springs, Colorado, Focus on the Family has nearly 700 employees who work to achieve the mission of enriching the lives of families, engaging the culture, advocating for life and spreading the Gospel of Jesus Christ. The work is meaningful, the culture is rewarding, and the purpose is eternal.

The Manager, Digital Acquisition, Marketing & Engagement position exists to lead the development, execution, measurement, and optimization of Focus on the Family’s digital acquisition and discovery strategies across paid digital advertising, traditional organic search (SEO), and AI/answer engine search (AEO/GEO). This role oversees paid campaign strategy and performance across Google Ads, Meta, and other social media platforms, while leading SEO and GEO strategies to strengthen organic search visibility and AI-driven discovery. Using tools such as Google Analytics, SEMrush, and AI-search intelligence platforms, this position translates campaign performance and search insights into actionable strategies that increase awareness, engagement, and measurable ministry outcomes.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities:

Is accountable for developing and optimizing an integrated search discovery strategy across paid search, organic search (SEO), and AI/answer engine search (AEO/GEO), with the objective of increasing Focus on the Family's visibility and constituent engagement across digital properties.
Is accountable for the optimization of paid search opportunities, both revenue-generating and ministry-focused, that lead to constituent engagement across Focus on the Family digital properties.
Designs and executes campaign strategies across Google Ads accounts, campaigns include ministry-focused, Ecommerce, Google Grant, and Fundraising, to maximize stewardship and the effectiveness of every dollar invested.
Designs and executes campaign strategies across Meta Ads and other social media ad accounts, campaigns include ministry-focused, Ecommerce, and Fundraising, to maximize stewardship and the effectiveness of every dollar invested.
Designs and executes A/B tests using a rapid test-and-learn approach to continuously optimize ad performance and post-click user engagement.
Proactively contributes to campaign budgets; manages execution against campaign strategies by optimizing spending during campaigns; and reports on results and learnings after campaigns conclude.
User Google Analytics and other reporting tools to ensure user behavior and engagement from marketing efforts is tracked properly and deeply understood behavior beyond ad platform reporting.
Leads foundational SEO research using Semrush or equivalent platforms to identify constituent search demand, search intent, keyword opportunities, competitive search gaps, content opportunities, organic search trends, and areas where existing content can be improved to increase discoverability and engagement.
Leads Answer Engine Optimization (AEO/GEO) research and measurement using AI-search intelligence platforms to understand how Focus on the Family, its ministries, resources, priority topics, and offers are represented across AI answer engines.
Monitors AI-search visibility, share of voice, prompt performance, competitor presence, citations, sentiment, and brand accuracy, and translates findings into recommendations for content development, optimization, digital PR, earned media, and other strategies that improve Focus on the Family's authority and discoverability in AI-generated answers.
Supports the Sr. Dir. Marketing-Guided Digital Engagement by delivering strategic keyword, prompt, audience-intent, competitor, and search-demand insights that inform ministry content strategy and help Focus develop resources around the questions, needs, and topics constituents are actively exploring through both traditional and AI-powered search.
Analyzes the sources and content cited by AI answer engines to identify opportunities for Focus-owned content, earned media, authoritative third-party references, partnerships, and other sources to strengthen Focus on the Family's authority and likelihood of inclusion in AI-generated answers.
Monitors how AI platforms describe Focus on the Family, its ministries, programs, resources, and positions; identifies material inaccuracies or outdated information; and collaborates with appropriate teams to improve the authoritative source information influencing AI-generated responses.
Develops and manages paid search, SEO, and AEO testing strategies to determine which content, technical, citation, messaging, and optimization approaches improve visibility, engagement, user experience, and conversion across traditional and AI-driven discovery channels.
Connects paid search, organic search, and AI-search performance to measurable ministry outcomes, including assessment participation, subscriptions, registrations, lead generation, donations, content engagement, and other priority constituent actions. Description

Help Us Grow What's Next

We’re looking for an energetic, creative, and curious marketing professional who sees opportunities everywhere. At Midland Scientific, marketing isn’t just about promoting products—it’s about creating experiences, telling our story, connecting with customers, supporting our sales team, and finding new and better ways to engage the people we serve.

“What if we tried this?”
— we want to hear from you!

Generate fresh, creative marketing ideas that help MSI stand out in the marketplace.
Develop engaging content for social media, email, website, customer communications, and other marketing channels.
Help develop campaigns, promotions, and initiatives that support company growth and customer engagement.
Create and coordinate written, visual, and digital content while maintaining MSI's brand and voice.
Work with internal teams to uncover stories, successes, customer insights, and ideas that can be turned into compelling content.
Help own MSI's social media presence and develop an engaging, consistent content strategy.
Create, schedule, and publish social media content.
