jobs.description:
Senior Marketing Account Manager
Tula AI Labs | Hybrid, Tampa, FL (must live in the Tampa area) | Full-Time

About Tula AI Labs
Tula AI Labs is a growing AI agency based in Tampa. We build AI agents into companies, design CRMs and automations, and run marketing for growing businesses with AI. Our clients range from manufacturers to hospitality brands, and our work shows up in their leads, their bookings, and their revenue.

Our mission: Technology should make people more human at work, not less. We build AI workers that take the busywork, so people can do what only people can.

We are small, fast, and building. The person in this seat will help shape how Tula runs marketing for years to come.

The Role
You will own our client accounts and lead marketing for our clients and for Tula itself. This is a strategic, hands-on role: you build the plan and you get into the details to execute it. You'll run client check-ins, set marketing strategy, raise the quality of everything we publish, and keep accounts renewing and growing. You'll work closely with our development team so client requests move quickly from the call to the build. AI is part of how we work every day, and it will be part of yours.

This is not a beginner role. You will lead client accounts from day one.

Core Responsibilities
• Client Relationship Leadership: Be the main point of contact for your accounts. Run weekly check-in calls on your own and deliver data-driven updates, performance reviews, and executive presentations.
• Cross-Functional Coordination: Partner with our developers, Marketing Coordinator, and content contractors so every deliverable meets client goals and KPIs. Run weekly developer check-ins that turn client requests into clear tickets.
• Revenue Growth and Upselling: Use campaign results to spot expansion opportunities, cross-sell Tula services, and own renewals and retention on your accounts.
• Budget and Project Oversight: Monitor campaign budgets, track project timelines, keep CRM records clean, and hold the team to deadlines.
• Marketing Strategy and Quality: Own strategy, content plans, and monthly performance reports for each account. Hold a high bar for brand and visual quality across social, ads, and landing pages.
• Paid Ads and Landing Pages: Plan and manage campaigns, including Google and ChatGPT ads, and the landing pages behind them.
• Results and ROI: Use analytics and performance data to connect marketing activity to leads, booked calls, and revenue, then optimize spend and channels based on what works.
• Team and Vendor Direction: Direct and approve the work of our Marketing Coordinator, on-site content contractors, freelancers, and vendors.
• Systems and Playbooks: Build repeatable marketing systems, reporting, content calendars, and playbooks we can use across every client as Tula grows.
• Content Shoots: Be on site for client content shoots as needed.
• Client Communication: Keep clients informed, confident, and clear on next steps.

Tula's Own Marketing (after ramp-up)
• Run Tula's lead generation, including Free AI Audit campaigns on Meta
• Make sure every Free AI Audit is delivered and followed up
• Manage Tula's content calendar, email newsletter, and social presence
• Turn client wins into case studies and testimonials
• Track pipeline results: cost per lead, audits booked, and calls booked

What You Bring (Required)
• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, PR, Communications, or Business
• Located in the Tampa, FL area, available for hybrid work
• Must be available for on-site content shoots
• 4+ years in social media marketing, managing retainer clients at an agency
• A portfolio of social accounts, brand visuals, and campaigns you have run
• You use AI tools every day in your work (for example ChatGPT, Claude, or AI design and video tools) and can show how they make your work better and faster
• A track record of running client meetings on your own and keeping accounts renewing
• Strong strategy across social, Meta and Google ads, landing pages, and email/SMS
• Strong analytical skills and the ability to tie marketing results to revenue
• Experience directing a team and managing vendors or freelancers
• Comfortable working with developers and turning client needs into clear tasks
• Highly organized, entrepreneurial, and comfortable building systems in a growing company

Nice to Have
• GoHighLevel or another CRM platform
• B2B, manufacturing, or hospitality marketing experience

Compensation and Benefits
• $70,000 base salary, with uncapped performance commission. Top performers can earn $85,000+.
• Unlimited PTO, including sick days

Hiring Process
1. Application with portfolio

How to Apply
Please apply through LinkedIn only. We review every application there.

No phone calls, no direct emails, and no private DMs. Applicants who contact us outside of LinkedIn will be disqualified.

We move quickly. If this sounds like you, apply today.

jobs.description:
Overview

Who We Are

Because health is personal.
That's why Personify Health created the first and only personalized health platform—bringing health plan administration, holistic wellbeing solutions, and comprehensive care navigation together in one place. We serve employers, health plans, and health systems with data-driven solutions that reduce costs while actually improving health outcomes. Together, our team is on a mission to empower people to lead healthier lives.

Learn even more about the work that drives us at personifyhealth.com.

At Personify Health, we value and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We believe in creating teams made up of individuals with various backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Why? Because diversity inspires innovation, collaboration, and challenges us to produce better solutions. But more than this, diversity is our strength, and a catalyst in our ability to #changelivesforgood.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do

Personify Health is a personalized health platform built on a simple idea: healthier lives create healthier businesses. We're entering a year where our story needs to get louder and sharper, and this role is how it happens. You'll set the content strategy, own how the brand shows up across channels, and still write and edit the work that matters most. You lead a small team of brand and social managers, partner closely with product marketing so our company story and our product story sound like one voice, and share ownership of our outside PR agency with the VP of Integrated Marketing.

This is a hands-on director role. You'll spend part of your week building a content plan and part of it fixing a headline.

Content strategy and creation

Build and run the content strategy for our wellbeing and health platform story, tied to the 2027 go-to-market priorities
Personally write and edit high-visibility pieces: executive thought leadership, bylines, key narratives, web and campaign copy
Build editorial calendars and a repeatable content engine that serves sales, marketing, and product
Turn complex health and benefits topics into clear, useful content for HR leaders, benefits buyers, brokers, and consultants

Brand and social leadership

Manage the brand manager and social media manager, setting priorities, giving real feedback, and developing their skills
Keep voice, tone, and visual identity consistent across every channel and partner
Shape an organic social presence that supports pipeline and executive visibility

Product marketing partnership and message continuity

Work hand in hand with product marketing to connect brand-level and division-level messaging to the product story, so a buyer hears the same thing at every stage
Make sure mid-funnel and bottom-of-funnel product content (solution briefs, case studies, sales enablement, demos, and web pages) carries the same narrative, proof points, and tone as top-of-funnel brand content
Set shared messaging frameworks and review practices with product marketing, so new launches and updates land consistently without slowing teams down
Spot gaps and conflicts between brand, division, and product content early, and resolve them with the owners

Marcom and campaign support

Partner with demand generation and client marketing so messaging lands the same way in every program
Provide messaging and content support for launches, events, and customer-facing materials

Agency management and communications support

Co-own the PR agency relationship with the VP of Integrated Marketing. You run day-to-day direction, review work, and track results, while the VP stays closely involved in strategy, scope, and commercial decisions
Keep the agency proactive: set priorities, bring them the message and platform news they need, and hold them to the plan
Support executive and internal communications as needed, including leadership messaging and company announcements
Help coordinate media and analyst opportunities with the agency, and prepare spokespeople when needed

Measurement

Track what content and communications actually move, including engagement, share of voice, and pipeline influence, and adjust fast

What Success Looks Like

First 30-45 days: You've audited our content and brand across the funnel, built a content plan tied to the 2027 priorities, agreed on a shared messaging framework with product marketing, and set a clear working rhythm with the agency and your team.
By six months: Strong thought leadership and campaign content is flowing, and a buyer sees the same story on our website, in a sales conversation, and in the press.
By year end: We can show measurable movement in visibility and pipeline influence, and the team is sharper for having worked with you

Qualifications

What You Bring to Our Team

10+ years in marketing communications, content, or brand, with at least 3 leading people
A strong writing portfolio. We will ask to see your work, and we'll want to know which parts are yours
Experience building content strategy that connected to business results, not just output
A record of working closely with product marketing to keep brand and product messaging aligned across the funnel
Comfort being both strategist and doer, and experience managing agencies without micromanaging them
Clear judgment on messaging, tone, and when something isn't ready
Skill working across marketing, sales, and product teams in a fast-moving environment
Bachelor's degree in communications, marketing, journalism, or a related field, or equivalent experience

It helps if you have

Experience in health tech, benefits, wellbeing, or health plan marketing
Background in B2B SaaS or platform launches
Familiarity with analyst relations and trade media
Experience with an AI-assisted content workflow

Physical Requirements

Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time.
The person in this job needs to occasionally move inside the office to access office machinery, filing cabinets, and meeting facilities.
Constantly operates a computer and other office productivity machinery, such as copy machine, computer printer, calculator, etc.
Frequently positions self to maintain files in file cabinets.
Frequently move boxes or equipment weighing up to 25 pounds.
Must communicate information and ideas so others understand. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.
Must be able to observe details at close range.

Disclaimer

This job description is not intended to contain a comprehensive list of activities, duties, or responsibilities, but constitutes a general description of the scope and function of the role within the company. Activities, duties, and responsibilities are subject to change at any time with or without notice.

Benefits

The Highlights:

Competitive base salary and benefits effective day one
Comprehensive medical and dental through our own health solutions (yes, we use what we build)
Unlimited PTO—rest and recharge time is non-negotiable
Mental health support, retirement planning, and financial protection
Professional development with clear career progression and learning budgets
Mission-driven culture where diverse perspectives drive real impact on people's health

Want the full picture?
Visit personifyhealthbenefits.com to explore our complete benefits package, wellness programs, and other employee perks.

Compensation:
This position offers a base salary range of $122,097 - $145,000, depending on location, skills, and experience. You're eligible for our full benefits package starting day one.

Our Commitment:
Personify Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We cultivate a work environment where differences are celebrated, and employees of all backgrounds are empowered to thrive—because diversity is core to who we are and critical to our work in health and wellbeing.

Stay Safe:
Personify Health will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information like social security numbers during hiring. All official communication comes from verified company email addresses and or our secure applicant tracking system. Suspicious requests? Report them to talent@personifyhealth.com . View all legitimate openings at personifyhealth.com/careers .

Company Description

Eurofins Scientific is a global leader in analytical testing, operating over 950 labs in 60 countries with 65,000 employees. EAG Laboratories, part of Eurofins, offers advanced services in analytical chemistry, microscopy, surface analysis, and engineering sciences—including failure analysis, product reliability, and ATE testing. We support clients across the product lifecycle, from R&D to manufacturing. Serving diverse industries, EAG delivers expert insights and tailored solutions. Our engineers and scientists collaborate with clients to solve complex challenges and deliver actionable results. We foster a growth mindset, empowering individuals to drive success while meeting evolving technological and business needs.

Imagine the possibilities. Let’s explore them together.

Job Description

The Marketing Intern will support the Marketing team across a variety of campaigns and initiatives, gaining hands-on experience in market research, content development, database projects, and digital marketing execution. This role is primarily remote
and part-time, with flexibility to support onsite marketing events in Sunnyvale and Santa Clara
as needed. This position requires someone who is within a 30-minute drive to Sunnyvale and Santa Clara CA.

The intern will assist with researching target markets and accounts, identifying new leads, supporting campaign development, and helping connect research and data insights to marketing content and execution. This internship is designed to provide end-to-end exposure to marketing—from data gathering and research to content creation and campaign performance.

Key Responsibilities Include

Supporting marketing campaigns through market and account research
Conducting lead research using third-party platforms (e.g., ZoomInfo)
Gathering and organizing data from provided prospect and account lists
Assisting with database cleanup, enrichment, and reporting projects
Repurposing existing content and developing new content for campaigns
Supporting digital marketing initiatives and campaign execution
Assisting with planning and execution of onsite marketing events as needed
Collaborating with marketing managers to understand how individual tasks support broader campaign goals

Learning & Development Opportunities

The Marketing Intern will be introduced to the fundamentals of marketing by supporting real-world campaigns and projects. With guidance from senior marketing leaders, the intern will learn how market research, data mining, content creation, and digital marketing work together to drive campaign success.

The Intern Will Gain

Practical experience in marketing research and lead generation
Exposure to digital marketing tools and campaign workflows
Experience developing and repurposing marketing content
Understanding of how data and research inform campaign strategy
Insight into marketing within a technical, B2B environment
Experience collaborating with cross-functional marketing teams

Progress will be evaluated based on the intern’s understanding of how their tasks connect to overall campaign objectives and outcomes.

Qualifications

This internship provides hands-on exposure to B2B marketing within a technical and engineering-focused organization. Prior marketing experience is not required; training and mentorship will be provided.

Preferred Fields Of Study Include

Marketing
Business Administration
Communications
Digital Marketing
Engineering or Science disciplines (a plus, especially for understanding technical markets)

Preferred Qualifications And Attributes Include

Strong interest in marketing, research, and campaign execution
Ability to analyze information and connect research to actionable insights
Strong written communication and content development skills
Comfortable working with data, lists, and databases
Attention to detail and strong organizational skills
Familiarity with Microsoft tools (Excel, PowerPoint); CRM or marketing tools a plus
Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote environment
Willingness and availability to support onsite events in Sunnyvale/Santa Clara as needed
Curiosity, creativity, and eagerness to learn

Physical Requirements

Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time.
Ability to continuously operate a personal computer or lab equipment for extended periods of time (4 or more hours).
Require close distance visual acuity with or without correction (Glasses, Contacts, etc.)
Ability to operate a keyboard and other lab equipment, use a telephone, access file cabinets and other items stored at various levels, including overhead
Ability to communicate clearly and understandably ensure an accurate exchange of information in normal conversational distance, over the telephone, and in a group setting.
Learn new tasks, remember processes, maintain focus, complete tasks independently, make timely decisions in the context of a workflow, ability to communicate with visitors, ability to complete tasks in situations that have a speed or productivity quota.

Additional Information

Position: Marketing Intern
Department: Marketing
Work Schedule: Part-time, 20–25 hours per week
Work Location: Primarily remote, with onsite support in Sunnyvale/Santa Clara, CA as needed for events
Estimated Duration: July 2026 – July 2027
Pay Rate: $21/hour
Schedule: Flexible / TBD

This internship is ideal for students interested in marketing, research, and digital campaigns who are looking to gain hands-on experience while balancing academic commitments in a flexible, part-time role.

Compensation is aligned with market standards for the region and tailored to individual qualifications and experience.

What It’s Like To Work Here

Teamwork: be inspired by your leaders, be encouraged by your teammates, and be supported in all parts of your journey while you work with us.
Learning & Development: take on career development programs and goal setting to create big possibilities for your career and life. Develop within the company; be mentored and grow as a leader.
Diversity & Authenticity: we work hard to embrace diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work every day.

jobs.description:
Who We Are Is What We Do.

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.

Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.

Why should you be part of our success story?

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.

Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.

Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.

About The Studio

Deel is one of the fastest-growing companies in the world, and we're building the brand and creative studio to match. We make global campaigns, partnerships, film, design, and social at real scale, for businesses and for workers in almost every country there is.

We're looking for someone exceptional to raise the bar on what we make. The role

Deel is a truly global, people-first brand, and it's taking off. Our creative team is pushing into new territory, on innovation and on what it means to own a cultural conversation.

We're looking for a creative to lead how that brand shows up on social. Someone who is equal parts designer, creative thinker, and social native. You'd own the creative expression across every platform, make the work that people share, and set the standard for what Deel looks and sounds like in the places culture actually happens.

What You'll Make

Brand and cultural moments. Original social-first ideas. The work people stop for and send to someone else.
Partnership and sports activations. Deel invests seriously in global sports and cultural partnerships. Social is where most people experience them.
Campaign extensions. When a brand campaign lands, you decide what it becomes on each platform and make it belong there.
Always-on. The steady presence between the big moments.
The system underneath. Templates, formats, and motion presets that let volume happen fast without going off-brand.

What You Bring

At least seven years in social-led creative, in-house or agency.
Design as a tool, not a finish. You use design to catch a moment and land an idea. You know when something needs to look made and when it needs to look found, and you can tell the difference between rough and sloppy.
You live in social. Not a designer who also posts. You read the platforms as creative formats, you know what's working this month, and you can tell a trend worth joining from one that's already over.
Video and motion. Most of what works on social moves. You shoot, edit, and animate well enough that nobody needs to fix it.
AI in your workflow. You use the current generative tooling in real production, and you know where it helps and where it looks cheap.
Concept to execution, on your own. You take an idea from thought to finished asset without a chain of handoffs. You work with the social team on strategy and timing, and you make the work.

What Would Set You Apart

Work that traveled beyond the brand's own following.
Experience making for a global audience across multiple markets and languages.
Copywriting instincts. On social the line and the image are one thing.
A point of view on where social creative is going, and opinions about who's doing it well.

Who You'll Work With

You'll report to our Creative Director and sit inside the creative studio alongside brand designers, motion designers, and video, pulling them in when a moment needs more than one person. You'll work daily with the social team, who own strategy, publishing, and community.

How We Work

We're a studio, not a request queue. People here make things rather than manage from a distance. We use AI seriously, and we're deliberate about where we don't.

Total Rewards

Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all.

Job Description:

Job Title:
Marketing Manager

Reports to:
Director, Marketing and Communications

FLSA Classification:
Exempt

Location:
Bentonville, Arkansas (On-site)

Date Reviewed
: 8/10/2026

Who We Are

Founded in 2021, Alice L. Walton School of Medicine (AWSOM) is a nonprofit, four-year MD program that will enhance traditional medical education with the arts, humanities, and whole health principles. The school’s culture embraces self-care to empower students to care for their own well-being as well as their patients’. The school’s state-of-the-art medical education facility is located in Bentonville, Arkansas on the Crystal Bridges campus, home to Crystal Bridges Museum of American Art and Heartland Whole Health Institute. The school has been granted preliminary accreditation status by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education.

About The Position

The Marketing Manager is responsible for executing integrated marketing, digital communications, social media, recruitment marketing, and website content strategies for Alice L. Walton School of Medicine (AWSOM). This position serves as the primary owner of AWSOM's marketing ecosystem and leads audience engagement efforts across social media, digital advertising, website content, and recruitment-focused campaigns.

Working closely with the Director, Marketing and Communications, Editorial Manager, and shared services partners, this role ensures AWSOM's marketing initiatives are effectively deployed across owned digital channels and aligned with institutional priorities, brand standards, and recruitment goals. The position serves as AWSOM's primary liaison to the shared services web and photo/video teams and supports campaign execution through data-informed decision making and performance analysis.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Marketing & Campaign Management

Develops and executes integrated marketing campaigns supporting student recruitment, institutional awareness, events, and strategic priorities.
Coordinates campaign deployment across digital, social media, email, and website channels.
Manages recruitment marketing initiatives and prospective student engagement campaigns.
Coordinates promotion of webinars, admissions events, and recruitment activities.
Supports audience development and engagement initiatives.
Manages campaign timelines, deliverables, and performance measurement.
Coordinates development of recruitment collateral and campaign materials.
Supports awareness-building initiatives that advance institutional goals and priorities.

Social Media Strategy & Management

Leads AWSOM's social media presence across LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and emerging platforms.
Develops and maintains the social media content calendar in collaboration with the Editorial Manager.
Coordinates deployment of editorial content through social media channels.
Creates channel-specific social media plans that support institutional goals.
Manages audience engagement and community management activities.
Monitors social media trends, audience sentiment, and competitor activity.
Supports executive and leadership social media initiatives.
Coordinates promotion of news stories, blogs, events, campaigns, and institutional initiatives across social channels.
Oversees paid social media advertising campaigns.
Tracks performance and recommends optimization strategies.
Develops social media analytics, reporting, and audience growth insights.

Website Content Development & Management

Serves as AWSOM's primary website content manager and institutional liaison to the shared services web team.
Develops and maintains website content strategy in alignment with recruitment, awareness, and institutional goals.
Coordinates website editorial planning in collaboration with the Editorial Manager.
Maintains accurate and current recruitment-related content, including admissions information, webinars, events, campus visits, and application resources.
Coordinates updates for program, curriculum, faculty, leadership, and institutional information.
Submits, prioritizes, and manages website update requests through the shared services web team.
Provides content, requirements, and business needs for new web pages, landing pages, and site enhancements.
Coordinates implementation of news stories, blog content, feature stories, and campaign content developed through the editorial process.
Partners with the shared services web team to support content publishing, CMS workflows, and site maintenance activities.
Reviews website content regularly to ensure accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and brand alignment.
Collaborates with the shared services web team on SEO best practices and content optimization efforts.
Utilizes web analytics and performance data to identify opportunities for content improvement, recruitment engagement, and audience growth.
Evaluates website user experience from a content and communications perspective and provides recommendations for enhancements.
Coordinates updates to faculty, staff, and leadership directories.
Partners with the shared services web team to support website accessibility compliance and content standards.
Serves as the primary point of contact for AWSOM stakeholders regarding website content needs and priorities.

Digital Advertising & Audience Development

Manages digital advertising campaigns across search, display, social media, and other digital platforms.
Coordinates paid recruitment marketing initiatives.
Develops audience targeting and segmentation strategies.
Monitors campaign performance metrics and conversion goals.
Optimizes campaigns based on performance data and institutional goals.
Evaluates channel effectiveness and recommends media investments.
Supports lead generation, engagement, and enrollment-related marketing initiatives.

Analytics & Reporting

Develops regular reports related to website performance, social media performance, digital advertising, recruitment marketing campaigns, and audience growth.
Analyzes trends and provides recommendations for improvement.
Supports departmental KPI tracking and campaign assessment.
Monitors performance against strategic marketing objectives.
Leverages data insights to inform channel, content, and campaign decisions.

Marketing Operations & Coordination

Coordinates marketing project workflows across internal staff and shared services partners.
Manages requests related to website updates, social media campaigns, marketing initiatives, and digital communications projects.
Ensures alignment between marketing campaigns and the editorial calendar.
Coordinates with shared services teams to obtain photography, videography, graphic design, and other creative assets needed for campaigns.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Stablecoins - Infrastructure
jobs.description:
At Anchorage Digital, we are building the world’s most advanced digital asset platform for institutions to participate in crypto.

Anchorage Digital is a crypto platform that enables institutions to participate in digital assets through custody, staking, trading, governance, settlement, and the industry's leading security infrastructure. Home to Anchorage Digital Bank N.A., the first federally chartered crypto bank in the U.S., Anchorage Digital also serves institutions through Anchorage Digital Singapore, Porto by Anchorage Digital , and other offerings.

The company is funded by leading institutions including Andreessen Horowitz, GIC, Goldman Sachs, KKR, and Visa, with its Series D valuation over $3 billion. Founded in 2017 in San Francisco, California, Anchorage Digital has offices in New York, New York; Porto, Portugal; Singapore; and Sioux Falls, South Dakota. Learn more at anchorage.com, on X @Anchorage, and on LinkedIn.

With the evolving landscape of digital threats and an increasing volume of sophisticated attacks by malicious actors, we have a security policy mandating all new hires complete an in-person onboarding process - no exceptions
. Security is our foundation and we prioritize physical identity verification and secure IT setup. While our security and IT logistics require physical presence to protect our infrastructure from sophisticated global threats, this move is equally about our Village culture. We believe that a laptop can be shipped, but our culture cannot.

We are looking to add a Senior Product Marketing Manager, Stablecoins - Infrastructure to our team.

You will own how Anchorage Digital positions and takes to market its stablecoin infrastructure: the platform institutions use to mint, redeem, bridge, custody, settle, and manage USD stablecoins through a federally chartered bank, plus the API and developer surface behind it and the payments service that lets banks move dollars onchain without a correspondent bank.

Your buyers are the people who run money movement and treasury: payments and treasury leads at banks and fintechs, trading desks and exchanges that settle in stablecoins, and the engineers and product managers who integrate against our API. They care about speed, cost, counterparty risk, and regulatory standing, and they are comparing us to crypto-native infrastructure providers, bank consortia, and doing nothing.

This is a generalist product marketing role on a small team. Product marketing is the core of the job, and you will also carry brand, events, and communications work for your product lines: the launch announcement, the developer content, the conference presence, the client reference program. You should be as comfortable writing a technical one-pager as briefing a designer or prepping an executive for a panel.

We have created the Factors of Growth & Impact to help Villagers better measure impact and articulate coaching, feedback, and the rich and rewarding learning that happens while exploring, developing, and mastering the capabilities and contributions within and outside of the Senior Product Marketing Manager, Stablecoins - Infrastructure role:

Technical Skills:

Write the positioning, messaging, and ICP definition for stablecoin infrastructure, covering minting and redemption, settlement, treasury, bank payments, and the API, and keep them current as the products and the market move.
Build and maintain the sales toolkit: pitch decks, one-pagers, solution pages, competitive battlecards, FAQs, integration overviews, and client case studies, and train Sales on how to use them.
Run product launches end to end: new chains and stablecoins supported, new API capabilities, pricing changes, and new bank services, with the announcement, developer content, website and in-app updates, and enablement ready on day one.
Produce content for an institutional and technical audience, from web copy and blog posts to developer guides, white papers, webinars, and conference talks, in the Anchorage Digital voice.

Complexity & Impact of Work:

Turn infrastructure concepts (settlement finality, reserve handling, bridging, treasury operations) into a clear business case for a treasurer, a payments lead, and an engineer, and decide which proof points each one needs.
Build competitive positioning against crypto-native infrastructure providers and bank consortia, and make the case for running money movement through a federally chartered bank in plain terms a buyer can repeat internally.
Own the brand, events, and communications calendar for your product lines, including developer and payments conference presence, speaking submissions, and executive prep.

Organizational Knowledge:

Develop fluency in how our platform and API work, which stablecoins and chains we support, and the regulatory standing that shapes what we can say.
Partner with Product and Engineering on roadmap priorities using client interviews, integration feedback, win and loss analysis, and market research.
Work with Legal and Compliance so every external claim survives review the first time.

Communication & Influence:

Gather client, prospect, developer, and competitor insight and share it across Marketing, Product, Sales, and the Stablecoin Solutions team.
Act as the marketing point of contact for the stablecoin infrastructure business, and bring the broader Marketing team (design, demand generation, social, communications) into your launches.

You may be a fit for this role if you have:

Have 5 or more years in B2B product marketing, with at least part of that marketing an API, platform, or infrastructure product in fintech, payments, financial services, or digital assets.
Have owned positioning and go-to-market for a technical product end to end, from ICP and messaging through launch and sales enablement, and can show the results.
Write clearly for both a treasurer and an engineer, in short form and long form, and can explain settlement, minting and redemption, or a bridge between chains without a glossary.
Have worked on brand, events, or communications programs, not only product marketing, and are happy to carry those for your product lines on a small team.
Have sold alongside a sales team: built the deck, trained the reps, sat in on the calls, and changed the pitch based on what you heard.
Are comfortable with regulatory and compliance review, and treat it as part of getting the story right rather than an obstacle.
Search constantly for client, prospect, developer, and competitor insight and use it to change what we build and say.

Although not a requirement, bonus points if:

Have marketed payments infrastructure, a developer platform, or a settlement or treasury product.
Have worked with developer relations or produced developer-facing content such as integration guides and API overviews.
Have marketed to banks, and understand how a bank evaluates a new vendor for money movement.
Follow stablecoin settlement, bank adoption of onchain payments, and the GENIUS Act closely and have opinions about where the market goes next.
Were emotionally moved by the soundtrack to Hamilton, which chronicles the founding of a new financial system.

About Anchorage Digital: Who we are

The Anchorage Village, what we call our team, brings together the brightest minds from platform security, financial services, and distributed ledger technology to provide the building blocks that empower institutions to safely participate in the evolving digital asset ecosystem. As a diverse team of more than 600 members, we are united in one common goal: building the future of finance by providing the foundation upon which value moves safely in the new global economy.

Anchorage Digital is committed to being a welcoming and inclusive workplace for everyone, and we are intentional about making sure people feel respected, supported, and connected at work—regardless of who you are or where you come from. We value and celebrate our differences and we believe being open about who we are allows us to do the best work of our lives.

Anchorage Digital is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status. Anchorage Digital considers qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with other legal requirements. “Anchorage Digital” refers to services that are offered either through Anchorage Digital Bank National Association, an OCC-chartered national trust bank, or Anchorage Lending CA, LLC a finance lender licensed by the California Department of Financial Protection and Innovation, License No. 60DBO-11976, or Anchorage Digital Singapore Pte Ltd, a Singapore private limited company, all wholly-owned subsidiaries of Anchor Labs, Inc., a Delaware corporation.

Full-Time Position

The Digital Marketing Manager, reporting to the Director of Marketing & Sales, will be responsible for leading the digital marketing strategy for an assigned portfolio of Cirque du Soleil Resident Shows in Las Vegas. This role will develop and optimize performance marketing strategies that drive awareness, ticket sales, and revenue growth through paid search, paid social, audience acquisition, and digital campaign optimization.

Working closely with show Marketing Managers, Analytics, CRM, agencies, Revenue Management, and partner organizations, the Digital Marketing Manager will identify opportunities to improve digital performance, maximize return on advertising spend, and support the commercial objectives of their assigned shows. The ideal candidate will be a strategic, analytical marketer with deep expertise in performance marketing, particularly paid search and paid social, who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

The Digital Marketing Manager will:

Lead the digital marketing strategy for an assigned portfolio of Resident Shows, ensuring alignment with business objectives and revenue goals
Develop digital marketing plans that support ticket sales, audience growth, and long-term brand health
Partner with internal and agency teams to develop and optimize paid search, paid social, display, programmatic, and other digital media campaigns
Own the paid search strategy for assigned shows, continually optimizing campaign structure, bidding strategies, keyword performance, audience targeting, and return on ad spend
Lead paid social strategy across platforms including Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging channels by developing audience strategies, creative testing plans, and optimization recommendations that maximize revenue and campaign performance
Analyze campaign, website, and sales performance to identify trends and recommend data-driven optimizations that improve revenue and marketing efficiency
Collaborate with CRM, Analytics, Social Media, Communications, Creative, and Revenue Management teams to deliver integrated Marketing strategies
Develop testing strategies for creative, messaging, landing pages, audience segmentation, and campaign optimization to continually improve performance
Work closely with external agencies and digital platform partners to ensure campaigns are executed efficiently and aligned with strategic priorities
Support the development and implementation of annual marketing plans, digital budgets, forecasting, and performance reporting for assigned shows
Develop presentations, business cases, and strategic recommendations for senior leadership and partner organizations
Proactively seek innovative digital marketing opportunities, emerging technologies, AI solutions, and platform best practices that support division objectives and revenue growth
Continually communicate campaign performance, insights, learnings, and recommendations to partners, senior leadership, and internal stakeholders
Complete all other job-related duties as assigned

The ideal candidate will have the following qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Digital Marketing, or a related field
At least 5 years of experience in digital marketing, performance marketing, entertainment marketing, tourism marketing, advertising, or agency environments
Previous experience driving revenue, ticket sales, or consumer demand through digital marketing initiatives preferred
Demonstrated expertise in paid search (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads) and paid social advertising (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other emerging platforms)
Experience managing multi-million-dollar digital advertising budgets and optimizing campaigns based on revenue performance and return on ad spend
Strong understanding of Google Analytics (GA4), Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, and other digital analytics and reporting platforms
Experience with audience segmentation, attribution, conversion optimization, A/B testing, and digital performance reporting
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and develop strategic business recommendations
Strong presentation, communication, project management, and organizational skills
Experience working collaboratively with agencies, vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders
Working knowledge of Microsoft Office software (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, etc.)
Ability to work under pressure while maintaining a professional and collaborative demeanor
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to travel as required
Verification of the right to work in the United States for Cirque du Soleil Entertainment Group, as demonstrated by completion of the Form I-9 upon hire and submission of acceptable documentation verifying identity and work authorization

As you can imagine, working with a circus can be quite different from other organizations, and at Cirque du Soleil Entertainment Group, we embrace these differences loudly with enthusiasm. We realize that one size fits none and invite you to come create your own specialized experience with us to see exactly what we’re talking about, firsthand.

Our emotion-provoking shows are just the tip of the iceberg: laced throughout our organization, you will find creative minds who are empowered to use their voices and be themselves, their truest selves. Diversity to us means various perspectives, fresh ideas and continuous improvement of the way we do things. We won’t pretend like we have every answer, that’s why we need you! The employees here are the center of what we do, the voices behind the final product and amazing performances on stage.

When you think of your ideal workplace, what comes to mind? For us, it looks (and really is) like this:

Teamwork - we thrive with collaborative teams, regardless of titles or departments;
Respect - when we ask someone to join our team, it’s because we trust and respect you;
Integrity - whether you work behind-the-scenes or in the office, you’re being counted on. We are a team and integrity goes a long way here, and like we mentioned previously, trust is important;
Authenticity - we want you to bring your full self to work, this is a place where you don’t need to fit into a box to belong; diverse perspectives foster even more creativity in the workplace. We embrace the human behind the employee number;
Being heard - you have access to everyone in the organization, use your voice on development questions or suggestions on how to improve the experience. We value open and transparent communication, and we want you to be heard!

jobs.description:
We are obsessed with the hero's journey at JobNimbus. Every person has a hero's journey. Hermione Granger, James T. Kirk, Frodo Baggins, Anna & Elsa, Nacho Libre, and even YOU! This is our "call to adventure" to come check out JobNimbus. What do you have to lose? You might make a few new friends, learn about a sick new company doing some amazing things, and maybe you'll even land a new job!

Mission

Paid media is how most roofing contractors first discover JobNimbus. Your mission is to run it hands-on so every dollar we spend turns into demos that close, not just clicks or cheap form fills. That starts with the signal. You'll teach Google and Meta to find contractors who become customers by feeding real revenue outcomes back into the platforms. Then you'll make sure the leads they find don't get lost. Every paid lead should land in HubSpot with a clear source and reach a rep who can help. From there, you'll widen the engine. Google carries most of our paid demand today, and you'll change that by building Meta into a proven second channel and launching target-account campaigns on LinkedIn. The goal is growth that holds steady, even when one platform has a bad week.

What You'll Be Doing

Run Google Ads hands-on. Audit and restructure the account for yield, keep Performance Max under control, and roll out bidding changes carefully so lead flow stays steady while the algorithms learn.
Build Meta from the ground up. Launch lead ads, the Conversions API, lookalike and retargeting audiences, and a steady stream of contractor-focused video and UGC creative tests. Then bring a data-backed case for how far to scale it.
Optimize to revenue, not form fills. Send demo-held and closed-won outcomes back to Google and Meta so the platforms learn which leads turn into customers.
Own the tracking and lead flow. Partner with Marketing Ops so every paid lead lands in HubSpot with its source and routes to a rep. Keep spam, invalid traffic, and abandoned forms out of your conversion data.
Launch target-account campaigns. Build account-based audiences on LinkedIn and Meta with Sales Ops, and run enterprise campaigns alongside our Business Development team.
Own the budget. Plan spend by channel and campaign, pace it weekly, and move dollars toward what produces demos that close.
Test constantly. Run creative, audience, and landing page tests every month, log what you learn, and scale the winners.
Partner with Creative, Content, and Sales. Write clear creative briefs, team up on landing page tests, and use feedback from sales reps to sharpen targeting.
Tell the story in plain language. Send a weekly paid performance snapshot to your leader that explains what changed, why, and what's next.
Support growth into new markets. Launch geo-targeted campaigns as JobNimbus expands into new regions.

What Makes You The Hero For This Job

4+ years of hands-on experience managing Google Ads for lead generation, including Performance Max, with results measured on pipeline or revenue
Hands-on Meta lead gen experience: lead ads, audience building, high-volume creative testing, and the Conversions API
Strong conversion tracking skills with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and offline conversion imports, plus the ability to find and fix broken tracking
Experience connecting ad platform leads to HubSpot so leads arrive with a source and route correctly
Comfortable owning a paid media budget and pacing spend weekly
Able to work full-time in our Lehi, Utah office

Superpowers

Customer Obsession: You want to know what makes a roofing contractor stop scrolling, click, and book a demo, and you go find out by listening to sales calls and reading the leads yourself.
Extreme Ownership: When a campaign stumbles, you're the first to say so. You own the fix, including the tracking, the lead flow, and the budget.
Self Awareness: You know where your paid media skills are deep and where they're still growing, and you ask for help or feedback early.
Proactive Learning: The platforms change every month and you keep up. You test new features, read the release notes, and bring back what works.
Team Commitment: You make Creative, Content, Marketing Ops, and Sales better partners by giving them clear briefs, fast answers, and credit for the wins.

You will connect marketing, business development, market intelligence, and communications into a coordinated strategy that supports profitable growth and lasting client relationships.

This role combines strategic influence with hands-on leadership. You will partner with firm and operational leaders to decide where to compete, develop client and pursuit strategies, and coach technical professionals to communicate their value. You will also build the marketing and business development team’s capability and strengthen DRMP’s market presence. The opportunity is to shape both the growth strategy and the practices that turn it into results.

What you will lead:

Growth Strategy and Market Intelligence
Partner with firm leadership to translate business goals into focused market, client, and growth plans. Recommend where to invest, expand, or redirect effort based on opportunity, competitive position, and delivery capability.
Track client capital plans, funding programs, procurement activity, legislation, and competitors to identify opportunities early and build a qualified pursuit pipeline.
Guide go/no-go decisions with a clear view of client relationships, competitive positioning, pursuit investment, and the firm’s ability to win and deliver.
Use pipeline, win-rate, client-growth, and pursuit data to assess results, challenge assumptions, and adjust priorities with operational leaders.

Pursuit Strategy and Winning Work
Lead strategy for major pursuits, from early positioning through RFQ/RFP responses and interviews. Shape differentiated win themes around client priorities and the firm’s technical strengths.
Provide hands-on direction on critical proposals and qualifications packages, ensuring persuasive writing, clear value propositions, and consistent quality.
Coach technical leaders and interview teams on client engagement, presentation strategy, messaging, team selection, and rehearsal.
Lead win/loss debriefs and apply the findings to improve pursuit selection, proposal quality, interview performance, and future results.

Client Development and Account Growth
Partner with client and technical leaders to develop key-account plans, deepen relationships, and identify needs before opportunities are formally advertised.
Equip technical professionals to build client relationships, ask effective questions, and turn insight into practical account and pursuit actions.
Identify opportunities to bring additional services and expertise to clients. Track continuing services contracts and subsequent task orders to help account teams convert awards into sustained work.
Gather client feedback, assess relationship health, and work with account teams to address concerns and follow through on commitments.

Brand and Strategic Communications
Translate complex technical expertise and project outcomes into a clear, differentiated market position and compelling client-facing content.
Direct thought leadership, public relations, digital marketing, social media, awards, and industry events in support of priority markets and client relationships.
Coach leaders and subject-matter experts to communicate credibly with clients and industry audiences through presentations, articles, and speaking opportunities.
Partner with the Chief People Officer on internal messaging and change communications, helping leaders explain business priorities while supporting the CPO’s ownership of internal communications.

Team Leadership and Business Partnership
Build, lead, and develop the marketing and business development teams, with clear priorities, ownership, resource allocation, and accountability for results.
Create trusted partnerships with operational and technical leaders. Influence across offices and disciplines, challenge constructively, and align teams around shared growth priorities.
Strengthen team knowledge of the firm’s services, clients, and commercial priorities. Develop the team’s ability to advise pursuit and account leaders.
Improve pursuit processes, CRM discipline, and knowledge sharing so teams can work consistently, use client intelligence, and adopt more effective ways of winning work.

What you bring:

Qualifications and Experience
8+ years of progressive marketing, business development, or growth leadership experience in AEC, engineering consulting, environmental consulting, or a closely related technical professional services business. Comparable impact and scope will be considered.
Experience leading a marketing or business development function, region, or business unit. Senior Directors and Vice Presidents ready for a broader remit are encouraged; a prior CMO title is not required.
A measurable record of improving pursuit outcomes, client growth, or market position, with clear examples of personal ownership and partnership with technical leaders.
Strong AEC pursuit expertise, including qualifications-based selection, RFQ/RFP strategy, proposal development, interview coaching, and pre-positioning. Able to connect marketing strategy with client development and winning work.
Success leading and developing teams across offices, disciplines, or a matrixed organization, and coaching technical professionals in client engagement and business development.
Strong commercial judgment, persuasive writing and presentation skills, and experience translating technical expertise into compelling positioning and communications.
High emotional intelligence and credibility with senior leaders. Able to influence without direct authority, navigate resistance, and lead adoption of new processes while maintaining strong relationships.
Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

Construction is a multi-trillion-dollar industry that still estimates by hand. Contractors measure and count materials off drawings manually, and it caps how many jobs they can bid. Bobyard uses computer vision and NLP to automate takeoffs and estimates, so contractors bid faster and win more. We raised a $35M Series A led by 8VC, with Primary and Pear, and we're growing fast.

About The Role

Contractors buy from people they've met, and a lot of those meetings happen on a trade show floor. You'll own Bobyard's events program across the trades we serve: landscaping, electrical, mechanical, concrete, and more. You'll set our events strategy, decide which events are worth it, run the biggest ones yourself, and report what each one returned in meetings and pipeline. You'll partner closely with sales, and plans will change often. The work is physical and show weeks are long. The payoff is knowing exactly which events win us customers.

What You'll Do

Set the events strategy and annual calendar, tier every event, and set a meetings target for each one before we sign

Get every lead into HubSpot and in front of the right rep within 48 hours of the show closing

Write the playbook so each show runs faster than the last

4+ years in event marketing or field marketing at a B2B company, including owning an events strategy and budget
You've run 12 or more events a quarter, from major booths to walk-the-floor shows, contract to follow-up

Calm under pressure. A crate goes missing at 6am and the booth still opens on time. The plan changes the night before and you adjust.
Comfortable traveling about 30%, often to convention centers for several days at a time

Construction, trades, or industrial trade show experience
Experience routing event leads in HubSpot or Salesforce
Experience bringing customers to the booth or onto a speaking panel
Experience as the first or only events hire at a startup

Cash for stability. Bonus for performance. Equity for ownership. Your package reflects your role, your experience, and what you deliver.

We strive to inspire and grow our company, our partnerships, our science, and our people, because when we do, we deliver more for patients.

As the Senior Director, Patient Marketing Excellence, you will lead the shaping of marketing capabilities, developing talent, implementing solutions to deliver strategic marketing innovation and optimization, and maximizing cross-functional connectivity needed to scale pipeline, patient commercial strategy, patient marketing and patient engagement across a growing portfolio. You will serve as the capability builder and accelerator – setting capability standards, developing emerging leaders, specialized expertise, and ensuring continued evolution consistent with patient, portfolio, and business needs. You will lead resource prioritization and deployment and help to build a versatile marketing talent bench with differentiated depth across marketing disciplines.

You will partner closely with cross-functional leaders across argenx pipeline, in-market indications, therapeutic areas and connect portfolio priorities with the capabilities and capacity needed to deliver them. This role is an opportunity to build not only what the organization needs today, but the talent, expertise, and marketing capabilities needed at scale.

Roles & Responsibilities

Patient Marketing Excellence Vision and Leadership

Set the vision, priorities, and capability agenda for the Patient Marketing & Engagement Strategy Community as portfolio and patient needs evolve.
Build and accelerate expertise with focus on patient engagement, patient commercial strategy (including early pipeline), patient marketing, and patient adherence, ensuring knowledge depth, prioritization, and effective cross-functional collaboration.
Proactively identify capability, talent, and capacity gaps and recommend where the organization should build, hire, or bring in external expertise.
Partner with the Head of Patient Marketing & Engagement Strategy on resourcing, talent mapping, and organizational decisions.

Capability Strategy and Evolution

Ensure Patient Marketing, Engagement Strategy, and emerging areas of expertise continue to evolve with the market, patient needs and preferences, portfolio, and business dynamics.
Work with cross-functional capability leaders to strengthen standards, tools, measurement, and best practices within marketing disciplines and across the enterprise.
Build new and/or deeper expertise where needed, including emerging patient populations, device and delivery needs, patient experience, and other cross-portfolio priorities.
Scale approaches, ways of working, and learnings across the portfolio so teams can build on what works.

Marketing Leadership, Excellence and Deployment

Shape and develop emerging talent within marketing as a flexible, high-performing team deployed against the portfolio’s highest-priority marketing needs.
Own resource prioritization and deployment, matching the right skills and level of experience to each assignment while balancing capacity and continuity.
Build differentiated expertise across early pipeline, launch excellence, marketing, omnichannel media, customer engagement, performance optimization, agency management, and other priority marketing disciplines.
Raise the standard of marketing excellence by building strategic discipline, marketing skills, and consistent quality across the team.
Keep the Patient Marketing & Engagement Community current with advances in AI, automation, data and analytics, technology, and external marketing practices; translate relevant innovation into practical ways of working.
Anticipate future demand and evolve the team’s skills, staffing, and external support before portfolio needs arise.
Measure impact and refine the deployment model based on business results, stakeholder feedback, capacity, and talent development.

Talent and Leadership development

Build leadership depth and succession pathways through coaching, mentorship, and clear development plans.
Create meaningful assignments and cross-portfolio experiences that build both versatile patient marketers and deep specialists.
Identify future skill and capability needs and develop or recruit talent to close critical gaps.
Create a culture of patient focus, accountability, collaboration, learning, and marketing excellence.

Cross-Portfolio Partnership and Impact

Partner with indication and cross-functional leaders to translate business priorities into clear marketing capability and resource needs.
Clarify how Indication Strategy Teams, Marketing, PSP, Patient Advocacy, and cross-functional partners work with patient marketing, so expectations, decisions and handoffs are clear.
Address competing resource and capability needs across the portfolio and escalate major trade-offs when needed.
Track Patient Marketing effectiveness through practical measures of capability strength, resource deployment, talent development, and business impact.

Strategic and organizational leadership: Ability to set a clear direction for a multi-capability organization, translate portfolio needs into priorities, and scale as the business grows.
Capability building: Demonstrated ability to build and strengthen marketing capabilities, identifying where expertise, standards, tools, talent, or new approaches are needed to meet evolving patient and business needs.
Modern marketing expertise: Strong understanding of marketing across launch, growth, and lifecycle stages, with the judgment to recognize emerging practices and capabilities that can strengthen patient marketing.
Fluency in AI-enabled marketing, automation, agile ways of working, reusable and modular approaches, customer analytics, with the ability to translate new capabilities into practical opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness, speed, and scale.
Experience leading agencies, budgets, workplans, vendors, and complex marketing initiatives with strong quality and performance discipline.

Change leadership: Ability to lead through growth, ambiguity, and organizational change, bringing clarity to new structures, capabilities, and ways of working.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Demand Generation
jobs.description:
We are obsessed with the hero's journey at JobNimbus. Every person has a hero's journey. Hermione Granger, James T. Kirk, Frodo Baggins, Anna & Elsa, Nacho Libre, and even YOU! This is our "call to adventure" to come check out JobNimbus. What do you have to lose? You might make a few new friends, learn about a sick new company doing some amazing things, and maybe you'll even land a new job!

Mission

JobNimbus helps roofing contractors run their businesses. Inbound is how most of them find us, so it’s our largest source of new business. Your mission is to turn inbound into a predictable revenue engine that the business, Sales and the board can plan around. That means owning the full journey, from the first ad impression to the signed contract. Every lead gets captured, routed to the right rep and followed up quickly. Demand doesn’t hinge on one platform or one bidding algorithm, so you’ll build paid, organic, AI search, referral, partner and event channels that grow together. Success is measured in demos held and closed-won revenue, not lead counts. You’ll also extend that engine into new territory: a pipeline program for mid-market and enterprise accounts with our BD and Sales teams, and a repeatable playbook for launching JobNimbus in new regional markets. Do this well and you’ll have built the growth foundation for JobNimbus’s next stage, and a team that keeps it running.

What You'll Be Doing

Own inbound from lead to closed-won. Diagnose the funnel by source and stage, present a plan of attack in your first few weeks, and take accountability for demos held, conversion and new ARR alongside Sales.
Fix the foundation. Make sure every form, ad platform and lead source lands in HubSpot as a lead, routed to the right rep within an agreed speed-to-lead SLA. Partner with RevOps so every demo has a source and leadership sees one trusted inbound number.
Diversify and improve paid performance. Launch and scale Meta as our next paid engine, grow organic, AI search, referral, partner and event channels, and direct agencies so paid search optimizes to demos held and closed-won, not cheap form fills.
Build new growth engines. Partner with BD and Sales on target-account advertising, ABM, and field and partner events for enterprise pipeline. Lead marketing for regional market launches, starting with Phoenix.
Lead the team. Develop marketers and agency partners, and brief Creative, Content, Events and Product Marketing so their work is measured against pipeline.

What Makes You The Hero For This Job

8+ years in B2B demand generation or growth marketing, including 3+ years leading teams and agencies. SaaS with high-velocity SMB inbound is strongly preferred.
You’ve owned a pipeline or revenue number alongside a sales team.
You’ve diagnosed and reversed a declining inbound funnel, and you can show before-and-after results through closed-won.
You’ve moved real budget and lead volume into a new paid channel, ideally Meta, and can show the results.
You have hands-on depth in Google Ads and Meta: value-based bidding, offline conversions, the Conversions API, Performance Max, and invalid-traffic controls.
You’re fluent in HubSpot or an equivalent marketing automation platform and CRM: lifecycle stages, lead scoring, routing and attribution.
You’ve built organic or content channels that produced pipeline, not just traffic.
You’re data-first: every number you present traces back to a real report.

Superpowers

Customer Obsession. Every campaign starts with the contractor. You learn how roofers actually buy software: what they search for at 9 p.m. after a long day on a roof, what makes them book a demo, and what makes them sign. Then you build the funnel around that, not around cheap clicks.
Extreme Ownership. You own the number, not just the MQLs. That means demos held, conversion and new ARR. When a lead falls through the cracks, a form isn’t connected, or a channel stalls, you’re the first to notice, you fix it, and you tell leadership before they have to ask.
Self Awareness. You know the difference between a story and a result, and you won’t call MQL growth a win when deals are falling. You ask for feedback from Sales, your team and your agencies, own your misses, and change course quickly when the data says you’re wrong.
Proactive Learning. Paid platforms, AI search and buyer behavior change every quarter, and you stay ahead of them. You test, measure and iterate fast, and you treat JobNimbus product knowledge as a competitive edge, because the better you know the product, the better you can sell it.
Team Commitment. Great demand gen is a team sport. You get Sales, RevOps, Creative, Content and Events working toward the same definitions and the same pipeline goals. You develop the people on your team, hold agencies to a high bar, and celebrate wins together.

Mentor

Matt Nelson - Specialist in hiring amazing people, lover of music, Connect Four, ping pong, tennis, pickleball, photography, celebrating birthdays, the Red Sox, and recruiting.

DEPARTMENT:

LOCATION:

COMPANY:
Humacyte Inc (Nasdaq: HUMA) is developing a disruptive biotechnology platform to deliver universally implantable bioengineered human tissues, advanced tissue constructs, and organ systems designed to improve the lives of patients and transform the practice of medicine. The Company develops and manufactures acellular tissues to treat a wide range of diseases, injuries, and chronic conditions. Humacyte’s initial opportunity, a portfolio of Acellular Tissue Engineered Vessel (ATEVs), is currently approved for use in vascular trauma repair and is in late-stage clinical trials targeting multiple other applications including AV access for hemodialysis and peripheral arterial disease. Preclinical development is also underway in coronary artery bypass grafts, pediatric heart surgery, treatment of type 1 diabetes, and multiple novel cell and tissue applications. Humacyte’s 6mm ATEV for AV access in hemodialysis was the first product candidate to receive the FDA’s Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy (RMAT) designation and has also received FDA Fast Track designation. Humacyte’s 6mm ATEV for urgent arterial repair following extremity vascular trauma also received the RMAT designation. For more information, visit www.Humacyte.com .

JOB SUMMARY:

The Marketing Manager/Senior Marketing Manager, Marketing Communications and DTC will play a key role in developing and executing integrated marketing programs that elevate brand awareness, engage key stakeholders, and support commercial objectives. Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) Marketing

jobs.description:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs.

Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”

Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.

The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.

About The Role

We're hiring a senior Growth leader to architect and operate our growth engine from the ground up — hands‑on. This isn't a "manage the agency" role. You'll be the one designing the system, wiring the stack, running the experiments, and shipping the assets. You think in funnels and frameworks, build measurement infrastructure before you launch campaigns, and treat go-to-market as an engineering discipline: instrument, test, iterate, scale.

You'll work directly with Sales, RevOps, Product, and Brand to turn signal into pipeline — and you'll be the one who actually builds the things that make that happen. Critically, you'll own the number: net new business in the form of marketing qualified leads is your north star, and you'll be accountable for hitting it. This will be a high-visibility role with incredible growth opportunities.

What You'll Do

Ad Engine Ownership & Performance Marketing

Own the design, build, and continuous optimization of our ad engine across paid search, paid social, programmatic, and video — with a focus on efficiency, scale, and measurable pipeline contribution.
Architect audience segmentation, bidding strategies, creative rotation logic, and budget allocation frameworks to maximize return on ad spend.
Move beyond channel management: treat the ad engine as a product, iterating on targeting logic, landing page pairings, offer variants, and conversion pathways to compound performance over time.
Own hands‑on execution — you're in the platforms, not just reviewing reports.

Driving Net New Business: MQL Ownership

Own the MQL number. You are directly accountable for generating net new marketing qualified leads that convert into pipeline and revenue.
Build and operate the demand generation engine that fills the top of funnel — from first touch to sales-ready hand‑off — with clear SLAs, routing logic, and feedback loops.
Define and enforce MQL quality standards in partnership with Sales and RevOps, continuously tightening the criteria as signal improves.
Report on MQL volume, velocity, cost-per-MQL, and downstream conversion rates; use those inputs to direct investment across channels and programs.

Scaling the Marketing Foundation: 1 to 100

Take the marketing foundations already in place — brand narrative, positioning, early channel presence, initial playbooks — and build the operational engine that scales them.
Translate strategy into a repeatable growth system: standardized processes, campaign architecture, channel playbooks, and asset libraries that multiply output without multiplying headcount.
Identify what's working at small scale and build the infrastructure — tooling, measurement, creative, ops — to run it at 10x without losing fidelity or efficiency.
Close the gaps between brand and demand: ensure every scaled program reinforces positioning while driving measurable business outcomes.

Full-Funnel Growth System Ownership

Design and own the full‑funnel growth architecture: paid (search, social, programmatic, video), organic (SEO, content, web), ABM, partnerships, and referral.
Build the experimentation infrastructure — test frameworks, audience segmentation, offer variants, landing page scaffolding — and run rapid learning cycles.
Engineer the demand‑to‑pipeline path: ICP definitions, routing logic, handoff SLAs, and Sales feedback loops.
Identify new channels and build the playbook before you scale spend.

Growth Stack & Analytics

Instrument the growth funnel end‑to‑end across Salesforce, HubSpot, GA4, Webflow/CMS, and attribution/BI tooling.
Partner with RevOps and Analytics to establish taxonomy, data hygiene standards, experimentation frameworks, and attribution models that hold up under scrutiny.
Build dashboards and reporting infrastructure that make the "what's working" question answerable in real time — and translate results into insights, next actions, and investment guidance for Marketing and GTM leaders.

Cross-Functional Alignment

Serve as the DRI for growth: set strategy, run the operating cadence, and align Sales, RevOps, Product, and Brand around clear priorities and decision criteria.
Build influence without line authority — turn cross‑functional stakeholders into an integrated growth squad.
Maintain a transparent roadmap and experiment backlog; communicate trade‑offs and learnings frequently.

What You Have

Senior, hands‑on experience building integrated growth programs in B2B SaaS; healthtech experience a plus.
Demonstrated ownership of an MQL or pipeline number — you've been accountable for net new business outcomes, not just activity metrics.
Deep hands‑on experience building and optimizing ad engines across paid search, social, and programmatic; you know the platforms as well as the strategy.
Proven ability to take an early-stage marketing foundation and scale it into a high-output, repeatable growth system.
You're equally comfortable instrumenting a funnel as writing a high‑conversion brief — you've shipped real things in both modes.
Strong systems instinct: you design processes, taxonomies, and operating cadences that other people can actually use.
You influence without authority, move fast with incomplete information, and maintain high standards while doing it.
A bias toward building: when something doesn't exist, you make it.

Nice to Have

Built ABM motions in close partnership with Enterprise and Mid‑Market Sales.
Run product‑led and sales‑led motions in parallel.
Worked with data science on incrementality testing or advanced attribution.
Scaled a performance creative system across channels — briefing, asset libraries, structured testing.

A Japanese global leader in the provision of ground-breaking and innovative technological and research solutions to the healthcare industry. The M3 Group operates in the US, Asia, and Europe with over 5.8 million physician members globally via its physician websites which include mdlinx.com, m3.com, research.m3.com, Doctors.net.uk, medigate.net, and medlive.cn.
