The M3 Group provides services to healthcare and the life science industry. In addition to market research, these services include medical education, ethical drug promotion, clinical development, job recruitment, and clinic appointment services. M3 has offices in Japan, UK, France, Germany, Brazil, Sweden, China, USA, and South Korea, as well as India.

M3 USA
is seeking a Senior Manager, B2B Outbound Marketing
to develop and execute targeted outbound strategies across our portfolio of healthcare businesses.

This is a hands-on, strategically focused role centered on identifying the right business decision-makers, building targeted prospect audiences, and generating qualified sales conversations through personalized, multichannel outreach.

You will work closely with sales and marketing leadership across multiple business units to develop buyer personas, build outreach campaigns using email, LinkedIn, and sales engagement platforms, and continuously optimize performance to drive measurable pipeline growth.

This is not a traditional digital advertising or paid media position. We are looking for a B2B marketing professional with demonstrated experience building and executing outbound programs that connect sales teams with qualified prospective customers.

Job Description

Build and own a full digital outreach path for each subsidiary by identifying decision makers for each product, define specific buyer personas for each business sales activity and grow contact lists from verified sources and research.
Run multi-channel outbound sequences across email, LinkedIn and other social and digital channels, tailored by subsidiaries, with messaging that speaks to a targeted audience.
Coordinate efforts with email deliverability specialists for all outbound email domains: authentication and IP warming, sender reputation monitoring, inbox placement testing, list hygiene, and compliance with Google, Yahoo, and Microsoft sender requirements, to reach corporate inboxes protected by enterprise filters.
Systematize a cross-subsidiary strategy that converts M3's proprietary data assets, such as a network of physicians or health-system relationships— into a repeatable pipeline of qualified conversations through referrals and warm introductions.
Use AI-assisted research and personalization: build account and contact intelligence, generate personalization at scale, test and refine messaging, while maintaining M3 human review and brand standards.
Partner with the business development and marketing leads of each subsidiary on target account lists, handoff criteria, follow-up cadence, and feedback on message performance;
Operate designated BU’s technology stack for outreach (sequencing, Sales Navigator,), integrate it with their CRM’s and recommend new or advanced tech tools.
Report weekly on placement, reply and positive-reply rates, and pipeline sourced by subsidiary and persona, and use the data to retire what does not work and scale what does.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Certifications in email deliverability, sequencing platforms, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator preferred.
7+ years in B2B digital outreach, demand generation, or sales development, with at least 3 years owning persona marketing for outbound commercial revenue generation
Demonstrated success reaching senior decision makers in healthcare, health systems, experience selling recruitment, staffing, or physician placement services strongly preferred.
Hands-on experience with sequencing platforms (e.g., Outreach, Apollo, HubSpot Sequences), LinkedIn Sales Navigator, contact enrichment and verification tools, deliverability monitoring tools, and CRM integration.
Experience supporting or consulting for multiple business units, clients or brands with distinct customers.
Working knowledge of email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI), domain and IP warming, reputation monitoring, and inbox placement testing, and of how Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Proofpoint, Mimecast, and similar filters treat outbound mail.
Ability to identify and verify the true buyer within a target organization (budget owner, decision maker, and influencers), distinguish them from adjacent or easier-to-reach contacts, and hold a disciplined outreach cadence toward that person without defaulting to volume.
Understanding of how health systems, medical groups, and staffing firms recruit physicians, and who own those decisions
Strong writing skills: short, specific with the ability to adapt voice by persona and by subsidiary brand.
Working knowledge of CAN-SPAM, CASL, GDPR/UK GDPR, TCPA, and LinkedIn terms of service as they apply to outbound outreach.
Ability to use AI tools for research, personalization, and testing, with judgment about accuracy, brand, and disclosure.
Ability to manage several concurrent programs independently, prioritize across businesses, and report clearly to sales and marketing leaders.
Analytical fluency with campaign, deliverability, and CRM data; comfortable building simple dashboards.

Additional Information

A career opportunity with M3USA offers competitive wages, and benefits such as:

Health and Dental
Life, Accident and Disability Insurance
Prescription Plan
Flexible Spending Account
401k Plan and Match
Paid Holidays and Vacation
Sick Days and Personal Day

To learn more about Plaud, please visit https://www.Plaud.ai and follow along on Instagram, X, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube

Why You Should Join Us

Plaud is building the next generation intelligence infrastructure and interfaces to capture, extract, and utilize intelligence from what people say, hear, see, and think.

Plaud is a bootstrapped, skyrocketing, profitable company with a $300M revenue run rate achieved in just three years.
Define the next-gen paradigm for human-AI interaction.
Gain exposure to cutting-edge AI for Pro tools and play a direct role in our global expansion.
Work with passionate teammates who value innovation, collaboration, and customer success.
Grow your career in a culture that champions continuous learning and fast career development.
Market-competitive compensation, global exposure, and a vibrant, creativity-fueled work atmosphere.

The role

We are looking for a Technical Product Marketing Lead to shape how Plaud’s software and AI products are understood, launched, and adopted around the world.

This role sits at the intersection of Product, AI, and Marketing. You will develop a deep understanding of how Plaud’s products work, identify the customer value behind their technical capabilities, and turn that understanding into compelling product stories, launch strategies, and customer-facing content.

At Plaud, Product Marketing Has Three Dimensions

Strategist: Define the audience, value proposition, positioning, product narrative, and go-to-market architecture.
Writer: Create the foundational messaging and critical content from which global and regional teams build.
Orchestrator: Coordinate cross-functional teams and channels to bring a cohesive product story to market.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role with significant ownership. You will not simply receive a finished strategy and execute against it. You will investigate the product, develop the strategy, write the essential materials, and guide the work through launch.

What You Will Own

Product understanding and technical translation

Develop a detailed understanding of Plaud’s software, AI systems, developer capabilities, and their connection to Plaud hardware.
Partner closely with Product, AI, Engineering, and Design to understand product architecture, technical documentation, roadmap decisions, and feature behavior.
Identify valuable capabilities and use cases that may not yet have been translated into customer-facing stories.
Turn technical functionality, specifications, and AI concepts into clear customer benefits without losing accuracy or substance.
Develop product FAQs, feature explanations, demo narratives, and technical education materials.

Positioning and product storytelling

Define target audiences, customer problems, value propositions, positioning, message houses, use cases, and product narratives.
Build the foundational messaging for products including Plaud Intelligence, Plaud Teams, Plaud developer, etc.
Connect Plaud’s hardware, software, and AI capabilities into one cohesive customer experience and narrative.
Establish clear messaging hierarchies that global and regional teams can adapt to their audiences and channels.
Maintain the accuracy, clarity, consistency, and quality of product messaging across the customer journey.

Go-to-market strategy and orchestration

Own the go-to-market architecture for new software products, AI capabilities, and major feature releases.
Define launch objectives, audiences, messaging, channel roles, critical assets, dependencies, rollout plans, and success measures.
Coordinate Product, AI, Creative, Growth, Communications, Sales, Support, and regional teams throughout the launch process.
Create the global toolkits and foundational assets that enable regional teams to activate launches locally.
Review execution across channels and ensure the product story remains accurate and coherent from strategy through activation.
Operate effectively across multiple launches and adapt quickly as product priorities evolve.

Foundational content and enablement

Personally write or directly own critical product-marketing deliverables, including messaging frameworks, launch briefs, product pages, feature descriptions, FAQs, internal briefs, blogs, and campaign narratives.
Partner with Creative and channel owners to turn the core product story into landing pages, videos, visuals, demonstrations, and campaign assets.
Build product training, enablement decks, competitive guidance, and objection-handling materials for Marketing, Sales, Support, and regional teams.
Give cross-functional partners the context, standards, and tools needed to communicate Plaud’s products effectively.

Insight and continuous improvement

Gather feedback from customers, product data, sales conversations, support teams, reviews, and regional partners.
Synthesize technical, customer, and market inputs into actionable recommendations.
Monitor competitors and emerging AI and productivity behaviors to identify narrative, product, and go-to-market opportunities.
Use launch results and customer feedback to improve positioning, content, product education, and future go-to-market programs.
Bring relevant market insights back to Product and AI teams to help inform roadmap decisions.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 12 months, you will have:

Built strong technical fluency across Plaud’s software and AI portfolio.

The next wave of enterprise software isn't about writing more code — it's about giving organizations the tools to combine trusted data, AI, and applications into systems that can reason and act on their own. If you want to work at the intersection of enterprise AI, knowledge graphs, and agentic applications — with real customers and real production stakes, across nearly every major industry — this is where that work is happening.

Content Marketing Manager – Industrial B2B

Siemens Digital Industries Software
is seeking a Content Marketing Manager who specializes in marketing to complex, engineering-driven industrial sectors and thrives at the intersection of technical depth and compelling storytelling. This individual will create content that earns the trust of executive audiences and translates complex technical concepts into narratives that drive awareness, pipeline, and product adoption.

You'll develop category-defining content including SME-driven insights, research-backed reports, practitioner guides, webinars, and executive thought leadership. The ideal candidate is curious, resourceful, process-oriented, and focused on delivering measurable business outcomes.

Content

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Operations Manager (Reporting and Analytics)
jobs.description:
Vestwell is the financial technology company powering the new savings economy. The New York City-based fintech platform redefines how people save for the critical aspects of life across retirement, education, and healthcare savings needs. Today, Vestwell enables over 790,000 businesses and more than 2.75 million active savers, with over $57 billion in assets saved across all 50 United States.

Vestwell offers a range of products, including workplace-delivered retirement plans, employer-offered student loan repayment benefits, and various savings accounts for education, emergencies, and individuals with disabilities.

Vestwell's platform serves a diverse clientele, including financial advisers, employers, third-party administrators, financial institutions, payroll providers, government agencies, and individual savers. To learn more, visit vestwell.com

Who Are We Looking For?

Vestwell's marketing team is looking for a Senior Marketing Operations Manager to serve as the primary owner of marketing analytics and reporting. This person will partner with Data, Product, and Revenue Technology to understand the data available across Google Analytics, HubSpot, and Salesforce, bring those sources into a consistent reporting view, and build the dashboards marketing needs to measure performance and make better decisions.

The role will also own marketing attributes, the data points used to identify meaningful customer groups and support targeted campaigns. Working closely with Product and Engineering, this person will understand how attributes are defined and used, represent Marketing when attributes change, and help campaign teams apply them effectively.

This is a hands-on analytics and reporting role, not a software or data engineering position. Success requires strong data judgment, practical reporting and dashboard-building skills, a clear understanding of how business systems connect, and the ability to translate stakeholder needs into useful reporting.

What Will You Be Doing?

Own marketing analytics and reporting. Serve as the main point of contact for marketing performance data, dashboards, recurring reporting, and measurement questions. Establish clear metric definitions and reporting standards so teams use a consistent view of performance.
Understand and connect the data. Partner with Data and Revenue Technology to map the available pre and post-sale data across Google Analytics, HubSpot, and Salesforce. Determine how those sources should work together, identify access or quality gaps, and create a reliable reporting view of the customer journey.
Build dashboards and recurring reports. Translate marketing questions into practical dashboards and reports that track initiatives, campaign performance, funnel movement, and business outcomes. Maintain the reports, validate the underlying data, and improve them as needs change.
Own marketing attributes. Maintain Marketing's understanding of the customer attributes used for segmentation and targeting. Partner with Product to understand how an attribute is defined, where it comes from, and how it can be used. Act as Marketing's point of contact when Product or Engineering proposes a new attribute or a change to an existing one.
Enable targeted campaigns. Help marketing teams identify useful customer groupings and apply approved attributes to campaign design, audience selection, personalization, and performance analysis. Confirm that segments are based on reliable data and can be measured consistently.
Measure the marketing funnel. Connect upper-funnel activity and pre-sale engagement to lead progression, sales outcomes, and relevant post-sale signals. Develop campaign and funnel reporting while clearly documenting data and attribution limitations.
Coordinate across teams. Work comfortably with Marketing, Data, Revenue Technology, Product, and Engineering to define requirements, resolve data questions, prioritize work, and communicate findings in terms each team can use.

Requirements

The Necessities

5+ years of experience in marketing analytics, marketing operations, business intelligence, or a similar data-focused role.
Advanced hands-on experience with Google Analytics and HubSpot reporting, including the ability to build, validate, and explain reports within each platform.
Working knowledge of Salesforce reporting and data structures, with the ability to partner with Revenue Technology to obtain and apply the data Marketing needs.
Experience building dashboards and reporting frameworks in a business intelligence or data visualization tool such as Tableau, Sigma, or Looker.
Experience reconciling data from multiple systems, documenting metric definitions, identifying data-quality issues, and explaining the limits of the available data.
Experience using customer attributes, segments, or product data to support targeted marketing campaigns and measurement.
Strong analytical judgment and the ability to translate business questions into clear data requirements, useful reports, and actionable findings.
Demonstrated ability to work across Marketing, Data, Revenue Technology, Product, and Engineering teams, including stakeholders with different technical backgrounds.
Strong project management and communication skills, with close attention to accuracy, consistency, and follow-through.
Bachelor's degree in marketing, analytics, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

The Extras

Experience in financial services, technology, or another regulated industry.
Relevant Google Analytics, HubSpot, Salesforce, or business intelligence certifications.
Familiarity with product or behavioral analytics tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or Pendo.
Basic familiarity with SQL, data warehouses, or data integration concepts. This knowledge is helpful for partnering with technical teams but is not an engineering requirement.

This role will be based in either the New York City office, and will be part of Vestwell's hybrid in-office operation.

The expected base salary range for this position is $105K - $140K base. This position is eligible to participate in the Company Bonus Pool and is eligible to receive new hire equity in the Company. Please note that salary bands are based on NY and other similar metro areas and may differ based on where the role is ultimately hired.

Employee Benefits

We’re an innovative, high-growth company with an exciting future ahead. At Vestwell, we prioritize employee wellbeing through comprehensive health benefits, generous time off, and a dedicated Employee Wellbeing Committee. Our hybrid work model offers flexibility while providing access to our collaborative offices in Midtown Manhattan, Austin, King of Prussia, and Scottsdale. And, of course, as a company focused on helping people save for the future, we offer a competitive 401(k) plan.

Interview Process

Our interview process starts the same for every candidate with 1-2 introductory conversations to learn more about your background, interests, and what you're looking for, while also giving you the opportunity to learn more about Vestwell and the team. From there, the process varies by role but typically includes a skills or experience-based assessment, such as a coding interview, portfolio review, or deeper discussion of your relevant experience. Successful candidates then move on to a virtual or in-person interview panel. Before extending an offer, we complete a reference check with a current or former manager and a peer. Throughout the process, we prioritize transparency, clear communication, and minimizing surprises.

For your awareness you will only receive correspondence from recruiting@vestwell.com any other domain not ending in vestwell.com is not our Recruitment team.

Vestwell’s Privacy Policy. Attention California residents: In the course of conducting our business and complying with federal, state, and local government regulations governing such matters as employment, tax, insurance, etc., we must collect Personal Information from you. Should you accept employment with Vestwell you may view our California Privacy Rights Act here: Vestwell’s California Privacy Rights Policy.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Project Coordinator, Program Marketing brings structure, clarity, and accountability to the marketing of AOPA Foundation aviation programs. Working directly with the Director of Program Marketing, this individual helps turn program goals, ideas, and requests into well-organized marketing campaigns and initiatives that engage audiences and advance the Foundation’s mission.
Highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented, the coordinator manages projects from initial request through final delivery, establishing clear plans, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, and approval processes. Working across Creative, Digital, Social, Web, Email, PMO, Data, and Analytics teams, this individual keeps stakeholders aligned, tracks progress, identifies potential roadblocks, and ensures marketing materials meet brand, legal, and operational requirements.
Through effective project coordination, reporting, and visibility into team workload and capacity, the Project Coordinator, Program Marketing helps minimize delays and rework, maintain quality and consistency, and keep marketing resources focused on priority initiatives. The coordinator also ensures the Director of Program Marketing has the information, materials, and project visibility needed to make informed decisions and keep work moving forward.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

End-to-End Project/Task Coordination

Coordinate marketing projects from initial request through final delivery, establishing scope, priorities, schedules, deliverables, and approval requirements.
Translate project requests into actionable plans with defined tasks, owners, timelines, dependencies, milestones, and review points.
Build, maintain, and manage project schedules and status updates in Wrike.
Monitor progress against milestones and deadlines; identify schedule conflicts and communicate changes promptly.
Coordinate the execution of marketing campaigns and plans within agreed scope, timelines, and budgets.
Identify risks, resource constraints, and dependencies early; develop options and coordinate solutions with the appropriate stakeholders.
Keep cross-functional projects moving by following up on outstanding tasks, decisions, and approvals and escalating issues when necessary.
Workflow and Intake Coordination

Coordinate project intake across Program Marketing and collaborating teams, ensuring requests are documented, requirements are understood, and priorities are clear.
Help translate incoming requests into defined project plans, identifying missing information, conflicting deadlines, and resource needs before work begins.
Communicate project timelines, priorities, constraints, and changes to the appropriate stakeholders.
Maintain visibility into project status, team capacity, and competing demands to support effective prioritization and resource planning.
Identify workflow inefficiencies and recommend or implement practical improvements that increase transparency, consistency, and efficiency.
Document and maintain processes that support repeatable, scalable marketing execution.
Identify practical opportunities to improve workflow and project coordination.
Cross-Functional Coordination

Coordinate with Creative, Digital, Web, Email, Social, PMO, Data, and Analytics teams to align campaign requirements, schedules, deliverables, and handoffs.
Serve as a central coordination point for campaign execution, ensuring stakeholders understand responsibilities, deadlines, and outstanding decisions.
Coordinate with external agencies, vendors, and production partners to track deliverables, manage timelines, and maintain quality expectations.
Track program owner reviews and approvals, following up to keep decisions on schedule.
Keep stakeholders informed of changes in scope, timing, priorities, and dependencies.
Facilitate clear handoffs between teams and help resolve coordination issues that could affect delivery.
Campaign and Collateral Production

Coordinate timelines and production requirements for multichannel digital and print marketing campaigns supporting AOPA Foundation aviation programs.
Track marketing deliverables from initial development through review, approval, production, and launch.
Coordinate the timely production, proofing, and delivery of campaign assets and marketing collateral.
Assist with proofreading promotional copy and reviewing marketing materials for accuracy, clarity, consistency, and alignment with project objectives.
Confirm that required assets, links, landing pages, approvals, and other launch components are ready by established deadlines.
Maintain visibility into production schedules and communicate potential delays or outstanding requirements before they affect launch dates.
Quality and Compliance

Review marketing materials for consistency with AOPA brand guidelines, project requirements, and established quality standards.
Confirm that required legal, operational, and stakeholder reviews are completed before materials are released.
Check deliverables for completeness, accuracy, and consistency across channels and formats.
Coordinate revisions and follow-up reviews to ensure feedback is addressed and final materials are ready for delivery.
Escalate quality or compliance concerns to the appropriate stakeholder before launch.
Calendar and Asset Management

Build, maintain, and monitor the Program Marketing campaign calendar, ensuring project timelines and key milestones are accurate and current.
Maintain organized digital and physical marketing asset libraries with consistent naming conventions, appropriate version control, and easy retrieval.
Flag resource concerns to the Director of Program Marketing.
Help maintain visibility into upcoming campaign commitments, production needs, and competing resource demands.
Reporting and Documentation

Prepare regular project status reports highlighting progress, upcoming milestones, risks, blockers, resource constraints, and decisions needed.
Maintain complete, accurate, and current project documentation throughout the project life cycle.
Compile campaign metrics, website traffic data, and performance reports for the Director of Program Marketing and relevant stakeholders.
Coordinate with Web, Data and Analytics teams to obtain required reporting and ensure performance information is available for review.
Communicate meaningful changes in project status promptly rather than waiting for scheduled reporting.
Help ensure reporting supports informed decisions, effective prioritization, and continuous improvement.
AI and Technology

Use approved AI-assisted and productivity tools to streamline and improve project coordination, support drafting routine communications, summarize information, and improve workflow efficiency.
Review AI-generated content and outputs for accuracy, clarity, brand voice, and compliance before use.
Follow AOPA policies and guidelines for AI use, protecting confidential information and using approved tools appropriately.
Remain accountable for the accuracy, quality, and appropriateness of all work, regardless of the tools used.
**Although this job description aims to capture the majority of the position duties, other duties may be assigned based on business and departmental needs.

The Paid Social Media Manager is responsible for the strategic planning, optimisation, and execution of our paid social media campaigns across multiple platforms. This position reports to the Head of Platform Partnerships and will work closely with various internal and external stakeholders to deliver high-performing campaigns. This position is focused on leveraging paid social strategies to enhance our B2B presence and distribute partnership content to designated audiences.

Objective/Purpose of the Role

The primary objective of the Paid Social Media Manager is to deliver strategic paid social campaigns that achieve projected KPIs for client-integrated campaigns within our NA region. This role involves developing and managing campaigns, analysing performance data and providing actionable insights. The Paid Social Media Manager will be leading campaigns across multiple social platforms to drive lead generation, brand awareness and engagement.

Campaign management

Develop, plan, set-up, and optimise paid social media campaigns across key platforms, including Meta, LinkedIn, X, and others such as YouTube and Reddit
Monitor and adjust targeting, bids, ad creatives, and landing pages to maximise ROI.
Conduct A/B testing on ad creatives and targeting options to improve performance.
Work closely with the media strategy team to deliver paid social campaigns that will meet preset client/agency objectives and engage target audiences to achieve KPIs

Performance Analytics and Insights
Define campaign KPIs and benchmarks for paid social media campaigns with allotted budget.
Translate complex campaign performance data into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders through visually engaging presentation decks

Present campaign strategies and performance updates to both internal stakeholders and external clients with confidence and clarity
Stay updated on industry trends, algorithm changes, and best practices to maintain competitive advantage

Collaboration and Integration

Collaborate with cross-functional teams, bringing a proactive approach to communication and problem-solving
Work within the B2B marketing team to align social media strategies with broader digital marketing and business objectives
Collaborate with media leads, content leads, sales, and other marketing team members to ensure cohesive and effective campaign execution

Experience Required For The Role

Proven experience in a paid social media role, with a primary focus on managing paid campaigns from strategic ideation and setup through to execution, optimization, and reporting. Agency experience a plus

A track record of using data analysis to drive campaign optimisations, translate complex performance data into actionable insights, and present findings with confidence to stakeholders and clients.
Demonstrable experience managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment, showing strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to meet deadlines.
Experience working collaboratively with cross-functional teams, including media strategy, content, and sales, to deliver cohesive and successful campaigns.

Skills Required For The Role

Platform Expertise: Deep, technical knowledge of paid advertising on key social media platforms, specifically Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Ads, X (formerly Twitter), and YouTube.

Ability to work for a global company on a team that spans multiple time zones (occasional calls before or after normal work hours)

At EAB , our mission is to make education smarter and our communities stronger. We work with more than 2,800 institutions to drive transformative change through data-driven insights and best-in-class capabilities. From kindergarten to college to career, EAB partners with leaders and practitioners to accelerate progress and drive results across enrollment, student success, institutional strategy, data analytics, and advancement. We work with each partner differently, tailoring our portfolio of research, technology, and marketing and enrollment solutions to meet the unique needs of every leadership team, as well as the students and employees they serve.

At EAB, we serve not only our partner institutions but each other—that's why we are always working to make sure our employees love their jobs and are invested in their communities. See how we've been recognized for this dedication to our employees by checking out our recent awards .

For more information, visit our Careers page.

The Role In Brief

SEO & AI Visibility Specialist

The SEO & AI Visibility Specialist will play a pivotal role in driving organic traffic growth and enhancing the online visibility of EAB’s higher education clients across both traditional search engines and AI-driven discovery platforms (e.g., Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Bing Copilot, Perplexity). This role bridges established SEO practices with emerging AI-driven search behaviors to ensure partner content is competitive, discoverable, and accurately represented across evolving digital experiences.

Responsibilities include advising partners, conducting audits, performing keyword and prompt research, and translating insights into actionable recommendations that improve both search performance and AI visibility while contributing to the continued evolution of EAB’s optimization discipline.

The role will be based in either Richmond, VA or Washington, D.C.

Primary Responsibilities

Compile and synthesize data across reporting platforms to evaluate performance and communicate impact to partners in higher education, educating partners and advocating for recommended changes.
Develop and guide SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) strategies aligned to partner goals, with a primary focus on technical performance and discoverability.
Provide targeted recommendations to improve crawlability, indexation, structured data, and content to support both search engine rankings and AI-driven discovery.
Perform keyword and prompt research to inform on page optimization and content strategy.
Leverage analytics to interpret SEO and AI visibility performance, delivering insights that inform partner decisions and ongoing strategy refinement.
Stay current on SEO and AI-driven search trends, rapidly adopting new tools and methodologies to enhance analysis and recommendations, and contributing to evolving best practices and team knowledge.
Utilize tools such as Google Ads, GA4, Search Console, and emerging SEO/GEO platforms to extract insights that inform recommendations, demonstrating adaptability as toolsets evolve.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, information technology, communications or related field.
2 years of SEO experience. This includes a deep understanding of SEO principles and the ability to apply them in a strategic manner.
Working knowledge of emerging Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) principles and AI-driven search behavior.
Strong communication skills, enabling effective collaboration across teams and clear presentation of strategies and outcomes to stakeholders at all levels.
Experience in utilizing GA4, Google Search Console, Looker Studio
Exceptional analytical skills, with the ability to distill complex data into actionable insights and strategies. This includes a proficiency in evaluating SEO performance metrics to guide strategic decisions and optimize for results.
Strong creative aptitude, including an understanding of website design, information architecture, and content strategy.

Ideal Qualifications

Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint
Experience with SEO tools including SEMrush, Ahrefs, Moz, etc.
Direct response marketing and/or higher education experience
Commitment to embracing a continual learning environment and contributing to a dynamic and welcoming culture of fairness, authenticity, and belonging in support of EAB’s mission, values, and aspiration.

Compensation

Actual salary varies due to factors that may include but not be limited to relevant experience, skills, and location. At EAB, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the starting salary range for their role.

Medical, dental, and vision insurance plans; dependents and domestic partners eligible
20+ days of PTO annually, in addition to paid firm and floating holidays

401(k) retirement savings plan with annual discretionary company matching contribution
Health savings account, healthcare and dependent care flexible spending account, and pre-tax commuter plans
Employee assistance program with counseling services and resources available to all employees and immediate family
Wellness programs including gym discounts, incentives to promote healthy living, and family access to the leading app for sleep, meditation, and relaxation

Access to milk shipping service to support nursing employees during business travel
Discounted pet health insurance coverage for dog and cat family members
Company-provided life, AD&D, and disability insurance
Financial wellness resources and membership in a robust employee discount program
Access to employee resource groups, merit-based advancement, and dynamic professional growth opportunities

The SEO & AI Visibility Specialist will play a pivotal role in driving organic traffic growth and enhancing the online visibility of EAB’s higher education clients across both traditional search engines and AI-driven discovery platforms (e.g., Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Bing Copilot, Perplexity). This role bridges established SEO practices with emerging AI-driven search behaviors to ensure partner content is competitive, discoverable, and accurately represented across evolving digital experiences.

Responsibilities include advising partners, conducting audits, performing keyword and prompt research, and translating insights into actionable recommendations that improve both search performance and AI visibility while contributing to the continued evolution of EAB’s optimization discipline.

The role will be based in either Richmond, VA or Washington, D.C.

Primary Responsibilities

Compile and synthesize data across reporting platforms to evaluate performance and communicate impact to partners in higher education, educating partners and advocating for recommended changes.
Develop and guide SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) strategies aligned to partner goals, with a primary focus on technical performance and discoverability.
Provide targeted recommendations to improve crawlability, indexation, structured data, and content to support both search engine rankings and AI-driven discovery.
Perform keyword and prompt research to inform on page optimization and content strategy.
Leverage analytics to interpret SEO and AI visibility performance, delivering insights that inform partner decisions and ongoing strategy refinement.
Stay current on SEO and AI-driven search trends, rapidly adopting new tools and methodologies to enhance analysis and recommendations, and contributing to evolving best practices and team knowledge.
Utilize tools such as Google Ads, GA4, Search Console, and emerging SEO/GEO platforms to extract insights that inform recommendations, demonstrating adaptability as toolsets evolve.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, information technology, communications or related field.
2 years of SEO experience. This includes a deep understanding of SEO principles and the ability to apply them in a strategic manner.
Working knowledge of emerging Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) principles and AI-driven search behavior.
Strong communication skills, enabling effective collaboration across teams and clear presentation of strategies and outcomes to stakeholders at all levels.
Experience in utilizing GA4, Google Search Console, Looker Studio
Exceptional analytical skills, with the ability to distill complex data into actionable insights and strategies. This includes a proficiency in evaluating SEO performance metrics to guide strategic decisions and optimize for results.
Strong creative aptitude, including an understanding of website design, information architecture, and content strategy.

Ideal Qualifications

Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint
Experience with SEO tools including SEMrush, Ahrefs, Moz, etc.
Direct response marketing and/or higher education experience
Commitment to embracing a continual learning environment and contributing to a dynamic and welcoming culture of fairness, authenticity, and belonging in support of EAB’s mission, values, and aspiration.

jobs.description:
Company Information

AEG brings music, sports, and live entertainment together to create moments people remember around the world. Each year, more than 100 million fans experience live events across five continents—from global touring, concerts, and festivals to iconic sports and entertainment destinations.

Through our music division, AEG Presents, one of the world’s leading operators of tours, concerts, and music festivals, we help shape the sound of now. We work with artists at every stage of their careers to bring live music to life, connecting artists with fans on stages around the world.

Headquartered in Los Angeles, AEG Presents is driven by creativity, innovation, and purpose, and powered by people who want their work to show up in the real world.

If you’re ready to help create moments that matter, there’s a place for you here. Because it happens here.

The Senior Data Analyst – Paid Media
sits on the Data Analytics, Reporting & Strategy
team and serves as the analytical partner and lead for the Paid Media team. Paid Media drives company-wide digital media strategy, campaign management, and consultative support across AEG divisions, including AEG Presents, Global Touring, Festivals, Goldenvoice, Bowery Presents, and Global Partnerships. Campaigns run across a broad mix of channels, including Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, and other social, search, and programmatic platforms.

This role is responsible for pulling, transforming, and modeling campaign data from those ad platforms and joining it with other data sources to build a unified view of performance. The analyst will design scalable data models and automated reporting that measure campaign effectiveness and surface opportunities to optimize budget allocation, audience targeting, creative, and customer acquisition. The role also turns findings into clear, practical recommendations that drive ticket sales, event awareness, and brand initiatives.

The Senior Data Analyst will work closely with the Paid Media, Product, and Data Engineering teams on cross-functional projects covering paid media data ingestion, aggregation, mastering, measurement, and visualization. The position will lead the work to make sure tracking and tagging (pixels, conversion APIs, UTMs) capture accurate marketing data. It will also develop and maintain attribution models and set performance benchmarks for key metrics such as CPA, ROAS, CTR, and conversion rate.

Essential Functions

Provide analytical support to Paid Media and Marketing teams, compiling performance marketing reports across digital channels using internal BI tools, Google Analytics, native advertising platforms. Communicate results to stakeholders, working with media and strategy teams to demonstrate clear actionable insights for media plans, budget forecasting, targeting/audiences, and creative.
Build and maintain comprehensive measurement plans to evaluate paid media performance, calculate benchmarks based on objectives, develop + maintain attribution models to identify trends, testing opportunities, and insights by channel, audience, festival/tour/regional show, and business unit.
Partner with Data, Product, Engineering teams to manage data pipelines + ingestion for channel metrics, define data collection requirements and enforce optimal taxonomy for reporting implementations, continual data hygiene + integrity across ad buying and internal platforms.
Collaborate with media, marketing, and data teams to inform audience and targeting strategies. Develop tests to evaluate new campaign strategies, ad products, optimization tactics, and targeting features.
Manage and lead paid media projects involving data aggregation and measurement tools such as Datorama, Google Analytics / GA4, Tag Manager, DOMO, BigQuery, LiveRamp, server-server integrations with media partners. Ensure appropriate site tracking is in place to capture relevant data points to measure marketing effectiveness.
Work closely with data team to develop and maintain reporting dashboards for internal and external use, while providing support for ad hot reporting requests.

Required Qualifications

BA/BS degree (4-year) in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Business, Marketing, or a related quantitative field
4–6 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a similar role, with exposure to paid media or digital marketing data on the client, publisher, or agency side; e-commerce experience preferred
Advanced SQL skills and experience pulling, transforming, and analyzing large, complex datasets
Strong ability to build data models, data flows, and ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL and/or Python, bringing together data from multiple media channels into a scalable, automated insights reporting structure
Proficiency in BI and data visualization tools such as DOMO, Looker Studio, Tableau, or similar, with strong dashboard design and data storytelling skills
Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Intelligence (formerly Datorama) or similar marketing data integration platforms is a strong plus
Working knowledge of paid media data and performance metrics, including impressions, CTR, CPC, CPA, conversion rate, and ROAS, across platforms such as Meta, Google Ads, and TikTok
Familiarity with tracking infrastructure such as GA4, Google Tag Manager, pixels, Conversions API, UTMs, and server-side tracking
Experience applying statistical methods to performance benchmarking, attribution modeling, and media mix modeling (MMM)
Understanding of the ad tech and Martech landscape (programmatic buying, DSP/SSP, audience management, ad serving, social buying platforms), and of privacy regulations’ impact on measurement, including cookie-less tracking and multi-touch customer journeys
Ability to clearly communicate insights and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders, and manage multiple cross-functional projects at once

Payscale: $82,158.00 -$125,000.00

Bonus:
This position is not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits:
Full-time:
We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings.

Working closely with the VP, Growth & Digital, you will lead lifecycle campaigns and contribute to a broader range of digital marketing initiatives, from acquisition and discovery through booking, pre-arrival and repeat stays.

You will manage campaign planning, work directly with property teams and agencies, and personally build, test and launch initiatives. Affiliate, search visibility and digital initiatives

Help identify and develop digital partnerships and audience-growth opportunities that bring qualified traffic and new guests into Viceroy’s marketing ecosystem.
Coordinate SEO and GEO initiatives with agencies and property teams: prioritize content opportunities, brief updates, track implementation and monitor search and AI visibility.
Support website, offer-page and booking journey improvements, including content updates, campaign landing pages and conversion testing.
Manage assigned digital projects, tracking owners, deadlines and dependencies through completion.

AI and workflow improvement

Use AI to accelerate campaign production, analysis, coding, QA, documentation and project management.
Build repeatable AI-assisted workflows and automations that improve execution speed and quality.
Apply sound judgment to AI outputs, maintaining accuracy, brand standards and responsible handling of guest data.
Identify opportunities to simplify manual work across corporate and property marketing teams.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
SENIOR PRODUCT MARKETING MANAGER

Kansas City Metro Residents ONLY
On-site
Up to 25% Travel

WHO IS VINCUE

We're VINCUE, a founder-led automotive tech SaaS company based in Kansas City, and we've hit our inflection point. We're the fastest-growing supply chain innovator in the $750B automotive industry, backed by operators who've built and exited automotive tech before. In 2026 we closed a $93M growth round led by Wavecrest Growth Partners, with proven product-market fit, strong retention, and deepening adoption behind us.

We're big enough to attract game-changing partnerships while retaining our startup culture that rejects bureaucracy, corporate fluff, and any time-wasting nonsense. We move fast, but not recklessly. We think big, but execute with discipline. Our culture runs on authenticity, momentum, and putting people first.

If you've got a #GAMEON mentality and want to be the one who tells the story behind everything VINCUE builds, this is where you belong.

ABOUT THE MARKETING TEAM

VINCUE's marketing team is small, fast, and close to the business. We run trade shows from NADA to state association meetings, produce our annual user conference, VINCUE: UNLEASHED, run digital and account-based programs, and partner with a creative team that shoots, designs, and animates in house.

Our product team ships constantly. New features, new solutions, new products, and partner integrations. What we haven't had is one person whose whole job is making sure each of those lands with dealers, with our sales team, and with the market. That's this role.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

We're looking for a product marketer who wants to be more than the person who writes the launch email. We want someone who decides what a release means, who it's for, and why a dealer should care, then makes sure that story shows up everywhere. You'll be the bridge between what our product team builds and what dealers, our sales team, and the market need to hear.

You'll report to our CMO and work side by side with our product team. You'll partner closely with our Creative Director, who owns all visual branding, writing the briefs and stories that creative brings to life. You'll coordinate with our Marketing Manager and Digital Marketing Manager on all content and campaign execution, equip our sales team to sell every release, and work with Business Development on partner integration launches.

This is a senior individual contributor seat with real ownership. You'll be expected to push back on product, shape launch decisions, and hold the line on message quality.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

THE RIGHT MINDSET
You're a translator. You can sit in a product demo and walk out knowing exactly why a used car manager should care.
You start with the customer, not the feature list.
You have opinions and you defend them. You'll tell product when a launch isn't ready and tell sales when a message isn't landing.
You thrive on a small team where everyone pitches in, and "that's not my job" isn't in your vocabulary.
You measure your work by what it moves, like pipeline, win rates, and adoption, not by how many assets you ship.

THE EXPERIENCE
5+ years in product marketing, with at least 3 in B2B SaaS
A track record of launching products and features end to end, with results you can point to
Proven sales enablement work, including material reps actually used and teams you trained to sell
Experience briefing and directing creative teams across print, digital, web, and video
Automotive, dealer software, or multi-location B2B experience is a plus, but not required

THE SKILLS
Positioning and messaging. You can define what a product is, who it's for, and why it wins, in words a dealer would actually use.
Launch planning. You know how to tier a release and run a launch across product, sales, marketing, and creative without dropping a thread.
Sales enablement. You build talk tracks, demo narratives, objection handling, and battlecards that reps reach for on their own.
Customer interviewing. You run interviews and win/loss conversations that surface the real reason a dealer buys, stays, or leaves.
Competitive analysis. You know how to track competitors and turn what you learn into clear, usable comparisons.
Writing. You make technical features clear and compelling to non-technical buyers.
Creative briefing. You write briefs and storyboards that give designers, videographers, and animators what they need to do their best work.
Organization. You keep a messaging library and master files so clean that anyone on the team can find the current version in seconds.

BONUS POINTS
None of these are required, but they'll help you stand out:
Launching a major platform release or migrating existing customers to a new platform
Marketing to enterprise buyers or large multi-location groups
Partner or integration marketing
Input on pricing and packaging
HubSpot or a similar marketing platform

ROLE EXPECTATIONS

As Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will:
Own positioning and messaging for every new feature, solution, product, and partner integration
Keep product messaging consistent with VINCUE's core platform story, tailored for single-rooftop dealers, large dealer groups, and OEM and partner audiences
Tier every release by impact and run launch plans with product, sales, creative, and marketing
Lead partner integration launches in coordination with Business Development and our partners
Make sure sales can sell what we ship before it ships, with talk tracks, demo narratives, objection handling, one-pagers, and decks
Train sales and account teams on new releases and keep enablement material current
Build ROI and business-case material for large dealer group opportunities
Track competitors and maintain battlecards and competitive comparisons
Talk to dealers regularly, run win/loss reviews, and feed what you learn back to product
Turn customer wins into case studies and proof points
Drive adoption of new features among existing customers with customer success and account management
Own all product content across print, digital, website, webinars, and video, writing the briefs and storyboards creative executes and approving final assets for message and product accuracy
Own the library of approved product messaging and master files for all product content
Measure launch results and report on what worked

PERFORMANCE PHILOSOPHY

You're measured on whether the market understands what we build and buys it, not on how many assets you ship.

In your first 90 days, you'll learn our platform, our customers, and our competitors, talk with at least 10 dealers, build our messaging library and launch framework, ship your first battlecards, and lead your first launch end to end.

Clear stories sell. Confident reps close. Dealers who use what we build stay.

TRAVEL & WORKING CONDITIONS

On-site at our Kansas City HQ when not traveling
Up to 25% travel for dealer interviews and trade shows

HOW TO APPLY

Send your resume and a few work samples to work@vincue.com. Launch plans, messaging frameworks, enablement material, or campaigns you led are all great. If you can, include a sentence or two about a launch you're proud of and what you owned on it.

HackerOne is a global leader in Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). The HackerOne Platform unites agentic AI solutions with the ingenuity of the world’s largest community of security researchers to continuously discover, validate, prioritize, and remediate exposures across code, cloud, and AI systems. Through solutions like bug bounty, vulnerability disclosure, agentic pentesting, AI red teaming, and code security, HackerOne delivers measurable, continuous reduction of cyber risk for enterprises. Industry leaders, including Anthropic, Crypto.com, General Motors, Goldman Sachs, Lufthansa, Uber, UK Ministry of Defence, and the U.S. Department of Defense, trust HackerOne to safeguard their digital ecosystems. HackerOne was recognized in Gartner’s Emerging Tech Impact Radar: AI Cybersecurity Ecosystem report for its leadership in AI Security Testing and has been named a Most Loved Workplace for Young Professionals (2024).

HackerOne is at a pivotal inflection point in the security industry. Offensive security is no longer optional – it is the standard for forward-thinking companies that want to build trust and resilience in a world where AI-driven innovation and adversaries are moving faster than ever. With the industry shifting, HackerOne stands apart: we combine the ingenuity of the largest security research community with a best-in-class AI-powered platform, trusted by the world’s top organizations.

HackerOne Values

HackerOne is dedicated to fostering a strong and inclusive culture. HackerOne is Customer Obsessed
and prioritizes customer outcomes in our decisions and actions. We Default to Disclosure
by operating with transparency and integrity, ensuring trust and accountability. Employees, researchers, customers, and partners Win Together
by fostering empowerment, inclusion, respect, and accountability.

Position Summary

At HackerOne, great content starts with a great story. It’s how we make complex cybersecurity topics understandable, turn original research into insights people remember, and build trust with security leaders.

As our Content Marketing Manager, you’ll help find and tell those stories. You’ll lead key parts of our content program, including the HackerOne blog, annual research, search optimization, and editorial standards. You’ll work with experts across HackerOne to uncover interesting ideas, find the story in the data, and turn technical expertise into content that is clear, useful, and worth reading.

This role is part editor, part storyteller, and part content strategist. You’ll bring strong editorial judgment, curiosity, and an audience-first mindset to what we create, while using data, search insights, and AI tools to help our content reach the right people and make a measurable impact.

What You Will Do

Manage the HackerOne blog, including the editorial calendar, story development, publishing, optimization, and performance tracking.
Lead the development of HackerOne’s annual research and flagship reports, finding the strongest stories in our data and working with internal experts and partners to turn those insights into compelling narratives.
Find stories across HackerOne by interviewing subject matter experts, asking the right questions, and identifying perspectives that can strengthen our thought leadership.
Turn complex cybersecurity topics into clear, engaging content for security leaders without losing the substance or expertise behind them.
Help execute our answer engine optimization (AEO) and search engine optimization (SEO) strategy, using search data and audience insights to identify opportunities and improve content performance.
Maintain and apply HackerOne’s Style Guide to ensure our content is clear, consistent, and distinctly HackerOne.
Manage the content intake process, helping teams sharpen ideas, prioritize requests, and move strong stories from concept to publication.
Multiply the impact of our best stories by adapting content for campaigns, social media, and audience engagement.
Measure content performance and use those insights to understand what resonates with our audience and inform what we create next.
Use AI tools throughout the content process to support research, idea development, drafting, editing, optimization, and repurposing while maintaining strong human editorial judgment.

Excellent writing, editing, and interviewing skills, with strong editorial judgment and attention to detail.

jobs.description:
Position Overview

The SVP of Sales and Marketing owns Dollamur’s full commercial engine — brand, demand generation, digital and e-commerce, product marketing, and all sales — and is accountable for turning brand and demand into booked revenue. This leader builds a high-performance commercial organization, holds marketing to pipeline and return on spend rather than impressions, gives sales the positioning and qualified demand it needs to win, and serves as Dollamur’s senior ambassador across the sports and Health and Safety markets. This role is an extremely hands-on position, requiring effective communication across multiple disciplines. The successful candidate will be comfortable with group and interpersonal leadership challenges, maintaining positive momentum and working to motivate teams and organizations in a dynamic environment.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Strategy & Growth

Set and execute an integrated commercial strategy — sales, marketing, pricing, and channel — that delivers profitable growth in Wrestling, Gymnastics & Cheerleading, and Martial Arts & Fitness, while developing adjacent, emerging, and international markets.
Own the full funnel — awareness through quote, close, and retention — with single-point accountability for conversion at every stage.
Define and enforce Dollamur’s value proposition, pricing discipline, and discount governance to protect premium positioning and margin.

Brand & Product Marketing

Own the Dollamur brand and sub-brands — positioning, identity, and creative — and enforce usage standards across dealers, distributors, licensees, and marketplaces.
Own product positioning, naming, launch, and lifecycle communication (introductions, substitutions, discontinuations), partnering with Product Development and Operations on readiness, forecast, and channel sequencing.
Keep sales equipped with current battlecards, competitive comparisons, ROI tools, and spec content, and feed win/loss and customer insight back to product and pricing.

Demand Generation, Digital & E-Commerce

Build a measurable demand engine across search, paid and organic social, email, and content, accountable to cost per qualified lead, pipeline, and return on ad spend.
Run the website and direct-to-consumer channel as commercial assets: traffic, conversion, merchandising, customer acquisition cost, and lifetime value.
Set channel policy for marketplaces, dealers, and direct — including advertised-price discipline and conflict resolution — so channels reinforce rather than undercut one another.
Run a disciplined lead process (capture, scoring, routing, follow-up SLAs) jointly with sales, and hold agencies and vendors to defined deliverables and ROI.

Sales Leadership & Organization

Lead and develop the two VPs and the Head of Marketing against revenue, gross margin, operating income, and demand targets; build bench strength and succession.
Design the commercial structure — inbound, outbound, key accounts, inside, field, and dealer support — and build a team known for responsiveness, product knowledge, and being easy to do business with.
Design incentive compensation aligned to revenue, margin, and customer experience.

CRM, Analytics & Performance Management

Drive consistent CRM and marketing automation use across sales and marketing: pipeline management, forecast accuracy, campaign attribution, and data integrity.
Maintain a single source of truth for commercial reporting, with marketing-sourced pipeline and revenue reported alongside sales.
Set KPIs for every team, segment, and channel, and align forecasting and planning with Operations and Finance, including the S&OP process.

Market Intelligence, Partnerships & Industry Presence

Run an ongoing competitive intelligence discipline — competitors, pricing, service models, substitutes — and turn it into positioning, pricing guidance, and selling tools.
Build senior relationships with key customers, distributors, governing bodies, and strategic partners, and run athlete, coach, club, and influencer partnerships that convert reach into revenue.
Own event and trade-show strategy end to end with measured ROI, and direct PR and communications as Dollamur’s primary commercial spokesperson.

Financial Leadership & Executive Reporting

Manage the combined sales and marketing budget, shifting spend toward the highest-return channels, and mitigate commercial, brand, channel-conflict, and reputational risk.
Report regularly to the CEO, executive team, and Board on revenue, pipeline, brand health, competitive dynamics, and risks, with clear recommendations.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field required; MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive commercial leadership across both sales and marketing, preferably in sports manufacturing, consumer products, building materials, or a related industry.
Has owned a marketing function — brand, demand generation, and digital — while carrying a revenue number.
Proven revenue growth in B2B and B2C environments, including dealer or distributor channels and direct-to-consumer, leading complex inbound and outbound sales organizations.
Hands-on experience building and measuring a digital demand engine (paid media, search, e-commerce, attribution) and managing agencies to measurable outcomes.
Strong negotiation and partnership skills, with a record of defending premium positioning against discounting.
Advanced proficiency in CRM, marketing automation, and commercial analytics.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Commercially aggressive, analytically disciplined and accountable for results.
Strong brand and marketing judgment with an operator's focus on revenue, margin and ROI.
Exceptional communication and negotiation skills.

Director of B2B Marketing

Company: EcoEnclose, Inc.

Contact: 



All potential applicants are encouraged to scroll through and read the complete job description before applying.


Overview

EcoEnclose is seeking a new B2B Marketing Leader to generate and capture demand for businesses seeking more sustainable packaging. Have you dreamt of working for Patagonia, Cotopaxi, Disney, or Ridwell? Well, we make their packaging – along with 500 other enterprise brands. Our customers are brands in industries like apparel, CPG, cosmetics, and supplements. Our products are innovative, sustainable packaging materials – including pouches made with recycled plastics, mailers made with seaweed polymers, and boxes printed with algae ink. 




In this critical role, you will own the marketing plan and are expected to be highly strategic and nimble. There is not an obvious playbook for success in today’s B2B marketing environment. We’re looking for candidates who can continuously try new tactics, including hypothesizing, ideating, testing, measuring, and concluding which tactics perform best in the given moment, and then adapting our budget allocation and marketing plan accordingly. The primary business outcome you are seeking is to increase our inbound qualified new business leads. 




We are looking for a strategic marketer with a strong B2B marketing track record. You must have a legitimate passion for identifying new marketing tactics, trying them out, and optimizing them. This role is for a sustainability-driven, highly analytical marketing trailblazer who loves experimentation and wants to advance the circular packaging movement. 




The compensation package is a $130K-$170K salary base + 15% bonus target, plus benefits. 

This is a hybrid 3 days/wk in-office + 2 days/wk WFH role, based in Boulder County, CO. 




About EcoEnclose

We are that rare, privately-owned, non-PE-funded company in a high-growth stage, with real-world viable, in-demand sustainability solutions. EcoEnclose is not a start-up; we’ve figured out what’s selling and how to execute, we have the infrastructure in place, stable leadership, and now we’re just scaling. EcoEnclose is very much a values-driven company with a vibrant office culture, energized by our mission to enable this country’s transition to circular packaging. We are also smart at business, service, and operations, and we want to have a big impact. 




Responsibilities

The Director of Marketing will be responsible for driving a plan that increases inbound qualified leads and grows our eCommerce revenue. 

Planning, strategy, and budget allocation across marketing tactics, including continuous optimization. Qualifications / Skills / Experience

5+ years experience with B2B marketing tactics, tools, and enablersHave managed a marketing budget and determined spend allocationsStrong digital savvy with an understanding of paid media, attribution, SEO, and site mechanics; must be able to build and maintain effective Google Ads / LinkedIn / Microsoft campaignsLove of writing content and/or the ability to program an agent that writes wellA healthy obsession with AI and have built AI tools to improve output and efficiencyHighly analytical; able to shape A/B testing programs, customer insights and pick apart performance metricsHave managed agency partners, including both hiring and firingIntuition, character, and professionalism consistent with organizational leadershipExceptional written and verbal communication skills and presentation skillsAn ambitious personal & professional growth mindset. Determination to grow your skillset, your earnings, and your contribution to EcoEnclose’s growth


Performance Expectation

Including a period of onboarding, we expect the Marketing Director to deliver 750+ inbound leads through emails, webforms, and sample orders within the first 12 months of employment with EcoEnclose.

jobs.title: Chief Marketing Officer (CMO)
jobs.description:
Knak Is a Mission-driven Company

Why? Because our time is limited, our competition is fierce, and our margin for error is small. To have the biggest impact on the world, we stay focused on our core mission, which is...

Empowering marketers to be creative .

That’s why Knak exists.

In a world where AI has made everyone a creator, Knak helps marketers turn ideas into on-brand, high-performing campaigns at scale. The world's most AI-forward companies, including Meta, OpenAI, NVIDIA, Vercel, Notion and Stripe, use Knak as their agentic marketing production layer.

Here's what they and our investor Insight Partners figured out: creation got easy, but that’s making production harder. Every new idea and brief still has to be built, versioned, checked, approved, and shipped across every channel, and that work runs on handoffs, review cycles, and a lot of copy-paste. That middle stretch of the marketing stack has no system, no standard, and no owner.

Knak is the flexible factory for that work. Our customers set the brand rules, choose the tools that feed in and the platforms that send, and decide where AI does the work and where people do. We handle the repeatable parts, so marketers get their time back for the parts that aren't.

We're built by marketers, for marketers. We started with email because it's the hardest channel to get right and where many campaigns win or lose. Now we're bringing that same production discipline to every channel our customers use.

For a CMO, that's a rare seat: the chance to define a category, not just compete in one. You get to market a marketing product to marketers and collaborate with a CEO who is a Marketer himself and truly understands Marketing, brand and the value it brings.

Oh, and we have a bit of fun while doing it, too!

The Role

Knak is looking for a builder CMO to lead our next stage of growth. As a fast-growing B2B SaaS company, redefining how enterprise marketing teams produce campaigns in the AI era.

This is not a role for someone looking to inherit a finished marketing machine. We need a leader who can build the machine - someone who has created pipeline, built teams, collaborated and built strong relationships with Sales, developed brands and operated successfully through ambiguity and rapid change.

You will own Marketing end to end, with particular emphasis on pipeline creation, demand generation and company-level GTM strategy
. You will also partner closely with our strong product marketing leadership, Sales, Product and Customer teams.

This is a remote friendly role - we are open to talent across the United States and Canada. Simply put, we are looking for the best!

What We’re Looking For

A proven B2B SaaS marketing leader who has helped scale a company through a meaningful high-growth stage, ideally from roughly $20M toward $100M+ ARR and has done so without burning a gazillion dollars.
Deep, hands-on experience building enterprise demand generation across digital, field/events, partners and other channels — with clear accountability for pipeline and revenue.
A builder who moves quickly, experiments, makes decisions with imperfect information and can operate without everything being predefined.
The ability to go high and low: from company strategy, positioning and executive communication to product details, campaigns, launches and funnel performance.
A strong talent leader who can recruit A players, raise the performance bar and make difficult people decisions when necessary.
Strong brand and creative judgment, with the resourcefulness to find unconventional ways to win without relying on massive budgets

Roles & Responsibilities

Own Knak’s marketing strategy and execution end to end.
Build and scale a marketing organization designed to support Knak’s next stage of growth.
Lead pipeline creation and demand generation with clear accountability for pipeline and revenue.
Develop and experiment with enterprise demand generation across digital, field and events, partners, and other channels.
Help shape company-level go-to-market strategy in close partnership with Sales, Product, Customer, and product marketing leadership.
Build Knak’s brand and develop creative, resourceful ways to increase awareness without relying on massive budgets.
Operate effectively through ambiguity and rapid change, moving quickly, experimenting, and making decisions with imperfect information.
Work across both strategic and tactical priorities, from company strategy, positioning, and executive communication to campaigns, launches, product details, and funnel performance.
Build and lead a high-performing marketing team, recruiting strong talent, raising the performance bar
Help establish Agentic Marketing Production as an important new category for enterprise marketers.

What We Offer

At Knak we have four foundational pillars. Culture, customers, product and growth. Culture is our number one pillar because we know that is at the core of building a strong company that can build amazing products and delight our customers. We do this with a laser focus on hiring the right people who are smart, positive and who want more than the typical nine-to-five offers.

We offer an extremely rewarding, second to none work environment as acknowledged by Ottawa’s Best Places to Work 2026! We show our investment in our people through our competitive salaries, great benefits, paid vacation, Life leave days (because life happens), team lunches and off-sites, and most importantly our commitment to YOUR career growth.

If this sounds like something you’re looking for, then we’d love to hear from you!

If you don’t see yourself fully reflected in every job requirement listed on the posting above, we still encourage you to reach out and apply. Research has shown that women and underrepresented groups often only apply when they feel 100% qualified. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientations, and life experiences to apply. Knak believes in creating an inclusive, barrier-free working environment. If you require ANY accommodation to the interview process please contact culture@knak.com.
