Senior Director, Brand Marketing 

Location: Costa Mesa, California 

Work Model: Hybrid — 4 days in office / 1 day remote 

Employment Type: Full-Time, Exempt

THE OPPORTUNITY

Z SUPPLY is looking for an exceptional Senior Director, Brand Marketing, to lead the evolution of our brand and help shape its next chapter of growth.

This is a highly visible leadership role for a strategic, consumer-obsessed brand builder who understands how to create both brand relevance and business impact. The Senior Director, Brand Marketing will be responsible for defining and bringing to life Z SUPPLY’s overarching brand marketing strategy—strengthening our positioning, expanding awareness, deepening consumer connection, and ensuring the brand shows up consistently and meaningfully across every touchpoint.

Rooted in an effortless California lifestyle, Z SUPPLY has built a loyal consumer following and strong product marketing discipline. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a brand leader who can build upon that foundation to bring fresh thinking, cultural awareness, strong commercial instincts, and a clear vision for where the brand can go next.

This leader will sit at the intersection of brand, consumer, and product, translating business priorities and consumer insights into compelling brand strategies and experiences from e-commerce to wholesale. From seasonal campaigns and product launches to PR, influencers, partnerships and brand experiences, this role will help determine how Z SUPPLY connects with consumers and builds lasting brand equity.

The ideal candidate is equal parts strategic thinker and hands-on leader—someone who can establish a long-term vision, inspire teams and agency partners, and also drive the rigor and execution required to turn that vision into results.

WHAT YOU’LL LEAD

Brand Strategy 

Partner with Creative Marketing leadership on the annual brand roadmap, turning business goals and consumer insight into focused strategic priorities.

Own Z Supply's brand messaging architecture and positioning framework — the strategic backbone of who we are and what we stand for, which Creative then translates into voice, tone, and social execution.

Partner closely with Creative to ensure strategy and execution stay tightly connected

Build the seasonal and annual brand marketing calendar, connecting campaigns, launches, partnerships, and brand moments into one cohesive story 

Manage the brand marketing budget, balancing brand and wholesale investments to deliver brand resonance and opportunities for discovery 

Identify emerging consumer behaviors, cultural shifts, and marketplace opportunities that can strengthen Z SUPPLY’s relevance and competitive position.

Ensure seasonal and monthly campaigns are designed holistically across channels and consumer touchpoints.

Help define opportunities for the brand to participate authentically in culture while remaining true to Z SUPPLY’s identity and California lifestyle positioning.

Partner closely with Creative, Ecommerce, Wholesale, Merchandising and other key business leaders to create a connected consumer and brand experience.

Wholesale

Oversee Wholesale Marketing inclusive of tradeshow support, collateral, reporting, and wholesale/retail events 

Partner with Wholesale team to develop annual Wholesale marketing roadmap and timelines across the seasonal product lifecycle, from concept through sales and GTM.

Coordinate across Marketing, Creative, Merchandising, Design, Planning, Digital, Visual, and Media teams to support integrated execution.

Build retail playbooks and integrated content plans, launch briefs and repeatable frameworks that scale across retailers. 

PR + Strategic Partnerships

Oversee PR, brand partnerships, and collaborations.

Identify high-impact opportunities to extend Z SUPPLY’s reach, introduce the brand to new audiences, and create culturally relevant brand moments.

Oversee PR agency and external partner relationships, establishing clear expectations, accountability, and measurable outcomes.

Evaluate partnership opportunities through both a brand-building and commercial lens.

Social + Community

Partner closely with Creative team to develop platform native, social first content strategies growing each channel and deepening engagement 

Own community/creator/influencer strategy and execution to drive growth, brand equity, and community engagement

Oversee the development of an advocate network that converts brand love into measurable word-of-mouth growth, and makes Z SUPPLY culturally relevant at scale

Team Leadership

Lead, develop and inspire a high-performing brand organization across Social Strategy, Wholesale Marketing, Community/Influencer, PR, Events, and Brand 

Establish clear priorities, accountability, and ways of working that enable the team to operate strategically, creatively, and efficiently.

Coach and develop talent while building capabilities to support the future needs of the organization.

Create an environment that encourages curiosity, strong thinking, collaboration, and an ongoing commitment to raising the bar.

Bring an outside-in perspective to the organization, continuously challenging the team to think bigger about the consumer, the competitive landscape, and the future of the brand.

Serve as a strategic brand voice with executive leadership, presenting recommendations, opportunities, results and future priorities.

Build trusted relationships across the organization and influence effectively in a highly collaborative, entrepreneurial environment.

Performance & Brand Health

Establish meaningful KPIs to evaluate brand health, consumer engagement and campaign effectiveness.

Oversee brand marketing reporting in partnership with VP, Creative + Operations 

WHAT YOU BRING

We are looking for an accomplished brand leader with a track record of building relevant consumer brands and translating brand strategy into meaningful business growth.

The strongest candidates will bring:

12+ years of progressive brand and integrated marketing experience, including significant leadership responsibility.

5+ years of experience leading and developing high-performing teams.

Deep experience within fashion, apparel, lifestyle, beauty, premium consumer or other highly brand-driven businesses.

A demonstrated track record of developing and evolving brand positioning, consumer strategy and integrated marketing programs.

Experience building brands across multiple consumer touchpoints, including wholesale, digital, social, influencer, PR, partnerships, ecommerce and wholesale.

Strong understanding of the relationship between brand building and commercial performance.

Experience leading seasonal campaigns, product launches and go-to-market strategies.

A sophisticated understanding of today’s consumer landscape, culture and the rapidly evolving ways consumers discover, experience and engage with brands.

Strong strategic and analytical capabilities, with the ability to move fluidly between big-picture thinking and execution.

Experience managing agencies, external partners and meaningful marketing budgets.

Exceptional communication, storytelling and presentation skills, including the ability to influence and inspire executive-level audiences.

A collaborative leadership style and the ability to build alignment across diverse functions.

The ability to thrive in a growing, entrepreneurial environment where priorities move quickly and leaders are expected to both set direction and make things happen.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

THE LEADER WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Beyond experience, we’re looking for someone who genuinely loves building brands.

You are deeply curious about consumers and culture. You have strong instincts, but you also know when to rely on data and insights. You understand what makes a brand distinctive and know how to protect its core while continuing to push it forward.

You are comfortable operating at the executive level while staying close enough to the work to ensure great ideas become great execution. You know how to bring creative, commercial and functional teams together around a shared vision—and you build credibility through both your thinking and your ability to deliver.

Most importantly, you’re excited by the opportunity to take an established, growing lifestyle brand and help define what comes next.

jobs.title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

Client Strategy & Relationships

Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

Paid Media Performance

Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

Copy & Creative Strategy

Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

Tracking & Funnel Execution

Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility
Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Experience

Financial services marketing
Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
Video sales letter marketing
High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
Performance marketing agency experience
Direct-response advertising

NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)
Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays

jobs.title: Director of Retail Marketing
jobs.description:
Overview

Are these things important to you:

Lower cost of living including no state income tax, untaxed retirement income, no inheritence or estate tax, and low property tax.
Less traffic, shorter commutes all without sacrificing access to healthcare, shopping, dining, and entertainment.
A close-knit community where neighbors know each other and local connections matter.
Raising a family in a safe, welcoming environment with strong community values and excellent opportunities for involvement in schools, churches, and local events.
Mild winters, four distinct seasons, and plenty of open space for gardening, farming, or outdoor hobbies.

The Pictsweet Company is growing! A 4th generation family owned company established in 1945, Pictsweet is a frozen vegetable producer with agricultural roots. We are currently seeking a Director of Retail Marketing to join our corporate office team at our headquarters in Bells, TN (Jackson, TN area). The Director of Retail Marketing will be responsible for leading consumer marketing strategy, planning and activation. The Director will play an integral role in our go-to-market strategy and media plans for campaign development, retail activation and consumer engagement. This leadership role is responsible for designing annual go-to-market strategies—leveraging consumer and business insights—to enable the organization to realize both business objectives and marketing objectives. The Director will prepare and execute campaigns, measure results, and report on their effectiveness. The position is responsible for managing a talented marketing team, providing strategic direction for the Pictsweet Company with exciting marketing plans and creating persuasive packaging & sales materials. This position reports directly to the Vice President, Marketing Retail.

Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities

Develop a strong understanding of the Pictsweet Farms brand foundation and ensure the relevance of the brand’s identity, essence, vision, mission and core values.
Lead critical thinking & strategic recommendations, including campaign & activation development.
Coach, lead and inspire a high performing marketing team.
Provide team with the critical experiences to meet both professional & personal development goals.
Champion The Pictsweet Company’s Core Values (Honesty, Hard Work, Fair Play, Perseverance and Self Reliance) with direct reports and colleagues, leading by example to motivate and inspire direct reports and cross-functional teams supporting the brand to win with consumers and customers.

Retail Marketing & Advertising

Work with the VP of Retail Marketing to create marketing strategy and an annual plan.
Drive the retail marketing strategy and have a holistic approach to retail marketing from traditional & digital advertising, retail media networks, in-store communication and visual merchandising.
Collaborate with the sales organization to build programs & sales tools to meet customer needs in an effort to drive sales at the point of purchase.
Lead the organization for new product and package launches.
Lead the internal creative team on delivering effective packaging and persuasive marketing & sales tools.
Lead the digital marketing team in social media activation and collaborate with agency partners to manage SEO and integration of digital media plans.
Understand existing media opportunities and bring forward new digital media strategies based on consumer and market insights.
Build increased collaboration between marketing & sales teams.

Research/Insights

Lead and develop understanding of the priority consumer and deliver marketing tactics that drive affinity for the Pictsweet Farms brand.
Leverage marketplace data & trends and uncover consumer insights to deeply understand behavioral drivers of the brand, products or a particular consumer segment.
Work with external research partners and resources to help unlock insights and translate them into a growth strategy and product development opportunities.
Analyze consumer/business/audience insights and business results in order to deliver key recommendations for business planning.

Budget/Business Planning

Lead all brand input in the business/marketing planning process; serve as a major contributor to business planning for the business unit across sales & marketing.
Assume responsibility for resource planning & budget management for retail branded marketing.

Qualifications

Education:

Required: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications or Business. MBA preferred.

Work Experience:

Required: 7-10 years of experience in strategic content development, marketing and media ideally with a CPG focus.
Preferred: Experience in retail marketing / food industry marketing.
Strong analytical capabilities with an emphasis on reading & interpreting data.
Sound strategic thinking capabilities and the ability to anticipate trends and turn insights into action.
Strong annual planning background; proven ability to prioritize & manage projects with a focus on timelines.
Ability to create data driven marketing recommendations for optimizing return on investment and others KPIs.
Possess a strong visual design acumen and a track record of delivering clear, effective direction to creative teams.
Proven ability in managing a team as well as an ability to cultivate solid relationships in other functional areas.
Exceptional written, verbal and presentation skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Applications (i.e. Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint), Google Analytics and data reporting tools.

jobs.title: Executive Marketing Director - Alzheimers Disease
jobs.description:
The Position

Why Genentech

We’re passionate about delivering on Our Promise to improve the lives of patients and create healthier communities for all. We foster a culture of inclusivity, integrity and creativity while boldly pursuing answers to the world’s most complex health challenges and transforming society.

About This Marketing Role

The Marketing organization shapes external perceptions & behaviors and drives market demand by establishing & communicating our full product value proposition across the full value chain, from payers, to health systems, to prescribers, to patients. Marketers are masterful storytellers - accountable to inform positioning using an insight-driven marketing strategy, deliver simple compelling customer-led content creation, and design outstanding integrated customer experiences in partnership with cross-functional/networked partners. Marketers strategically use resources and their network to drive patient outcomes for today’s innovations, and fuel tomorrow’s breakthroughs.

This Executive Marketing Director (EMD) is responsible for leading the development of the inaugural Therapeutic Area and Marketing Vision for Genentech Neurodegeneration (NDG) including promising, Phase 3 assets in Alzheimer’s Disease and Parkinson’s Disease and driving significant changes in US Commercial/Medical/Government organization to prepare for for our first launch in the large, evolving, and competitive NDG markets. The NDG EMD leads the function and team responsible for strategy-to-execution brand marketing for some of the largest and most innovative assets in the Roche pipeline that could meet large areas of high unmet medical need for patients. This leader is responsible for hiring & leading the first set of marketing leaders in NDG, and, as the launches approach, scaling the team into a larger multilayered marketing team for launch. The NDG EMD reports to the Vice President, Head of Genentech Neurodegeneration, sits on the NDG cross-functional Squad, and will contribute to the vision & strategy of our NDG portfolio & Therapeutic Area.

Key Job Responsibilities :

Maximize Our Business

Sets ambitious forecasts, adjusts based on new clinical & market data, and identifies what is needed from Roche/Genentech to deliver on the ambitious forecast and P&L.
Accountable development and execution of DA & brand strategy across customers, patients, and payers
Leads strong collaboration with Squad, Digital Data and Analytics, Customer Engagement Ecosystems, Public Affairs & Access, and all Functional and Development Partners to develop integrated value proposition, strategic business plan, including specific, measurable and action-oriented 90-day priorities that grow franchise profitability, patient uptake and customer expectations. Deftly enables re-prioritization as business needs, market events, and available resources change.
Champion tenants of the Marketing Excellence, inclusive of embracing agile and evolving ways of working in the domains of content generation, measurement, omnichannel, and end to end ownership from strategy development to campaign execution.
Identifies, develops, implements and maintains an appropriate and aligned infrastructure of internal and external resources that are required to achieve the maximum level of customer satisfaction and enterprise best practice while maintaining a healthy P&L.

Shape Our Future

Serves as the Marketing Lead for Neurodegeneration Therapeutic Area with accountability to develop and execute the NDG vision, meet long-term (3-5 year) and short-term (90-day) strategic goals for a line of business within the marketing organization and across functional partners with measurable impact on customer utilization and patient access.
Defines the critical success factors for launches in early disease and pre-symptomatic disease, and reshapes our internal organization (as well as the external care coordination system) as appropriate .
Responsible for reimagining and shaping of our approach to access to meet the unique NDG patient & customer journey in close collaboration with Genentech’s Patient Strategy initiative
May be the US commercial representative on global Lifecycle Teams & Commercialization Leadership Teams and responsible to develop, access, resource, prioritize, and execute Lifecycle options to maximize the value we bring to patients. Beyond lifecycle options this may include the evaluation of Business Development opportunities.
Contributes leadership skills, insights/knowledge and courage to embrace new approaches in order to help identify innovative priorities, plans and tactics that will help improve year-on-year brand adoption to maximize the number of patients who currently benefit from treatment.
Represents the brand value proposition for all products in the assigned franchise(s) to others inside and outside of Genentech.

Evolve Our Skills & Capabilities

Builds highly-connected, highly-motivated and high-performing teams by leading, developing and inspiring a thriving NDG Marketing Team and fostering belonging within and across teams.
Champions the principles of our commercial operating model including a new digital-first mindset, end-to-end ownership, prioritizing velocity & execution over perfection & customization.
Develops a deeply patient-centric and customer-focused culture by continuously integrating emerging insights from patients, customers, providers, and, payers to define the NDG vision, strategy, and execution priorities.
Leads and contributes to the broader 1Marketing community at Genentech, participates in initiatives that have broad functional impact or impact across multiple therapeutic areas, offers functional expertise and supports capability development for the entire Marketing function, and advances progress towards our CMG outcomes.
Embraces agile working practices to mobilize the Marketing team to maximize customer value and help more patients while ensuring the marketing team engages in fulfilling work.
Responsible for long term capacity planning, enablement, project coaching and oversight of marketing team leads and is accountable for all aspects of Genentech’s people practices
Actively builds and cultivates future leaders within Marketing.
Leads or oversees hiring of direct and indirect reports.
Complies with all laws, regulations and policies that govern the conduct of Genentech activities.

Demonstrates Expert Proficiency within the following Key Competencies

Executive Marketing Directors are expected to consistently perform at the Expert level (expertise is defined as setting up strategies, systems, and structures to improve competencies across Genentech)

Customer Understanding - I’m always learning about my customers, what they need, and the world they live in.
Competitive Value Creation - I determine the relevant, competitive, and profitable value story we offer to customers.
Strategy Development - I make smart choices about what efforts will help achieve customers’ goals and our goals.
Integrated Campaign Development - I build compelling, motivating campaigns that get customers to take action.
Content Development & Approval - I craft simple, meaningful stories in an efficient and fully compliant way.
Execution Readiness - I rally the organization to plan, coordinate, and pull through the strategy together.
Delivery & Optimization Across Channels - I make sure our story is reaching customers in a seamless, memorable experience.
Measurement & Iteration - I evaluate everything we do, and adjust, stop, or start for continuous improvement.
Project & Vendor Management - I manage projects, partners, and suppliers to drive on strategy, on time, on budget impact.

Minimum Candidate Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor's degree
Ten years minimum work experience with minimum 8 years of healthcare commercial experience (e.g. market access, marketing, sales, medical affairs)
Proven track record of leading teams to deliver exceptional customer & business outcomes and positive working environments

Additional Strongly Desired Candidate Qualifications & Experience

5+ years commercial experience in neurodegenerative disease(s) is strongly preferred
Experience in payer access & contracting
Relevant graduate level degree

Location

This position is based in South San Francisco, CA
Relocation assistance is available

Roche Operating Principles

Put Patients First: I always act as if patients I know are in the room and do what’s best for them
Follow the science: I seek answers through experiments, data and debate, and act on facts
Act as one team: I care, collaborate and commit without boundaries, and trust others to do their part
Embrace differences: I seek diverse perspectives, invite opposing views, and challenge myself and others
Accelerate learning: I push to learn new things even if difficult, and openly share my successes and failures
Simplify radically: I eliminate complexity, reuse with pride, and accomplish more with less
Make impact now: I take accountability to do what’s right, deliver value fast, and don’t wait for certainty
Think long term: I choose actions today that benefit future generations

jobs.title: Director of Brand Marketing
jobs.description:
Who We Are:
Banza reimagines your favorite comfort foods, like pasta, pizza, mac & cheese, using chickpeas. Why? Because we know chickpeas aren’t just delicious; they’re also one of the most nutritious and sustainable foods. Yet 80% of the country isn’t eating enough of them. Our mission is to inspire people to eat more chickpeas and other beans, making a positive impact on human health and the environment. Banza is the #1 better-for-you pasta brand in the country, and our products are available in over 21,000 stores nationwide. We’ve been named one of TIME Magazine’s Best Inventions of the Year, Adweek’s Best Food Brand, and are proud to have fans at Good Morning America, The New York Times, Food & Wine, Bon Appetit, and more.

Your Mission:

Banza built its name by turning a humble chickpea into something people get excited about in the pasta aisle, with packaging you can spot from across the store, a social voice with real personality, and creativity that takes genuine swings. As our Director of Brand Marketing, you’ll shape what comes next: our positioning across paid, owned, and shopper channels, including eCommerce, in close partnership with Sales, Brand Management, and the Product Team, and ownership of our packaging and creative agency relationships. Sound like you? Keep reading.

What You'll Do

Play a key role in driving our brand strategy and narrative via paid media, ongoing content, and within retail stores
Own and enhance our brand voice and look & feel to ensure our campaigns, events, and various marketing touch points are ownable, breakthrough, and distinct
Identify new ways to celebrate our community of brand fans across the marketing ecosystem
Oversee and help lead product positioning across existing and new product lines
Ensure messaging is consistent yet optimized across various channels, and that all channels are working together to tell a cohesive and compelling story
Work cross functionally with internal teams to develop our value proposition strategy to ensure we’re resonating and driving action with the right audiences
Work with Consumer Insights to spearhead our marketing research agenda and turn insights into relevant messaging outputs
Optimize and create new processes to help manage ongoing projects across the team
Own brand marketing budget and strategize how to leverage it in the most meaningful way throughout the fiscal year
Manage and coach three direct reports and external agency & contractor partners

Who you are

Creative Background: At least eight years of experience growing a consumer brand with expertise in creative strategy, development, project management, and team leadership
Exceptional writer. You can tell compelling stories concisely and passionately.
360 Thinker: You understand the power of combining media + messaging and have experience developing content for paid and owned channels, including video, content, social media, OOH, packaging, email, and events.
Creative and powerful storyteller. You have a knack for finding stories worth telling that break through the clutter.
You have out-of-the-box ideas that you aren’t afraid to defend.
Culture and news-obsessed. You keep up with trending threads, the viral Social Media postings, and the breaking food news updates.
Delighted by data. You understand the power of consumer insights and know how to leverage them for successful brand storytelling.
Team Leader: You have experience managing and growing a team, and use an informed approach to craft feedback.
Problem solver. Eagerly identify process improvements and have a “no-task-too-small” attitude.
A natural relationship-builder. You're deeply empathetic and conscientious, and always strive to do the right thing.
Enthusiastic and flexible. You’re a driven, high-performer who can adapt to new conditions, assignments and deadlines in a fast-paced environment. You’re comfortable working both independently and collaboratively.

To Apply: Write a cover letter describing why you want to join Banza and why you would be an excellent fit for this role (yes, we actually read every cover letter!) and then apply directly to this posting. If you have any questions, please email jobs@eatbanza.com .

We're aware of the research showing that historically underrepresented groups are less likely to apply for a job if they don't believe that they meet all of the criteria. Do you hesitate to submit an application because you believe you need to check every box? Please apply anyway with a thoughtful cover letter! We would love to hear from you to discuss how you can help us build a great team at Banza.

Compensation

The salary range for this role is $150K-180k. The range is for the expectations as laid out in the job description; however, we are often open to a wide variety of profiles. Any updates to the salary range or considerations based on your experience and location will be communicated to you as a candidate.

Our salary ranges are based on verified market data and our philosophy of paying competitively for our size and industry. Individual pay rate decisions are based on several factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, geographical location, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall within the range based on these factors.

Perks and Benefits

Equity in Banza
Annual Bonus
Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance starting day 1: Banza pays 80% of the monthly premiums for employees and 70% for dependents
One Medical Membership
Short Term Disability and Life Insurance
Flexible Spending Account / Health Savings Account
Commuter Benefits
401(k)
Paid Time Off: 20 vacation days, 10 holidays, 6 sick days, 2 personal days, and a birthday day off
Extended Leave: Short-Term Disability, Parental Leave, and other Paid Family Leave. Support provided by our end-to-end leave management partner, Sparrow
New Parents: 12 weeks of paid parental leave plus additional optional leave time to add, and 4 weeks of flexible return to work arrangements.
Breast milk shipping service for traveling team members provided by Milk Stork
Unlimited Pasta & Mac
$500 annual stipend to purchase our pizza and waffles, wherever they're sold
NYC office stocked with snacks and beverages

Our Commitment: Banza is committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce. To achieve our mission of inspiring people to eat more chickpeas and other beans, we greatly benefit from a range of perspectives, which comes from diversity of all types, at all levels of the organization. Facilitating diversity and inclusion is the smart thing for our business. So we strongly encourage women, veterans, people with all abilities, people of color, and gender nonconforming candidates to apply.

Banza is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual's sex, age, race, color, creed, national origin, alienage, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation or affectional preference, gender identity and expression, disability, genetic trait or predisposition, carrier status, citizenship, veteran or military status and other personal characteristics protected by law. jobs.title: Product Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
Product Marketing Lead Orion Sleep | New York, NY | Full-time, on-site

COMPANY DESCRIPTION

Orion Sleep, founded in 2025, is focused on building the world's most advanced sleep system. The Orion Sleep System tracks millions of physiological signals each night and uses water-based temperature regulation to optimize sleep quality. The company combines cutting-edge hardware, software, and data science to improve rest and recovery. Orion Sleep is headquartered in San Francisco and New York City, with cross-functional teams collaborating closely to drive innovation in consumer health and wellness.

ROLE DESCRIPTION

The Product Marketing Lead is a full-time, on-site role based in New York, NY, reporting to the VP of Growth. This is Orion's first product marketing hire.
You will own how the Orion Sleep System is communicated to our core customer, visually and in copy, and how that communication evolves as the product does. The Orion system is a technical product with a hardware, software, and data layer, and our customers are people who want to understand what they're buying. Your job is to make the product digestible, compelling, and aligned with what customers actually care about, and to make sure that story is consistent everywhere it appears.

This is a strategic role with a strong hands-on component. You will set the direction for how the product is displayed and described, define the product content roadmap that supports it, produce core assets yourself, and partner with design, growth, ecommerce, sales, lifecycle, and engineering so that content is used across all facets of the business. You will also lead product marketing for future releases, from positioning through launch.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Positioning and messaging. Define and maintain the positioning, messaging hierarchy, value propositions, and feature narrative for the Orion Sleep System. Decide what we say about the product, in what order, and with what proof.

Visual and written communication of the product. Set the direction for how the product is shown and explained: how the system works, what each component does, what the software adds, and why it matters to the customer. Translate technical detail into clear, digestible language and visuals.

Product content roadmap. Build and own the roadmap of product marketing assets: demos, explainers, how-it-works visuals, comparison content, spec and proof assets, app walkthroughs, and supporting copy. Prioritize by customer need and business impact, and determine how the content gets made, through in-house design, partners, and your own production.

Cross-functional distribution. Ensure product content is used consistently across the website and product pages, paid media, email and SMS, organic social, sales conversations, customer support, onboarding, and the app. Partner with channel and site owners so the product story is the same everywhere.

Product releases. Lead go-to-market for new features, software updates, and product releases. Work directly with engineering and product to understand what's shipping, define how it's communicated, and coordinate launch across channels and teams.

Sales enablement. Create the materials the sales team uses to explain the product: pitch decks, one-pagers, demo scripts, objection handling, feature explainers, and competitive comparisons. Partner with sales to support pipeline growth.

Customer and market insight. Conduct market and competitor analysis, develop and refine customer personas, and gather the questions customers actually ask through sales, support, reviews, and community. Feed those insights back into messaging and content.

Proof and claims. Maintain the library of product claims and supporting evidence and partner with legal on review. We sell on specifics.

Measurement. Analyze performance data across product pages, launches, and sales conversations to understand what's landing and refine the approach.

QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience marketing a premium connected hardware product with a software or app component, with direct accountability for conversion or revenue outcomes. Consumer products, healthtech, or hardware backgrounds are strongly preferred. • A content background. You have personally produced product marketing content for a technical product, including demos, explainers, feature stories, product visuals, or comparison content, and can show the work. • Experience building positioning and messaging frameworks from scratch and carrying them through product pages, paid, lifecycle, and sales. • A track record of successful go-to-market launches for new features or products. • Comfort working directly with engineers and product teams, and the ability to translate a technical mechanism into something a customer understands quickly. • Hands-on production skills: you write finished copy, work in Figma, can shoot and cut a product demo, use AI image and video tools, and build a one-pager without waiting on anyone. You know when to hand off for polish. • Strong market research skills: customer insights, competitive analysis, persona development, and data-driven decision-making. • Excellent communication: clear written messaging, storytelling, and cross-functional collaboration across growth, ecommerce, sales, support, lifecycle, and engineering. • Strategic and organized: able to set a content roadmap, prioritize across competing needs, explain the reasoning, and bring teams along with it. • Understanding of sales processes and experience creating sales enablement tools for a considered purchase. • Demonstrated analytical skills, comfort with metrics, and experience with marketing and CRM tools. • Ability to work on-site in New York, NY, operate autonomously, and manage multiple projects and deadlines. • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience. • Bonus: experience with optional-subscription or software-upsell models on hardware.

COMPENSATION, LOCATION, AND BENEFITS

$130,000–$190,000 base salary, plus equity. Full-time, on-site in New York, NY. Health, dental, and vision insurance.

jobs.title: Marketing Campaign Manager
jobs.description:
Campaign Manager, Marketing

Eightfold is a global leader in an AI-native enterprise talent platform, trusted by the world's largest & most respected Fortune 500 organizations. Our platform is built from the ground up, operating at scale across Azure and AWS, deployed in multiple regions globally, including IL4-compliant environments for the US Government, supporting users in 100+ countries and 30+ languages. Today, Eightfold is at the forefront of agentic AI, delivering intelligent agents that actively drive outcomes across hiring and talent workflows, while much of the industry is still experimenting with prototypes. Backed by over $410M in funding and valued at $2B+, we are defining the next era of agentic talent systems.
What sets Eightfold apart is not just the technology & our mission, but the team behind it. We are a deeply technical, execution-driven organization that values ownership, collaboration, and high standards. Our engineers, product leaders, and go-to-market teams work closely together, in person and across functions, to build systems that scale in the real world. If you're excited to work on hard problems, move with urgency, raise the bar every day, and help build agentic systems that transform how the world works, Eightfold is the place to do it.

About the Role

We're looking for a Campaign Manager who uses AI tools end to end to architect, lead, and optimize integrated campaigns for our agentic AI solutions for enterprises. This is a senior, high-ownership role: you'll set campaign strategy (not just execute against a brief), manage a portfolio of concurrent programs across email, paid, web, and events, and act as the connective tissue between demand gen, product marketing, sales, and marketing ops. You'll also set the standard for how AI is used across the campaign lifecycle, using platforms like Perplexity, Claude (Anthropic), ChatGPT, and Gemini to research audiences, generate assets, orchestrate automations, and continuously improve performance and mentor other marketers on doing the same.

Responsibilities

You will own campaign strategy and execution end to end, with AI in the loop at every stage, and be a force multiplier for how the broader marketing team works:
Own campaign strategy for a portfolio of integrated programs (email, paid media, webinars, events, website), setting goals, targets, and measurement plans that tie directly to pipeline and product adoption for our agentic AI offerings.
Lead AI-powered market and account research, using Perplexity, Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini to develop persona insights, messaging strategy, and competitive positioning, then translate findings into campaign briefs that other marketers and agencies can execute against.
Direct the creation of campaign assets with AI assistance (email sequences, landing pages, ad copy, nurture tracks, event promotions), setting quality bar and brand standards while partnering closely with content, design, and product marketing.
Architect and manage complex campaign workflows in Marketo and Salesforce, including segmentation strategy, lead routing logic, and scoring models, and partner with marketing ops to evolve these systems as programs scale.
Own end-to-end campaign operations, list strategy, UTM governance, form/landing page architecture, QA, and post-launch monitoring — and establish repeatable processes and quality standards for the broader team.
Use AI agents and analytics to drive a continuous optimization program: diagnosing performance across subject lines, offers, creative, and segments, and translating insights into a prioritized testing roadmap.
Own and continually expand the team's prompt and agent playbook, establishing best practices, training other marketers on effective AI-assisted workflows, and acting as the go-to resource for AI-powered campaign execution.
Serve as the primary campaign partner to demand gen, product marketing, sales, and marketing operations leadership, aligning campaign strategy with product launches, ABM programs, and sales motions, and representing campaigns in cross-functional planning.
Evaluate emerging AI marketing tools and capabilities, pilot new use cases, and make recommendations on which to adopt at scale, helping define how AI is used across the marketing organization going forward.

What "AI-powered" means in this role

Given you're in an AI-first org, it helps to be concrete:
Research and insights: Lead deep AI-assisted research on markets, accounts, and personas, synthesizing findings into strategic campaign briefs that guide other contributors and agencies.
Content production: Direct the use of ChatGPT/Claude to generate first drafts of emails, ad variants, webinar outlines, and nurture trees, then apply senior-level editorial judgment for quality, strategy, and brand alignment.
Agentic workflows: Design and own AI agent workflows (in partnership with marketing ops) for audience segmentation, performance summaries, and experiment proposals, and train others to use them.
Experimentation: Build and prioritize an AI-informed testing roadmap, own the analysis of results, and set the strategic direction for what gets tested next.

This is not a "prompt button pusher" role, you'll design, run, and scale AI-assisted workflows that improve speed, quality, and outcomes across the entire funnel, and set the example for how the rest of the team should do the same.

Qualifications

4–6 years of experience in B2B marketing, demand generation, or campaign management, with a track record of owning campaigns end to end.
Proven, hands-on expertise running campaigns in a marketing automation platform (Marketo strongly preferred; HubSpot or Pardot considered) and deep familiarity with a CRM such as Salesforce, including segmentation and lead routing/scoring logic.
Demonstrated, sophisticated use of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, or similar) to drive research, content creation, and campaign operations — not just occasional use, but workflows you've built and can teach to others.
Strong command of multi-touch funnels, lead lifecycle stages, and key SaaS metrics (MQL, SQL, opportunity, pipeline, revenue), with the ability to diagnose performance issues and recommend strategic fixes.
Fluent working with data: building lists, building and interpreting dashboards, and translating performance reports into clear recommendations for stakeholders.
Excellent writing and editing skills, with the judgment to elevate AI-generated drafts to a senior, brand-appropriate standard.
Highly organized and process-driven, with experience managing multiple concurrent, complex campaigns and cross-functional stakeholders under deadline pressure.
A builder mindset with a bias toward experimentation — you've introduced new tools, automations, or workflows at a previous company and can point to the impact.
Strong cross-functional communication and influence skills — comfortable partnering with and, at times, informally guiding marketing, sales, and operations stakeholders without formal authority.

Nice to Haves

Experience marketing AI, SaaS, or enterprise software products.
Experience with agentic AI, AI agents for marketing, or similar autonomy-oriented AI concepts.
Experience with A/B testing programs, attribution reporting, and common B2B sales motions (ABM, product-led growth, partner-led).
Prior experience mentoring or informally leading other marketers or agency partner.

We are a team of self-starters who excel in their fields. We believe in giving you responsibility, not a task. We want you to have ownership and pride in your work and see your work's positive impact on your colleagues, our customers, and the world. We believe in providing transparency and support so you can do the best work of your career.

Hybrid Work @ Eightfold:
At Eightfold, we believe our best work happens when we collaborate closely, learn from one another, and build together. We follow a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with a strong emphasis on in-person collaboration to foster innovation, culture, and rapid execution.
Employees based near our Santa Clara, London, Bangalore, and Noida offices are expected to work from the office three days per week, as we believe regular in-person engagement is essential to how we build high-impact products and strong teams.

Lead email for product go-to-market and thought leadership, partnering with Product Marketing, Content and regional teams.

Test and grow lifecycle channels and tactics beyond email.
Set up regular reporting and feedback loops with sales and regional teams, showing how lifecycle programs affect pipeline, merchant transaction volume and retention.

Hands-on Marketo experience building emails, nurture programs, dynamic content and audience segments.

jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.
 The Role We’re looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to shape how businesses experience Afterpay and Cash App, from their first touch with us to becoming long-term partners. You’ll build and own our global B2B lifecycle and email strategy, including the plan, the personalized journeys and the test roadmap. Your programs will turn prospects into merchants, get new merchants set up and transacting quickly, and give established merchants what they need to grow. You’ll also use AI to personalize at scale and to learn faster than any single campaign could teach us.
This is a global role focused on North America, the UK and APAC. You’ll build strategies globally but think regionally, so each market gets programs that reflect how its merchants buy, sell and grow. You might start your day in merchant insights and lost-deal notes from Sales, looking for the moment new merchants stall during setup. By the afternoon, you’ve turned that insight into a personalized onboarding journey that gets them transacting faster. You’ll report to the Global B2B Commerce Growth Lead and work closely with Sales, Marketing & Revenue Operations, Account-Based Marketing, Content, Partnerships, Product and Compliance.

You Will You will develop a global lifecycle and email marketing strategy that:
Thinks like a customer, using merchant insights to help prospects solve their problems, improve their business and see the value of Afterpay and Cash App.
Grows net new merchants through personalized nurture journeys that move prospects to opportunities and signed merchants.
Gets new merchants set up and transacting as quickly as possible, then helps them adopt more of our products.
Helps established merchants grow at scale, increasing transaction volume and engagement with Block.
Delivers thought leadership, product releases, events and growth opportunities that increase merchant engagement, retention and lifetime value.
Keeps merchants with us through churn prevention and winback programs.
Sets lifecycle best practices so prospects and merchants are happy and succeed with Block.
Uses AI to personalize content, sharpen segmentation, and speed up production and learning.

  Day-to-day:
Own the full prospect and merchant lifecycle across every segment, from small businesses to enterprise.
Build global strategies but think regionally: get to know the needs of each market and adapt one global framework to fit them.
Work with regional sales leaders to understand their needs, find gaps in the customer journey, and turn those insights into new journeys and improvements.
Lead email for product go-to-market and thought leadership, partnering with Product Marketing, Content and regional teams.
Own the email test roadmap: write hypotheses, run A/B and multivariate tests, and share what you learn across the team.
Test and grow lifecycle channels and tactics beyond email.
Set up regular reporting and feedback loops with sales and regional teams, showing how lifecycle programs affect pipeline, merchant transaction volume and retention.

You Have

Minimum 5 years experience owning B2B lifecycle, email or CRM marketing, ideally for global, sales-led products serving businesses of all sizes.
Experience measuring lifecycle impact on attributed, influenced and incremental revenue, retention and merchant engagement, and presenting results to leadership.
Hands-on Marketo experience building emails, nurture programs, dynamic content and audience segments.
Working knowledge of Figma or similar software for designing and building email creative.
Experience designing, running and measuring lifecycle growth and testing strategies.
AI fluency, with a track record of using AI tools to scale marketing programs.
Experience managing programs from idea to launch across multiple teams and time zones.
Experience partnering with sales and regional leaders to understand their needs and turn them into lifecycle programs that drive results.

improveit 360 is looking for a Senior Growth Marketing Manager – ABM
to build and scale our account-based marketing strategy for a focused market of high-value remodeling businesses.

This is a strategic, hands-on role for an experienced ABM marketer who can bring Marketing and Sales together around a shared target-account strategy and turn account intelligence into programs that drive engagement, pipeline and revenue.

You’ll own the ABM motion across target account strategy, account tiering, buying committee engagement, intent, coordinated Sales and Marketing plays, Marketing Qualified Accounts (MQAs), and measurement. Because we serve a relatively small, high-value market, you’ll help us determine where highly personalized 1:1 and 1:few approaches matter most and where broader account-based programs can create leverage.

Most importantly, you’ll build a strong partnership with Sales and create a repeatable ABM operating model that both teams can use to identify, engage and progress the accounts that matter most.

Responsibilities:

Own the ABM Strategy

Own and continuously refine improveit 360’s Target Account List (TAL), account tiers and prioritization criteria in partnership with Sales.
Define priority personas and buying committees and improve contact coverage across target accounts.
Develop the right mix of 1:1, 1:few and 1:many strategies based on account value, ICP fit, intent and engagement.
Build and maintain a prioritized roadmap for evolving the ABM program as our capabilities mature.

Build and Activate Account-Based Programs

Develop integrated account-based plays across priority accounts and segments.
Translate account tiers, buying committees and customer needs into differentiated engagement strategies.
Partner with Paid Media, Product Marketing, Content, Events and other teams to activate coordinated account experiences.
Identify messaging, content and personalization needs and partner with channel owners to bring them to market.
Test and optimize channels, audiences, messaging and plays based on account engagement and progression.

Lead Sales + Marketing Alignment

Serve as the primary Marketing partner to Sales leadership for the ABM motion.
Establish recurring account reviews focused on priority accounts, intent, engagement and next actions.
Translate Marketing and account intelligence into actionable recommendations for AEs and SDRs.
Develop Sales plays and enablement tied to account tier, persona and buying signals.
Build feedback loops so Sales insights continually improve targeting, messaging and qualification.

Own Account Progression + Measurement

Own the account funnel from target account → engaged account → MQA → Sales-accepted account → opportunity → pipeline/revenue.
Define and continuously improve MQA criteria and Sales handoffs in partnership with Sales and RevOps.
Use account fit, intent, buying committee engagement and Marketing activity to identify accounts showing meaningful buying signals.
Partner with Marketing Ops and RevOps on ZoomInfo MarketingOS, Salesforce integrations, data quality, workflows and reporting.
Measure account coverage, engagement, MQAs, Sales acceptance, opportunities, pipeline and revenue.
Use performance data and Sales feedback to identify where accounts are stalling and continually improve the program.

Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:

You enjoy building, not simply inheriting a mature ABM program. You’re comfortable walking into ambiguity, assessing what exists and creating structure without overengineering it.

You know successful ABM starts with Sales and Marketing agreeing on who matters, how to engage them and what happens when an account shows interest. You bring a strong point of view while remaining collaborative enough to adapt based on Sales feedback, customer insights and performance.

Ultimately, you’re focused on building the right ABM program for the market — one that is actionable for Sales and creates measurable account progression, pipeline and revenue.

Significant experience building or leading B2B account-based marketing programs, ideally in SaaS or another complex B2B environment.
Hands-on experience with target account strategy, account tiering, buying committees, intent, personalization and ABM measurement.
Strong understanding of 1:1, 1:few and 1:many ABM models and when to use each.
Demonstrated ability to partner with Sales leadership, AEs and SDRs to build shared account strategies and coordinated plays.
Experience with ABM and intent platforms such as ZoomInfo MarketingOS, 6sense, Demandbase, Propensity or similar.
Strong understanding of Salesforce and experience partnering with Marketing Ops and RevOps on data, integrations and reporting.
Analytical mindset with the ability to translate account data into clear actions and business decisions.
Ability to move comfortably between strategy and execution and work cross-functionally across Marketing.
Strong communication, facilitation and stakeholder-management skills.

Where:

The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States– if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. jobs.title: Director of Product Marketing
jobs.description:
About Telnyx

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network , to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.

We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.

Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.

The opportunity

We're looking for a Director or VP of Product Marketing to lead that effort globally. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can connect deep technical understanding with positioning, distribution and commercial results. The title will reflect the experience and scope of the person we hire.

A good product story matters, but a story alone isn't enough. The person in this role needs to turn our infrastructure into clear customer problems we solve, compelling reasons to choose Telnyx and practical ways to try it. A great sample application, integration or reference architecture can do more than another 30-slide deck. So can a precise message that reaches a developer at the moment they are deciding how to build.

You'll work across Product, Engineering, Developer Relations, Sales and Marketing to bring those pieces together. You'll help shape what we launch, how we explain it, how buyers discover it and how our field teams take it to market.

What You'll Build

A coherent product story. Own positioning, segmentation and competitive differentiation across AI inference, Voice AI, agent and edge infrastructure, communications, networking and wireless. Make the full platform understandable without flattening the technical details that make it valuable.
Solutions people can actually use. Drive the packaging of sample apps, reference architectures, integrations, templates and working demos that prove what the infrastructure makes possible. Build repeatable plays for use cases such as contact centers, agent assist and industry-specific workflows. These should accelerate adoption and enterprise sales, not become disconnected software products.
Distribution that reaches technical buyers. Shape how we win discovery through product pages, developer content, SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), technical communities and paid acquisition. You won't necessarily operate every campaign, but you must understand the mechanics deeply enough to direct them: search and answer-engine visibility, technical site structure, intent, targeting, conversion paths, attribution and economics.
A field-ready commercial engine. Give enterprise sellers, FDEs and solutions teams the pitches, discovery frameworks, architecture diagrams, competitive proof, demos and ROI narratives they need to generate and advance opportunities. Translate platform capabilities into buying reasons for developers, technical executives and enterprise decision-makers.
Launches that translate into adoption. Work with Product and Engineering early, not after something ships. Choose the audience, packaging and launch strategy, then measure activation, qualified demand, field utilization and downstream pipeline. Build an operating cadence that keeps pace with a rapidly changing roadmap.
An AI-native PMM team. Use AI research tools, coding assistants, agents and automation as part of everyday work to accelerate market research, competitive analysis, messaging tests, content production, demo development and go-to-market execution. Know when to trust those tools, how to evaluate outputs and where human technical judgment still matters. Lead the team to operate the same way.

How We'll Measure Success

The ultimate measure is pipeline. Not the number of launches, assets, impressions or campaigns. We expect this leader to partner closely with Demand Generation and Sales to create measurable, qualified pipeline, improve conversion and accelerate opportunities. Product marketing should be able to show how specific product narratives, solutions, integrations and programs contribute to commercial results.

Early wins will look like a dramatically clearer platform story; a small number of flagship use cases with runnable demos and integrations; sellers using consistent, technically credible plays; stronger discovery and conversion from search, AEO and paid channels; and a repeatable link from product launches to adoption and pipeline. We care about what works and scales, not activity for its own sake.

What We're Looking For

You've led product marketing for a complex B2B technical platform, ideally in AI infrastructure, developer tools, APIs, cloud, networking or communications. You can be strategic without becoming removed from the work.
You are technically fluent. You can understand architecture, work with APIs or SDKs, interrogate a latency or cost claim and talk comfortably with engineers. You don't have to be a production engineer, but you need to know when a demo is real and when it's just a pitch.
You understand modern technical acquisition. You're credible directing AEO, SEO, paid programs and developer-focused content, and can connect channel-level metrics to funnel economics and qualified pipeline.
You're already effective with AI tools and agents in your own work. You experiment, build workflows and use the technology to move faster. Familiarity with the limitations and evaluation of AI-generated outputs is as important as enthusiasm for the tools.
You write exceptionally well, have strong instincts for enterprise sales, and know how to turn a complex product advantage into a clear reason to buy.
You've built or led strong teams, can prioritize across competing launches and products, and enjoy working directly with product leaders and technical builders.

Telecom experience is not required. Technical curiosity, taste, speed and a track record of generating commercial impact matter more.

Why Telnyx

This is a chance to shape the market narrative for a company that owns the underlying network, communications and compute infrastructure it sells. The platform is real, customers are deploying it in production, and the commercial opportunity is substantial. You'll have direct access to senior leadership and the ability to build a PMM function measured by its contribution to growth.

Equal opportunity

Telnyx is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from different backgrounds and evaluate candidates based on the skills and experience relevant to the role.

jobs.description:
Position Summary

This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.

Samsung Electronics America, Inc. (SEA), the U.S. Sales and Marketing subsidiary, is a leader in mobile technologies, consumer electronics, home appliances, enterprise solutions and networks systems. For more than four decades, Samsung has driven innovation, economic growth and workforce opportunity across the United States—investing over $100 billion and employing more than 20,000 people nationwide. By integrating our large portfolio of products, services and AI technology, we’re creating smarter, sustainable and more connected experiences that empower people to live better. SEA is a wholly owned subsidiary of Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd.

To learn more, visit Samsung.com. For the latest news, visit news.samsung.com/us.

We are seeking a strategic, data-driven Senior Manager of B2B CRM & Marketing Automation to lead the evolution of our digital customer engagement, marketing automation, and lead management capabilities. This role will help architect the digital demand journey—connecting media, content, web experiences, lead capture, marketing automation, CRM, and sales activation into an integrated B2B growth engine. The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with strong operational expertise and understands how digital experiences work together to attract prospects, capture demand, nurture relationships, identify buying signals, and ultimately generate pipeline.

This leader will partner closely with Sales, Integrated Marketing, Digital, Creative, Analytics, Product Marketing, Technology, and external partners to develop scalable customer journeys that improve engagement, strengthen marketing-to-sales connectivity, and deliver measurable business impact. This is an opportunity for a builder—someone who can optimize today’s programs while helping design the capabilities, processes, technology, and customer experiences required to support future B2B growth.

Role And Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

CRM, Lifecycle & Customer Engagement Strategy

Participate in CRM Governance Council for planning and coordination across SEA lines of business. Ensure compliance with all guidelines and provide briefs and analysis for Council review.
Own and evolve the B2B CRM and marketing automation strategy across the customer engagement journey.
Develop scalable lifecycle and nurture strategies aligned to customer needs, buying stages, business priorities, and sales motions.
Build segmentation, personalization, and next-best-action approaches that increase customer relevance and accelerate progression through the funnel.
Identify gaps and opportunities across the customer journey and translate them into actionable programs, capabilities, and technology improvements.
Develop strategies for lead capture, qualification, scoring, routing, nurture, recycling, re-engagement, and sales activation.
Continuously explore new approaches to customer engagement, including emerging automation, AI, personalization, and journey orchestration capabilities.

Digital Customer Journey & Conversion Experience

Own and continuously improve the digital pathways that move B2B prospects from awareness and engagement through lead capture, nurture, sales engagement, and conversion.
Partner across Integrated Marketing, Digital, Creative, Media, Product Marketing, and Sales to develop connected experiences across websites, landing pages, digital advertising, content, email, events, and other customer touchpoints- translating campaign engagement into scalable nurture and conversion programs.
Develop and optimize high-performing landing pages, lead-capture experiences, calls-to-action, forms, and conversion pathways that translate marketing engagement into identifiable demand.
Use behavioral and conversion data to identify friction within the digital journey and recommend improvements to content, UX, personalization, navigation, conversion paths, and nurture experiences.
Partner with creative and content teams to identify the assets needed to support customer progression, including digital advertising, solution content, thought leadership, case studies, gated and ungated content, and sales enablement experiences.
Champion experimentation through A/B testing, personalization, dynamic content, progressive profiling, journey optimization, and emerging AI-enabled experiences.

Demand Generation & Pipeline Acceleration

Partner with Sales and Sales Operations to strengthen marketing-to-sales handoffs and improve lead follow-up, acceptance, conversion, and pipeline velocity.
Identify opportunities to improve lead quality and prioritize prospects based on fit, intent, engagement, and buying behavior.
Establish clear measurement frameworks connecting CRM and digital engagement programs to business outcomes including engagement, MQLs, SQLs, opportunities, pipeline, conversion, and revenue.

Marketing Automation, Technology & Data

Serve as a business owner and subject matter expert for B2B marketing automation, CRM, lead management, and related customer engagement capabilities.
Translate business and customer requirements into scalable marketing technology solutions and workflows.
Partner with technology, analytics, and platform teams to improve integrations, data quality, audience management, campaign orchestration, identity resolution, and measurement.
Ensure customer and behavioral data can be effectively activated across marketing programs and surfaced to Sales where appropriate.
Evaluate emerging technologies and capabilities that can improve marketing effectiveness, customer experience, operational efficiency, and sales connectivity.
Establish governance, documentation, testing, quality assurance, and operational standards for CRM and automated marketing programs.

Analytics, Optimization & Innovation

Develop reporting and performance frameworks that provide actionable insights into customer behavior, funnel progression, campaign effectiveness, and pipeline contribution.
Use data and experimentation to continually improve engagement, conversion, customer experience, and business outcomes.
Establish test-and-learn roadmaps across messaging, segmentation, cadence, channel, personalization, landing experiences, and journey design.
Identify friction and leakage across the customer journey and develop recommendations to address them.
Bring forward emerging technologies, industry best practices, and innovative approaches that advance the organization’s B2B digital marketing maturity.
Translate performance data into actionable recommendations for marketing, digital, and sales stakeholders.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Act as a strategic connector across Marketing, Sales, Sales Operations, Digital, Creative, Analytics, Technology, Product Marketing, and other key stakeholders.
Translate complex business requirements into clear strategies, processes, and execution plans.
Lead cross-functional initiatives requiring coordination across multiple teams, platforms, and stakeholders.
Influence without direct authority and proactively drive decisions, accountability, and progress.
Establish clear roles and operating processes across teams involved in the digital customer journey.
Serve as an internal advocate for customer-centric, data-driven B2B marketing practices.

Agency, Vendor & Contract Management

Manage agency, technology, and vendor relationships supporting CRM, marketing automation, digital customer experiences, data, and related programs.
Own or support scopes of work, contract development, renewals, procurement processes, budgets, and vendor performance.
Establish clear KPIs, deliverables, and service expectations for external partners and hold partners accountable for performance.
Evaluate existing and prospective partners based on capability, scalability, performance, cost, and alignment with future business needs.
Identify opportunities to improve partner models, consolidate capabilities, increase efficiency, or introduce new expertise as business needs evolve.

Qualifications

Skills and Qualifications

8+ years of experience across B2B marketing, CRM, lifecycle marketing, marketing automation, demand generation, digital marketing, or related disciplines.
Demonstrated experience developing customer journeys and marketing programs that contribute to lead generation, pipeline, and revenue growth.
Strong understanding of complex B2B buying journeys, demand generation, lead management, sales funnels, and digital conversion.
Experience with enterprise CRM and marketing automation platforms and familiarity with the broader marketing technology ecosystem.
Understanding of digital experience fundamentals including landing pages, conversion optimization, web journeys, forms, content strategy, digital media, and UX principles.
Strong understanding of segmentation, lead scoring, nurture strategy, personalization, campaign orchestration, and funnel measurement.
Experience partnering closely with B2B sales organizations and translating marketing engagement and behavioral signals into actionable sales opportunities.
Demonstrated ability to use analytics and customer insights to identify opportunities and improve marketing performance.
Experience managing agencies, technology vendors, contracts, scopes of work, and budgets.
Team player and ability to collaborate with cross- functional stakeholders for best outcomes
Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex programs involving multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and priorities.
Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and cross-functional leadership skills.
Proficient in Excel, PowerPoint and Tableau.
High ability to develop an analysis, interpretation, and presentation
Able to learn new systems quickly and maximize potential of available tools

Preferred

Experience supporting enterprise, technology, SaaS, telecommunications, or other complex B2B sales environments.
Experience with account-based marketing, intent data, advanced personalization, or multi-channel journey orchestration.
Familiarity with emerging AI applications across marketing automation, personalization, content, analytics, and customer experience.
Experience helping mature or transform an organization’s marketing technology, CRM, or digital demand-generation capabilities.
