jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Director, Performance Marketing to join our Performance Marketing team to support a new, unannounced ARPG mobile game based on a major IP. This role is available on a hybrid basis in Los Angeles, CA, or remotely within the United States.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and aim to inspire play every day—whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers developing, publishing, and innovating within the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people worldwide daily.

The Performance Marketing team is focused on driving player growth and efficiency across a diverse set of digital marketing channels. With teams across the US and Europe, the team operates in a fast-evolving mobile advertising ecosystem.

In this role, you will play a critical part in launching and scaling Scopely’s next major title, shaping user acquisition strategy from pre-launch testing through global scale.

The Director, Performance Marketing will lead global performance marketing strategy and execution for a new, unannounced ARPG mobile title based on a major IP. This role is responsible for driving player growth, building scalable acquisition strategies, optimizing multi-million-dollar budgets, and developing a high-performing performance marketing team across global markets.

What You Will Do

You will lead performance marketing efforts for a new, unannounced ARPG title based on a major IP, driving global user growth and building scalable acquisition strategies from pre-launch through live operations.
Own and lead global go-to-market performance marketing strategy and execution for the new title, from pre-launch testing through global scale.
Define and execute user acquisition strategies, methodologies, and processes to achieve growth and efficiency targets.
Partner with Product, Strategic Marketing, Growth, Finance, Analytics, Creative, and Data Engineering teams to align UA strategy with game positioning, audience targeting, lifecycle marketing, and business goals.
Build and scale acquisition programs across key channels, including Meta, Google, TikTok, DSPs, ad networks, and emerging platforms.
Establish and optimize full-funnel measurement frameworks, including KPI definition, attribution strategy, incrementality testing, and LTV modeling.
Drive deep analytical insights into campaign performance, working with Analytics and Data Science to improve forecasting and decision-making.
Build and oversee Scopely’s UA pod in Shanghai, China.
Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of performance marketers, fostering accountability, innovation, experimentation, and continuous improvement.
Collaborate cross-functionally to enhance creative strategy, marketing technology, automation, and fraud prevention systems.
Manage and optimize multi-million-dollar marketing budgets with a focus on ROI and long-term player value.

What We’re Looking For

Fluent in English and Mandarin
Preferred experience working with Chinese gaming studios
Deep understanding of the Performance Marketing best practices on the Chinese gaming market
8+ years of performance marketing / user acquisition experience, ideally within mobile gaming or consumer apps
4+ years of people management experience, with a track record of building and leading high-performing teams
Proven success managing and scaling multi-million dollar acquisition budgets across multiple channels
Strong experience with major platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok, programmatic networks, etc.) Demonstrated expertise in go-to-market strategy, launch planning, and scaling new products
Deep analytical mindset with experience in attribution, incrementality testing, LTV modeling, and performance forecasting
Track record of driving significant growth through improvements in automation, marketing tech, or data infrastructure
Experience working with global, cross-functional teams across multiple time zones
Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills
Bonus: Experience in Midcore, RPG, Strategy 4x mobile games

Bonus Points

Experience working with Chinese gaming studios.
Deep understanding of performance marketing best practices in the Chinese gaming market.
Experience in midcore, RPG, or 4X strategy mobile games.

Please ensure that the résumé/CV you attach is written in English.

At Scopely, we create games for everyone—and we believe the people behind our games should reflect that. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect and has the opportunity to thrive.

For candidates in CA, CO, NJ, NY, and WA, the annual salary range is provided below. In addition to base pay, employees may be eligible for equity, bonuses, and a comprehensive benefits package, including healthcare benefits, retirement benefits, pet insurance, paid holidays, paid Scopely free days, and unlimited paid time off. Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

CA, CO, NJ, NY, and WA Annual Salary Range

$160,000—$230,000 USD

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

At Mitratech, we are a team of innovators focused on building world-class products that simplify operations in the Legal, Risk, Compliance, and HR functions. We are a close-knit, globally dispersed team that thrives in an ecosystem that supports individual excellence and takes pride in its diverse and inclusive work culture centered around great people practices, learning opportunities, and having fun! Our culture is the ideal blend of entrepreneurial spirit and enterprise investment, enabling the chance to move at a rapid pace with some of the most complex, leading-edge technologies available.
For over 35 years, the experts at Mitratech have been focused on solving the complex needs. Today, we serve 20,000 client companies of all sizes globally, representing 30% of the Fortune 500 and over 500,000 users in over 160 countries.
As we continue to grow, we’re always looking for resourceful, enthusiastic, and fresh perspectives. Join our global team and see what makes Mitratech a truly exceptional place to work!
Job Overview 

We are seeking a Paid Digital Marketing Manager
to own and scale our paid digital strategy for Mitratech’s Workforce Compliance and HR Solutions portfolio, including Background Screening, I-9 Compliance, HR Compliance & Expertise, and Leave Management solutions.  
This role is responsible for planning, executing, optimizing, and reporting on paid digital programs that drive qualified demand across the full sales and marketing funnel. You’ll work closely with product marketing, demand generation, sales, and revenue operations to ensure paid media programs are data-driven, AI-enabled, and tightly aligned to pipeline and revenue goals.  
This is a hands-on, individual contributor role ideal for a performance marketer who is comfortable operating both strategically and tactically in a B2B SaaS environment.  
Essential Duties & Responsibilities
:
Paid Media Strategy & Execution

Ensure alignment of all paid digital initiatives with business priorities, solution-level goals, and defined KPIs, including pipeline contribution, revenue impact, and efficiency metrics.  

Develop, execute, and optimize paid digital programs across channels, including paid search (Google Ads and Bing Ads), paid social (LinkedIn, Meta), display, retargeting, and B2B review and marketplace platforms (e.g., Capterra, Software Advice, SHRM MediaBrains) to support pipeline and revenue targets.  

Own channel-level budgeting, forecasting, pacing, and performance optimization across multiple HR solutions and buyer personas.  

Translate product positioning and campaign strategy into high-performing paid media programs aligned to each stage of the buyer journey.  

Partner with Product Marketing to ensure messaging, keywords, and creative reflect compliance-driven value propositions and customer pain points.  

AI-Forward & Data-Driven Marketing

Leverage AI-powered bidding, audience targeting, creative testing, and optimization tools within paid platforms to improve efficiency and performance.  

Use AI and automation to scale keyword expansion, ad variation testing, audience segmentation, and performance insights.  

Apply predictive and behavioral data to inform spend allocation, audience prioritization, and conversion optimization.  

Continuously evaluate and pilot emerging AI-driven advertising tools and capabilities to maintain a competitive edge.  

Optimization, Testing & Analytics

Prepare and present performance insights, recommendations, and strategic readouts to senior marketing leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, including C-suite and executive audiences, translating complex data into clear business impact.  

Design and manage A/B and multivariate tests across ads, landing pages, audiences, and offers to improve conversion rates and CPL.  

Monitor performance against KPIs, including CPL, CAC, conversion rate, pipeline contribution, and ROI.  

Analyze campaign, channel, and cohort-level data to deliver actionable insights and recommendations to marketing and sales leadership.  

Partner with web and CRO teams to optimize landing page experience, conversion paths, and form strategy.  

Martech, Attribution & Collaboration

Manage and optimize integrations between paid platforms, marketing automation (HubSpot), CRM (Salesforce), and analytics tools.  

Ensure clean tracking, attribution, and reporting across the funnel in collaboration with Revenue Operations.  

Work cross-functionally with to align paid programs to active campaigns, events, and sales priorities.  

Manage external vendors or agencies as needed to support execution and scale.  

Perform other related duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

4–6 years of experience in paid digital marketing, performance marketing, or demand generation within a B2B SaaS or technology environment.  

Hands-on experience managing paid search (Google/Bing), paid social (LinkedIn), display, and retargeting campaigns.  

Strong understanding of full-funnel B2B demand models, lead lifecycle management, and revenue attribution.  

Experience using marketing automation platforms (HubSpot) and CRM systems (Salesforce).  

Proven ability to analyze data, identify insights, and translate performance data into optimization actions.  

Experience collaborating cross-functionally with product marketing, sales, and operations teams.

Experience leveraging AI-driven features within ad platforms (e.g., automated bidding, audience expansion, responsive ads).  

Familiarity with AI-assisted tools for keyword research, creative development, performance analysis, and experimentation.  

Experience with 6sense is a significant plus, including use of intent data, account-based targeting, audience activation, and orchestration of paid media across channels. Candidates with hands-on 6sense experience will be prioritized and moved to the top of the candidate pool.  

Strong analytical mindset with experience using analytics tools.  

Working knowledge of conversion tracking, attribution models, and marketing data pipelines.  

Preferred Experience

Familiarity with regulated or compliance-driven industries.

Exposure to conversion rate optimization, landing page optimization, and personalization strategies.

The marketing and communications program led by the Director will embody and reflect the VMCVM’s core values, principles, strategic goals and priorities, and VMCVM’s unique attributes and offerings that contribute to the broader understanding of Virginia Tech.

In support of a successful marketing and communications program for VMCVM and the university, the Director will collaborate with and/or be a part of several teams, including the VMCVM’s Dean and senior leadership group; the VMCVM’s advancement team (including marketing and communications, alumni engagement and referring practitioner relations, and development); marketing and communications directors in other colleges and units across the university; and colleagues in the Advancement and Marketing and Communications divisions, among others. The Director collaborates with university leadership, faculty, staff, students, alumni, friends, grateful clients, and external partners to support marketing and communications initiatives.

Currently, the Director directly leads and supervises a team of four marketing and communications professionals, providing performance planning and evaluation, direction, support, and professional development opportunities. In addition, the Director works with VMCVM department heads and teaching hospital administration to align marketing and communications work to both VMCVM and university priorities.

Elements of a comprehensive and strategic marketing and communications program for VMCVM will include a wide range of tactics and strategies, including communications plans, news and feature stories, speeches for VMCVM leadership, message alignment, marketing campaigns, media relations and pitches, publications, photography and videography, social media, advertising, and similar items. This position supports VMCVM and university initiatives in Blacksburg, Roanoke, and the greater Washington, D.C. metro area, including the three teaching hospitals in Blacksburg, Roanoke, and Leesburg, Virginia. The Director is designated as emergency personnel.

The position is based at the Virginia Tech campus in Blacksburg, Virginia. The position reports to both the Senior Director of Marketing and Communications, Virginia Tech, and the Assistant Dean of Advancement of VMCVM.

● Develop, implement, and evaluate a comprehensive, strategic marketing and communications plan that supports VMCVM and university’s mission and integrates university and VMCVM priorities.

Zipliens is a leading lien resolution company that specializes in streamlining the lien process for personal injury law firms. We are looking for proactive, results-driven individuals to join our dynamic team.

Zipliens has grown through referrals and relationships. Now we're building a content engine that earns attention beyond them. As our Senior Content Specialist, you'll be an early member of a small, growing marketing team, reporting to the Director of Marketing and working side by side with product marketing, events, marketing operations, and design.

You'll drive how Zipliens shows up in search engines (SERPs and AI platforms) and in the resources law firms rely on: our SEO strategy and baseline, website content, the LinkedIn content calendar, blog posts, customer newsletters, and case studies. Lien resolution is technical (Medicare, Medicaid, ERISA, medical liens, subrogation), and your job is to turn that complexity into content that paralegals, case managers, and attorneys actually find, use, and trust.

You'll thrive here if you love both the craft of a sharp draft and the discipline of keyword research and performance data, enjoy pulling insight out of subject-matter experts, solving industry pain points through creative mediums, and want to build a content program from the ground up. The role is primarily hands-on writing and execution, with growing ownership of strategy and planning as the program grows.

Requirements

Responsibilities:

Build the SEO and content strategy

Establish an organic search baseline (traffic, impressions, rankings, branded vs. non-branded performance, top landing pages, backlinks, and technical health) before optimizing.
Partner with internal subject matter experts (SMEs) to develop and execute the keyword and topic strategy across lien resolution, Medicare, Medicaid, ERISA, medical liens, subrogation, settlement administration, and personal injury firm operations, balancing high-intent commercial terms with educational and long-tail searches.
Build and maintain the editorial/blog calendar, aligned to our ideal customer profile, product launches, and events.
Partner with marketing operations to connect organic visibility to qualified traffic, leads, and pipeline rather than traffic volume alone.

Create content that earns trust

Write and edit blog posts, guides, checklists, templates, FAQs, and reports that help personal injury law firm teams solve real lien resolution problems.
Partner with lien resolution SMEs, Customer Success, and company leadership to turn operational and regulatory knowledge into accurate, practical content.
Use Voice of the Customer (VOC) insights to develop customer case studies and spotlights that put proof behind our positioning, working with Product Marketing and Customer Success.
Support executive and employee thought leadership, including LinkedIn posts, bylines, and speaking abstracts.

jobs.title: FP&A Manager - Sales & Marketing and Revenue
jobs.description:
Description

Reporting to the Head of FP&A, you will be the primary finance business partner for the Company's US Sales & Marketing organization, working closely with a wide range of stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, and Market Access.

You will also oversee the Company's Gross-to-Net (GTN) revenue estimates and financial reporting. Most of the GTN modeling and data processing is outsourced to a specialized third-party provider (Integrichain / ICH); in this role, you will control, challenge, and validate the work performed by ICH rather than build or maintain the underlying models yourself.

Location
: Warren, New Jersey - minimum 3 days on site

Salary Range
: $140-160k

Key Responsibilities

FP&A / Business Partnering – Sales & Marketing (Priority #1):

Act as the lead finance business partner for US Sales & Marketing leadership, managing a wide range of stakeholders and moving parts across the organization.
Lead the annual budgeting, quarterly forecasting, and long-range planning processes for Sales & Marketing expenses.
Analyze trends and variances against budget/forecast, provide decision-support indicators, and identify risks and opportunities across all partnered functions.
Support senior leaders (VP Sales, VP Marketing, and Market Access) on investments, projects, contracts, and resource allocation decisions.
Challenge business owners on their forecasts and planning assumptions; ensure spend discipline and visibility across a broad and evolving set of partners.
Actively participate in the monthly and quarterly financial closing process for the Sales & Marketing scope.

Revenue & Gross-to-Net (GTN) – Oversight & Control

Oversee and control the Gross-to-Net (GTN) estimates and deliverables prepared by the Company's outsourced GTN provider (Integrichain / ICH), rather than building or maintaining the GTN models directly.
Review and challenge ICH's monthly and quarterly GTN accruals (rebates, chargebacks, discounts, returns, Medicaid/Medicare/340B, distribution and prompt-pay fees) for completeness and accuracy.
Act as the main internal point of contact with ICH, ensuring deliverables are timely, well-documented, and aligned with contract terms and business assumptions.
Monitor GTN ratios and deductions as a percentage of gross sales, flagging unexpected trends or variances to Accounting and senior Finance leadership.
Ensure GTN estimates and revenue recognition are compliant with US GAAP (ASC 606) and support internal/external audit requests.

Contribution To Financial Reporting

Contribute to the preparation of US GAAP financial disclosures (10-Q, 10-K) related to revenue, GTN reserves, and Sales & Marketing expenses during quarterly and annual closings.
Prepare management reporting packages and Board/Executive Committee materials on commercial and revenue performance.

Continuous Improvement

Contribute to the enhancement and automation of Sales & Marketing and GTN reporting and planning tools.
Integrate non-financial KPIs into financial models and management reporting.
Improve existing processes to strengthen the reliability, timeliness, and relevance of financial information.

Ensure internal control procedures (SOX) are properly implemented and maintained within the scope

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or Business Administration required; MBA, CPA, or CMA is a plus
Minimum 5–7 years of progressive FP&A or commercial finance experience, ideally within the biotech/pharmaceutical industry, including exposure to Sales & Marketing business partnering.

Behavioral skills :

A few years of experience as a manager (or senior analyst) within a Gross-to-Net (GTN) team is sufficient; deep GTN model-building expertise is not required, as most GTN activities are outsourced to a specialized third-party provider (Integrichain / ICH).
Experience managing or overseeing outsourced service providers / vendors is a plus.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with ERP/EPM systems (e.g., Dynamics, SAP, Oracle, Anaplan, Hyperion) required.
Working knowledge of US GAAP revenue recognition (ASC 606) and the main components of Gross-to-Net (rebates, chargebacks, discounts, Medicaid/Medicare/340B), sufficient to control and challenge third-party deliverables.
This is a high-exposure role requiring strong business partnering capabilities, with direct interaction with a broad and evolving set of stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, and Market Access functions.
Rigor, autonomy, responsiveness, and the ability to operate in a demanding, fast-paced environment with many moving parts are essential.
Strong analytical skills, ability to prioritize, proactive mindset, synthesis skills, and intellectual curiosity are key to success in this role.
Curiosity: Keep on exploring uncharted territories. Always ask “why?” and more importantly “why not?”,
Courage: Take smart risks, mentor each other to always do better & be accountable for our choices, our opinions, and our actions,
Collaboration: Teamwork and spirit. Support each other and be equally involved in the achievement of our common goals,
Credibility: Be transparent, follow through and build trust. Educate ourselves about our unique technology.

jobs.description:
Social Media Manager & Content Creator

Location: Valley Stream, NY

Schedule: 4 days per week in office | 1 day WFH

Salary: $75,000 per year

About Twillory

Twillory makes clothes that feel like nothing: dress shirts, suits, blazers, polos and pants built from breathable, stretchy performance fabric. We started in menswear, and this month we’re launching our first women’s line. You’ll be building content for both from day one.

We sell mostly online, have two stores in the New York area, and we’re growing fast. We want our social to look like it.

The role

We’re hiring someone who lives on social and can make content that doesn’t look like an ad. You’ll come up with the idea, shoot it, edit it yourself and post it. No waiting on an agency or an editor.

This is an on-camera role. Menswear is most of our business, so a big part of the job is being the face of it: wearing and styling our men’s shirts, suits and pants on camera every week.

You’ll own Twillory’s organic presence on Instagram and TikTok, and the content you make will also run as paid ads. If a video works organically, we’ll put money behind it. You’ll work closely with our creative and paid media team.

What you’ll do

Be on camera in our menswear.
Model and style our men’s line in your own content most weeks: try-ons, fit checks, get-ready-with-me, outfit breakdowns. You’re the guy in the videos as much as the one making them.
Make content every week.
Shoot and edit short-form video (Reels, TikToks, Stories) and photo posts that feel native to the feed: styling videos, try-ons, day-in-the-life, trends, street interviews, behind the scenes in our stores and studio.
Edit it yourself.
Take raw footage to a finished post in CapCut, Premiere or similar. Cuts, captions, sound, pacing, text on screen.
Run our accounts.
Plan and keep the content calendar, post consistently, write captions, and handle comments and DMs with personality.
Know what’s happening on social.
Spot trends, sounds and formats early and turn them into Twillory content the same week, not the next month.
Show the clothes looking good.
Different outfits, different places, real guys. Make a dress shirt look as cool on your feed as it does on a person.
Feed our ads.
Hand off your best organic content for paid, and make variations (new hooks, new openings) when something works.
Work with creators.
Help brief and direct UGC creators and influencers, including for the women’s line.
Learn from the numbers.
Track views, saves, shares, follower growth and watch time. Double down on what’s working and kill what isn’t.
Cover launches and moments.
New products, sales, store events and the women’s line launch.

Who you are

You’re comfortable modeling menswear on camera and do it regularly, in your own content or for brands. Your portfolio should show it.
You’re on TikTok and Instagram more than anyone you know, and you can explain why a video blew up.
You have a portfolio of content you shot and edited yourself: a personal account, a brand you’ve worked with, or both. We want to see it.
You edit fast and well. You don’t need someone else to finish your videos.
You’ve grown an account, or a piece of content, and can tell us how.
You’re comfortable with a phone, a ring light and a mic, and you know how to make good lighting out of a window.
You care about style and have taste. You know what looks cool and what looks like a catalog.
You’re comfortable directing other people on camera.
You move quickly, take feedback well, and can manage your own calendar without being chased.
2–3 years making social content for a brand, creator or agency, or the equivalent body of your own work.

Bonus points

Fashion, menswear or DTC ecommerce experience
You’ve made content that ran as a paid ad and know what makes an ad stop the scroll
Photography skills
Experience working with UGC creators or influencers
Comfortable with Adobe Premiere, After Effects or Lightroom on top of CapCut

How to apply:

Send your resume and links to 3–5 pieces of content you shot and edited yourself, including at least one where you’re on camera wearing menswear. Tell us in a sentence or two which one performed best and why you think it worked.

jobs.title: Senior Paid Media Manager
jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

Client Strategy & Relationships

Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

Paid Media Performance

Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

Copy & Creative Strategy

Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

Tracking & Funnel Execution

Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility
Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Experience

Financial services marketing
Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
Video sales letter marketing
High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
Performance marketing agency experience
Direct-response advertising

NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)
Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

Benefits

Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays
Training & Development
Work From Home
Flexible Schedule
Performance Bonus

Ashley Digital is the e-commerce engine behind Ashley Furniture Industries — one of the most recognized home brands in the world. As the world's largest manufacturer of home furnishings and the largest furniture store brand in North America, Ashley is in a category unto itself. Our team sits at the intersection of world-class retail and digital innovation, driving the e-commerce experience for millions of customers across every platform and touchpoint. If you've shopped online for a mattress in the last decade, there's a good chance you've already experienced our award-winning Nectar Sleep and DreamCloud. It's a rare combination: the energy of a tech company, the stability of an industry leader, and the opportunity to build something truly significant. jobs.title: Growth Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

Client Strategy & Relationships

Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

Paid Media Performance

Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

Copy & Creative Strategy

Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

Tracking & Funnel Execution

Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility
Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Experience

Financial services marketing
Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
Video sales letter marketing
High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
Performance marketing agency experience
Direct-response advertising

NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)
Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

Benefits

Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays
Training & Development
Work From Home
Flexible Schedule
Performance Bonus

We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

Client Strategy & Relationships

Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

Paid Media Performance

Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

Copy & Creative Strategy

Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

Tracking & Funnel Execution

Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility
Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Experience

Financial services marketing
Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
Video sales letter marketing
High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
Performance marketing agency experience
Direct-response advertising

Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

Client Strategy & Relationships

Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

Paid Media Performance

Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

Copy & Creative Strategy

Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

Tracking & Funnel Execution

Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility
Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Experience

Financial services marketing
Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
Video sales letter marketing
High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
Performance marketing agency experience
Direct-response advertising

NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)
Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

Benefits

Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays
Training & Development
Work From Home
Flexible Schedule
Performance Bonus

jobs.title: Americas Field Marketing, AI
jobs.description:
About Stripe

Stripe's infrastructure and suite of APIs powers hundreds of thousands of businesses—from startups to Fortune 500s—in almost every country around the world. From developers and product managers to founders and CFOs, a broad audience interacts with Stripe's products and uses them to start, run, and scale their companies. Removing the barriers to online commerce helps more new businesses get started, expedites growth for existing companies, and increases economic output and trade globally.

We operate at a significant scale, but we're still tiny relative to the opportunity ahead, so there is still much to do. Join us and help put the global economy within everyone's reach.

Role Overview

We're seeking an experienced, creative, and results-oriented marketer who knows the AI ecosystem to drive world-class field marketing for AI organizations in the Americas region. This field marketer will be responsible for executing marketing strategies that delivers growth and revenue at scale for AI businesses. The ideal candidate is data-driven, relentlessly seeks to optimize, stays at the cutting edge of modern marketing practices, and has a passion for collaborating with sales teams to drive successful customer outcomes. As a member of the Americas Marketing team, this is a great opportunity to build and have a significant impact on our rapidly growing business.

About The Team

The Americas Marketing team is a high-performing group laser-focused on fueling Stripe's expansion across the region. You'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact by building and optimizing programs and strategies. You'll collaborate closely with cross-functional partners in Sales, Product, Partnerships, and others to drive measurable business results and growth.

You Will

Execute the regional field marketing strategy and plan to fuel pipeline growth with the AI sales teams across the Americas

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. jobs.description:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 250 employees
while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D
at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About The Role

We're making our first CRO hire to own conversion at Suno, across web and the app stores. You'll sit on the Growth team at the point where our marketing spend turns into revenue: the landing pages, app store listings, funnels, and copy people hit after they click an ad, land from search, or find us in the App Store.

This is a performance job. You'll live in the numbers – conversion rate, install rate, CAC, revenue per visitor – and tie every test you run back to what it did for the business. You'll own the strategy and the copy, build pages and listings from our existing design system, and ship experiments at a pace that surprises people. You'll understand our ideal customer better than anyone in the building – who they are, what brings them to Suno, and what makes them convert — and shape every page, listing, and test around that.

You'll partner with User Acquisition, Lifecycle, Product, Engineering, and Data Science, and you'll work within our existing design system rather than in Figma yourself — grab a template, own the copy and the test, and ship. Conversion is yours to run. This is a senior IC role with real ownership and no team to manage. We want a hacker: someone scrappy and relentless who finds the fast path, ships more tests than anyone thinks is possible, and cares about learning fast and at scale more than about building the perfect system.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/vVeA30cOueLXfw8R

What You'll Do

Understand our ideal customer more deeply than anyone else here, and turn that into pages, listings, copy, and tests that actually speak to them
Ship a high volume of landing pages across paid, SEO, lifecycle, partnerships, and new launches, assembled from our existing design system and tailored to the channel and audience each serves
Own app store optimization: the listing copy, screenshots, and store creative that turn store visits into installs, and the handoff into onboarding
Localize and adapt pages and store listings for our international markets, so conversion holds up across languages and regions
Write persuasive, on-brand copy and build pages from our existing design components, then test your way to better versions fast
Run experiments at real volume: A/B and multivariate tests shipped quickly, using AI and whatever scrappy tooling gets you more shots on goal than the team could hit by hand
Dig into user behavior with heatmaps, session recordings, surveys, and analytics to find where people drop off and why
Hunt down the highest-leverage opportunities across the funnel by combining performance data, user research, and business context
Own the conversion numbers end to end across web and app: conversion rate, install rate, CAC, and revenue per visitor, paid and organic
Partner with Revenue Product on paywall and upsell copy, keeping it clear and true to what people are getting
Push conversion testing to a volume and speed Suno hasn't seen, and pull the rest of the company along with what you learn

Qualifications

You're a hacker. You move fast and ship a lot, and you've run a high volume of tests without a big team behind you
5-8 years in performance marketing, growth marketing, or CRO. You've owned conversion and funnel testing at scale, on the web and in the app stores (including ASO)
You can write. You've written landing page copy that actually converted, and you know the customer well enough to know what to say to them
You can read an experiment and know what it's telling you. We use Statsig internally, so you're comfortable pulling results, judging significance, and deciding what to do next
You know the landing page toolkit. You've built and tested pages in tools like Optimizely, VWO, or Unbounce, and watched behavior in Clarity or Hotjar
You set your own KPIs and run your own analysis. You can take user data and research and turn it into a test plan that ties back to the business
You use AI to get more done than one person normally could
You can tell a real win from a cheap trick, and you won't ship dark patterns. You work well with product and engineering and get changes live without slowing everyone down

Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US, and willing to work 5 days/week at our office in NYC or LA

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Who are we?

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing American companies since 2008.

About The Role

Smarsh is looking for a Senior Marketing Analyst to build the data foundation that marketing and go-to-market (GTM) teams run on — and that our AI tools will increasingly depend on. AI assistants and agents can only answer revenue questions reliably when the data model beneath them is clean, governed, and well defined. This role owns that layer for marketing: from source-system connectors and Snowflake, through dbt models and a governed semantic layer, to the dashboards, analysis, and AI-driven insight that leadership uses to make decisions.

You'll set the measurement and data roadmap, not just execute against it. You'll partner with Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, Sales/Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and IT/Data Architecture, and you'll be a trusted analytical partner to marketing and GTM leadership on planning, pipeline, and growth strategy.

How will you contribute?

AI-ready data foundation

Design and build an AI-ready data foundation for marketing and GTM: governed dbt models and a semantic layer (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, Omni) with consistent metric definitions that both people and AI tools can query.
Prioritize foundation domains in partnership with RevOps and IT — starting with marketing performance and attribution, and connecting to pipeline, account hierarchy, and customer retention data.
Build validation and testing frameworks (data tests, reconciliation checks, and accuracy evaluation of AI-generated answers) so AI assistants and agents return answers leadership can trust.
Partner with Marketing Operations and IT to deploy and improve AI tools (e.g., Claude, BI-native AI agents) that answer recurring marketing and pipeline questions in a self-serve way.

Data architecture & engineering

Own the marketing data architecture end to end: source-system connectors, ingestion into Snowflake, transformation logic, orchestration, and curated data models.
Build and maintain reliable pipelines (e.g., Salesforce, Marketo, Marketo Measure/Bizible, ABM, Google/LinkedIn/Bing Ads, sales engagement platforms) using ELT and orchestration tooling such as Fivetran and Airflow, with monitoring and documented SLAs.
Model account hierarchies and lead-to-account matching so marketing engagement rolls up correctly to accounts, buying groups, and opportunities.

Measurement, attribution & analytics

Own the design, governance, and evolution of marketing attribution (W-Shaped, Custom Model, and account-level influence), including documenting assumptions and limitations.
Lead ABM measurement: account engagement scoring, buying-group coverage, intent-to-pipeline conversion, and target-account progression.
Go beyond descriptive reporting — apply cohort analysis, funnel velocity, incrementality/test-and-control design, and forecasting to answer "what's working, and what should we do next?"
Analyze campaign and channel performance (organic search, paid search, paid social/ABM, display, email, events, field) and deliver prioritized recommendations on budget and program mix.

Strategy, reporting & stakeholder leadership

Partner with marketing and GTM leadership on annual planning, pipeline targets and coverage, growth strategy, and operating cadences, bringing the analysis that grounds those decisions.
Build and own executive-grade dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Looker, Tableau, Omni) reconciled against Salesforce and finance data, and own the analytics behind monthly/quarterly business reviews and QBRs.
Define and govern a single set of marketing metric definitions (MQL/MQA, SAL, pipeline sourced vs. influenced, CAC, ROI) and drive adoption across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.
Set and maintain the marketing analytics roadmap: prioritize requests, balance ad hoc work against foundational builds, and communicate trade-offs.

Data quality, governance & enablement

Establish data quality standards and automated checks across CRM, marketing automation, and the warehouse; fix root causes rather than patching symptoms.
Ensure marketing data and AI use align with Smarsh data privacy, security, and governance requirements in partnership with Legal, Security, and IT.
Mentor analysts and Marketing Operations teammates on SQL, dbt, data modeling, and responsible use of AI in analytics.

What will you bring?

5+ years of experience in GTM, marketing, or revenue operations analytics, or business intelligence, ideally in B2B SaaS or technology.
Advanced SQL and hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse (e.g., BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks), including designing data models, not just querying them.
Hands-on dbt experience building production-grade, tested, documented models.
Experience building or governing a semantic or metrics layer (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, Omni, or a BI-native equivalent).
Experience with ELT and orchestration tooling (e.g., Fivetran, Airflow, or similar).
Deep working knowledge of Salesforce data structures (leads, contacts, accounts, opportunities, campaigns, campaign members) and Marketo or a comparable marketing automation platform.
Expert BI skills in at least one major platform (e.g., Power BI, Looker, Tableau, Omni, Hex), including governed, self-serve dashboard design.
Proven experience designing and governing multi-touch attribution and ABM reporting, and explaining methodology and its limits to non-technical executives.
Practical, hands-on use of AI tools (e.g., Claude, Claude Code) in analytics work, and a clear point of view on what makes data AI-ready.
Track record of owning an analytics roadmap and influencing senior stakeholders with data.

jobs.description:
Shape the future with us. And also your own.

As a driver of innovation, Viega is one of the most important technology leaders in the installation industry. We develop intelligent systems and integrated digital solutions. More sustainable.
Support Us As

Social Media Strategist
Job-ID: 17724; Location(s): Broomfield CO

Job Summary

The Social Media Strategist is responsible for developing and executing Viega’s social media strategy across North America, using social channels to build brand awareness, strengthen audience engagement and bring Viega’s people, products and expertise to life. This position develops audience-focused social strategies, create compelling content and build thought leadership programs that elevate Viega’s expertise and industry presence. Partners with internal subject matter experts and cross-functional teams to uncover relevant stories, perspectives and opportunities that connect with Viega’s audiences
Responsibilities

Develops and executes Viega’s North American social media strategy, establishing audience, channel, content and engagement strategies aligned with business and marketing priorities.
Develops strategies to grow and engage Viega’s priority audiences across relevant social channels.
Develops and executes social thought leadership programs that strengthen Viega’s industry presence and showcase internal expertise.
Identifies and partners with internal subject matter experts to uncover perspectives, stories and expertise and translate them into authentic social content.
Coaches and supports subject matter experts and leaders in building their social presence and effectively engaging professional audiences.
Creates engaging social-first content, including copy, photography, interviews and short-form video.
Owns and manages Viega’s integrated social media calendar, balancing always-on content with campaigns, product initiatives, events and emerging opportunities.
Partners with Campaign Marketing to develop social strategies and content supporting integrated brand, segment and product campaigns.
Leads Viega’s influencer and creator marketing efforts, including identifying partners, developing activations and measuring performance.
Uses social listening, audience insights and industry trends to identify relevant conversations, content opportunities and emerging trends.
Builds and engages Viega’s social communities through proactive interaction with customers, industry organizations and partners.
Establishes and tracks social media KPIs, translating performance data into insights and recommendations to continuously improve strategy and content.

Proficient in the use of common office equipment and software – including, but not limited to: computers, printers, Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams, and PowerPoint
Effectively builds positive, productive relationships with colleagues, customers, vendors and others, contributing to a productive and welcoming work environment.

Strong interpersonal skills with demonstrated ability to effectively partner with key stakeholders and tactfully exercise influence across the organization
Demonstrates careful attention to detail, ensuring accuracy in all aspects of work.
Works effectively in a fast-paced and sometimes uncertain environment, making sound decisions based on best available information
Adept at identifying problems and finding effective solutions – requires critical thinking, creativity and solid facilitation skills.
Ability to work both independently and in a team environment, effectively collaborating with internal teams and other stakeholders.
Highly organized to manage multiple tasks, priorities, schedules, and documents effectively.
Takes initiative and proactively addresses needs.
Strong knowledge of B2B2C social media strategy, audience development, engagement and content best practices.
Strong understanding of social thought leadership and subject matter expert content development.
Excellent writing, interviewing, and storytelling skills.

Strategic and creative thinker with the ability to identify opportunities and proactively bring forward new ideas.

jobs.title: Walmart Search Marketing Associate Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

This high-visibility position will lead retail media search strategy and marketing for assigned retailers across the PepsiCo NA Commerce business. The associate will be hands-on-keyboard to develop, execute, and optimize retail media search campaigns in support of the full portfolio of PepsiCo brands. You will be a trusted thought partner with senior business stakeholders (marketing & sales), retail media networks, and data science teams to design and execute best in class retail media search marketing program, report on key metrics to deliver on how the channel is driving customer and business value. You will stand up reporting solutions that help stakeholders understand effectiveness of the channel and will develop and implement recommendations on how to improve business results. You will work directly with the customer, pressure-testing new capabilities, pushing for enhanced measurement, and designing novel tests toward foundational learnings. Your work will be critical to help improve the value driven through Digital Commerce platforms with retail media search being a significant portion of our marketing investment.

Responsibilities

Campaign execution:

Create & execute retail media search campaigns for Walmart, supporting the full PepsiCo portfolio of brands.
Optimize campaigns at regular cadence to hit key KPIs
Ensure deployment of best practices across all retail media search activities; communicate gaps and opportunities
Proactively seek out new opportunities to grow search campaigns via new campaign strategies and tactics, creative testing, landing page optimizations, enhanced automation tests, and keyword expansion
Liaise with cross functional teams (Sales, Marketing, digital/tech product, etc.) to build in-depth knowledge of business objectives, performance, and product mix to identify growth opportunities on retail media search
Develop retailer-specific search strategies that reflect differences in auction dynamics, onsite placements, and shopper behavior

Budget management:

Drive forecasting process across budgets, ensure pacing, adjustments and alignment to any budget changes, working closely with finance stakeholders and internal systems
Advocate for incremental investment, developing business cases outlining scenario outcomes and communicating opportunity cost trade-offs to senior stakeholders
Make investing decisions, considering budgetary allocation trade-offs across calendar and brands, proactively recommending shifts to drive optimal business outcomes

Retail media partnership:

Advocate for insightful measurement reporting beyond what is readily available
Co-build and pilot enhanced capabilities to optimize PepsiCo performance
Strong partnership on incrementality, lift, or causal measurement frameworks for retail media search, including designing statistically credible tests (hypothesis, success criteria, control conditions)

Reporting and optimization:

Develop and lead reporting framework with internal stake holders, proactively work with cross-functional teams to build and deliver reporting solutions
Test and measure automation capabilities and scale positive outcomes
Ideal candidate will have execution, testing and integration experience across the Skai ecosystem
Partnering with data science / analytics teams to evolve iROAS and value-based KPIs, not just platform ROAS

Compensation and Benefits:

The expected compensation range for this position is between $93,500 - $156,450.
Location, confirmed job-related skills, experience, and education will be considered in setting actual starting salary. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range during the hiring process.
Bonus based on performance and eligibility target payout is 10% of annual salary paid out annually.
Paid time off subject to eligibility, including paid parental leave, vacation, sick, and bereavement.
In addition to salary, PepsiCo offers a comprehensive benefits package to support our employees and their families, subject to elections and eligibility: Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, Health, and Dependent Care Reimbursement Accounts, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Insurance (Accident, Group Legal, Life), Defined Contribution Retirement Plan.

Qualifications

Desired Characteristics / Qualifications/Requirements:

Strong player/coach mentality, equally comfortable building and advocating for new strategies while also executing hands-on-keys in Search platforms
Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively at various levels of the organization, inclusive of senior marketing and sales leadership
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills
Results-oriented strategic thinker who demonstrates a bias for action with a can-do approach
Team player with the ability to excel in an agile, collaborative, ambiguous environment
Ability to multitask and handle other duties as assigned
Comfort navigating highly complex and matrix organizations
Accountability and management of large-scale budgets
Be able to communicate business requirements to translate to platform/product priorities and actions
Flexibility to sometimes work around tentpole retailer events and activations
Comfort working with raw data extracts

Minimum Qualifications

4+ years' experience in running retail media search campaigns (e.g. Amazon Ads, Walmart Connect, Kroger Precision Marketing, Instacart Ads, Criteo Search). 2+ years owning direct customer/retailer facing leadership and with accountability to investment and business results
Prior experience with automation platforms (e.g Skai, Pacvue)
Expertise with Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, advanced formulas) , Word, and PowerPoint is required
Experience with within an agency environment highly desired

EEO Statement

Our Company will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Fair Credit Reporting Act, and all other applicable laws, including but not limited to, San Francisco Police Code Sections 4901-4919, commonly referred to as the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance; and Chapter XVII, Article 9 of the Los Angeles Municipal Code, commonly referred to as the Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.
