At Peak Performance Physical Therapy, your work matters to your patients, your team, and your future. We’re committed to helping you reach your highest potential through mentorship, collaboration, and a culture built on compassion and excellence.

Who We are

A People-First Culture

Our story began with a simple belief: when people feel supported, they thrive. As part of a family of clinics dedicated to professional growth, clinical excellence, and real human connection, we foster an environment where you’re valued, encouraged, and empowered to do meaningful work daily.

Our Purpose

Empowering lives through evidence-informed care

Our mission is to help people move freely, feel better, and live fully. Every member of our team contributes to breaking down barriers to care through prevention, education, and long-term recovery strategies. If you’re passionate about making a real difference, you’ll feel at home here.

Director of Sales and Marketing

Company:

Peak Performance Physical Therapy

Position Type:

Full-Time, Exempt

Reports To:

Chief Financial Operations Officer

Position Overview

The Director of Sales and Marketing is responsible for driving patient acquisition, building brand awareness, and growing revenue across Peak Performance Physical Therapy's Greater Lansing locations.

This position will develop and execute sales and marketing strategies to increase patient referrals, strengthen physician and community relationships, and position Peak Performance as the premier orthopedic and manual physical therapy provider in mid-Michigan.

Approximately 60% of the role will focus on sales and marketing, with the remaining 40% spent treating patients as a physical therapist at our Lansing clinic (two days per week).

The ideal candidate combines clinical knowledge, strong relationship-building skills, an entrepreneurial mindset, and a passion for growing the business while delivering excellent patient care.

This is a hands-on leadership role. The Director will be responsible for developing Peak's sales and marketing strategy and personally executing key elements of that strategy.

Key Responsibilities

Referral Development & Relationship Management

Develop and manage a structured outreach program to physician practices, orthopedic surgeons, sports medicine providers, and other referral sources across the Greater Lansing area.
Build and maintain strong, lasting relationships with referring providers, their office staff, and key healthcare system contacts to drive consistent and growing patient referral volume.
Track referral source data, identify growth opportunities, and develop action plans to expand and diversify the referral network across all clinic locations.
Represent Peak Performance at healthcare community events, networking functions, and professional associations throughout mid-Michigan.
Conduct regular scheduled visits to high-priority referral sources and maintain a contact management system for all referral relationships and outreach activities.

Digital Marketing & Brand Management

Develop and execute Peak Performance’s digital marketing strategy, including website content, search engine optimization (SEO), Google Ads, and social media channels across all locations.
Manage the company’s online reputation, including Google Business profiles for each clinic location, patient review platforms, and brand consistency across all digital touchpoints.
Create and distribute content that educates prospective patients, engages referring providers, and reinforces Peak Performance’s clinical expertise and patient outcomes.
Coordinate with external vendors, designers, or agencies as needed for creative, digital, or media production support.
Ensure consistent brand standards, messaging, and visual identity across all locations, marketing materials, and digital channels.

Patient Acquisition & Market Growth

Identify and capitalize on market opportunities to grow new patient volume across all Peak Performance locations in the Greater Lansing area.
Develop and execute community outreach initiatives, clinic sponsorships, health fairs, employer wellness partnerships, and athletic team or league relationships.
Collaborate with clinical directors and front desk teams at each location to optimize the patient experience from first contact through initial visit conversion.
Track new patient sources, marketing campaign performance, and conversion metrics to evaluate ROI and continuously improve strategy.

Marketing Operations & Reporting

Manage the marketing budget effectively, allocating resources to highest-impact channels and activities.
Develop and maintain marketing calendars, campaign plans, and promotional materials for all locations.
Provide regular performance reports to the CFOO, including new patient volume trends, referral source analysis, digital marketing metrics, and campaign results.
Coordinate internal communications, seasonal promotions, and announcements that support clinical team engagement and patient communication.
Evaluate marketing technology platforms, tools, and systems to improve efficiency and measurement.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities Of Physical Therapist

Evaluate patients, identify physical impairments, and develop individualized treatment plans.
Provide evidence-based therapeutic interventions to improve strength, mobility, balance, coordination, and functional abilities.
Educate patients and families on therapeutic exercises, home exercise programs, and injury prevention.
Monitor patient progress, modify treatment plans as needed, and document care accurately in accordance with regulatory requirements and organizational policies.
Collaborate with healthcare professionals to coordinate care and optimize patient outcomes.
Maintain current clinical knowledge, participate in professional development and team meetings, and adhere to ethical standards and patient confidentiality requirements.
Deliver exceptional patient service while fostering a positive, respectful, and supportive care environment.

Qualifications

Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) degree from an accredited physical therapy program.
Current, unrestricted Michigan Physical Therapist license, or eligibility to obtain licensure before beginning clinical responsibilities.
Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the ability to develop productive relationships with physicians, healthcare providers, community partners, and prospective patients.
Demonstrated initiative, entrepreneurial mindset, and interest in business development, sales, and marketing.
Experience or familiarity with digital marketing, social media, referral development, and healthcare marketing strategies preferred.
Ability to develop and execute sales and marketing initiatives, measure results, and adjust strategies to improve performance.

Relationship Building

Market Awareness

Execution & Initiative

Communication

Data-Driven Decision Making

Adaptability

Work Environment

Multi-location environment; regular travel between Peak Performance clinic locations and to referral source offices throughout the Greater Lansing area.
Combination of office-based work and field-based outreach activities; schedule flexibility required to accommodate referral visits, community events, and internal meetings.
Collaborative culture with close partnership between marketing, clinical leadership, and front desk operations.
Valid Michigan driver’s license and reliable transportation required.

Ability to sit, stand in place, walk, twist (knees/waist/neck), climb, push/pull and lift objects of various weights of up to 50 pounds

We are seeking a customer-obsessed, experienced Senior Product Manager to lead sales and marketing for Echo devices. If you have passion for tech and commercial strategy, come build with us.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will lead the Sales strategy for a subset of Echo products and work with a cross-functional team including product development, demand planning, in-stock, finance, retailers, merchandising, and advertising to develop and execute a multi-year plan to grow the Echo business. You will be a critical part of the team and develop annual, quarterly, and monthly sales strategies to maximize unit sales as well as profit and revenue. jobs.title: Senior Marketing Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Who are we?

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing American companies since 2008.

About The Role

Smarsh is looking for a Senior Marketing Analyst to build the data foundation that marketing and go-to-market (GTM) teams run on — and that our AI tools will increasingly depend on. AI assistants and agents can only answer revenue questions reliably when the data model beneath them is clean, governed, and well defined. This role owns that layer for marketing: from source-system connectors and Snowflake, through dbt models and a governed semantic layer, to the dashboards, analysis, and AI-driven insight that leadership uses to make decisions.

You'll set the measurement and data roadmap, not just execute against it. You'll partner with Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, Sales/Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and IT/Data Architecture, and you'll be a trusted analytical partner to marketing and GTM leadership on planning, pipeline, and growth strategy.

How will you contribute?

AI-ready data foundation

Design and build an AI-ready data foundation for marketing and GTM: governed dbt models and a semantic layer (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, Omni) with consistent metric definitions that both people and AI tools can query.
Prioritize foundation domains in partnership with RevOps and IT — starting with marketing performance and attribution, and connecting to pipeline, account hierarchy, and customer retention data.
Build validation and testing frameworks (data tests, reconciliation checks, and accuracy evaluation of AI-generated answers) so AI assistants and agents return answers leadership can trust.
Partner with Marketing Operations and IT to deploy and improve AI tools (e.g., Claude, BI-native AI agents) that answer recurring marketing and pipeline questions in a self-serve way.

Data architecture & engineering

Own the marketing data architecture end to end: source-system connectors, ingestion into Snowflake, transformation logic, orchestration, and curated data models.
Build and maintain reliable pipelines (e.g., Salesforce, Marketo, Marketo Measure/Bizible, ABM, Google/LinkedIn/Bing Ads, sales engagement platforms) using ELT and orchestration tooling such as Fivetran and Airflow, with monitoring and documented SLAs.
Model account hierarchies and lead-to-account matching so marketing engagement rolls up correctly to accounts, buying groups, and opportunities.

Measurement, attribution & analytics

Own the design, governance, and evolution of marketing attribution (W-Shaped, Custom Model, and account-level influence), including documenting assumptions and limitations.
Lead ABM measurement: account engagement scoring, buying-group coverage, intent-to-pipeline conversion, and target-account progression.
Go beyond descriptive reporting — apply cohort analysis, funnel velocity, incrementality/test-and-control design, and forecasting to answer "what's working, and what should we do next?"
Analyze campaign and channel performance (organic search, paid search, paid social/ABM, display, email, events, field) and deliver prioritized recommendations on budget and program mix.

Strategy, reporting & stakeholder leadership

Partner with marketing and GTM leadership on annual planning, pipeline targets and coverage, growth strategy, and operating cadences, bringing the analysis that grounds those decisions.
Build and own executive-grade dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Looker, Tableau, Omni) reconciled against Salesforce and finance data, and own the analytics behind monthly/quarterly business reviews and QBRs.
Define and govern a single set of marketing metric definitions (MQL/MQA, SAL, pipeline sourced vs. influenced, CAC, ROI) and drive adoption across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.
Set and maintain the marketing analytics roadmap: prioritize requests, balance ad hoc work against foundational builds, and communicate trade-offs.

Data quality, governance & enablement

Establish data quality standards and automated checks across CRM, marketing automation, and the warehouse; fix root causes rather than patching symptoms.
Ensure marketing data and AI use align with Smarsh data privacy, security, and governance requirements in partnership with Legal, Security, and IT.
Mentor analysts and Marketing Operations teammates on SQL, dbt, data modeling, and responsible use of AI in analytics.

What will you bring?

5+ years of experience in GTM, marketing, or revenue operations analytics, or business intelligence, ideally in B2B SaaS or technology.
Advanced SQL and hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse (e.g., BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks), including designing data models, not just querying them.
Hands-on dbt experience building production-grade, tested, documented models.
Experience building or governing a semantic or metrics layer (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, Omni, or a BI-native equivalent).
Experience with ELT and orchestration tooling (e.g., Fivetran, Airflow, or similar).
Deep working knowledge of Salesforce data structures (leads, contacts, accounts, opportunities, campaigns, campaign members) and Marketo or a comparable marketing automation platform.
Expert BI skills in at least one major platform (e.g., Power BI, Looker, Tableau, Omni, Hex), including governed, self-serve dashboard design.
Proven experience designing and governing multi-touch attribution and ABM reporting, and explaining methodology and its limits to non-technical executives.
Practical, hands-on use of AI tools (e.g., Claude, Claude Code) in analytics work, and a clear point of view on what makes data AI-ready.
Track record of owning an analytics roadmap and influencing senior stakeholders with data.
Excellent written and verbal communication; able to turn complex analysis into a concise business narrative.

Bonus Skills & Experience

Experience building or evaluating AI agents or LLM-based assistants that answer business questions over a governed data model, including accuracy testing.
Python or R for statistical analysis, automation, or modeling (e.g., forecasting, propensity, marketing mix or incrementality analysis).
Experience with Marketo Measure (Bizible) at an administrator or model-design level.
Familiarity with the broader GTM data ecosystem: sales engagement and conversation intelligence (e.g., Salesloft, Outreach, Gong), data enrichment and hygiene (e.g., Clay, RingLead), ABM/intent platforms, and product analytics (e.g., Heap, Amplitude).
Experience supporting annual planning, territory design, pipeline coverage modeling, or retention KPIs.
Experience in a regulated industry (financial services, healthcare, or similar) where data accuracy and auditability are especially important.
Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Business, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

$106,000 - $141,000 a year

The above salary range represents Smarsh's good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible base compensation at the time of posting. Any applicable bonus programs will be discussed during the recruiting process.

The salary for this role will be set based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, internal equity, experience, education, location, specialty and training.

Local cost of living assessments are done for each new hire at the time of offer.

About Our Culture

Smarsh hires lifelong learners with a passion for innovating with purpose, humility and humor. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We work closely with the most popular communications platforms and the world’s leading cloud infrastructure platforms. We use the latest in AI/ML technology to help our customers break new ground at scale. We are a global organization that values diversity, and we believe that providing opportunities for everyone to be their authentic self is key to our success. Smarsh leadership, culture, and commitment to developing our people have all garnered Comparably.com Best Places to Work Awards. Come join us and find out what the best work of your career looks like.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Marketing Manager, Robot Vacuum
jobs.description:
Description

About Us:

Headquartered in the United States, TP-Link Systems Inc. is a global provider of reliable networking devices and smart home products, consistently ranked as the world’s top provider of Wi-Fi devices. The company is committed to delivering innovative products that enhance people’s lives through faster, more reliable connectivity. With a commitment to excellence, TP-Link serves customers in over 170 countries and continues to grow its global footprint.

We believe technology changes the world for the better! At TP-Link Systems Inc, we are committed to crafting dependable, high-performance products to connect users worldwide with the wonders of technology.

Embracing professionalism, innovation, excellence, and simplicity, we aim to assist our clients in achieving remarkable global performance and enable consumers to enjoy a seamless, effortless lifestyle.

About The Role

The Sr. Product Marketing Manager, Robot Vacuums, will own the go-to-market strategy, positioning, and content execution for TP-Link’s robot vacuum portfolio within the Smart Home division. Reporting directly to the Director of Product Marketing – Smart Home, this role is a high-impact, category-focused position that requires an operator who can think like a brand builder and act like an owner.

The right candidate will bring deep knowledge of the robot vacuum category, a sharp instinct for what motivates consumers, and the creative ability to transform technical specifications into compelling, moments-based stories that drive purchase. TP-Link’s robot vacuums compete in one of the fastest-growing segments of the smart home market – this person will be the driving force behind how we position, message, and market our products, and a key contributor to taking market share from SharkNinja, Ecovac, Eufy, Roborock, Wyze, and Dreame.

A Note On Experience

Prior hands-on product marketing experience in the robot vacuum or floor care category is highly desirable and candidates who have marketed robot vacuums – including knowledge of navigation technology, self-empty systems, mop/vac combos, and Matter compatibility – will be prioritized. Equally essential is the demonstrated ability to write world-class consumer copy: translating technical specs such as LiDAR navigation, suction Pa ratings, and auto-empty docks into emotionally resonant, moments-based language that speaks to real consumer life. We also place high value on idea generation – we want someone who brings differentiated campaign concepts, sharp naming instincts, and a creative point of view that helps TP-Link stand out in a crowded category.

Key Responsibilities

Product Positioning, Naming, and Messaging

Own the positioning and messaging architecture for TP-Link’s full robot vacuum portfolio – from entry-level models to premium self-empty and mop-combo systems.
Develop moments-based copy that connects product capabilities to real consumer life situations: clean floors before guests arrive, mornings without chores, homes that clean themselves.
Translate technical specifications – suction power, navigation precision, obstacle avoidance, dock auto-empty – into clear, differentiated consumer benefits that drive purchase intent.
Build and maintain naming frameworks and messaging hierarchies consistent across retail, digital, social, and in-box materials.
Partner with the Director of Product Marketing to align robot vacuum messaging with the broader Smart Home brand narrative and Tapo brand architecture.

Go-to-Market Strategy and Execution

Lead GTM planning for all robot vacuum product launches – from feature brief to retail execution – in coordination with product management, sales, and creative teams.
Build coordinated launch frameworks covering product messaging, creative direction, media strategy, retail assets, and Amazon listing optimization.
Develop creative retail, web and packaging assets that will help differentiate our category in the robot vacuum market.
Ensure all launch activities are data-driven, consumer-informed, and aligned with sales and channel objectives.
Coordinate with retail partners including Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart, Costco, and Target on content, promotional windows, and sell-in materials.

Product Feature Prioritization and Content Creation

Lead the creation of all robotic vacuum product content: web copy, product detail pages, Amazon A+ content, retail assets, setup videos, explainer videos, and social-ready creative.
Brief and manage creative partners, agencies, and in-house teams to produce high-quality video and visual assets that bring the product to life.
Ensure all content reflects the voice of the customer and clearly communicates differentiated value at every touchpoint – Amazon search, Google organic, retail shelf, and social.
Generate original concepts for campaigns, hero moments, and product storytelling that differentiate TP-Link from SharkNinja, Ecovac, Eufy, Roborock, Wyze, and Dreame in the consumer’s mind.
Collaborate with Product Management to influence feature prioritization based on consumer insights, market trends, and competitive research – particularly around AI navigation, smart home integration, and Matter compatibility.

Brand Awareness, Consideration, and Conversion

Develop marketing strategies that elevate TP-Link’s presence in the robot vacuum market and strengthen consumer engagement across the full funnel.
Execute awareness and conversion campaigns across digital, paid, retail, and social channels.
Leverage analytics and consumer data to optimize the customer journey and maximize conversion rates.
Create and manage programs that deepen customer engagement throughout the product lifecycle, including Tapo Care subscription acquisition and retention.

Competitive Intelligence and Consumer Insights

Maintain a deep, current understanding of the robot vacuum competitive landscape: pricing tiers, product roadmaps, messaging strategies, and market share trends.
Track consumer sentiment, product reviews, and community feedback to identify messaging gaps, product pain points, and differentiation opportunities.
Translate competitive intelligence into actionable positioning recommendations that keep TP-Link ahead of the market.

Community Management and Social Engagement

Partner with Digital and Social teams to strengthen TP-Link’s community presence in the robot vacuum category across social platforms, forums, and review channels.
Support influencer marketing, creator programs, and ambassador initiatives to generate authentic engagement and word-of-mouth visibility.
Monitor sentiment and community insights to guide ongoing messaging improvements and campaign refinement.

PR, Digital Marketing, SEO, EDM, and Influencer Collaboration

Drive collaboration across PR, digital, and influencer channels to promote robot vacuum product launches and sustain visibility.
Own Amazon product listing strategy for the robot vacuum category: title optimization, bullet points, A+ content, backend keywords, and Brand Store architecture.
Manage SEO strategy for robot vacuum pages on tplink.com and tapo.com, ensuring product pages are discoverable, conversion-optimized, and current.
Manage coordination of email (EDM), SEO, and influencer campaigns to support ongoing product promotion and brand growth.

Requirements

Qualifications:

8+ years of product marketing experience in consumer electronics, smart home, or IoT technology industries, required.
Demonstrated ability to write compelling consumer copy – web copy, product descriptions, campaign concepts – that converts browsers into buyers.
Proven track record of translating complex technical features into clear, benefit-driven, moments-based consumer language.
Deep understanding of market insights and user research; and how it can be used to improve product launches.
Experience owning or significantly contributing to product launch planning and go-to-market execution from brief to live.
Strong understanding of Amazon marketing, A+ content, retail content strategy, and e-commerce channel management.
Experience managing agencies.
Proven success leading cross-functional marketing initiatives from concept to execution.
Deep understanding of consumer behavior, market trends, and competitive dynamics in the robot vacuum and connected home space.
Experience managing digital marketing, retail, and e-commerce programs preferred.
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field required; MBA preferred.

Highly Desirable

Direct product marketing experience in the robot vacuum category – SharkNinja, Ecovac, Eufy, Roborock, Wyze, and Dreame or a comparable brand. Candidates with this background will be prioritized.
Deep knowledge of robot vacuum technology: LiDAR vs. camera navigation, suction Pa ratings, self-empty base systems, mopping systems, obstacle avoidance, and smart home integrations.
Ability to generate breakthrough marketing ideas that create measurable business impact – differentiated campaign concepts, sharp naming instincts, and a creative point of view that makes TP-Link stand out, not just show up.
Understanding of the Matter smart home standard and how it affects product positioning and consumer messaging.
Experience managing Amazon Sponsored Products campaigns, A+ content, and Brand Store optimization.
Experience working with a global brand.

Benefits

Base salary with a structured commissions with significant earning potential above base salary.
Fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance (partial coverage for dependents)
Contributions to 401k funds (Quarterly Employer Contributions)

11 paid holidays

jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Lifetime Brands is looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own lifecycle marketing strategy across our portfolio of direct-to-consumer brands, including PlanetBox, S'well, Year & Day, Mikasa, Pfaltzgraff, Fitz & Floyd, Fred & Friends, and others. This role sets the roadmap for email, SMS, loyalty, referral, and reviews across our DTC brand portfolio, owns the underlying platform architecture in Klaviyo and Yotpo, and builds the reporting that tells leadership the story of how lifecycle is performing.
This role will be the strategic and technical anchor our brand teams work through, setting priorities, building the systems and playbooks, and driving alignment across seven brands. The ideal candidate is a strong strategist and hands-on platform owner who is equally comfortable configuring a Klaviyo flow themselves and getting a brand marketer who doesn't report to them to execute against a shared roadmap on deadline.

What you'll do:

Lifecycle Strategy & Cross-Brand Coordination (35%)

Own end-to-end lifecycle marketing strategy across all DTC brands, tailoring journeys to each brand's customer base, tone, and product cadence
Build and maintain a shared lifecycle playbook and testing framework that scales across the portfolio without flattening brand distinctiveness
Set priorities and drive execution through each brand's digital marketing team, who owns day-to-day campaign execution; align teams with competing launch calendars and business priorities.
Serve as the go-to resource on lifecycle strategy and platform capability for brand teams

Klaviyo Platform Ownership (25%)

Own platform architecture, segmentation strategy, and automation design in Klaviyo across all brands
Build and refine automated programs including welcome, abandoned cart, browse abandonment, post-purchase, replenishment, win-back, VIP, and sunset flows, in partnership with brand marketers on execution
Set and govern A/B testing standards and deliverability practices across seven brand sending domains
Troubleshoot and resolve platform-level issues brand marketers can't solve on their own

Yotpo: Loyalty, Referral & Reviews (20%)

Own configuration, feature rollouts, and ongoing optimization of Yotpo Loyalty, Referral, and Reviews across the brand portfolio
Design and iterate on loyalty program mechanics and referral incentive structures per brand
Manage the review generation strategy and integrate review content into lifecycle and onsite experiences
Stay current on Yotpo's feature roadmap and evaluate new capabilities for adoption

Reporting & Executive Communication (20%)

Build recurring reporting that clearly tells the story of lifecycle performance across the portfolio: retention, repeat purchase rate, CLTV, and program-level revenue contribution, by brand and in aggregate
Translate performance data into a clear narrative and prioritized recommendations for the SVP of Digital
Track and report on Yotpo program health: loyalty enrollment, referral conversion, and review volume and sentiment

What you'll need:

6 to 9 years of hands-on lifecycle, CRM, or retention marketing experience, ideally with multi-brand or multi-portfolio ownership
Deep, hands-on Klaviyo expertise: flows, segmentation, A/B testing, deliverability management at the platform-architecture level, not just campaign execution
Hands-on experience with Yotpo (or a comparable loyalty/referral/reviews platform), including configuration and feature adoption
Proven ability to drive execution cross functionally, across multiple distributed brand teams with competing priorities
Strong project management instincts: you keep seven brands' worth of moving pieces organized without anything slipping
Proven ability to build reporting that a senior leader can act on without follow-up questions
Experience in DTC, ecommerce, or consumer products preferred

Salary:
$95,000 - $100,000

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Strategist
jobs.description:
About Sumeru Sumeru is a leading global IT and marketing consulting services company headquartered in Los Angeles. We turn bold ideas into impact through strategy rooted in customer insight, fueled by innovation and technology. Our vision is to help brands earn a lasting place in their customers' hearts by personalizing every experience in real time.
In our Digital Customer Experience practice, agency and technology teams work side by side, bringing strategy, creative, technology and analytics under one roof so clients work with a single partner. Our strategists and creatives lead omnichannel, campaign and content strategy and experience design, using data and AI to personalize at scale. We serve clients across industries, from healthcare and education to retail and finance, and measure success by business results.
We partner with Salesforce, SAP, AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft and ServiceNow. Our inclusive culture is built on curiosity, commitment, joy, belonging and awareness, and on the belief that human excellence guided by good intentions creates real impact.

Your impact As lead strategist on a Fortune 100 healthcare client's omnichannel engagement program, you'll own the strategy and be accountable for its performance, driving acquisition, retention and lifetime value across email, SMS, app, web and landing pages.
You'll help the client deliver personalized, real-time engagement across channels and connect customer journeys and data across systems, so every interaction moves the business forward.

Who you'll work with You'll join Sumeru's Digital Customer Experience practice in Los Angeles, working within the client-facing front-end team of strategy and creative. You'll own the strategy and ensure the creative delivers on it, collaborating closely with our marketing technology, CRM and analytics teams and the client's brand, digital and medical/legal/regulatory stakeholders.

What you'll do Strategy and client partnership

•     Serve as a primary strategic counterpart to the client, from brand managers to director-level stakeholders, and lead strategy workshops on site and remote.
•     Build the annual omnichannel roadmap with clear KPIs, in partnership with Sumeru's account manager.
•     Align each project strategy with Sumeru's account manager before presenting it to client stakeholders for approval.
Customer experience and journeys

•     Own the end-to-end customer messaging strategy across lifecycle, transactional and engagement communications, so every interaction is timely, personalized, compliant and aligned to business outcomes.
•     Design lifecycle journeys from acquisition and onboarding through retention, grounded in journey mapping, personas and segmentation.
•     Define personalization strategy with the CRM and data analytics teams: tailored content, next-best-action and offers by segment.
Campaign strategy and creative alignment

•     Own campaign strategy and content strategy for unified omnichannel campaigns across email, SMS, app, web and landing pages, and partner with the marketing technology team on channel-level implementation.
•     Translate campaign strategy into clear content and creative briefs, review creative work against the brief and client feedback, and confirm it's aligned with the strategy before client presentation.
•     Steer work through the client's medical/legal/regulatory review without losing pace or quality.
Measurement and optimization

•     Define KPIs with the analytics team and use reporting and attribution insights to drive optimization that continuously improves engagement, conversion and ROI.
•     Run a structured testing program and act on audit findings across targeting, messaging, creative and cadence.
•     Present performance and recommendations to client stakeholders, and bring the client new ideas from emerging martech and AI trends.

What you bring •     6+ years in digital marketing strategy, with at least 3 years as lead strategist on enterprise accounts.
•     Strategy ownership on a Fortune 500 or comparable enterprise account, including presenting to senior client stakeholders.
•     Proven omnichannel and lifecycle CRM work across email, SMS, app and web, with retention or LTV results you can quantify.
•     Hands-on expertise in customer journey mapping, customer marketing maturity assessment, omnichannel marketing, personalization, measurement and ROI, and contextual marketing.
•     Ability to translate strategy into clear requirements for technology and analytics teams, with working knowledge of marketing automation, CRM, first-party data and privacy-compliant personalization.
•     Excellent written and spoken English, strong copy judgment and a sharp eye for design quality, backed by a bachelor's degree in marketing, advertising, communications or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Nice to have •     Experience in a regulated industry, ideally healthcare, pharma or medical device, including work through compliance or medical/legal/regulatory review.
•     Familiarity with HIPAA and patient-data privacy as they apply to CRM marketing.
•     Experience with an enterprise marketing automation platform such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe or Braze.
•     Experience applying AI to personalization, content production or analytics.
•     Agency background on enterprise accounts.

What success looks like •      First 90 days:
you know the account's key strategies and the program's journeys, KPIs and stakeholders, and have delivered an audit with prioritized recommendations.
•      First 6 months:
you lead strategy on assigned campaigns and secure client approval on schedule.
•      First year:
acquisition, retention and engagement KPIs have measurably improved, and the testing program produces learnings that shape the next year's plan.

Your growth and benefits You'll gain senior client exposure on a Fortune 100 account, with room to expand your scope as the account grows. Sumeru invests in professional growth and development at every level.
•     A benefits package, including health coverage and paid time off
•     Access to current martech and AI tools
•     Collaboration with diverse, talented teams

jobs.title: Product Marketing Senior Manager
jobs.description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What You’ll Be Doing…

As a Product Marketing Senior Manager, you will provide support for Verizon Business Group’s Advanced Solutions product portfolio. This portfolio is designed to provide high-performance network solutions to support the connectivity and applications our customers are implementing globally. Within the marketing organization, you’ll act as the single point of contact and subject matter expert for products within the Advanced Solutions portfolio and assist with strategy formulation, collateral creation, review, and any other needed activities to support the success of the product set.

Additionally, you will also serve as the product and portfolio marketing lead working with the Product Management organization. You will be responsible in partnership and collaboration with product, segment marketing, sales, and solutions architects to develop product/portfolio value proposition, customer outcome/benefits, VBG’s market differentiation, and the channel and digital activation strategy.

Leveraging market data and insights, Verizon base customer and prospect analytics, customer persona types and other information to develop the appropriate launch strategy for new and existing products.
Partnering with Product Management, Sales, Sales Architects, Sales Operations, Field Marketing, Go-to-Market, and other marketing partners.
Playing a central role in strengthening our brand and executing on our product marketing plans by conducting independent marketing research, developing marketing plans, and creating high quality customer collateral and product assets, using segmented value propositions.
Developing compelling, differentiated positioning to accelerate revenues and bookings for our products.
Developing and executing marketing strategies to drive growth and retention across Global Enterprise, Public Sector, and Business Markets.
Strengthening our brand, defending revenues, and driving new sales by developing marketing strategies with compelling and differentiated positioning to accelerate revenues and bookings.
Collaborating with partner teams to promote cross sell/upsell opportunities and reinforce cross-portfolio messaging to ensure sales motion includes selling comprehensive solutions to build loyalty.
Overseeing project management related to product launches and other marketing activities with the goal of accelerating revenue and improving services to our customers as well as results for Verizon.

What We’re Looking For...

You are a highly collaborative, innovative, and strategic thinker with a deep understanding of wireline and wireless networks. You are equally comfortable leading teams focused on strategy and teams focused on execution and project delivery. You are an expert communicator who can deliver a message across stakeholder teams.

You’ll Need To Have

Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
Product Marketing/Strategy experience using market research and/ or data analytics.
Experience with Marketing collateral and/or Sales Enablement creation and execution.
Willingness to travel.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

A Master’s degree.
Product lifecycle and/ or product placement experience.
Strategic consulting with a business development and marketing focus.
Experience using AI tools.
Strong project management, analytical, problem-solving, interpersonal, communication, negotiating, and relationship-building skills.
Experience with wireline connectivity products and understanding of voice connectivity solutions and strategic connectivity products (network connectivity products).
Experience with AI tools.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits And Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $105,000.00 - $201,000.00.

The annual salary range for the Illinois location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $115,500.00 - $201,000.00.

jobs.description:
Our client in the healthcare space is seeking a FULL-TIME Senior Product Marketing Manager - Solutions and Services
. This is a hybrid role that must be onsite three days a week in either Irving, TX; Edina, MN; Chicago, IL; or Centennial, CO.
The Senior Product Marketing Manager, Solutions & Services will lead go-to-market strategy, positioning, messaging, and commercialization for a portfolio of complex solutions, services, and enterprise offerings. This role is responsible for transforming expertise, consulting capabilities, data and analytics, technology, AI-enabled solutions, and other specialized offerings into differentiated, market-ready products and services that drive awareness, adoption, pipeline growth, revenue, and customer value.
The ideal Senior Product Marketing Manager is an experienced product, solutions, or services marketer who excels at translating complex capabilities into clear market narratives, compelling value propositions, and scalable commercialization strategies. This role will work cross-functionally with business leaders, subject matter experts, delivery teams, sales, account management, and marketing to bring offerings to market and accelerate growth.
Senior Product Marketing Manager - Solutions and Services Responsibilities:

Develop and execute comprehensive go-to-market strategies for solutions, services, portfolios, and enterprise offerings.
Define target markets, customer segments, buyer personas, use cases, value propositions, and expected client outcomes.
Build commercialization plans that support awareness, pipeline generation, revenue growth, and customer adoption.
Lead offering launches and commercialization initiatives, ensuring alignment across stakeholders and readiness across customer-facing teams.
Evaluate launch effectiveness and continuously optimize go-to-market execution based on performance metrics and market feedback.
Translate complex expertise, services, technology, data, analytics, and AI-driven capabilities into compelling customer-focused offerings.
Develop positioning frameworks, messaging architectures, solution narratives, and proof points that clearly communicate market value.
Create and maintain buyer personas and customer journey insights.
Develop portfolio architecture that demonstrates how offerings address customer needs and business challenges.
Ensure consistent messaging across marketing, sales, proposal, and customer-facing materials.
Partner with business leaders, service-line leaders, solution owners, delivery teams, sales, account management, and marketing stakeholders.
Collaborate with subject matter experts to identify market opportunities and transform capabilities into differentiated offerings.
Influence stakeholders across a matrixed organization without direct authority.
Ensure market-facing messaging accurately reflects operational capabilities and delivery outcomes.
Develop sales enablement materials including presentations, competitive intelligence, messaging guides, training content, proposal support, and battle cards.
Support campaign development, thought leadership initiatives, and demand generation programs.
Equip customer-facing teams with the tools and content needed to effectively position offerings and communicate business value.
Help establish repeatable sales motions for new and existing offerings.
Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and customer insight activities to inform strategy and prioritization.
Monitor industry trends, emerging technologies, customer needs, and competitive dynamics.
Analyze commercialization metrics, sales engagement, pipeline performance, customer feedback, and revenue impact.
Identify opportunities to refine positioning, packaging, messaging, and go-to-market execution.

Senior Product Marketing Manager - Solutions and Services Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Healthcare Administration, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in Product Marketing, Solutions Marketing, Services Marketing, Portfolio Marketing, or Go-to-Market Strategy.
Proven success developing and executing commercialization and go-to-market strategies for complex offerings.
Experience packaging and positioning complex capabilities into differentiated and commercially compelling market solutions.
Demonstrated ability to drive measurable business outcomes, including pipeline growth, adoption, customer engagement, and revenue impact.
Strong strategic thinking, storytelling, analytical, communication, and presentation skills.
Experience collaborating across sales, marketing, delivery, account management, and executive stakeholder groups.
Ability to influence cross-functional teams and build alignment within highly matrixed organizations.
Experience marketing professional services, consulting, advisory services, managed services, technology-enabled services, or enterprise solutions is highly preferred.
Experience with data, analytics, AI-enabled products, digital transformation solutions, or complex technology offerings.
Healthcare or life sciences industry experience preferred but not required.
Experience supporting highly consultative or value-based sales environments.

In this position, you may have access to client or customer systems, confidential and/or proprietary information or data, including medical data. This position is onsite and requires you to work closely with other individuals in a collaborative team environment. Additionally, drug products may be present in the workplace.

What You'll Own

Client Strategy & Relationships

Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps

Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

Paid Media Performance

Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility
Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention

Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging

About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

Client Strategy & Relationships

Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

Paid Media Performance

Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

Copy & Creative Strategy

Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

Tracking & Funnel Execution

Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility
Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Experience

Financial services marketing
Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
Video sales letter marketing
High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
Performance marketing agency experience
Direct-response advertising

NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)
Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

Benefits

Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays
Training & Development
Work From Home
Flexible Schedule
Performance Bonus

Partner cross-functionally with Product Management, Sales, Marketing, Account Management, and Sales Enablement teams.
Create sales enablement resources such as training materials, battle cards, sales talk tracks, and objection-handling guides.
Support demand generation campaigns, thought leadership initiatives, pipeline development, and revenue growth efforts.
Define, track, and analyze product marketing performance metrics, including content utilization, sales engagement, adoption, pipeline influence, and win/loss trends.
Manage multiple priorities and execute effectively in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

Strong storytelling, messaging, positioning, and communication skills.
Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making abilities.
Understanding of enterprise sales cycles and complex buying processes.

Experience in enterprise technology, software, analytics, or AI-driven products is highly preferred.

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager, Audience Management & Activation, Amazon Leo
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

Amazon Leo are seeking a Marketing Operations Manager to own audience management, segmentation, and activation across Amazon Leo's global marketing engine. This role is the primary owner of audience management and systems, managing access, governance standards, and seamless activation across channels. You will enable Marketing, Product, and Leadership teams to reach the right customers with the right messages at the right time.

This is a high-impact role requiring both strategic thinking and hands-on administration. You will own and evolve audience management systems—primarily our Customer Data (Treasure Data)—and across our marketing tech stack, building upon existing foundations as new data sources, channels, and use cases emerge. You will design and maintain audience infrastructure, activation workflows, and governance standards, partnering with Marketing Operations, cross-functional marketing teams, Business Intelligence Engineers, and Marketing Automation teams to ensure accurate, actionable audiences across the full customer journey. As Amazon Leo's marketing expands globally, you will evolve audience capabilities to support new markets, channels, and customer segments, while managing health, roadmap prioritization, and scalability requirements.

Key job responsibilities

Own the end-to-end audience management strategy for Amazon Leo marketing across B2B, B2C, and B2G customer segments
Serve as the primary administrator and expert for the Amazon Leo Customer Data (Treasure Data), including data model design, identity resolution strategies, audience activation workflows, and optimization
Build self-service audience segmentation capabilities and empower marketing teams to independently create and activate audiences through training, documentation, and scalable processes
Design and maintain audience taxonomy, naming conventions, and governance standards while ensuring data quality and privacy compliance
Translate complex marketing campaign requirements into technical audience definitions, segmentation logic, and activation workflows across marketing automation (Braze, Marketo, Adobe Experience Manager)
Create comprehensive documentation, deliver training sessions, and build enablement resources that reduce dependency on technical teams for routine audience creation
Own the audience management roadmap, prioritizing feature requests and enhancements in partnership with Marketing, Data Engineering, and Product teams
Monitor audience performance metrics, conduct deep-dive analysis, and provide recommendations for optimization and refinement

Export Control Requirement

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

A day in the life

You will spend part of your day improving the audience management architecture—designing better segments, refining activation workflows, and enabling new use cases in the CDP and marketing automation. Another part of your day will involve partnering with Marketing teams to translate campaign requirements into audience definitions or troubleshoot activation issues. You will also work directly with Data Engineering and BI teams to validate data quality and ensure measurement accuracy. You might conduct a training session for new marketing team members on audience segmentation best practices, or update documentation to reflect new capabilities. You will be a strategic and technical owner ensuring that Amazon Leo Marketing can reach the right audiences with precision and scale.

About The Team

The Amazon Leo Marketing team is responsible for building a world-class brand and driving global demand for a transformational connectivity service. The Marketing Ops & Analytics team builds the systems, data flows, measurements, and insights that support a multi-LOB global business. We operate with the agility of a startup inside Amazon, partnering closely with Engineering, Product, Science, and global marketing teams to ensure our decisions are grounded in high-quality data.

Basic Qualifications

4+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional programs or marketing campaigns from concept to completion
Experience managing and measuring marketing performance in various channels

Preferred Qualifications

Experience managing external partners to develop marketing programs
Experience presenting ideas to various levels of an organization to gain support for initiatives

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Sr. Marketing Data Analyst is responsible for transforming CRM, business development, and marketing data into clear, actionable insights that strengthen lead generation, support revenue growth, improve campaign performance, and guide strategic decision-making. This role serves as the business owner and primary administrator of the Company’s CRM system, with responsibility for system enhancements, reporting, dashboards, workflows, data integrity, user access, and ongoing optimization.

In addition to CRM ownership, this position analyzes data across the Company’s marketing technology ecosystem, including HubSpot, Google Analytics, digital advertising, SEO, website activity, email marketing, social media, campaign performance, and other tools used to measure customer engagement and marketing effectiveness. The role partners closely with Business Development, Marketing, IT, Corporate Training, operating subsidiaries, and leadership to turn data into actionable insights, recommendations, and measurable action to drive revenue growth.

This role can be filled in one of the following Company offices: Houston, TX; Broomall, PA; or Tulsa, OK.

Essential Functions

Actively supports the Company’s commitment to safety and its Core Values.
Represents the Company at all times with high moral standards while adhering to the Company’s Code of Business Conduct and Ethics.
Serves as the primary point of contact, business owner, administrator, and internal champion for the Company’s CRM system.
Leads CRM optimization efforts, including system enhancements, dashboards, reporting, workflows, data integrity, permissions, roles, user access, and overall system usability.
Works closely with business stakeholders across operating subsidiaries, Business Development, Marketing, and IT to identify CRM needs, gather requirements, improve processes, and implement appropriate system solutions.
Leads the CRM Technical Steering Team, including key end users and IT subject matter experts, to advance system functionality, adoption, governance, and long-term value.
Critically analyzes current systems, business processes, workflows, and functional needs; recommends and implements modifications that improve efficiency, data quality, reporting, and user experience.
Maintains CRM data integrity through duplicate detection and resolution, data cleansing, discrepancy reporting, missing or malformed data correction, and improved data governance processes.
Integrates CRM data with other marketing and business tools to provide a more complete view of customer, prospect, campaign, and business development activity.
Develops and maintains dashboards, reports, scorecards, and visualizations that track KPIs and communicate performance trends to Business Development, Marketing, operating teams, and leadership.
Analyzes performance across marketing channels, including CRM, HubSpot, Google Analytics, website activity, SEO, paid advertising, email marketing, social media, forms, landing pages, and campaign engagement.
Builds and maintains measurement frameworks that evaluate campaign ROI, lead quality, funnel performance, customer journey activity, attribution, conversion rates, and marketing effectiveness.
Develops, manages, and refines lead scoring models in HubSpot using firmographic, demographic, behavioral, web, email, and engagement data.
Defines and monitors criteria for marketing-qualified and sales-qualified leads to help Business Development focus on higher-value prospects and opportunities.
Cleans, organizes, and maintains HubSpot data, including properties, associations, workflows, lists, campaign data, and reporting structures.
Collaborates with Business Development and Marketing to evaluate lead quality, campaign performance, customer engagement, and opportunities for optimization.
Supports Business Development’s Strategic Account Management efforts.
Conducts A/B testing, attribution analysis, ROI analysis, and campaign performance evaluation across digital channels, including email, paid media, web, SEO, and social.
Translates complex data into actionable, executive-level insights by explaining what changed, why it matters, and what actions should be considered.
Supports strategic initiatives by developing analysis, reporting, and recommendations that inform marketing priorities, budget decisions, campaign direction, and business development strategy.
Partners with IT and data teams to improve data collection, system integration, security, scalability, and access to reliable marketing and CRM data.
Works with Corporate Training and internal stakeholders to support user training, adoption, and best practices for CRM and related marketing tools.
Supports Business Development and other functions with CRM, marketing, campaign, and financial data for reports, presentations, planning, and leadership discussions.
Prepares monthly, quarterly, ad hoc, and executive-level reports as required.
Identifies opportunities to improve marketing efficiency, data accessibility, self-service reporting, and overall marketing analytics maturity.
Performs other duties or responsibilities as required or assigned.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Information Systems, Data Science, Statistics, Business, or a related field; equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience may be considered.
5+ years of progressive experience in marketing analytics, CRM administration, business intelligence, data analysis, marketing operations, or a related data-driven marketing role.
Strong working knowledge of CRM systems, including configuration of views, dashboards, reports, workflows, data structures, data integrity processes, and external reporting tools.
Demonstrated experience pulling, cleaning, organizing, analyzing, and interpreting data from CRM systems and marketing technology platforms.
Proficiency with HubSpot, including reporting, workflows, properties, lists, lead scoring, campaign tracking, and marketing automation data.
Experience with Google Analytics, website analytics, digital campaign reporting, SEO reporting, paid media reporting, and customer journey tracking preferred.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Power BI and DAX; experience with other BI or visualization tools such as Tableau or Looker Studio preferred.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint.
Strong understanding of marketing performance metrics, lead funnels, campaign attribution, customer engagement, and business development pipeline reporting.
Ability to synthesize large amounts of data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to actively listen, ask thoughtful questions, explain technical information clearly, and develop executive-ready presentations.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills with the ability to work through complex issues from identification to resolution.
Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail, accuracy, and data quality.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, requests, and projects in a fast-paced, changing environment.
Effective interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships and work collaboratively across Business Development, Marketing, IT, Operations, Corporate Training, and leadership.

If you have run a monetized newsletter program at scale—this is the role for you. This is a true player-coach role: you’ll shape the strategy, but you’ll also be in the work: building campaigns, solving problems, analyzing performance, testing, optimizing, and jumping in wherever needed, while leading a high-performing team.

You’ll own a high-volume newsletter program of 40+ campaigns per week, along with automated lifecycle journeys, partnering closely with internal marketing stakeholders, Ad Sales and Merchant teams—advising on best practices and turning sold inventory and placements into engaging, effective campaigns. As a strategic right hand to the VP of Global Marketing, you’ll balance commercial performance with a great member experience while continuously pushing the program forward.

If you’re a hands-on email leader who wants to take a strong, high-volume program and make it even better—sharper targeting, cleaner deliverability, and more value for members and partners alike—we’d love to meet you.

What You’ll Do

Newsletter Excellence, Monetization and Partner Performance

Execute the newsletter program as a high-performing media channel, optimizing how sponsored placements and commissionable offers are delivered to drive strong, defensible performance for our partners while protecting the member experience.
Serve as the email and newsletter expert to Ad Sales and the Merchant team, advising on inventory, placement, and campaign best practices and bringing data-backed recommendations that improve monetization to the teams responsible for what is sold and placed.
Report program and placement performance credibly to partners and leadership, using defensible, trustworthy metrics.
Own the execution and performance of every campaign, translating results into best-practice guidance and recommendations that help Ad Sales, Merchant, and Marketing teams improve outcomes over time.
Propose and, once approved, execute the global (22-market) newsletter strategy and roadmap, balancing send volume and frequency with engagement and long-term list health. Translate the strategy into a market-by-market campaign and inventory calendar used cross-functionally by Ad Sales, the Merchant team, and Marketing.

Campaign Execution and Deliverability Excellence

Oversee a full portfolio of concurrent campaigns-from planning through send and post-send analysis.
Build, QA, schedule, and deploy newsletter and email campaigns in our ESP, personally and through your team.
Manage dynamic, catalog-driven offer placement and per-segment/per-client targeting and suppression at scale.
Develop mobile-first templates flexible enough to A/B test any element, refreshed quarterly on performance, best practices, and trends; run an ongoing testing program across offers, segmentation, timing, and creative.
Own inbox placement, sender reputation, and deliverability across multiple sending domains and markets - IP/domain warm-up, authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), list hygiene, audience data quality, and feedback loops - monitored with tools such as Validity/Everest, Google Postmaster Tools, and Microsoft SNDS.
Serve as the internal expert on deliverability best practices and mailbox-provider requirements.

Engagement, Lifecycle, and Product Campaigns

Balance commercial goals with a great member experience, delivering the right offer to the right member to drive discovery, clicks, and purchase activity.
Own audience segmentation and personalization by market, client, and member behavior, matching messaging and placements to the right audiences with a focus on engagement and deliverability, while ensuring client settings are always respected.
Design and run lifecycle and behavior-based journeys-activation, welcome, re-engagement, and win-back-to grow engagement and long-term value while reducing churn.
Own a smaller but strategically important set of product marketing and go-to-market sends that grow adoption of BenefitHub's own products and verticals (e.g., home and auto insurance, the browser extension), in partnership with Marketing stakeholders.

Performance, Team and Cross-Functional Leadership

Define and track KPIs across performance, engagement, deliverability, and lifecycle - including weekly reporting on open rate, CTR, CTOR, and sender reputation - and lead regular performance updates to marketing leadership, the executive team, and the broader company on results, trends, and priorities, adjusting based on data.
Ensure advertiser- and partner-facing metrics are accurate and defensible, with an awareness of non-human/invalid traffic (bots, scanners, prefetch) and its impact on reported performance, partnering with analytics to mitigate it.
Lead, coach, and develop a growing team of email marketers and email marketing specialists responsible for executing our newsletter, email marketing, and journey programs.
Oversee, own, and continuously improve the operating framework for intake, QA, approvals, and reporting for efficiency and clear cross-departmental communication.
Manage vendor relationships (ESP, CDP, and deliverability tools) and act as a key stakeholder in ESP strategy, capabilities, and any platform evaluation or migration.
Ensure compliance with email and privacy regulations across our markets (e.g., CAN-SPAM, CASL, GDPR), and own consent, subscription, and preference management.

What You Bring—Required

9+ years of hands-on email marketing in a high-volume program, including at least 7 years running a newsletter or email program monetized through sponsored placements and/or commissionable/affiliate revenue.
Experience programming reoccurring newsletters: maintaining send and inventory calendar while balancing paid placements with member experience.
Deep, hands-on expertise in email deliverability, compliance and reputation management (IP/domain warmup, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, list hygiene, mailbox-provider relations).
Hands-on mastery of a major enterprise ESP and CDP / marketing-automation stack — our current stack includes Iterable and Lytics — across segmentation, dynamic content, automation, lifecycle journeys, behavioral targeting, and reporting.
Proven success managing and developing a high-performing team.
Strong command of segmentation, personalization, dynamic content, A/B testing methodologies, plus experience building triggered and automated journeys
Advanced knowledge of marketing analytics, attribution modeling, and performance measurement, building KPIs and dashboards and translating performance data into insights for partners and executives — with the judgment to distinguish genuine engagement from invalid traffic.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

What Sets You Apart—preferred

Background at an ecommerce, marketplace, perks/benefits, affiliate, deals, newsletter publishing or media/ad-monetization company preferred (e.g., PerkSpot, EBG / Perks at Work, LifeMart, Rakuten, Groupon, RetailMeNot, or similar)
Understanding of the HR, benefits, and employee-engagement landscape
Experience with multi-tenant programs, product-marketing/GTM email, global multi-market programs, and evaluating or migrating ESPs.
