jobs.title: Sr. Marketing Manager, Enterprise B2B (Americas) — Amazon Leo, Amazon Leo
jobs.description:
Description

The Amazon Leo team is on a mission to create a connected world that will usher in a new era of global productivity and prosperity. Through a constellation of satellites in low earth orbit, we’re going to bring fast Internet to every individual, household, school, and business to empower everyone to collaborate, work, play, invent, and learn from any location, at any time, on any device.

Amazon Leo’s Americas B2B marketing team is looking for an exceptionally talented and passionate individual to create awareness and generate sales-ready leads in the enterprise by leveraging inbound and outbound marketing plays. This is an opportunity to make a lasting impact within an emerging business (and long-term bet) within Amazon.

The ideal candidate is a B2B demand generation expert with deep experience running account-based marketing programs and coordinating inbound and outbound plays against named enterprise accounts. You have worked a target account list with a field sales team, understand how buying committees form in large organizations, and know how to build pipeline in long-cycle, high-consideration deals.

To be successful in this role, you will need to develop vertical expertise across Leo’s priority enterprise industries to produce account-specific campaigns, and partner closely with field sellers, SDRs, and Central Marketing to deliver coordinated insight-driven campaigns that move buying committees from awareness to sales-ready engagement.

Key job responsibilities

Enterprise Demand Generation & ABM

Own and execute Leo’s North America enterprise ABM motion, orchestrating targeted account plays across inbound and outbound channels to build pipeline within named accounts across priority verticals, partnering closely with field sellers and SDRs to coordinate account buying committee engagement, and to automate sales handoff.
Develop and manage integrated campaign calendars aligned to Leo’s enterprise GTM milestones, service availability expansions, key industry events, and EBC programming—ensuring marketing plays are sequenced to amplify field sales moments rather than run in parallel.
Build and manage enterprise nurture programs in Marketo that move engaged accounts from awareness to sales-ready status, including vertical-specific nurture tracks, EBC follow-up sequences, and post-event re-engagement, all with clearly defined MQA thresholds and handoff criteria co-developed with sales.
Serve as the connective tissue between marketing and the enterprise field sales team to align campaign calendars to account pursuit timelines, co-developing vertical-specific messaging and outbound sequences with SDRs, and ensuring marketing investment is concentrated on accounts where sales is actively engaged.
Drive inbound demand capture by briefing and directing Central Marketing channel owners on Leo’s enterprise targeting inputs (account lists, vertical personas, intent signals) to activate paid social (LinkedIn), content syndication, SEM, programmatic display, and webinar programs against named account clusters and buying committees.

Scale Impact Through AI and Intelligent Automation

Design and deploy AI-powered workflows that operationalize Leo's ABM motion at scale, from intent signal ingestion and account prioritization to personalized content assembly and campaign activation across target verticals.
Use AI agents to compress the time between insight and action: automate account research, buying committee mapping, and outbound sequence personalization so sellers and marketers spend time on high-judgment work, not repeatable tasks.
Treat Leo's marketing stack like a high-performance engine: frequently instrument, test, tune, and examine the components (Demandbase, MAP, CRM, generative AI) to increase account coverage and pipeline velocity through intelligent tooling.
Document and codify what works so that ABM plays, agent workflows, and campaign frameworks become repeatable infrastructure the broader Leo marketing team can build on globally.

Measurement & Reporting

Define and own the enterprise demand gen measurement framework anchored on Marketing Qualified Accounts (MQAs), influenced pipeline value, account coverage by tier and vertical, and pipeline velocity, then run structured experiments to continuously improve program performance, giving leadership a clear view of what’s working and where to invest next.
Build and maintain an enterprise demand gen performance dashboard that connects account-level campaign activity to pipeline outcomes, translating raw data into actionable insights for field sales, SDR leadership, and the broader North America marketing team.

Export Control Requirement

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Basic Qualifications

6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
Experience communicating results to senior leadership
6+ years of experience in B2B demand generation or account-based marketing, with at least 2 years operating in an enterprise GTM motion with a field sales team and named account targets.
Understanding of enterprise ABM mechanics and the tools that support them (like Demandbase), intent signal interpretation, account scoring, and buying committee mapping, well enough to brief, direct, and optimize program performance even when not directly instrumenting every tool.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience creating and executing integrated marketing lead generation campaigns using tactics that include live or virtual events, webinars, email, lead nurture programs, and CRM/sales insights
Strong analytical skills with the ability to work across account-level data sources (Salesforce, MAP dashboards) to surface account engagement signals, measure pipeline influence, and make data-driven program decisions.
Hands-on experience with marketing automation platforms (Marketo preferred) for building and managing enterprise nurture programs, including vertical-specific email sequences, decision-tree logic, account-level scoring thresholds, and MQA handoff triggers integrated with Salesforce.
Demonstrated ability to define enterprise demand gen KPIs (MQAs, account coverage, pipeline influence, velocity), interpret multi-touch attribution data, and translate program performance into actionable recommendations for both marketing and sales leadership.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to write compelling campaign briefs, creative direction, and executive-ready performance summaries.
Experience marketing to enterprise or strategic accounts in satellite, telecommunications, broadband, cloud infrastructure, or industrial technology market segments, with familiarity with the operational and procurement complexity of large organizational buyers.
Experience working in both a hyperscaler business and an early-stage (launch-phase) business where strategy is actively being built rather than inherited.
Proven ability to communicate performance results and strategic recommendations to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, both verbally and in writing.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Marketing Cloud Next (Public Sector)
jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) for Marketing Cloud Next is a versatile expert responsible for ensuring high-value customers who purchase the Signature Success Plan achieve a significant return on their investment with our platform. This role functions as an extension of the customer's workforce and a trusted advisor, providing guidance and advice to customer organizations.

As a trusted advisor, the CSM will build a track record in customer success through superb communication with partners and extensive knowledge of the Salesforce platform to translate their business needs to solutions. You will forge relationships with your customers and account teams, develop a deep technical understanding of their Salesforce implementation, share standard methodologies, and adoption of proactive services. These activities will enable you to proactively set the customer up for success through optimization of the platform, with special care during critically important peak events.

As a CSM, you will occasionally act as a point of contact for any major incidents, owning the customer’s expectations and communications through the resolution of such incidents. The CSM acts as the technical main interface on behalf of our customers and works closely across both internal and external collaborators, including partners and ISVs, as required to address the customer needs.

This role specializes in guiding organizations through seamless migrations from legacy marketing automation platforms—including Granicus GovDelivery, Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement —to Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next and Salesforce Data Cloud. By identifying and addressing both technical and business concerns, the CSM strategically aligns solutions with the customer’s top priorities, projects, and goals.

The ideal CSM has an extraordinary focus on the success of the customer, is an exceptional communicator, exhibits professionalism, is dedicated to meeting and exceeding expectations, enjoys forming relationships, has excellent collaboration skills, and has the ability to learn new technologies quickly.

This is an Individual Contributor position.

Your Impact

Customer Accountability and Value Alignment

Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the delivery of all Signature deliverables, the overall customer experience, and renewal and expansion.
Coordinate all deliverables the customer is entitled to, overseeing the experience throughout the Signature lifecycle.
Apply the correct processes to address customer needs and ensure value is delivered through the Signature offer.
Successfully align with and manage both Business and Technical Stakeholders, focusing on aligning Business Value and Technical Goals to the Signature offer.
Prioritize the most urgent work activities, organize tasks to avoid missing key steps, and create basic plans to focus time, taking responsibility for assigned tasks.
Use internal resources to increase effectiveness and rely on managers or mentors for guidance on priority problems.
Conduct enablement sessions on opportunity and case management, forecasting, pipeline hygiene, knowledge creation, and omni-channel routing.
Share best practices for sales and service process optimization, data quality, and customer experience.

Strategic Advisory and Stakeholder Management

Track usage metrics (opportunity updates, activity logging, forecast submissions, report usage, case resolution times, knowledge article usage, channel adoption, and CSAT scores).
Develop and maintain strong relationships at key stakeholder levels, including cultivating executive-level relationships within customer IT and business leadership.
Act as a trusted advisor by gaining trust through mutual goals, understanding the customer's business model, and applying proven solutions to their problems.
Solidify partnership commitments and drive innovation aligned with customers' business challenges.
Increase customer engagement with products and services and identify major political barriers to customer success.
Partner with more experienced team members to solve complex problems and develop strategic success plans when needed.
Conduct quarterly reviews of feature usage to drive adoption of tools like Journey Builder or Commerce Promotions, ensuring platform stability and performance.
Identify underutilization of contracted entitlements (e.g., messaging volume or GMV tiers) and align platform features with customer priorities to increase throughput.

Core Technical Skills Required

Marketing Cloud Next — Platform Breadth: Strong functional knowledge of the full Marketing Cloud Next platform. Able to architect solutions end-to-end and lead discovery without referring to technical resources for platform capability questions.
Salesforce Data Cloud: Solid understanding of Data Cloud architecture — data streams, unified profiles, identity resolution, segmentation and activation to Marketing Cloud Next — sufficient to own the functional integration design and validate the Data Cloud Architect’s technical approach.
Subscriber Data Model & Consent Architecture: Deep understanding of MCN subscriber data model — data extensions, sendable/non-sendable objects, contact counts, suppression lists — and proven expertise designing consent migration strategies that comply with GDPR, CAN-SPAM, CASL and POPI.
Legacy Marketing Platform Knowledge: Working knowledge of at least one major legacy marketing platform (Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot, legacy Marketing Cloud Engagement ) — sufficient to run discovery workshops, assess migration complexity and translate legacy features to Marketing Cloud Next equivalents.
Journey & Campaign Migration Strategy: Proven ability to inventory, assess and priortize complex legacy marketing automation libraries — mapping legacy journey logic, drip campaigns and triggered send rules to Flow native design patterns.
Email Deliverability: Solid understanding of email deliverability principles — IP warm-up, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, sender reputation, inbox placement — to advise clients on post-migration deliverability strategy.
Integration Architecture Awareness: Understanding of Marketing Cloud Connect (CRM sync), REST/SOAP MC APIs, API-triggered sends and event-driven messaging — sufficient to design functional integration specifications and validate the TA’s implementation approach.
Data Migration Strategy (Functional): Ability to define what data migrates, the business transformation rules governing subscriber and consent data, validation criteria for data sign-off and the business cutover sequence — partnering with the TA and Data Cloud Architect for ETL execution.
Salesforce Platform Awareness: Working knowledge of Salesforce CRM, Sales/Service Cloud data model, Flows and permission sets — sufficient to design end-to-end Marketing Cloud Next solutions that integrate with the broader Salesforce org.
Functional Design Documentation: Expertise in producing executive-quality solution blueprints, functional design documents, process maps, data mapping specifications, migration approach papers and UAT test scripts.
Workshop Facilitation & Client Management: Proven ability to lead large, complex discovery workshops and design sessions with senior client stakeholders — managing scope discussions, capturing requirements and building consensus on migration approach.
Agile Delivery: Proficiency in Agile delivery practices — user story writing, backlog management, sprint planning and sprint review facilitation — within the Migration Factory’s MDLC wave delivery model.

Technical Health, Adoption, and Risk Management

AI Literacy: Proficiency in using AI agents to automate routine tasks such as meeting summaries, QBR data collection, and initial health monitoring.
Prompt Engineering Basics: Ability to use natural-language commands to guide AI agents in retrieving accurate customer data and generating first drafts of success plans.
AI Engagement Monitoring: Use AI-driven sentiment and intent analysis to flag early customer concerns for human intervention.
Collaborative Learning: Actively seek out Agentblazer training and certifications to stay current on autonomous agent capabilities.
Learning & Development: Apply product knowledge and expertise to address technical concerns, use this knowledge to ask effective diagnostic questions, and align platform features with customer priorities and roadmaps.
Proactively monitor and conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
Serve as the primary interface for major incidents (e.g., checkout failures or email deliverability drops) to protect peak revenue.
Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
Form a clear plan for client engagements, communicate clearly and proactively with collaborators, and keep the customer goal central to decision-making.
Escalate complex automation, data model, routing, or integration questions to technical resources.

Minimum Requirements

5+ years of relevant industry expertise in Customer Success, SaaS platform use, or related fields.
Strong consulting skills and demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate discussions, handle objections, and influence C-level conversations.
Possesses industry-relevant expertise and is actively honing skills in a relevant functional area, with an understanding of the broad impact of the industry on the customer's business.
Excellent communication skills to articulate technical issues to diverse audiences and the ability to translate technical concepts into business terms.
Actively seeks out relevant learning activities, approaches obstacles as growth opportunities, and seeks experienced mentors to accelerate personal development.
Position requirements: Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required. Company visa sponsorship is not available for this position at this time.

Cloud/Platform Requirements (included With The Above)

3+ years of experience supporting customers using Marketing Cloud Next or Legacy Marketing Platform knowledge
Marketing Cloud Next - Platform Breadth: Strong functional knowledge of the full Marketing Cloud Next platform - Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Mobile Studio, Advertising Studio and Contact Builder
Legacy Marketing Platform Knowledge: Working knowledge of at least one major legacy marketing platform (GovDelivery, Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot, legacy Marketing Cloud Engagement )

Deep understanding of Marketing Cloud, marketing automation, personalization, advertising, and/or marketing platforms.
Deep understanding of Digital Marketing processes, challenges and trends
Knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud features and applications and able to articulate the value and how a Customer can benefit from Signature Success for Marketing Cloud

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

Client Strategy & Relationships

Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

Paid Media Performance

Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

Copy & Creative Strategy

Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

Tracking & Funnel Execution

Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility
Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Experience

Financial services marketing
Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
Video sales letter marketing
High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
Performance marketing agency experience
Direct-response advertising

NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)
Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

Benefits

Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays
Training & Development
Work From Home
Flexible Schedule
Performance Bonus

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Category Marketing, AWS Cross Category Marketing
jobs.description:
Description

AWS is seeking a Senior Manager to lead the Cross-Category Services marketing team. This role owns the marketing strategy and execution for a portfolio of services that help AWS customers accelerate their cloud transformations and achieve long-term success: AWS Training & Certification, AWS Support, AWS Professional Services, and AWS Marketplace & Partner Services.

These services represent a critical part of the AWS customer journey — from building skills and getting expert guidance, to finding and deploying third-party solutions, to ensuring ongoing operational excellence. Together they generate billions in revenue.

As the leader of this team, you will build and manage a high-performing team of product marketers, develop differentiated positioning and messaging for each portfolio, drive customer insights that inform marketing strategy, and serve as the connective tissue between diverse business stakeholders who have different operating rhythms, go-to-market motions, and customer audiences.

This is a role for someone who thrives in complexity — someone who can context-switch fluidly across businesses while maintaining strategic coherence, who builds trust with senior stakeholders through intellectual rigor and consistent delivery.

Key job responsibilities

Marketing Strategy & Execution

Develop and own the marketing strategy for Training & Certification, Support, Professional Services, and Marketplace — including positioning, messaging, value propositions, and go-to-market plans
Synthesize customer insights, market data, and competitive intelligence to identify opportunities and shape strategy across all four businesses
Drive differentiated messaging that connects each service to the broader AWS customer success narrative — helping customers understand how these services accelerate transformation
Lead product launch strategies and associated plans, including naming, target audience definition, content development, and marketing vehicle selection
Continuously measure and optimize marketing performance, establishing KPIs and mechanisms for each portfolio

Stakeholder Management & Cross-Functional Leadership

Serve as the primary marketing partner to four distinct business leadership teams, each with different operating rhythms, customer segments, and go-to-market motions
Build deep trust with VP and Director-level stakeholders across product, sales, professional services, and partner organizations through intellectual rigor and consistent delivery
Navigate competing priorities and resource constraints across portfolios — making principled trade-off decisions and communicating them transparently

People Management & Team Building

Build, lead, and develop a team of product and general marketing professionals spanning multiple portfolios and locations
Hire, retain, and grow top marketing talent
Resource the team effectively across portfolios, making staffing recommendations aligned to business priority and impact

About The Team

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

10+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
Experience managing teams
Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
Experience driving direction and alignment with cross-functional teams

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of B2B procurement processes
Experience working with executive leadership in large organizations

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

Client Strategy & Relationships

Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

Paid Media Performance

Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

Copy & Creative Strategy

Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

Tracking & Funnel Execution

Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility
Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Experience

Financial services marketing
Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
Video sales letter marketing
High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
Performance marketing agency experience
Direct-response advertising

NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)
Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

Benefits

Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays
Training & Development
Work From Home
Flexible Schedule
Performance Bonus

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

Client Strategy & Relationships

Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

Paid Media Performance

Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

Copy & Creative Strategy

Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

Tracking & Funnel Execution

Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility
Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Experience

Financial services marketing
Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
Video sales letter marketing
High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
Performance marketing agency experience
Direct-response advertising

NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)
Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

Benefits

Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays
Training & Development
Work From Home
Flexible Schedule
Performance Bonus

jobs.description:

Marketing
Full time

About The Role

Blacksmith Agency is scaling its marketing division to support a growing portfolio of PPC and SEO clients across multifamily, B2B and technical verticals. As SEO (Search Engine Optimization) Manager at Blacksmith, you own strategy, performance and client-facing leadership across paid search, paid social, SEO and conversion optimization.

This is a hybrid strategic and operational role. You join sales calls to shape strategy, oversee internal and external specialists, build performance roadmaps and make sure client campaigns deliver measurable outcomes. You own results, reporting, QA and continual improvement. It is a senior seat that blends analytical depth, strong communication and execution oversight.

What You Will Own

Lead strategy for all PPC and SEO clients across multiple industries.
Join sales calls with account executives to validate scope, pitch technical recommendations and help close deals.
Build 90 day, 6 month and annual growth roadmaps for every client.
Own client performance across Google Ads, Meta, Microsoft and organic search.
Audit PPC campaigns, keyword strategies, bidding structures, landing pages and CRO opportunities.
Oversee technical SEO, on-page SEO, link building, programmatic pages and AI-driven content.
Own KPI tracking, conversion attribution and analytics accuracy.
Give weekly direction and QA, and coordinate priorities with the marketing project manager.
Present monthly and quarterly performance summaries to clients.

What You Bring

4 to 7 years in PPC, SEO or multi-channel full-funnel strategy.
Strong experience running paid and organic channels at the same time.
Expertise with Google Ads, GA4, Google Search Console, keyword research tools and paid media optimization.
Ability to build and articulate strategic recommendations for clients and account executives.
A track record of overseeing execution teams and managing deliverable quality.
Sharp analytical skills and the ability to diagnose performance issues fast.

Nice to have

Agency experience managing multiple clients at once.
Experience joining sales calls and influencing close rates.
Familiarity with multifamily, real estate or high-intent lead generation.
Experience with AI SEO, programmatic SEO, technical SEO audits and CRO.

Who Succeeds Here

People who think strategically and manage execution.
People who simplify complex marketing ideas for clients.
People who own results and take full accountability.
People who work well with distributed teams.
People who enjoy building rather than inheriting polished systems.

US military experience through military service or a military spouse/domestic partner.

jobs.title: Senior Demand Generation Manager
jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

Client Strategy & Relationships

Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

Paid Media Performance

Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

Copy & Creative Strategy

Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

Tracking & Funnel Execution

Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility
Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Experience

Financial services marketing
Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
Video sales letter marketing
High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
Performance marketing agency experience
Direct-response advertising

NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)
Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

Benefits

Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays
Training & Development
Work From Home
Flexible Schedule
Performance Bonus

jobs.description:
Description

The Worldwide Grocery Brand & Sustainability team is seeking an experienced and entrepreneurial Senior Brand Strategist to serve as an embedded expert supporting all Whole Foods Market and Amazon Grocery brands. This role brings deep brand expertise—positioning, brand architecture, narrative development, creative strategy, and brand governance—to high-impact programs and initiatives within Grocery. Sitting at the intersection of marketing, ecommerce, private label and merchandizing, you will ensure that every touchpoint reflects a consistent and compelling brand experience for customers.

The ideal candidate will be a seasoned brand and retail expert who brings both vision and operational rigor to the team: You are a dynamic, multifaceted strategist who is a comprehensive and incisive thinker. You thrive in complex and fast-paced environments, and are gifted at finding a true, distinctive, and compellingly clear strategic narrative in the most complicated business and consumer challenges. You have a deep understanding of how retail and lifestyle brands are built and sustained across audiences, and you are passionate about applying that expertise to Amazon Grocery.

You will partner closely with all teams across the Grocery organization to define and drive relevant brand-actions. You will be accountable for developing mechanisms that ensure brand excellence across existing and new initiatives, helping teams connect long-term brand building with measurable business outcomes. You will navigate ambiguity where business strategy, consumer needs, or creative direction may not yet be defined (or be in conflict), and make trade-offs between short- and long-term brand objectives. You will speak and write with laser-sharp clarity, using data to support assertions while still inspiring new thoughts and solutions.

This role requires a highly fungible and articulate professional who can operate as a trusted brand advisor—leaning into insights, defining positioning, shaping narratives, driving alignment with a diverse set of stakeholders—while thriving in a fast-paced and highly collaborative environment.

This role reports to the Director of Brand & Sustainability and is based in Austin, TX

Key job responsibilities

Serve as the brand expert for all WWGS programs. Specifically:

Use insights and data to author, revise and/or update coherent strategies and positioning frameworks for all WWGS banners and brands (as needed).
Own and up-level brand guidelines, strategic narratives, partnership tenets, and messaging architecture for all grocery brands, keeping them current as the market and the business evolves.
Contribute perspective to cadenced reporting and narratives (MBR, QBR, PR/FAQ) and present brand performance insights to senior leaders.
Earn trust with stakeholders and proactively influence partner team roadmaps and outputs ensuring brand coherence across all touchpoints.
Partner with diverse stakeholder teams to shape campaign narratives, validate concepts, and drive brand alignment from ideation through execution.
Elevate the quality of marketing creative to reflect brand differentiators and drive customer relevance.

Measurable Outcomes

Impact will be measured through lifts in brand equity for all Grocery brands. Specifically:

Increased awareness and meaning for WFM, 365, Amazon Saver, Amazon Grocery.
Perceptual gains for all brands in overall relevance and value perception.
Quantifiable boost to WFM’s equities in Health, Quality and Unique items.
Increased customer consideration for Amazon Saver and Amazon Grocery.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, or equivalent
9+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
Experience driving direction and alignment with cross-functional teams
Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working cross-functionally with partner teams to drive adoption and usage of brand assets and messaging
Experience in strategic marketing management and market analysis and demonstrated ability to build and execute a strategy with clear goals and objectives to align to business and service objectives, and support portfolio objectives

jobs.title: Marketing Manager, ATL
jobs.description:
About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Marketing Manager, GTM
jobs.description:
ABOUT OBLQ

OBLQ builds software for independent insurance agencies, providing technology solutions that help independent P&Cs operate more efficiently and grow faster. We handle the technology so agencies can focus on selling policies and driving revenue. Learn more at oblq.ai.

Same Team. More Agency.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager to help turn our products that deliver for existing customers into a company and category that independent insurance agencies know about, understand, and want to buy.

You'll work directly with the founders and stay close to both the product and our customers. You'll learn how independent agencies operate, what slows their teams down, why they buy, what makes them skeptical, and how OBLQ changes the economics of their business. Then you'll turn those insights into the way we go to market.

You'll own product positioning, messaging, launches, customer stories, sales enablement, competitive intelligence, and much of the content that connects OBLQ to the market.

This is an early-stage role. We have products our customers love, we have great data and measurable results, a brand, and a point of view. We need someone who can take those raw materials and build a repeatable product marketing engine around them.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Position OBLQ and its products.
Develop clear positioning and messaging for OBLQs current and future products. Understand what matters to agency owners & agents, and translate complex product capabilities into simple reasons to care.

Own the product story.
Make sure our website, social presence, sales materials, demos, campaigns, and product launches tell a consistent and compelling story.

Know the customer.
Spend time with independent agency owners and agents. Understand how they generate leads, quote business, work with carriers, use their CRM, follow up with customers, and make technology decisions.

Turn customer outcomes into proof.
Build case studies, customer stories, ROI narratives, testimonials, and other evidence that helps prospective customers understand what OBLQ can do for their agency.

Build sales enablement.
Give the people selling OBLQ what they need to have better conversations: messaging, presentations, one-pagers, competitive positioning, objection handling, demo narratives, follow-up materials, and customer-specific stories.

Own product launches.
Create the go-to-market plan for new capabilities, carrier integrations, product releases, and future OBLQ products. Define the audience, message, channels, assets, and measures of success.

Understand the market.
Know the insurance technology landscape, the alternatives agencies use today, and where OBLQ fits. Track competitors, comparative raters, agency management systems, CRMs, automation products, and emerging technologies that could change the market.

Build content that earns attention.
Create and manage content for the channels where our customers spend time. That may include LinkedIn, customer email, website content, product education, thought leadership, webinars, industry communities, and other formats we discover work.

Improve how we generate demand.
Work across organic, outbound, partnerships, referrals, and paid acquisition to understand which messages and channels create qualified interest. Test quickly, measure results, and keep what works.

Bring the market back into the product.
You won't own the product roadmap, but you'll have an important voice in it. Bring customer feedback, competitive intelligence, win/loss insights, and market signals back into product decisions.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You have experience marketing B2B software products and can show examples where your work changed how a product was understood, sold, adopted, or launched.

You know how to find the useful insight inside a customer conversation and turn it into positioning or messaging people actually understand.

You can explain a complicated product simply without stripping away what makes it valuable.

You understand the difference between describing a feature and explaining why someone should care about it.

You're comfortable creating the strategy and doing the work. At this stage, you may define the launch plan in the morning and write the landing page in the afternoon.

You can work closely with product and engineering teams and become technically fluent enough to market what we're building accurately.

You use data to evaluate your work. You care about pipeline, conversion, engagement, adoption, and revenue more than impressions for their own sake.

You're comfortable operating with incomplete information and creating structure where it doesn't yet exist.

You have strong judgment about brand and messaging. You know when something needs another round of thinking and when it just needs to get into the market so we can learn.

SKILLS WE'RE INTERESTED IN

Working with AI tools to accelerate research, content, experimentation, and execution
B2B SaaS or vertical SaaS
Insurance or insurtech (nice to have)
Products sold to small and midsize businesses
Workflow automation or operational software
Product-led or founder-led companies moving toward a repeatable GTM model
Sales enablement and customer storytelling
Launching new or unfamiliar product categories
Competitive and market research
Demand generation and lifecycle marketing

Insurance experience is not a prerequisite. We care more about your ability to understand a market quickly and turn what you learn into effective product marketing.

HOW WE WORK

Our development cycle is fast. New capabilities can move from idea to working software quickly, which means product marketing needs to stay equally close to the product and the customer.

We value people who understand the problem, form a point of view, communicate it clearly, put it into the market, measure what happens, and improve it.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

A year from now:
An independent agency owner can land on OBLQ and quickly understand what we do, why it's different, and why it matters to their business.
Our positioning and messaging are consistent everywhere a prospect encounters us.
Customer outcomes have become credible stories, proof points, and sales assets.
Product launches have an audience, message, plan, and measurement strategy before they ship.
Sales conversations are supported by strong materials and a clear understanding of customer objections and competitive alternatives.
We know which messages, audiences, and channels create qualified opportunities and we're investing more heavily in the ones that work.
What we're learning in the market is consistently making its way back into the product.
Our product marketing capability is repeatable and can scale with the company.

A Little Bit About Us: You might know us from our founder and CEO, Dave Ramsey, who's given no-nonsense money advice on the radio since 1992. Three decades later, Ramsey Solutions is a household name in personal finance, with a mission to change the toxic money culture for good.

Our Mission: Ramsey Solutions provides biblically based, commonsense education and empowerment that give HOPE to everyone in every walk of life.

Here's a Taste Of Our Benefits

Health insurance (includes plans eligible for an HSA—with a company match up to $500!)
401(k) retirement plan with 4% match/company contribution
Annual wellness, counseling and grocery membership reimbursement
On-campus cafe with subsidized pricing for breakfast, lunch and coffee bar
Dependent care FSA
Tons of cultural activities, like weekly devotional, leadership development courses, Battle of the Bands, and one epic Christmas party!

Where And How You'd Work

Ramsey Solutions Headquarters is located just outside of Nashville in Franklin, Tennessee. We value our strong, unified company culture because we believe the best work is done together. That's why all of our team members work on-site under the same roof. But work-life balance is also important to us, so we offer flexible work schedules to take the stress out of appointments, family obligations and other needs that may pop up.

While every team member has a designated workspace (with an electronic sit-stand desk), our campus was designed to house a variety of unique work and play zones (e.g., quiet library space, coffee bar/lounge areas, recreational game zone, and outside/patio work and break areas).

What You'd Do In This Role

Live Events is the team that brings that hope out from behind a screen and into a room. You'll lead the marketing squad behind some of our most visible, in-person moments: the Ramsey Cruise, Investing Essentials, the Money and Marriage Getaway, and whatever event comes next. As the leader of two marketers, a copywriter, and a designer, you'll own the strategy that fills the room, in person and virtually, driving ticket sales and revenue for every event on the calendar. If you love the craft enough to stay hands-on and love people enough to make them better at it, you'll fit right in.

You're Probably a Match If

You lead with a player-coach mentality: hands-on enough to jump into the craft when your team needs it, but coach-first in how you show up day to day, with enough design and copy fluency to give real creative direction.
You've worked in live events, ticketed experiences, or travel and hospitality marketing, such as cruises or retreats.
You're comfortable pulling and analyzing your own data in Google Analytics (GA4), and you use AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude as part of your everyday marketing work.
You've built and run consumer-facing (B2C) marketing campaigns, ideally something conversion-driven and moment-based, like a seasonal push or a big launch.
You know how to run planning cadences, prioritize a team's workload, and manage a marketing budget against revenue targets.
You know how to delegate the day-to-day marketing work to marketers and coach them through it, giving your team room to make mistakes and learn instead of stepping in and doing it yourself, because your instinct is to coach, not just tell.
You have experience with customer concept testing, market research, or survey design, and you're comfortable marketing virtual or hybrid events alongside in-person ones.

What Winning Looks Like

Growing your team's critical thinking and marketing instincts season over season, not just their output.
Helping create successful and smoothly run events that super serve our fans.
Making decisions from GA4, Klaviyo, and Segment data you dug into yourself, not numbers someone else handed you.
Building planning cadences and prioritization habits that keep your squad focused on the highest-impact work each season.
Coaching your team toward more delegation and stronger critical thinking, while keeping the team's current momentum and morale strong.
Partnering across Ramsey's marketing team so Live Events campaigns stay connected to the bigger picture.

Other Stuff To Know

We're looking for people who are passionate about our mission. This isn't just a J-O-B. We experience resistance every day because what we believe is absolutely countercultural. We actually hate debt. We actually cut up our credit cards . . . like, for real. Some of us are still fighting our way out of debt, but we aren't going back. If you don't know much about Ramsey Solutions and our founder, Dave Ramsey, we encourage you to download the Ramsey Network mobile app and consume our content.

If Ramsey Solutions sounds like a workplace where you can get excited about Mondays, apply today. We can't wait to hear from you!

jobs.title: Business Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Marketing Lead based in the United States.

Join a fast-growing blockchain ecosystem working to expand the adoption of decentralized technology across businesses and financial markets. As Business Marketing Lead, you will turn strategic partnerships, integrations, and commercial deployments into compelling stories that demonstrate the value of building on a high-performance blockchain network. You will lead collaborative go-to-market initiatives with crypto-native companies, financial institutions, fintechs, and technology partners. Working across business development, go-to-market, content, and creative teams, you will develop campaigns that strengthen market awareness and showcase real-world adoption. From messaging and case studies to launch activations, you will own campaigns from initial brief through execution and performance measurement. This remote opportunity is ideal for a strategic, highly organized marketer who combines excellent storytelling skills with strong execution and a passion for blockchain innovation.

Accountabilities

In this role, you will lead partner marketing initiatives that translate business relationships and technical integrations into impactful campaigns and market-facing content. Your responsibilities will include:

Go-to-Market Collaboration: Work closely with business development, go-to-market, and content teams to understand pipeline priorities, identify partnership opportunities, and determine where collaborative marketing can generate the greatest impact.
Campaign Strategy and Prioritization: Maintain visibility into upcoming integrations, deployments, and launches. Evaluate opportunities based on potential impact, determine the appropriate level of marketing support, and develop clear campaign strategies.
Partner Marketing Campaigns: Design and lead joint marketing initiatives with key ecosystem partners, translating integrations and commercial relationships into compelling narratives that demonstrate adoption, capabilities, and momentum.
Content Development and Storytelling: Create and oversee social media activations, case studies, blog posts, messaging, and other creative assets that communicate the value of building on the network to business and technical audiences.
End-to-End Campaign Execution: Manage campaigns from initial briefs through launch and follow-up, coordinating timelines, creative deliverables, stakeholder alignment, legal and compliance reviews, and launch sequencing.
External Stakeholder Management: Collaborate directly with partner marketing and business teams to understand their objectives, identify strong storytelling opportunities, and deliver high-quality joint campaigns.
Campaign Measurement and Optimization: Define campaign objectives and success metrics upfront, monitor performance, evaluate outcomes, and use insights to improve future marketing initiatives.
Cross-Functional Coordination: Work across internal go-to-market and creative teams to ensure campaign priorities, messaging, and deliverables are aligned with broader business objectives.
Operational Excellence: Manage multiple complex workstreams simultaneously, maintain high standards of quality, and use AI tools and automation to improve efficiency and execution.

Requirements

The ideal candidate combines business or partner marketing expertise with strong storytelling abilities, sound judgment, and a deep understanding of the blockchain ecosystem. You should be comfortable working autonomously, managing complex external relationships, and translating technical or commercial concepts into compelling marketing campaigns. Key qualifications include:

At least 5 years of experience in business marketing, partner marketing, or a related field, ideally within crypto, financial services, or enterprise technology.
A solid understanding of the cryptocurrency and blockchain ecosystem, with the ability to communicate credibly with both crypto-native organizations and traditional businesses.
Familiarity with decentralized finance (DeFi), payments, stablecoins, tokenization, or financial infrastructure is a strong advantage.
Demonstrated experience owning integrated marketing or joint go-to-market campaigns involving external partners, from initial planning through launch and performance measurement.
Excellent writing and editing skills, including the ability to understand complex integrations or business relationships and translate them into clear, persuasive stories for sophisticated audiences.
Strong strategic judgment and the ability to identify the most compelling market-facing narratives and prioritize opportunities according to business impact.
Excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple concurrent campaigns, manage timelines, and maintain high-quality deliverables.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience collaborating with external marketing teams and internal cross-functional partners.
A proactive, self-directed approach, with the ability to take ownership, make informed decisions, and move projects forward with minimal oversight.
Familiarity with AI tools and automation, including the ability to use them thoughtfully to improve marketing workflows and productivity.
Adaptability and a collaborative mindset suited to a lean, ambitious team that values initiative, low-ego teamwork, and high-quality output.

Benefits

Remote work: Full-time remote opportunity.
Meaningful impact: Help expand blockchain adoption by showcasing real-world business applications and strategic integrations.
Complex and challenging work: Tackle technically demanding marketing challenges at the intersection of decentralized technology, financial infrastructure, and enterprise adoption.
Autonomy and ownership: Lead campaigns from concept to execution, with the opportunity to shape partner marketing strategy and deliver measurable results.
Collaborative team environment: Work with a highly motivated team that values collaboration, initiative, and high-quality work.
Ecosystem exposure: Engage with a growing network of investors, builders, businesses, and long-term contributors across the blockchain industry.
Professional growth: Develop expertise in business marketing, strategic partnerships, and go-to-market initiatives within an evolving technology ecosystem.

jobs.description:
At Acorns, our mission is to look after the financial best interests of the up-and-coming, beginning with the empowering, proud step of micro-investing. How do we accomplish our mission? Our values.

Lead With Heart
- With compassion, integrity, and tenacity, inspire yourself and others to move past all previous thresholds of possibility

Make Bold Decisions
- We are creating a new world. Be optimistic, adventurous, and courageous. Leap fearlessly into the future

Always Build Trust
- Say what you mean, mean what you say, and do what you say you’re going to do. We are all owners. We are one team

Never Stop Growing
- Change IS the constant. Stay hungry and curious. Be relentless in the pursuit of progress

Find a way
- Never settle, no excuses, nothing is impossible. Just make it happen

Our values guide us, and our mission drives us. Come join us and help deliver financial wellness for the whole family, putting the tools of wealth-making into everyone’s hands.

____________________________________________________________

Growth Marketing, Sr. Associate - New Channels | Acorns

Acorns is looking for a curious, driven Growth Marketing Sr. Associate to join our team and help expand our paid acquisition channel mix. You will work closely with the Senior Paid Acquisition Manager to research, launch, and scale emerging platforms—from programmatic DSPs to community-based channels like Reddit—driving user growth across Acorns and Acorns Early.

This role carries real ownership. You’ll operate with meaningful day-to-day autonomy, exercise judgment within established frameworks, and produce analysis and recommendations that shape how we invest in new channels. You’ll collaborate cross-functionally with Analytics, Creative, and channel partners to bring experiments to life and move quickly from proof of concept to scaled channel.

Acorns is a remote-first organization
, offering the flexibility to work remotely while providing optional access to office space in Irvine, CA.

What You Will Do

Channel Testing & Execution

Help develop and execute a structured testing roadmap for new and emerging paid media channels, including programmatic display, Reddit, Snapchat, and other alternative platforms.
Own day-to-day campaign management across existing channels like Meta, TikTok, Snap, Reddit, and YouTube
Run tests on new channels, including setup, trafficking, pacing, and ongoing optimization.
Use performance data and judgment to make in-channel optimizations, escalating broader strategic decisions to the Senior Paid Acquisition Manager as needed.
Partner with the Creative team to brief, test, and iterate on ad assets tailored to each platform and audience.

Measurement & Reporting

Identify incrementality and lift study opportunities, collaborate with the Analytics team to design the test structure, and own the launch and ongoing performance monitoring of each experiment.
Track and report on key performance indicators for new and existing channel initiatives, translating data into clear summaries for internal stakeholders.
Maintain organized records of test results, learnings, and optimization actions to build a shared knowledge base for the team.

Cross-Brand & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Support acquisition growth across our brand portfolio—Acorns and Acorns Early.
Work collaboratively with Analytics, Creative, and other marketing teammates to execute experiments efficiently and surface actionable insights.
Actively monitor the AdTech landscape—including gaming platforms (e.g., Roblox, Discord), community platforms, and emerging programmatic DSPs—and bring forward channel opportunities for the team to evaluate.

What You Will Bring

3+ years of experience in performance marketing, paid media, or growth marketing with a BS/BA; or equivalent work experience.
Hands-on experience with at least one paid media platform (e.g., Meta, Snapchat, Reddit, The Trade Desk, or similar).
Familiarity with mobile measurement platforms (e.g., Adjust, AppsFlyer) and an understanding of how attribution frameworks inform paid media decisions. Exposure to Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) is a plus.
A data-driven mindset—you’re comfortable working with performance data and translating numbers into clear, actionable takeaways.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; you follow processes carefully, flag questions early, and aren’t afraid to modify your approach when the situation calls for it.
Clear written and verbal communication skills—you can summarize experiment results and share channel recommendations in a way that’s easy for stakeholders to act on.
Genuine curiosity about where digital advertising is heading and a hunger to explore channels competitors aren’t using yet.
A belief that your work is connected to something bigger—helping everyday people build financial security is core to what we do at Acorns, and we want teammates who are energized by that mission.

You are not expected to have experience with every platform listed. If you’re passionate about Acorns’ mission and eager to grow in performance marketing, we encourage you to apply.

What We Offer

Competitive salary and stock options
A comprehensive benefits package for you and your family
Flexible work location, hours, and paid time off
401(k) matching
Monthly Acorns account contribution & GoHenry account for your family
Mindfulness and Financial Wellness resources, Headspace and Addition Wealth
Acorns Career Development Program (Ongoing training sessions, development plans, development check-ins, Cornerstone’s online training platform)
Roots Leadership Program for Emerging Leaders
Community week onsite gatherings and various virtual events
Talented and motivated team members who care deeply about one another, our mission, and our customers.
The rare opportunity to create a new world. We inspire one another every day to do meaningful work that solves big societal challenges.

About Acorns

Acorns is the financial wellness company helping everyday Americans grow their money for the long term. Since 2014, Acorns has grown into a global company with multiple life stage products serving the needs of kids, teens, adults and parents. Named one of America's Best Financial Services of 2026 by TIME, Acorns has served over 16 million people, and helped customers save & invest over $33 billion dollars, much of it from spare change and small amounts.
