jobs.title: Content Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Overview

The Content Marketing Specialist serves as a key communications liaison to support the division and HRTD’s recruitment, marketing, and strategic functions. The Specialist is responsible for a variety of communications functions, to include strategic design and placement of recruitment communications and ads, developing and maintaining communication tools, supporting and promoting job fairs and hiring events through multiple platforms both paid and earned media, creating and distributing high-quality content marketing materials. The Content Marketing Specialist is responsible for analyzing and leveraging analytics in order to make strategic, data-driven marketing and communications recommendations.

Roles And Responsibilities

The following information is intended to describe the overall nature and scope of the work being performed. This is not a comprehensive listing of all responsibilities or tasks; work may differ and other work may be assigned when deemed appropriate.

Collaborates with HRTD to support the alignment of large scale communication goals, marketing strategies and multi-channel campaign plans for LCPS recruitment activities
Develops presentations, social media campaigns, news releases, fact sheets, website content, video content and other information sharing tools
Works with the communications office to support the LCPS brand in publication development
Builds a strategic sourcing plan for LCPS recruitment in all areas, including researching and building a network of recruiting sources, internal referrals, and other external resources such as social media outlets, websites, industry associations, and print and radio advertisements
Works in partnership with HRTD to maintain LCPS brand integrity across all recruitment and informational publications
Creates and coordinates large scale recruitment materials and advertisements tailored to reach a wide range of candidates, in collaboration with vendors and HRTD
Manages the social media sites and editorial calendar to support LCPS communication
Analyzes data and leverage analytics to assist in decision making

Qualifications

Below are the minimum qualifications for this job. Equivalent combinations of education and experience may be considered.

Education

Bachelor’s Degree in Communications, Marketing or similar field

Experience

Five (5) years of professional experience in marketing or communications
Experience in managing, developing and executing social media campaigns, both paid and earned
Experience in planning and managing internal (employee) and external communication programs

Licenses And Certifications

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

Excellent oral, written and interpersonal communication skills
Understanding of brand awareness and current marketing strategies and trends
Demonstrated effective project management skills, from concept and planning through tactical execution and evaluation, including managing the work of various professionals in the development and delivery of publications and web content
Possesses the professional and personal characteristics necessary for working effectively with school and administrative personnel at multiple levels of the organization, as well as external stakeholders
Strong writing and graphic design skills
Knowledge of recruitment and sourcing strategies

Physical Requirements

The following provides a brief description of physical requirements for this job:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to communicate verbally and exchange information with others. The employee must be able to convey detailed or important instructions accurately and effectively. The employee must possess the cognitive abilities necessary to learn, recall, interpret, and apply relevant practices, policies, laws, and procedures. The employee may occasionally be required to exert up to 25 pounds of force and exert negligible amounts of force to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects.

Reports to
: Supervisor, Communications

FLSA Status
: Exempt

Months/Days/Hours
: 12 months/ 254 days/ 8 hours

Salary Level
: Universal/Scale B.2 - Level 14

Salary Scale
: https://www.lcps.org/compensation

Salary Range
: $91,002 - $156,961

Remote Work Eligible
: Partial

Union Designation
: Non-Union

Remote Work Disclosure

Employees who perform the responsibilities of the above position have been identified as having the potential to telework. Telework is defined as completing one's duties and responsibilities at a site other than one's assigned duty location. In order to be eligible for telework privileges, an employee must have demonstrated consistent, positive performance and have the support and approval of their direct supervisor. In addition, these employees must have reliable high-speed internet and a designated workspace that allows them privacy while completing sensitive and confidential work. Employees who are non-exempt and are teleworking will work their required scheduled hours and gain approval from their supervisor if they work more than 8 hours a day or more than 40 hours in a workweek. Teleworking privileges can be amended, changed, or revoked based upon the performance of the employee, as well as the needs of Loudoun County Public Schools.

jobs.title: Product Demand - Marketing Senior Manager
jobs.description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What You’ll Be Doing…

As the Product Demand - Marketing Senior Manager, you will play a critical role within the Growth Marketing team, directly supporting and reporting to the Associate Director of Growth Marketing product demand campaigns. You are the tactical execution engine and central point of coordination between Product, Marketing, Sales, and Solutions teams to bring growth marketing campaigns to market to drive demand.

This is an execution-focused growth marketing role—not a general product marketing function. You will translate product positioning and messaging into actionable, full-funnel growth strategies and high-converting marketing campaigns. Your focus will center on audience segmentation, targeted list development, multi-channel demand generation campaigns, and aggressive customer migration initiatives—specifically driving the transition from legacy TDM (Time Division Multiplexing) networks to Verizon’s Advanced Solutions as well as demand for these products among prospects.

Strategic Campaign Development & Coordination

Integrated Campaign Management: Developing comprehensive briefs and implementing integrated marketing campaigns designed to boost lead generation, pipeline velocity, customer acquisition, and revenue growth across Global Enterprise (GE), Public Sector (PS) and Business Market (BM) segments.
Cross-Functional Governance: Serving as the central point of coordination between Product Marketing, Segment Marketing, Field Marketing, Integrated Marketing and creative execution teams in development and execution of growth campaigns. Establishing clear communication channels and regular governance processes to provide campaign updates, align on objectives, and track execution.
Continuous Feedback Loop: Proactively engaging with field marketing and solutions teams to assess growth opportunities, actively solicit feedback on campaign performance, and rapidly iterate on tactics.

Tactical Growth Execution & Messaging Guidance

Strategy-to-Tactics Translation: Taking overarching value propositions from Product Marketing and converting them into concrete, multi-touch growth campaigns.
Messaging & Creative Guidance: Providing creative guidance based on strategic messaging for growth campaign development that highlights Verizon’s unique value, addresses key customer friction points, and demonstrates Verizon’s value proposition.
TDM-to-IP Migration Campaigns: Planning and executing time-sensitive migration campaigns to transition from legacy TDM/copper networks to modern fiber, Ethernet, and advanced wireless solutions.
Content development: Partnering with third parties and stakeholders in the development of meaningful content to drive demand in programmatic and syndication efforts.

Segmentation & List Development

Audience Segmentation: Working with database marketing to build, refine, and maintain granular target lists derived from Verizon customer base analytics
List Enrichment & AI Capabilities: Utilizing internal customer databases and AI resources to size the addressable market and develop targeted campaign lists.

Sales Enablement, Market Feedback & Performance Tracking

Sales Enablement Kits: Packaging marketing assets into plug-and-play outreach toolkits for direct sales reps and account executives to capitalize on lead generation.
Performance Analytics & Optimization: Tracking and measuring campaign progress against KPI’s (Click-to-Convert Rates, Migration TDM-to-IP Conversions, MQL/SQL Volume, and Incremental Bookings generated) to optimize ROI.

What We’re Looking For…

You are a highly collaborative, data-driven, and execution-oriented marketer who excels at hitting aggressive revenue targets. You know how to translate product capabilities into actionable demand campaigns.

You’ll Need To Have

Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
Relevant marketing experience in B2B growth marketing, demand generation, campaign execution,marketing strategy, and/or Product Marketing.
Willingness to travel.

Even Better If You Have one or more of the following:

Experience in legacy network modernization campaigns or enterprise telecom product campaigns (Managed Network Services, IoT/FWA, Private Wireless, SIP/Voice, Wireline, CX solutions).
Experience with audience targeting.
Experience presenting deck/presentation to all levels of th organization including executive leadership.
Experience developing campaigns in the enterprise, Public Sector and B2B marketing space.
Practical experience applying AI tools for list building, campaign personalization, predictive audience targeting, and workflow efficiency.
Proficiency with marketing automation platforms (e.g., Marketo, Eloqua), CRMs (Salesforce), and database segmentation tools.
Customer segmentation experience.
Experience with cross-functional leadership, analytical, and stakeholder management skills
Proven track record in multi-channel campaign execution.
Demonstrated experience translating positioning and messaging frameworks into tactical marketing plans and brief creation.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits And Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $105,000.00 - $201,000.00.

The annual salary range for the Illinois location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $115,500.00 - $201,000.00.

The annual salary range for the New York location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $115,500.00 - $201,000.00.

jobs.description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What You’ll Be Doing…

As the Product Demand - Marketing Senior Manager, you will play a critical role within the Growth Marketing team, directly supporting and reporting to the Associate Director of Growth Marketing product demand campaigns. You are the tactical execution engine and central point of coordination between Product, Marketing, Sales, and Solutions teams to bring growth marketing campaigns to market to drive demand.

This is an execution-focused growth marketing role—not a general product marketing function. You will translate product positioning and messaging into actionable, full-funnel growth strategies and high-converting marketing campaigns. Your focus will center on audience segmentation, targeted list development, multi-channel demand generation campaigns, and aggressive customer migration initiatives—specifically driving the transition from legacy TDM (Time Division Multiplexing) networks to Verizon’s Advanced Solutions as well as demand for these products among prospects.

Strategic Campaign Development & Coordination

Integrated Campaign Management: Developing comprehensive briefs and implementing integrated marketing campaigns designed to boost lead generation, pipeline velocity, customer acquisition, and revenue growth across Global Enterprise (GE), Public Sector (PS) and Business Market (BM) segments.
Cross-Functional Governance: Serving as the central point of coordination between Product Marketing, Segment Marketing, Field Marketing, Integrated Marketing and creative execution teams in development and execution of growth campaigns. Establishing clear communication channels and regular governance processes to provide campaign updates, align on objectives, and track execution.
Continuous Feedback Loop: Proactively engaging with field marketing and solutions teams to assess growth opportunities, actively solicit feedback on campaign performance, and rapidly iterate on tactics.

Tactical Growth Execution & Messaging Guidance

Strategy-to-Tactics Translation: Taking overarching value propositions from Product Marketing and converting them into concrete, multi-touch growth campaigns.
Messaging & Creative Guidance: Providing creative guidance based on strategic messaging for growth campaign development that highlights Verizon’s unique value, addresses key customer friction points, and demonstrates Verizon’s value proposition.
TDM-to-IP Migration Campaigns: Planning and executing time-sensitive migration campaigns to transition from legacy TDM/copper networks to modern fiber, Ethernet, and advanced wireless solutions.
Content development: Partnering with third parties and stakeholders in the development of meaningful content to drive demand in programmatic and syndication efforts.

Segmentation & List Development

Audience Segmentation: Working with database marketing to build, refine, and maintain granular target lists derived from Verizon customer base analytics
List Enrichment & AI Capabilities: Utilizing internal customer databases and AI resources to size the addressable market and develop targeted campaign lists.

Sales Enablement, Market Feedback & Performance Tracking

Sales Enablement Kits: Packaging marketing assets into plug-and-play outreach toolkits for direct sales reps and account executives to capitalize on lead generation.
Performance Analytics & Optimization: Tracking and measuring campaign progress against KPI’s (Click-to-Convert Rates, Migration TDM-to-IP Conversions, MQL/SQL Volume, and Incremental Bookings generated) to optimize ROI.

What We’re Looking For…

You are a highly collaborative, data-driven, and execution-oriented marketer who excels at hitting aggressive revenue targets. You know how to translate product capabilities into actionable demand campaigns.

You’ll Need To Have

Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
Relevant marketing experience in B2B growth marketing, demand generation, campaign execution,marketing strategy, and/or Product Marketing.
Willingness to travel.

Even Better If You Have one or more of the following:

Experience in legacy network modernization campaigns or enterprise telecom product campaigns (Managed Network Services, IoT/FWA, Private Wireless, SIP/Voice, Wireline, CX solutions).
Experience with audience targeting.
Experience presenting deck/presentation to all levels of th organization including executive leadership.
Experience developing campaigns in the enterprise, Public Sector and B2B marketing space.
Practical experience applying AI tools for list building, campaign personalization, predictive audience targeting, and workflow efficiency.
Proficiency with marketing automation platforms (e.g., Marketo, Eloqua), CRMs (Salesforce), and database segmentation tools.
Customer segmentation experience.
Experience with cross-functional leadership, analytical, and stakeholder management skills
Proven track record in multi-channel campaign execution.
Demonstrated experience translating positioning and messaging frameworks into tactical marketing plans and brief creation.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits And Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. Brand Management at Riot is focused on our players. Our mission is to make it better to be a player by building trust, inspiring fandom, and delivering meaningful experiences that resonate globally.

As a Brand Manager for an undisclosed R&D game, reporting to the Director of Global Brand Management, you will help introduce a brand-new product to players for the very first time. This is a rare opportunity to be an early pioneer, shaping how this product shows up in the world, how players first experience it, and how the brand and live service evolve over time.

You will be focused on driving go-to-market strategy and executing global player experiences that bring this new game to life, operating at the intersection of product, publishing, and creative to align teams, build momentum, and deliver key moments with clarity, craft, and operational excellence. This role is ideal for a highly organized, execution-driven brand marketer who thrives in ambiguity and loves bringing big moments to market.

Responsibilities

Deliver against global go-to-market strategy, translating global game experiences into clear, actionable marketing plans, briefs, and milestones that teams can execute against with confidence
Lead execution of cross-functional campaigns end-to-end, from framing objectives and defining audiences through creative development, production, launch, and post-launch evaluation.
Partner closely with external and internal partners such as Product, Publishing, Creative, Production, Community, Social, Comms, and Regional teams to align priorities, timelines, and execution plans across functions.
Own the development and execution of core go-to-market tactics, including channel planning, asset development, launch sequencing, and cross-channel coordination across owned, earned, and partner surfaces.
Serve as the accountable on-team owner for campaign rollout and tactical execution, overseeing end-to-end development of marquee moments, including briefing and alignment with external vendors and agency partners, while partnering with producers and channel owners who support day-to-day execution.
Drive cross-functional coordination and operational rigor, maintaining sources of truth such as campaign roadmaps, timelines, creative trackers, and status updates.
Ensure campaigns are delivered on time, on brief, and on budget, proactively identifying risks and dependencies and helping teams navigate tradeoffs.
Support the development of scalable campaign frameworks and go-to-market processes that can evolve as the product grows into a long-term live service.
Partner with Analytics and Insights to evaluate campaign performance, synthesize learnings, and apply optimizations to evolve the publishing playbook.

Required Qualifications

4+ years of experience in brand management, product marketing, publishing, or equivalent roles, agency or in-house.
Experience delivering integrated go-to-market campaigns from strategy through execution in fast-moving environments.
Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with a track record of aligning multiple teams and stakeholders around shared goals.
Exceptional organizational and project management abilities, comfortable managing complex timelines, dependencies, and deliverables.
Demonstrated strength in execution, able to turn strategy into action and keep work moving forward with clarity and momentum.
Experience working on live-service products or ongoing content-driven marketing programs and with first party or third party partners to land product/brand campaigns.
Excellent communication skills, including the ability to write clear briefs, present plans, and drive alignment across partners.
Passion for games and empathy for players.

Desired Qualifications

Familiarity with global publishing models and working with regional or international partners.
Experience or passion for the games industry, entertainment, or youth-culture-driven brands.

For this role, you will find success through collaboration, operational excellence, and a deep commitment to delivering great player experiences. If you are energized by launching something new, aligning teams around bold moments, and turning ideas into action this could be the role for you.

You'll develop a differentiated market narrative that resonates with technical and executive buyers, establish Blitzy as a category leader, and build the programs, systems, and team required to support our next phase of hypergrowth.

Deep expertise in product marketing, enterprise demand generation, account-based marketing, and go-to-market strategy.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Marketing Account Manager – Supply

Position: Marketing Account Manager – Supply
Area: Supply
Location: Remote
Reports to: Global Strategy Supply ManagerTarget Start: ASAP

About Classic Vacations – The Classic® Difference

Classic Vacations is the #1 luxury vacation wholesaler for Travel Advisors, driven by a singular purpose: to delight our clients with exceptional vacation experiences. Our team’s commitment to excellence ensures that every journey we create is seamless, luxurious, and filled with unforgettable moments. We take pride in our role as trusted partners to travel professionals worldwide, providing world-class accommodations, unparalleled service, and exclusive privileges in premier destinations.

Role Overview

The Marketing Account Manager – Supply develops supplier-funded marketing partnerships that strengthen Classic Vacations’ position in luxury travel. Serving assigned hotel and tourism board partners across Hawaii, the South Pacific, Asia, Australia, the Americas, and other destinations, this role creates marketing opportunities that deliver measurable results and sustainable revenue growth.

The position leads partner discovery, annual co-op planning, customized proposals, presentations, negotiations, and account engagement. It manages co-op revenue goals, pipeline development, forecasting, contracts, and campaign handoffs while collaborating with Supply, Marketing, Sales, Operations, Creative, Digital, and Finance.

The role also supports European supplier marketing through proposals, campaign guidance, coordination, and reporting, while the Europe Supply team retains regional relationship ownership. Success requires strong relationships, commercial judgment, creativity, organization, and cross-functional accountability.

Why This Role Matters

This role connects supplier goals with effective co-op marketing, strengthening partner relationships, advisor engagement, revenue growth, and accountability across teams.
Key Responsibilities
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

Responsibilities include:
Supplier Marketing Strategy & Account Leadership

Strategic Account Ownership:
Serve as the primary marketing point of contact and strategic account manager for assigned hotel and tourism board partners across Hawaii, the South Pacific, Asia, Australia, the Americas, and other designated destinations, providing consistent relationship leadership, commercial direction, and marketing expertise.
Partner Discovery & Relationship Development:
Lead meaningful supplier conversations to understand partner objectives, commercial priorities, destination needs, booking windows, marketing budgets, and opportunities for mutual growth.
Annual Co-op Marketing Planning:
Lead the development of annual supplier co-op marketing strategies and plans, aligning proposed investments with partner goals, Classic's commercial priorities, and relevant advisor-facing marketing opportunities.
Customized Marketing Solutions:
Develop compelling, tailored marketing recommendations that reflect supplier needs, target audiences, destination positioning, seasonal opportunities, and Classic Vacations' luxury brand standards.
Strategic Presentations & Negotiations:
Prepare and deliver professional supplier presentations, communicate the value of Classic's marketing portfolio, and negotiate appropriate opportunities and commitments.
Incremental Revenue Opportunities:
Proactively identify opportunities for additional co-op investments, marketing packages, à la carte placements, educational programs, supplier promotions, and relevant sales events.
Relationship Continuity:
Maintain consistent, proactive communication with assigned partners, strengthening trust, managing expectations, and ensuring marketing priorities remain aligned throughout the partnership lifecycle.
Commercial Partnership Development:
Identify opportunities to deepen supplier engagement, strengthen long-term relationships, and expand the strategic and commercial value of assigned marketing accounts.

Europe Supplier Marketing Support & Regional Alignment

Europe Supply Partnership:
Collaborate closely with the Europe Supply team to support supplier marketing strategy, annual marketing plans, campaign proposals, and partner initiatives while respecting established regional relationship ownership.
Marketing Portfolio Expertise:
Provide guidance regarding Classic's available marketing programs, advertising opportunities, campaign formats, pricing structures, deliverables, and promotional capabilities.
Proposal & Presentation Support:
Assist the Europe Supply team with developing supplier-facing marketing proposals, presentations, tactic recommendations, and supporting materials.
Campaign Coordination:
Support the coordination and execution of European supplier marketing initiatives, helping ensure approved plans are communicated effectively and delivered according to agreed expectations.
Reporting & Performance Support:
Provide relevant marketing reporting, campaign insights, and performance information to support Europe Supply's partner discussions and ongoing planning.
Regional Commercial Alignment:
Ensure European marketing recommendations reflect Supply-led partner relationships, regional priorities, supplier objectives, and Classic's broader commercial strategy.
Clarity of Ownership:
Maintain a collaborative approach that distinguishes primary marketing account ownership in assigned non-European regions from the specialized marketing support provided to Europe.

Co-op Revenue Development, Forecasting & Financial Accountability

Co-op Revenue Ownership:
Manage assigned co-op marketing revenue goals, identifying opportunities to achieve and strengthen commercial performance through strategic supplier engagement.
Pipeline Development:
Maintain an accurate and actionable pipeline of proposed marketing investments, signed commitments, incremental opportunities, and potential future business.
Revenue Forecasting:
Prepare and maintain reliable co-op revenue forecasts, communicating expected commitments, changes, risks, and opportunities to appropriate leadership stakeholders.
Marketing Proposals & Agreements:
Prepare accurate supplier proposals, marketing agreements, tactic selections, pricing details, campaign street dates, and supporting contractual documentation.
Contract Coordination:
Coordinate required approval and signature workflows, ensuring marketing commitments are appropriately documented and aligned with established processes.
Commitment Tracking:
Maintain organized records of supplier marketing plans, approved tactics, campaign deliverables, financial commitments, and relevant deadlines.
Financial Reconciliation:
Reconcile marketing commitments and plan records with reporting and forecast systems to maintain visibility into revenue performance and outstanding obligations.
Finance Partnership:
Collaborate closely with Finance to coordinate co-op marketing invoicing schedules, support accurate billing and revenue tracking, provide timely forecast updates, and reconcile marketing plans against financial records.
Commercial Risk Management:
Proactively identify potential revenue shortfalls, delayed commitments, invoicing concerns, or changes affecting marketing plans and communicate recommended next steps to leadership.
Financial Integrity:
Support accurate, transparent financial reporting through timely documentation, disciplined follow-through, and consistent coordination across Supply, Marketing, and Finance.

Marketing Campaign Planning, Execution & Performance

Campaign Translation:
Convert signed supplier marketing plans into clear campaign briefs, deliverables, timelines, ownership expectations, and cross-functional execution requirements.
Cross-Functional Campaign Coordination:
Partner with Marketing Operations, Creative, Digital, Sales, and Supply to ensure marketing initiatives are executed consistently and effectively.
Multi-Channel Marketing Activation:
Coordinate supplier-funded marketing opportunities across relevant advisor-facing channels, including email, website, booking engine, social media, webinars, editorial content, and other approved marketing programs.
Campaign Readiness:
Monitor campaign preparation, creative requirements, supplier deliverables, approvals, launch dates, and operational dependencies to support timely execution.
Deliverable Accountability:
Maintain visibility into committed marketing tactics and ensure appropriate teams understand campaign expectations, deadlines, and required handoffs.
Campaign Performance Monitoring:
Review campaign performance, supplier outcomes, and relevant engagement or production indicators to evaluate marketing effectiveness.
Proof of Performance:
Coordinate the collection and communication of appropriate campaign performance documentation and reporting to support supplier commitments.
Optimization Opportunities:
Identify opportunities to refine marketing recommendations, improve campaign performance, and strengthen the value of future supplier investments.
Follow-Up Investment: Use campaign outcomes and partner feedback to identify appropriate additional marketing opportunities and support ongoing account development.

jobs.title: VP of Marketing (Growth)
jobs.description:
APPLY HERE!
https://lineage.typeform.com/to/lfVmQPMs

The TL;DR - Who we’re looking for

As VP of Marketing (Growth), you'll own Lineage's growth engine: new-customer acquisition, the marketing P&L, and the experimentation program behind every spend, offer, and creative decision. You'll lead a cross-functional team across paid acquisition, creative and content, CRO, ecommerce, email and retention, affiliates, and partnerships, and you'll be accountable for new-customer growth, CAC efficiency, and LTV expansion.
You'll also lead how the team uses AI across creative production, testing, reporting, and analysis, and you'll use it in your own work every day.
This role is ideal for a hands-on, analytical growth leader who has scaled a CPG or DTC brand to $100M+, runs growth on written hypotheses and clean tests, and wants to build that system at a profitable, bootstrapped, subscription-driven brand. Experience growing a brand with well-known founders is a big plus.

About Lineage

Lineage Provisions makes animal-based nutrition products with high standards for quality, nutrient density, taste, and transparency. The company was founded by Paul Saladino MD and Anthony Gustin DC and sources from producers and farms committed to regenerative agriculture. We sell primarily direct to consumer on Shopify, with most revenue coming from subscriptions. We are mid-eight figures in revenue, profitable, bootstrapped, and fully remote.

💪 Why Lineage Provisions?

We think that the majority of health products online are just a bunch of garbage with fancy labels trying to sell trendy items for a quick buck. We make the best products we possibly can to help humans eat like humans. We believe that real-food nutrition is the cornerstone for proper human health. We exist to make adhering to this lifestyle easy and delicious.
We also are passionate proponents of regenerative agriculture. Regenerative agriculture is the only way we can produce food indefinitely. The vast majority of how we currently produce food is destroying our ecosystems which we depend on for survival. The more we support regenerative agriculture, the more we support a food system that can continue to feed people in the future. There is no other option.
Eating a hyper local and seasonal diet is the best way to approach nutrition, but the reality is most food is purchased in packaged form. We aim to drive a wedge into that industry by sourcing from the best farms, making the best products, and displacing those that cut corners and sell lies.
If we’re successful with Lineage Provisions, we will help transition farms from conventional to regenerative agriculture, all while nourishing the people who are supporting us to do so. And we need your help!

About The Role

We are looking for a VP of Marketing (Growth) to lead new-customer acquisition and revenue growth across our DTC business. You will own the marketing P&L and experimentation program, and you will manage a cross-functional team spanning paid acquisition, creative and content, CRO, ecomm, email/retention, affiliate, and partnerships.
Our approach to growth is traditional: form a hypothesis, run a clean test, read the result, and apply what you learn to the next decision. The team already includes dedicated retention and marketing directors, so this role is focused on measurable growth rather than brand marketing. Success is defined by new-customer growth, CAC efficiency, and LTV expansion.

What You’ll Do

1. Growth Strategy & Experimentation
Set the growth roadmap and translate it into weekly execution and clear KPIs
Run a structured testing program across audiences, offers, funnels, landing pages, and creative, with written hypotheses, weekly readouts, and documented decisions
Own growth reporting and dashboards that leadership and finance rely on, including attribution and incrementality testing and cohort LTV analysis
Partner with finance on forecasting, budget pacing, and first-order profitability

2. Paid Acquisition
Own the paid media budget and performance across Meta, Google, YouTube, and emerging channels such as TikTok
Scale spend while holding CAC, payback, and contribution margin targets

3. Creative Strategy
Lead creative strategy for paid and organic growth: ad concept development, UGC production, and iteration speed
Work with the content team and founders to turn performance data into creative priorities

4. Acquisition Beyond Paid Social
Build affiliate and performance partnership programs
Develop programs that convert the organic audiences of Dr. Paul Saladino and Dr. Anthony Gustin into customers, including lead magnets, advertorial funnels, and whitelisting

5. Offers, Funnels & Retention
Test offers (bundles, entry price points, sample packs) and funnels (subscription, lead generation) to improve conversion rate, AOV, and acquisition efficiency
Work with the Director of Retention and Director of Marketing on email/SMS, post-purchase flows, and campaigns that improve repeat purchase rate and 30/60/90-day cohort LTV

6. Team Leadership
Lead, hire, and develop the growth team, and set quarterly goals and clear ownership across channels
Manage agency and contractor relationships while owning outcomes

😍 You'll love this role if

You approach growth like a scientist: you form hypotheses, run structured tests, and let the results decide
You enjoy building funnels, testing offers, and developing creative angles until you find what works
You think in systems and want to build a growth program that runs without you
You're hands-on and happy to build alongside your team
You use AI every day to work faster and better, and you want your team to do the same
You give direct feedback and hold yourself and your team to a high bar
You can set a clear strategy and get your team and leadership aligned behind it
You care about nutrition, real food, metabolic health, and the environment
You do your best work in a low-ego, remote, async environment where clear writing matters

🤬 You'll hate this role if:

You need a large team around you to get things shipped
You'd rather manage agencies than get into the work yourself
You prefer quick growth hacks to sustainable, customer-centric growth
You're used to scaling with large amounts of outside funding
You prefer meetings to written, async communication
You need close direction to solve problems
You're looking for a clearly defined career path
You prefer doing the same tasks every day
You prefer the structure of a large corporate environment

📈 What You’ll Bring

6+ years of growth or performance marketing experience in DTC eCommerce; CPG or supplements/VMS experience strongly preferred
Experience scaling a CPG or DTC brand to $100M+ in revenue, managing a cross-functional team and multi-million-dollar annual paid media budgets
Direct ownership of a marketing P&L, with accountability for CAC, payback, and contribution margin
A disciplined approach to testing: hypotheses in writing, well-designed tests, honest readouts, and clear scale-or-kill decisions
Strong analytical skills; you can build and explain the models behind budget decisions, including first-order profitability and ROAS vs. LTV tradeoffs
Hands-on experience with attribution and incrementality testing, using platforms such as Haus, Prescient, Triple Whale, or Northbeam
Experience growing a subscription business, with fluency in nCAC, aMER, iROAS, cohort LTV, and churn
Creative strategy experience for paid social, including ad concept frameworks and landing-page CRO

Nice to Have
Experience with founder-led or organic-to-paid acquisition programs
Background or genuine interest in health, nutrition, or food
Comfort in a fully remote, async, low-ego work environment

Compensation & Benefits

Full-time salary with bonus opportunities based on company performance. Benefits include:
Top-of-the-line health, vision, and dental plans with employer matching
Monthly stipends for local farmer's market and food, gym or personal fitness, and mental wellness
Free Kindle and unlimited free books
$3,000 per year for continued learning and training programs
Free Lineage products and friends-and-family discounts
Unlimited time off and a parent-friendly working environment
Fully remote and location-independent, with no set work schedule and no monitoring of hours

jobs.title: Head of Growth & Marketing
jobs.description:
About High Camp

High Camp was born from a love of craft cocktails and the great outdoors. What began as a Kickstarter campaign has grown into a brand known for premium, beautifully designed products that are built to last and made to share.

We design Fortified Barware for people who care about what they pour, wherever they pour it. We make it easy to craft and carry your favorite drinks everywhere from the backyard to the backcountry.

We're a lean team that has grown primarily through a strong direct-to-consumer business. Now we're building toward true omni-channel growth across DTC, wholesale/B2B, corporate gifting, and marketplaces. This hire is one of the most important seats in the company.

Head of Growth & Marketing

About the job

As Head of Growth & Marketing, you'll own High Camp's acquisition, retention, and revenue performance across our direct-to-consumer business, our largest revenue channel, while supporting marketing needs across the broader company. You'll lead our creative and performance marketing team, translate brand direction into marketing that performs across every channel, and oversee the partners and systems that power growth and e-commerce. This role is a deliberate middle ground between a pure growth operator and a CMO: strong growth fundamentals come first, with enough marketing range to serve the whole company.

This role reports to our CEO & you’ll lead an in-house team across creative, performance, and organic, and direct a roster of agency and contract partners covering media buying, email and SMS, video and design, web development, and emerging channels. You’ll own a seven-figure media budget, the partner relationships behind it, and the decisions about how this capability is resourced as we scale.

What you'll do

Own DTC growth and e-commerce performance.
Hold the DTC revenue target and contribution margin, not just top-line revenue. Whoever executes the work, the outcome sits with you.
Partner with Finance on forecasting and reporting.
Build the annual and peak-season paid media budget and an inventory-aware DTC forecast, set efficiency targets, and review performance against plan regularly.
Lead paid growth strategy.
Own risk analysis and go/no-go calls on paid and marketplace spend, using incrementality testing to know where the next marginal dollar earns the most.
Run creative as a performance lever.
Direct our in-house creative team and creative vendors, and build the creative testing program and creator/UGC pipeline that feed paid performance.
Grow organic reach.
Set direction for social, PR, affiliates and brand partnerships, and make sure they build demand that paid and retention can convert.
Own retention and lifecycle.
Set email and SMS strategy, calendar and LTV goals, and own the repeat purchase and LTV targets that come with them. You’ll work through a mix of in-house and partner resources, and you’ll shape how that mix evolves as the business scales.
Own go-to-market, launches and promotions.
Plan launches around when product actually lands and around wholesale and corporate timelines, own the promotional calendar, and translate brand direction from the founders into channel execution.
Make marketing show up for the whole company.
Make sure the content engine produces assets our wholesale and corporate custom teams can use, and that paid supports where DTC and B2B overlap, like corporate gifting in Q4. When channels compete for the same product, creative or spend, make the call that's right for the company.
Own the analytics and marketing tech stack.
Make sure tracking and reporting can be trusted, decide what to keep or retire, and direct the technical resources who run it.
Build the team.
Shape the growth and marketing functions as the business scales, deciding what to build in-house and what to contract or partner. We expect AI and automation to be a real part of that answer, so the function grows on leverage rather than headcount alone.

Key requirements

Owned the number.
You’ve owned a DTC P&L or contribution margin line at a brand doing $20M or more, and can describe the efficiency targets you were accountable for.
Came up as an operator.
You started as a media buyer or close to it, and you’ve since managed media buyers or agencies rather than only executing buys yourself.
Proven creative testing
. You’ve directed a creative team or vendors producing high-volume, fast-iteration content, and built a testing or creator/UGC program whose results changed where spend went.
Planned around real constraints
. You’ve forecast demand where supply was limited (long lead times, seasonal peaks, constrained launches) and adjusted spend to match.
Retention results.
You’ve grown repeat purchase or LTV through email and SMS, including work with outside partners.
Hands-on measurement.
You’ve run a tracking or analytics implementation and can walk us through it. You’re fluent in growth math (MER, CAC, contribution margin, incrementality) and can pressure-test any buyer’s or agency’s plan.
Built growth teams.
You’ve built and led growth teams, decided when to hire, contract or partner, and directed technical or e-commerce platform resources.
Tools.
Deep Shopify literacy, hands-on with Meta, Google and TikTok ads, and working knowledge of modern attribution tools.
Location:
Remote-friendly across the U.S., with hybrid co-working options available in Bozeman, MT; San Rafael, CA; or Golden, CO.
Travel:
Two team retreat/collaboration trips per year to a hub location, plus 2–3 additional business trips per year as needed.

Nice-to-haves

You’ve supported B2B, wholesale, retail or corporate gifting alongside DTC.
Experience on both sides of the agency table, or running an agency selection or transition.
Incrementality testing and media-mix modeling, or experience scaling newer channels like AppLovin and TikTok.
You’ve worked on premium consumer goods, lifestyle brands, or hard goods, where the product itself carries the brand.

Salary & benefits

Expected base salary range (San Francisco Bay Area): $170,000 - $210,000 USD. Offered compensation will vary based on geographic location, as well as relevant experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance.

Eligible for target bonus of 20% of base salary
Choice of three PPO medical plans, with employee coverage on our base plan 100% company-paid
Dental, vision, and HSA plan options
Flexible PTO
401(k) with up to 5% company match
Monthly cell phone stipend
Paid parental leave (16 weeks for birthing parents, 12 weeks for non-birthing parents)
Remote-friendly, with flexible schedules in a high-trust, high-autonomy culture
Office hubs and bi-annual company offsites for in-person collaboration and community

High Camp is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Applicants must be currently authorized to permanently work in the United States. At this time, we are not able to sponsor employment visas or provide relocation assistance.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Join Team Amex and let's lead the way together.

Resy is the American Express global dining platform within U.S. Consumer Services (USCS). Our mission is to power the world’s best restaurants, using technology to imagine the future of hospitality. Our customers discover the amazing world of restaurants thanks to our content-rich website and innovative mobile app. Our diners are insiders, and we love having them at the table. The team is responsible for reimagining hospitality and redefining the way restaurants and diners connect through a single network.

Interested in joining our team of restaurant-obsessed explorers? Right this way.   

About The Role

We’re looking for a Senior
Analyst, Venue Retention & Lifecycle Marketing
, to support the execution and optimization of Resy’s venue retention, nurture, and B2B content marketing strategy. Reporting to the Manager of Venue Lifecycle and Retention Marketing
, this role will play a key part in bringing data-driven, multi-channel marketing programs to life that deepen restaurant partner engagement, strengthen loyalty, drive product adoption, and support long-term partner retention.

This individual will work closely with the Manager of Venue Retention Marketing to execute partner nurture strategies and B2B content programs across the venue lifecycle
, translating strategic priorities, partner insights, and product value into relevant and compelling communications. They will own key executional workstreams across email and editorial content
including the B2B Content Calendar and end-to-end development of Resy’s partner eNewsletter, while supporting the development and execution of trigger-based and ongoing nurture journeys.

The role will sit at the intersection of lifecycle marketing, B2B content, email execution, and marketing operations
. This person will partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Partner Success, Product, Creative, Compliance, and other teams to move campaigns and initiatives from ideation and briefing through development, approval, deployment, measurement, and optimization. They will bring strong operational rigor to the team, ensuring that multiple campaigns, stakeholders, approvals, and deadlines are effectively managed.

The ideal candidate is an organized and execution-oriented marketer with strong email, editorial, and social instincts and analytical curiosity
. They are equally comfortable developing a content idea, building an email campaign, coordinating a legal review, analyzing campaign performance, and managing a complex project plan. They have a desire to understand our hospitality partners and use data-driven lifecycle marketing to create communications that deliver meaningful value.

Responsibilities

Support the execution and optimization of Resy’s venue retention and lifecycle marketing strategy, bringing partner-facing content and communications to life across email, editorial, and social channels.
Lead execution of partner email and lifecycle programs, including Resy’s partner eNewsletter, developing relevant, engaging communications across key partner moments while evolving and optimizing evergreen engagement strategies.
Manage Resy’s B2B editorial ecosystem, including supporting blog maintenance and owning the content calendar, translating product capabilities, industry trends, partner stories, and business priorities into timely partner-facing content.
Partner with the Manager to advance personalization, segmentation, and ongoing optimization of email and content, using partner insights and performance data to improve the relevance and effectiveness of communications.
Support cross-functional campaign execution, partnering with Sales, Partner Success, Product, Product Marketing, Creative, Compliance, and other stakeholders to keep initiatives aligned and on track.
Support the development of partner retention and loyalty strategies, identifying opportunities to deepen engagement through new channels, programs, events, and partner experiences.
Maintain strong operational processes and project management across campaigns and content, ensuring clear timelines, approvals, documentation, and performance reporting.
Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Partner Success, Product, Product Marketing, Creative, and other teams to ensure partner communications reflect shared business objectives.

Qualifications

2+ years of experience in lifecycle, CRM, email, B2B, content, digital, or integrated marketing, ideally within a SaaS, technology, hospitality, or partner-focused organization.
Hands-on experience developing and executing email or lifecycle marketing campaigns, with an understanding of campaign development from audience definition and content creation through QA, deployment, and reporting.
Strong editorial and writing skills, with the ability to generate content ideas and translate business priorities, product capabilities, and audience needs into clear and compelling B2B communications; familiarity with SEO principles is a plus.
Experience supporting or executing nurture and lifecycle marketing programs, with an understanding of segmentation, personalization, behavioral triggers, and journey-based marketing; familiarity with HubSpot is a plus.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to use campaign performance, CRM data, partner feedback, research, and other qualitative and quantitative insights to inform marketing decisions and identify opportunities for optimization.
Strong project management and organizational skills, with experience managing multiple campaigns, stakeholders, timelines, dependencies, and approval processes.
Experience navigating Compliance, Brand, or other structured marketing approval processes is a plus.
Strong written and verbal communication skills and demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across functions and stakeholders.

You’ll Thrive In This Role If You

Are both creative and execution-oriented—you enjoy developing content and campaign ideas and are equally energized by bringing them to life.
Have strong editorial instincts and intellectual curiosity, with an interest in understanding what content will be useful and engaging for Resy’s partners.
Are a highly organized project manager with exceptional attention to detail who can bring structure to complex work and keep multiple workstreams moving at once.
Are proactive and take ownership, following up with stakeholders, anticipating roadblocks, and keeping projects moving without needing every next step defined.
Have a “can do” approach to problem solving and are comfortable operating amid ambiguity, white space, evolving priorities, and strategic pauses.
Are analytically curious and interested in using performance data, partner behavior, and feedback to understand what’s working and continuously improve your work.
Are a strong cross-functional collaborator who can build productive relationships across Marketing, Partner Success, Product, Creative, Compliance, and external partners.
Have a desire to continuously learn and improve, building your expertise across lifecycle, content, and B2B marketing.
Have a passion for the hospitality industry and curiosity about the challenges, priorities, and opportunities facing Resy’s partners.

s

Partner with global HQ to provide market intelligence and ground-level channel insights that inform product lineup and portfolio strategy decisions.
Create high-quality reporting and presentations for both executive leadership reviews and customer-facing business meetings.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with experience preparing materials for executive leadership and external customers.

8+ years of experience in product marketing or category management within consumer electronics or retail industry.
Previous people management experience, including hiring, coaching, and leading a team.
Experience with and the ability to own P&L or revenue targets across retail channels, with strong analytical skills in market research, competitive analysis, and promotion planning.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About OpenSesame

OpenSesame is the trusted partner for workforce reinvention in the age of AI. We deliver integrated software, curated and customizable content, and expert services embedded into existing learning, HR, and work systems to help organizations expand their human + AI potential and thrive through change.

About the Role

OpenSesame is on a mission to become the global leader in corporate training and professional learning. As we expand our platform offerings and reinvent our workforce through AI adoption we are looking for an experienced Senior Product Marketing Manager to own this function within the organization and guide our strategic positioning, messaging, and enablement forward.

This role acts as the strategic centerpiece in our GTM org and is ideal for professionals who enjoy entrepreneurial ownership, cross-functional collaboration, and being a hands-on builder of strategy and assets.

Key Responsibilities:

Revenue Enablement:
Act as a subject-matter expert on messaging, market position, and competition. Develop GTM assets, case studies, and battlecards to aid the sales process.
Go-to-Market
- You’ll own the end-to-end GTM for the new product & features launching, from positioning & messaging, to asset creation, GTM launch management and internal enablement. You’ll collaborate with Product, Sales, Marketing and Customer Success teams to help create and test the positioning & messaging for your portfolios, which may include technology products and features, partnerships, or publishers.
GTM Impact Analysis:
Plan and execute ongoing analysis of the sales funnel, collateral kit, and GTM strategy inclusive of Win/Loss, sales cycle, engagement, and response.
Launch Program:
Build and manage a company-wide launch process for planning and directing the scope, schedule, and execution of our most critical moments.
Market Research:
Stay ahead of market trends, customer needs, and competitor moves. Engage with analysts and other industry stakeholders to build our brand and inform strategy. Use your insider-knowledge of our personas and industry to shape our unique approach to market.
Messaging & Positioning:
Build a compelling narrative around our products and value that we can take to market and win with. Help the organization tell our story more effectively by developing and aligning messaging, value propositions, and audiences.
Cross-Functional Alignment:
Collaborate with other teams to align GTM strategy, identify collateral needs, influence pricing and packaging, and ensure our market position is optimized for success.
Personal Effectiveness & AI utilization:
Create your own urgency, keep work organized, and have line of sight to achieving all deadlines. Have a plan to incorporate AI into the daily flow of work to contribute to your effectiveness.

Performance Objectives

First 30 Days:

Audit the existing selling collateral kit and sales playbook to identify areas of opportunity and notable gaps.
Refresh our competitor battlecards to reflect current market conditions and changes in messaging tied to AI.
Develop a working perspective on our brand messaging framework and identify gaps in implementation of this framework across the entire portfolio of channels and assets.
Create an initial POV on the key drivers of our value proposition that includes partners, publishers, and technology.
Establish relationships with key stakeholders across product management, sales, and the partner teams.
Learn about OpenSesame products and solutions and be able to accurately speak to their opportunities and position in the market.
Outline the plan for incorporating AI into the product marketing workflows.

First 90 Days:

Support GTM enablement as a subject-matter expert on messaging, market dynamics, competition, and positioning.
Establish a template and process for conducting company launches with an emphasis on cross-functional collaboration and audience optimization.
Establish a reporting cadence for key metrics including asset utilization, launch adoptions and outcomes, pipeline influence, and sales cycle metrics.
Collaborate with marketing stakeholders to build a messaging transition to in-market campaign process, determining key steps, templates, and RACI to ensure alignment between strategic messaging and positioning decisions and how we bring that to life in the market.
Build at least one LLM-based workflow to optimize your work.

First 6 Months:

Plan and engage analysts and industry stakeholders to evangelize OpenSesame’s products and position to share our story far and wide.
Deepen our GTM collateral kit through segmentation and targeting including industry-specific plays, persona targeted assets, and variable flows.
Utilize AI tools and processes to automate workflows, build templates, and gain organizational traction across the PMM function.
Leverage our robust publisher, partner, and customer audiences towards a combined narrative that compounds our value in the market.

By the end of Year 1:

Accelerate workflows across the GTM organization through streamlined, efficient processes, AI-enabled automations, and a fully realized PMM playbook.
Demonstrably accelerate and improve sales win rate, cycle speed, and engagement through improved collateral, processes, and strategic direction.
Help OpenSesame establish a defensible brand position as a global leader in corporate training and AI-enabled learning.

You might notice we don’t have the typical list of requirements and buzzwords here. That’s intentional.
We’re looking for proven examples from your career that show you can do this job, that you’ve built systems, driven alignment, and created impact at scale. When you look back a year from now, you’ll know you’ve made OpenSesame better, faster, and stronger because of your leadership.
Although it should go without saying (but it doesn’t), OpenSesame is an equal opportunity employer and we strive to create a welcoming, inclusive environment that celebrates diversity.

We use AI. For real.
Every team at OpenSesame works with AI tools daily, not as a buzzword, but as practice. You'll build fluency that most companies are still talking about adopting, with hands-on training and clear guardrails to experiment responsibly. AI amplifies your creativity and judgment. It doesn't replace them. The skills you build here travel with you.

Location:
This position can be based anywhere in the US. We operate as a remote-first company, and invest in mandatory all-company meetings several times a year in addition to required team travel as necessary.

Performance Driven:
We're looking for self-starters with a track record of delivering excellent results, but we're highly selective about who we hire. We don't focus on typical job requirements, instead, we're interested in specific examples from your past experiences. All positions can be based anywhere in the US, and require up to 15 days of travel per year, with senior management and leadership teams requiring up to 35 days.

Compensation:
The pay range for this position is generally between $140,000 and $170,000, depending on experience. At OpenSesame, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to employees upon hire, including professional development, ISOs, health insurance, 401(k) matching, and paid time off.

Benefits:
Benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible PTO, 401(k) matching, incentive stock options, volunteer time off, Employee Resource Groups, and a generous professional development program with dedicated annual time off for learning and growth.

Equal Employment Opportunity:
OpenSesame is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer that values and welcomes diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of various legally protected characteristics, including criminal history, and strive to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. We prioritize safety and security and may use your information accordingly, and you can contact us for assistance or accommodations during the job application process.

Pay Transparency:
At OpenSesame, we prioritize pay transparency, fairness, and equity to create a positive and inclusive work environment, regularly reviewing our compensation practices to align with our values and goals. We provide competitive and fair compensation to our employees based on their skills, experience, and performance.

CPRA (California Candidates):
When you submit your application, OpenSesame may collect and use your personal information in accordance with our privacy policy and the CPRA.
This may include personal details and employment history, and will only be used for employment-related purposes. We may share this information with third-party service providers, but we will not sell it to third parties. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us, and for more information on your rights under the CPRA, refer to our privacy policy
or the California Attorney General's website.

We Care About Your Security:
We’ve been made aware of a phishing scam involving individuals impersonating OpenSesame recruiters. All legitimate communication from our team will come from @opensesame.com email addresses. If you receive a suspicious message, please contact us directly at careers@opensesame.com . Your security matters to us, thank you for staying vigilant.

Blue Star Families

Blue Star Families is the largest nonprofit dedicated to making military life better for families. Each year, we support over 1.5 million military- and veteran-connected family members through a national network of 300,000+ members and local chapters in communities across the country.

Our mission is simple and bold: We make military life awesome for families.

We listen, share, partner, and act to deliver evidence-based, data-driven solutions that work for real people. We’re a lifestyle organization, a friend and neighbor, and a trusted partner. Our approach is collaborative, human-centered, and designed with the whole family in mind.

A Blue Star Family is one with an immediate family member — a spouse, parent, or child — actively serving in the U.S. Armed Forces, including the Guard and Reserves. These families face unique challenges: frequent relocations, deployments, career disruption, and isolation. We respond with research-informed programs that create connection, build resilience, and foster a true sense of belonging.

We serve with urgency but build trust over time — because change happens at the speed of trust. Whether we’re driving spouse employment, supporting caregivers, or helping communities welcome military families, we strive for upstream solutions.

Who We’re Looking For

Bold thinkers. Fast movers. Smart collaborators. People who want to build, lead, and drive measurable change — and who care deeply about making an impact that matters.

What You’ll Do Here

Solve complex challenges with data, heart, and humility
Build cross-sector partnerships that get things done
Help military families feel at home wherever they live

If you're ready to work in a high-performance, mission-driven environment — and to make life better for those who serve — Blue Star Families is where you belong.

General Description

The Vice President, Direct Marketing & Peer-to-Peer Fundraising leads the strategy and performance of Blue Star Families' direct response and peer-to-peer fundraising programs. This role grows BSF's broad base of individual donors through multi-channel direct marketing. It also builds scalable peer-to-peer and grassroots giving programs that engage volunteers, ambassadors, chapter members and community members as fundraisers on behalf of military families.

Reporting to the Chief Development Officer and directly supervising [direct report title(s)], this leader partners closely with Marketing, Development Operations and Chapters/Programs staff to integrate direct marketing and peer-to-peer fundraising into the organization's broader revenue strategy.

This role requires the ability to travel overnight several times per year to attend team offsites, leadership sessions, fundraising events and company-wide events. Attendance and participation in these gatherings is a non-negotiable component of the position.

Key Job Functions

Direct Marketing & Mass-Market Fundraising

Oversee multi-channel direct response strategy, including donor acquisition, retention, reactivation, and upgrade pathways across direct mail, email, digital advertising, SMS, and other mass-market channels.
Set annual revenue goals, budgets and performance benchmarks for direct marketing programs.
Ensure rigorous segmentation, A/B testing, and performance-based ROI analysis to inform channel investment, with a bias toward rapid experimentation and scaling winning plays.
Manage relationships with external direct marketing vendors and agencies (e.g., MissionWired), ensuring quality, timeliness, and cost-effectiveness; hold partners to the same high-performance standard as internal team members.
Monitor campaign performance, donor acquisition costs, retention, and lifetime value metrics, adjusting strategy as needed.
Build a clear pathway that moves donors from first-time gifts to recurring, mid-level and major gift potential.

Peer-to-Peer & Grassroots Fundraising

Design and grow peer-to-peer fundraising programs (e.g., team and individual fundraising campaigns, DIY fundraising, ambassador programs) to diversify and expand BSF's donor base.
Partner with Marketing to build compelling peer-to-peer campaign assets, digital fundraising pages, and participant communications.
Develop toolkits, training and playbooks that equip volunteers, ambassadors and chapter leaders to fundraise effectively.
Set and track participant recruitment, fundraising, and retention goals across peer-to-peer campaigns.
Create a visible scoreboard and recognition program that celebrates top fundraisers and teams and fuels healthy competition.
Launch, test, and iterate on new peer-to-peer concepts quickly, scaling winning approaches and retiring those that underperform.
Convert peer-to-peer donors and participants into ongoing supporters through targeted direct marketing follow-up.

Team Leadership & Performance Management

Supervise staff and provide leadership and coaching to expand the chapter fundraising support function.
Develop, coach, and appraise staff to ensure high performance and professional growth, providing regular, candid feedback and addressing performance gaps promptly.
Build a high-talent-density team in which every member understands the strategy, owns their results, and makes decisions quickly.
Foster a collaborative, solutions-oriented culture aligned with BSF values across the chapter network, grounded in freedom, responsibility, and accountability.

Program Integration & Cross-Functional Coordination

Partner with Marketing & Communications on donor messaging, campaign creative, branding and channel strategy.
Coordinate with the Chapters/Programs team to engage chapter members and volunteers in peer-to-peer campaigns.
Ensure alignment between direct marketing, peer-to-peer, major gifts, corporate and events strategies to build strong donor pipelines.

Systems, Data & Reporting

Oversee accurate tracking of chapter and peer-to-peer fundraising activity within the CRM, ensuring data integrity and consistent reporting.
Establish performance dashboards and revenue pacing for direct marketing and peer-to-peer channels, using them as a real-time scoreboard for the team.
Provide regular reporting to the Chief Development Officer, and to the Board as needed, on channel performance, donor retention and revenue forecasts.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Experience, Skills, Background

8+ years of progressive nonprofit development experience, including experience with chapter-based, affiliate, or peer-to-peer fundraising models.
3+ years of experience managing staff or leading a team.
Demonstrated experience building or scaling peer-to-peer, grassroots, or volunteer-driven fundraising programs.
A proven track record of meeting or exceeding ambitious revenue and participation goals, with specific, measurable wins you can speak to.
An athlete's mindset: high energy, competitive drive, resilience after setbacks, and a hunger to keep improving.
A coach's ability to motivate, hold accountable, and bring out the best in staff and volunteers alike.
Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy and accountability, and the ability to give and receive candid feedback.
Experience developing training, toolkits, or resources to support a distributed or volunteer fundraising network.
Strong relationship-building skills with the ability to motivate and support volunteer leaders across a geographically dispersed organization.
Demonstrated success working with CRM systems (preferably Salesforce) and peer-to-peer fundraising platforms.
Strong organizational, analytical, and communication skills.
Ability to travel to chapters and organizational gatherings several times per year, including overnight travel.
May be required to work nights, weekends, and holidays as necessary to carry out key job functions.

Desired Experience, Skills & Background

Bachelor's degree in nonprofit management, business administration, or a related field.
Experience in membership-driven, chapter-based, or affiliate nonprofit organizations.
Familiarity with the military and Veteran-connected community.
Experience with peer-to-peer fundraising software (e.g., Classy, GoFundMe Charity, OneCause).
Experience in a high-growth, performance-driven culture (nonprofit or private sector).

More About Blue Star Families

Blue Star Families empowers military and Veteran families to thrive by connecting them with their civilian neighbors — both people and organizations — to create strong communities of mutual support. We believe we're all stronger when we take care of one another.

Our groundbreaking research is raising the nation's awareness of the unique challenges of military family life. With the help of neighbors across the country, Blue Star Families is overcoming the isolation and alienation of frequent moves, deployments, and reduced support from the government. Our innovative programs are solving specific challenges for military families, including fighting economic insecurity with resources that foster spouse career development, creating family strength with rich family programming, and providing critical peer support for caregivers, whose numbers are only increasing.

Blue Star Families is a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization.
